蹴鞠_KEMARI　Japanese Football in Kyoto
description:
京都府の中部、京丹波町で蹴鞠を体験することができます。
https://morinokyoto.jp/event/event-117616/

1400年以上の日本の歴史のなかで愛され続ける「蹴鞠」。
それに欠かせない道具が「鹿革鞠」です。その鞠を鹿皮からすべての工程を昔ながらの製法で復活させた、唯一の鞠師が京丹波美女山の里にいます。鞠足としても40年の経験を持つ池田游達氏が、実演を交えて「蹴鞠の真髄」をお話します。
京都の文化を楽しく、生涯スポーツKEMARIとして体験できます。

title: KEMARI - Japanese Football in Kyoto
description:
You can experience KEMARI in Kyotanba Town, located in the central part of Kyoto Prefecture.
https://morinokyoto.jp/event/event-117616/

KEMARI, which has been loved for over 1400 years in Japanese history.
An essential tool for it is the 'deer leather ball.' The only ball maker who has revived the entire process of making these balls from deer skin using traditional methods is located in the beautiful mountains of Kyotanba. Mr. Yutaka Ikeda, who has 40 years of experience as a KEMARI player, will share the 'essence of KEMARI' with a live demonstration.
You can enjoy and experience Kyoto's culture as a lifelong sport, KEMARI.

title: 暮らしのそばに、ほら世界。
description:
https://etooto.jp/

市内へと向かうトンネルを抜けると、
目の前には海と街が同時に現れる。
港をぐるりと取り囲む斜面には、家々がひしめいている。
かつてこの街には海の向こうからやってきた外国人と
海の向こうを目指す志士や幕臣が行き交っていた。
今も、ポルトガルのお菓子と、オランダの商館と、中華街と、
造船所と、うまい魚料理がごちゃまぜに同居している。
日本の西の端に位置する長崎市は、遠い。
その印象に反するように、海と街、人と人の距離は、近い。
街の人は言う。
すべてを受け入れる長崎市民の懐の広さが
この街を常に新しい街へと進化させてきた、と。
その意味を理解できるまで、あと何度か通うことになりそうだ。

title: Nearby in life, look, the world.
description:
https://etooto.jp/

As I pass through the tunnel heading into the city,
I am greeted by both the sea and the city at once.
On the slopes surrounding the port, houses are crowded together.
Once, this city was bustling with foreigners arriving from across the sea
and those who aspired to reach beyond the sea, including warriors and samurai.
Even now, Portuguese sweets, Dutch trading posts, Chinatown,
shipyards, and delicious fish dishes coexist in a delightful mix.
Nagasaki City, located at the western edge of Japan, feels distant.
Contrary to that impression, the distance between the sea and the city, and between people, is close.
The people of the city say,
the open-mindedness of Nagasaki citizens, who embrace everything,
has continually evolved this city into a new one.
It seems I will need to visit a few more times to fully understand that meaning.

title: THE ROOTS #05 人に伝えたくなるメロン
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

瀬戸内海の穏やかな島
因島重井町は、スイカの名産地。
ただ、ごく少数の農家さんによって
極上のマスクメロンが栽培されることを
知る人は多くない。

その稀少な「因島メロン」を
稼業として継ぎ
「熊八屋」を盛り立てる
村上智規（むらかみとものり）さん。
瀬戸の凪をうわまわる穏やかさ、
元・絵描きらしい。

「熊八屋」とは
智規さんが彼女とメロンに惚れ込んで
婿入りした農家の屋号で、
初代“熊八じいさん”に由来する。
（重井町にはユニークな屋号が多く残る）
智規さんは五代目。

「甘さ」は糖度計で測れるけど、
「美味しさ」とは、人の心が動くこと。
つくり手の想いを
島の子どもたちにも届ける。
給食にメロンだ。贅沢っ！

適期適作。
メロンも、子どもたちも
おおらかな島の時間に添うて、
愛され、育つ。
美味しさの理由はそこにある。

さあ、ひとくち、召し上がれ。

title: THE ROOTS #05 A Melon You Want to Share with Others
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

A tranquil island in the Seto Inland Sea,
Inushima Shigei Town is famous for its watermelons.
However, not many people know that
only a handful of farmers cultivate
exquisite musk melons.

Tomonori Murakami, who continues the rare
"Inushima Melon" as a family business
and supports "Kumahachiya."
He embodies the calmness that surpasses
the tranquility of the Seto Sea,
a former painter.

"Kumahachiya" is the name of the farm
where Tomonori fell in love with his girlfriend
and melons, and it is derived from
the first generation "Kumahachi-san."
(Shigei Town has many unique farm names.)
Tomonori is the fifth generation.

While "sweetness" can be measured with a sugar meter,
"deliciousness" is about moving people's hearts.
He delivers the feelings of the producers
even to the children of the island.
Melon in school lunches. How luxurious!

Timely and appropriate cultivation.
Both melons and children
grow loved and nurtured,
along with the generous time of the island.
The reason for their deliciousness lies there.

Now, take a bite and enjoy.

title: THE ROOTS #02 一年で嫁ぐにんにく
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

福山市加茂町で農業を営む
岡本啓二（おかもとけいじ）さん。
20年前から農業に たずさわり、
にんにくを作り始めたのは3年前。

無農薬＝除草剤を使わないこと。
すると、畑の畔には雑草が生い茂るし
虫だって集まってくる。
当然、手間はかかるし、心配も絶えない。

それでも、手がかかる「娘」ほどかわいい。

溢れんばかりの愛情をたっぷり受けて
天真爛漫に育った「娘」たちは
雑味がなく、素直な味がする。
それは、ほかの野菜も同じこと。

素直な素材には、シンプルな調理を。
岡本さんオススメの食べ方は、
にんにくを塩こしょうだけで炒めること。

まずはひとかけ、めしあがれ。

title: THE ROOTS #02 Garlic Married in a Year
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

Keiji Okamoto, who runs a farm in Kamo Town, Fukuyama.
He has been involved in agriculture for 20 years,
and started growing garlic three years ago.

No pesticides = not using herbicides.
As a result, weeds grow thick along the field's edge,
and insects gather as well.
Naturally, it takes effort, and worries never cease.

Even so, the 'daughter' that requires care is the most precious.

Receiving an abundance of overflowing love,
the 'daughters' have grown up carefree,
with a pure and straightforward taste.
The same goes for other vegetables.

For simple ingredients, simple cooking.
Mr. Okamoto's recommended way to enjoy it is
to sauté garlic with just salt and pepper.

First, try one clove.

description:

title: Tamabayama Tourism PR: Exploration of the Hidden Gold Mine of the Takeda Clan
description:
It is said that during the era of Takeda Shingen, a gold mine magistrate was established in Tamabayama Village for the mining of the Kurokawa Gold Mine. Remnants of this can still be found within the village, and we will head to the gold mine site with a guide.
As you walk along the stream, which is also a source of water for Tokyo, please experience the blessings of water with all your senses.

title: 侍う-SABURAU- 展in錦 〜原点回帰〜2022年3月12日(土)より開催決定！
description:
一般社団法人錦まち観光協会は、2022年3月12(土)から4月10日(日)までの31日間で「侍う-SABURAU- 展 in 錦 ～原点回帰～」を開催いたします。
 
『 侍う-SABURAU- 』プロジェクト

『 侍う-SABURAU- 』とは「侍」の語源です。当プロジェクトは「侍」をテーマとし、武芸、武具を始めとする伝統文化とポップカルチャーをコラボレーションさせることでその魅力を世界に伝え、尚且つ後世に繋いでゆくことを目的としています。

若者や子ども達、海外の人びとからは、敷居が高く難解なイメージを持たれる伝統文化を、マンガ、アニメ、ゲーム等ポップカルチャーを通じ、誰もが今昔を身近に感じ、楽しんでいただける内容となっております。

2022年3月開催の『 侍う-SABURAU-展 in 錦 』では、熊本県錦町に伝わる西の天下一といわれた古流剣術「兵法タイ捨流」と「侍」を題材としたマンガやアニメ作品、オリジナルアートや映像、武具等が多数展示されます。

1. 展覧会名
侍う-SABURAU- 展in錦 〜原点回帰〜
2. 会期
2022（令和4）３月12日（土）～４月10日（日）31日間
9:00～16:00(入館は15:30まで)  休館日なし
日　時　
令和4年3月12日（土）　
9：30～受付開始
10：00～開幕式

3.  会場
錦町立人吉海軍航空基地資料館（にしき ひみつ基地ミュージアム）
（〒868-0301　熊本県球磨郡錦町大字木上西２－１０７）
4. 入館料　
錦町立人吉海軍航空基地資料館へのご入館でご覧いただけます。
・大人(高校生以上)　800円　・小・中学生　500円　・未就学児　無料

5. 概要
錦町にゆかりある「兵法タイ捨流」。創始から450年を経過する今も脈々と受け継がれる歴史ある日本伝統古武道の一つ。国内外の門人と共に兵法タイ捨流と日本の伝統文化を伝える活動を続けています。
本展は、これまで2019年のイタリア開催のご要望に応えて以来、国内外9か所で開催されており、熊本県錦町では初の凱旋展となります。
展示会では、日本の「侍」をテーマにした展示を柱に、兵法タイ捨流演武披露、刀剣類、国宝青井阿蘇神社所蔵品、古武道にゆかり有るサブカルチャー作品としてドリフターズ、武装少女マキャヴェリズム、MUJIN -無尽-といった漫画の原画資料等を展示し、オリジナルグッズの販売を行います。
・出展作品(約200点予定)


主催：（一社）錦まち観光協会、侍う実行委員会

【会場イベント】
　　兵法タイ捨流演武
　　筆字作家 雪駄氏 実演・ライブドローイング 
　　赤松太郎兼光氏 銘切実演
　　※その他調整中

兵法タイ捨流（日本遺産構成文化財）
今から約450年前の戦国時代に流祖　丸目蔵人佐(まるめくらんどのすけ)が、実戦で培った経験を工夫研究研鑽し、自分を活かし相手も活かす活殺剣法を編み出した。
タイ捨流の「タイ」という言葉には、漢字にすると「体」（からだ）「待」（まつ）「対」（つい）「退」（さがる）など多くの漢字が当てはまる。「体」を使うことを捨てる、「待つ」ことを捨てる、「対峙」することを捨てる、「退がる」ことを捨てる。
即ち、考えずに動ける自然体。自然と共に在ること。「タイ捨」という言葉にはこのような意味が込められている。
熊本県錦町ゆかりの古武道である兵法タイ捨流は、第15代上原エリ子が宗家を務め熊本県八代市に本部を置き、国内に100人、海外に70人の門下生を持ち、伝統の継承はもとより世界に伝統文化を発信する活動を行っている。平成29年5月、日本遺産 人吉球磨「相良700年が生んだ保守と進取の文化」が認定を受け、兵法タイ捨流は構成文化財の一つとして名を連ねている。
兵法タイ捨流は、日本の伝統古武道として国外で注目されている。今年2022年には、イギリスでタイ捨流の本が出版予定で、発刊プロモーションとして熊本の伝統文化を中心とした50本以上の動画をYou Tubeにて配信する取り組みが行われている。
兵法タイ捨流 剣術道場 龍泉館 公式サイト　https://www.taisharyu.jp/

これまで兵法タイ捨流は、2014年よりヨーロッパの門下生と共にタイ捨流の稽古会セミナーを開始し年間500名程がセミナーを受講。2019年にはイタリア・ヴェネツィアで開催された世界空手大会において演武披露及び日本文化を紹介する展示会「Samurai Expo侍うin ITARY」には延べ6000人が来場した。　　


国内においては、同年、国宝青井阿蘇神社（熊本県人吉市）において「Samurai Expo侍う凱旋展」を一夜限り（4時間）で開催し、500人が来場したことで大きな注目を集めた。


侍(さぶら)う―SABURAU―展では、古武道とサブカルチャーの融合展示及びイベントが行われる。サブカルチャー作品のラインラップは、少年画報社「月間アワーズ」で連載中のドリフターズ、KADOKAWA『月刊少年エース』連載の武装少女マキャヴェリズムなどが中心となる。
これらの人気作品に登場するメインキャラクターが、タイ捨流の使い手であることから原画の提供など協力体制が実現した。

熊本県錦町との関係性
熊本県南部に位置し、梨、桃など農産物の生産が盛んであり、2018年には戦後70年を経て歴史が解明された「人吉海軍航空基地」を紹介する資料館がオープンした。
町のキャッチフレーズは「剣豪とフルーツの里」。
ゆかりの剣豪「丸目蔵人佐」を顕彰した剣道大会は、これまでに51回を数える。
これまでタイ捨流の海外活動を町のプロモーション活動としてとらえ支援を行っている。2017年には、日本の文化を紹介するタイ捨流の活動と共に錦町もイタリアトリノ市長より感謝状を受けている。

title: Samurai -SABURAU- Exhibition in Nishiki ~Return to the Origin~ Starting March 12, 2022!
description:
The Nishiki Town Tourism Association will hold the 'Samurai -SABURAU- Exhibition in Nishiki ~Return to the Origin~' for 31 days from March 12 (Saturday) to April 10 (Sunday), 2022.

' Samurai -SABURAU- ' Project

' Samurai -SABURAU- ' is derived from the word 'samurai.' This project aims to convey the charm of 'samurai' by collaborating traditional culture, including martial arts and weapons, with pop culture, and to pass it on to future generations.

Through manga, anime, and games, we aim to make traditional culture, which is often perceived as highbrow and difficult by young people, children, and foreigners, accessible and enjoyable for everyone.

At the 'Samurai -SABURAU- Exhibition in Nishiki' in March 2022, numerous displays will feature the ancient swordsmanship 'Heihō Taisharyū,' known as the best in the west, passed down in Nishiki Town, Kumamoto Prefecture, as well as manga and anime works themed around 'samurai,' original art, videos, and weapons.

1. Exhibition Name
Samurai -SABURAU- Exhibition in Nishiki ~Return to the Origin~
2. Exhibition Period
March 12, 2022 (Saturday) to April 10, 2022 (Sunday) for 31 days
9:00 AM to 4:00 PM (Admission until 3:30 PM) No closed days
Date and Time
March 12, 2022 (Saturday)
Reception starts at 9:30 AM
Opening ceremony at 10:00 AM

3. Venue
Nishiki Town Historical Museum of the Navy Air Base (Nishiki Secret Base Museum)
(2-107, Kinoshita Nishi, Nishiki Town, Kumamoto Prefecture, 868-0301)
4. Admission Fee
You can view the exhibition by entering the Nishiki Town Historical Museum of the Navy Air Base.
・Adults (high school students and above) 800 yen ・Elementary and junior high school students 500 yen ・Preschool children free

5. Overview
'Heihō Taisharyū,' which has ties to Nishiki Town, is one of Japan's traditional martial arts that has been passed down for over 450 years. We continue activities to convey Heihō Taisharyū and Japanese traditional culture with disciples from both Japan and abroad.
This exhibition has been held in nine locations domestically and internationally since responding to requests for an event in Italy in 2019, and it will be the first homecoming exhibition in Nishiki Town, Kumamoto Prefecture.
The exhibition will feature displays themed around Japan's 'samurai,' demonstrations of Heihō Taisharyū, swords, national treasures from Aso Shrine, and original works related to subculture such as 'Drifters,' 'Armed Girl Machiavellism,' and original merchandise sales.
・Exhibited works (approximately 200 pieces planned)

Organized by: Nishiki Town Tourism Association, Samurai Executive Committee
Supported by: Nishiki Town, Nishiki Town Board of Education, Kumamoto Prefecture, Hitoyoshi City, Hitoyoshi City Board of Education, Kumamoto Nichinichi Shimbun, Kumamoto Broadcasting, Kumamoto Prefecture Kobudo Association, National Treasure Aso Shrine, All Japan Swordsmith Association Kyushu Branch
Cooperation: Shōnen Gahōsha Young King Editorial Department, KADOKAWA, Sanshin Co., Ltd.
Kimura Nihon Art Sword Taro Tamura Forge, Engines Co., Ltd., Layer Co., Ltd., Junpu Design, Heihō Taisharyū Ryūsenkan, Nishiki Town Historical Museum of the Navy Air Base

Event Schedule During the Exhibition
Please check the website for the event schedule during the exhibition period.
https://www.saburau.org/

【Venue Events】
Heihō Taisharyū Demonstration
Calligraphy artist Yuki's live drawing performance
Taro Akamatsu's engraving demonstration
*Other events are under adjustment.

Heihō Taisharyū (Cultural Heritage of Japan)
About 450 years ago during the Warring States period, the founder, Marume Kurando no suke, developed a sword technique that utilizes both oneself and the opponent through practical experience and research. The word 'Tai' in Taisharyū can correspond to many kanji such as '体' (body), '待' (wait), '対' (confront), and '退' (retreat). It means to discard the use of 'body,' to discard 'waiting,' to discard 'confrontation,' and to discard 'retreat.'
In other words, it is a natural state of being that can move without thinking. It embodies being in harmony with nature. The term 'Taisharyū' carries this meaning.
Heihō Taisharyū, a traditional martial art with ties to Nishiki Town, is led by the 15th generation Uehara Eriko, with its headquarters in Yatsushiro City, Kumamoto Prefecture, having 100 disciples in Japan and 70 overseas, continuing activities to transmit traditional culture to the world. In May 2017, the cultural heritage 'Cultural Heritage of Sagara born from 700 years of conservatism and innovation' was certified as a Japanese heritage, and Heihō Taisharyū is listed as one of the cultural properties.
Heihō Taisharyū is gaining attention as a traditional martial art of Japan overseas. In 2022, a book on Taisharyū is scheduled to be published in the UK, and as part of the publication promotion, over 50 videos centered on Kumamoto's traditional culture are being distributed on YouTube.
Heihō Taisharyū Kenjutsu Dojo Ryūsenkan Official Website https://www.taisharyu.jp/

Since 2014, Heihō Taisharyū has started training seminars with disciples in Europe, with about 500 participants annually. In 2019, at the World Karate Championship held in Venice, Italy, 6,000 people attended the demonstration and exhibition introducing Japanese culture 'Samurai Expo SABURAU in ITALY.'

Domestically, in the same year, a one-night-only (4 hours) 'Samurai Expo SABURAU Homecoming Exhibition' was held at the National Treasure Aso Shrine (Hitoyoshi City, Kumamoto Prefecture), attracting 500 visitors and garnering significant attention.

The Samurai -SABURAU- Exhibition will feature a fusion of traditional martial arts and subculture displays and events. The lineup of subculture works will mainly include 'Drifters,' serialized in Shōnen Gahōsha's 'Monthly Hours,' and 'Armed Girl Machiavellism,' serialized in KADOKAWA's 'Monthly Shōnen Ace.'
The main characters in these popular works are practitioners of Taisharyū, leading to a collaborative effort such as providing original drawings.

Relationship with Nishiki Town
Located in the southern part of Kumamoto Prefecture, Nishiki Town is known for its production of agricultural products such as pears and peaches. In 2018, a museum introducing the 'Hitoyoshi Navy Air Base,' whose history was clarified after 70 years post-war, opened.
The town's catchphrase is 'The Land of Swordmasters and Fruits.'
A kendo tournament honoring the swordmaster 'Marume Kurando no suke' has been held 51 times to date.
Nishiki Town has supported Heihō Taisharyū's overseas activities as part of its promotional efforts. In 2017, Nishiki Town received a letter of appreciation from the mayor of Turin, Italy, for its activities introducing Japanese culture alongside Taisharyū.

title: 2021年度森の京都文化観光サポーターラジオ 第3回「丹波の漆かき」
description:

 第3回目は【丹波の漆かき】
京都府福知山市夜久野町は古くから「丹波漆」が採れる日本でも有数の漆の産地です。そこには、日本の伝統産業を守り、受け継いでいく漆かき職人がいます。

 番組前半は漆の基礎知識編。
江戸時代に盛んだった漆かき、現在使われている漆は9割が輸入漆です。
この貴重な国産漆のスゴイをご紹介します！

後半は漆かき職人でNPO法人丹波漆の広報担当でもある山内耕祐さんをゲストに迎えお話しを伺います。漆との出会い、福知山移住のきっかけ、苦労されることや漆の魅力などをお聞きしました。爽やかな印象の山内さんの漆に対する熱い想いにサポーターも感動！

title: 2021 Forest of Kyoto Cultural Tourism Supporter Radio Episode 3: "Tamba's Lacquer Harvesting"
description:
This is the broadcast audio of the radio program "Forest of Kyoto presents Do You Know? Traditional Culture in Fukuchiyama" on Kyoto FM Tanba. The Forest of Kyoto Cultural Tourism Supporters will introduce the intangible cultural heritage of Fukuchiyama from the perspective of supporters once a month.

The third episode features 【Tamba's Lacquer Harvesting】. 
Yakuno Town in Fukuchiyama City, Kyoto Prefecture, has long been one of Japan's leading lacquer-producing areas known for "Tamba Lacquer." There, lacquer harvesting artisans work to protect and pass on Japan's traditional industries.

The first half of the program covers the basics of lacquer. 
Lacquer harvesting was thriving during the Edo period, and currently, 90% of the lacquer used is imported. 
We will introduce the amazing qualities of this precious domestic lacquer!

In the second half, we welcome Kousuke Yamauchi, a lacquer harvesting artisan and the public relations officer of the NPO Tamba Lacquer, as our guest to share his story. We asked him about his encounter with lacquer, the reasons for moving to Fukuchiyama, the challenges he faces, and the charm of lacquer. The supporters were moved by Yamauchi's passionate feelings towards lacquer, which left a refreshing impression!

Miki Kondo: A mother of three from Fukuchiyama, a barista, English teacher, and guide, working in various fields as a multi-talented individual. Her hobbies include watching movies and dramas, and exploring caves and ruins.

Eisuke Adachi: Born and raised in Fukuchiyama, a person who loves Fukuchiyama. He enjoys drawing illustrations, participating in local events, and various aspects of Fukuchiyama life. In the future, he wants to live a careful and thoughtful life!

description:
北海道の魅力的な観光スポットや観光資源を紹介するBEST HOKKAIDO。
北海道の絶景景色を様々な角度から映像でお届けします。

#ベスト北海道　#北海道観光　#サンタランド

今回は、広尾町にある「サンタランド」をご紹介します。

北海道十勝にある広尾町はサンタクロースの故郷ノルウェーのオスロ市が認めた国外初、日本で唯一のサンタランドです。
サンタランドの活動拠点であるフログン市と友好交流提携を結び、サンタランドの基本理念「愛と平和、感謝と奉仕」に基づいたまちづくりを行っています。

日本一早いクリスマス点灯式である「サンタランドツリー点灯式」が行われ、15万球のイルミネーションで彩る「サンタランドイルミネーション」は11月から楽しめます。また、2020年にはシンボルツリーとなるクリスマスツリーが植樹されました。カップルにオススメな場所です。

詳しくはこちらから ▼
https://www.santaland.or.jp/


This time, we will introduce "Santa Land" in Hiroo Town.

Hiroo Town, located in Tokachi, Hokkaido, is the first SantaLand in Japan and the first outside Japan to be recognized by Oslo, Norway, the hometown of Santa Claus.
We have formed a friendship and exchange partnership with Frogn City, the base of Santaland's activities, and are developing the town based on Santaland's basic philosophy of ``Love, Peace, Gratitude and Service.''

The ``Santaland Tree Lighting Ceremony'' is the earliest Christmas lighting ceremony in Japan, and the ``Santaland Illumination'' with 150,000 lights can be enjoyed from November. Additionally, in 2020, a Christmas tree was planted as a symbol. This place is recommended for couples.

#ベスト北海道　#北海道観光　#サロマ湖展望台

今回は、オホーツク管内佐呂間町にある「サロマ湖展望台」をご紹介。

サロマ湖展望台は、日本で3番目に広い面積を誇るサロマ湖全体を見渡すことができる唯一の場所で、周囲に高い山がないため、ここでしか見られない壮大なパノラマをお楽しみいただけます。
展望台からは湖と海を仕切る「龍宮街道」とも呼ばれる砂州や、天気が良い日は遠く知床連山を見渡すこともできます。

展望台には３つの望遠鏡がついておりサロマ湖のすみからすみまで眺めることができ、その眺望は一級です。

詳しくはこちらから ▼
https://www.town.saroma.hokkaido.jp/kakuka/keizaika/tenboudai.html



This time, we will introduce the "Lake Saroma Observatory" in Saroma-cho, Okhotsk.

Lake Saroma Observatory is the only place where you can see the whole of Lake Saroma, which is the third largest lake in Japan, and there are no high mountains around, so you can enjoy a magnificent panorama that can only be seen here. 
From the observatory, you can also see the sandbar, also known as the "Ryugu Kaido" that separates the lake and the sea, and the Shiretoko mountain range in the distance on a clear day.

The observatory has three telescopes, and you can see every corner of Lake Saroma, and the view is first-class.

title: 羊蹄山 4K／北海道の絶景景色 【BESTHOKKAIDO_VOL.102】Superb view of Hokkaido／Mt.Yotei
description:
北海道の魅力な観光スポットや観光資源を紹介するBEST HOKKAIDO。
北海道の絶景景色を様々な角度から映像でお届けします。

#ベスト北海道　#北海道観光　#羊蹄山

今回は、別名”蝦夷富士”とも呼ばれる均整のとれた円錐形の成層火山「羊蹄山 」を紹介します。

札幌中心部から車で約2時間、後志地方南部に位置する羊蹄山の標高は1,898メートル。支笏洞爺国立公園に属しており、日本百名山にも認定されている名峰です。
登山スポットとしても人気で、4種類の登山コースがあり、頂上からは日本海や太平洋を見渡すことができます。

周囲には、羊蹄山に降った雨や雪が長い年月をかけて大地に染みこみ、ろ過されたミネラル成分たっぷりの湧き水が汲めるスポットもあります。

詳しくはこちらから！
https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/spot/detail_10334.html

This time, we will introduce the well-proportioned cone-shaped stratovolcano "Mt. Yotei", also known as "Ezo Fuji".

About 2 hours by car from the center of Sapporo, Mt. Yotei is located in the southern part of Shiribeshi region and has an altitude of 1,898 meters.
It belongs to Shikotsu-Toya National Park and is a famous peak that has been certified as one of the 100 famous mountains in Japan.
It is also popular as a mountain climbing spot, and there are 4 types of climbing courses, and from the top you can overlook the Sea of ​​Japan and the Pacific Ocean.

In the surrounding area, there are spots where you can get spring water with plenty of mineral ingredients that has been filtered after the rain and snow that fell on Mt. Yotei soaked into the earth over many years.

For more information is here！

今回は北海道の白老町にある「ポロト湖」をご紹介。
ポロト湖は、周囲約４㎞、面積33haの湖。
周りに湿原や森林が広がる自然豊かな場所で、ポロトとはアイヌ語で「大きな沼」の意味。
湖の南側の湖畔には、伝統的なアイヌの集落を再現したアイヌの歴史を紹介するナショナルセンター「ウポポイ」民族共生象徴空間があります。

冬には、一面が凍り付きワカサギ釣りが楽しむことができます。


This time, we will introduce "Lake Poroto" in Shiraoi Town, Hokkaido.
Lake Poroto is a lake with a circumference of about 4 km and an area of ??33 ha.
In a place rich in nature with moors and forests surrounding it, Poroto means "big swamp" in the Ainu language.
On the shore of the lake on the south side of the lake, there is the national center "Upopoy", a symbolic space for ethnic symbiosis, which introduces the history of the Ainu, which reproduces the traditional Ainu settlement.

In winter, you can enjoy smelt fishing with freezing on one side.

description:
なかなかうきはを訪れることができない方へ、「うきはの今」をお届けします。

#調音の滝
春の新緑、秋の紅葉と、滝は時々の自然と美しく調和し、訪れる人々にやすらぎを与えてくれます。夏はとりわけ心地よく、別天地の涼しさに我を忘れてしまうほど。カジカが鳴く清流では、そうめん流しの楽しみもあります。また、夏期限定で、地元住民によるお茶やしいたけ、手作りこんにゃくなど自然の恵み豊かな特産品を販売しています。四季を通して魅力に溢れたステキなところです。平成7年には林野庁の「水源の森百選」に選ばれました。

調音の滝公園園内には、十代有馬藩主の妻、清雲院が巡行の折、滝の水音が音を奏でるかのように聴こえたことに由来する「調音の滝」をはじめ、「魚返りの滝」「斧渕の滝」「三重（みしけ）の滝」の三つの滝があります。四季折々の景色を眺めながらの散策をお楽しみください。

title: Choonnotaki: The Current of Ukiha | UkihaDays
description:
For those who cannot visit Ukiha often, we bring you 'The Current of Ukiha'.

#Choonnotaki
In spring, the fresh greenery and in autumn, the colorful leaves harmonize beautifully with the waterfall, providing tranquility to visitors. Summer is particularly pleasant, making one forget the heat in this refreshing paradise. In the clear stream where the river stones sing, you can also enjoy the fun of flowing somen noodles. Additionally, during the summer season, local residents sell abundant local specialties such as tea, shiitake mushrooms, and handmade konnyaku, all gifts from nature. It is a wonderful place full of charm throughout the four seasons. In 1995, it was selected as one of the '100 Forests of Water Sources' by the Forestry Agency.

Within Choonnotaki Park, there are three waterfalls: 'Choonnotaki', named after the sound of the waterfall that was said to resemble music when the wife of the 10th lord of the Arima clan, Seiun-in, visited; 'Uo-kaeri no Taki'; and 'Ono-buchi no Taki'. Enjoy a stroll while taking in the seasonal scenery.

城ヶ鼻公園内にある浮羽稲荷は、伏見稲荷神社から稲倉魂の神（うがみたまのかみ、通称、稲荷大神（いなりおおかみ））、京都松尾大社から大山咋の神（おおやまぐいのかみ）、太宰府天満宮から菅原道真公の三神が祀られており、商売繁盛、五穀豊穣、酒造と健康、長命長寿、学問の神様と言われています。

description:
For those who cannot visit Ukiha often, we bring you 'Ukiha Now'.

#Ukiha Inari Shrine (https://ukiha-inari.jp/)
Located within Jōgahana Park, Ukiha Inari Shrine enshrines three deities: Uga Mitama no Kami (commonly known as Inari Ōkami) from Fushimi Inari Shrine, Ōyama Kushi no Kami from Matsuo Taisha in Kyoto, and Sugawara no Michizane from Dazaifu Tenmangu. They are said to bless prosperity in business, abundant harvests, sake brewing and health, longevity, and academic success.
Climbing the red torii gates that continue along the mountain leads to a scenic viewpoint with a great view. On a clear day, you can see Harazuru Onsen and even as far as Amagi. It is also known as a famous cherry blossom spot in spring.
In recent years, it has become a popular spot on social media, attracting many visitors.

description:
The people living on the Shimanami Kaido gently share the charm of the Shimanami Kaido with those who will visit in the future. title: CYCLING SHIMANAMI 2022（サイクリングしまなみ2022）｜Japan’s biggest cycle event!｜しまなみ海道｜しまなみジャパン
description:
2022年10月30日（日）に開催された『サイクリングしまなみ2022』の模様を通して、しまなみ海道・ゆめしま海道の美しい景観とサイクリングの魅力を感じていただける動画を作成しました。地域住民やこの地の文化との触れ合いなど、しまなみ海道を楽しむためのヒントも随所にちりばめられています。この動画をご覧になって、ぜひ一度この地を訪れてみてください。皆さまのお越しをお待ちしています！

https://shimanami-cycle.or.jp/


▼ English 　------------------------------------------

The 70km-long Shimanami Kaido in Japan is one of the world’s most beautiful and accessible bike routes, and is enjoyable at any time of the year. The CYCLING SHIMANAMI event, however, is a true festival of cycling. Around 7,000 riders come from all over Japan and around the world for the rare opportunity to ride the iconic route via the expressway, the awesome views, local hospitality and relaxed vibe.
In 2022, CYCLING SHIMANAMI returned after a 4 year hiatus and was held under clear blue skies, in bright sunshine – perfect conditions for island hopping by bike.
The islands look absolutely stunning and we hope that this short film will prompt you to start planning your own cycling adventure on the Shimanami Kaido and Yumeshima Kaido.
We are looking forward to welcoming you to Shimanami!

title: Minpaku Experience 2
description:
Sora no Sato, located in the western part of Tokushima Prefecture in Shikoku, is in the Nishi-Awa area (Mima City, Miyoshi City, Tsurugi Town, Higashi-Miyoshi Town) at the center of Shikoku.
At Sora no Sato Yamasato Monogatari, we promote educational travel minpaku.
Students are welcomed as family members and collaborate in small-scale, diverse self-sufficient agriculture, such as tea picking, onion, potato, and grain harvesting.
Using the seasonal vegetables and wild plants harvested, we cook rural dishes together, share meals for heartfelt exchanges, and engage in experiences that connect with nature.

title: 【一期一会〜sustainability〜】
description:
日本有数のリゾート地、北海道ニセコのおすすめスポットを紹介するチャンネルです！

■倶知安観光協会公式SNS
【インスタグラム】
https://www.instagram.com/nisekokutchantravel/
【Twitter】
https://twitter.com/KutchanN


■一般社団法人倶知安観光協会
 https://www.niseko.co.jp/


　 
【一期一会〜sustainability〜】
　
昨年のプロモーションムービー「WELCOME BACK」では「観光再開」を掲げ、地元の方達より皆様へ届ける「おかえり」を表現しました。

今回のテーマは「一期一会」。
倶知安・ニセコは多くの出会いが溢れている場所です。
四季折々の姿を魅せる大自然。世界中から訪れる人々。
異国の食文化、地元の食産物。
「自然・人・食・文化」を通して多くの出会いを持って帰って欲しいという願いを込めました。

そして、目に見える分かりやすい環境保護活動だけが「Sustainability」ではなく、地元の方、移住者の方、観光客の方、多くの方たちとの出会いが縁となり、未来に繋がっていくことこそが大切な「Sustainability」であり、倶知安ニセコの魅力はそこにあります。

大切な「一期一会」に出会えることを、心より願っております。



このチャンネルは、北海道ニセコエリアにある倶知安観光協会（くっちゃんかんこうきょうかい）が運営しています。

title: Ichigo Ichie ~sustainability~
description:
This is a channel that introduces recommended spots in Niseko, Hokkaido, one of Japan's premier resort areas!

■ Kutchan Tourism Association Official SNS
【Instagram】
https://www.instagram.com/nisekokutchantravel/
【Twitter】
https://twitter.com/KutchanN

■ General Incorporated Association Kutchan Tourism Association
 https://www.niseko.co.jp/


Ichigo Ichie ~sustainability~

In last year's promotional movie "WELCOME BACK," we expressed the message of "reopening tourism" and conveyed the "welcome back" from the local people to everyone.

This time, the theme is "Ichigo Ichie." 
Kutchan and Niseko are places overflowing with many encounters. 
The great nature that shows its beauty in every season. People visiting from all over the world. 
Exotic food cultures and local food products. 
We hope that you will take home many encounters through "nature, people, food, and culture."

Moreover, visible and easily understandable environmental protection activities are not the only aspect of "Sustainability." The encounters with local residents, immigrants, tourists, and many others are what truly connect to the future, and that is the important "Sustainability" that embodies the charm of Kutchan and Niseko.

We sincerely hope that you will have the opportunity to experience the important "Ichigo Ichie."

title: 2025年度森の京都文化観光サポーターラジオ 第3回「丹波漆＆やくの木と漆の館」
description:
京都FM丹波のラジオ番組「森の京都presents どぅゆの～？伝統文化 in 福知山」の放送音声です。前シリーズ「知っとる？伝統文化 in 福知山」から2年、今シリーズはレギュラーゲストに福知山に住むアイルランド出身のカハルさんを迎え、福知山市の無形文化財や伝統文化を取り上げます。

第3回「丹波漆＆やくの木と漆の館」
前半は、日本の漆の歴史や海外では漆の代わりに何が使われていたかを紹介します。
後半は、福知山市夜久野町にある「やくの木と漆の館」から、館長の平岡 明子さんをゲストに迎えました。やくの木と漆の館では、丹波漆の紹介や漆かきに使われる道具が展示されている他、漆塗りや金継きの体験ができます。館ではどのような事をしているのか、また丹波漆のPRにも力を入れておられる館長にその想いを話していただきました。

近藤 美紀：サポーター5年目。福知山出身、3児の母でバリスタ、英語教室経営、英語ガイドなどいろいろな分野で働くマルチ人間。趣味は映画・ドラマ鑑賞、洞窟・廃墟の探検 。

公庄 美保子：サポーター3年目。福知山出身、2児の母。猟師。狩猟は誰だって出来る！をモットーに、福知山市有害駆除隊員として活動中。捕獲した鹿肉を使い犬用ジャーキーを加工販売(屋号　鹿鹿)、藍愛プロジェクトリーダー。

カハル・オカラハン：アイルランド出身で福知山市在住2年目で子供達に英語を教えています。日本の伝統文化や伝統芸能にとても興味があります。心の優しいスポーツマン。只今日本語猛勉強中です。

title: 2025 Forest Kyoto Cultural Tourism Supporter Radio Episode 3: 'Tamba Lacquer & Yaku Wood and Lacquer Museum'
description:
This is the broadcast audio of the Kyoto FM Tanba radio program 'Forest Kyoto presents Do You Know? Traditional Culture in Fukuchiyama.' Two years have passed since the previous series 'Do You Know? Traditional Culture in Fukuchiyama,' and in this series, we welcome our regular guest, Mr. Cahill from Ireland, who lives in Fukuchiyama, to discuss the intangible cultural assets and traditional culture of Fukuchiyama.

Episode 3: 'Tamba Lacquer & Yaku Wood and Lacquer Museum'
In the first half, we will introduce the history of Japanese lacquer and what has been used instead of lacquer overseas.
In the second half, we welcomed Ms. Akiko Hiraoka, the director of the 'Yaku Wood and Lacquer Museum' located in Yakuno Town, Fukuchiyama City, as our guest. The museum showcases Tamba lacquer and tools used for lacquer application, and offers experiences in lacquer painting and kintsugi. We discussed what activities are conducted at the museum and the director's efforts in promoting Tamba lacquer.

(Mori no Kyoto Regional Promotion Association) https://morinokyoto.jp/ 
Kyoto FM Tanba Broadcasting Fukuchiyama 79.0MHz http://fukuchiyama.fm-tanba.jp/ 
Forest Kyoto Cultural Tourism Supporter Page https://morinokyoto.jp/bunka_supporter/

=================================================== 

【Forest Kyoto Cultural Tourism Supporter & Regular Guest Profile】 
Miki Kondo: 5th year supporter. From Fukuchiyama, mother of three, barista, manages an English school, and works in various fields as a multi-talented individual. Hobbies include watching movies and dramas, and exploring caves and ruins.

Mihoko Kojo: 3rd year supporter. From Fukuchiyama, mother of two. Hunter. Active as a member of the Fukuchiyama City harmful wildlife control team with the motto 'Anyone can hunt!' Processes and sells dog jerky using captured deer meat (business name: Shikashika), and is the leader of the Ai Ai Project.

Cahill O'Callaghan: Originally from Ireland, now in his second year living in Fukuchiyama, teaching English to children. Very interested in Japanese traditional culture and performing arts. A kind-hearted sportsman. Currently studying Japanese intensively.

description:

Two years have passed since the previous series "Do You Know? Traditional Culture in Fukuchiyama". [Narai-juku, Shiojiri City] A popular post town located in the middle of the Nakasendo. Strolling through the streets that have remained for 200 years gives you a feeling of time slipping away. The approximately 1 km long post town is home to cafes and restaurants where you can enjoy not only the taste but also the atmosphere, including a 180-year-old traditional house café. title: [Kanto's Largest Hydrangea Forest] The 'Hydrangea Festival' will be held again from mid-June this year! Let's visit the hydrangea garden with 1,200 varieties and 28,000 plants♪
description:
The 'Hydrangea Forest' located in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
It is one of the largest hydrangea gardens in Kanto, boasting 1,200 varieties and 28,000 blooming hydrangeas across a vast area.

After getting off at the 'Kitaibaraki IC' on the Joban Expressway, it takes about 10 minutes by car towards 'Mizunuma Dam' and 'Hanazono Valley' to arrive.
*For detailed routes from the IC, please watch this video:
　https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2RC7xzogEW4

From mid-June to late June, 320 varieties of 'Yama Ajisai' and 'Ezo Ajisai' will be in full bloom,
while from mid-June to mid-July, 600 varieties of 'Temari-type Ajisai' and 'Gaku-blooming Ajisai' will reach their peak.
*The peak blooming period may vary each year, so for details, please check the official website:
　http://www.ajisainomori.com/index.html

■ Kitaibaraki City Hydrangea Forest

*Address
　1138 Azukihata, Hanakawa Town, Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture

*Contact
　090-9107-0263

*Features
　In addition to 320 varieties of wild hydrangeas collected by the Japan Hydrangea Association's collectors from all over the country, there are also horticultural varieties and original varieties bred by Japanese breeders, totaling about 150 varieties, allowing visitors to enjoy a magnificent display of hydrangeas.
Furthermore, visitors can also enjoy clusters of rare foreign species of hydrangeas, such as Annabelle and oakleaf hydrangeas.

We look forward to your visit!♪

■ For information on tourist spots in the same area as the Hydrangea Forest, click here:
　http://www.kitaibarakishi-kankokyokai.gr.jp/page/dir000002.html#areaHanazono

description:
茨城県北茨城市にある『花園オートキャンプ場』
茨城県は県内に約160箇所のキャンプ場があり、全国で最もフィールドの多いことで有名です。
その中で、川辺フィールドとして人気を誇るにキャンプ場です。

※必ず字幕ONでご視聴ください※

オートキャンプサイト(約70㎡)には全サイトAC電源・専用水道付きで初心者にとてもやさしいサイト仕様になっています！
大型車も乗り入れできるモーターホームサイト(150㎡)も有り。
場内にはじゃぶじゃぶ川が流れ、水遊びができるのでファミリーのお客様にも人気です！

また、キャンプ場のそばには『花園川』が流れているため、清流の音を聴きながらのキャンプを楽しむことができます♪
夜になると空いっぱいに星が輝き、キャンパーの心を奪います。。。

キャンプ場周辺は、子宝や安産の御利益を与ろうと全国から多くの観光客が訪れる『花園神社』や新緑や紅葉時期がとても美しい『七ツ滝』や『栄蔵室』、『和尚山』でのトレッキング、『花園渓谷』での車窓紅葉、『増渕魚園』での釣り堀体験・川魚昼食などなど、キャンプ２日目も楽しみがたくさんッ！！

title: Recommended Campsite in Ibaraki Prefecture: Hanazono Auto Campground - Safe for Beginners - Kanto Ibaraki Campsite Recommendations
description:
Located in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture, 'Hanazono Auto Campground' 
Ibaraki Prefecture is famous for having about 160 campsites within the prefecture, making it the area with the most fields in the country. 
Among them, this campground is popular as a riverside field.

*Please make sure to turn on the subtitles while watching*

The auto camping sites (approximately 70㎡) come with AC power and dedicated water supply, making them very beginner-friendly! 
There are also motorhome sites (150㎡) that can accommodate large vehicles. 
A stream flows through the campground, allowing for water play, making it popular among families!

Additionally, the 'Hanazono River' flows near the campground, allowing you to enjoy camping while listening to the sound of the clear stream♪ 
At night, the sky is filled with shining stars, captivating the hearts of campers...

Around the campground, many tourists visit 'Hanazono Shrine' for blessings of childbirth and safe delivery, as well as 'Nanatsutaki' and 'Eizōmuro' which are beautiful during the fresh green and autumn foliage seasons, trekking on 'Oshōzan', enjoying the autumn leaves from the car window in 'Hanazono Valley', and fishing experiences and river fish lunches at 'Masubuchi Gyōen', so there are plenty of fun activities for the second day of camping too!!

Please create wonderful memories at Hanazono Auto Campground in Kitaibaraki City＊

*Turning on the subtitles will display detailed explanations*

title: 【忍者がご案内】How to Enjoy Okayamajo! ―岡山城の楽しみ方―
description:
【公式】岡山城ウェブサイト
https://okayama-castle.jp/

ようこそ、岡山城へ。
2022年11月3日「令和の大改修」が完了し、
岡山城は新しい時代へと踏み出しました。

目指したのは「歴史を伝える城・集う城」です。
岡山市出身の歴史学者・磯田道史氏による展示監修や、
多彩なイベントの開催、天守の夜間貸出など、
さまざまな面から楽しめる城へとリニューアルしました。
黒の深みがさらに増した外観も
別名「烏城（うじょう）」の威風を今に伝えます。

……お堅い紹介はこれくらいにしておきましょう。
この動画はとことんやわらかい内容です。
ふだんは忍ぶはずの忍者がガイドとなって、
岡山城のあれこれをアクティブにご案内します。

飛行機の搭乗に機内安全ビデオがあるように、
岡山城の登城にはこの動画です。
あなたを安全かつ安心な岡山城の旅へと誘います。

もちろん動画だけでは本当の岡山城は分かりません。
ぜひ岡山城へ！
お待ちしています。

title: [Elementary School Edition] Ask Mr. Isoda! Okayama Castle Children's Tour

title: 【岡山城】磯田道史氏による歴史解説 Explanation about the history of Okayama Castle by Michifumi Isoda of a historian
description:
歴史家の磯田道史氏により岡山城をわかりやすく解説。天守閣や月見櫓、石垣の変遷などを説明しています。ここではダイジェスト版で紹介していますが６編からなる詳しい内容は、岡山城天守閣でご覧いただけます。第1編 対岸から眺めた岡山城、第2編 石山の城、第3編 天守閣東側石垣、第4編 月見櫓下石垣・廊下門、第5編 中の段、第6編 本殿・天守閣。

Under the direction of Hideie Ukita, a daimyo of the Sengoku Period, Okayama Castle was completed in 1597 after eight years of construction. Because the castle was oriented to the west, Hideie undertook a major project to pull the nearby Asahigawa River to flow along the eastern end of the castle to ward off enemies from entering through the rear. The architecture of the period is partly represented by the use of boards painted with black lacquer on the walls of the castle tower (Tenshukaku). As such, the exterior is black, and in the later periods, the castle came to be known as the Crow Castle (Ujo). Hideie not only used Okayama Castle as a military facility, but also called in merchants and craftsmen around the castle's domain to develop a castle town.

After the Ikeda Family took control over the castle, Okayama Korakuen Garden,a vast daimyo garden, was built to the north across the Asahigawa River at the end of the 17th century.

Under the aegis of historical castle lords, Okayama continued to thrive as a city, laying down the foundations of a modern city.

title: 空から見たみちのく潮風トレイル～春・夏・秋～／Michinoku Coastal Trail From the Sky: Spring, Summer, Fall
description:
普段の歩く旅では見ることのできない上空からの視点で、みちのく潮風トレイルの魅力をお伝えします。春の桜の風景から始まり、入り組んだリアスの森と海、穏やかな湾の水面に映る夕映え、岩に打ち寄せる白波など、トレイル沿線の変化に富んだ海の表情を鳥になった気分でご覧いただけます。
This is a perspective you don’t get to see on foot: let us show you how lovely the Michinoku Coastal Trail is from the sky. We start with scenes of cherry blossoms in the spring, then the forest and sea along the meandering ria coastline, the glowing sunset reflecting from calm bay waters, and white waves crashing against the rocks. Enjoy the many faces of the ever changing ocean along the Michinoku Coastal Trail from a bird’s perspective.

ハイカーに美味しい料理を提供する人、道づくりに関わった人、休憩場所を提供する人、トレイルを日々守る人、山道を整備する人、地場産業を支える人、ハイカーを島から島へと渡す人・・・そして、ハイカーを見かけると声を掛けてくれる地域の人。みちのく潮風トレイルにはたくさんの「トレイルエンジェル」がいます！

title: ハイカーの声を聞く／Interviews of Hikers | みちのく潮風トレイル
description:
「旅って人なんですよね、人との出会いこそ旅の醍醐味。だからこそロングトレイルって、ただ山の中を歩いているんじゃダメなんですよ。地域とか町とか人と密接に結びついているからこそのロングトレイルなんですよね。」－長谷川 晋 氏／MCTスルーハイカー(2018)　
「震災を経験した方と関わることはとても心に残るし、とても個人的なレベルで響くもの。ただ、悲しみに焦点を当てるのではなく、希望への物語や強靭さに関して聞くこと、人生を再生する人々が笑顔でいることなど、こういった東北の人たちとの出会いは魅力的な経験だったと思う。本当に人生を変える経験だった。」－ロビン・ルイス 氏／MCTスルーハイカー(2017)　
“Journeys are about the people. The true pleasure of travel is in meeting people. That’s why long distance trails aren’t just hiking in the mountains. Long distance trails are about close connections with local areas, towns and people.” --Shin Hasegawa, MCT thru-hiker (2018)
“When you interact with other human beings who have experienced such tragedy it really sticks with you and resonates with you on a personal level. Not just focusing on the sad side, but hearing the stories of hope and resilience, that people rebuilt their lives and have this huge smile. It’s really just a magical experience to have these interactions with people in Tohoku. It’s a really life-changing experience.” --Robin Lewis, MCT thru-hiker (2017)

title: 空から見たみちのく潮風トレイル～秋・冬～／Michinoku Coastal Trail From the Sky: Autumn and Winter
description:
ドローン映像ならではの迫力ある壮大な海岸線や河口の風景、そしてどこまでも続く防潮堤や震災遺構など、青森県八戸市から福島県相馬市まで1,000kmを超えるみちのく潮風トレイルの道の多様性が凝縮されたおすすめの動画です。時々映るハイカーの小ささから現地のスケールを感じてください。
See the impressive footage we can expect from drones: majestic scenes of coastline and river mouths, as well as seemingly endless stretches of seawall and tsunami monuments. A highly recommended video because it shows, in a condensed form, the variety of the over 1000 kilometer long Michinoku Coastal Trail running from Hachinohe in Aomori Prefecture to Soma in Fukushima Prefecture. Get a grasp of the massive scale of this landscape by watching for occasional appearances by miniature hikers.

title: 【5分でわかる】世界遺産  熊野古道・熊野三山【最強パワースポット】
description:
和歌山県の観光に欠かせない、熊野三山（熊野本宮大社。熊野速玉大社・熊野那智大社）の魅力をコンパクトに5分でお伝えします。
熊野三山は1000年以上の歴史を持つ熊野詣での聖地で、熊野古道は熊野三山を巡る参詣道。
世界文化遺産「紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道」にも登録され、癒やしと蘇りのパワースポットです。

ほかにも皆さまが和歌山の観光スポットについて紹介して欲しいスポットや、聞いてみたい質問がありましたらコメントでぜひ教えて下さい！

title: [5 Minutes to Understand] World Heritage Kumano Kodo & Kumano Sanzan [The Ultimate Power Spot]
description:
In just 5 minutes, we will compactly convey the charm of Kumano Sanzan (Kumano Hongu Taisha, Kumano Hayatama Taisha, and Kumano Nachi Taisha), which is essential for tourism in Wakayama Prefecture.
Kumano Sanzan is a sacred site of Kumano pilgrimage with over 1,000 years of history, and the Kumano Kodo is the pilgrimage route that connects the three shrines.
It is also registered as a UNESCO World Heritage Site under 'Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range,' serving as a power spot for healing and revival.

title: 【熊野】Photographic Video Magazine -KUMANO- 2014
description:
毎年、3月から5月の3ヶ月間以外の立ち入りが一切禁止されている神域に、特別の許可を得て、11月の晩秋シーズンに入域した際の映像です。
見事な色彩を放つ扇型の滝壺に降り注ぐ「二の滝」。そして、さらにその奥に佇む「三の滝」では、太陽の光と水しぶきの完全なる調和により、「奇跡の虹」を映像として捉えることにも成功しました。

title: [Kumano] Photographic Video Magazine -KUMANO- 2014
description:
This footage was taken in November during the late autumn season, with special permission to enter a sacred area that is completely off-limits for three months each year, from March to May.
The "Ni no Taki" waterfall, with its stunningly colorful fan-shaped basin, cascades down. Furthermore, at the back lies the "San no Taki" waterfall, where we successfully captured the "Miracle Rainbow" on film, thanks to the perfect harmony of sunlight and water splashes.

title: Lavender Festa Kamifurano 2023  Liting up&Fireworks with Nene&Waka
description:
A new event that colors the summer of Kamifurano, "Lavender Festa Kamifurano 2023". This year marks the 42nd anniversary since lavender became the town flower of Kamifurano. Residents, as well as people from all over Japan and abroad, have cherished this town flower, and this year you can enjoy it at night for a limited time.
On July 15th (Saturday), we will set up a booth for one day only where you can enjoy beer made with locally produced hops and barley.
Would you like to enjoy the grand panorama of lavender beautifully illuminated with enchanting lighting?

We will also have a special live stream of a performance by the unit "Nene & Waka," who are active in the music scene centered around Hokkaido. Please look forward to it!

title: FLOWERLAND KAMIFURANO FIREWORKS ONLINE 2020
description:

世界中でコロナウイルスが猛威を振るう中、「悪疫退散」「無病息災」「五穀豊穣」という世界の平和を願い花火を打上げます。
上富良野町を愛してくださる全世界の方へ、広大な花園に配置されたランタンと、そこから打ちあがる花火を今まで見たことのない角度からドローンの空撮で全世界に向けYouTubeでライブ配信されます。

title: FLOWERLAND KAMIFURANO FIREWORKS ONLINE 2020
description:
★★★ Spectacular! Fireworks will light up the 100,000㎡ flower fields adorned with panoramic mountain views! ★★★
Amidst the global pandemic of the coronavirus, we will launch fireworks wishing for world peace, with hopes for "the eradication of the plague," "good health," and "bountiful harvests."
For everyone around the world who loves Kamifurano, lanterns placed throughout the vast flower garden and the fireworks launched from there will be live-streamed on YouTube from a drone's perspective, showcasing angles never seen before.

★★★ Request ★★★
The venue will be closed to entry, including the parking lot, on the day of the event.
There will be no live sound or music at the venue, so please watch on your TV, computer, or mobile device that can access YouTube at home.
Please refrain from parking on the streets around the venue, as it will obstruct traffic, and police patrols will be conducted.
*The broadcast may be interrupted or canceled due to weather or internet conditions.

★★★ Special WEB Broadcast via YouTube Live ★★★
The WEB broadcast of "FLOWERLAND KAMIFURANO FIREWORKS ONLINE 2020" will be conducted on the YouTube channel of the Kamifurano Tokachidake Tourism Association. By subscribing to the Kamifurano Tokachidake Tourism Association channel, you will receive notifications when the broadcast starts, so please take this opportunity to subscribe!

★★★ Scheduled Content ★★★
・Live Streaming: As a new way to enjoy fireworks, we will share drone footage of the fireworks on YouTube worldwide.
・Drive in HANABI: Guests staying on the day of the Kamifurano accommodation campaign can watch the fireworks from their cars.
・Participatory Performance: Message Fireworks
・Fireworks Display: Approximately 10 minutes of fireworks, hoping you can feel the summer of Kamifurano.
・End of Live Streaming

Date and Time
August 29, 2020 (Saturday) 19:30～
If "Flowerland Kamifurano" cannot be held due to inclement weather, it will be canceled.
The decision on whether to hold the event will be made, in principle, at 1 PM on the day of the event.

title: 🎨黒板にお絵描き第2弾🎨 #北広島町
description:
🎨黒板にお絵描き第2弾🎨

今回描いたのはおめでたい神楽の演目の「恵比寿( えびす)」恵比須とも書きます。

商売繁盛・豊漁の神、恵比寿様が釣りをする御姿を舞う演目。鯛を釣る撒き餌として餅やお菓子をお客さんにまきます。これらは「福の種」として拾うと幸せが訪れるとか✨️

恵比寿様のにこやかな表情と、軽やかな舞は見ていると心が晴れやかになるほど神々しいものがあります。

「釣〜ろや釣ろや、エビで鯛を釣〜ろや♪」
「ま〜こやまこや、福の種をま〜こや♪」

恵比寿はお祝いの席などで舞われる事が多いです🎣

季節に合わせて春らしく、桜と恵比寿のコラボにしました🌸鯛のウロコを桜にしたのがポイントです。

黒板にお絵描き、リクエストも募集中です！
神楽や北広島町に関するものが好ましいです。

観光案内所にいらっしゃるお客様の心がほぐれるような絵を描けたらと思っております。
次回もお楽しみに！！

title: 🎨Second Round of Drawing on the Blackboard🎨 #Kitahiroshima Town
description:
🎨Second Round of Drawing on the Blackboard🎨

This time, I drew the auspicious Kagura performance "Ebisu (恵比寿)" which can also be written as "恵比須".

The performance depicts the god of prosperous business and abundant fishing, Ebisu, fishing. As bait to catch sea bream, we scatter rice cakes and sweets to the audience. It is said that picking these up as "seeds of fortune" will bring happiness✨️

Ebisu's cheerful expression and light dance are so divine that they brighten the heart when watched.

"Catch a fish, catch a fish, let's catch a sea bream with shrimp♪"
"Scatter, scatter, let's scatter the seeds of fortune♪"

Ebisu is often performed at celebratory occasions🎣

In line with the season, I made it spring-like, combining cherry blossoms and Ebisu🌸. The point is that the scales of the sea bream are represented by cherry blossoms.

I am also accepting requests for drawings on the blackboard! I prefer themes related to Kagura or Kitahiroshima Town.

I hope to create a drawing that will warm the hearts of the customers visiting the tourist information center.
Stay tuned for the next one!!

"Ebisu (恵比須)" Photo: Otsuka Kagura Group
Thank you for the permission to use it😊

Music: Shoon Yamagata "Come on! Kita Hiro"

title: 🍮なめらかプリンと軽やかなシフォンケーキ専門店「にわのにわとり」に観光協会職員が行ってきました🥚 #北広島町　 #スイーツ
description:
🍮甘いものはお好き？🍮

観光協会職員がスイーツを求めて北広島町の「にわのにわとり」さんへ行ってきました！！

横山さんご夫婦が営む、なめらかプリンと軽やかなシフォンケーキ専門店「にわのにわとり」。

扉を開けるとふぁ〜っと甘い香り。ズラリと並んだプリンやシフォンケーキに胸が躍ります。

たまご屋さんの菓子工房ならでは、お菓子達は香料を使用していないので卵の味がしっかりします。
お取り寄せネットプリン部門１位を獲得されたそう✨️

観光協会職員のおすすめは「プリンマドンナ」
ずっしりなめらかでご褒美スイーツです。
ほろ苦いカラメルがまたたまりません。

見た目も愛らしいいちごのミルクプリンは期間限定。5月頃まで。高カカオチョコレートと卵が贅沢なハーモニーを奏でる生チョコプリンも人気商品です🍫

シフォンケーキはふあっふあ。雲のよう。
紅茶やショコラ、桜など豊富な種類があり、差し入れにもぴったりです。
メレンゲクッキーやシフォンケーキのラスクも絶品です。

撮影中も終始笑い声が絶えない和やかな雰囲気で、横山さんご夫婦のお人柄がこの短い動画でも伝わるのではないでしょうか🌷

自分へのご褒美に、また大切な人への贈り物に、ぜひ『心ほどける』しあわせのお菓子達を。

【にわのにわとり】
住所:〒731-1534 広島県山県郡北広島町後有田１２９９
営業日:金・土・日11:00-18:00

title: 🍮 A Specialty Store for Smooth Pudding and Light Chiffon Cake 'Niwa no Niwatori' Visited by a Tourism Association Staff 🥚 #KitahiroshimaTown #Sweets
description:
🍮 Do you like sweets? 🍮

A staff member from the tourism association visited 'Niwa no Niwatori' in Kitahiroshima Town in search of sweets!!

'Niwa no Niwatori' is a specialty store for smooth pudding and light chiffon cake run by the Yokoyama couple.

As soon as you open the door, a sweet aroma wafts through the air. My heart leaps at the sight of the neatly arranged puddings and chiffon cakes.

Being a confectionery workshop run by an egg farm, the sweets do not use any flavoring, allowing the taste of the eggs to shine through.
They have reportedly won first place in the online pudding category! ✨️

The tourism association staff's recommendation is the 'Pudding Madonna.'
It's rich and smooth, a reward-worthy sweet.
The slightly bitter caramel is simply irresistible.

The adorable strawberry milk pudding is a limited-time offering, available until around May. The fresh chocolate pudding, featuring high-cocoa chocolate and eggs in a luxurious harmony, is also a popular item. 🍫

The chiffon cake is fluffy and cloud-like.
With a variety of flavors such as tea, chocolate, and cherry blossom, it's perfect for gifts.
The meringue cookies and chiffon cake rusk are also exquisite.

Throughout the filming, laughter filled the air, creating a warm atmosphere that reflects the Yokoyama couple's personality, even in this short video. 🌷

As a treat for yourself or a gift for someone special, be sure to enjoy these 'heartwarming' sweets.

【Niwa no Niwatori】

title: 神秘的な「氷瀑ツアー」へ⛄⛄ #北広島町 #北広島市
description:
皆さんは雪山に登った事がありますか？？⛄️

季節限定！豊平にあるワイルドグランピングやキャンプ場「 りゅうずの森 」の藏田さん企画🧊神秘の氷瀑モニターツアー🧊に観光協会職員が行ってきました！！

真冬の龍頭山に登るのは２回目。雪をギュッギュと踏みしめながら進んでいきます。

各所で登山を飽きさせないよう、藏田さんが山の豆知識やクイズを出してくれます🏔️

少し息が切れてきたところで、見どころ１箇所目の「駒ヶ滝」に到着。タイミングが合えばカッチコチの滝を見ることができます🧊
この日は少し天気が良く溶けていましたが、ところどころ氷柱があったり地面の草木が凍っていて宝石のようでした💎

２箇所目の「黒滝」には、溶けて地面に突き刺さった氷柱が！！身長が167センチある職員と同じくらいの大きさって…自然の力の凄みを感じます。

そして太陽の光が降り注ぐ雪山の美しいこと！！
鳥のさえずりと風音しか聞こえない、静かで神秘的な空間でした。

下山したら登山口のそばにあるカフェ「Caf'e de la Richesses 六」でランチ🍽️

藏田さん特製スパイスキーマカレーと、手作りマーマレードティーで体がぽっかぽか！
暖炉で温まりながらツアーの感想をみんなで言い合うお喋りもゆったり贅沢な時間でした☺️

普段なかなか見られない冬の龍頭山をめいっぱい満喫できる、神秘的な氷瀑ツアーでした✨

🧊この氷瀑ツアー、★2/8(土)と★2/11(火)も開催されます！！！ご興味のある方はりゅうずの森さんへDMをお願い致します。　(雪が降る中でのツアーになる可能性もあるため登山初心者の方はご遠慮ください)

title: Mysterious 'Ice Waterfall Tour' ⛄⛄ #KitaHiroshimaTown #KitaHiroshimaCity
description:
Have you ever climbed a snowy mountain??⛄️

Limited season! A special project by Mr. Kurata from the wild glamping and camping site 'Ryuzu no Mori' in Toyohira 🧊 Mysterious Ice Waterfall Monitor Tour 🧊 was attended by staff from the tourism association!!

This is my second time climbing Mount Ryuzudake in mid-winter. I advance while firmly stepping on the snow.

To keep the mountain climbing interesting, Mr. Kurata shares mountain trivia and quizzes along the way 🏔️

Just as I started to feel a bit out of breath, we arrived at the first highlight, 'Koma Falls.' If the timing is right, you can see the frozen waterfall in all its glory 🧊. On this day, the weather was a bit nice, causing some melting, but there were still icicles here and there, and the frozen grass and trees looked like jewels 💎.

At the second spot, 'Kuro Falls,' there were icicles that had melted and pierced into the ground!! They were about the same height as our staff member, who is 167 cm tall... you can really feel the power of nature.

And the beauty of the snowy mountain bathed in sunlight is breathtaking!! It was a quiet and mystical space where only the chirping of birds and the sound of the wind could be heard.

After descending, we had lunch at the nearby cafe 'Caf'e de la Richesses 六' 🍽️

Mr. Kurata's special spice keema curry and homemade marmalade tea warmed me right up! Chatting by the fireplace about our impressions of the tour was a leisurely and luxurious time ☺️.

This was a mysterious ice waterfall tour where we could fully enjoy the winter scenery of Mount Ryuzudake, which is not often seen✨.

🧊 This ice waterfall tour will also be held on ★2/8 (Sat) and ★2/11 (Tue)!!! If you're interested, please DM Ryuzu no Mori. (Please note that there is a possibility of the tour taking place in snowy conditions, so beginners in mountain climbing are advised to refrain.) Search for 'Ryuzu no Mori' 🔍

Song: Gaku/Mt. Gassan Shouun 'Come on! Kita Hiro'

title: 「何を描いているでしょうか？」 #北広島町#広島県 #神楽

🎨黒板にお絵描きシリーズ復活！！🎨

黒板にはもう絵は描かんのん？？とたくさんの方に言っていただき、お絵描きシリーズ復活しました。

今回描いたのは北広島町が誇る伝統芸能「神楽」の人気演目🦊悪狐伝(あっこでん)🦊

和尚さんと悪狐がぬくぬく冬を楽しむ様子を描きました。
描いていたらお餅が食べたくなりました、今夜食べよう…

title: What are we drawing?
description:
🎨The drawing series on the blackboard is back!!🎨

Many people have asked, "Aren't you drawing on the blackboard anymore?" and so the drawing series has returned.

This time, we drew the popular performance of the traditional art of Kitahiroshima Town, "Kagura" 🦊The Tale of the Evil Fox (Akko-den)🦊

The beautiful woman "Tamamo-no-Mae" is actually the embodiment of an evil fox. This is a story from the Heian period where a master archer defeats the evil fox that continues its wicked deeds by transforming into various forms. (In a nutshell)

I depicted the scene of the monk and the evil fox enjoying a cozy winter together.
While drawing, I started craving rice cakes; I think I'll have some tonight...

I hope to create drawings that warm the hearts of visitors at the tourist information center!!

We are also accepting requests! Anything related to Kagura or Kitahiroshima Town is preferred!
Example: The town's bird, the Night Heron 🐦️

"The Tale of the Evil Fox" Photo: Asaka Kagura Group
Thank you for the permission to use it 😊

title: 【古民家】洗礼された宿でた特別な時間を過ごす。 #旅行 #北広島町　#古民家 #宿泊
description:
✨️大朝にある1棟貸し古民家「hitaru石橋邸」へ観光協会職員がお邪魔してきました✨️こちらはロングバージョンです！

少し高台になっているところを上がっていくと、温かみのある光とともに古民家が現れます。　　

築200年。刀鍛冶(かたなかじ)職人の邸宅を「株式会社フム」さんがリノベーション。

中に入ると、ぱっと開けた空間に黒を基調としたシックな雰囲気が漂います。う……美しい。

キッチンを中心とした食のゲストハウス がテーマの石橋邸は、旬の食材を自分達で調達して楽しむのもあり、厳選されたシェフの出張料理を味わうのもまた格別です。

至福な食卓を囲むのはこの大きなまーるいテーブル。
こちらはなんと同じ大朝地域にある「福光酒造」さんの酒樽の蓋をリメイクしたもの🍶✨️

宿泊された方に『非日常』に浸ってもらうため、家具やインテリアには隅々までこだわっておられます。
(電化製品は全てBALMUDA😲)

これ使ってみたかった！憧れの家電も。
LEDライト付きの鏡もテンションが上がります🪞

お庭での楽しみは焚き火やBBQ。寒〜い日でもパチパチと揺らぐ火を見つめている時間は心に安らぎをもたらします。
街灯がなく、真っ暗な闇に目が慣れてきたら満天の星空が。星を眺めるなんていつぶりでしょうか…

日が昇ると目の前には「大朝富士」と呼ばれる寒曳山が真正面に。雄大な自然の中での鳥のさえずりは石橋邸ならではのBGMですね☺️

ベッドルームは2部屋あり、布団をしける部屋もあります。最大12名宿泊可能なのは中々珍しいそう。

広島市内から車で1時間の「非日常」。
大切な人たちとの、大切な時間。

「食う」「ねる」「ひたる」都会では味わえない贅沢な時間がここ「hitaru石橋邸」にありました。

title: [Old Folk House] Spend a special time at a refined accommodation. #Travel #KitahiroshimaTown #OldFolkHouse #Accommodation
description:
✨️We visited the one-house rental old folk house "Hitaru Ishibashi-tei" in Oasa, where the tourism association staff had a great time✨️ This is the long version!

As you ascend to a slightly elevated area, the old folk house appears with warm light.

Built 200 years ago. The residence of a swordsmith has been renovated by "Fumu Co., Ltd."

Upon entering, a spacious area with a chic atmosphere based on black greets you. Wow... it's beautiful.

The Ishibashi-tei, themed as a food guest house centered around the kitchen, allows you to enjoy seasonal ingredients that you procure yourself, or savor the exceptional dishes prepared by selected chefs.

Gathering around this large round table for a blissful dining experience. This table is actually remade from the lid of a sake barrel from "Fukumitsu Sake Brewery" located in the same Oasa region 🍶✨️

To immerse guests in the "extraordinary," every detail of the furniture and interior has been carefully considered. (All electrical appliances are BALMUDA 😲)

I wanted to try this! The appliances I've always admired. The mirror with LED lights also raises the excitement 🪞

Enjoying the garden with a bonfire or BBQ. Even on cold days, the time spent gazing at the crackling fire brings peace to the heart. When your eyes adjust to the pitch darkness without streetlights, a starry sky unfolds. When was the last time I gazed at the stars...

As the sun rises, right in front of you is the "Oasa Fuji," also known as Sanbaku Mountain. The chirping of birds in the majestic nature is the unique BGM of Ishibashi-tei ☺️

There are two bedrooms, and one room has futons. It's quite rare to accommodate up to 12 guests.

An "extraordinary" experience just an hour's drive from Hiroshima City. Precious time with your loved ones.

"Eat," "Sleep," and "Immerse" in luxurious moments that cannot be experienced in the city, right here at "Hitaru Ishibashi-tei."

hitaru Guest House Ishibashi-tei
731-2104
Oasa 1913-1, Kitahiroshima Town, Yamagata District, Hiroshima Prefecture

大人買いする気持ちがわかります。全部食べてみたい😋

素敵なお店たち🌿

description:

バスの駅だった大朝駅をサイクリストや観光客が集える場所にしたのが大朝モビリティステーション『O.M.S』。

バスを利用される方はもちろん、サイクリストや大朝に遊びに来られた方も気軽にお立ち寄ることのできるスポットです。

title: Autumn Cycling Tour in Kitahiroshima Town 🍂🍂
description:
✨️ A staff member from the tourism association visited the autumn cycling tour at 'O.M.S. Oasa Mobility Station' ✨️

The former Oasa bus station has been transformed into a gathering place for cyclists and tourists, known as the Oasa Mobility Station 'O.M.S'.

It is a spot where not only bus users but also cyclists and visitors to Oasa can easily stop by.

Here, you can join tours on sports-type electric assist bicycles (E-BIKES) or rent bicycles. 
Parking and bike parking are available, and they also provide bicycle maintenance and guidance on cycling routes.

The Kake-yama Hill Climb Challenge is also registered at O.M.S 🔥

The tour guided by the tourism staff featured an autumn course available only at this time of year.

Although I was a bit out of breath from the exercise after a long time, the refreshing view from Kake-yama instantly revitalized me!!

The salt rice balls eaten at the summit are simple yet the best 🍙

After Kake-yama, we headed to the ginkgo trees at Saikyo-ji Temple and the Hoko Bara Amusement Park! 
This video was filmed on November 4th, but it seems this weekend will be the most beautiful ✨️

This tour is filled with the extensive knowledge and flexible course development of our guide, Mr. Tagawa, and above all, his passionate desire to entertain the guests.

The tour can be arranged to suit each individual guest, allowing everyone to enjoy an original experience ✨️

Along the way, Mr. Tagawa shared core information about the history, culture, and trivia of the Oasa region that only locals would know, making it not only fun but also educational.

'An no Hanadaue' has a deep connection with our town, Kitahiroshima-cho, and I was able to participate in the event organized by the An no Hanadaue Preservation Society held yesterday, October 11 (Sun)ー(^^)/

The tourism PR of Kitahiroshima-cho, including 'Mibu no Hanadaue', featured our town's image character, Hanada Muitaro (Moutarou), who appeared and danced with the performers in cute costumes to the theme song 'Oideyo! Kita Hiro'♪

The children who watched the YouTube video and learned the dance captivated the audience with their nearly perfect performance(^^♪
It was truly wonderful☆彡

This year, we were unable to showcase the Hanadaue, but we were able to effectively promote 'An no Hanadaue' and 'Mibu no Hanadaue' in preparation for next year's event!

Next year! Let's meet under the blue sky(^^)/

description:
[National Natural Monument 'Tengu Shide Grove in Oasa']
～Drone Photography and Video～
The 'Tengu Shide Grove in Oasa' is home to about 100 twisted and contorted varieties of the Japanese Zelkova tree.

description:
日本最北にある利尻島には、島の中心にたたずむ雄大で美しい利尻山、氷河期から命を繋ぐ様々な美しい花や植物、山からの湧水が流れ暖流と寒流が交わる豊かな海で採れた海産物、この山と海と生きてきた人々の文化や、島の自然を体感できる様々なアクティビティがあります。

利尻島の大自然を旅する１年間をギュッと2分30秒でご覧ください。

Rishiri Island, located at the northernmost point of Japan, features the beautiful Mt. Rishiri standing at its center. The island is home to various stunning flowers and plants that have survived since the Ice Age. The rich seas, nourished by both warm and cold currents as well as spring water from the mountains, provide abundant seafood. The culture of people who have lived in harmony with the mountains and the sea is vibrant. Visitors can experience the island's nature through a variety of activities.

title: 加太活き魚市場
description:
漁師さんが一本釣りで獲った活き魚は、加太蓄養施設に運ばれ各地に流通していきます。
加太産、一本釣り、活きているということで阪神地域では高値で取引されています。

都会では高額ですが、加太で食べればお手頃価格。
魚の本当の美味しさを確かめにいらっしゃいませんか？
一般の方にも販売するイベントもございますので、お問合せください。

title: Kada Live Fish Market
description:
The live fish caught by fishermen using pole-and-line fishing are transported to the Kada aquaculture facility and distributed to various regions.
Due to being locally sourced, pole-and-line caught, and alive, they are traded at high prices in the Hanshin area.

While they are expensive in the city, they are reasonably priced when eaten in Kada.
Why not come and experience the true deliciousness of the fish?
We also have events where we sell to the general public, so please contact us.

title: グレ（メジナ）の調理
description:
一本釣りで獲ったグレの調理です。
活きているグレを締めた鮮度の良さは、街で味わうことはできません。
グレってこんなに美味しい魚だったんだと皆さん驚かれます。
加太観光協会青年部長 稲野雅則氏（活き魚料理いなさ）の美技をごらんください。

title: Cooking Gray (Mejina)
description:
This is the cooking of gray caught by single-line fishing.
The freshness of a live gray that has been dispatched cannot be experienced in the city.
Everyone is surprised to find out how delicious gray is.
Please take a look at the exquisite skills of Mr. Masanori Inano, the head of the Kadota Tourism Association Youth Division (Ikizukuri Ryori Inasa).

title: 一本釣りアジの調理
description:
紀淡海峡の速い潮で育った天然一本釣りのアジです。
網で獲ったアジとはまったく別物の味！
直前まで活きていた鮮度バツグンの逸品です。
加太観光協会青年部長 稲野雅則氏（活き魚料理いなさ）の美技をごらんください。

title: Cooking Wild-Caught Horse Mackerel
description:
This is a naturally caught horse mackerel, raised in the fast currents of the Kitan Strait.
It has a completely different taste from those caught with nets!
This is a superb product with outstanding freshness, having been alive until just before preparation.
Please enjoy the exquisite skills of Mr. Masanori Inano, the head of the Youth Division of the Kada Tourism Association (Ikizukuri Restaurant Inasa).

title: 乗船注意ビデオ
description:
本物の一本釣り漁船に乗ります！
海が相手ですので、乗船前にこのビデオでちょっと勉強していただきます。
出演は虹色ポッケさんです。

観光船ではない男の戦場！お客様用の座席もありません。
でもめったに経験することのできない貴重な体験になります。

title: Boarding Safety Video
description:
You will board a real longline fishing boat!
Since the sea is our opponent, please take a moment to study this video before boarding.
Featuring Nijiiro Pokke.

This is a man's battlefield, not a sightseeing boat! There are no seats for customers.
But it will be a rare experience that you won't often have.
The Kada Tourism Association regularly holds fishing boat boarding and longline fishing experience tours, so please contact us.

title: 【兵庫県】日本遺産　西国巡礼二十五番札所　播州清水寺【加東市】
description:
播州清水寺は兵庫県加東市の御嶽山山頂に立ち、地蔵信仰の聖地として今昔物語集にも登場します。日本遺産・西国三十三所巡礼の第２５番札所とされる当寺の大講堂は古くから沢山の方が巡礼に訪れます。

また花や新緑、紅葉の美しい４月～１１月のシーズンは多くの方々が観光に訪れます。

title: [Hyogo Prefecture] Japan Heritage - 25th Sacred Site of the Saigoku Pilgrimage - Banshu Seiz temple [Kato City]
description:
Banshu Seiz temple stands at the summit of Mount Ontake in Kato City, Hyogo Prefecture, and is mentioned in the Konjaku Monogatari as a sacred site of Jizo faith. This temple, recognized as the 25th sacred site of the Japan Heritage Saigoku 33 Pilgrimage, has long attracted many pilgrims to its grand lecture hall.

Additionally, from April to November, during the beautiful seasons of flowers, fresh greenery, and autumn leaves, many visitors come for sightseeing.

title: 神戸の旅 HD
description:
神戸の旅
●http://www.feel-kobe.jp/
都市の観光魅力はどこに宿っているのでしょうか。

普段と違う体験、日常から離れた刺激や安らぎ、そして、自らを高めていく何物か。

それは旅人の選択の中にあります。

title: ＼旬感！ 菊もみ！ 学生記者クラブ／
description:
11.1〜11.7に弘前公園では、
「弘前城 菊と紅葉まつり」が開催されています。
「弘前城 菊と紅葉まつり」（通称 菊もみ）に弘前大学の学生がリポーターとなり、潜入取材を敢行！
フラワーアートの制作風景や、まつりの楽しみ方などをお届けします。

 今回は、「青龍を見つけよう！」を動画でご紹介します！

植物園内の様々なところに、雪吊り飾りの「青龍」たちは、９体ひそんでいます。青龍とは、慶び事や発展を促すとも言われている縁起のよい守り神です。園内に潜む九体の青龍を見つけると、いいことが起きるかも…！？

ちなみの動画内では、３体の青龍が映り込んでいます。
おわかりいただけたでしょうか……？

https://www.hirosaki-kanko.or.jp/flowerart/

title: Seasonal Sensation! Kiku Momi! Student Reporter Club
description:
From November 1 to November 7, the "Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival" is being held at Hirosaki Park.
Students from Hirosaki University are acting as reporters and conducting undercover coverage of the "Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival" (commonly known as Kiku Momi)!
We will deliver scenes of flower art production and ways to enjoy the festival.

This time, we will introduce "Let's Find the Seiryu!" in a video!

In various places within the botanical garden, there are nine hidden "Seiryu" decorations with snow hanging. The Seiryu is said to be a lucky guardian deity that promotes joy and development. If you find the nine Seiryu lurking in the garden, something good might happen...!?

By the way, three Seiryu appear in the video.
Did you catch them...?

title: ＼旬感！ 菊もみ！ 学生記者クラブ／
description:
11.1〜11.7に弘前公園では、
「弘前城 菊と紅葉まつり」が開催されています。
「弘前城 菊と紅葉まつり」（通称 菊もみ）に弘前大学の学生がリポーターとなり、潜入取材を敢行！
フラワーアートの制作風景や、まつりの楽しみ方などをお届けします。

 もうすでに、ご来場いただいた方もいらっしゃるでしょうか？
遅ればせながら今回は、より深くフラワーアートを愉しむための鑑賞順序についてお届けします。

東からやってきた龍は、東門を通り、弘前城植物園に入ってきました。
花くぐりを通り抜け、龍は白い花を頭につけたまま三の丸庭園に鎮座しています。
花手水は、龍の足跡を表現します。

龍の横にそびえるりんごの木には、願いがこもった赤い実がつきます。
りんごの木から追手門に向かう花手水は、木から飛んだりんごの葉が溢れ、三の丸庭園の追手門側には大きなりんごが実を結んでいます。

物語のようになってしまいましたが、

弘前城植物園東門入り口
　↓
花くぐり
　↓
花手水
　↓
昇天華龍
　↓
りんごのウィッシュツリー
　↓
追手門側へ

というようにフラワーアート「枯木龍吟」の物語が進みます。
物語を知った上での鑑賞はより深く、感じ入るものがあります。

title: Seasonal Sensation! Kiku Momi! Student Reporter Club
description:
From November 1 to November 7, the "Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival" is being held at Hirosaki Park.
Students from Hirosaki University are acting as reporters and conducting undercover coverage of the "Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival" (commonly known as Kiku Momi)!
We will deliver scenes of flower art production and ways to enjoy the festival.

Have some of you already visited?
Belatedly, this time we will present the order of appreciation for enjoying flower art more deeply.

The dragon that came from the east passed through the East Gate and entered the Hirosaki Castle Botanical Garden.
Passing through the flower arch, the dragon is seated in the San-no-Maru Garden with white flowers on its head.
The flower water represents the dragon's footprints.

Next to the dragon, the apple tree towers, bearing red fruits filled with wishes.
The flower water leading from the apple tree to the Otemon Gate overflows with apple leaves that have fallen from the tree, and a large apple is bearing fruit on the Otemon side of the San-no-Maru Garden.

It has turned into a story, but,

Hirosaki Castle Botanical Garden East Gate Entrance
　↓
Flower Arch
　↓
Flower Water
　↓
Ascended Flower Dragon
　↓
Apple Wish Tree
　↓
Towards Otemon

Thus, the story of the flower art "Kareki Ryugin" progresses.
Appreciating the story adds depth and resonance to the experience.

title: 予期せぬ出会い～Unexpected Encounter～
description:
作品名：「予期せぬ出会い～Unexpected Encounter～」　

監督―― 宮田 耕輔
映像――反保シュウジ
写真――Eito Mars

撮影場所：
ウドノスビーチ・寺崎漁港・鳩の池・大金久海岸・サトウキビ畑・アジニッチェー神社・味咲・居酒屋やす　など

撮影秘話：
人に会いに行く島。
　宮田組一行は、3泊4日のスケジュールで初日の午後与論島に到着し、ゲストハウスKAIを拠点に撮影場所は実際に島を巡りながら、人の温かさに触れる旅を想定した企画を元に、「与論の人に出会う旅の中で、物書きの宮田氏が与論で感じ綴られた言葉と、Eito Mars氏が切り取った与論島の美しい情景、その旅の様子とまた別の視線で捉えた反保氏の映像がMIXされて作り出される観光映像」を制作するという内容で撮影を進めていきました。
　宮田組はレンタカーで島を巡りながら、ウドノスビーチで与論島産みずレモンを栽培している島人から、観光客があまり知らない夕日スポットを教えてもらって撮影したり、粂田監督の撮影にも協力を頂いていた肥田みちよさんが行っているテントサウナを体験したり、朝日のシーンを撮影に訪れた鳩の池では、三線と法螺貝で観光客をもてなす島人に出会うなど、与論の人の出会いが繋がりながら、撮影がすすめられました。その島の人との出会いの体験を元に、実際に宮田監督が紡いだ文章が作品内で使用されるテロップに流れ、その心象風景を納めたスチールカメラの写真と実写が映し出される映像作品として仕上がりました。

title: Unexpected Encounter
description:
Title: "Unexpected Encounter"  

Director: Kousuke Miyata  
Cinematography: Shuji Hanbo  
Photography: Eito Mars  

Filming Locations:  
Udono Beach, Terasaki Fishing Port, Pigeon Pond, Okaneku Coast, Sugarcane Fields, Ajinichie Shrine, Ajisaki, Izakaya Yasu, etc.  

Filming Anecdote:  
A journey to meet the people of the island.  
The Miyata crew arrived on Yoron Island on the afternoon of the first day with a 3-night, 4-day schedule, using Guest House KAI as a base. The filming locations were planned to be a journey that would allow them to experience the warmth of the island's people while actually touring the island. The project aimed to create a tourism video that mixes the words written by writer Miyata, who felt and recorded his experiences on Yoron, the beautiful scenery of Yoron Island captured by Eito Mars, and the footage taken by Shuji Hanbo from a different perspective during the journey.  
The Miyata crew traveled around the island by rental car, filming at Udono Beach where they learned about a sunset spot that tourists rarely know from a local who cultivates Yoron Island's water lemons. They also experienced a tent sauna run by Michiyo Hida, who had been assisting Director Kumeda with filming. At Pigeon Pond, where they visited to capture the sunrise scene, they encountered locals who welcomed tourists with the sanshin and conch shell. The filming progressed as connections with the people of Yoron were made. Based on the experiences of meeting the island's people, the text woven by Director Miyata was used in the subtitles of the work, culminating in a video piece that showcased both still photographs capturing the mental landscape and live-action footage.

title: 日日是与論 4K  Yoron Island,Nature moves on,as do we
description:
Learn more about Yoron Island
https://travel.yorontou.info/

　タイトルの「日日是与論＝にちにちこれよろん」は、禅語である「日日是好日（その日一日に感謝し、ただありのままに生きる」をオマージュしたもの。2020年、コロナを経験した私たちはいま、「日常」こそが有難く「特別」な時間の重なりであることを知りました。
　「与論島」は、観光の島であるという観点から、コロナ禍でのダメージはもちろん大きなことですが、それは世界中どこでも同じこと。それどころか毎年の台風をはじめとする自然災害や戦争も乗り越えてきた島です。
　今回のART&FACTORY JAPAN出品作では、与論島に暮らすさまざまな「いのち」の擬人化を通して、大きな自然のサイクルを受け入れながら日々を繰りかえす、島の美しさやたくましさを表現します（とはいえ、与論の日常はほかの街に住む人からみれば大いなる非日常ですが）。
　与論島から、同じような問題を抱え悩む離島や、過疎の町、”今”を生きるすべての人たちへのエールとなるように。

title: Every Day is Yoron 4K Yoron Island, Nature moves on, as do we
description:
Learn more about Yoron Island
https://travel.yorontou.info/

The title "日日是与論＝にちにちこれよろん" is an homage to the Zen phrase "日日是好日 (Be grateful for each day and live as it is)." In 2020, after experiencing the pandemic, we learned that our "daily life" is indeed a precious overlap of "special" moments.

From the perspective of being a tourist island, Yoron Island has certainly suffered significant damage due to the pandemic, but this is true everywhere in the world. Moreover, it is an island that has overcome natural disasters such as annual typhoons and wars.

In this work presented at ART&FACTORY JAPAN, we express the beauty and resilience of the island through the personification of various "lives" that inhabit Yoron Island, while accepting the great cycles of nature that repeat day by day (though, to those living in other cities, daily life in Yoron may seem like a great non-daily experience).

From Yoron Island, we hope to send a message of encouragement to other remote islands and depopulated towns facing similar issues, as well as to all people living in the "now."

title: Tomo no Ura JAPAN HERITAGE
description:
We produced a PR video to promote the charm of Tomo no Ura, which has been recognized as a Japan Heritage.
It depicts scenes of people's lives thriving amidst the port facilities and townscapes that have remained since the Edo period.

title: 在地紀錄片【鄉野中的日本】EP01 | 修驗道行者隱居深山打造完美治愈空間 | 奈良縣宇陀市深野
description:
這次巡旅君前往拜訪的是位在奈良縣宇陀市深野，由一位修驗道行者松林哲司先生創辦的「笹百合庵」。
松林先生是一位有著奇特人生經歷的人物，大學時代孤身一人遊歷世界，雖被喜馬拉雅山脈的神秘與肅穆所折服，終究還是返回家鄉在大阪經營商社。而後為了追求自己理想的精神世界成為一名修驗道的僧人，改造深山村落裡的百年古宅，在這裡修行，經商，接待世界各地的旅人。
他自己所追尋的，同時也希望在現代都市生活中奔波的人們所體驗的究竟是一片怎樣的土地和居住空間呢？

********************

《鄉野中的日本》是一部在地紀錄片。我們聚焦位在鄉野經營小型精品旅舍的主理人，透過他們的理念，生活以及與當地人之間的聯繫，帶大家走進大都會以外的另一個日本。

********************

日本巡旅｜注重個性與本質的永續出行指南。

相較遊人交織、量化生產的觀光地，『日本巡旅』更多的著眼於仍然保留有在地淳樸風情的小地方。蘊含當地人念想的旅舍、料理店、茶館、藝術創作、個性店鋪，是一扇扇洞察在地文化與傳統的窗口。她們通過對當代生活方式的探索，在自然生態造就的古老營生和永續發展之間找到平衡。希望我們的小小努力能夠拓寬旅行的邊界，幫助構建起超越國界與文化的連接。

【在做的事】

ア 線上旅遊指南

EDITORIAL POLICY
1  傳達背景而非表象的介紹
2  傳達價值而非虛幻的數字
3  傳達思想而非冰冷的物質

FACEBOOK｜紀行・隨筆・物語
INSTAGRAM｜在地生活方式
微信公眾號｜在地旅舍
網頁程序｜構建中

イ 在地旅舍平台

我們甄選日本各地隱與鄉野的小型獨立旅舍。她們或是藏在山間、矗立於海島、甚至可能混跡於村落的煙火氣息中。原則上遠離都會及熱門觀光景點，客房數量不多於5間。剔除流水線式的複製旅舍，均為主理人或在地公司獨立運營。作為深入當地的旅行據點，擁有強烈個性，能夠闡釋當地特有的生態環境，生活文化美學，以及踐行永續旅遊的理念。

我們通過對主理人的訪談，從人文生態/在地食材/主理人物語/建築設計/交流體驗等各個角度深度剖析在地旅舍的魅力所在。

title: Local Documentary 【Japan in the Countryside】 EP01 | A Shugendo Practitioner Creates a Perfect Healing Space in the Deep Mountains | Fukano, Uda City, Nara Prefecture
description:
This time, we visit 'Sasayuri-an', located in Fukano, Uda City, Nara Prefecture, founded by Mr. Tetsuji Matsubayashi, a Shugendo practitioner.
Mr. Matsubayashi is a person with a unique life experience. During his university years, he traveled the world alone, captivated by the mystery and solemnity of the Himalayas, but eventually returned to his hometown to run a trading company in Osaka. Later, in pursuit of his ideal spiritual world, he became a Shugendo monk, transforming a century-old house in a mountain village into a place for practice, business, and welcoming travelers from around the world.
What kind of land and living space is he seeking, and what do people rushing through modern urban life hope to experience?

********************

'Japan in the Countryside' is a local documentary. We focus on the operators of small boutique inns in rural areas, bringing you into another Japan outside the metropolis through their philosophies, lives, and connections with local people.

********************

Japan Travel | A Sustainable Travel Guide that Values Personality and Essence.

Compared to tourist spots that are intertwined with visitors and mass production, 'Japan Travel' focuses more on small places that still retain the local rustic charm. Inns, restaurants, tea houses, art creations, and unique shops that embody the thoughts of local people are windows into local culture and traditions. Through exploring contemporary lifestyles, they find a balance between ancient livelihoods shaped by natural ecology and sustainable development. We hope our small efforts can broaden the boundaries of travel and help build connections that transcend borders and cultures.

【What We Do】

A. Online Travel Guide

EDITORIAL POLICY
1. Convey background rather than superficial introductions
2. Convey value rather than illusory numbers
3. Convey thoughts rather than cold material

FACEBOOK | Travelogues, Essays, Stories
INSTAGRAM | Local Lifestyle
WeChat Official Account | Local Inns
Website Program | Under Construction

B. Local Inn Platform

We select small independent inns hidden in the mountains and countryside across Japan. They may be tucked away in the mountains, standing on islands, or even blending into the local village atmosphere. In principle, they are far from urban and popular tourist spots, with no more than 5 guest rooms. We exclude mass-produced inns; all are independently operated by the owners or local companies. As a travel base for deep local experiences, they possess strong personalities that can explain the unique ecological environment, cultural aesthetics, and the practice of sustainable tourism.

Through interviews with the operators, we deeply analyze the charm of local inns from various perspectives, including cultural ecology, local ingredients, operator stories, architectural design, and experiential exchanges.

トアロードの住人であろうがなかろうが、人生のなかでトアロードに立ち寄った時間は、あなたの歩いていく道にきっと花を咲かせるだろう、という想いを込めたタイトルです。

description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

第3回 日本国際観光映像祭 ART&FACTORY JAPAN 最優秀賞受賞作品

［日々是与論 4K_Yoron Island,Nature moves on,as do we］
タイトルの「日々是与論＝にちにちこれよろん」は、禅語である「日々是好日」（その日一日に感謝し、ただありのままに生きる）をオマージュしたもの。2020年、コロナを経験した私たちはいま、「日常」こそが有難く「特別」な時間の重なりであることを知りました。
「与論島」は、観光の島であるという観点から、コロナ禍でのダメージはもちろん大きなことですが、それは世界中どこでも同じこと。
それどころか毎年の台風をはじめとする自然災害や戦争も乗り越えてきた島です。
この作品では、与論島に暮らすさまざまな「いのち」の擬人化を通して、大きな自然のサイクルを受け入れながら日々を繰りかえす、島の美しさやたくましさを表現します。（とはいえ、与論の日常はほかの街に住む人からみれば大いなる非日常ですが）。
与論島から、同じような問題を抱え悩む離島や、過疎の町、“今”を生きる
すべての人たちへのエールとなるように。

title: Every Day is Yoron 4K_Yoron Island, Nature moves on, as do we
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

Winner of the Grand Prize at the 3rd Japan International Tourism Film Festival ART&FACTORY JAPAN

[Every Day is Yoron 4K_Yoron Island, Nature moves on, as do we]
The title "Every Day is Yoron = Nichinichi Kore Yoron" is an homage to the Zen phrase "Nichinichi Kore Kōjitsu" (to be grateful for each day and to live simply as it is). In 2020, after experiencing the pandemic, we have come to realize that "everyday life" is indeed a precious overlap of "special" moments.
Yoron Island, being a tourist destination, has certainly suffered greatly due to the pandemic, but this is true everywhere in the world.
Moreover, the island has overcome natural disasters such as annual typhoons and wars.
This work expresses the beauty and resilience of the island through the personification of various "lives" that inhabit Yoron Island, while accepting the great cycles of nature and repeating daily life. (That said, the daily life of Yoron may seem like a great non-everyday to those living in other cities).
From Yoron Island, we hope to send a message of encouragement to other remote islands and depopulated towns facing similar issues, and to all those living in the "now."

Through this video "Together in Time," we invite you to return, if only for a moment, to the gentle and peaceful time that thrives in the Japan Heritage designated "Tomonoura."

Let’s experience the life of Tomonoura, where joy is woven into the fabric of daily life.

title: 『EVで島をMOTTO元気にプロジェクト』 新入社員研修 in 式根島 【東日本三菱自動車販売株式会社】
description:
4月18日（木）～4月20日（土）の3日間、東日本三菱自動車販売株式会社（以下、東日本三菱）は、昨年に引き続き2024年4月に入社した新入社員研修を東京都新島村の式根島にて開催しました。

この活動は、台風などの自然災害による停電復旧までのインフラの不足が社会課題になっている島しょ地域の、BCP 対策の一環として、三菱自動車の中古電気自動車と外部給電装置を東京電力パワーグリッド株式会社（以下、東京電力パワーグリッド）と連携しながら普及させるために新島村と締結する『地域循環共生圏の実現に向けた共創に関する提携協定』に賛同した東日本三菱が参画し運営するものです。

プロジェクト名称：『EVで島をMOTTO元気にプロジェクト』

研修前日には新島村役場を表敬訪問。大沼村長さまに対する電動車導入状況や研修に関する説明のなかで自治体との連携を一層深めることができました。

研修では、東京電力パワーグリッドにも参加して頂き、島しょ地域の生活と、電気自動車の重要性に対する理解を深めました。また、環境省、東京電力パワーグリッド、新島村商工会のご協力のもとビーチクリーン活動を実施しました。

東日本三菱は、式根島がBCP強化に向けて三菱自動車の電気自動車を積極的に導入頂いていることに敬意を表して、島民の皆さまのお役に立てる様、新島村商工会式根島支部に対して外部給電器を寄贈しました。

東日本三菱は、更なる島民の皆さまの安全・安心に寄与すべく、電動車並びに外部給電器の普及を通じて社会にお役立てできる企業を目指して参ります。

title: ‘EV for a More Energetic Island Project’ New Employee Training in Shikine Island 【East Japan Mitsubishi Motors Sales Co., Ltd.】
description:
From April 18 (Thursday) to April 20 (Saturday), East Japan Mitsubishi Motors Sales Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as East Japan Mitsubishi) held new employee training for those who joined in April 2024 on Shikine Island in Niijima Village, Tokyo, continuing from last year.

This activity is part of the BCP measures for island regions, where the lack of infrastructure for restoring power outages due to natural disasters such as typhoons has become a social issue. East Japan Mitsubishi, which supports the 'Co-Creation Agreement for Realizing a Regional Circulation and Symbiotic Sphere' signed with Niijima Village, aims to promote the use of used electric vehicles from Mitsubishi Motors and external power supply devices in collaboration with Tokyo Electric Power Grid Corporation (hereinafter referred to as TEPCO Power Grid).

Project Name: ‘EV for a More Energetic Island Project’

On the day before the training, we paid a courtesy visit to the Niijima Village Office. During the explanation regarding the introduction of electric vehicles and the training to Mayor Onuma, we were able to deepen our collaboration with the local government.

During the training, TEPCO Power Grid also participated, enhancing our understanding of life in island regions and the importance of electric vehicles. Additionally, with the cooperation of the Ministry of the Environment, TEPCO Power Grid, and the Niijima Village Chamber of Commerce, we conducted a beach clean-up activity.

East Japan Mitsubishi expressed respect for the active introduction of Mitsubishi Motors' electric vehicles in Shikine Island for BCP enhancement and donated external power supply devices to the Shikine Branch of the Niijima Village Chamber of Commerce to be of service to the island residents.

East Japan Mitsubishi aims to be a company that contributes to society through the promotion of electric vehicles and external power supply devices to further ensure the safety and security of the island residents.
