title: 【新島ミライプロジェクト】210402 CX Live News it!
description:
2021年春、東京の島　新島から島内全家庭のプラスティック洗濯バサミを、くさや型のアルミ製洗濯バサミ　”HOSSY" との交換を目指すプロジェクトです。

　紫外線で劣化し、すぐに壊れるプラスティック洗濯バサミを島のシンボルである”くさや型洗濯バサミ”に換えることにより、島の大切な産業である、くさやをより身近に感じてもらい、何より、もう壊れて捨てることのない洗濯バサミに交換することで、プラスティックのゴミを出さない生活へと変えていきたいと考えています。

海から恵みをいただき発展してきた島だから、「今こそ自然環境に対し、何ができるか？」を島の人たち一人一人が考える機会の創出です。

　今後は、東京宝島の力もお借りし、同時に企業様の力もお借りしたいと願っております。もちろん私たちでもクラウドファンディングを行い、少しでも多くの方にコミットいただきたいと考えています。

そして新島での取り組みを、東京諸島の全11島へ広げ、その先にこのアクションを日本の島々へ広めて行きたいと考えております。
狙いは2つ。

①日本の食文化への理解 “干物（くさや）”から、郷土への誇りを高めるとともに、
②難しく考えがちな “環境問題”をユニークな取組みで、気づきの連鎖につなげたい。

それは【新しい、でつながる島】だから。
海と生きるまち。海の環境問題に正面から取り組む「エコアイランド構想」への環境アクションです。

title: [Niijima Mirai Project] 210402 CX Live News it!
description:
In spring 2021, this project aims to exchange plastic laundry clips from all households on Niijima Island, Tokyo, for aluminum laundry clips shaped like kusaya, called 'HOSSY'.

By replacing plastic laundry clips, which deteriorate under UV light and break easily, with the island's symbol, the 'kusaya-shaped laundry clip', we hope to make the important industry of kusaya more familiar to everyone. Most importantly, by exchanging for laundry clips that won't break and be thrown away, we aim to transition to a lifestyle that produces no plastic waste.

As an island that has developed by receiving blessings from the sea, we want to create opportunities for each islander to think about 'What can we do for the natural environment now?'.

In the future, we hope to leverage the power of Tokyo's Treasure Island and also seek the support of companies. Of course, we plan to conduct crowdfunding ourselves, hoping to get as many people as possible to commit to this cause.

We also aim to expand our efforts on Niijima to all 11 islands of the Tokyo Islands, and ultimately spread this action to the islands of Japan.
There are two main objectives:

1. To enhance understanding of Japan's food culture through 'dried fish (kusaya)' and foster pride in our local heritage.
2. To connect the often complex topic of 'environmental issues' to a chain of awareness through unique initiatives.

This is because it is [a new island connected by innovation].
A town that lives with the sea. This is an environmental action towards the 'Eco-Island Concept', which directly addresses marine environmental issues.

title: Nagoya City Promotion Movie, “COOL! NAGOYA” 【MATSURI】
description:
New movies have been completed introducing the traditional & futuristic charm of Nagoya. The concept is a “COOL! NAGOYA”. We are introducing our attractive MATSURI (Festival) & FAMILY TRIP (recommended places for family vacations) with electronic dance music composed by Yamato. Please check them out!
* We took videos after thorough infectious disease prevention measures.

0:00　White Dragon (Kigakurin Banshoji-Temple)
0:01　WORLD COSPLAY SUMMIT 2022 (Osu Cosplay Parade)
0:03　Nagoya Castle Summer Festival Bon Dancing 2022
0:06　Atsuta Festival (Shobusai Festival)
0:07　Nagoya Festival (The 67th)
0:11　DOMATSURI 2022 (The largest dance festival in the Chubu Region)
0:22　WORLD COSPLAY SUMMIT 2022 (Osu Cosplay Parade, Oasis21)
0:33　Nagoya Festival (The 67th) /Parade Float, Procession of the Three Feudal Lords (Nobunaga Oda, Hideyoshi Toyotomi and Ieyasu Tokugawa)
0:40　Atsuta Festival (Shobusai Festival)
0:49　Nagoya Castle Summur Festival Bon Dancing 2022

-------------------------------------------------

名古屋の「伝統」と「近未来」的な魅力が融合した動画が完成しました。 コンセプトは「COOL! NAGOYA」。 お祭りと家族旅行にお薦めの場所を、名古屋発祥の和楽器「大正琴」の音色を取り入れて、DJ/プロデューサーのYamatoが生み出すオリジナルのエレクトロニック・ダンスミュージックに乗せて紹介します。どうぞご覧ください！ 
※新型コロナウイルス感染症対策に留意して撮影しています。

東京と大阪のほぼ中間に位置し、白川郷観光の起点としても大変便利な都市「名古屋」。過去には数多くのサムライたちが大活躍したこの地域は、現代においては日本経済をけん引する多くの産業を有する大都市です。MATSURI編ではエミリーさんが、名古屋発祥の和楽器「大正琴」の音色を取り入れたオリジナルのエレクトロニック・ダンスミュージックに乗せて、名古屋の祭りやイベントの魅力を紹介します。動画視聴前にあなたが名古屋に対して抱いているであろう『COOL？』のイメージは、動画視聴後にはきっと『COOL！』に変わっていることでしょう！

0:00　白龍（亀岳林　万松寺）

名古屋の「伝統」と「近未来」的な魅力が融合した動画が完成しました。
コンセプトは「COOL! NAGOYA」。
お祭りと家族旅行にお薦めの場所を、名古屋発祥の和楽器「大正琴」の音色を取り入れて、DJ/プロデューサーのYamatoが生み出すオリジナルのエレクトロニック・ダンスミュージックに乗せて紹介します。
どうぞご覧ください！
※新型コロナウイルス感染症対策に留意して撮影しています。

東京と大阪のほぼ中間に位置し、白川郷観光の起点としても大変便利な都市「名古屋」。
過去には数多くのサムライたちが大活躍したこの地域は、現代においては日本経済をけん引する多くの産業を有する大都市です。
MATSURI編ではエミリーさんが、名古屋発祥の和楽器「大正琴」の音色を取り入れたオリジナルのエレクトロニック・ダンスミュージックに乗せて、名古屋の祭りやイベントの魅力を紹介します。
動画視聴前にあなたが名古屋に対して抱いているであろう『COOL？』のイメージは、動画視聴後にはきっと『COOL！』に変わっていることでしょう！

title: Spring in Nagoya
description:
コロナ禍により観光渡航が途絶する中、早春の名古屋の美しさを感じていただきたく、春の精に誘われるイメージで動画を作成しました。
乾杯のシーンでは、VYSA Tokai（在日ベトナム学生青年協会東海支部）のメンバーにご協力いただきました。

title: Spring in Nagoya
description:
Amidst the pandemic that has halted tourism, we created a video to convey the beauty of early spring in Nagoya, inspired by the spirit of spring.
In the scene of the toast, we received cooperation from members of VYSA Tokai (Vietnamese Youth and Student Association Tokai Branch).

title: 名古屋神社めぐり旅
description:
愛知県は神社仏閣の数が日本一だということはご存じでしょうか？
そんな神社仏閣の多いエリアにおいて、名古屋市内には700以上の「神社」が鎮座しています。
神社はその土地の歴史に縁が強く、いろいろな物語を楽しむことができます。
観光名所や施設以外に、名古屋の街中にある「神社」を巡ってみてはいかがでしょう。

title: Nagoya Shrine Tour
description:
Did you know that Aichi Prefecture has the highest number of shrines and temples in Japan?
In this area rich with shrines and temples, there are over 700 'shrines' located within Nagoya city.
Shrines are closely tied to the history of the land, and you can enjoy various stories.
How about exploring the 'shrines' scattered throughout the city of Nagoya, in addition to the tourist attractions and facilities?

title: 日本の産業を巡る旅へ！Journey Through Japanese Industries
description:
From South Osaka to Wakayama, we offer two unique plans of Industrial Tourism: the Superior Plan, where you can engage in direct conversations with business owners, learning their secrets of business succession, sustainable manufacturing, and remarkable recovery from global financial crises; and the Standard Plan, which provides a behind-the-scenes look at traditional industries. 
Join us on a journey to discover the heart of Osaka’s craftsmanship and passion.

Please contact us from the URL below.
https://matcha-jp.com/jp/23218
------------------------------------------------
What is Industrial Tourism?
★Discover the Hidden Side of Japan’s Manufacturing
Osaka is where products showcasing the skills of Japan’s proud craftsmen are created. You can experience a wide range of factories, from traditional crafts to metal processing. Take a step inside to the actual workshops.

★Learn from the Leaders of Long-Established Companies
Executives from companies with over 50 years of history will personally explain the secrets of their insights -environmentally friendly manufacturing, methods for training young talent, business succession strategies, and more.

★Optimal Location in Osaka
The companies are located between Kansai Intl Airport and Namba, offering excellent access.

For more information/enquiries, check our website :https://matcha-jp.com/en/23218

南大阪・和歌山エリアの企業を訪問する特別ツアーです。プレミアムプランでは経営者との対話を通じて事業承継や製造業の展望を学び、スタンダードプランでは伝統産業の現場見学ができます。
大阪のものづくりの真髄に触れる貴重な機会をお届けします。

産業観光とは？
★ものづくり大国ニッポンの裏側に潜入！
日本が誇る職人の技術がつまった製品が生み出されている場所ーそれが、関西です。
伝統工芸品からプラスチックや金属加工品まで、幅広いものづくりの現場を見学・体験いただけます。
見学いただける工場は、優れた技術とイノベーティブな経営者がいるものづくり企業。世界から信頼されている日本の製品が生まれている生の現場に潜入いただきます。

★長寿企業の経営者から学ぶ体験を
　50年以上の歴史を誇る企業の経営層が皆さまをお迎えし、環境共生型のものづくりの秘訣や、若手人材の確保/育成方法、３Ｓの徹底、事業承継の方法など、社長自らご説明いたします。
　
★関西国際空港と大阪万博の間の最適なロケーションで体験　
弊社がご提案するものづくり企業の多くは、関西の玄関口・関西国際空港と、
大阪の中心地・なんばの間に位置しているため、アクセス抜群。

詳細について/お問合せはこちらから：https://matcha-jp.com/jp/23218

title: 令和5年度岐南地芝居公演(美濃歌舞伎保存会)
description:
令和5年9月10日（日）
岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

昨年に引き続き、「伏屋の獅子芝居」と県内の他の獅子芝居や地歌舞伎を同時にみられる「岐南地芝居公演」を開催しました。今年は関市獅子舞保存会と美濃歌舞伎保存会が出演しました。

　　地歌舞伎『三人吉三』
　　
【あらすじ】
「月も朧に白魚の…」「こいつぁ春から、縁起がいいわぇ」の名ぜりふで有名な、河竹黙阿弥の世話物作品。　
　節分の夜、お嬢吉三は隅田川の河畔で夜鷹の女から金百両を奪うが、それをお坊吉三が見とがめ、二人は金を巡って争う。通りかかった和尚吉三が争いを仲裁し、互いの正体をあかしあった同じ名の三人は義兄弟の契りを結ぶ。和尚は百両を父の伝吉に貢ぐが、悪銭は要らぬと投げ捨てられる。百両はお坊の手に渡り、伝吉はお坊に殺されてしまう。
　お嬢とお坊は、和尚と再会、そこでお坊は初めて自分が和尚の父を殺したことを知り、お嬢は夜鷹の女が和尚の妹だということを知る。二人は罪を悔いて死のうとするが…

title: Ginan Local Kabuki Performance 2023 (Mino Kabuki Preservation Society)
description:
September 10, 2023 (Sunday)
Ginan Local Kabuki Performance @ Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Hall

Continuing from last year, we held the "Ginan Local Kabuki Performance" where you can enjoy "Fushiya's Lion Kabuki" along with other lion kabuki and local kabuki from within the prefecture. This year, the Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society performed.

Local Kabuki 'San-nin Kichisa'

[Synopsis]
Famous for the lines, "The moon is hazy, and the white fish..." and "This is a good omen from spring," this is a sewa-mono work by Kawatake Mokuami. On the night of Setsubun, Ojou Kichisa steals 100 ryo from a night hawk woman by the Sumida River, but Bou Kichisa witnesses it, and the two argue over the money. Passing by, Osho Kichisa mediates the dispute, and the three men, sharing the same name, reveal their true identities and become sworn brothers. The Osho offers the 100 ryo to his father, Denkichi, but the bad money is thrown away. The 100 ryo ends up in the hands of the Bou, and Denkichi is killed by the Bou. Ojou and Bou reunite with Osho, where the Bou learns for the first time that he killed Osho's father, and Ojou discovers that the night hawk woman is Osho's sister. The two regret their sins and contemplate death, but...

title: 令和5年度岐南地芝居公演(岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会)
description:
令和5年9月10日（日）
岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

岐阜県にて令和6年度開催される、第39回国民文化祭 第24回全国障害者芸術・文化祭 「『清流のぎふ』文化祭2024」のプレイベントのひとつとして、今年も「岐南地芝居公演」を開催しました。「伏屋の獅子芝居」と県内の他の獅子芝居や地歌舞伎が同時にみられる公演で、今年は岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会、関市獅子舞保存会と美濃歌舞伎保存会が出演しました。

　　道行
　　寄
　　悪魔払い
　　獅子芝居『傾城阿波の鳴門　巡礼歌の段』
　　
【あらすじ】
　徳島は玉木家の家宝、名刀「国次」を探すため、十郎兵衛、お弓(獅子)の夫婦は三歳の娘お鶴を国許に残し、諸国を巡るが、じきに金銭も尽き、悪事を重ね尋者となってしまう。
　九歳になったお鶴は、両親に会いたい一心から、巡礼姿で諸国遍路の旅に出ていた。ある日、大阪に身を隠すお弓の元に、偶然、順礼姿のお鶴が訪れる。お弓は話を聞くうちに、間違いなく我が娘、お鶴であることに気がつく。今すぐに抱きしめ、母と名乗りたい思いを抑え、娘に罪が及ぶことを恐れて、国へ帰るよう諭すお弓だが、お鶴は「どうやら母さんのように思われて」と泣き、ここにおいてほしいと頼むのであった。

title: Ginan Local Theater Performance for the 5th Year of Reiwa (Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Preservation Society)
description:
September 10, 2023 (Sunday)
Ginan Local Theater Performance @ Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Hall

As one of the pre-events for the 39th National Cultural Festival and the 24th National Arts and Culture Festival for Persons with Disabilities, "'Seiryu no Gifu' Cultural Festival 2024" to be held in Gifu Prefecture in the 6th year of Reiwa, the "Ginan Local Theater Performance" was held again this year. This performance featured the "Fushiya Lion Theater" alongside other lion theaters and local kabuki from within the prefecture, with appearances by the Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Preservation Society, the Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society, and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society.

　　Road Journey
　　Visit
　　Demon Exorcism
　　Lion Theater 'Keisei Awa no Naruto: Pilgrimage Song Scene'

【Synopsis】
In search of the family heirloom, the famous sword "Kunitsugi" of the Tamaki family in Tokushima, Jurobei and his wife Oyu (the lion) leave their three-year-old daughter Otsuru at home and travel through various countries. However, soon their money runs out, and they resort to wrongdoing, becoming fugitives. At the age of nine, Otsuru, with a strong desire to see her parents, sets out on a pilgrimage journey dressed as a pilgrim. One day, Oyu, who is hiding in Osaka, unexpectedly encounters Otsuru, who is in pilgrimage attire. As Oyu listens to her story, she realizes without a doubt that this is her daughter, Otsuru. Suppressing her desire to embrace her immediately and introduce herself as her mother, Oyu advises Otsuru to return home, fearing that her daughter might be implicated in her troubles. However, Otsuru, crying, says, "It seems I am thought to be like my mother," and pleads to stay here.

Город Майдзуру - портовый город на севере префектуры Киото. В этом ролике мы расскажем о восточной части города. title: かかしの村の声- The Voice of the Scarecrow Village [ #Poem #Tokushima #filmfestival ]
description:
Our first video that is officially selected for a film festival!
https://jwtff.world/aiovg_videos/2022_j201/

時間の止まった天空の村を訪れた異邦人は、迎えくる案山子と共に旅路を共にしたあの人の思い出をそっと村に留めおく。ただ永遠いうその時を刻むために。

This poem is meant to reflect our final adventure together and this beautiful Nagoro Scarecrow Village and its surroundings. Making youtube videos together have gotten us to go places we never knew we would. Although it didn't last long, we have been able to see and experience things we never imagined possible in Japan. I visited Iya Valley with my friend last year. We had the time of our life. It was only the two of us. I documented our travel around Shikoku. After our trip to Shikoku, we came back to Tokyo and we went our separate ways. I have never seen her since, and she never had the chance to see this video. With this video, I hope besides promoting the Nagoro “Scarecrow” Village, I can reach her out somehow. The poem represents my feelings towards her after our trip but at the same time, it also symbolizes reaching out to people from far away to see the Nagoro “Scarecrow” Village.

去年、友達と祖谷渓を訪れました。そこで私たちは特別な時間を過ごしました。 そこは、私たち二人だけの空間でした。その四国での旅を記録しました。 東京に戻った後、私たちは別々の道を進みました。 それ以来、私は彼女に会ったことがなく、彼女はこの映画を見る機会はありませんでした。 この映画で、なごろ「かかし」村を宣伝するだけでなく、なんとかして彼女に連絡できることを願っています。 この詩は、旅行後の彼女への私の気持ちを表しています。しかし、それと同時になごろ「かかし」の村を遠方からの人たちにも見てもらいたちとの思いを届けるものです。

徳島県のなごろ「かかし」村を宣伝したいと思います。 友達とこの場所を訪れたとき、自分たち以外には観光客は皆無でした。 そこで出会った地元の人々はとてもフレンドリーで、もっと多くの人に自分たちの美しい故郷とその近隣を訪れてほしいという彼らの思いが伝わってきました。 外国人の友人の何人かは、この場所について耳にしたことがありますが、実際の場所を目にしたものはいません。その場所も聞いたことないのが、ほとんどです。 しかし、映画を見せると、彼らはこの場所に行きたがりました。 そして、そこへの道順と到着するのに必要な費用を聞いてきました。 この映画を見て、友達のように、祖谷渓の村や他の場所を訪れてくれることを願っています。

title: The Voice of the Scarecrow Village - かかしの村の声 [ #Poem #Tokushima #filmfestival ]
description:
Our first video that is officially selected for a film festival!
https://jwtff.world/aiovg_videos/2022_j201/

The foreigner who visited the sky village where time has stopped quietly leaves the memories of that person who traveled with the welcoming scarecrow in the village. Just to mark that eternal moment.

This poem is meant to reflect our final adventure together and this beautiful Nagoro Scarecrow Village and its surroundings. Making youtube videos together have gotten us to go places we never knew we would. Although it didn't last long, we have been able to see and experience things we never imagined possible in Japan. I visited Iya Valley with my friend last year. We had the time of our life. It was only the two of us. I documented our travel around Shikoku. After our trip to Shikoku, we came back to Tokyo and we went our separate ways. I have never seen her since, and she never had the chance to see this video. With this video, I hope besides promoting the Nagoro “Scarecrow” Village, I can reach her out somehow. The poem represents my feelings towards her after our trip but at the same time, it also symbolizes reaching out to people from far away to see the Nagoro “Scarecrow” Village.

Last year, I visited Iya Valley with my friend. We had a special time there. It was a space just for the two of us. I documented our journey in Shikoku. After returning to Tokyo, we went our separate ways. Since then, I have not seen her, and she never had the chance to see this film. With this film, I hope to not only promote the Nagoro “Scarecrow” Village but also somehow reach out to her. This poem expresses my feelings towards her after our trip. At the same time, it conveys my desire for people from afar to see the Nagoro “Scarecrow” Village.

I would like to promote the Nagoro “Scarecrow” Village in Tokushima Prefecture. When I visited this place with my friend, there were no tourists other than us. The local people we met were very friendly, and their desire for more people to visit their beautiful hometown and its surroundings was palpable. Some of my foreign friends have heard of this place, but very few have actually seen it. Most have never even heard of it. However, after showing them the film, they expressed a desire to visit this place. They also asked about the directions and the costs needed to get there. I hope that after watching this film, they will visit the village in Iya Valley and other places, just like my friend did.

description:
梅雨の風物として、古くから愛されている約３，０００本のあじさいが公園を彩ります。
雨にも映える赤、白、紫色の色鮮やかなあじさいは多くの人を和ませてくれます。

title: Hibiyama Park Hydrangeas
description:
About 3,000 hydrangeas, loved for a long time as a symbol of the rainy season, adorn the park.
The vibrant red, white, and purple hydrangeas shine even in the rain, bringing comfort to many.

title: 家族旅行村「安心院」
description:
家族旅行村「安心院」は、大自然のなかでご家族・ご友人と気ままにのんびりと別荘感覚でご利用いただける本格的ログハウスをはじめ、お子様からお年寄りまで世代を超えて気軽に楽しめるパークゴルフ場などのスポーツ施設、疲れた体を癒してくれる温泉など、魅力あふれる複合レジャー施設です。
また近年、注目を集めているオートキャンプ場は、最大１６張りのテントを設置することができ、バーベキューや昆虫採集、天体観測などをお楽しみいただけます。
家族旅行村「安心院」で、大自然を感じながら、ゆったりとしたひと時をお楽しみください。

title: Ajimu Family Travel Village
description:
Ajimu Family Travel Village offers a variety of attractions, including authentic log cabins where families and friends can relax in a villa-like atmosphere amidst nature, sports facilities such as a park golf course that can be enjoyed by all generations from children to the elderly, and hot springs that soothe tired bodies. 
In recent years, the auto camping site has gained attention, allowing for the setup of up to 16 tents, where you can enjoy barbecues, insect collecting, and stargazing. 
Experience the great outdoors and enjoy a leisurely time at Ajimu Family Travel Village.

description: 令和6年6月1日(土)に開催した「平和を考える 映画と落語」で宇佐市にお越しいただいた林家三平氏に、宇佐市平和ミュージアム（仮称）建設予定地にて平和への想いを語っていただきました。

There was a country saved by a recluse... #travel #IWantToConnectWithPeopleWhoLoveTravelingAbroad #OverseasTravel #vlog #Europe #Italy #Vatican
フィッシャーマンズワーフ白浜
description:
地元の漁師の方々が運営する施設です。１階が鮮魚市場で２階がレストラン、屋上には季節限定のビアガーデンがあります。
併設した桟橋から直接水揚げされた新鮮な食材を、ふんだんに使用した和食とイタリアンを堪能ください。

title: Fisherman's Wharf Shirahama
description:
This facility is operated by local fishermen. The first floor is a fresh fish market, and the second floor is a restaurant, with a seasonal beer garden on the rooftop.
Please enjoy Japanese and Italian cuisine that makes abundant use of fresh ingredients directly landed from the pier attached to the facility.

title: 三段壁 シネマティック
description:
千畳敷の南海岸にそそり立つ高さ50m～60mの断崖。
その昔、漁師たちが通りゆく船や魚の群れを見張った場所「見壇」に由来するといわれるこの大岩壁は、南北2kmにわたって展開され、岩肌に打ち寄せる黒潮が激しくぶつかり合うダイナミックな光景には、自然の迫力を感じずにいられません！
2016年4月、恋人の聖地｢南紀白浜/三段壁｣として選定されました

title: Sandanbaki Cinematic
description:
A 50m to 60m high cliff towering over the southern coast of Chijōzaki.
This massive rock wall, said to be named after the place 'Midan' where fishermen once watched over passing ships and schools of fish, extends for 2 kilometers from north to south. The dynamic scene of the Kuroshio current crashing against the rocky surface is a sight that cannot help but evoke the power of nature!
In April 2016, it was selected as a 'Sacred Place for Lovers' in Nanki Shirahama/Sandanbaki.

WEB : https://moare.jp

【English】
Since ancient times, trees have played an important role in  Japanese culture.

There is something about wood that, when it is present in our daily life,  it eases our minds.  

After all, that feeling is embedded in our DNA, so when we are in constant exposure with something made of wood, an overflowing warmth runs throughout our whole self.

Humans feel unsafe in darkness,  that's why even a feeble light at the end of the road gives us hope and a feeling of safety.

The very heart of  Hida region's technique and workmanship that has been passed down for generations provides a special synergy between  illumination and the feeling of warmth in raw materials.  This offers a unique experience through a delicate illumination

Our mission is to offer products that are highly valued all over the world even after 50, 100, or more years.

【Español】
Desde tiempos inmemoriales, los árboles han tenido un rol vital en la cultura japonesa.

Hay algo en la madera que, cuando está presente en nuestro día a día, nos llena de paz. Ya que ese sentimiento está impreso en nuestro ADN,  cuando estamos en contacto con algo de madera, sentimos una calidez indescriptible. 

Los humanos nos sentimos inseguros en la obscuridad, por lo que, cuando encontramos una señal de luz,  aquel rayito de esperanza nos proporciona una sensación de seguridad.

El espíritu de la tradicional técnica y destreza de la región de Hida, que ha sido transmitido de generación en generación, proporciona una sinergia entre la belleza de la iluminación y la calidez de sus materiales, lo cual nos brinda a su vez una experiencia única por su suave luz.

Nuestra misión es brindarle a todo el mundo productos que mentengan su preferencia aún después de 50, 100 o más años.

title: Amami Islands, Japan in 8K
description:
The Amami Islands consist of eight inhabited islands (Amami Oshima, Kakeroma Island, Kikaijima, Yorojima, Kikai Island, Tokunoshima, Okinoerabu Island, and Yoron Island) scattered over the sea 380 to 580 kilometers south of Kagoshima. The subtropical nature includes many rare creatures, including endemic species. Each island has many attractive points, such as islands where 'habu' snakes live, islands formed by raised coral, and islands with world-renowned limestone caves underground.

title: 中津川【富士見台高原】Fujimidaikogen, Nakatsugawa
description:
富士見台高原は、中央アルプスの南端、恵那山系にある標高1,739mの笹に覆われた美しい山です。

山の中腹まで車で行けるため手軽なハイキングスポットとして人気があります。

晴れた日には一面、緑色の笹に覆われた山肌と抜けるような青空とのコントラストが楽しめます。
山頂では恵那山、北アルプス、南アルプス、中央アルプスを見渡す壮大な360度の大パノラマが待ち受けています。

7月には日本原産で希少植物のササユリ、10月中旬から11月上旬ごろには燃え上がるような真っ赤な山並みを楽しむことができます。

登山シーズンは、4月末から11月中旬まで。

撮影日：2021年7月18日

富士見台高原や中津川の観光については、中津川観光協会までお問い合わせください。
【一般社団法人　中津川観光協会】

title: Fujimidaikogen, Nakatsugawa
description:
Fujimidaikogen is a beautiful mountain covered in grass at an elevation of 1,739 meters, located at the southern end of the Central Alps in the Ena mountain range.

It is a popular hiking spot due to the accessibility of driving up to the mountainside.

On clear days, you can enjoy the contrast between the green grass-covered slopes and the bright blue sky.
At the summit, a magnificent 360-degree panorama awaits, offering views of Ena Mountain, the Northern Alps, the Southern Alps, and the Central Alps.

In July, you can see the rare native plant, Sasayuri, and from mid-October to early November, you can enjoy the fiery red mountain ranges.

The climbing season is from late April to mid-November.

Date of photography: July 18, 2021

For information about tourism in Fujimidaikogen and Nakatsugawa, please contact the Nakatsugawa Tourism Association.
【General Incorporated Association Nakatsugawa Tourism Association】

title: Reidai Bridge　霊台橋　英字幕付き　美里町観光PR動画
description:
This is a Misato Town tourism PR video created in 2025.

This is a gigantic stone bridge with a total length of 90 meters that spans Funatsu Gorge, the most difficult point on the main stream of the Midori River. It is one of the largest single stone arches in Japan from the Edo period. It is a nationally designated important cultural property that was built in 1847 (4th year of Koka) by the three Taneyama mason brothers Usuke, Uichi, and Johachi.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
すっかり秋めいてきた下呂温泉、
紅葉を楽しむのなら「温泉寺」がおすすめです。

昼間でも見事な紅葉を見ることができますが、
11月11日（金）～20日（日）までに行っている、紅葉ライトアップも見逃せません。
16時半～21時まで、紅葉がライトアップされて、その中を散策することもできます。

入場無料で入退場も自由にでき、お参りしつつ、夜の散歩をするにはもってこいですね。
寒さが強くなってきていますので、防寒具の用意をお忘れなく。

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
Gero Onsen has completely embraced autumn, 
if you want to enjoy the autumn leaves, we recommend "Onsen-ji".

You can see the magnificent autumn foliage even during the day, 
but don’t miss the autumn leaf light-up event happening from November 11 (Friday) to 20 (Sunday).
From 4:30 PM to 9 PM, the autumn leaves will be illuminated, and you can stroll through them.

Entry is free, and you can come and go as you please, making it perfect for a night walk while paying your respects.
As the cold is getting stronger, don’t forget to prepare warm clothing.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
本日は、太陽がずっと雲に隠れていました。

雨は降らなかったけれど、涼しくてなんだかしんみりした気持ちになります。市街の道や飛騨川のそばでも、静かでゆったりした時が流れているようでした。
河原にある大きな石たちは、ずっと昔から下呂温泉を見てきたのでしょうか？

こんな日は、温泉に入って気分転換に限ります！
日々是温泉がモットーの、下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Today, the sun was hidden behind the clouds all day.

Although it didn't rain, it was cool and somehow made me feel a bit melancholic. It seemed like a quiet and relaxed time was flowing along the streets of the city and by the Hida River.
Did the large stones by the riverbank witness Gero Onsen for a long time?

On days like this, there's nothing better than soaking in the hot springs to refresh oneself!
We appreciate your support for Gero Onsen, where our motto is 'Every day is a hot spring day!'

title: Exploring Rural Japan: A Journey to Okayama岡山, Kagamino鏡野, Tsuyama津山, Okutsu Onsen奥津温泉 | Autumn
description:
#japan #japantravel #japanvlog #offthebeatenpath #autumn #maple #okayama #okayamacity #kagamino #tsuyama #roadtrip #driveinjapan #travelog #onsen #onsentown 

Join me and Mom on an unforgettable journey through the hidden gems of Okayama, Kagamino, and Tsuyama during the enchanting autumn season! 🍁 In this vlog, we venture off the beaten path to explore destinations that are delightfully untouched by tourist crowds, giving us a true taste of authentic Japan. 🇯🇵 From the serene landscapes of Okayama to the charming Autumn foliage of Kagamino and the scenic beauty of Tsuyama, every moment is filled with awe-inspiring sights and heartwarming experiences. And as if that wasn't adventurous enough, watch as I take on the ultimate challenge of driving for the first time in rural Japan! 🚗💨 Join us for a one-of-a-kind journey filled with laughter, self discovery, and unforgettable memories. Don't forget to hit subscribe and join our travel family as we explore the world together! ✈️🌏 #JapanTravel #OffTheBeatenPath #AutumnAdventure"

　つるし柿・あんぽ柿・いちご・大和牛・大和野菜（大和まな、祝だいこん、宇陀金ごぼう）

奈良秘食旅とは・・・
　お茶やうどん、豆腐といった日本人の暮らしに欠かせない食材たち。
　そのルーツは、ここ奈良にある。
　時は飛鳥・奈良時代。
　シルクロードの終着点として栄えたこの地には、渡来人によって多くの文化や技術が持ち込ま
　れ、ここから、現在にまで脈々と受け継がれる食文化が育まれていく。
　大和かしわの再現を夢見て作られた「大和肉鶏」
　伝統を守りながら発展を遂げてきた「大和野菜」
　それらの食材は、大切に育てられ、そして今日もなお、未来を見つめ、進化を続けている。
　知られざる食のルーツと、魅力あふれる食材をめぐる

title: Nara Secret Food Journey - Winter
description:
Introducing the culinary charms of Nara Prefecture by season

Ingredients featured in the video...
　Dried persimmons, anpo persimmons, strawberries, Yamato beef, Yamato vegetables (Yamato greens, Iwai daikon, Uda golden burdock)

What is the Nara Secret Food Journey...
　Ingredients essential to Japanese life, such as tea, udon, and tofu.
　Their roots lie here in Nara.
　During the Asuka and Nara periods.
　This region flourished as the terminus of the Silk Road, where many cultures and technologies were brought by immigrants,
　and from here, a food culture that has been passed down to the present day was nurtured.
　The "Yamato chicken" created with the dream of recreating Yamato kashiwa.
　The "Yamato vegetables" that have developed while preserving tradition.
　These ingredients are carefully cultivated, and even today, they continue to evolve while looking towards the future.
　Exploring the unknown roots of food and the captivating ingredients.

title: 【公式】五所川原立佞武多２０１９PV（60秒 ver）　【official】Goshogawara Tachineputa Festival ２０１９ PV（60sec ver.）
description:
巨大な山車が力強いお囃子と「ヤッテマレ！ヤッテマレ！」の掛け声のもと、五所川原市街地を練り歩きます。大きいものだと高さ約23メートル、重さ約19トンもある山車は、その圧倒的迫力で沿道の観客を魅了します。
一台一台がテーマを持ち、それを表現するために細かな造形と鮮やかな色使いが施されています。迫力あるお祭りと優美に燈った立佞武多の絶妙なバランスは必見です。
期間：8月4日から8月8日



Massive parade floats accompanied by powerful festival music and the chant "Yattemare! Yattemare!" make their way through downtown Goshogawara. Tachineputa are as tall as 23 meters and as heavy as 19 tons. Spectators along the street are awed by the sheer size of them.

Each float is designed with a unique theme expressed with crafted shapes and brilliant colors. A fine balance of a powerful festival and exquisitely illuminated floats is the must-see feature of Tachineputa.

Period：August 4 to 8 every year

title: 3秒で保存したくなる高山グルメ！高山駅から徒歩2分創業40年以上の老舗「中華そば郷里」　#飛騨高山
Gourmet Mountain Cuisine You’ll Want to Save in 3 Seconds! 'Chuka Soba Gori', a Long-Established Shop with Over 40 Years of History, Just 2 Minutes Walk from Takayama Station #HidaTakayama
#飛騨高山 の紅葉 AutumnHida
description:
岐阜県高山市は、市域が日本一広く、標高差は最低436mから最高3,190mまで。市街地よりも高い場所が多く点在し、その豊かな自然が四季折々の彩りを織りなしています。
なかでも秋は、標高ごとに色づきのタイミングがずれるため、例年9月下旬から11月中旬ごろまで長い期間にわたり紅葉を楽しめるのが特徴です。

古い町並や歴史ある寺社、渓谷や滝、北アルプスの稜線まで——訪れるエリアごとに違う表情の紅葉が待つ高山市。
飛騨高山ならではの“紅葉グラデーション”をめぐる旅に出かけてみませんか？

title: #Hida Takayama's Autumn Colors AutumnHida
description:
Takayama City in Gifu Prefecture has the largest area in Japan, with an elevation difference ranging from a minimum of 436m to a maximum of 3,190m. Many locations are situated at higher altitudes than the urban area, and the rich nature creates a tapestry of colors throughout the seasons.
Among them, autumn is characterized by the timing of color changes varying by elevation, allowing visitors to enjoy the autumn leaves over a long period, typically from late September to mid-November.

From the old townscape and historic temples to valleys, waterfalls, and the ridges of the Northern Alps—different expressions of autumn foliage await in Takayama, depending on the area you visit.
Why not embark on a journey to experience the unique “autumn foliage gradient” of Hida Takayama?

description:
～自然探勝の聖地、秘境探検を楽しむ～
北アルプス乗鞍岳の北西山麓に広がる「五色ケ原」は、中部山岳国立公園の南端にあたる約3000haの広大な森林地帯です。これまで、ほとんど手つかずの希少な自然が豊富に残る、まさに秘境。

乗鞍岳を源とする多くの渓流と滝、池、湿原、さらに多種の獣、野鳥、昆虫などの野生生物が生息し、自然の多彩な表情が楽しめるスポットです。ひとたび足を踏み入れたら、偉大な自然のパワーを感じることができます。

title: #Hida Takayama Awakening the Senses in the Forest of Goshikigahara.
description:
～A sacred place for nature exploration, enjoy the adventure of hidden realms～
Goshikigahara, sprawling at the northwestern foot of Mount Norikura in the Northern Alps, is a vast forest area of about 3000 hectares located at the southern end of Chubu Sangaku National Park. It is truly a hidden gem, rich in rare and untouched nature.

With numerous streams, waterfalls, ponds, and wetlands originating from Mount Norikura, as well as a variety of wildlife including beasts, wild birds, and insects, it is a spot where you can enjoy the diverse expressions of nature. Once you step in, you can feel the power of the great outdoors.

title: 大盛況の「#氷点下の森」は2月末まで！氷点下１０度の冬の自然を逆手に取り、制作を始め出来上がった氷の森は、昼間は太陽の光を浴びた純白の氷の美しさが楽しめます。 #飛騨高山

#Frozen Forest, a great success, is open until the end of February! Taking advantage of the winter nature at minus 10 degrees, the ice forest that has been created allows you to enjoy the beauty of pure white ice bathed in sunlight during the day. #HidaTakayama
#飛騨高山 で昔から人々が栽培し、作られてきた「赤かぶ漬」。雪が多く降るため生野菜が収穫できず、冬の保存食として愛されてきました。寒暖差のある気候で育てられた赤かぶは、旨みがギュッとつまっています。

#Hida Takayama's 'Akakabu-zuke' has been cultivated and made by people for generations. Due to heavy snowfall, fresh vegetables cannot be harvested, making it a beloved winter preserved food. The red turnips grown in a climate with temperature variations are packed with flavor.
滝巡りが楽しめる「#宇津江四十八滝」の紅葉🍁が見頃です。渓谷沿いには大小無数13の滝があり、豊かな自然の中、滝の水音に耳を澄ませながらのんびり散策ができ、リフレッシュにピッタリ！#飛騨高山

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　一之宮町
description:
飛騨一之宮観光協会会長　稲子盛雄さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
一之宮町は、高山市の南部に位置する歴史と伝統が息づく地域。美しい自然に囲まれており、その環境を活かした農業体験や地元の人たちとのふれあい体験ができるグリーンツーリズムが盛んな地域です。なかでも、飛騨一宮水無神社は飛騨の国で最も格式高い神社とされ、地域に住む人たちの信仰を集め敬われています。他にも内閣府認定のどぶろく特区、樹齢1,100年の臥龍桜、分水嶺が見られる位山の散策やウィンタースポーツなど様々なジャンルを見て感じることができます。
一之宮町に是非お越しください。
（高山市街地から車で約２０分）

Morio Inako, chairman of the Hida Ichinomiya Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town.
Ichinomiya Town is located in the southern part of Takayama City and is an area steeped in history and tradition. Surrounded by beautiful nature, it is a popular area for green tourism, where you can experience farming that takes advantage of the environment and interact with local people. Among them, Hida Ichinomiya Mizunashi Shrine is considered to be the most prestigious shrine in Hida, and is worshiped and revered by the people living in the area. You can also see and experience a variety of other genres, such as the Cabinet Office-certified Doburoku Special Zone, the 1,100-year-old Garyu Cherry Tree, a walk on Mt. Iyama where you can see the watershed, and winter sports.
Please come to Ichinomiya Town.
(About 20 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　高根町
description:
飛騨高根観光協会会長　小坂守さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
高根町は高山市の南東に位置し、乗鞍岳と御嶽山を望み大自然に囲まれた高地にあります。長野県木曽地域に隣接しているため、歴史や文化、風俗に至るまで木曽の影響を色濃く受けており、飛騨の中でも異郷の地として知られています。高根町は木曽馬の産地だったことでも有名であり、馬の供養のために作られた石仏には、人と馬との物語が込められています。高根町では発酵食品に力を入れており、廃校を再利用したウイスキー蒸溜所は大きな話題を集めています。また、塩を一切使わず乳酸菌で漬けられた「すな」や、飛騨の郷土料理によく使われる田舎味噌なども盛んに作られています。この地域特有の涼しい夏と寒冷な冬の環境が、これらの発酵食品の育成に役立っています。その他には火畑そばやタカネコーン、野麦峠や御嶽山など様々な見どころがあるユニークな場所になっています。
高根町に是非お越しください。
（高山市街地から車で約５０分）

Mamoru Kosaka, chairman of the Hida Takane Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town.
Takane Town is located in the southeast of Takayama City, on a highland surrounded by nature overlooking Mt. Norikura and Mt. Ontake. Because it is adjacent to the Kiso region of Nagano Prefecture, its history, culture, and customs are strongly influenced by Kiso, and it is known as a foreign place even within Hida. Takane Town is also famous for being a production area for Kiso horses, and the stone Buddha statues made for memorial services for horses are filled with stories between people and horses. Takane Town is putting a lot of effort into fermented foods, and its whiskey distillery, which was repurposed from an abandoned school, is attracting a lot of attention. In addition, suna, which is pickled with lactic acid bacteria without using any salt, and country miso, which is often used in Hida's local cuisine, are also actively produced. The region's unique cool summers and cold winters are conducive to growing these fermented foods. It is also a unique place with many other attractions such as Hibata Soba, Takane Corn, Nomai Pass, and Mt. Ontake.
Please come to Takane Town.
(Approximately 50 minutes by car from Takayama city center)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　丹生川町
description:
千光寺住職　大下真海さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
丹生川町は、高山市の北東部に位置する山岳地帯がある地域です。町を象徴するのが、日本百名山のひとつである乗鞍岳。標高3,000ｍ級の山にも関わらず、2,702mの畳平まで路線バスで行くことができるため、厳しいといわれる山岳の世界を子どもや女性でも気軽に体感することができます。７月から８月中旬にかけてバスターミナルのすぐ近くには天空のお花畑が広がり、希少な高山植物を観察できます。運が良ければ天然記念物のライチョウにも出会えるかもしれません。乗鞍岳の裾野に広がる五色ヶ原の森、観光鍾乳洞としては日本一標高が高い900ｍに位置する飛騨大鍾乳洞、
飛騨の英雄・両面宿儺伝説、神社めぐり豊かな田園風景が残る里山など乗鞍岳に抱かれる町、丹生川町には多様な見どころがあります。荘川町に是非お越しください。
（丹生川町は高山市街地から車で約15分／乗鞍岳山頂までは畳平から徒歩約90分）

Senkoji Temple chief priest Mami Oshita will introduce the charm of the town.
Nyukawa Town is a mountainous region located in the northeastern part of Takayama City. The town is symbolized by Mt. Norikura, one of Japan's 100 famous mountains. Although the mountain is 3,000 meters above sea level, you can take a bus to Tatamidaira, which is 2,702 meters high, so even children and women can easily experience the harsh world of mountains. From July to mid-August, a field of flowers spreads out in the sky right next to the bus terminal, and you can observe rare alpine plants. If you're lucky, you might even come across a grouse, a natural monument. Goshikigahara Forest spreads out at the foot of Mt. Norikura, Hida Great Limestone Cave is located at 900m, the highest tourist limestone cave in Japan,
Nyukawa-cho, a town nestled in Mt. Norikura, has a variety of attractions, including the legend of Hida's hero, Ryōshuku-na, shrine visits, and a rural village with rich rural scenery. Please come to Shokawa Town.
(Nyukawa Town is about 15 minutes by car from downtown Takayama / About 90 minutes walk from Tatamidaira to the summit of Mt. Norikura)

title: せせらぎが聴こえる町　#飛騨清見
description:
森に囲まれたおしゃれなカフェやレストランが点在する清見町は、洗練された雰囲気とのどかな自然が共存。町の中央を南北に縦断する全長64㎞の「飛騨美濃せせらぎ街道」は、格好のドライブルート。清流沿いで、初夏には新緑が輝きます。また、秋には紅葉の名所として知られ、標高差によって色づく場所が移り変わることで長期に渡り目を楽しませてくれます。

title: The Town Where You Can Hear the Murmuring Stream #HidaKiyomi
description:
Kiyomi Town, dotted with stylish cafes and restaurants surrounded by forests, is a place where a sophisticated atmosphere coexists with tranquil nature.
The 'Hida-Mino Seseragi Road,' which runs north-south through the center of the town for a total length of 64 km, is an ideal driving route.
Along the clear stream, fresh greenery shines in early summer.
In autumn, it is known as a famous spot for autumn leaves, and the changing colors due to the elevation differences provide a long-lasting visual delight.

description:
荘川町は山々に囲まれ、荘川町の北西に位置し富山県、石川県、福井県、岐阜県の４県にまたがる「白山」の雄大な姿を眺望できる自然あふれる町です。桜、新緑、紅葉、雪景色と季節ごとに美しい四季折々の絶景を楽しむことができます。

title: History and Nature Weaving Together #Gifu Prefecture #Hida Takayama 'Shokawa Town'
description:
Shokawa Town is surrounded by mountains and offers a view of the majestic 'Hakusan', which spans four prefectures: Toyama, Ishikawa, Fukui, and Gifu, located to the northwest of Shokawa Town. You can enjoy the beautiful seasonal scenery throughout the year, including cherry blossoms, fresh greenery, autumn leaves, and snowy landscapes.

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　高根町
description:
飛騨高根観光協会会長　小坂守さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
高根町は高山市の南東に位置し、乗鞍岳と御嶽山を望み大自然に囲まれた高地にあります。長野県木曽地域に隣接しているため、歴史や文化、風俗に至るまで木曽の影響を色濃く受けており、飛騨の中でも異郷の地として知られています。高根町は木曽馬の産地だったことでも有名であり、馬の供養のために作られた石仏には、人と馬との物語が込められています。高根町では発酵食品に力を入れており、廃校を再利用したウイスキー蒸溜所は大きな話題を集めています。また、塩を一切使わず乳酸菌で漬けられた「すな」や、飛騨の郷土料理によく使われる田舎味噌なども盛んに作られています。この地域特有の涼しい夏と寒冷な冬の環境が、これらの発酵食品の育成に役立っています。その他には火畑そばやタカネコーン、野麦峠や御嶽山など様々な見どころがあるユニークな場所になっています。
高根町に是非お越しください。
（高山市街地から車で約５０分）

Mamoru Kosaka, chairman of the Hida Takane Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town.
Takane Town is located in the southeast of Takayama City, on a highland surrounded by nature overlooking Mt. Norikura and Mt. Ontake. Because it is adjacent to the Kiso region of Nagano Prefecture, its history, culture, and customs are strongly influenced by Kiso, and it is known as a foreign place even within Hida. Takane Town is also famous for being a production area for Kiso horses, and the stone Buddha statues made for memorial services for horses are filled with stories between people and horses. Takane Town is putting a lot of effort into fermented foods, and its whiskey distillery, which was repurposed from an abandoned school, is attracting a lot of attention. In addition, suna, which is pickled with lactic acid bacteria without using any salt, and country miso, which is often used in Hida's local cuisine, are also actively produced. The region's unique cool summers and cold winters are conducive to growing these fermented foods. It is also a unique place with many other attractions such as Hibata Soba, Takane Corn, Nomai Pass, and Mt. Ontake.
Please come to Takane Town.
(Approximately 50 minutes by car from Takayama city center)

title: #飛騨高山 #宇津江四十八滝 を #トレッキング
description:
大小無数の滝をめぐるマイナスイオンあふれる癒しスポット「宇津江四十八滝」。岐阜県名水50選にも選定された自然公園です。豊かな自然の中、滝の水音に耳を澄ませ13の滝を巡りながらのんびり散策ができます。なかでも「王滝」は高さが18.8mあり、岩肌を流れ落ちる白い水瀑は迫力満点！滝めぐりの出発地点からゴール地点の四十八滝高原までは約1時間ほど。途中の展望台からは北アルプスが望めます。国府町だからこそ楽しめる自然の美しさをお楽しみください。


【スポット情報】
宇津江四十八滝
住所：高山市国府町宇津江3253-86
ＪＲ飛騨古川駅又は飛騨国府駅から車で15分
JR高山駅より車で国道41号経由30分
〇大人200円 / こども100円　（清掃協力金）

``Utsue 48 Falls'' is a healing spot filled with negative ions, surrounded by countless waterfalls large and small. This natural park has been selected as one of Gifu Prefecture's top 50 famous waters. In the midst of rich nature, you can listen to the sound of water and take a leisurely stroll around 13 waterfalls. Among them, "Otaki" is 18.8m high, and the white water falling down the rock face is very impressive! It takes about an hour from the starting point of the waterfall tour to the goal point, Shijuhachitaki Plateau. You can see the Northern Alps from the observation deck along the way. Please enjoy the beauty of nature that can only be enjoyed in Kokufu Town.


[Spot information]
Utsue 48 waterfalls
Address: 3253-86 Utsue, Kokufu-cho, Takayama City
15 minutes by car from JR Hida Furukawa Station or Hida Kokufu Station
30 minutes by car from JR Takayama Station via National Route 41
〇Adults 200 yen / Children 100 yen (cleaning cooperation fee)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　一之宮町
description:
飛騨一之宮観光協会会長　稲子盛雄さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
一之宮町は、高山市の南部に位置する歴史と伝統が息づく地域。美しい自然に囲まれており、その環境を活かした農業体験や地元の人たちとのふれあい体験ができるグリーンツーリズムが盛んな地域です。なかでも、飛騨一宮水無神社は飛騨の国で最も格式高い神社とされ、地域に住む人たちの信仰を集め敬われています。他にも内閣府認定のどぶろく特区、樹齢1,100年の臥龍桜、分水嶺が見られる位山の散策やウィンタースポーツなど様々なジャンルを見て感じることができます。
一之宮町に是非お越しください。
（高山市街地から車で約２０分）

Morio Inako, chairman of the Hida Ichinomiya Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town.
Ichinomiya Town is located in the southern part of Takayama City and is an area steeped in history and tradition. Surrounded by beautiful nature, it is a popular area for green tourism, where you can experience farming that takes advantage of the environment and interact with local people. Among them, Hida Ichinomiya Mizunashi Shrine is considered to be the most prestigious shrine in Hida, and is worshiped and revered by the people living in the area. You can also see and experience a variety of other genres, such as the Cabinet Office-certified Doburoku Special Zone, the 1,100-year-old Garyu Cherry Tree, a walk on Mt. Iyama where you can see the watershed, and winter sports.
Please come to Ichinomiya Town.
(About 20 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: #飛騨高山 #おおくら滝遊歩道 を散策
description:
「おおくら百滝」と呼ばれる大小の滝を眺めながら散策できる「おおくら滝遊歩道」。落差約３０ｍを豪快に流れ落ちる「大倉滝」を目指し渓谷沿いを巡るコースです。中でもオススメはあちこちに残る巨石群。遊歩道にトンネルのように覆いかぶさる「くぐり岩」はどこか神秘的で迫力満点です。自然の壮大なパワーと美しさに触れ、ぜひその魅力を体感してください。最高の自然体験が、清見町にはあります。

The ``Okura Falls Promenade'' allows you to take a walk while admiring the large and small waterfalls known as ``Okura Hyakudaki.'' This is a course that goes along the valley aiming for Okura Falls, which flows down with a drop of approximately 30 meters. Among the most recommended are the huge boulders that remain here and there. Kuguriiwa, which covers the promenade like a tunnel, is mysterious and impressive. Come and experience the magnificent power and beauty of nature. The best nature experience can be found in Kiyomi Town.

[Spot information]
Okura Falls Promenade
Address: 981-1 Sakashita, Kiyomi-cho, Takayama City, Gifu Prefecture

title: 文化と民話が根付く飛騨のふるさと#岐阜県  #飛騨高山 「国府町」
description:
日本一面積が広い市である高山市は、町のすみずみまでたくさんの見どころに溢れています。飛騨高山を織りなすエリアにフォーカスしご紹介！
知られざる逸話やその場所でしか味わえない体験など、飛騨高山ならではの多彩な魅力を掘り下げます。私たちの町、飛騨高山へようこそ

飛騨国府は、千数百年前、斐陀国(ひだのくに）の中心地「国府」として栄えました。風が香り、風が色づく、風の郷。土が香り、土が色づく、土の郷。季が香り、季が色づく、季の郷。飛騨路を北へたどると、なつかしい、ぬくもりに満ちた郷「飛騨国府」があります。初めて訪れた地なのに、なぜか不思議と懐かしさに包まれます。日本の原風景が色濃く残る歴史、民俗、自然をたずねて、この地になぜ「国府」が置かれたのかを実感できる旅となることでしょう。

Takayama City, the largest city in Japan, is full of attractions in every corner of the city. We will focus on and introduce the areas that make up Hida Takayama!
We will delve into the various charms unique to Hida Takayama, including unknown anecdotes and experiences that can only be experienced in that location. Welcome to our town, Hida Takayama

Over a thousand years ago, Hida Kokufu flourished as the central ``kokufu'' of Hidanokuni. The land of the wind, where the wind smells and the wind colors. A land of soil where the scent of soil and the color of soil change. A village of the seasons, where the scent of the seasons and the colors of the seasons change. If you follow Hidaji to the north, you will find Hida Kokufu, a nostalgic village filled with warmth. Even though it's my first time visiting this place, I feel strangely nostalgic for some reason. As you explore the history, folk customs, and nature that are so reminiscent of Japan's original landscape, you will feel like you can understand why the Kokufu was established in this area.

title: 出雲 日御碕神社 夕日の祭り - Sunset Festival HINOMISAKI Shrine in IZUMO
description:
出雲大社から北西約7kmの島根半島西端に位置するこの神社は夜を守る神社として言い伝えられてきました。この夕日の祭り(日御碕神社 例大祭、神幸神事)では、年に一度神官のみが足を踏み入れることのできる神域、経島から沈みゆく太陽に祈りを捧げます。

Located at the western end of the Shimane Peninsula, about 7km northwest of Izumo Taisha, this shrine has been said to be a shrine that protects the night.  At this sunset festival (Hinomisaki Shrine annual festival, Shinko Shinto ritual), we pray once a year to the setting sun from Fumishima, a sanctuary where only priests can set foot.

title: Japan's tallest stone steps, 3333 steps　日本一の石段　3333段　釈迦院御坂遊歩道　英字幕付き　美里町観光PR動画
description:
This is a Misato Town tourism PR video created in 2025.

These stone steps were built in Misaka, the main approach to the historic Shaka-in Temple (Izumi-cho, Yatsushiro City), which has a history of 1,200 years, and are the largest in Japan.They will be preserved for future generations as a century-old cultural heritage and will revitalize the town. It was built with the aim of creating a tourist attraction and a symbol of town revitalization.
Construction of the stone steps began in January 1980, and in November 1986, it surpassed the 2,446 steps of Mt. Haguro in Yamagata Prefecture to become the number one in Japan in both name and reality, and was completed at the end of March 1986.
In addition to famous stones from all over the country, these stone steps use granite from countries around the world such as China, South Korea, India, the former Soviet Union, Brazil, the United States, and South Africa.They are used to build international goodwill and friendship, and to promote historical exploration and health. It is used as a tourist and recreational facility.
Additionally, Attack the Nihon Ichi is held every November using the stone steps.
Some early climbers may take less than an hour to complete the climb, but for the general public, please expect it to take about 3 hours, including 2 hours for the ascent and 1 hour for the descent.


◇HP　http://misato.town/spot.html?id=68

title: Hiking in Japan - Sacred Peak Mt. Hakkai 八海山 | Adventures in Yukiguni | Minamiuonuma
description:
Climbing Mt. Hakkai (1778 m) of the Echigo Sanzan Mountains. Using the Hakkaisan Ropeway the hike took about 7 hours round-trip. 

Many tourists flock to Snow Country in the winter months to hit the slopes, but many of these snow resort grounds continue to attract visitors seeking outdoor adventures through mountain climbing in the summer as well. 

Mt. Hakkai is a famous mountain in Minamiuonuma that boasts a long history of dedicated climbers coming from all across the country. There are two impressive shrines dedicated to the mountain at each trail-head, and the mountain's delicious spring water and impressive shape are part of the reason its name has become one of Japan's most reputable sake brands: Hakkaisan. The mountain is very popular for tourists hiking on summer break and its lookout decks offer beautiful views of the varicolored Uonuma Basin in autumn once the leaves begin to change too. The mountains in this region are said to bless the locals with many gifts and in the green season these are manifested in the landscape's breathtaking scenery.


Hakkaisan Ropeway Info: https://www.tohokukanko.jp/en/attractions/detail_1784.html
Visit Minamiuonuma: https://www.facebook.com/visitminamiuonuma/

title: octagon tunnel 　熊延鉄道遺構　八角トンネル　英字幕付き　美里町観光PR動画
description:
This is a Misato Town tourism PR video created in 2025.

It is one of the remains of the Kumanobe Railway, which opened in April 1912 in Minami Kumamoto Station (Kumamoto City) and later extended to Toyo, Shimomashiki District (Misato Town), running for a total length of 28.6 km.
The line was discontinued in 1962, but even now, about 60 years later, this octagonal tunnel, which was built to prevent the rocks on both sides of the track from collapsing, still welcomes many tourists as an industrial ruin. I am.
A leading theory is that the reason why the seven towers are connected, with gaps between them, making it an imperfect shape for rockfall protection, is to reduce construction costs. It is a ruin with many mysteries.
Also, nearby are the piers of the Tsurugawa Bridge, which are also the remains of the Kumanobe Railway, and are valuable remains of the Kumanobe Railway, which supported industrial development in the past.

◇HP　http://misato.town/spot.html?id=73

title: 天空ミュージック（Knock on Wood）
description:
Kock on Wood
香川県高松市の屋島山上にて2012年から行ってきたライブイベント「天空ミュージック」。今年は10周年を迎え小倉博和さんの美しいギターをフィーチャーした映像を制作しました。小倉さんの思い出の中の父の背中、屋島の形状とも重なりノスタルジックな魅力に包まれます。
監督は中野裕之さん、この映像は小倉博和さんの音楽と山上の空気感を切り取ったバージョン　ここにしかない特別な時間に浸っていただければ！。
 主催：屋島山上ライブイベント実行委員会
 企画制作：街角に音楽を@香川（MUSIC BLUE） 
協力：屋島寺　屋島山上観光協会 
監督：中野裕之 
音楽：小倉博和 
 
中野裕之
映像作家・映画監督・演出家
1958年広島県福山市生まれ 福山誠之館高校卒 早稲田大学商学部卒。 読売テレビを経て、タイレルコーポレーションを設立し、ヴィジュアルアー ト、音楽ビデオの製作、日本、世界の音楽アーティストのMVを多数演出。 93年ピースデリックを設立して、見る人が幸せになるコンテンツを多数演出。 映画、広告、WEB映像、サイネージ、イベント演出など活動範囲は多岐にわた る。
1998年映画「SF SAMURAI FICTION」で韓国プチョン国際ファンタジー 映画祭グランプリ受賞。 短編「アイロン」で2006年カンヌ国際映画祭国際批評家週間ヤング批評家賞 受賞。 2015年「フライング・ボディーズ」で沖縄こども映画祭グランプリ受賞。 2018年 8年間撮影した日本全国の美しい風景と精神の歴史を描いた   映画「ピース・二ッポン」公開 現在、引き続き、日本を未来に伝える ピース・ニッポン・プロジェクトを実行中。
MV:布袋寅泰 今井美樹 Mr.Children GLAY AKB48 SKE48 STU48他 CM: サントリー 住友生命 パイオニア TOYOTA 武田薬品 三菱自動車     POLA 明治製菓 KOSE ヤクルト セブン&アイ 日立製作所 他 サイネージ:京都駅京都プレミアムビジョン上映中       長野トヨタパノラマビジョン上映中
Web :浜松市PR ,福山市PR、WABARAほか イベント:京都ファッション・カンタータ2007-2014企画演出      東京モーターショーAUDIブース演出      ISSAY MIYAKE 3D collection演出
映画:「SF SAMURAI FICTION」監督
   「SF Stereo Future」脚本監督
   「SF Short Films」製作脚本監督
   「RedShadow 赤影」監督     短編集「男たちの詩」製作脚本監督
   「TAJOMARU」監督
   「FLYING BODIES」三宅一生さん企画青森大学男子新体操のドキュメンタリー映画    「FOOL COOL ROCK / ONE OKE ROCK DOCUMENTARY FILM」               ロックバンド ワンオーケーロックのドキュメンタリー映画

小倉博和
(ギタリスト・ソングライター・アレンジャー)
桑田佳祐・サザンオールスターズ・福山雅治・森山良子・大貫妙子・槇原敬之・JUJU・Bank Band・kokuaをはじめ数多くの邦楽作品に関わる。
ギターインストデュオ・山弦を結成、5枚のアルバムをリリース。
2014年、ソロアルバム「GOLDEN TIME」、2016年「Summer Guitars」、2019年「Sketch Song」「Sketch Song 2」をリリース。
高いテクニックと幅広い音楽性、ハートフルな彼の音楽＆ギタープレイはジャンルを越えて支持を受けている。
FM COCOLOでMARTIN CLUB JAPAN Presents「小倉博和のFRIDAY,Sound of Strings」のラジオDJを努めている。

title: Sky Music (Knock on Wood)
description:
Kock on Wood
The live event "Sky Music" has been held at the top of Mount Yashima in Takamatsu City, Kagawa Prefecture since 2012. This year marks the 10th anniversary, and we have produced a video featuring the beautiful guitar of Hirokazu Ogura. The nostalgic charm is enveloped in the memories of Ogura-san's father and the shape of Yashima.
Directed by Hiroyuki Nakano, this video captures the music of Hirokazu Ogura and the atmosphere of the mountaintop. We hope you can immerse yourself in this special time that can only be experienced here!
Organized by: Yashima Mountaintop Live Event Executive Committee
Planning and Production: Music in the Streets @ Kagawa (MUSIC BLUE)
Cooperation: Yashima Temple, Yashima Mountaintop Tourism Association
Director: Hiroyuki Nakano
Music: Hirokazu Ogura

Hiroyuki Nakano
Filmmaker, Film Director, Director
Born in 1958 in Fukuyama City, Hiroshima Prefecture. Graduated from Fukuyama Seiryu High School and Waseda University, Faculty of Commerce. After working at Yomiuri Television, he established Tyrell Corporation, producing visual art and music videos, directing numerous MVs for music artists in Japan and around the world. In 1993, he established Peace Delic, directing many contents that make viewers happy. His activities span a wide range, including film, advertising, web videos, signage, and event direction.
In 1998, he won the Grand Prix at the Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival in South Korea for the film "SF SAMURAI FICTION." In 2006, he won the Young Critics Award at the Cannes International Film Festival's Critics' Week for the short film "Iron." In 2015, he won the Grand Prix at the Okinawa Children's Film Festival for "Flying Bodies." In 2018, he released the film "Peace Nippon," depicting the beautiful landscapes and spiritual history of Japan captured over eight years. He is currently continuing the Peace Nippon Project to convey Japan to the future.
MVs: Tomoyasu Hotei, Miki Imai, Mr.Children, GLAY, AKB48, SKE48, STU48, etc.
CMs: Suntory, Sumitomo Life, Pioneer, TOYOTA, Takeda Pharmaceutical, Mitsubishi Motors, POLA, Meiji Seika, KOSE, Yakult, Seven & I, Hitachi, etc.
Signage: Currently screening at Kyoto Station Kyoto Premium Vision, Nagano Toyota Panorama Vision.
Web: Hamamatsu City PR, Fukuyama City PR, WABARA, etc.
Events: Kyoto Fashion Cantata 2007-2014 Planning and Direction, Tokyo Motor Show AUDI Booth Direction, ISSEY MIYAKE 3D Collection Direction.
Films: Directed "SF SAMURAI FICTION," Scripted and Directed "SF Stereo Future," Produced, Scripted, and Directed "SF Short Films," Directed "Red Shadow Akakage," Produced, Scripted, and Directed the short film collection "Men's Poetry," Directed "TAJOMARU," Directed "FLYING BODIES" (a documentary film about Aomori University Men's Rhythmic Gymnastics planned by Issey Miyake), Directed "FOOL COOL ROCK / ONE OK ROCK DOCUMENTARY FILM" (a documentary film about the rock band One OK Rock).

Hirokazu Ogura
(Guitarist, Songwriter, Arranger)
Involved in numerous Japanese music works, including those of Keisuke Kuwata, Southern All Stars, Masaharu Fukuyama, Ryoko Moriyama, Taeko Onuki, Noriyuki Makihara, JUJU, Bank Band, and kokua.
Formed the guitar instrumental duo Yama Strings, releasing five albums.
In 2014, released the solo album "GOLDEN TIME," in 2016 "Summer Guitars," and in 2019 "Sketch Song" and "Sketch Song 2."
His high technique, wide musicality, and heartfelt music & guitar play are supported across genres.
He serves as a radio DJ for FM COCOLO's MARTIN CLUB JAPAN Presents "Hirokazu Ogura's FRIDAY, Sound of Strings."
Born in Takamatsu City (Takamatsu City Tourism Ambassador).

香川県高松市の屋島山上にて2012年から行ってきたライブイベント「天空ミュージック」。今年は10周年を迎え小倉博和さんの美しいギターをフィーチャーした映像を制作しました。監督は中野裕之さん、この映像は小倉博和さんの音楽と山上の空気感を切り取ったバージョン　ここにしかない特別な時間に浸っていただければ！。

title: Sky Music (Father's Back) Music: Hirokazu Ogura Video: Hiroyuki Nakano
description:
The live event 'Sky Music' has been held since 2012 on the top of Mount Yashima in Takamatsu City, Kagawa Prefecture. This year marks the 10th anniversary, and we have produced a video featuring the beautiful guitar of Hirokazu Ogura. Directed by Hiroyuki Nakano, this video captures the essence of Ogura's music and the atmosphere of the mountaintop. We hope you can immerse yourself in this special time that can only be experienced here!

title: 「高松ミュージックブルーフェス2021スペシャル　with サンポートオータムジャム2021」（延期開催）PV VO2  「DAY BY DAY」
description:
●2011年から始まった「高松ミュージックブルーフェス」は
瀬戸内を代表する音楽フェスとして例年5月GWに継続開催されてきました
2021年5月のフェスは2度の延期を経ましたが、2022年3月に開催を予定しています。
会場は瀬戸内海の海風の気持ち良い「サンポート高松エリア」
出演はゲストミュージシャン5組、地元ミュージシャン32組の計37組。
テーマは「FREE AS A BIRD」心の羽を広げて　鳥のように自由に歌おう　です。
出演ミュージシャンの自由な音楽の響きに包まれてください。
●当PVについて
今回は21日に出演予定の「ウィリアムス浩子さん」「松丸契さん」が事前に高松においでいただき素敵な演奏の様子をプロモーション映像に作成しました。
映像　電マーク　音響　日笠洋典
高松の自然と音楽の風景を味わっていただき、ぜひフェスに足をお運びください。
VOL１　松丸契　屋島山上
VOL２　松丸契　ウィリアムス浩子　サンポート高松
VOL３　ウィリアムス浩子　男木島

●会場＆日程：
３月２０日（日）JR高松駅前広場　玉藻公園西門北プロムナード　
　　　　　　　　サンポート高松デックスガレリア（出演：地元ミュージシャン）
３月２１日（月祝）JR高松駅前広場　玉藻公園西門北プロムナード　
フェリー乗場（Liminal Air -core- 前）（出演：地元ミュージシャン）
 3月21日（月祝）サンポート高松多目的広場(サンポートオータムジャム2021)
（出演：ゲストミュージシャン）
●ゲストミュージシャン
「マヤハッチ（Maya Hatch）グループ」、「松丸契バンド」、「The Timeless Nation feat.多和田えみ」「RS5pb (RUIKE SHINPEI 5 piece band)」、「ウィリアムス浩子+小沼ようすけ」
●地元ミュージシャン　32組
Vocal Group AURORA、WHITE　WIND、ヨシコトミキ、SWING SAM、フルイカズキ、西川ユウヒスキー、SWJO NY-Combo、高松ジャズユニット、海人Family 、South Blues Band 、　WANNABE、 　THE CHOIR ALL STARS、 　CHERRY BOY KINGS、NOIZ、 　Soul痛　Soul 、ゆうゆうバンド、　音楽療法グループＷＡＬＫ、　RAG　ROSE、Favorite things、 　Maxwell Street Gang 、DEXTER、 トラトリオ、　COSMOS、ウクレレBABYとSAXダンディ、 筒井茂広、　ダッパーサクセーバーズ、　
ジャンゴティガール、　みちるカルテット、　Trick Box、 シゲルとキイチ、Hawaiʻian vocal duo KAI、　アプマーシュ

●主催「MUSIC BLUE　TAKAMATSU　実行委員会」（高松市、シンボルタワー開発株式会社、ヨンデンプラザ・サンポート、　四国旅客鉄道株式会社、株式会社百十四銀行、一般社団法人 街角に音楽を＠香川）

●PV出演者プロフィール
・ウィリアムス浩子
リリースしたアルバムが7作連続ジャズチャート1位を記録中。 作編曲家・服部克久氏に「最高のエンジンを積んだロールスロイスが時速100kmで優雅に走るよう」 と称された歌声は、ジャズシーンを中心に絶大な人気を誇る。 2014年、アルバム「A Wish」がビルボードJapanで2位を記録。 2017年、アルバム「My Room side1」がe-onkyoなど配信サイト6社によるハイレゾ音源大賞を J-POP、クラシックも含めた全ジャンルの中で受賞。ジャンルの枠を越えた快挙となる。  2021年、12月にクリスマススペシャル・with ストリングスとして弦楽四重奏＋ピアノトリオという編成で コットンクラブ東京にてコンサート開催。 アルバムは現在ドイツ、イタリアなどの ヨーロッパ各国やアジアのオーディオショップでも取り扱われ アジアの新・オーディオクイーンとして人気を博している。 その歌唱力と表現力からピアニスト佐山雅弘氏の推薦で日本の曲を取り上げるCSテレビ番組に歌手として出演。 近年では「ウィリアムス浩子singsちあきなおみ」など、アコースティックサウンドでの日本の名曲コンサートも多くおこなっている。

・松丸契
ʻ95 年千葉⽣まれ。パプアニューギニア出⾝。サックス・作曲・即興。ʼ14 年に全額奨学⾦でバークリー⾳楽⼤学⼊学、ʼ18 年⾸席卒業。ʼ17 年度ヤマハ⾳楽奨学⽣、ʼ18 年Downbeat Competitionで⾃⾝のトリオ・オリジナル曲で全⽶1位。ʼ19 年にデビューアルバム『THINKKAISM』リリース。バンド「SMTK」では ʻ19 年に東京ジャズ等の企画に参加、ʼ20 年に1st EP と1st アルバム、ʼ21 年に2ndアルバム『SIREN PROPAGANDA』を発表。ʼ20 年11⽉に⾃⾝名義による1st アルバム『Nothing Unspoken Under the Sun』をリリース。ジャンルを問わず現在都内を中⼼に様々な場で活動中。

title: Takamatsu Music Blue Fest 2021 Special with Sunport Autumn Jam 2021 (Postponed) PV VO2 "DAY BY DAY"
description:
● The "Takamatsu Music Blue Fest," which started in 2011, has been held annually in May during the Golden Week as a representative music festival of the Setouchi region. The festival scheduled for May 2021 has been postponed twice, but is planned to be held in March 2022. The venue is the pleasant "Sunport Takamatsu Area" with the sea breeze of the Seto Inland Sea. There will be a total of 37 groups performing, including 5 guest musicians and 32 local musicians. The theme is "FREE AS A BIRD" - spread your wings and sing freely like a bird. Please be enveloped by the free sounds of the performing musicians.
● About this PV: This time, we created a promotional video featuring the wonderful performances of "Hiroko Williams" and "Kei Matsumaru," who are scheduled to perform on the 21st, as they visited Takamatsu in advance. Video: Denmark, Sound: Hironori Hikasa. Enjoy the natural and musical scenery of Takamatsu, and we hope to see you at the festival.
VOL 1: Kei Matsumaru, Yashima Mountain Top
VOL 2: Kei Matsumaru, Hiroko Williams, Sunport Takamatsu
VOL 3: Hiroko Williams, Ogijima

● Venue & Schedule:
March 20 (Sun) JR Takamatsu Station Front Square, Tamamo Park West Gate North Promenade, Sunport Takamatsu DEX Galleria (Performers: Local Musicians)
March 21 (Mon, Holiday) JR Takamatsu Station Front Square, Tamamo Park West Gate North Promenade, Ferry Terminal (in front of Liminal Air -core-) (Performers: Local Musicians)
March 21 (Mon, Holiday) Sunport Takamatsu Multipurpose Square (Sunport Autumn Jam 2021) (Performers: Guest Musicians)
● Guest Musicians
"Maya Hatch Group," "Kei Matsumaru Band," "The Timeless Nation feat. Emi Tawatada," "RS5pb (RUIKE SHINPEI 5 piece band)," "Hiroko Williams + Yosuke Onuma"
● 32 Local Musicians
Vocal Group AURORA, WHITE WIND, Yoshikoto Miki, SWING SAM, Furui Kazuki, Nishikawa Yuuhisuki, SWJO NY-Combo, Takamatsu Jazz Unit, Uminchu Family, South Blues Band, WANNABE, THE CHOIR ALL STARS, CHERRY BOY KINGS, NOIZ, Soul Pain Soul, Yuyuu Band, Music Therapy Group WALK, RAG ROSE, Favorite things, Maxwell Street Gang, DEXTER, Toratrio, COSMOS, Ukulele BABY and SAX Dandy, Shigehiro Tsutsui, Dapper Saxes, Django T-Girls, Michiru Quartet, Trick Box, Shigeru and Kiichi, Hawaiian Vocal Duo KAI, Apumash

● Organized by "MUSIC BLUE TAKAMATSU Executive Committee" (Takamatsu City, Symbol Tower Development Co., Ltd., Yonden Plaza Sunport, Shikoku Railway Company, Hyakujushi Bank Co., Ltd., General Incorporated Association Music in the Streets @ Kagawa)

● PV Performer Profiles
- Hiroko Williams: Her released albums have consecutively topped the jazz charts for 7 times. Her singing voice, described by composer Katsuhisa Hattori as "like a Rolls Royce with the best engine running gracefully at 100 km/h," boasts immense popularity in the jazz scene. In 2014, her album "A Wish" reached No. 2 on Billboard Japan. In 2017, her album "My Room side1" won the High-Resolution Audio Award from six distribution sites, including e-onkyo, across all genres, including J-POP and classical. In December 2021, she held a Christmas special concert with strings at Cotton Club Tokyo, featuring a string quartet and piano trio. Her albums are currently available in audio shops across Europe, including Germany and Italy, gaining popularity as Asia's new audio queen. Due to her singing ability and expressiveness, she was recommended by pianist Masahiro Sayama to appear as a singer on a CS television program featuring Japanese songs. In recent years, she has also held many concerts of famous Japanese songs in an acoustic sound format, such as "Hiroko Williams sings Chiaki NaomI."
- Kei Matsumaru: Born in Chiba in '95, originally from Papua New Guinea. Saxophonist, composer, and improviser. He entered Berklee College of Music on a full scholarship in '14 and graduated at the top of his class in '18. He was a Yamaha Music Scholarship student in '17 and won first place in the Downbeat Competition in '18 with his trio's original composition. In '19, he released his debut album "THINKKAISM." With the band "SMTK," he participated in projects like Tokyo Jazz in '19, released his 1st EP and 1st album in '20, and his 2nd album "SIREN PROPAGANDA" in '21. In November '20, he released his 1st album "Nothing Unspoken Under the Sun" under his own name. He is currently active in various venues in Tokyo across genres.

title: Tsugaru Nuri（津軽塗） Brand Movie
description:
青森県弘前市の伝統工芸「津軽塗」。
300年の歴史がある津軽塗は、時間と塗り重ねの美しさにかけた職人の絶え間ない努力と美的センスにより、現在まで受け継がれてきました。

ヒバの素地塗りから、研ぎ、磨きを繰り返し、四十数回の工程と2カ月余の長い工程を経て完成される堅牢優美な塗物であり、その長く丁寧な工程と作業から、別名「馬鹿塗」とも呼ばれています。「唐塗」「七々子塗」「紋紗塗」「錦塗」の4つの技法と職人の手仕事を、津軽の美しさとともに表現しています。


Tsugaru nuri, the traditional crafts of Hirosaki city, Aomori prefecture, Japan.

Tsugaru nuri, from over 300 yeas ago, have been handed down to theborn present by its long history up to today to the craftsmen’s patience, hard works and to their aesthetic eyes for beauty.

From painting the surface of Cypress tree, and repetition of
sharpening and polishing, the solid and elegant lacquer ware is 
after completing a long process of over forty steps for more than two months. It is also called “ Baka nuri” meaning Foolish painting,
because of the long careful process.

This movie shows hand works of cratfsman, and four types of techniques "Kara-nuri", "Nanako-nuri", "Monsha-nuri", and "Nishiki-nuri"  with the beauty of Tsugaru district.

title: Tsugaru Nuri（津軽塗） Brand Movie
description:
Tsugaru nuri, the traditional crafts of Hirosaki city, Aomori prefecture, Japan.

Tsugaru nuri, from over 300 years ago, have been handed down to the present by its long history up to today to the craftsmen’s patience, hard work, and their aesthetic eyes for beauty.

From painting the surface of Cypress tree, and repetition of sharpening and polishing, the solid and elegant lacquer ware is completed after a long process of over forty steps for more than two months. It is also called “Baka nuri” meaning Foolish painting, because of the long careful process.

This movie shows the handworks of craftsmen, and four types of techniques "Kara-nuri", "Nanako-nuri", "Monsha-nuri", and "Nishiki-nuri" with the beauty of the Tsugaru district.

title: 青ノ詩を詠う - Pass the Baton -「市木木綿」唯一の職人の挑戦
description:
「伝統工芸×観光」
三重県御浜町の伝統工芸「市木木綿」唯一の職人 向井浩高
向井さんは、代々続くふとん店を営みながら、週に1度、三重県御浜町の市木地区で100年以上前の織り機を使い、三重県の伝統工芸にも指定されている「市木木綿」を1人で織り続けている。
市木地区で、江戸時代から続く木綿織産業は、明治時代に「市木木綿」としてブランド化され、全盛期には40軒以上もの工場がありました。しかし、現在は、向井さんを残すだけになりました。
そんな時に、借りていた工場からの移転を余儀なくされ、市木木綿が消滅の危機を迎えます。しかし、彼はその窮状を逆手にとり、「市木木綿を未来へ紡ぐ会」を発足、さらには、自分の後の世代が、市木木綿のバトンを受け取りやすくするために、自らの工場を手に入れ、まだ見ぬ後継者に無償でその新しい工場を譲ることを決意します。そして、その工場移転費用、購入費用、改装費用をクラウドファンディングで集めることにしました。
クラウドファンディングの返礼品の目玉として、町の名を冠し、この町の海の色のような新しい縞「御浜ブルー」を制作します。新しい縞「御浜ブルー」の成り立ちや市木木綿の窮状と向井さんの献身的な活動を知った全国の多くの方々のご支援により、クラウドファンディングは大成功に終わります。
向井さんは、移転と改装を終えた新工場を拠点に、さらに多くの方々に「市木木綿」の魅力を知ってもらうため、持続可能な伝統工芸の形を作るために、新工場の周辺に点在する「市木木綿」にまつわる歴史やストーリーを巡る「伝統工芸×観光」ツアーの開催を始めました。市木木綿を未来へ紡ぐため、彼の新たな挑戦はここから始まっています。

title: Aoi no Uta wo Yomu - Pass the Baton - The Challenge of the Only Craftsman of Ichiki Cotton
description:
"Traditional Craft × Tourism"
Hirotaka Mukai, the only craftsman of the traditional craft "Ichiki Cotton" in Mihama Town, Mie Prefecture.
Mr. Mukai runs a family-owned futon shop and, once a week, continues to weave "Ichiki Cotton," which is designated as a traditional craft of Mie Prefecture, using a loom that is over 100 years old in the Ichiki area of Mihama Town.
The cotton weaving industry in the Ichiki area, which has continued since the Edo period, was branded as "Ichiki Cotton" during the Meiji period, and at its peak, there were more than 40 factories. However, now only Mr. Mukai remains.
At such a time, he was forced to relocate from the factory he was renting, putting Ichiki Cotton at risk of extinction. However, he turned this crisis into an opportunity by establishing the "Ichiki Cotton Future Weaving Association" and decided to acquire his own factory to make it easier for future generations to take over the baton of Ichiki Cotton, pledging to pass on this new factory to an unseen successor free of charge. He then decided to raise funds for the relocation, purchase, and renovation costs through crowdfunding.
As a highlight of the crowdfunding rewards, he will create a new stripe called "Mihama Blue," named after the town and reminiscent of the color of the sea. Thanks to the support of many people across the country who learned about the creation of the new stripe "Mihama Blue," the plight of Ichiki Cotton, and Mr. Mukai's dedicated activities, the crowdfunding campaign was a great success.
Based in the new factory after the relocation and renovation, Mr. Mukai began hosting "Traditional Craft × Tourism" tours to share the charm of "Ichiki Cotton" with more people and to create a sustainable form of traditional craft by exploring the history and stories related to Ichiki Cotton scattered around the new factory. His new challenge to weave Ichiki Cotton into the future starts here.

青ノ詩を詠う - Searching for Japan Blue 「御浜は年中青し」
description:
「青々とした緑」日本人には独特の美意識が存在する。
「日本の青」は、青と呼ばれる「青」と、青と呼ばれる「緑」で、できている。

太平洋の海の「青」と、紀伊山地の山の「青」が出会う町、神仏習合の聖地・熊野、三重県御浜町。
この町で、「日本の青」を旅する。

詩人、佐藤春夫は、故郷である熊野の風景に思いを馳せ、「望郷五月歌」を詠みました。
「空青し、山青し、海青し」、初夏の故郷の情景を詠み上げた佐藤の歌は、熊野の「青」を巧みに切り取りました。太平洋の青い海と空、紀伊山地の青い山々など、「青」は熊野を彩ります。
「海青し、風青し、みかんも青し」、もし佐藤が生きていれば、御浜町の情景をこのように詠んだのかもしれません。

里山、尾呂志(おろし)の山間には、風の通り道、熊野古道風伝峠。
朝霧「風伝おろし」と親しまれる霧が風に乗り、その道をぬける姿は神秘的で、霧に熊野の青々とした山の「青」が反射して、風が青に染まる。そうして、その風は、里山を下り、青々と茂る稲穂や御浜町の特産品、青いみかん「極早生温州みかん」の隙間を駆けぬけて、さらに青に染まる。
やがて、山の「青」は海に届き、海の「青」と一つになる。

御浜は青い、海が青い、山が青い、空が青い、風が青い、みかんも青い

「日本の青」で互い違いに編まれたこの町を、紐解き、味わい、それぞれの感性で編み直す。 そうして、あなただけの御浜の「青」の詩を詠んでみてください。

あなたには、御浜の町は何色に映りますか？

title: A Poem of Blue - Searching for Japan Blue 'Mihama is Blue All Year Round'
description:
'Lush Green' - There exists a unique aesthetic sense among the Japanese. 'Japan's Blue' is made up of the 'blue' called blue and the 'green' called blue. 

In the town where the 'blue' of the Pacific Ocean meets the 'blue' of the Kii Mountains, the sacred site of the syncretism of Shinto and Buddhism, Kumano, Mihama Town in Mie Prefecture. 
In this town, we journey through 'Japan's Blue'. 

The poet, Haruo Sato, reflected on the landscapes of his hometown, Kumano, and composed the 'May Song of Nostalgia'. 
'Sky is blue, mountains are blue, sea is blue' - Sato's poem, capturing the early summer scenery of his hometown, skillfully encapsulated Kumano's 'blue'. The blue sea and sky of the Pacific Ocean, the blue mountains of the Kii Mountains, all contribute to the color of Kumano. 
'Blue sea, blue wind, even the oranges are blue' - if Sato were alive, he might have composed a poem about the scenery of Mihama Town like this. 

In the satoyama, in the mountains of Oroshi, there is a passage for the wind, the Kumano Kodo Fuden Pass. 
The morning mist, affectionately known as 'Fuden Oroshi', rides the wind, and its appearance as it flows through that path is mystical, with the mist reflecting the 'blue' of Kumano's lush mountains, dyeing the wind in blue. Thus, the wind descends the satoyama, racing through the gaps of the lush rice ears and the local specialty of Mihama Town, the blue oranges 'Gokuwase Unshu Mikan', becoming even more blue. 
Eventually, the 'blue' of the mountains reaches the sea, merging with the 'blue' of the sea. 

Mihama is blue, the sea is blue, the mountains are blue, the sky is blue, the wind is blue, even the oranges are blue. 

Unravel, savor, and reweave this town, interlaced with 'Japan's Blue'. Then, try to compose your own poem of Mihama's 'blue'. 

What color does Mihama Town reflect to you?

title: 【おすすめのカフェ】田舎で見つけたお気に入りのカフェ｜熊野｜地方移住｜サステナブル｜ビーガン
description:
♯10 丁寧な暮らしを尋ねて
ENG SUB

2020年7月
東京から三重県御浜町へ移住しました。
今日は、久々の休みの。
お気入りのカフェ、御浜町尾呂志にある、ここからかふぇでゆっくりランチ。
サステナブルな暮らし
先輩移住者がやっているこのカフェでは地元の野菜やお米を使ったヴィーガン定食、神戸でパン屋を営んでいた、マスターの天然酵母の焼きたてパンが食べられる。デザートも勿論ヴィーガンスタイル。素材の味を活かした、シンプルで奥深い料理は東京でも中々お目にかかれないクオリティーです。そんな、マスターとの会話、アドバイスが私たちの理想とする田舎での暮らしとは？と自問し始めるキッカケになりました。

今年1月から移住場所探しを始め、コロナで外出制限がかかるギリギリの3月に三重県御浜町を含め、和歌山、東紀州エリアを運良く訪問することができました。ただし、その後は現地訪問が出来ない状態が続き、他の場所のリサーチに行くことが出来なくなったこともあり、
運命的な出会いであった御浜町に移住を決断しました。約半年で決めた移住。縁も所縁もない町、加えて、結局、3月に数時間だけ訪問した町に移住を決断するのは勇気がいりましたが、
このまま、探し続けると移住するのが何年も先になると思ったので、思い切ることが出来たと思います。

よみがえりの地、熊野
熊野にある町、三重県御浜町
English description follows

熊野は「よみがえりの地」と言われてきました。古来より日本では、人々が生活を営む里に対し、山は神や祖先の霊が宿る神聖な場所である、という考え方があります。中でも熊野は神々が籠る深山の霊場であり、訪れた方は心魂が甦り、新たな気持ちになります。
「人生、出発たびだちの地」

と言われる所以です。また、有史以前から続く自然信仰、熊野修験に代表される山岳宗教、そして神＝仏であるとする神仏習合の信仰形態が相まり、日本固有の宗教観を育む土壌ともなりました。

熊野本宮大社ホームページより引用

About Kumano

“Kumano is a feeling - not a form - a manifestation of the Divine Intangibles, a celebration of life's powerful vitality.
It is a peaceful place in nature to take a moment to reflect on, and reaffirm one's future direction and meaning of life - a sacred space to open one's mind, heart soul ; all of one's senses; and let the artificial boundaries and borders of the modern world  disappear - allowing us to contemplate life as one unified humanity on planet earth.
The importance of a pilgrimage to Kumano is not in its completion, but rather what you take home after internalizing your experience” (Kumano Kodo, 2019).



What kind of life are we searching for?

We are now searching for the meaning of life.

Most of people moved to Kumano say it has sacred power, 
and the power of Kumano leads us to come living or visiting here.
Once you come to visit Kumano, you would be able to understand what they felt.
What kind of adventures are waiting for you?

I moved from Tokyo to Mihama Town, Mie Prefecture.
Today, I have a rare day off.
I’m enjoying a leisurely lunch at my favorite cafe, Koko Kara Cafe, located in Oroshi, Mihama Town.
Sustainable Living
At this cafe run by a senior relocator, you can enjoy a vegan set meal made with local vegetables and rice, as well as freshly baked natural yeast bread from the master who used to run a bakery in Kobe. Of course, the dessert is also vegan. The simple yet profound dishes that bring out the flavors of the ingredients are of a quality that is hard to find even in Tokyo. Conversations with the master sparked questions about what our ideal rural life looks like.

I started looking for a relocation spot in January this year, and I was fortunate to visit Mie Prefecture, including Mihama Town, and the Wakayama and Higashi-Kishu areas just before the COVID-19 restrictions in March. However, after that, I was unable to visit the area again, and I couldn’t research other locations. Thus, I decided to relocate to Mihama Town, which felt like a fateful encounter. It took about six months to make the decision. Moving to a town with no connections or ties, and ultimately deciding to relocate to a town I had only visited for a few hours in March took courage. However, I thought that if I continued searching, it would take years to relocate, so I believe I was able to take the plunge.

The Land of Resurrection, Kumano
Mihama Town in Kumano, Mie Prefecture
English description follows

For more information about Mihama Town, please visit the website below:
https://mihama-mie-townpromotion.jp/

Kumano has been referred to as the "Land of Resurrection." Since ancient times in Japan, there has been a belief that while the villages where people live are ordinary, the mountains are sacred places where gods and ancestral spirits reside. Among them, Kumano is a spiritual site where deities dwell, and those who visit find their spirits revived and their hearts renewed. This is why it is said to be "the land of life's new beginnings."
Additionally, the natural faith that has continued since before recorded history, the mountain religion represented by Kumano Shugendo, and the syncretic belief that gods and Buddhas are one have all contributed to nurturing a unique Japanese religious perspective.

Quoted from the Kumano Hongu Taisha website

About Kumano

"Kumano is a feeling - not a form - a manifestation of the Divine Intangibles, a celebration of life's powerful vitality. It is a peaceful place in nature to take a moment to reflect on, and reaffirm one's future direction and meaning of life - a sacred space to open one's mind, heart, soul; all of one's senses; and let the artificial boundaries and borders of the modern world disappear - allowing us to contemplate life as one unified humanity on planet earth. The importance of a pilgrimage to Kumano is not in its completion, but rather what you take home after internalizing your experience" (Kumano Kodo, 2019).

What kind of life are we searching for?

We are now searching for the meaning of life.
Sustainable Living
We come to see some people who show us their meaning of life in Mihama, Kumano. Most of the people who moved to Kumano say it has sacred power, and the power of Kumano leads us to live or visit here. Once you come to visit Kumano, you would be able to understand what they felt. What kind of adventures are waiting for you?

description:
田舎の日常を旅する。旅するように暮らしたい。
平凡な一日が一番幸せだったりする。
朝、草刈りの音で起こされ、予想外のトラブルに巻き込まれながらも、
自家製番茶を作るために庭のお茶の葉を摘む。
サステナブルな暮らしを意識しながらも、都会暮らしの感覚が抜けなく失敗する田舎暮らしの普通の日常。
人生は全てがうまく行くわけではないので、終わり良ければ全て良し。
憧れはあるがやるとなると難しい理想の田舎暮らし、でもそれに挑戦することは何だか楽しい。
地方移住して良かったなと改めて感じた日になりました。

と言われる所以です。また、有史以前から続く自然信仰、熊野修験に代表される山岳宗教、そして神＝仏であるとする神仏習合の信仰形態が相まり、日本固有の宗教観を育む土壌ともなりました。

description:
Traveling through rural daily life. I want to live as if I am traveling.
Sometimes an ordinary day is the happiest.
Woken up by the sound of grass cutting in the morning, while getting caught up in unexpected troubles,
I pick tea leaves from my garden to make homemade bancha.
While being conscious of a sustainable lifestyle, I still struggle with the urban living mindset, leading to ordinary rural life failures.
Life doesn’t always go smoothly, so as long as the ending is good, everything is good.
There is an ideal rural life that is difficult to achieve despite the longing, but somehow it is fun to challenge it.
It was a day when I felt once again that moving to a rural area was a good decision.

For more information about Mihama Town in Mie Prefecture, please visit the website below:
https://mihama-mie-townpromotion.jp/

The town in Kumano, Mihama Town, Mie Prefecture

The Land of Resurrection, Kumano

Kumano has been called the "Land of Resurrection." Since ancient times in Japan, there has been a belief that mountains are sacred places where gods and ancestral spirits reside, in contrast to the villages where people live. Among them, Kumano is a spiritual site of deep mountains where deities dwell, and those who visit find their spirits revived and their hearts renewed.
This is the reason it is said, "Life is the land of departure."
Additionally, the natural faith that has continued since before recorded history, the mountain religion represented by Kumano Shugendo, and the belief system that combines gods and Buddhas have fostered a unique religious perspective in Japan.

Quoted from the Kumano Hongu Taisha website

About Kumano

"Kumano is a feeling - not a form - a manifestation of the Divine Intangibles, a celebration of life's powerful vitality.
It is a peaceful place in nature to take a moment to reflect on, and reaffirm one's future direction and meaning of life - a sacred space to open one's mind, heart soul; all of one's senses; and let the artificial boundaries and borders of the modern world disappear - allowing us to contemplate life as one unified humanity on planet earth.
The importance of a pilgrimage to Kumano is not in its completion, but rather what you take home after internalizing your experience" (Kumano Kodo, 2019).

I started looking for a place to move in January this year, and fortunately visited Mie Prefecture's Mihama Town, Wakayama, and the Higashi-Kishu area just before the COVID-19 restrictions in March. However, after that, I was unable to visit the area, and due to the inability to research other places,
I decided to move to Mihama Town, which felt like a fateful encounter. I made the decision to move in about six months.
Mihama Town, with no connections or ties, and it took courage to decide to move to a place I only visited for a few hours in March,
but I thought that if I continued searching, it would take years to move, so I believe I was able to take the plunge.

Rural Japan #15 An Ordinary Day in Rural Japan | Sustainable Living | Slow Living | Explore Japan | Travel Japan | ENG SUB

The sounds woke me up in the morning.
I found some tea trees in my garden which I hadn’t known until today.
Let’s make homemade Japanese tea today.
Life isn’t always going well all the time.
Sometimes life is much more complicated than we think.
However, we enjoy the life we are in anyway.

What kind of life are we searching for?

We moved from Tokyo to Mihama Town to search for the meaning of life.
In the town, we found a lot of things we have never touched.
We come to see some people who show us their meaning of life in Mihama, Kumano.
Most people who moved to Kumano say Kumano has sacred power.
Once you come to visit Kumano, you would be able to understand what they are saying.
What kind of adventures are waiting for you?
Please come to visit Mihama Town, Mie, Japan after everything gets back to normal.
We are waiting for you who want to have some special experience of Japan.

I plan to upload videos about 2 or 3 times a month, so if you like it, please give a thumbs up, comment, and subscribe to the channel. I also started an Instagram.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rural_life_japan/

I have been greatly helped by this.

[Mihama Town Migration and Exchange Support Desk]
If you are interested in moving to Mihama Town, please do so. We were also helped by them.
http://mihama-iju.com/

[Kumano Migration Network]
If you are interested in moving to Kumano City, please do so.
Unfortunately, I moved to Mihama Town, not Kumano City,
but thanks to the dedicated staff who were very supportive, it is not an exaggeration to say that my move to the Higashi-Kishu area was realized.
https://kumanoijunet.jimdofree.com/

description:

2週間の外出自粛期間を経て、やっと普通の生活に戻り始めました。
そんな中、御浜町で出会った人たちがBBQパーティーを企画してくれました。コロナの中、帰省も旅行もできずに、夏においてけぼりにされた気持ちになっていましたが、夏らしいことができて、やっと夏に追いついた気がした一日になりました。

今年1月から移住場所探しを始め、コロナで外出制限がかかるギリギリの3月に三重県御浜町を含め、和歌山、東紀州エリアを運良く訪問することができました。ただし、その後は現地訪問が出来ない状態が続き、他の場所のリサーチに行くことが出来なくなったこともあり、
