【Kirishima Onsen Kintokan】
~ A historical inn that supported the dawn of modern Japan, where the draft of the Meiji Constitution was also created ~
This is the inn based on Seichi Morimura's novel (Proof of Humanity).
For more details, please watch this enjoyable and educational video → https://youtu.be/TlS4eqRssyI

【Megane Bridge and Apt Path】
The brick arch bridge, affectionately known as "Megane Bridge," has a span of four, a length of 91 m, and a height of 31 m, making it the largest brick arch bridge in Japan. In 1893, the railway opened between Yokokawa and Karuizawa at Usui Pass. A total of 26 tunnels and 18 bridges were constructed over a distance of 11.2 km with an elevation difference of 552.5 meters.
Usui Pass has long been a difficult transportation point. To navigate its steep gradients, the German mountain railway technology known as the "Abt system" was adopted. Rails with teeth were laid on the tracks, which meshed with gears on the underside of the train. The "Megane Bridge" was one of the 18 bridges that spanned the valley.
The opening of this section dramatically increased the distribution of silk and raw silk, playing a key role in Japan's industrial development. It was decommissioned in 1963 with the opening of a new double-track line.
In 1993, it was registered as a national important cultural property for its contribution to modernization as a "modernization heritage." The approximately 6 km path from Kumano-daira Station to Yokokawa Station, passing through the Megane Bridge and 10 tunnels, has been developed as a walking path called "Apt Path," becoming a popular tourist spot.
It is also a popular filming location → https://youtu.be/nBwT2Sgb1yY

【Usui Pass Abandoned Line Walk】
The "Usui Pass Abandoned Line Walk" is a guided walking tour.

"The history of the mountain pass railway was the history of people."
A 104-year history of crossing Usui Pass by railway, connecting Gunma Prefecture and Nagano Prefecture.
Opened in 1893, it greatly contributed to Japan's economic development after the Meiji period.
This town, which flourished due to the opening of the railway, holds the memories and thoughts of its people.
Connecting the end of the dead-end rails to the next generation.
The steepest section of railway in Japan operated until September 30, 1997.
To promote preservation and utilization, a "Supporter System" was launched.
Shin'etsu Main Line New Line, the Yokokawa-Karuizawa section, commonly known as the "Usui Line."
"The history of the mountain pass railway will continue to be the history of people."

For details on the Supporter System, click here → https://camp-fire.jp/projects/view/474873

【Usui Pass Railway Culture Village】
A railway theme park that conveys the history of the old Usui Line, enjoyable for children and railway fans alike. You can enjoy railway models, playground equipment for children, and authentic locomotive driving experiences that adults will love. Experience the history of over a century of railways at the "Usui Pass Railway Culture Village." Here is the website → https://www.usuitouge.com/bunkamura/

【Isobe Onsen Mark Festival】
In 2022, it was held on February 25♨︎
During the festival, the "Onsen Mark Curry" is offered at half price, and the background of its commercialization lies in the "crisis of the Onsen mark." In 2016, the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry discussed changing the current Onsen mark to a symbol that includes bathers, as it was deemed unclear for foreigners, especially in preparation for the Tokyo Olympics and Paralympics. Those involved with Isobe Onsen opposed this, saying, "Please do not change the traditional mark!" The mark was settled by coexisting, and a story emerged about the "love for the Onsen mark." I hope that eating this curry filled with love will create more travel memories.

For information on Isobe Onsen, I recommend this website → https://www.isobeonsen.com/

title: 【安中市 -春- 】ANNAKA CITY - Spring - 〈群馬県 観光PR〉
description:

のってたのしい列車

【安中総合学園和太鼓部 〜飛翔〜】

2022年7月には第11回 全国高校生太鼓甲子園へ出場（群馬県初）
詳しくはこちらから→https://annakasogo-hs.gsn.ed.jp/club/wadaiko

夏の暑い日も、冬の寒い日も横川を賑やかにしてくれています。

【秋間梅林】
ぐんま三大梅林のひとつで、観光梅林として約60年の歴史があります。
約50ヘクタールの広大な丘陵に約35,000本の紅白梅が咲き誇ります。
秋間梅林祭を2月中旬から3月末にかけて毎年開催しています。
梅農家のお母さんたちが笑顔で営業する売店が11軒連なり、地元のごはんやおやつを味わう事が出来ます。
秋間梅林は観て、食べて、体験できる梅のふるさとです。
安中駅からバスに乗っても行けます。
詳しくはこちらから→https://akimabairin.com/access/

【碓氷 横川の旅】
碓日のお宿 東京屋 https://oyado-tokyoya.com/
横川駅を降りて、徒歩3分。おいしいご飯と旅館のおもてなし。
鉄道で栄えたまちで過ごす夜、列車の動き出す朝の雰囲気。
もう一度、横川に来たくなること間違いなしです。

横川周辺の桜の見頃は4月1週目あたりです。
かつての鉄道員たちの角打ちスポット
伊丹屋酒店→https://goo.gl/maps/eyNdzPaDAFQ6teSM6
お花見用のお酒はこちらでどうぞ。
アプトの道を歩いた後の乾杯にもおすすめです。

【後閑城址公園】
戦国時代に西上州の要城として存在した「後閑城」をもとに、堀切、郭、虎口門、櫓　台など、当時の形状を生かした広場が配置された公園です。
それぞれの広場を遊歩道で結び、草花や樹木の中を散策しながら、四季折々の移り変わりが楽しめます。特に春は、浅間山と奇勝妙義山を借景に、本丸跡に植栽された桜が満開になる様は一見の価値があります。
2024年3月31日開催、桜まつり花火大会。
600発の大輪の花火とライトアップで照らされたサクラが春の夜空に咲き誇る。

【安中市立臼井小学校・九十九小学校】
2022年3月31日をもって閉校となり、松井田小学校へ統合となりました。
桜が咲く校庭で子どもたちが元気に遊ぶ姿を記録に残すことができました。
タイムカプセルを開ける時に、この映像を見てくれたらうれしいです。

【妙義山】
妙義山は上毛三山の1つで、日本三奇勝の1つにも数えられております。奇岩怪石の妙義山には、自然の造形美ともいえるアーチ状の石門群や、日暮れまで見ていても飽きない「日暮らしの景」などの名所が幾つもあります。秋は、モミジやカエデなどの紅葉が見事で、多くの人々が登山や紅葉狩りに訪れます。


【横川ナイトパーク】
碓氷峠鉄道文化むらが20:00までナイトミュージアムに。
高崎ー横川間をEL/DL横川ナイトパーク号が運行します。
想いが込められたヘッドマークのデザインに注目！！
https://www.instagram.com/p/Cmz8FhYh3K7/?hl=ja

〈担当者より✏️〉🎹song by  I Like It  / KONCOS 

安中市の春夏秋冬を記録した中でも個人的に1番気に入っている映像です。
碓氷峠の春は野鳥の鳴声から始まり、木々が芽吹き、山桜がきれいに咲きます。
その空気感、そこに吹く風は鉄道が走っていたときと変わらないはずです。

この間までトンネルを抜けると樹氷が見えた場所でも、春の陽気を感じるようになった。

機関士だった祖父の日記には、春の訪れを喜ぶ様子が書かれていました。

来てくれる人たちの好きなことを、楽しめるように案内をすること。
峠の鉄道の歴史を、次の世代に語り継ぐ。
祖父を含め、携わった方々がそうしてくれたように。

ああしたい、こうしたい、できたらいいな。
という前向きな気持ちも大切で、必要なのは、決める事。

このまちの風景を、
このまちの文化を、
このまちの歴史を、

愛することを決めました。

The Akima Plum Grove Festival is held every year from mid-February to the end of March.

1893年にアプト式の鉄道が開業し、その後1963年に新線を開通させて峠を越えました。横川〜軽井沢間は1997年に廃線となって、J Rから当時の碓氷郡松井田町が譲渡を受け、22年経った今でもトンネルや線路は当時のまま残っています。

title: [2020 Fresh Green] Usui Pass Abandoned Line Walk [Nobuhiko Otani's Friday Daijoubu! Letter from Hometown]
description:
[What is an Abandoned Line Walk?]
The stage for the Abandoned Line Walk is the Usui Pass, which separates Gunma Prefecture and Nagano Prefecture.
The Abt-style railway opened in 1893, and a new line was opened in 1963, allowing passage over the pass. The section between Yokokawa and Karuizawa was abandoned in 1997, and the then Matsuidamachi in Usui County received the transfer from JR. Even after 22 years, tunnels and tracks remain as they were at that time.
(The section that was discontinued is the 11.2 km stretch from JR Shin'etsu Line Yokokawa (Anjō City, Gunma Prefecture) to Karuizawa (Karuizawa Town, Nagano Prefecture). This was in conjunction with the opening of the Nagano Shinkansen (then name, now known as the Hokuriku Shinkansen) 22 years ago in 1997.)

This time, we present footage of the fresh green Usui Pass taken on May 13, 2020.

It is high-quality 4K footage. Enjoy the feeling of going out from the comfort of your home.

The Usui Pass Abandoned Line Walk supports the 'Anjō Helmet Project'.

https://www.annakahelmetproject.com/Aboutthisproject

This project aims to raise disaster prevention awareness by delivering helmets to the children of Anjō.

In case of an emergency, may precious lives be protected.

The profits from the 'ANNAKA CITY T-shirt' sold through this activity will be transformed into 'disaster prevention helmets' and returned to the children of Anjō.

We appreciate your support for the activities of the 'Anjō Helmet Project', where the actions of adults benefit the children.

The audio used in the video is from a live performance at the 'Anakaruchia' event held by 'the Anjō Association', which was the catalyst for the establishment of the 'Anjō Helmet Project'.

Once the coronavirus pandemic is over, please come visit the Akima Plum Grove, Isobe Onsen, Kirizumi Onsen, and Usui Pass in Anjō City!

The 'Anjō City Tourism Organization Antrip' also provides information on inns and restaurants!
https://www.antrip.jp/

We are planning fun experiences and look forward to your visit!

美しい自然環境を誇るサンゴでできた島"喜界島"。美しい海の青と大地の緑が折り重なる自然豊かな島です。そして島の文化や、ゆったりとした島時間、優しい島民との出会いは喜びに溢れる素敵な旅を彩ります。

■喜界島とは
喜界島は鹿児島から南に約380km・奄美大島の東25km。太平洋と東シナ海のぶつかる洋上に浮かぶ隆起珊瑚礁の島です。
島の大半が隆起サンゴ礁で、今でも年間平均2mmずつ隆起し続けている学術的にも貴重な島です。
島一面にサトウキビ畑が広がり、サトウキビから作られる黒糖、黒糖焼酎は島の特産品となっています。また国内最大の白ゴマの産地としても知られています。
喜界島島内には奄美十景の１つ、百之台公園を始め、美しいスギラビーチやハワイビーチ、古くから残るサンゴの石垣など数々の名所があります。近年はダイビングスポットとしても注目をされています。

title: [Kikai Island, Japan] Island of Smiles
description:
Official website: https://bit.ly/3koX8Qf
Official Instagram: https://bit.ly/3XgZuzh

Kikai Island, made of coral, boasts a beautiful natural environment. It is a lush island where the blue of the sea and the green of the land intertwine. The island's culture, the relaxed island time, and encounters with the kind islanders create a wonderful journey filled with joy.

■ What is Kikai Island?
Kikai Island is located about 380 km south of Kagoshima and 25 km east of Amami Oshima. It is an uplifted coral reef island floating in the ocean where the Pacific Ocean and the East China Sea meet. The majority of the island is made up of uplifted coral reefs, and it continues to rise at an average rate of 2 mm per year, making it a scientifically valuable island.
The island is covered with sugarcane fields, and the brown sugar and brown sugar shochu made from sugarcane are local specialties. It is also known as the largest producer of white sesame in Japan. 
Within Kikai Island, there are many famous spots, including Hyakunodai Park, one of the Ten Scenic Views of Amami, as well as the beautiful Sugirabeach, Hawaii Beach, and ancient coral stone walls. In recent years, it has also gained attention as a diving spot.

title: 未だ見ぬ世界（ふくい）へ【地味にすごい、福井動画コンテスト入賞作品】
description:
本作品は、「地味にすごい、福井」をテーマに、福井県が実施した動画コンテストの入賞作品です。
【動画制作者からのコメント】
私たちは、福井市のセブンディという映像制作会社で、高島と今城の２人で運営しております。2016年より、YouTubeにチャンネルを開設し、現在まで、福井のなんでもない景色をテーマに動画をアップしてきました。動画を制作するにあたり、地味にすごいとは何か、そして、福井の素晴らしさは何かを考えました。福井の素晴らしさは、景色、風景にあると思います。豊な水がもたらす大自然は、大きく変わる時代の流れの中でも普遍である雄大さがあります。それは、誰もが知っている観光地や名所だけではなく、なんでもないところにも溢れていて、その景色というのはきっと、福井に住む人の数、福井に訪れた人の数、福井を思う人の数あるのではないでしょうか。動画では、みなさんが知っている観光地はもちろん、私たちが見つけた素晴らしい景色や自然をで織り交ぜ、動画をご覧になった方に、どうか皆さんのそれぞれのとっておきの景色を見つけに福井へ来てほしいというストーリーにしています。タイトルは、雲海ではっきり見えない福井の景色に、鋭い視線を切り込み、未だ見ぬ世界（ふくい）にあなたの視点を入れて欲しいという思いを込めました。動画は４Kになっています。美しい福井をどのように再現できるかに苦労しました。どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

title: The Unseen World (Fukui)【Award-winning Work of the Subtly Amazing Fukui Video Contest】
description:
This work is an award-winning entry in the video contest conducted by Fukui Prefecture, themed "Subtly Amazing, Fukui." 
【Comment from the Video Creators】 
We are a video production company called Seven D, based in Fukui City, operated by Takashima and Imajo. Since 2016, we have been uploading videos themed around the ordinary landscapes of Fukui on our YouTube channel. In creating this video, we contemplated what it means to be subtly amazing and what makes Fukui wonderful. We believe the beauty of Fukui lies in its scenery and landscapes. The abundant nature brought by rich water possesses a grandeur that remains constant even amidst the changing tides of time. This beauty is not only found in well-known tourist spots and landmarks but also overflows in the most ordinary places. The scenery reflects the number of people living in Fukui, those who visit, and those who think of Fukui. In the video, we weave together not only the tourist spots you know but also the wonderful landscapes and nature we have discovered, creating a story that encourages viewers to come to Fukui and find their own special scenery. The title expresses our desire for you to cut through the obscured views of Fukui's landscapes in the sea of clouds and to bring your perspective into the unseen world (Fukui). The video is in 4K. We struggled to recreate the beauty of Fukui. Thank you for your support. 

#Fukui #ふくい 

Creators: 
Cinematography: Koji Imajo 
Composition, Direction, Editing: Chie Takashima

title: Traditional Japanese Sake Making at Ogaki
description:
ユネスコ無形文化遺産に登録された日本の「伝統的酒造り」を発信するPR動画です。
大垣は、地下水が豊富でおいしい水に恵まれ、市内には３つの酒蔵があります。

【撮影協力】
武内酒造、三輪酒造、渡辺酒造醸
　

～大垣観光協会の公式チャンネルです～
自然や歴史、文化など大垣の様々な魅力を動画でご紹介します。

【大垣市のご紹介】
岐阜県の西部、西美濃の中心に位置する人口16万人のまちで、古くから「水の都大垣」と称されるほど、豊富な地下水に恵まれています。
俳人松尾芭蕉の紀行文「奥の細道」のむすびの地として知られ、関ケ原合戦の際に西軍石田三成の本拠地となった大垣城や、豊臣秀吉が一夜で築いたとされる墨俣一夜城などもあり、自然と歴史が共存したまちです。
3月下旬から5月には、舟下りやたらい舟、平成28年にユネスコ無形文化遺産にも登録された大垣まつりが開催され、多くの観光客で賑わいます。

title: Traditional Japanese Sake Making at Ogaki
description:
This is a PR video promoting Japan's 'traditional sake making,' which is registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.
Ogaki is blessed with abundant underground water, providing delicious water, and there are three sake breweries in the city.

【Filming Cooperation】
Takeuchi Sake Brewery, Miwa Sake Brewery, Watanabe Sake Brewery

～This is the official channel of the Ogaki Tourism Association～
We introduce various attractions of Ogaki, such as nature, history, and culture, through videos.

【Introduction to Ogaki City】
Located in the western part of Gifu Prefecture, in the center of Nishi-Mino, Ogaki is a city with a population of 160,000, known for its abundant underground water, earning it the nickname 'Water City Ogaki' since ancient times.
It is known as the ending point of Matsuo Basho's travelogue 'The Narrow Road to the Deep North' and features Ogaki Castle, which served as the base for Ishida Mitsunari of the Western Army during the Battle of Sekigahara, as well as the Sumiyaki Castle, said to have been built by Toyotomi Hideyoshi in one night, making it a city where nature and history coexist.
From late March to May, the Ogaki Festival, which was registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2016, is held, attracting many tourists with activities like boat rides and tarai boats.

title: 釧路、阿寒、摩周、川湯で自然と共生する（短縮版） - 手付かずの北海道 2023 -
description:
手付かずの北海道 - 水のカムイ観光圏
[Japanese website] https://untouchedhokkaido.jp
[English website] https://untouchedhokkaido.jp/en/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido

釧路湿原、阿寒湖、摩周湖がある東北海道の地域は、自然の美しさの輝く宝石です。先住民族アイヌの人々は、カムイ（神）がすべてに宿ると信じており、水の自然の恵みとの共生関係を大切にしています。この信念は、歴史的かつ地理的にユニークなこの土地で今も息づいており、非常に希少なブレキストンのフクロウを含む無数の野生動物の種が生息しています。冬には、タンチョウ、オジロワシ、シロハラワシを見るために訪れてください。古代から保存されてきた自然の美しさの地、手付かずの北海道へようこそ。
歴史的・地理的に、ユニークな場所である東北海道は、日本でありながら北米プレートに位置するため、その植生はとても珍しい種類で溢れている。この土地だからこそ出逢える希少な野生生物、そして多くの生き物が暮らす日本の国立公園はその自然と共生する地元の人々がずっと昔から守りぬいてきた『自然が手付かずで残る場所（Untouched Hokkaido）』。東北海道、この地域は豊かな清流でつながっており、日本の特別天然記念物でもある、優雅で美しいタンチョウが住んでいる。北海道の先住民族であるアイヌの言葉で、タンチョウはサロルンカムイ（湿原に住む神）と呼ばれていた。水は生命を育みながら、魔法をかけられたようにさまざまなカタチに変化する。

#HOKKAIDO #JAPAN #Adventure

title: Co-existing with nature in Kushiro, Akan, Mashu and Kawayu(short ver.) -Untouched HOKKAIDO 2023-
description:
Untouched Hokkaido - 水のカムイ観光圏
[Japanese website] https://untouchedhokkaido.jp
[English website] https://untouchedhokkaido.jp/en/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido

The area of East Hokkaido where you'll find the Kushiro Shitsugen Wetland, Lake Akan and Lake Mashu is a shining jewel of natural beauty. The indigenous Ainu people believe that Kamuy (deity) dwells in everything, and treasure a symbiotic relationship with the waters' natural bounty.
This belief continues to thrive in this historically and geographically unique land, which is home to countless species of wildlife, including the incredibly rare Blakiston's fish owl. Visit in winter to see red-crowned cranes, Steller's sea eagles and white-tailed eagles.
Welcome to Untouched Hokkaido, a land of natural beauty that has been preserved since ancient times.
歴史的・地理的に、ユニークな場所である東北海道は、⽇本でありながら北⽶プレートに位置するため、その植⽣はとてもに珍しい種類で溢れている。この⼟地だからこそ出逢える希少な野⽣⽣物、そして多くの⽣き物が暮らす⽇本の国⽴公園はその⾃然と共⽣する地元の⼈々がずっと昔から守りぬいてきた『⾃然が⼿付かずで残る場所（Untouched
Hokkaido）』。 東北海道、この地域は豊かな清流でつながっており、日本の特別天然記念物でもある、優雅で美しいタンチョウが住んでいる。北海道の先住民族であるアイヌの言葉で、タンチョウはサロルンカムイ（湿原に住む神）と呼ばれていた。

title: Sea of Clouds Over Lake Mashu in the Early Morning / 摩周湖早朝雲海
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

Around 20 minutes by car from Kawayu Hot Springs is Lake Mashu Viewpoint No. 3. Arrive here between sunrise and around 8:00 AM and you might see an incredible sea of clouds. The clouds covering the sky change from one movement to the next - you won't be able to tear your eyes away! The scene is completed by waves of clouds that flow over Lake Mashu from the surrounding mountains. June to September is the best time to see the sea of clouds in Teshikaga Town. Lake Mashu Viewpoint No. 3 is the best vantage point, at over 100m higher than Viewpoint No. 1. If you're lucky, you'll see a "double sea of clouds" around you, with clouds covering both Lake Mashu and Lake Kussharo! Make sure you check the best time of morning and viewing conditions in advance, as it changes depending on the season and the weather.

川湯温泉から摩周第３展望台までは車で約20分。日の出前から朝8時ぐらいまでが雲海の見頃だ。空を覆う雲海は、刻一刻と姿を変え、見る者の心を奪う。雲の波が外輪山から摩周湖に流れ込むように湖面を覆う、その様は圧巻の一言。弟子屈町で雲海を見るなら6月から9月がベストシーズン。摩周第3展望台の標高は、第1展望台よりも100メートル以上高く、雲海スポットとしては第３展望台がおすすめ。運が良ければ、360度見渡す限り雲海に埋め尽くされた摩周湖と、屈斜路湖両方の雲海、通称「ダブル雲海」を見ることができる！ 雲海の見ごろの時間帯は、季節や気象条件などにより異なるので事前の確認を。

title: Kagami no Ma Cruise in the Headwaters of the Kushiro River / 釧路川源流クルーズ・鏡の間
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

The Kushiro River is the only river that flows out of Lake Kussharo. It runs through Kushiro Shitsugen Wetland and out to sea. A short distance to the side of the Kushiro River is a magical spot called Kagami no Ma. Kagami no Ma is Japanese for "mirror room" and you'll see why as soon as you see how clear this spring is. The water remains below 10°C all year round, and the area offers a vastly different scene from the Kushiro River nearby. With its cool air, crystal-clear water and lush greenery, Kagami no Ma will captivate you.

屈斜路湖から流れ出る唯一の川、釧路川。川は釧路湿原へとつながり最後は海へ流れ出る。釧路川から少しだけ脇にはいったところに「鏡の間」と呼ばれる神秘のスポットがある。湧き水から成る「鏡の間」は、その名に相応しく透明度が抜群に高い！水温は四季を通して10度以下で触るとひんやり冷たい。釧路川との違いをしっかり感じることができる。清涼な空気、鏡面の水面、澄んだ緑、訪れる者を魅了する神秘の空間。

屈斜路湖から流れ出る唯一の川、釧路川。川は釧路湿原へとつながり最後は海へ流れ出る。釧路川から少しだけ脇にはいったところに「鏡の間」と呼ばれる神秘のスポットがある。湧き水から成る「鏡の間」は、その名に相応しく透明度が抜群に高い！水温は四季を通して10度以下で触るとひんやり冷たい。釧路川との違いをしっかり感じることができる。清涼な空気、鏡面の水面、澄んだ緑、訪れる者を魅了する神秘の空間。

title: Canoe Cruise around Wakoto Peninsula / 和琴半島一周カヌークルーズ
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

Wakoto Peninsula is a peninsula that is about 3km around, jutting into a lake with a circumference of 57km. Its name comes from the Ainu phrase "wakkochi", which means "the narrow part of a fish's tail". The peninsula is a fascinating volcanic area, with hot springs everywhere and an area called Oyakotsu Jigoku (Oyakotsu Hell) at the tip of the peninsula, where plumes of smoke rise from the ground. Covered with deep forest, Wakoto Peninsula offers new natural splendor with each season: North Japanese hill cherry blossoms in spring, new greenery in early summer, colorful foliage in autumn. On a sunny day, Lake Kussharo is at its clearest, offering a view that will take your breath away. After you paddle around the peninsula, Mrs. Hiratsuka will serve you a hearty homemade lunch near the stunning Oyakotsu Jigoku. Made with local ingredients from Teshikaga and the surrounding area, every option will have you smacking your lips in satisfaction. The heartfelt hospitality you'll receive will make this the best canoe cruise you've ever been on.

周囲57kmの湖に突き出た和琴半島、半島1週は約3kmになる。和琴の名前の由来は、アイヌ語のワッコチ、「魚の尾のくびれた所」が語源。至る所で温泉が沸き、半島先端部には「オヤコツ地獄」と呼ばれる噴煙を上げる場所もあり、火山の島であることを実感できる。深い森におおわれた和琴半島は、春はエゾヤマザクラ、初夏の新緑、秋は紅葉など、その豊かな自然が季節様々の表情を見せてくれる。天気が良いと、屈斜路湖の透明度は最高の演出となり感動ものだ。カヌーガイドの平塚さんの奥さんの手作りランチは、オヤコツ地獄に上陸していただく最高のご馳走。弟子屈近郊の食材を使って用意されたランチはどれをとっても絶品！心優しい地元への想いが詰まったランチと絶景で、カヌークルージングは最高潮になる。

Kazuaki and Ai Hiratsuka
This husband and wife duo are guides at Northeast Canoe Center, Ltd.
After encountering Canadian canoeing in 1986, they decided to recreate the experience on the beautiful Lake Kussharo and Kushiro River, and began working as tour guides to share the spectacular nature of their hometown through exciting canoe tours.
After a leisurely canoe trip with the Hiratsukas where you’re surrounded by the natural marvels of Lake Kussharo and the Kushiro River, you’ll be treated to a hearty homemade lunch made by Ai.

平塚 一明・愛
有限会社ノースイーストカヌーセンター　ガイド。
1986年にカナディアンカヌーと出会い、屈斜路湖と釧路川の魅力を再発見。ふるさとの素晴らしい自然を、カヌーを通じて知ってもらいたいとツアーガイドをスタート。屈斜路湖と釧路川の豊かな自然の中で過ごす贅沢な時間を、のんびりと優雅に過ごしていただくために、夫婦でカヌーツアーを行う。愛さんの手作りランチは地元食材にこだわった最高のごちそう。

title: Fishing in Lake Akan and the Akan River / 阿寒湖・阿寒川フィッシング
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

Lake Akan is famous for is marimo moss balls and is surrounded by untouched nature. It's also home to an abundance of native trout species, making it a beloved spot for fly fishing and lure fishing enthusiasts. Fishing is banned until April 30 each year to protect the fish population, but the period from May 1 until autumn is an angler's paradise! Even beginners will find it easy to catch rainbow trout, Japanese char and kokanee in Lake Akan. Be aware that the area from the mouth of the Akan River at Lake Akan to the Yukan Bridge is a catch-and-release area - the first in Hokkaido (designated in 2003). A recreational fishing charge of JPY1,500 per day applies (to be paid in advance).

マリモの生息で有名な阿寒湖には、手つかずの自然の姿がそのまま残る。そして阿寒湖はネイティブトラウトの宝庫で、多くのアングラー（釣り人）のあこがれの地でもあり、フライフィッシングやルアーフィッシングの聖地とも呼ばれる。5月1日の解禁日から秋にかけては、釣り三昧の休日を過ごせるベストシーズン！ニジマス・アメマス・ヒメマス釣りなどは初心者でも手軽に楽しめる。 ちなみに2003年に北海道で初めてキャッチ＆リリース（再放流）を遊漁規則化したことにより、阿寒川湖流出口から雄観橋下流端はキャッチ＆リリースエリアに設定されている。遊漁料1日.1,500円が必要（事前支払い）。

title: Chikurouen Flagship Store / 竹老園東家総本店
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhok...
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_h...

Chikurouen's flagship store is one of the oldest soba noodle restaurants in Hokkaido. With a history of over 140 years, this specialist restaurant has honed its skills and is still striving to improve on its authentic local noodles. Kushiro soba noodles stand out from the rest - they're green! That's because they're made from new buckwheat. The founder of Chikurouen is said to have wanted every customer to enjoy soba noodles made from new buckwheat, and that tradition is still alive today.

北海道で最も古い蕎麦屋のひとつとされる老舗蕎麦屋「竹老園東家総本店」。明治創業から140年余り、そばひと筋。歴史を積み重ねるごとに磨かれてきた技で、今なお本物の味を追い求め続けている。釧路のそばの特徴は緑色。そばが緑色なのは新そばで作られているから。緑色のそばが出来上がった理由は諸説あるが、お客様に常に新そばを食べている気分を味わっていただけるよう、出されるようになったといわれている。創業当時からの主の想いは今も受け継がれている。

〒085-0824
北海道釧路市柏木町3-19 
Tel. 0154-41-6291
http://chikurouen.com/


歴史的・地理的に、ユニークな場所である東北海道は、⽇本でありながら北⽶プレートに位置するため、その植⽣はとてもに珍しい種類で溢れている。この⼟地だからこそ出逢える希少な野⽣⽣物、そして多くの⽣き物が暮らす⽇本の国⽴公園はその⾃然と共⽣する地元の⼈々がずっと昔から守りぬいてきた『⾃然が⼿付かずで残る場所（Untouched
Hokkaido）』。 東北海道、この地域は豊かな清流でつながっており、日本の特別天然記念物でもある、優雅で美しいタンチョウが住んでいる。北海道の先住民族であるアイヌの言葉で、タンチョウはサロルンカムイ（湿原に住む神）と呼ばれていた。
水は生命を育みながら、魔法をかけられたようにさまざまなカタチに変化する。

Considered one of the oldest soba restaurants in Hokkaido, Chikurouen has been dedicated to soba since its establishment over 140 years ago in the Meiji era. With skills refined over the years, they continue to pursue the authentic taste. The characteristic of Kushiro soba is its green color, which comes from being made with new buckwheat. Historically and geographically, Eastern Hokkaido is a unique place, located on the North American Plate despite being in Japan, resulting in a rich variety of rare plant species. This land is home to rare wildlife that can only be encountered here, and the national parks of Japan, where many creatures live, have been preserved by the local people who have coexisted with nature for a long time, known as 'Untouched Hokkaido.' Eastern Hokkaido is connected by rich clear streams, and is home to the elegant and beautiful Tancho, a special natural monument of Japan. In the language of the Ainu, the indigenous people of Hokkaido, the Tancho is called Sarorunkamuy (the god that lives in the marsh). Water nurtures life while magically transforming into various forms.

title: Mt. Io:Untouched Hokkaido/硫黄山
description:
Teshikaga Town: Mt. Io

Stand inches away from the pulse of the earth
With the distinctive smell of sulfur and alpine plants at much lower altitudes than they usually grow, Mt. Io is like a scene from another planet. Mt. Io is located around 3km from Kawayu Hot Springs, and is called Atosa-nupuri (bare mountain) in Ainu. To this day, sulfur plumes rise from various areas of the mountain, with an incredible rumbling sound. Large-scale sulfur mining once took place here, which played a significant role in Teshikaga Town's development.
Parking is free during the winter (late November to early April).
Parking fees apply during summer: \200 for a motorcycle, \500 for a car, \1,000 for a minibus, \2,000 for a large bus
*Mt. Io is currently closed to the public for safety reasons, as there is currently a risk of falling rocks.

Untouched Hokkaido
Eastern Hokkaido has a history and geography all of its own. Despite its location in Japan, it is actually on the North American tectonic plate, and as a result it is full of extremely rare plant life. Eastern Hokkaido locals have coexisted for generations with the area's rare wildlife and the nature in the national parks that those animals call home, and as a result there are many natural areas that are untouched by human hands.

title: Hike along the Akan River:Untouched Hokkaido/阿寒川リバーサイドハイク
description:
You’ll be hard-pressed to find a more beautiful hiking spot than this tranquil river surrounded by forest with natural hot springs along the way
The pure waters of the Akan River are home to rainbow trout and whitespotted char. In winter, you can hike on snowshoes through the snow-covered forest by the river. Hot springs can be found along the river, making the perfect end point for your hike. If the timing is right, you might even see wildlife such as foxes, raccoon dogs (tanuki) and Yezo deer, which drink from the hot springs to get minerals.

"Where water kamuy and fire kamuy meet"
The indigenous Ainu people of Hokkaido place great importance on coexisting with nature, where they believe that deities reside. There are two types of deities in nature – the deity of fire  (apefuchi-kamuy) and the deity of water (wakkaushi-kamuy). The Akan River is a holy ground where the two meet, and the two types of kamuy are believed to provide the nutrients that the forest wildlife lives on.

Tel. +81-154-67-3200

title: Kotan no Yu: A free open-air hot spring by Lake Kussharo/Untouched Hokkaido/コタンの湯
description:
This natural open-air hot spring bath will make you feel like you’re bathing in Lake Kussharo itself
This hot spring bath surrounded by stones is just 5m from Lake Kussharo, creating the illusion that you are bathing in Lake Kussharo itself. In winter, the warm water runs into the lake, attracting swans that you can see right before your eyes. As you look out over the lake, you'll feel as if the swans are bathing in the hot spring with you. This vast natural paradise is stunningly beautiful no matter what time of day you visit, with incredible sunsets over the mountains beyond the lake and stars as far as the eye can see at night. Admission is free and free parking is available. Basic men's and women's changing facilities are available. The bath is surrounded by stones. title: Kotan no Yu: A free open-air hot spring by Lake Kussharo/Untouched Hokkaido/コタンの湯
description:
This natural open-air hot spring bath will make you feel like you’re bathing in Lake Kussharo itself
This hot spring bath surrounded by stones is just 5m from Lake Kussharo, creating the illusion that you are bathing in Lake Kussharo itself. In winter, the warm water runs into the lake, attracting swans that you can see right before your eyes. As you look out over the lake, you'll feel as if the swans are bathing in the hot spring with you. This vast natural paradise is stunningly beautiful no matter what time of day you visit, with incredible sunsets over the mountains beyond the lake and stars as far as the eye can see at night. Admission is free and free parking is available. Basic men's and women's changing facilities are available. The bath is surrounded by stones. While there is a large stone in the center dividing the bath in two, each side is visible from the other side, so bathing is basically mixed. Swimwear is OK.

title: Early morning tour of Lake Akan in winter:Untouched Hokkaido/冬の阿寒湖早朝散歩
description:
Take an early morning tour through the snowy scenery around Lake Akan
In winter, you can explore a freezing natural environment where it is not uncommon for early morning temperatures to reach -20°C. The winter chill creates magical natural beauty. You can walk across the completely frozen Akan lake to its island in around 10 minutes. You can also see the sunrise over Mt. Oakan and beautiful natural phenomena such as frost flowers, rime and diamond dust. The tour meets at 6:20, early mornings from late January to mid-March.
In summer, this island can only be reached by boat.

description:
Fukutsukasa is a brewery that has made seishu sake in Kushiro since 1919.
Fukutsukasa is one of Kushiro's best-known brands. Its name is said to come from fuku wo tsukasadoru, an ancient Japanese concept of inviting good fortune. As Kushiro's only sake brewery, Fukutsukasa makes delicious sake that cannot be imitated elsewhere, and is a firm favorite among Kushiro locals. The main ingredient is Hokkaido rice, brewed in groundwater filtered by the great nature of eastern Hokkaido.

title: Untouched Hokkaido ダイジェスト(Winter)
description:
Welcome to Eastern Hokkaido, an incredibly beautiful area filled with rare wildlife and natural wonders.
The area is blessed with an abundance of pure, natural water that transforms the landscape throughout the seasons. 

Sarorun Kamuy
The Kushiro area is home to the natural habitat of the red-crowned crane, a designated special natural monument that was once called “sarorun kamuy”, which means “spirits that live in the marshlands”, by the native Ainu people.

Cape Kirakotan
Cape Kirakotan is a designated national natural monument area, and its name originates from when the marshland was still part of the ocean, 6 thousand years ago. It was found to be a natural breeding ground of the red crowned crane that was previously thought to be extinct.

Sunset Cruise
Kushiro is said to have one of the three most beautiful sunsets in the world, and the best place to see it is from a boat. 

Robatayaki
Robatayaki is a style of cooking that is unique to the port town of Kushiro, and these restaurants are the perfect place to enjoy amazing food and delicious sake with friendly locals.

Sake : Fukutsukasa
Established in 1919, Fukutsukasa sake brewery blends delicious local spring water with the finest natural ingredients to create a wide variety of sakes.

Snowshoeing
Snowshoeing along the banks of Akan River brings you to a natural oasis that attracts many wild animals, a mystical place where the Ainu believed the spirits of fire and water coexist.

Ainu Culture
Ainu are the indigenous people of Hokkaido, who believe that spirits exist in nature. The culture and customs of the Ainu people remain strong in the Akan region.

Lake Kussharo
Lake Kussharo is the largest caldera lake in Japan and is home to a large number of wild swans that keep warm through the harsh winter near the natural hot springs.

Mt. Iou
Mt. Iou vents plumes of sulfurous steam through volcanic craters in the mountain side, creating a strong smell of sulfur in the surrounding area. 

Kawayu Hot Spring
Hotels in Kawayu Onsen area draw their hot spring water from the same pure source, so abundant that even the river that flows through the town stems from natural volcanic springs.

Lake Mashu
The lake water is so pure it is said to be the second clearest water in the world, and the lake surface has a distinctively beautiful color known as Mashu blue.

#japan #Hokkaido #water

title: The Four Seasons in Osaka＜Short ver.＞
description:
Check out some of Osaka’s top sightseeing spots, food, and culture.
The long version is here. →https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LvwrqwlK0FE&t=5s

Whether Spring, Summer, Autumn, or Winter, Osaka can be enjoyed at any time of the year!
Watch on as we introduce just some of Osaka's many seasonal hot spots.

Spring: Discover the lovely pinks of Cherry Blossom at Osaka Castle.
Summer: Take part in one of Japan's most famous festivals, the "Tenjin Festival", and check out the breath-taking Minoo Falls.
Autumn: Fall in love with the Autumn leaves of trees lining the Midosuji Boulevard and painting Katsuo-ji temple into a fiery red and yellow masterpiece.
Winter: Take in the city's enchanting winter illumination. 

With so many more fantastic sights, including the Expo ’70 Commemorative Park, Umeda Sky building, and Universal Studios Japan, Osaka is full of incredible activities and hotspots that will keep you longing for more.

Subscribe to our channel now and discover Osaka and its many wonders!

title: 道 - My Journey of Life in Nanki Kumano
description:
After twenty years since he moved from overseas to Nanki Kumano, there is still something mysterious to him – the faith of the local people. He sets out on a journey visiting waterfalls, stones, trees and islands around the area, and learns that these have been worshiped by the people for years and years. One day, he joins a local festival, and realizes the true faith of the area.

title: 大阪の24時間
description:
大阪は素晴らしい観光名所、文化、食べ物でいっぱいです。

この街の刺激的で活気に満ちたシーンは、世界中で知られています。しかし、大阪が知られる無限のアクションと興奮に加えて、訪問者が自然と一体になり、この壮大な都市の歴史を真に感じることができる場所もたくさんあります。

梅田、難波、道頓堀などの人気の観光地から、たこ焼きや寿司などの魅力的な食べ物まで、歴史と文化に富んだ多様な街を見て、発見してください。象徴的な大阪城から、街の通りにある無限のナイトクラブの電気的な活気まで - これが大阪です。

今すぐ私たちのチャンネルを登録して、大阪とその多くの魅力についてもっと知りましょう！

title: 24 hours in Osaka
description:
Osaka is jam-packed full of stellar tourist attractions, culture, and food. 

The city's exhilarating and lively scene, full of unbounded energy, is well known across the world. However, in addition to the endless action and excitement that Osaka has become known for, there are many places where visitors can be at one with nature and truly sense the history of this magnificent city.  

From some of the most popular destinations including Umeda, Namba, and Dotonbori, to irresistible food such as takoyaki (Octopus Dumplings) and sushi, watch and uncover a diverse city rich in history and culture. From the iconic Osaka Castle to the electric vivacity found in the boundless nightclubs in the city streets - this is Osaka.

Subscribe to our channel now and discover more about Osaka and its many wonders!


大阪の観光地や文化、食べ物などの魅力をグッと詰めた動画です。

大阪は刺激的でにぎやかな面が注目されがちですが、実は美しい自然や歴史を感じられる場所もたくさんあります。

梅田、難波、道頓堀をはじめとする人気エリア、たこ焼きや寿司などの食べ物、大阪城や万博公園からナイトクラブといった観光スポットなどを短くまとめているこの動画をぜひご覧ください。

title: TOKAMACHI SNOW FESTIVAL／十日町雪まつりプロモーションムービー
description:
TOKAMACHI SNOW FESTIVAL Web Site／十日町雪まつりホームページ
http://snowfes.jp/wp/

In Tokamachi such a heavy snowfall area, we have “Tokamachi Snow Festival” that started by a enthusiasm of local residents “delight to play with snow as a friend” .

It is a big event in midwinter light up Tokamachi with variety of events and entertainments such as “festival field” located everywhere in the city, artistic snow sculptures made by citizen’s hands, “Snow carnival” unfolded various performances in sequence on the magnificent snow stage, and etc.

豪雪地帯である十日町において、あえて「雪を友とし、雪を楽しむ」という地元住民の想いから生まれた『十日町雪まつり』。
市内のあちこちに設置された「おまつりひろば」でのイベントやおもてなし、市民の手による芸術性の高い雪像、そしてすべて雪で作られたステージで繰り広げられる「雪上カーニバル」など、真冬の十日町を彩る一大イベントです。

title: TOKAMACHI SNOW FESTIVAL / Tokamachi Snow Festival Promotional Movie
description:
TOKAMACHI SNOW FESTIVAL Web Site / Tokamachi Snow Festival Homepage
http://snowfes.jp/wp/

In Tokamachi, a heavy snowfall area, we have the "Tokamachi Snow Festival" that started from the enthusiasm of local residents who have a "delight to play with snow as a friend".

It is a big event in midwinter that lights up Tokamachi with a variety of events and entertainments such as "festival fields" located everywhere in the city, artistic snow sculptures made by citizens' hands, and the "Snow Carnival" that unfolds various performances in sequence on the magnificent snow stage, and more.

In the heavy snowfall area of Tokamachi, the "Tokamachi Snow Festival" was born from the local residents' desire to "make snow a friend and enjoy it". It is a major event that colors midwinter Tokamachi with events and hospitality at the "festival fields" set up throughout the city, highly artistic snow sculptures created by citizens, and the "Snow Carnival" that unfolds on a stage made entirely of snow.

第１回新潟ふるさとCM大賞　十日町市CM作品
description:
第１回新潟ふるさとCM大賞に応募した十日町市の作品「＃あちこたねーよ！」です。
太古の昔から脈々と受け継がれている十日町市の生活文化や里山の自然など、雪国の魅力を30秒にぎゅっと詰め込みました。

●新潟ふるさとCM大賞とは
新潟県内の各市町村が地元愛あふれるCMを制作し、地域の一体化醸成を図るとともに、県内外への発信を通じて地域の活性化に資することを目的に、UX新潟テレビ21・新潟県・新潟県市町村振興協会が主催で行う事業です。各市町村がエントリーしたCM作品は、令和２年11月19日(木)に審査会が行われました。

title: 1st Niigata Furusato CM Award - Tokamachi City CM Works
description:
This is the work from Tokamachi City titled "#Achikotaneyo!" submitted for the 1st Niigata Furusato CM Award.
We have packed the charm of the snow country, including the living culture and the natural beauty of the satoyama that have been passed down since ancient times, into a 30-second video.

● What is the Niigata Furusato CM Award?
This project is organized by UX Niigata Television 21, Niigata Prefecture, and the Niigata Prefecture Municipal Promotion Association, aiming to promote regional revitalization through the production of local love-filled commercials by each municipality in Niigata Prefecture, fostering community integration, and disseminating information both within and outside the prefecture. The judging for the CM works submitted by each municipality took place on November 19, 2020.

title: 願入集落 canvas 1 | 布施知子【越後妻有 この大地の里山は キャンバスになり 祭りがはじまる。】
description:
越後妻有 願入集落 canvas 1
越後妻有 この大地の里山は キャンバスになり 祭りがはじまる。

大地の芸術祭 作家　布施知子
新潟県十日町市 願入集落　小宮山マツノ
語り　山口ひかり（十日町市在住／十日町市立吉田中学校）

新潟県十日町市・津南町からなる越後妻有地域。2000年からこの地で始まった「大地の芸術祭」。
その祭りの舞台となるのは、その地域で生活を営む人々の暮らしと、四季を通じて豊かな大自然が織りなす様々な表情の大地。

この映像作品は、地域をキャンバスと捉え、そこで暮らす人々や自然・文化の魅力を再認識し、大地の芸術祭で訪れたアーティストが作品のインスピレーションとなる地域の魅力へ迫る、地域の暮らしが主役のドキュメンタリーです。

監督：分部康仁
クリエーティブディレクター：引地央行
企画・プロデュース：酒井隆光

【大地の芸術祭の里】
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/

【新潟県十日町市】
https://www.tokamachishikankou.jp/

▼大地の芸術祭
新潟県越後妻有地域を舞台に、地域に内在するさまざな価値を、アートを媒介として掘り起こし、その魅力を高めて世界に発信し、地域再生の道筋を築くことを目指す世界最大級の国際芸術祭。越後妻有は、縄文期からの豪雪という厳しい条件のなかで、米づくりをしてきた土地です。人々は、切り離すことができない人間と自然の関わり方を探りながら、濃密な集落を営んできました。そこから「人間は自然に内包される」という基本理念が生まれ、すべてのプログラムに貫かれています。人間と自然がどう関わっていくか――。その可能性を示すモデルになろうと、越後妻有の地域づくりは進められています。

▼布施知子「うぶすなの白」※公開終了
「うぶすなの家」に宿る精霊のようなものに対する敬意を、白い紙を折ることで表す。「風の茶室」「闇の茶室」には、一つが二つに分かれ、それがまた二つに分かれ、どんどん無限に分割していく「無限折り」を使った白い紙の作品を中心に展示。「風の茶室」には、螺旋状の雫のような折りの作品も吊るす。「光の茶室」には、色を使った折り紙の「入れ物（箱）」を並べ、人間の営みを表現する。
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/art/artwork/ubusuna-house/

▼うぶすなの家
築100年を迎える茅葺き屋根の古民家に、陶芸家たちが囲炉裏・かまど・風呂・洗面所をしつらえ、「やきもの」の美術館として再生した。１階はレストランとして、地元の食材を使った慈悲深い料理をにぎやかな女衆が提供する。2階は3つの茶室に新作が展開される。
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/art/artwork/ubusuna_house/

【My trip TOKAMACHI 新潟県十日町市】
https://www.tokamachishikankou.jp/
十日町市にはアート、自然、グルメなどの見どころが満載です。
アート作品と出会ってじっくり思考を巡らせたり、大自然が織りなす造形美に心を癒されたり…ここでしか味わえないグルメや温泉もあります。
たくさんのスポットの中から、おすすめのコースを巡ったり、行きたい場所だけをぎゅっと集めて自分だけの旅をつくることもできます。
十日町市で「私だけの旅」を楽しもう。

【Snow Rich.Tokamachi! 日本遺産「究極の雪国 とおかまち　-真説！豪雪地ものがたり」】
https://www.city.tokamachi.lg.jp/yukiguni/nihonisan/index.html
地域の歴史的魅力や特色を通じて日本の文化・伝統を語るストーリーを「日本遺産（Japan Heritage）」として文化庁が認定しています。ストーリーを語る上で欠かせない魅力溢れる有形・無形の様々な文化財群を総合的に整備・活用し、国内外へも戦略的に発信していくことにより、地域の活性化を図ることを目的としています。令和2年(2020)に十日町市のストーリー「究極の雪国とおかまち ―真説！豪雪地ものがたり―」が「日本遺産」に認定されました。

【I’m home! Tokamachi　移住・定住サイト】
https://www.city.tokamachi.lg.jp/iju/index.html
十日町市移住コンシェルジュでは、移住検討中または移住して約1年の方を対象にオンライン相談を実施しています。支援制度の紹介、しごとや住まい、子育て環境や不安事の相談など一貫してサポートします。

title: Negaiiri Settlement Canvas 1 | Tomoko Fuse [Echigo-Tsumari, This Land's Satoyama Becomes a Canvas and the Festival Begins.]
description:
Echigo-Tsumari Negaiiri Settlement Canvas 1
Echigo-Tsumari, This Land's Satoyama Becomes a Canvas and the Festival Begins.

Art Festival of the Earth Artist: Tomoko Fuse
Negaiiri Settlement, Tokamachi City, Niigata Prefecture, Matsuno Komiyama
Narration: Hikari Yamaguchi (Resident of Tokamachi City / Tokamachi City Yoshida Junior High School)

The Echigo-Tsumari region, consisting of Tokamachi City and Tsunan Town in Niigata Prefecture. The "Art Festival of the Earth" began in this area in 2000.
The stage for this festival is the lives of the people who live in the region and the various expressions of the rich nature that unfolds throughout the seasons.

This video work captures the region as a canvas, re-recognizing the charm of the people, nature, and culture that live there, and approaches the allure of the region that inspires the artists who visit during the Art Festival of the Earth, making the local life the main focus of the documentary.

Director: Yasuhito Bunbe
Creative Director: Hiroyuki Hikichi
Planning and Production: Takamitsu Sakai

【Art Festival of the Earth】
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/

【Tokamachi City, Niigata Prefecture】
https://www.tokamachishikankou.jp/

▼ Art Festival of the Earth
Aiming to excavate various inherent values of the region through art as a medium, enhance its charm, and communicate it to the world, this is one of the largest international art festivals in the world. Echigo-Tsumari is a land that has cultivated rice under harsh conditions of heavy snowfall since the Jomon period. People have built dense communities while exploring the inseparable relationship between humans and nature. From this, the fundamental philosophy that "humans are encompassed by nature" was born, which permeates all programs. How humans and nature interact—Echigo-Tsumari's community development is progressing to become a model that shows this possibility.

▼ Tomoko Fuse "Ubusuna no Shiro" *Closed to the public
Expressing respect for the spirit residing in "Ubusuna no Ie" by folding white paper. In the "Wind Tea Room" and "Dark Tea Room," a central exhibition features white paper works using "infinite folding," where one piece splits into two, and then splits again, endlessly dividing. In the "Wind Tea Room," works resembling spiral droplets are also suspended. In the "Light Tea Room," origami "containers (boxes)" using colors are arranged to express human activities.
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/art/artwork/ubusuna-house/

▼ Ubusuna no Ie
A 100-year-old thatched-roof farmhouse has been transformed into a museum of ceramics, with potters setting up an irori (hearth), stove, bath, and washroom. The first floor serves as a restaurant where lively women serve compassionate dishes made with local ingredients. The second floor features new works displayed in three tea rooms.
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/art/artwork/ubusuna_house/

【My trip TOKAMACHI, Tokamachi City, Niigata Prefecture】
https://www.tokamachishikankou.jp/
Tokamachi City is full of attractions such as art, nature, and gourmet food.
You can encounter art works and ponder deeply, or be healed by the sculptural beauty created by nature... There are also gourmet foods and hot springs that can only be experienced here.
You can explore recommended courses from many spots or create your own unique trip by gathering only the places you want to visit.
Enjoy "My Own Trip" in Tokamachi City.

【Snow Rich.Tokamachi! Japan Heritage "The Ultimate Snow Country, Tokamachi - True Story! The Tale of Heavy Snow Country"】
https://www.city.tokamachi.lg.jp/yukiguni/nihonisan/index.html
The story that conveys Japan's culture and traditions through the region's historical charm and characteristics has been certified as "Japan Heritage" by the Agency for Cultural Affairs. By comprehensively organizing and utilizing various tangible and intangible cultural properties that are essential for telling the story, the aim is to revitalize the region by strategically communicating it both domestically and internationally. In 2020, the story of Tokamachi City, "The Ultimate Snow Country, Tokamachi - True Story! The Tale of Heavy Snow Country," was certified as "Japan Heritage."

【I’m home! Tokamachi Migration and Settlement Site】
https://www.city.tokamachi.lg.jp/iju/index.html
The Tokamachi City Migration Concierge offers online consultations for those considering migration or who have migrated within the past year. We provide consistent support, including introductions to support systems, consultations on work, housing, child-rearing environments, and concerns.

title: 【360°VR 全方位檢視】北山川觀光木筏漂流
description:
【HMD觀看年齡限制：10歲以上】即使使用一般螢幕，也可操作360度視角觀看。

感受飛濺的水花、壯麗的北山峽谷岩壁，以及經驗豐富的筏師以傳統技術操控木筏的震撼場面！

透過沉浸式VR，體驗日本唯一的原木木筏漂流──北山川觀光木筏漂流，彷彿親自乘坐在筏上馳騁於激流之中。

這項珍貴的北山村木筏文化備受國內外高度評價，與壯麗的吉野熊野國立公園自然景觀相結合，邀請您一同欣賞與體驗。

title: [360° VR All-Around View] Kitayama River Sightseeing Rafting
description:
[HMD Viewing Age Limit: 10 Years and Older] Even with a regular screen, you can operate and view in 360 degrees.

Feel the splashing water, the magnificent cliffs of the Kitayama Gorge, and the stunning scenes of experienced rafters skillfully maneuvering the raft using traditional techniques!

Through immersive VR, experience Japan's only log rafting—Kitayama River Sightseeing Rafting, as if you are personally riding on the raft, racing through the rapids.

This precious Kitayama Village rafting culture is highly regarded both domestically and internationally, combined with the magnificent natural scenery of Yoshino Kumano National Park, inviting you to appreciate and experience it together.

description:
【HMD觀看年齡限制：10歲以上】即使使用一般螢幕，也可操作360度視角觀看。

位於紀伊半島深山之中的北山村，是日本唯一的飛地村落，一座小巧卻充滿驚喜的隱藏版秘境。

在這裡，你可以體驗刺激的北山川觀光木筏漂流，乘坐傳統原木筏順流而下。此外，北山村也是珍稀柑橘**「じゃばら」(邪払)**的原產地，並擁有與世隔絕的壯麗自然景觀。

title: [360°VR All-Around View] Kitayama Village VR Video
description:
[HMD Viewing Age Restriction: 10 years and older] You can also operate the 360-degree perspective viewing even with a regular screen.

Located deep in the mountains of the Kii Peninsula, Kitayama Village is Japan's only exclave village, a small yet surprising hidden gem.

Here, you can experience the thrilling Kitayama River sightseeing rafting, riding down the river on traditional wooden rafts. In addition, Kitayama Village is the birthplace of the rare citrus fruit **'Jabara' (邪払)** and boasts magnificent natural scenery that feels isolated from the world.

Through immersive VR, let yourself indulge in the tranquil beauty of Japan's mountains and feel the moments when your soul is gently healed by nature.

title: こんな田舎なのに魅力たっぷりえびの市。知らなかった人損してますよ。
description:
こんにちは！宮崎県えびの市観光商工課ＰＲ担当のみなほです。
皆さんえびの市を知っていますか？
ポテンシャルは高いのに中々知名度が上がらないこの町。
観光地や綺麗な景色、特産品もあるのに知ってもらえないこの町。
そんなポテンシャル満載の魅力たっぷりなこの町をもっと色んな人に知ってもらいたい、従来の情報発信だけでは伝わらないこのご時世。
そこで、みなほ、動画配信始めます。

新型コロナウイルス感染症によりアウトドア人気が高まった時、えびの高原にある「えびの高原キャンプ村」が大盛り上がりしたのは地元の人しか知らない…。

今回の動画で紹介するえびの高原はキャンプやトレッキングするには最適の場所。
えびの高原の四季折々の景色に囲まれて体験するアウトドアアクティビティは非日常感にあふれていて、仕事や私生活のストレスを発散するには最高のデトックス効果抜群の場所です！

この動画を見て少しでも魅力を感じたそこのあなた！

えびの市は皆さんを迎える準備はいつでも出来ていますよ！

是非、えびの市へおじゃったもんせ（お越しください）~！

title: 平湯大滝  冬　氷の世界　Hida Hirayu waterfall in winter      岐阜県 高山市 奥飛騨温泉郷
description:
岐阜県高山市奥飛騨温泉郷にある落差64メートル、幅6メートルの平湯大滝は飛騨三大名瀑のひとつで、日本の滝百選にも選定されている「平湯大滝」巨大な滝の流れはこの冬の時期と共に氷結しまるで行く手を阻むかの如く氷の柱と姿を変えます。自然の力がなす氷の彫刻をどうぞ、ご堪能ください。

Hirayu Otaki, located in Okuhida Onsengo, Takayama City, Gifu Prefecture, has a height of 64 meters and a width of 6 meters. With the winter season, it freezes and transforms into a pillar of ice as if it were blocking the way. Please enjoy the ice sculpture created by the power of nature.

title: Hida Hirayu waterfall in winter
description: Hirayu Otaki, located in Okuhida Onsengo, Takayama City, Gifu Prefecture, has a height of 64 meters and a width of 6 meters. It is one of the three great waterfalls of Hida and has been selected as one of Japan's top 100 waterfalls. During the winter season, the massive flow of the waterfall freezes, transforming into pillars of ice as if blocking the way. Please enjoy the ice sculpture created by the power of nature.

title: 熊野神社 伊邪那美(イザナミ)の道 - KUMANO Shrine The road of IZANAMI
description:
広島県庄原市、熊野神社。旧比婆大社。創建年は不詳。比婆山山麓に位置するこの場所は日本最古とされる歴史書『古事記』の伝承を現代に伝える場所です。
神々の母伊邪那美命(イザナミノミコト)は、立烏帽子山に伊邪那岐(イザナギノミコト)が訪ねてきた際、夜になったので自分の櫛に火をつけて灯りとして、この山道を歩き、天から火の雨が降り注いだ際に途中の岩穴に身を隠し難を逃れたという逸話が残されています。
また、後に火の神を産んだ伊邪那美は、この道の岩穴で亡くなり、黄泉の国に旅立ったとも伝えられています。

Kumano Shrine, Shobara City, Hiroshima Prefecture.  Former Hiba Ohyashiro Shrine.  The year of foundation is unknown.  Located at the foot of Mt. Hiba, this place is a place to convey the tradition of Japan's history book said that oldest history book "Kojiki" to the present day.
 The mother of the gods, Izanami Nomikoto When Izanagi Nomikoto visited her, Mt. Tateeboshi, It's night, so she lit her comb and used it as a light. There is an anecdote that she hid herself in a rock hole on the way and escaped the difficulty when it rained on fire from the sky.
 It is also reported that Izanami, who later gave birth to the god of fire, died in a rock hole on this road, and she left for heaven.

title: 山陰海岸 - Sanin(mountain’s yin) Coast
description:
日本の中国地方では古くから中国山地の北を山陰、南を山陽と呼んできました。

地名をつけるとき、山の北と南を陰と陽、川の北と南を陽と陰で表現することは古代中国の考えに基づいています。

これは、南天に太陽が昇る北半球では、山の北が影になり、南が太陽に当たるからです。

 川の場合、洛陽（洛水と呼ばれる川の北の地域）と淮陰（淮水と呼ばれる川の南）のように川の北と南で陰陽と表現する土地が中国にあります。

川の場合では、南から指した光が川面に跳ね返り、川の北を照らし、南の物体が川面に影を落とすことから、そう呼ばれるようになりました。

中国山地を挟んで北側の山陰地方の海岸は日本海に面しています。
大陸から吹く風により発生する日本海の荒波により形成された山陰の海岸の風光明媚な景観をお楽しみ下さい。

In the Chugoku region of Japan, the north of the Chugoku Mountains has been called Sanin(mountain’s yin) and the south has been called Sanyo(mountain’s yang) for a long time.

When naming a place, it is based on the idea of ​​ancient China that the north and south of the mountain are represented by yin and yang, and the north and south of the river are represented by yang and yin.

This is because in the northern hemisphere, where the sun rises in the southern sky, the north of the mountain is in the shadow and the south is in the sun.

In the case of rivers, there are lands in China that are described as Yinyang in the north and south of the river, such as Rakuyo (the area north of the river called Luoyang) and Huaiyin (south of the river called Huai’an).

In the case of rivers, the light from the south bounces off the surface of the river, illuminating the north of the river, and objects in the south cast shadows on the surface of the river.

The coast of the San'in(mountain’s yin) region on the north side of the Chugoku Mountains faces the Sea of ​​Japan.
 Enjoy the scenic landscape of the San'in coast formed by the rough waves of the Sea of ​​Japan generated by the wind blowing from the continent.

description:
御祭神は古代豪族 物部氏 初代
宇摩志麻遅命(うましまじのみこと)。
宇摩志麻遅命は邇芸速日命(にぎはやひのみこと)の子にあたられ、
神武天皇の東征の際、長髄彦(ながすねひこ)を討ち、後に物部氏を
率いて皇城守護の任に就いたとされています。
創建から数えて1500年以上の歴史があり、ご本殿は
出雲大社に次ぐ二番目の大きさで、春日造りの巨大神
殿となっています。
御神紋 『ひおい鶴』は
宇摩志麻遅命が鶴に乗って降臨されたという故事に基づいた
御神紋で、日本唯一の御神紋と言われています。

Ancient powerful family - Mononobe clan Founder
Umashimaji no Mikoto.
Umashimaji no Mikoto is a child of Nigihayahi no Mikoto,
it is said that during the eastern expedition of Emperor Jimmu, 
he defeated Nagasunehiko and later led 
Mononobe clan to protect the imperial castle.
It has a history of more than 1500 years since its foundation,
The main shrinen is the second largest shrine after Izumo Taisha.
Shrine Crest "Hioi Crane"
 is a sacred crest based on the fact that Umashimaji no Mikoto
was descended on a crane, and is said the only Shrine crest in Japan.

title: 東京 赤坂 氷川神社 - TOKYO AKASAKA HIKAWA Shrine
description:
鎮座から千年を数える赤坂氷川神社。御祭神は
素戔嗚尊(スサノオノミコト)、奇稲田姫命(クシナダヒメノミコト)、大国主命(オオクニヌシノミコト)。
かつて、奇稲田姫命は八岐大蛇(ヤマタノオロチ)の生贄になっていたところを素戔嗚尊によって助け出さ
れ、後に素戔嗚尊の妻となりました。大国主命は、お二人の御子孫にあたられ、国造の神様として出雲大社
の主祭神でもあられます。

ヤマタノオロチ退治の舞台となった出雲国の簸川(ひかわ)が由来とされ、951年に東国遊行中だった蓮
林僧正が現在の赤坂4丁目で一夜を過ごした際に夢中でお告げを受け、この地にお祀りしたしことに始まり
ます。

その後、江戸幕府第八代将軍、徳川吉宗によって建立された御社殿はかつての震災、戦災を免れ、鳥居、
狛犬、灯籠に建立当時の面影を現在に伝えます。

Akasaka Hikawa Shrine, which counts a thousand years since its enshrined.

 : Susano-no-mikoto, Kushinadahime-no-mikoto, Okuninushi-no-mikoto

 In the past, Kushinadahime-no-mikoto was rescued by Susano-no-mikoto from the sacrifice of Yamata-
no-Orochi, and later became the wife of Susano-no-mikoto. Okuninushi is the descendant of couple, 
and is also the main deity of Izumo Taisha as a national creation god.

 It is said to have originated from Hikawa in Izumo Province, which was the stage for exterminating 
Yamata-no-Orochi. It begins when a monk who was traveling to Togoku in 951, in his drem, responce to 
the announcement from the deity when he spent the night at the present Akasaka 4th street and 
worshiped here.


 After that, the shrine built by Yoshimune Tokugawa, the eighth shogun of the Edo Shogunate, escaped
the former earthquake and war damage, and conveys the remnants of the time when it was built to the
 torii gate, guardian dog, and lantern.

title: TOKYO AKASAKA HIKAWA Shrine
description:
Akasaka Hikawa Shrine, which counts a thousand years since its enshrined.

Deity
: Susano-no-mikoto, Kushinadahime-no-mikoto, Okuninushi-no-mikoto

In the past, Kushinadahime-no-mikoto was rescued by Susano-no-mikoto from the sacrifice of Yamata-no-Orochi, and later became the wife of Susano-no-mikoto. Okuninushi is the descendant of couple, and is also the main deity of Izumo Taisha as a national creation god.

It is said to have originated from Hikawa in Izumo Province, which was the stage for exterminating Yamata-no-Orochi. It begins when a monk who was traveling to Togoku in 951, in his dream, responded to the announcement from the deity when he spent the night at the present Akasaka 4th street and worshiped here.

After that, the shrine built by Yoshimune Tokugawa, the eighth shogun of the Edo Shogunate, escaped the former earthquake and war damage, and conveys the remnants of the time when it was built to the torii gate, guardian dog, and lantern.

title: ココロに響く、岡山アートトリップ【full ver.】
description:
岡山県北・奈義町は、今注目のアートエリア。体感型現代美術館の先駈け「NagiMOCA」
はもちろん、秀峰・那岐山をはじめ、自然が生み出す景観そのものがアート。大自然の中で心を解放して向き合えば、五感を刺激する出会いがそこに。さぁ、次の旅は岡山へ。

【“映える美術館”が全国区で話題！ 奈義町アートトリップ】
来館者がSNSに投稿した写真が“映える！”と話題になり、全国区で注目を集めている「奈義町現代美術館（Nagi MOCA）」。まちのシンボルでもあるこの美術館を旅の目的地にして訪れる人が、今増えています。今回は、せっかく奈義町に行くならぜひとも立ち寄りたい、カフェ併設のギャラリーや企画展も行われる観光案内所など、アート要素を持ったスポットも一緒にご紹介。さぁ、アートな旅を楽しみに奈義町へトリップ！
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/okatabi/812/page


【奈義町現代美術館（NagiMOCA）】 
プリツカー賞受賞の建築家・磯崎新氏が手掛けた美術館。秀峰・那岐山を借景に、3組のアーティストの巨大作品＝空間を美術館として建築化しています。「太陽」、「月」、「大地」と名付けられた３つの展示室で構成されており、作品と建物が半永久的に一体化した公共建物としては世界初のもの。円筒形の展示室「太陽」内部は、写真映えするスポットしても人気です。
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11826

【PIZZERIA La gita】 
「奈義町現代美術館」と那岐山を望むピッツェリア。本場ナポリから取り寄せた石窯で焼き上げる、本格的なピッツァが堪能できます。 
https://pizza-lagita.com/

【cafe calme】
奈義町にあるレンタルギャラリー「gallery FIXA」に併設したカフェ。シンプルな空間で、コーヒーや焼き菓子など楽しめます。テイクアウトも可能。
https://www.gallery-fixa.com/

【屋敷の滝】
周囲を原生林に囲まれた、高さ40ｍの滝。戦国武将・延原弾正の屋敷跡があったというところから「屋敷の滝」と呼ばれています。
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11812

【菩提寺の大イチョウ】
浄土宗の開祖・法然上人が幼年時代に修行した寺として知られる「菩提寺」の境内にそびえる、推定樹齢900年を超えるイチョウの樹です。樹高約45ｍ、目通り周囲約12ｍの木は県下一の大樹で、国の天然記念物に指定されています。
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11832

title: A Heartfelt Art Trip in Okayama【full ver.】
description:
Nagi Town in northern Okayama Prefecture is an emerging art area. The pioneering experiential contemporary art museum "NagiMOCA" is just the beginning; the stunning views created by nature, including the majestic Mt. Nagi, are art in themselves. When you open your heart to the great outdoors, encounters that stimulate your five senses await. So, let’s make Okayama your next travel destination.

【“Instagrammable Museum” Gaining National Attention! Nagi Town Art Trip】
Photos posted by visitors on social media have become a hot topic for being "Instagrammable!" and have drawn national attention to the "Nagi Town Contemporary Art Museum (Nagi MOCA)." More and more people are choosing this museum, a symbol of the town, as their travel destination. This time, we will also introduce art-related spots such as a gallery with a café and a tourist information center that hosts special exhibitions, which you should definitely visit while in Nagi Town. Get ready for an art-filled trip to Nagi Town!
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/okatabi/812/page

【Nagi Town Contemporary Art Museum (NagiMOCA)】
Designed by Pritzker Prize-winning architect Arata Isozaki, this museum features the majestic Mt. Nagi as a backdrop and incorporates the large works of three artists into its architecture. It consists of three exhibition rooms named "Sun," "Moon," and "Earth," and is the world's first public building where the artworks and the structure are permanently integrated. The cylindrical exhibition room "Sun" is also popular as a photo spot.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11826

【PIZZERIA La gita】
A pizzeria overlooking the Nagi Mountain and the "Nagi Town Contemporary Art Museum." Enjoy authentic pizza baked in a stone oven imported from Naples.
https://pizza-lagita.com/

【cafe calme】
A café attached to the rental gallery "gallery FIXA" in Nagi Town. Enjoy coffee and baked goods in a simple space. Takeout is also available.
https://www.gallery-fixa.com/

【Yashiki no Taki (Yashiki Waterfall)】
A 40-meter tall waterfall surrounded by virgin forest. It is called "Yashiki no Taki" because it is said to be the site of the residence of the Sengoku warlord, Nobuhara Danjo.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11812

【Great Ginkgo Tree at Bodai-ji Temple】
This ginkgo tree, estimated to be over 900 years old, towers over the grounds of "Bodai-ji Temple," known as the place where the founder of the Jodo sect, Honen, trained in his youth. The tree stands about 45 meters tall with a circumference of about 12 meters, making it the largest tree in the prefecture and designated as a national natural monument.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11832

title: 【津山まなびの鉄道館】こどもたちも大喜び！まなびと発見がいっぱいの鉄道館（岡山県津山市）
description:
【こどもたちも大喜び！鉄道ファンも必見！懐かしい車両を多数展示】
津山まなびの鉄道館は、旧津山扇形機関車庫として車両、転車台、蒸気機関車の動輪など展示するスペースと、岡山の鉄道の歴史や、鉄道のしくみを体験しながら学べるスペース、さらに、津山の街並みをジオラマ展示したスペースで構成されています。
1936年に建設された旧津山扇形機関車庫は現存するものでは国内2番目の規模を誇る貴重な施設です。国内で1台のみ製造された大馬力のエンジンを積んだディーゼル機関車「DE50-1」が保存されています。
家族で訪れれば、こどもたちも大喜び！開館日の12時と15時に汽笛の吹鳴は迫力満点！
鉄道や機関車に興味がある人も必見のスポットです！

title: Tsuyama Manabi no Tetsudoukan: A Delight for Children! A Railway Museum Full of Learning and Discovery (Tsuyama City, Okayama Prefecture)
description:
A Delight for Children! A Must-See for Railway Fans! A Large Collection of Nostalgic Vehicles on Display
Tsuyama Manabi no Tetsudoukan is composed of a space displaying vehicles, a turntable, and the driving wheels of steam locomotives, which were part of the former Tsuyama Roundhouse, as well as a space where visitors can learn about the history of Okayama's railways and experience the workings of trains. Additionally, there is a diorama display of the streets of Tsuyama.
The former Tsuyama Roundhouse, built in 1936, is a valuable facility that boasts the second largest scale in Japan among existing ones. It houses the diesel locomotive "DE50-1," which is equipped with a powerful engine that was manufactured only once in the country.
If you visit with your family, the children will be thrilled! The sound of the whistle at 12:00 and 15:00 on opening days is truly impressive!
This is a must-visit spot for anyone interested in railways and locomotives!

The Shizutani School
Japan's oldest existing school for the common people.  It is famous for its auditorium, which is designated as a national treasure and the roof of which is tiled with Bizen ceramics, and the beautiful autumn colours of its nearby Chinese Pistache Tree.

description:
「晴れの国」と呼ばれる岡山県は、晴天率の高さに加え大気が安定しているため、星の光の揺らぎが少なく、天体観測に適していると言われています。なかでも天文施設やキャンプ場など、夜に訪れたい人気スポットが集まっている「備中エリア」。美しく光る満天の星と宙（そら）を眺めながら、備中エリアを巡ってみませんか。

title: Bichu: A Journey Through Stars and the Sky in Okayama Prefecture ☆彡
description:
Okayama Prefecture, known as the 'Land of Sunshine,' is said to be suitable for stargazing due to its high rate of clear weather and stable atmosphere, which results in minimal twinkling of stars. Among these, the 'Bichu Area' is home to popular spots like astronomical facilities and campgrounds that are perfect for night visits. Why not explore the Bichu Area while gazing at the beautifully shining stars and sky?

title: Okayama 岡山｜JAPAN - Kitagi-shima island! -
description:
Let’s go cycling around a Japan Heritage, Kitagi-shima Island, also known as “Stone Island” to experience thrilling lookout and stunning rock views. 
It is a one-hour ferry ride to the island while looking out to the beautiful Seto Inland Sea. You can fully enjoy the island even in a day trip. It offers a plenty of attractive spots such as sceneries reminding of Guilin or Venice, and spectacular quarry sites! 

9:25 Board  ferry departing from Fushigoe-ko Port, Kasaoka 
Single ticket: JPY 550/person 
　　↓
10:28 Arrival at Toyoura-ko Port, Kitagishima (Kitagi Island) 　
　　↓Rent a bike at K’s LABO, JPY 800 each for 3-8 hour use 
Highlight: Photo spot 
　　↓20 minutes on the rented bike 
Lunch: Ramen noodle at “Minatoya” restaurant 
Highlight: Enjoy an exclusive Ramen with “Kamenote” broth! The restaurant serves Ramen using that the stock is taken with “Kamenote” , a kind of or Japanese goose barnacle (scientific name: Capitulum mitella) for the broth. The unique name “kamenote” comes from its similarity with turtles’ paws (Japanese names for: turtle=Kame and, paw=Te). 
　　↓20 minutes on the rented bike
Visit to Hikari Cinema, a former movie theater
　　↓1 minute on the rented bike
Ishikiri no Tani (Stonecutting Valley) viewpoint
Admission fee: JPY 1,000/person（Hours: 12:00-13:00 on weekdays and 11:00-13:00 on Saturday, Sunday and public holidays)
　　↓5 minutes on the rented bike
“Venice” of the Kitagi 
Highlight: Photo spot
　　↓
“Guilin” of the Kitagi 
Highlight: Photo spot
　　↓
Return bikes to K’s LABO and have a break at the café 
Highlight: Ocean view café 
　　↓5 minute walk 
“Möbius strip” stone sculpture
Highlight: Photo spot
　　↓5 minute walk
16:26 Board ferry departing from Toyoura-ko Port, Kitagishima (Kitagi Island) 
Single ticket: JPY 550/ person
　　↓
17:26 Arrival at Fushigoe-ko Port, Kasaoka

title: Hokkaido’s Niagara Falls
description:
北海道にあるナイアガラの滝（伊達市大滝区）と言われるこの滝は、大滝総合運動公園から、長流川沿いの森林を歩く約６㎞のトレイルコ
ースニアル。落差３ｍ、幅３０ｍの大滝ナイアガラの滝や徳舜瞥山の眺望が楽しめる。

title: Hokkaido’s Niagara Falls
description: This waterfall, known as Niagara Falls in Hokkaido (in the Otaki area of Date City), is accessible via a trail course of about 6 km along the Nagauru River through the forest from the Otaki General Sports Park. You can enjoy the view of the 3-meter drop and 30-meter width of the Otaki Niagara Falls, as well as the scenery of Mount Tokushunbetsu.

title: Active Volcano Walk  - Summit of Mt.Usu -
description:
活火山を歩く。
有珠山外輪山からは、火口原内部にそびえる小有珠、大有珠、オガリ山、有珠新山などの溶岩ドームが見える。

Active Volcano Walk (Summit of Mt. Usu)
A walk around the out rim of Mt. Usu grants a view of Mt. Ko-usu towering out of the crater, and the surrounding volcanic formations such as Mt. Ogari, Mt. Ō-usu and the Usushinzan lava dome.

title: Active Volcano Walk - Summit of Mt. Usu -
description:
A walk around the active volcano.
From the outer rim of Mt. Usu, you can see the lava domes of Ko-usu, Ō-usu, Mt. Ogari, and Usushinzan towering within the crater.

title: The Scar Left Behind (金比羅火口災害遺構散策路)
description:
金比羅火口災害遺構散策路では、2000年噴火で形成された火口や、熱泥流などの災害で被災した施設など、学びの場として災害遺構を見学することができます。

是非、ご覧いただければと思います。

CORRECTION: The trail was destroyed by a mudslide, not by lava.

title: The Scar Left Behind (金比羅火口災害遺構散策路)
description:
At the Konpira Crater Disaster Ruins Trail, you can visit disaster ruins as a place of learning, including the crater formed by the eruption in 2000 and facilities affected by disasters such as hot mud flows.

We hope you will take a look.

CORRECTION: The trail was destroyed by a mudslide, not by lava.

title: Hokkaido fisherman in spring
description:
北海道の内浦湾にある洞爺湖町では、ホタテの養殖が盛んだ。
ユネスコの世界遺産にも登録されているこの地域は、100年の間に４度も噴火を繰り返す「有珠山」や、噴火によって形成されたカルデラ湖「洞爺湖」があり、その噴火によって降り注ぐ火山灰はやがて豊富な土壌となり、川からはミネラル豊富な水が海に注がれる。
そんな美しい海で育ったホタテの味は絶品である。

特に春は、「耳づり」と言われる独特な養殖方法に多くの人手が必要なため、小さな漁業町は活気づく季節である。

title: Hokkaido fisherman in spring
description:
In Toyako Town, located in Uchiura Bay, Hokkaido, scallop farming is thriving.
This region, which is registered as a UNESCO World Heritage site, features Mount Usu, which has erupted four times over the past 100 years, and Lake Toya, a caldera lake formed by volcanic eruptions. The volcanic ash that falls from these eruptions eventually becomes rich soil, and mineral-rich water flows from the rivers into the sea.
The taste of scallops raised in such beautiful waters is exquisite.

Especially in spring, the unique farming method known as 'mimizuri' requires a lot of manpower, making this small fishing town a bustling place during the season.

title: 埼玉県熊谷市グルメCMシリーズ『雪くま編』
description:
埼玉県熊谷市グルメCMシリーズ『雪くま編』です。

荒川が関東平野に流れ込む扇状地に広がる熊谷市は、伏流水による美味しい地下水が豊富で、その美味しい熊谷の水をつかった氷を、ふわふわに仕上げたかき氷が『雪くま』です。
日本一の夏の暑さが、かき氷をさらに美味しくしてくれます。

title: Kumagaya City Gourmet CM Series 'Yuki Kuma Edition'
description:
This is the Kumagaya City Gourmet CM Series 'Yuki Kuma Edition'.

Kumagaya City, which spreads across the fan-shaped alluvial plain where the Arakawa River flows into the Kanto Plain, is rich in delicious underground water from spring water. The fluffy shaved ice made with this delicious Kumagaya water is called 'Yuki Kuma'.
The hottest summer in Japan makes the shaved ice even more delicious.

title: 祝 佐渡金山世界遺産登録！「黄金KAIDO」でお得な旅を／佐渡・新潟
description:
【黄金KAIDOとは……】
徳川直轄の金山であった「佐渡金山」（新潟県）と「土肥金山」（静岡県）は、家康公が開発に注力した金山であり、発掘された金は、江戸や大御所となった家康公が過ごした駿府に運ばれておりました。
長野県、山梨県にも金山があったことから、佐渡～土肥を結ぶ金を運んだ道を「黄金KAIDO」と命名いたしました。

【お得なドライブプラン】
黄金KAIDOエリアの高速道路がお得になるドライブプランを販売中

 【詳しくは公式webをチェック】
https://gold-road.jp/

title: Celebrate the Registration of Sado Mine as a World Heritage Site! Enjoy a Great Trip on the 'Golden KAIDO' / Sado, Niigata
description:
[What is Golden KAIDO...]
The 'Sado Mine' (Niigata Prefecture) and 'Doi Mine' (Shizuoka Prefecture) were gold mines directly controlled by Tokugawa, and they were the mines that Tokugawa Ieyasu focused on developing. The gold that was excavated was transported to Edo and to Sunpu, where Ieyasu spent his time as a shogun.
Since there were also gold mines in Nagano and Yamanashi Prefectures, we named the road that transported gold connecting Sado and Doi as 'Golden KAIDO'.

[Great Driving Plan]
We are currently offering a driving plan that makes the highways in the Golden KAIDO area more affordable.

[For more details, check the official website]
https://gold-road.jp/

description:
ツアー公式HP
https://anytimeainutime.jp/

日本の先住民族「アイヌ」。
阿寒湖のほとりに今も息づく彼らの文化を、現代に生きるみなさまに。

古くからアイヌと和人とが協働してきた阿寒湖のアイヌ文化は、
他の地域にはない特色を持っています。
北海道最大規模のアイヌコタン（集落）があり、工芸品販売や歌、踊りなどの
文化が脈々と受け継がれている地域が阿寒湖なのです。

title: Ainu Cultural Guide Tour at Lake Akan, Hokkaido "Embroidery Time" ~ Anytime Ainutaimu - A Journey at Lake Akan Spending Time with the Ainu ~
description:
Official tour website
https://anytimeainutime.jp/

Japan's indigenous people, the Ainu.
Their culture, which still thrives by the shores of Lake Akan, is for everyone living in the modern world.

The Ainu culture at Lake Akan, where the Ainu and the Wajin have collaborated for a long time, has unique characteristics not found in other regions.
Lake Akan is home to the largest Ainu village in Hokkaido, where crafts, songs, dances, and other cultural traditions are continuously passed down.

瑞泉寺は、天正9年・宝暦12年・明治12年と三度大きな火災にあって（伽藍）建物が焼失しましたが、そのたびに地域の方々の想いとともに再建されてきました。その際、京都本山のお抱え大工らが直接の再建と指導のために派遣され、井波の大工らに卓越した技術を伝えたといわれております。現在まで連綿と続く伝統工芸の井波彫刻は、京都の優れた伝統的な寺院建築や寺院彫刻に学んだ技術と、瑞泉寺再建などで培ってきた井波大工の技術との調和・融合によって生み出されたと考えられます。このことから、井波別院瑞泉寺は井波彫刻発祥の地ともいわれております。

○Address: 3050 Inami, Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture 932-0211
○Phone Number: 0763-82-0004
○URL: https://inamibetuin-zuisen-ji.amebaownd.com/

○Overview
Zuisen-ji has suffered three major fires in the years Tensho 9, Hōreki 12, and Meiji 12, resulting in the loss of its (garan) buildings. However, it has been rebuilt each time with the support and wishes of the local community. During these reconstructions, master carpenters from the main temple in Kyoto were dispatched for direct rebuilding and guidance, passing on their exceptional skills to the carpenters of Inami. The traditional craft of Inami carving, which has continued to this day, is believed to have been created through the harmony and fusion of techniques learned from Kyoto's excellent traditional temple architecture and sculpture, along with the skills developed by Inami carpenters during the reconstruction of Zuisen-ji. For this reason, Inami Betsuin Zuisen-ji is also said to be the birthplace of Inami carving.

*Source: Inami Betsuin Zuisen-ji Official Website

title: Zuisenji temple Night Museum ＜Toyama, Nanto＞
description:
Nanto City, Inami is renowned as one of the best wood carving towns in Japan and has been recognized as a 'Japanese Heritage'.
Even now, about 200 artisans continue the carving techniques passed down since the mid-Edo period.
At the center of Inami, the Inami Betsuin Zuisenji temple is often referred to as a 'museum of wood carving', adorned with intricate sculptures throughout.
In this plan, the wood carvings within the temple are illuminated, creating shadows that allow you to appreciate the meticulousness of the sculptures more than during the day.
Additionally, an Inami woodcarver will provide explanations, deepening your understanding of the techniques of Inami wood carving.

title: 【旅なんと】福野夜高祭り　～引き合い（通称：ケンカ）～　Trip to Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture
description:
福野夜高祭り（ふくのよたかまつり）
　福野神明社の春祭りは、５月１日・２日の夜高祭が神迎えの宵祭り、３日が神輿と曳山の巡行する本祭りです。かつて、神は常に神社においでになるのではなく、祭りの時だけおいでになるものと考えられ、これを迎える神迎えの行事として宵祭りが行われました。宵祭りでは、夜高行燈の練り回しが行われ、赤々とともる行燈の灯とともに、夜高太鼓と若衆の「ヨイヤサ！ヨイヤサ！」という勇ましい掛け声が春の夜空に響き渡ります。
　２日は呼び物の引合い（通称：ケンカ）が行われます。神明社の神様は喧嘩が大好きな女神であり、引き合いが激しいほどお悦びになると言い伝えられており、上町通りで上り行燈と下り行燈がすれ違う瞬間に始まります。昔はローソクでしたので、灯が燃え移ったりしたこともありました。全部の町内が練り終わると、締めくくり「しゃんしゃん」の儀が行われます。各町裁許が銀行四つ角に集まり、無事終えたことの報告と引継ぎの儀式で、手締め（しゃんしゃん）が行われます。
　神迎えを終えた５月３日は本祭りが行われます。４町（上町、新町、浦町、横町）の曳山が、紋付・袴姿の裁許に先導され神明社に参詣します。また、午後からは庁内をみこしが巡幸し、氏子が清めの塩をまいて行列をお迎えします。

３５０年余の歴史と伝統を守り伝える勇壮・優美な夜高行燈･･･前夜祭開催は、毎年４月３０日。JR福野駅前広場（ロータリー）で行われる。目玉は、文久の大行灯。高さ約１５メートルで、南砺市福野地域中心部で今も受け継がれる大行燈の２倍余り。電柱がない時代に作られていた規模のものを再現している。
５月1日から始まる宵祭りでは、夜高行燈の練り回しが行われ、夜高太鼓と若衆の勇ましい掛け声が響き渡ります。最大の見どころは、２日の23時頃から始まる呼び物の引合い（ケンカ）。威勢のいい拍子木とともに、若衆が相手方の行燈を壊し合います。その激しい引合いは、見る者を釘付けにする迫力があります。そして、本祭りでは、４町の曳山が神明社に参詣し、神輿が町内を巡行します。

南砺市観光協会ホームページ（福野夜高祭りページ）

title: Trip to Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture - Fukuno Yotaka Festival ~Hiki-ai (commonly known as Kenka)~
description:
Fukuno Yotaka Festival
The spring festival at Fukuno Shinmeisha features the Yotaka Festival on the nights of May 1st and 2nd, which is the welcoming ceremony for the gods, and the main festival on the 3rd, where the portable shrines and floats parade. In the past, it was believed that the gods did not always come to the shrine, but only during the festival, which is why the welcoming ceremony was held. During the evening festival, the Yotaka lanterns are paraded, and with the bright lights of the lanterns, the sounds of the Yotaka drums and the spirited shouts of the young men, "Yoi Yasa! Yoi Yasa!" resonate through the spring night sky.
On the 2nd, the highlight of the festival, Hiki-ai (commonly known as Kenka), takes place. The deity of Fukuno Shinmeisha is a goddess who loves fights, and it is said that the more intense the Hiki-ai, the more pleased she becomes. It begins at the moment when the ascending and descending lanterns pass each other on Uemachi Street. In the past, candles were used, so there were instances of flames catching fire. Once all the neighborhoods have completed their parades, the closing ceremony called "Shan-shan" is held. Each neighborhood gathers at the bank's four corners to report the safe completion and perform the hand-clapping ritual (Shan-shan).
On May 3rd, after the welcoming ceremony, the main festival takes place. The floats from the four neighborhoods (Uemachi, Shinmachi, Uramachi, Yokomachi) are led by participants in traditional attire to visit Fukuno Shinmeisha. In the afternoon, the portable shrine parades through the town, and the parishioners sprinkle purification salt to welcome the procession.
The magnificent and elegant Yotaka lanterns, which have been preserved for over 350 years of history and tradition... The pre-festival is held every year on April 30th at the JR Fukuno Station front square (rotary). The highlight is the large lantern from the Bunkyu era, which stands about 15 meters tall, more than twice the size of the large lanterns still passed down in the Fukuno area of Nanto City. It recreates the scale of lanterns made in an era without utility poles.
During the evening festival starting on May 1st, the Yotaka lanterns are paraded, and the sounds of the Yotaka drums and the spirited shouts of the young men resonate. The biggest highlight is the Hiki-ai (Kenka) that begins around 11 PM on the 2nd. With the lively sounds of the clappers, the young men clash with each other's lanterns. The intensity of the Hiki-ai captivates the audience with its power. During the main festival, the floats from the four neighborhoods visit Fukuno Shinmeisha, and the portable shrine parades through the town.

title: KOKIRIKO -The Ancient Japanese Folk Song- ｜こきりこ　English Ver.
description:
In Gokayama, a life in harmony with nature has been passed down through generations.
Along with the World Cultural Heritage Gassho-style Village, Kokiriko—believed to be Japan’s oldest folk song—has been faithfully preserved by the locals.
Passed down through generations in the Gokayama region, Kokiriko is a simple folk song and dance with roots in a performing art called Dengaku, which originated around 1,400 years ago during the Taika Reforms. Believed to be the oldest folk song in Japan, its name appears in many ancient documents.

■A special plan to experience the World Heritage Site of Gokayama: "Stay in the World Heritage Site of Gokayama Gassho-style Houses and Watch the Traditional Kokiriko Performing Arts"
Kokiriko is a song and dance imbued with the heart of the locals and the way of life that has been sustained here.
Come and experience the essence of Gokayama firsthand on this special tour.
Stay in a Gassho-style house and enjoy a traditional Kokiriko performance.
Immerse yourself in the beauty of classic Japanese culture.

Along with the World Cultural Heritage Gassho-style Village, Kokiriko—believed to be Japan’s oldest folk song—has been faithfully preserved by the locals.
Passed down through generations in the Gokayama region, Kokiriko is a simple folk song and dance with roots in a performing art called Dengaku, which originated around 1,400 years ago during the Taika Reforms. Believed to be the oldest folk song in Japan, its name appears in many ancient documents.

■A special plan to experience the World Heritage Site of Gokayama: "Stay in the World Heritage Site of Gokayama Gassho-style Houses and Watch the Traditional Kokiriko Performing Arts"
Kokiriko is a song and dance imbued with the heart of the locals and the way of life that has been sustained here.
Come and experience the essence of Gokayama firsthand on this special tour.
Stay in a Gassho-style house and enjoy a traditional Kokiriko performance.
Immerse yourself in the beauty of classic Japanese culture.
https://www.tabi-nanto.jp/kokiriko/en/

title: KOKIRIKO -The Ancient Japanese Folk Song-  | こきりこ  Japanese Ver.
description:
自然とともにある暮らしが脈々とつづく「五箇山」。
世界文化遺産に登録された「合掌造り集落」とともに地域住民の手によって大切に受け継がれているのが日本最古の民謡といわれる「こきりこ」です。
五箇山の地に伝わる「こきりこ」。1400年前（大化の改新ごろ）に発祥した田楽踊りがルーツと伝わる素朴な唄踊りです。日本最古の民謡といわれ、数々の古文献にその名が残されています。

■世界遺産五箇山を体験する特別なプラン「世界遺産五箇山合掌造りステイ＆伝統芸能こきりこ鑑賞」
この地で守られてきた暮らしとこの地に生きる人々のこころがこもった唄と踊り。
五箇山の息吹を一度に体験する特別なツアーをご用意しました。
合掌造りに泊まり「こきりこ」を鑑賞する、古き良き日本文化に触れる旅をお楽しみください。
詳細はこちら　https://www.tabi-nanto.jp/kokiriko/

"Kokiriko" is a simple song and dance that is said to have originated from the dengaku dance that began about 1400 years ago (around the time of the Taika Reforms). It is considered the oldest folk song in Japan, and its name has been preserved in numerous ancient texts.

■ A special plan to experience the World Heritage Gokayama: "World Heritage Gokayama Gassho-zukuri Stay & Traditional Performing Arts Kokiriko Viewing"

The song and dance filled with the spirit of the people living in this land and the lifestyle that has been protected here.

We have prepared a special tour to experience the breath of Gokayama all at once.

Enjoy a journey that allows you to stay in a Gassho-zukuri house and view "Kokiriko," immersing yourself in the good old culture of Japan.

title: EN（縁）
description:
若狭湾と若狭富士「青葉山」に囲まれる福井県高浜町は、鈴木大拙の師にして世界へ禅をZENとして初めて広めたパイオニアである釈宗演の生誕の地です。
釈宗演が幼少期を過ごした海と山に囲まれた若狭高浜。自然とつながり、人とつながり、心と体をリセットするZEN（禅、然、膳、善、全…）の体験が、今も暮らしの中に息づいています。
陰陽の陽（春夏）を表現した今回の動画では、ZENのEN（縁）に出会ってほしいという思いを込めました。

縁がつながり、新たな縁を紡いでいく。

そんな高浜へ、ZENの体験を、日本海の美味しい魚を味わいに、そしてワーケーションをしに、福井県高浜町へお越しください。

title: EN (En)
description:
Takahama Town in Fukui Prefecture, surrounded by the Wakasa Bay and Wakasa Fuji 'Aobayama', is the birthplace of Shaku Soen, a pioneer who was Daisetsu Suzuki's master and the first to spread Zen to the world as ZEN.

Wakasa Takahama, where Shaku Soen spent his childhood, is surrounded by the sea and mountains. The experience of ZEN (Zen, nature, meal, goodness, wholeness...) that connects with nature, connects with people, and resets the mind and body still breathes in daily life.

In this video, which expresses the positive aspect of Yin-Yang (spring and summer), we hope you encounter the EN (connection) of ZEN.

Connections are made, and new connections are woven.

We invite you to Takahama, to experience ZEN, to taste the delicious fish of the Japan Sea, and to workation in Takahama Town, Fukui Prefecture.

description:

title: Wakasa Wada Beach in Takahama, Fukui Prefecture
description:
Wakasa Wada Beach in Takahama, Fukui Prefecture, is a popular beach that has received the first international environmental certification "BLUE FLAG" in Asia. It is characterized by its outstanding transparency, shallow waters, and wide white sandy beach. It has also been selected as one of Japan's 88 bathing beaches. During the swimming season, lifeguards and rescue personnel are stationed on the beach, ensuring a safe and secure environment. Additionally, the scenery is beautiful, and it has been chosen as one of Japan's top 100 sunsets.

Wakasa Wada Beach page⇛https://wakasa-takahama.jp/spot/wakasawada-beach/

Wakasa Takahama Tourism Association official site⇛https://wakasa-takahama.jp/
