title: 「I LOVE AIKAWA-MACHI 愛川町の魅力がいっぱい」 愛川レッドカーペット優秀賞受賞作品（あいかわ発見動画の部）
description:
愛川町をロケ地とした初の動画コンテスト「愛川レッドカーペット」
「私が感じた愛川町の魅力」をテーマに60秒以内の作品を募集した「あいかわ発見動画の部」。応募全34作品の中から、次点の優秀賞を獲得した片山憲一さん製作の「I LOVE AIKAWA-MACHI 愛川町の魅力がいっぱい」です。

【作品概要】
一般公募したロケ地めぐり企画「ロケ地にゴー！」に参加。その際に撮影したスポットや、その後再び町を訪れたときに撮影したスポットをてんこ盛りにした本作品。
光を生かした描写など、見せ方やつなぎ方が上手く、タイトルどおりに町の魅力がいっぱいの作品となりました。

【町内のロケ地】
中津川（広瀬河原・仙台下付近）、平山橋、勝楽寺、塩川滝、清雲寺、宮ケ瀬ダム、菅原神社、へいしの坂、古民家山十邸、龍福寺、箕輪耕地、県立あいかわ公園、服部牧場（順不同）

title: I LOVE AIKAWA-MACHI: The Charm of Aikawa Town
description:
The first video contest featuring Aikawa Town as a filming location, "Aikawa Red Carpet".

In the "Aikawa Discovery Video" category, we invited submissions of works under 60 seconds on the theme of "The Charm of Aikawa Town as I Feel It." Among the 34 entries, the excellent award was won by Kenichi Katayama's work, "I LOVE AIKAWA-MACHI: The Charm of Aikawa Town."

【Overview of the Work】
This work participated in the publicly recruited location tour project "Go to the Filming Locations!" It is packed with spots filmed during that time and those filmed when the town was visited again later.
The depiction utilizing light and the way it is presented and connected are skillfully done, making it a work full of the town's charm, just as the title suggests.

【Filming Locations in the Town】
Nakatsugawa (Hirose River and near Sendai-shimo), Hirayama Bridge, Shorakuji Temple, Shiokawa Falls, Seiunji Temple, Miyagase Dam, Sugawara Shrine, Heishi no Saka, Kominka Yamajuttei, Ryufukuji Temple, Minowa Agricultural Land, Aikawa Prefectural Park, Hattori Farm (in no particular order)

title: 瀬見温泉
description: 最上小国川の清流に臨む静かな温泉場。山水の景勝に恵まれ、特に紅葉の季節がすばらしい温泉地です。源義経の妻、北の方が亀若丸を生んだ際、産湯を探しに出た弁慶が近くの岩陰から立ち昇る湯煙を見つけたのがこの温泉の始まりと伝えられています。近くには亀若丸の誕生に加護のあった亀割子安観音や瀬見温泉の守り神が祀られている湯前神社など、義経・弁慶に関する伝説や旧跡が数多く残っています。夏は、近くを流れる最上小国川でアユ釣りを楽しむ方を多く見かけます

title: Semmi Onsen
description: A quiet hot spring resort overlooking the clear stream of the Mogami Oguni River. Blessed with scenic mountain waters, this hot spring area is particularly wonderful during the autumn foliage season. It is said that the origin of this hot spring began when Benkei, searching for a bath for Kamewakamaru, the child of Yoshitsune's wife, Kito no Kata, discovered the rising steam from a nearby rock. Nearby, there are many legends and historical sites related to Yoshitsune and Benkei, such as the Kamewakamaru's protective Kamewariko An Kannon and the Yumemae Shrine, which enshrines the guardian deity of Semmi Onsen. In summer, many people can be seen enjoying sweetfish fishing in the nearby Mogami Oguni River.

title: 【東北・山形】「EMMA」山形県最上町プロモーション動画  Promotion Video for Mogami Town, Yamagata (Tohoku, Japan)
description:
[山形県最上町の歴史や風景を背景にした心が動かされる短編物語]

　最上町は、古来より馬の産地であり、小国駒と呼ばれる名馬の産地として、馬を慈しみ深い関わりを持って暮らしてきた町であった。
　今回のプロモーション動画は、東北三大馬頭観音の一つであり、馬の守り神として崇拝されてきた富山馬頭観音の東善院と、近代では観光地として「馬」に関わりの深い前森高原をメインロケ地にし、その2箇所が『桜』の名所でもあり、『馬』と『桜』、その桜のイメージから『女性』をテーマに、主人公の過去から未来に繋がるストーリーを町の魅力的なロケ地を活かして制作。


[A moving short story set against the backdrop of the history and scenery of Mogami Town, Yamagata Prefecture]

Mogami Town has been a horse-breeding town since ancient times, and as the birthplace of the famous horse called Oguni Koma, it has been a town where people have lived in a beautiful and deep connection with horses.
The main locations for this promotional video are Tozen-in Temple of Tomiyama Bato Kannon, one of the three major horse-headed Kannon temples in the Tohoku region and worshipped as the guardian deity of horses, and Maemori Plateau, which has a deep connection with horses as a tourist destination in modern times. These two places are also famous for cherry blossoms. The story is based on the theme of horses, cherry blossoms, and the protagonist, taking advantage of the town's attractive locations to create a story that connects the protagonist's pas, present, and future.

title: Premium dinner with Ama butler at private beach
description:
■Activity details■
Ama are female freedivers who catch seafood such as abalone and sea urchin. Ama fishing, which has been a tradition in Shima, Mie for over 2,000 years, is designated as an important intangible folk cultural property. With over 200 active ama, it is one of the few places in the country where this type of fishing is still practiced. The average ama age is 65!

This program offers participants the chance to get their fill of Shima accompanied by energetic ama. First, participants will head out on a boat with the ama to experience their traditional basket fishing technique used to collect a variety of fresh seafood. Next they'll enjoy a special dinner made with the freshly caught seafood on a private beach. The ama serve as their own private butlers for an unforgettable experience.

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■
「海女（あま）」ー素潜りで海に入り、あわびやウニなどの海鮮類を獲る漁をする女性です。
三重県志摩市は2000年以上続く海女漁が重要無形民俗文化財に指定されており、今もなお200名以上の海女さんが現役で活躍している国内でも希少な地域です。海女さんの平均年齢はなんと65歳！
本プログラムはそんなエネルギッシュな現役海女さんと一緒に志摩を満喫するプランです。まずは伝統的な漁法である「かご漁体験」をするため、海女さんと一緒に船で海に出かけましょう。そして、漁で捕れた新鮮な食材を使った特別ディナーをプライベートビーチで堪能してください。海女さんが、あなただけのbutlerとなって忘れられない1日をご案内します。

title: Premium dinner with Ama butler at private beach
description:
■Activity details■
Ama are female freedivers who catch seafood such as abalone and sea urchin. Ama fishing, which has been a tradition in Shima, Mie for over 2,000 years, is designated as an important intangible folk cultural property. With over 200 active ama, it is one of the few places in the country where this type of fishing is still practiced. The average ama age is 65!

This program offers participants the chance to get their fill of Shima accompanied by energetic ama. First, participants will head out on a boat with the ama to experience their traditional basket fishing technique used to collect a variety of fresh seafood. Next they'll enjoy a special dinner made with the freshly caught seafood on a private beach. The ama serve as their own private butlers for an unforgettable experience.

■Overview & Story of the Content■
"Ama" - women who dive into the sea to catch seafood such as abalone and sea urchin.
Shima City in Mie Prefecture has a tradition of ama fishing that has continued for over 2,000 years and is designated as an important intangible folk cultural property. Even now, there are more than 200 active ama, making it a rare region in Japan. The average age of ama is an astonishing 65!
This program is a plan to fully enjoy Shima with energetic active ama. First, let's head out to sea on a boat with the ama to experience the traditional fishing method known as "basket fishing." Then, enjoy a special dinner made with the fresh ingredients caught during the fishing on a private beach. The ama will be your own butlers, guiding you through an unforgettable day.

title: Nagatanien, the Iga ware kiln with 200 years of Japanese culinary history
description:
■Activity details■
Located in northern Mie prefecture in a quiet area where you can see chimneys poking up around town is Marubashira, the Iga ware village. The pottery crafted here is highly flame resistant, and since long ago, clay pots used for cooking on open flames and teapots have been made in this village.

Nagatanien, one of the potteries of Iga ware, has continued to carry on the techniques of this craft since the workshop's founding in 1832, making pieces that are highly valued both in Japan and abroad. This program offers participants the chance to go on a special tour of the climbing kilns with the eighth generation head of Nagatanien while listening to secret stories about Iga ware, and to try cooking in a famous Nagatanien clay pot. Don't miss the chance to try some delicious rice prepared in this unique piece of pottery!

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■
三重県の北部、穏やかな里山に煙突が登る風景が見られる伊賀焼の里、丸柱。この地の陶土は耐火性が高く、古来より直火の土鍋・土瓶などが作られてきました。
伊賀焼窯元「長谷園」は1832年築窯して以来、伊賀焼の伝統と技術を継承し、国内外から高く評価される製品を生み出しています。本プログラムでは、8代目当主による特別な案内で登り窯見学と伊賀焼に関する秘話を聞くことができるだけでなく、長谷園の代表的作品である土鍋を使った炊飯実演もご用意。炊き立ての土鍋ご飯の美味しさをぜひ味わってみてください。

title: Walk the Magose pass on the Kumano Kodo trail, UNESCO World heritage site
description:
■Activity details■
Long ago, it was popular for people from all across Japan to walk hundreds of kilometers to tour sacred sites such as Ise Grand Shrine and Kumano Sanzan (the Three Grand Shrines of Kumano). Many travelers walked the perilous Magose Pass, which is part of the Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range that leads to Kumano Sanzan. The beautiful stone paved path leading deep into the forest has been lovingly maintained by locals for centuries, and still looks as it did long ago. This program offers participants the chance to dress in travel garb recreated from ukiyo-e prints and historic documents and walk the Magose Past just as ancient travelers did. Partial proceeds from the program are used to preserve the stone paving and keep the scenery in pristine condition for future generations.

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■
かつて日本では、日本全国から何百キロもの道のりを歩いて伊勢神宮や熊野三山を参拝する聖地巡礼の大ブームが起きました。世界遺産「紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道」の一部である「馬越峠」もまた、数多くの旅人がいくつもの険しい峠を越え、熊野三山を詣でるために通った“祈りの道”の一つ。森の奥へと伸びる美しい石畳は、何百年もの間、地元の人々の手によって大事に保全され、今もなお、当時の姿を留めています。本プログラムでは、浮世絵や文献等を参考に再現された旅装束に身を包み、かつての旅人たちのように馬越峠を歩きます。体験代の一部は、この先もこの美しい景色を残すため、石畳の保全活動費用に使われます。

title: 伊勢志摩で真珠文化を発見し学ぶユニークな真珠ジュエリー体験
description:
■アクティビティの詳細■
三重県志摩市は真珠養殖の発祥の地です。豊かな海の資源と受け継がれた技術のおかげで、志摩の真珠は世界でも最高品質のものとして知られています。このプログラムでは、参加者が真珠養殖場を訪れ、職人と話しながら養殖技術を直接学ぶ機会を提供します。また、参加者は牡蠣から真珠を取り出す体験や、非常に珍しい母貝への核入れ作業を行い、真珠養殖のプロセスがどれほど難しいかを学ぶことができます。最後に、参加者は取り出した真珠を使って、世界に一つだけのオリジナルジュエリーを製作します。

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■
真珠養殖の発祥の地である三重県志摩市。豊かな海と技術が受け継がれる志摩で作られる真珠の品質の高さは世界有数です。本プログラムでは、今もなお稼働している真珠養殖の現場に訪問し、伝統的な養殖手法を間近で見学、職人と直接お話することができます。また、「真珠の取り出し体験」や通常は体験することができない「母貝への核入れ作業」を通して、「真珠づくり」の真の難しさを体感してみてください。そして最後に、取り出した真珠で世界に一つだけのオリジナル真珠ジュエリーを製作しましょう。

description:

Shima, Mie is the birthplace of pearl cultivation. Thanks to abundant ocean resources and time-honored techniques, Shima pearls are known as being some of the highest quality around the world. title: An authentic Ninja experience on the site of a mountain castle
description:
■Activity details■
Long ago, many mountain castles were built in Iga, where the ninja were valued for their ability to move swiftly when fighting in mountainous terrain. This program offers participants an authentic ninja experience to learn ninjutsu at the site of a mountain castle, just like the ninja of old. The introductory course teaches breathing techniques, mystic hand signs, and fundamental walking techniques based on Iga ninjutsu at an indoor dojo. After lunch, participants will try swinging a sword in the forest, using a grappling hook, concealment techniques, and more while walking through the site of a mountain castle which records say was used for actual ninja training. This program is designed by the Japan Ninja Council, and is part of a rare domestic workshop that offers continuous advancement based on a systematic curriculum.

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■
かつて伊賀には山城が多く築かれ、山岳地帯での戦において山を素早く移動できる忍者は重宝されました。本プログラムは、かつての忍者のように山城を使って忍術を学ぶ、本格的な忍者体験です。初回は「入門編」として、道場（屋内）で伊賀発祥の忍術をベースとした呼吸法や印、歩き方の基礎を学びます。昼食後、実際に忍者が活動した記録の残る山城を散策しながら、山城ならではの森での刀の振り方、鍵縄の使い方、隠れ方等々に挑戦。本プログラムは、日本忍者協議会の忍道プログラムを用いており、体系的なカリキュラムに基づいた継続的なステップアップもできる国内でも珍しいワークショップです。

都会から大自然の景色へと移り行く先にあるのは

サウナ付きトレーラーハウスEarthboat。

An experiential plan
that turns the “journey” leading to Earthboat into entertainment,
offering a way to enjoy the unique charm of each location—

Charter a luxury taxi and
enjoy the journey itself as you head toward your destination.

From the city to breathtaking natural landscapes,
you arrive at the Earthboat,
a trailer house equipped with a sauna
that offers more comfort than camping
and a closer connection to nature than a hotel.

title: 善光寺僧侶による参向ビジネスセミナー
description:
善光寺永代宿坊「⽟照院」の⼭ノ井住職による企業セミナー
心身の調和と働くことの意義を探求するこのセミナーでは、仏教の教義を基に、心の整え方を日常生活に導入する方法を学びます。ミズノ認定ウォーキング指導員でもある住職が、「静」の坐禅と「動」のウォーキングを通じて心身の調和を整える方法を指導します。また、働くことの真の意味を仏教の視点から探求します。これまで、航空会社、商社、食品会社などの大手企業や、行政自治体での研修を10年以上の実績を持つ、善光寺の僧侶による出張（参向）ビジネスセミナーとなります。
【このプログラムを受講することで、期待できる効果】
あらためて、「働くことの意味」を考え心の状態が仕事・人間関係に及ぼす影響を学ぶ。
「心の動き」「感情」のシステムを知り、呼吸法と効果的なウォーキングにより「心と身体の整え方」を学ぶ。
【対象者】
・職場での人間関係等ストレスを抱えている方
・仕事が、つまらない方、苦痛な方　　
・心身の健康が気になる方

title: Business Seminar by Zenkoji Monks
description:
A corporate seminar led by the head priest of Zenkoji's Eitai Shukubo, Tamashoin.
In this seminar, which explores the significance of work and the harmony of body and mind, participants will learn how to incorporate methods of mental alignment into their daily lives based on Buddhist teachings. The head priest, who is also a certified walking instructor by Mizuno, will guide participants on how to achieve harmony of body and mind through 'static' zazen (seated meditation) and 'dynamic' walking. Additionally, the true meaning of work will be explored from a Buddhist perspective. This is a traveling (business) seminar conducted by Zenkoji monks, with over 10 years of experience in training for major companies such as airlines, trading companies, and food companies, as well as local government agencies.
【Expected Benefits of Attending This Program】
Reconsider the 'meaning of work' and learn about the impact of mental states on work and interpersonal relationships.
Understand the system of 'mental movements' and 'emotions,' and learn 'how to align the mind and body' through breathing techniques and effective walking.
【Target Audience】
- Those experiencing stress in workplace relationships.
- Those who find their work uninteresting or painful.
- Those concerned about their mental and physical health.

title: 京都市観光PR映像本編_KYOTO PROMOTIONAL MOVIE -Where Every Corner Sparks Discovery-
description:
映像の詳細は、京都市観光協会のホームページをご覧ください。
https://www.kyokanko.or.jp/news/20240430/

～ストーリー～
この旅で初めて会う２人の旅人、マックとカレン、
日本に住むマックは、親友の娘であるカレンを京都案内することになった。

旅は駅でマックが荷物を預けるところからスタートする。
マックが荷物を預ける一方、待ち合わせ場所の観光案内所になかなか到着しないカレン。
マックは伏見へと向かう。

スケジュールを管理しながら京都を巡るマックと、
出会いと直感に導かれて街を駆け抜けるカレン。
時折、２人の旅は交錯しながらも、それぞれのスタイルで京都を旅していく。

滞在最後の日、着物を纏い京懐石を楽しむ２人。
お互いの旅の出来事について会話が弾む。
お店を出て京都の街を歩くと、幻想的な東山の夜があった。

2人は東山を歩きながら地元の人たちが集うバーに辿り着く。
旅の出来事について会話が弾む中、京都の旅の終わりを迎える。

四季が巡り、1年後、カレンは再び京都を訪れる。
京都の静かな朝、木漏れ日に包まれながらお寺を歩く。
これから待つ新たな出会いと発見に静かに心を躍らせながら。

For more details about this video, please visit our website.
https://kyoto.travel/en/see-and-do/we_released_kyoto_city_promotional_videos.html

~Story~
In the historical city of Kyoto, two travelers, Mac and Karen, embark on a unique journey of discovery. Mac, a resident of Japan, offers to guide Karen, his best friend's daughter, to showcase the beauty of Kyoto. Their journey begins at Kyoto Station with Mac checking his luggage, but their paths quickly diverge as Karen loses her way to their meeting point at the Kyoto Tourist Information Center. Mac continues the planned itinerary and visits Fushimi Inari Shrine alone. Karen, guided by instinct and spontaneous encounters, sets off on her own. 
Both travelers weave through the city’s sights as their paths intertwine sporadically, discovering Kyoto’s charms from different perspectives. That evening, adorned in traditional kimonos, they enjoy an exquisite Kyoto kaiseki meal followed by a stroll through the enchanting atmosphere of Higashiyama at night.  On their final night in Kyoto, the two visit a local bar and amid new friends share stories of their discoveries around the ancient capital.
A year later Karen returns to the city. She meanders through a temple in the peaceful morning light, her heart brimming with excitement for the new memories Kyoto promises to unveil.

title: KYOTO PROMOTIONAL MOVIE -Where Every Corner Sparks Discovery-
description:
For more details about this video, please visit our website.
https://www.kyokanko.or.jp/news/20240430/

~Story~
In this journey, two travelers, Mac and Karen, meet for the first time. Mac, who lives in Japan, is set to guide Karen, the daughter of his best friend, around Kyoto.

The journey begins at the station where Mac checks his luggage. While Mac is checking his luggage, Karen struggles to arrive at their meeting point at the tourist information center. Mac heads towards Fushimi.

While managing the schedule, Mac explores Kyoto, and Karen rushes through the city, guided by encounters and intuition. Occasionally, their paths intersect, but they each travel through Kyoto in their own style.

On the last day of their stay, the two enjoy a kaiseki meal dressed in kimonos. They engage in lively conversation about their travel experiences. After leaving the restaurant, they walk through the streets of Kyoto, where a magical night in Higashiyama awaits.

As they walk through Higashiyama, they arrive at a bar where locals gather. Amidst their conversation about their travel experiences, they reach the end of their journey in Kyoto.

Seasons change, and a year later, Karen visits Kyoto again. On a quiet morning in Kyoto, she walks through a temple, enveloped in dappled sunlight, quietly excited for the new encounters and discoveries that await her.

title: 京都のセレンディピティ - シャルロット・ペリアン
description:
「空間にリズムを与える、自由な形」。モダニズムのデザイナー、シャルロット・ペリアンが京都を訪れた際、彼女は変革的なインスピレーションを見出しました。桂離宮の棚は、彼女の有名な『Nuage a Plots bookshelf』に直接影響を与えました。

桂離宮から河井寛次郎との民藝哲学への共鳴まで、京都は彼女にとってアイデアの交差点でした。20世紀を形作ったデザインのルーツを探求しましょう。人生のあらゆる瞬間における時を超えた美しさ。

title: KYOTO SERENDIPITY - Charlotte Perriand
description:
"A free form that gives rhythm to space." When modernist designer Charlotte Perriand visited Kyoto, she found a transformative inspiration. The shelving at Katsura Imperial Villa directly inspired her famous "Nuage a Plots“ bookshelf
From the imperial villa to the philosophy of Mingei with Kanjiro Kawai, Kyoto was a meeting ground of ideas for her. Explore the roots of the design that shaped the 20th century. Timeless beauty in every moment of life.

「空間にリズムを与える、自由な形」。 モダニズムの巨匠シャルロット・ペリアン。彼女の代表作である『Nuage a Plots bookshelf』は、実は京都の桂離宮にある「違い棚」から着想を得て生まれたと言われています。
桂離宮の機能美、そして河井寛次郎らとの出会いによる民藝哲学への共感。 20世紀のデザイン史に影響を与えた、「出会い」の物語に触れよう。

title: 京都のセレンディピティ - ジョン・ケージ
description:
「静寂とは、音がないことではなく、心の扉を開くこと」。
伝説的な作曲家ジョン・ケージは、龍安寺の石庭で深い「音の風景」を発見しました。
彼は石をただ観察するだけでなく、その輪郭をなぞって音楽を作り出し、偶然性と虚無の中に美を見出しました。
彼にとって、京都の美学は音楽そのものでした。
喧騒から離れ、自分自身の静寂を見つけてください。
人生のすべての瞬間に時を超えた美があります。

title: KYOTO SERENDIPITY - John Cage
description:
"Silence is not the absence of sound, but the opening of the mind." Legendary composer John Cage discovered a profound "Soundscape" in the rock garden of Ryoan-ji Temple. He didn't just observe the stones; he traced their outlines to compose music, finding beauty in chance and emptiness.
For him, the aesthetics of Kyoto were like music itself. Step away from the noise and find your own silence. Timeless beauty in every moment of life.

「静寂とは、音がないことではなく、心の扉を開くこと」。 音楽家・ジョン・ケージは、龍安寺の石庭に深いインスピレーションを受けました。彼は石庭を眺めるだけではなく、石の輪郭をなぞることで音を紡ぎ、偶然性と虚無の中に音楽を見出したのです。
彼にとって、京都の美意識は音楽そのものでした。 日常の喧騒を離れ、心研ぎ澄ます静寂の旅へ。

title: 京都のセレンディピティ - イザベラ・バード
description:
「ガイドブックのその先にある、真の京都」。1878年、英国人探検家イザベラ・バードは京都で単なる風景以上のものを見つけました。彼女は人々の日常生活に織り込まれた「清潔さ」、「自尊心」、そして「相互扶助」を目にしました。
彼女の著書『日本の未踏の道』に記したように、「日本人は驚くほど優しく、礼儀正しく、温和です」。彼女が称賛した普遍的な美徳を発見し、人生のあらゆる瞬間に見られる時を超えた美に触れてみましょう。

title: KYOTO SERENDIPITY - Isabella Bird
description:
"Beyond the guidebooks, the true Kyoto awaits." In 1878, British explorer Isabella Bird found more than just scenery in Kyoto. She saw "immaculate cleanliness," "self-respect," and "shared responsibilities" woven into the everyday lives of the people.
As she noted in her book Unbeaten Tracks in Japan: "The Japanese are wonderfully gentle, courteous, and good-tempered." Discover the universal virtues she admired?a timeless beauty found in every moment of life.

「ガイドブックのその先にある、真の京都」。 明治期、1878年に京都を訪れた英国人探検家イザベラ・バード。彼女がこの地で見つけたのは、単なる風景ではなく、人々の暮らしに根付く「清潔さ」「自尊心」、そして「相互扶助」の精神でした。
「日本の人々はまじめで勤勉で礼儀正しい」。 彼女が感動した普遍的な美徳と、受け継がれる暮らしの美に触れる旅へ。

title: Top 10 Things to Do in Toyama City／富山市のおすすめ観光10選
description:
Planning a Trip to Japan? ✈️ Top 10 Things to Do in Toyama City

Discover Toyama City, a hidden gem in central Japan that perfectly blends breathtaking nature, rich culture, delicious food, and unforgettable experiences. Whether it’s your first visit or you’re a seasoned traveler, this video guides you through the must-see attractions and top activities in Toyama City.

🌟 Top 10 Things to Do in Toyama City:

①Toyama City Hall Panorama – Stunning city views you can’t miss
②Toyama Kirari Glass Art Museum – Modern architecture and exquisite glass art
③Local Sushi Restaurants – Taste Toyama’s famous fresh seafood
④Fugan Canal Kansui Park – Relax in this beautiful waterfront park
⑤Toyama City Tram – Scenic and convenient way to explore the city
⑥Toyama Castle / Tourist Information Center & Samurai Experience – History and culture in one spot
⑦Black Ramen Shops – Try Toyama’s unique soul food
⑧Iwase Port Area – Historic port town with retro charm
⑨Gokoku Shrine / Hie Shrine – Peaceful shrines with deep historical significance
⑩Sougawa Arcade / Daiwa Department Store – Shopping and local vibes
🎉 Special Event: Owara Kaze no Bon – A traditional festival with music and dance, held every September.

🗞️ As featured by The New York Times: On January 7, 2025, Toyama City was listed as #30 on the annual “52 Places to Go”, highlighting it as a top destination for travelers worldwide.

💡 Travel Tips & Recommendations: From sightseeing and local food to cultural experiences, this guide will help you plan the perfect trip to Toyama City.

📍 Learn more & plan your trip: 
👉 Toyama City Official Website: ‟Explore the Toyama CIty” 
https://www.toyamashi-kankoukyoukai.jp/en/explore-toyama/

🌟 富山市で訪れるべきトップ10スポット：

①富山市役所展望塔パノラマ – 見逃せない絶景スポット
②富山市ガラス美術館（TOYAMA Kirari） – 近代建築と精巧なガラスアート
③地元の寿司店 – 富山名物の新鮮な海鮮を味わう
④富岩運河環水公園 – 美しい水辺の公園でリラックス
⑤路面電車 – 景色を楽しみながら便利に市内観光
⑥富山城 / 観光案内所 & 侍体験 – 歴史と文化を一度に体験
⑦ブラックラーメン – 富山ならではのソウルフードを味わう
⑧岩瀬地区 – レトロな魅力あふれる歴史的港町
⑨護国神社 / 日枝神社 – 静かで歴史深い神社
⑩総曲輪アーケード / 大和百貨店 – ショッピングと地元の雰囲気を満喫
🎉 特別イベント：おわら風の盆 – 9月に開催される伝統のお祭り

title: 効能の高さで全国有数のラジウム温泉を求め阿賀野の里『五頭温泉郷』へ！
description:
皆さまこんにちは。
ラジウム温泉に入ってみたくて新潟の村杉温泉へ行ってきました。

お宿は角屋旅館さん。
もともと農家さんだった角屋さんは、
今も食事で使う野菜やお米を自家栽培！
地産地消のお宿ということに惹かれ、こちらのお宿に決定。

こちらのラジウム温泉は気体にラドンが多く含まれるので
もし行かれた方は、温泉でたくさん深呼吸してください。
わたしも過呼吸になるくらい（！）深呼吸してきましたら
なんだかとってもリフレッシュ！
とっても元気になれました。

#角屋旅館
#新潟
#ラジウム温泉

title: Seeking one of Japan's top radium hot springs in Agano's 'Gozu Onsen Area'!
description:
Hello everyone.
I wanted to try a radium hot spring, so I went to Muramatsu Onsen in Niigata.

The accommodation is Kakuya Ryokan.
Originally a farm, Kakuya still grows its own vegetables and rice for meals!
I was drawn to this farm-to-table inn, so I decided to stay here.

This radium hot spring contains a high amount of radon gas, so if you visit, please take deep breaths in the hot spring.
I took so many deep breaths (to the point of hyperventilation!) and felt incredibly refreshed!
I became very energetic.

#KakuyaRyokan
#Niigata
#RadiumHotSpring

皆さまこんにちは。
2025年5月に完成した秋田男鹿半島の『山人 -oga-』のご紹介です。

ラウンジではコーヒーなどの飲み物やアイスクリームなども
無料で頂けて、最高です。

とてつもなく贅沢な時間を過ごせますので
皆様もぜひ一度行ってみてください！

title: A Luxurious Resort Hotel 'Yamato -oga-' with a Stunning View is Born!
description:
Hello everyone.

I would like to introduce 'Yamato -oga-', which was completed in May 2025 on the Oga Peninsula in Akita.

I have stayed at 'Yamato' several times, located on the border of Akita and Iwate, and I remember the delicious food.

This year, a new accommodation has been completed on the Oga Peninsula, and the hot spring will start in October 2025, so I went to check it out.

It has a perfect location with a panoramic view of the Oga land.
All rooms (16 in total) have an ocean view.
The comfort of these rooms makes you want to live here!

The meals are served in a wonderful restaurant, featuring dishes that utilize local ingredients from Oga.

In the lounge, you can enjoy drinks like coffee and ice cream for free, which is fantastic.

You can spend an incredibly luxurious time, so I highly recommend that everyone visit at least once!

title: 【Drone空撮映像】楽山園と煌
description:
甘楽町役場公式ホームページはこちら：https://www.town.kanra.lg.jp/

「空から町を見てみて新たな魅力発見を！」、そんなコンセプトのもと映像を撮影していきます。
今回は甘楽町にございます名勝「楽山園」を撮影いたしました！
また、4.20~4.30の間行われた、楽山園ライトアップイベント「煌(きらめき)」の様子も撮影しましたので併せてご覧ください。

楽山園は…
江戸時代初期に織田氏によって造られた小幡藩邸の庭園です。池泉回遊式の借景庭園で、景石（けいせき）の置かれた池を中心として、「中島」や「築山」を築いて起伏のある地形を造り出し、「梅の茶屋」や全国的にも珍しい五角形の形状をした「腰掛茶屋」など複数の茶屋を配し、それらを巡る園路にも工夫を凝らしています。

撮影機体：【DJI】Phantom 4 Pro V2.0
編集：Adobe Premiere Pro 2019
ビューポイント：楽山園
群馬県甘楽郡甘楽町大字小幡６４８－２

チャンネル登録お願いします！：https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUQ2TeS_4eysYlNDHObQubw

title: [Drone Aerial Footage] Rakuzan-en and Kirameki
description:
The official website of Kanra Town Hall is here: https://www.town.kanra.lg.jp/

"See the town from the sky and discover new charms!" With this concept, we will be filming.
This time, we filmed the scenic spot "Rakuzan-en" located in Kanra Town!
Additionally, we also captured the scenes from the Rakuzan-en light-up event "Kirameki" that took place from April 20 to April 30, so please take a look.

Rakuzan-en is...
A garden of the Obata clan residence created by the Oda clan in the early Edo period. It is a pond-style strolling garden with borrowed scenery, centered around a pond with placed scenic stones (keiseki), creating an undulating terrain with "Nakajima" and "Tsukiyama," and featuring multiple tea houses such as the "Ume no Chaya" and the uniquely pentagonal "Koshikake Chaya," with thoughtful paths winding around them.

Filming drone: [DJI] Phantom 4 Pro V2.0
Editing: Adobe Premiere Pro 2019
Viewpoint: Rakuzan-en
648-2 Obata, Kanra Town, Kanra District, Gunma Prefecture

Please subscribe to our channel! : https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUQ2TeS_4eysYlNDHObQubw

小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館は、日本近代彫刻の巨匠・平櫛田中の作品を保存・展示し、ながくその功績を顕彰するとともに、市民文化の向上を図ることを目的として、昭和59年に平櫛田中の旧宅を公開し、「小平市平櫛田中館」として開館しました。その後、平成6年に展示館を新築し、平成17年に遺族から作品の寄贈を受けたことを機に、平成18年4月に館名を「小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館」へ変更し、現在に至っています。

主な美術館活動として、田中が遺した彫刻、書、資料を中心とする通常展示のほか、平櫛田中と関係の深い作家の作品紹介を中心とする特別展（2年に1回の隔年開催）を開催し、田中芸術への理解が深められるような企画・展示を行っています。

また、春と秋の2回開催するお茶会や、夏休みに小学生とその保護者を対象としたワークショップ「親子で美術館」もご好評いただいております。

title: 平櫛田中の庭  - Japanese garden of Hirakushi Denchū  -
description:
今年も春がやってきました。

彫刻家・平櫛田中がこの地に移り住んできたのは、九十八歳の時でした。

それから先、二十年、三十年と彫刻を掘るために、クスノキを買って、周囲を驚かせました。

もしかしたら、平櫛田中は、今でもこの庭を眺めながら、彫刻を掘り続けているのかもしれません。

その優雅で且つ、力強いこの景色から、

何にも屈することのない平櫛田中の息遣いが聞こえるような気がします。


（詳細: https://kodaira-tourism.com/spot/5880/ ）
【小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館】

平櫛田中彫刻美術館（ひらくしでんちゅうちょうこくびじゅつかん）は、
日本近代彫刻界の巨匠、彫刻家平櫛田中（文化勲章受章者、小平市名誉市民）の終えんの館を保存し、
広く市民の皆様に公開するため、昭和59年10月に開館しました。その後、平成6年2月に、貴重な木彫作品を展示、保存するため展示館を新築し、
2館併設の美術館として現在に至っています。
記念館は、国立能楽堂などを手がけた大江宏の設計による書院造の名建築。
玉川上水をのぞむ美しい庭園が魅力です。
展示館では、年間を通じて４回の企画展、特別展（隔年開催）を開催。
お茶会（春・秋）、親子で美術館など、各種のイベントを開催しています。
また、多機能端末で音声と画像による作品解説を楽しむことができるサービスもありますので、ぜひご来館ください。


【開館時間】
午前１０時～午後４時
※なるべく午後３時３０分までに入館してください。


【休館日】
火曜日（祝日、または振替休日に当たる場合は開館し、翌日休館）


【観覧料】

小・中学生…１５０円（１１０円）
※カッコ内は、団体２０人以上です。

URL　http://denchu-museum.jp


【今後の展覧会・イベント情報】

◆「彫刻と人形」◆

彫刻と人形の境目はどこにあるのでしょうか。創作人形、市松人形、アンティークドー
ルなど、平櫛田中がコレクションした様々な人形を楽しみながら、そんな疑問について考
えてみませんか。

平成30年 ２月７日（水）～５月２０日（日）


◆期間限定「おひなさま展示」◆

記念館では会期中の３月１９日（月）まで、田中が娘のために制作した「内裏びな」を
はじめ、田中が集めた雛人形を展示します。

平成30年 ２月７日（水）～３月１９日（月）


◆期間限定「誕生仏展示」◆

お釈迦様の生誕を祝う「潅仏会（かんぶつえ）」の時期にあわせて、平櫛田中が制作し
た「南無誕生仏」を展示いたします。
「南無誕生仏」は御厨子の中に納められています。この厨子は記念館（平櫛田中旧邸）
の設計を手がけた建築家・大江宏によって作られたものです。
こちらも田中の彫刻とあわせてお楽しみください。

平成30年３月２１日（水・祝）～４月１６日（月）



◆春の庭園を眺めながらお弁当を味わってみませんか？◆

美術館庭園は梅の美しい季節を迎えました。春の美術館庭園を楽しみながら「平櫛田中
弁当」を味わってみませんか。期間中、「平櫛田中弁当」を美術館でお受け取りの場合、
記念館和室でお弁当をお楽しみいただけます。お弁当はまるやす商店まで各自ご注文くだ
さい。

title: Japanese garden of Hirakushi Denchū
description:
Spring has come again this year.

The sculptor Hirakushi Denchū moved to this place at the age of ninety-eight.

For the next twenty, thirty years, he bought camphor trees to carve sculptures, astonishing those around him.

Perhaps Hirakushi Denchū is still gazing at this garden, continuing to carve sculptures.

From this elegant yet powerful scenery,

I feel as if I can hear the breath of Hirakushi Denchū, who is unyielding to anything.

(Details: https://kodaira-tourism.com/spot/5880/)
【Kodaira City Hirakushi Denchū Sculpture Museum】

The Hirakushi Denchū Sculpture Museum was opened in October 1984 to preserve the residence of the master of modern Japanese sculpture, Hirakushi Denchū (recipient of the Order of Culture, honorary citizen of Kodaira City), and to widely open it to the public. In February 1994, a new exhibition hall was built to display and preserve valuable wooden sculptures, and it has since become a museum with two facilities.
The memorial hall is a beautiful building designed in the Shoin style by Hiroshi Oe, who also worked on the National Noh Theatre. The beautiful garden overlooking the Tamagawa Josui is a charm.
The exhibition hall hosts four planned exhibitions and special exhibitions (held every other year) throughout the year.
Various events such as tea ceremonies (spring and autumn) and family art museum activities are held.
Additionally, there is a service where you can enjoy audio and image explanations of the works using multifunctional terminals, so please visit us.

【Opening Hours】
10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
*Please enter by 3:30 PM if possible.

【Closed Days】
Tuesdays (open if it falls on a holiday or substitute holiday, and closed the following day)

【Admission Fees】
General…300 yen (220 yen)
Elementary and junior high school students…150 yen (110 yen)
*The prices in parentheses are for groups of 20 or more.

【Access】
- 10 minutes walk from Seibu Tamako Line "Hitotsubashi Gakuen" Station South Exit
- 5 minutes by taxi from JR Musashino Line "Shin-Kodaira" Station
- 5 minutes by taxi from Seibu Line "Kokubunji" Station
*There is no parking at our museum. Please contact us if you need to use a parking lot.

【Contact】
Kodaira City Hirakushi Denchū Sculpture Museum
☎042 (341) 0098
URL http://denchu-museum.jp

【Upcoming Exhibitions and Event Information】

◆ "Sculpture and Dolls" ◆
Where is the boundary between sculpture and dolls? While enjoying various dolls collected by Hirakushi Denchū, such as creative dolls, Ichimatsu dolls, and antique dolls, why not ponder this question?

From February 7, 2018 (Wednesday) to May 20, 2018 (Sunday)

◆ Limited-time "Hinamatsuri Display" ◆
During the exhibition period until March 19 (Monday), we will display "Dairi-bina" made by Tanaka for his daughter, along with various hina dolls collected by Tanaka.

From February 7, 2018 (Wednesday) to March 19, 2018 (Monday)

◆ Limited-time "Birth Buddha Display" ◆
In conjunction with the time of the "Kanbutsue" (Buddha's Birth Celebration), we will display the "Namu Birth Buddha" created by Hirakushi Denchū. The "Namu Birth Buddha" is housed in a shrine made by architect Hiroshi Oe, who designed the memorial hall (former residence of Hirakushi Denchū). Please enjoy this along with Denchū's sculptures.

From March 21, 2018 (Wednesday, holiday) to April 16, 2018 (Monday)

◆ Would you like to enjoy a bento while gazing at the spring garden? ◆
The museum garden has entered the beautiful season of plum blossoms. While enjoying the spring museum garden, why not taste the "Hirakushi Denchū Bento"? During the period, if you pick up the "Hirakushi Denchū Bento" at the museum, you can enjoy it in the memorial hall's Japanese-style room. Please order your bento from Maruyasu Shoten.

From February 28, 2018 (Wednesday) to March 19, 2018 (Monday) from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM
*It may be canceled due to museum circumstances.

◆ Spring Tea Ceremony & Primula Display ◆
In the garden loved by Hirakushi Denchū, you can enjoy delicious matcha and the scenery. A beautiful display of primulas will also be held in conjunction with the tea ceremony.

It features two peaks, Mount Nantai and Mount Nyotai, and has long been revered as a sacred mountain.
The hiking trails to Mount Tsukuba allow visitors to enjoy historical towns that retain the charm of the Edo period, with signposts and traditional storehouses, making it an attractive destination for nature lovers year-round.
Additionally, with the use of cable cars and ropeways, reaching the summit is easy, allowing everyone from children to the elderly to enjoy the beautiful views.

Hitachi Seaside Park　（Japan）
Welcome to “Everywhere Blue World,” of sky blue, ocean blue, and nemophoila blue, which makes you feel refreshed.
With an area of about 190 ha, Hitachi seaside park boasts its wide variety of seasonal flower gardens such as narcissus and tulip in spring, nemophila and rose in early summer, zinnia in summer and kochia and cosmos in autumn.
An amusement park (cycling road, BMX course, athletic field, BBQ space) is set up as an annex.


國營常陸海濱公園　（日本）
面積約153.2公頃的園內，隨處可見大規模的花圃，春天是水仙、郁金香，初夏是粉蝶花(nemophila)、薔薇，夏天是百日菊（zinnia）,秋天是笤帚草、大波斯菊等等，四季都有特色各異的花草供遊客觀賞。
園內備有自行車路線，可乘自行車巡回觀賞。園內還有25種以上吸引人的“娛樂花園”、 ＢＭＸ路線和林間體育廣場、野餐廣場等等，供遊客盡情享受。


国营常陆海滨公园　　（日本）
面积约153.2公顷的园内，随处可见大规模的花圃，春季是水仙、郁金香，初夏是粉蝶花(nemophila)、蔷薇，夏天是百日菊（zinnia）,秋天是扫帚草、大波斯菊等等，四季都有特色各异的花草供游客观赏。
园内备有自行车专用线路，可乘自行车巡回观赏。园内还有25种以上吸引人的“娱乐花园”、 ＢＭＸ路线和林间体育广场、野餐广场等等，供游客尽情享受


국영 히타치 해변 공원　（일본）
개원 면적 약 190ha에 달하는 원내에는 이곳 저곳에 대규모 꽃밭이 있어, 봄에는 수선화, 튤립, 초여름에는 네모필라, 장미, 여름에는 백일홍, 가을에는 코키아(댑싸리)와 코스모스로 사계절마다의 꽃이 찾는 이들의 눈을 즐겁게 해 줍니다.
사이클링 코스도 정비되어 있어 자전거로 넓은 원내를 돌며 볼 수도 있습니다. 또한 25 종류 이상의 어트랙션을 즐길 수 있는 놀이공원 '프레저가든'외에 BMX 코스나 임간 애슬래틱 광장, 바베큐 광장등도 있어 끝없이즐길 수 있습니다.


Công viên ven biển Hitachi　（Nhật Bản）
Công viên Hitachi là một công viên đầy hoa với những bông hoa tuyệt vời nở quanh năm. Công viên này đặc biệt nổi tiếng với hoa Nemophilas. 
Vào khoảng tháng 5 hàng năm, khoảng 4.5 triệu bông hoa Nemophilas với đường kính bông hoa vào khoảng 3cm nở xanh cả sườn đồi.
Đặt biệt hơn nữa, khi đứng giữa đồi hoa Nemophilas,người ta có cảm giác như đang hòa mình vào đại dương xanh mênh mông tựa như bầu trời đang sa dần xuống mặt đất.

title: 【絶景茨城】 茨城の水辺　- Relaxation in IBARAKI -
description:
茨城の滝や渓谷などの水辺を紹介します。
【月待の滝】
大子町の月待の滝は久慈川の支流・大生瀬川がつくり出す、高さ17メートル・幅12メートルの三筋に流れ落ちる滝です。
水の後ろに回り込んで、滝を裏側から見ることができます。
夏には子どもの水遊び、秋は紅葉、冬は氷瀑と、季節に応じて様々な姿を見せてくれます。

【竜神峡】
常陸太田市の竜神峡は、奥久慈県立自然公園に位置するV字形の美しい渓谷です。竜神ダムの上に竜神峡のシンボル竜神大吊橋がかかります。峡谷のほぼ中央に位置する亀ヶ淵は清らかな水をたたえ、竜神ダムから歩いて訪れることができます。
冬はバードウォッチング，春から秋にかけては小鳥の声を聞きながらの自然散策に最適。遊歩道も整備されていて春のツツジから秋の紅葉まで楽しめます。

【花貫渓谷】
高萩市の花貫渓谷は、大小さまざまな淵と滝が連なり、四季折々の渓谷の自然を楽しむことができます。春の新緑と秋の紅葉、冬は雪景色。花貫渓谷では季節とともに移り変わる自然の姿を楽しむことができます。
上流の汐見滝吊り橋からは、眼下に勢いよく流れ落ちる汐見滝の姿や小さな淵をぬって流れる花貫川の清流に出会うことができます。下流の乙女滝・不動滝周辺では夏にかけては新緑が生い茂り花貫川を流れる水も空気も澄んでいて、清涼感を感じられるスポットです。秋は、紅葉と滝を同時に楽しむことが出来ます。

＃茨城県　＃月待の滝　＃竜神峡　＃花貫渓谷　＃大子町　＃常陸太田市　＃高萩市

title: [Spectacular Ibaraki] The Waterside of Ibaraki - Relaxation in IBARAKI -
description:
Introducing the waterside of Ibaraki, including waterfalls and valleys.

[Tsukimachi Falls]
Tsukimachi Falls in Daigo Town is a waterfall that flows down in three streams, with a height of 17 meters and a width of 12 meters, created by the Oonase River, a tributary of the Kuji River. 
You can walk behind the water and see the waterfall from the back. 
In summer, it is a place for children's water play, in autumn, it showcases beautiful foliage, and in winter, it transforms into an icefall, presenting various appearances according to the seasons.

[Ryujin Gorge]
Ryujin Gorge in Hitachiota City is a beautiful V-shaped gorge located in the Oku-Kuji Prefectural Natural Park. The symbol of Ryujin Gorge, the Ryujin Big Suspension Bridge, spans over the Ryujin Dam. 
Kamega-uchi, located almost in the center of the gorge, holds clear water and can be visited by walking from the Ryujin Dam. 
In winter, it is perfect for bird watching, and from spring to autumn, it is ideal for nature walks while listening to the songs of small birds. 
The walking paths are well-maintained, allowing enjoyment from spring azaleas to autumn foliage.

[Hanakuni Gorge]
Hanakuni Gorge in Takahagi City features various pools and waterfalls, allowing you to enjoy the natural beauty of the gorge throughout the seasons. 
In spring, you can see fresh greenery, in autumn, beautiful foliage, and in winter, a snowy landscape. 
At Hanakuni Gorge, you can enjoy the changing natural scenery with the seasons. 
From the Shio-mi Falls suspension bridge upstream, you can encounter the powerful Shio-mi Falls flowing below and the clear waters of the Hanakuni River winding through small pools. 
Around the downstream areas of Otome Falls and Fudo Falls, lush greenery flourishes in summer, and both the water flowing in the Hanakuni River and the air are clear, making it a refreshing spot. 
In autumn, you can enjoy both the foliage and the waterfalls at the same time.

title: 松山城天守閣に行ってきました！
description: ここは、愛媛県松山市にある松山城です。松山城には、加藤嘉明の鎧や当時使われていた武器が展示されています。その他にも、武装服を試着できたり、松山城小天守復興の様子のビデオを視聴することもできます。そして、天守閣では360°のパノラマを見ることができます！RyoFさんが松山城入口までの景色を撮影しております！→https://youtu.be/T1l3eHh-TaQ

title: I visited Matsuyama Castle's Main Keep!
description: This is Matsuyama Castle located in Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture. Matsuyama Castle displays armor worn by Kato Yoshiaki and weapons used at that time. Additionally, you can try on armored clothing and watch a video of the restoration of the Matsuyama Castle's small keep. Moreover, you can enjoy a 360° panorama from the main keep! RyoF has captured the scenery leading to the entrance of Matsuyama Castle! → https://youtu.be/T1l3eHh-TaQ

description: ここは、高知県高知市丸ノ内１丁目２−２−１にある高知城です。 詳しい情報はこちら！→http://kochipark.jp/kochijyo/ そしてこの動画の最後には、高知県高知市の日曜市を撮影しております。 日曜市についての詳しい情報はこちら！→http://www.city.kochi.kochi.jp/soshiki/39/nichiyouichi.html

description: This is Kochi Castle located at 1-2-2-1 Marunouchi, Kochi City, Kochi Prefecture. title: 大洲城に行ってきました！
description: ここは、愛媛県大洲市大洲９０３にある大洲城です。大洲城には、2004年に復元された天守をはじめ、国指定重要文化財に選定された4棟の櫓があります。そしてこの動画の最後には、愛媛県松山市を流れる宮前川にいたコガモを撮影しております。

title: I visited Ozu Castle!
description: This is Ozu Castle, located at 903 Ozu, Ozu City, Ehime Prefecture. Ozu Castle features the main keep, which was restored in 2004, as well as four turrets designated as Important Cultural Properties by the national government. At the end of this video, we also captured footage of a female teal that was in the Miyamae River flowing through Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture.

title: 宇和島城に行ってきました！(天守編)
description:
ここは、愛媛県宇和島市にある宇和島城です。宇和島城は、標高80mの丘上に築かれた平山城です。伊達氏2代宗利が大改修し現在の形になってます。天守閣は国指定重要文化財です。そしてこの動画の最後には、愛媛県宇和島市にいた猫を撮影しております。 登城編→https://youtu.be/bJbAEg2EYcE

title: I visited Uwajima Castle! (Main Keep Edition)
description:
This is Uwajima Castle located in Uwajima City, Ehime Prefecture. Uwajima Castle is a flatland castle built on a hill at an elevation of 80m. It was significantly renovated by the second generation of the Date clan, Muneyoshi, to take its current form. The main keep is a nationally designated important cultural property. At the end of this video, I have captured a cat that was in Uwajima City, Ehime Prefecture. Castle Climbing Edition → https://youtu.be/bJbAEg2EYcE

title: Enchanting Tokyo  - Is this really Tokyo? -  Volcano Island OSHIMA  (Full ver.) / 絶景！大島 三原山火口をドローン空撮
description:
OSHIMA Island
1 hour 45 minutes (minimum) from central Tokyo by high-speed jet ferry . 
Enjoy the island’s dynamic scenery, with views such as Mt. Mihara, the volcanic crater you can see close, a vast ‘desert’ and ‘Fudeshima’, the brush-like rock protruding from the sea surface. Be it camping or cycling, there are activities for you to immerse yourself in the rich nature of the island. 
Full of charm, Oshima Island is waiting to enchant   you. 

Oshima tourist information:
https://www.gotokyo.org/jp/destinations/izu-and-ogasawara-islands/oshima-island/index.html

────────────────────────────
東京都心から高速ジェット船で最短1時間45分。
間近で見ることのできる三原山の火口、広大な「砂漠」、海面から突き出た岩「筆島」などのダイナミックな景観と、自転車、キャンプなど豊かな自然の中で楽しむアクティビティ。
魅力あふれる大島でお待ちしています。

大島観光情報

title: Enchanting Tokyo HACHIJOJIMA Island (Full ver.)／八丈島
description:
Hachijojima Island, which is less than an hour’s flight from Tokyo, is an island where you can enjoy the great outdoors. With one of the highest precipitation rates in Japan, Hachijojima has its own unique environment including giant ferns and potholes carved into the rock by ever-flowing spring water. On the island, you can enjoy hiking as well as running and fishing. After enjoying physical activities, visitors can relax in a natural hot spring surrounded by rich nature, making it the perfect environment for a refreshing weekend getaway. 

Access
・Airplane (Haneda Airport-Hachijojima Airport) 3 flights/day [approximately 55 minutes, one way]
・Boat (Takeshiba Pier, Tokyo- Hachijojima, Sokodo or Yaene Port): Runs daily [10 hours and 20 minutes, one way]

Hachijojima Tourist Information
https://www.gotokyo.org/en/destinations/izu-and-ogasawara-islands/hachijojima-island/index.html 

東京から飛行機で1時間弱で到着する八丈島は、大自然と向き合える島です。日本でも降水量がトップクラスとなる八丈島は、巨大なシダ植物や、枯れることのない湧水によって岩盤が削られたポットホールなど独自の自然を育んでいます。島ではトレッキングはもちろんランニングや釣りなども楽しめます。身体を動かすアクティビティを楽しんだ後は、豊かな自然に囲まれた天然温泉でリラックスすることができ、週末のリフレッシュには最適な環境です。

アクセス
・飛行機（羽田空港－八丈島空港）：1日3便［片道約55分］
・船（東京・竹芝桟橋－八丈島・底土または八重根港）：毎日運航［片道約10時間20分］

八丈島観光情報
https://www.gotokyo.org/jp/destinations/izu-and-ogasawara-islands/hachijojima-island/index.html

title: Enchanting Tokyo AOGASHIMA Island (Full ver.)／青ヶ島
description:
Aogashima Island, located 358 kilometers (222 miles) south of urban Tokyo in the Pacific Ocean, was the only Japanese location selected as the “World’s Top 13 Most Beautiful Views to See Before you Die” by a US-based NGO, thereby attracting attention from around the world. The video “Enchanting Tokyo AOGASHIMA Island” introduces the unique landscape of the island, including the world-famous double caldera and geothermic “hingya” steam eruptions. The video also explores the island’s way of life and beliefs that coexist in harmony with nature. 

Access
・Helicopter (Hachijojima Airport-Aogashima Heliport): 1 flight/day [20 minutes, one way]
・Boat (Hachijojima, Sokodo or Yaene Port-Aogashima, Sanpo Port): 4-5 trips weekly [2 hours and 30 minutes, one way]

Aogashima Tourist Information
https://www.gotokyo.org/en/destinations/izu-and-ogasawara-islands/aogashima-island/index.html 

東京から南に358㎞離れた太平洋上に浮かぶ青ヶ島は、アメリカ・環境保護NGOによって「死ぬまでに見るべき世界の絶景13選」に日本で唯一選出（2014年）され、世界中から注目を集めています。Enchanting Tokyo AOGASHIMA Island（動画）では、世界的にもめずらしい二重カルデラや、地熱によって水蒸気が噴出する「ひんぎゃ」など、他には見られない景観を紹介しています。さらに、自然と共生する島のくらしや、信仰などにも迫っています。

title: Enchanting Tokyo AOGASHIMA Island (Full ver.)／青ヶ島
description:
Aogashima Island, located 358 kilometers (222 miles) south of urban Tokyo in the Pacific Ocean, was the only Japanese location selected as the “World’s Top 13 Most Beautiful Views to See Before you Die” by a US-based NGO, thereby attracting attention from around the world.
The video “Enchanting Tokyo AOGASHIMA Island” introduces the unique landscape of the island, including the world-famous double caldera and geothermic “hingya” steam eruptions.
The video also explores the island’s way of life and beliefs that coexist in harmony with nature.

Access
・Helicopter (Hachijojima Airport-Aogashima Heliport): 1 flight/day [20 minutes, one way]
・Boat (Hachijojima, Sokodo or Yaene Port-Aogashima, Sanpo Port): 4-5 trips weekly [2 hours and 30 minutes, one way]

Aogashima Tourist Information
https://www.gotokyo.org/en/destinations/izu-and-ogasawara-islands/aogashima-island/index.html

東京から南に358㎞離れた太平洋上に浮かぶ青ヶ島は、アメリカ・環境保護NGOによって「死ぬまでに見るべき世界の絶景13選」に日本で唯一選出（2014年）され、世界中から注目を集めています。
Enchanting Tokyo AOGASHIMA Island（動画）では、世界的にもめずらしい二重カルデラや、地熱によって水蒸気が噴出する「ひんぎゃ」など、他には見られない景観を紹介しています。
さらに、自然と共生する島のくらしや、信仰などにも迫っています。

title: 千年の草原
description:
九州熊本県阿蘇地方。
27万年前からの度重なる大噴火で出来たカルデラと呼ばれるくぼ地に、約5万人が暮らす、世界でも珍しい場所です。
カルデラの中央には、今も噴煙を上げる活火山阿蘇山がそびえ、その周辺には日本最大の草原地帯が広がります。
この唯一無二の空間は、国立公園、ユネスコ世界ジオパーク、世界農業遺産にも認定されています。

#阿蘇の草原 #サステナブル #千年の草原

title: Thousand-Year Grassland
description:
Kumamoto Prefecture, Aso region in Kyushu.

This is a rare place in the world where about 50,000 people live in a caldera, a depression formed by repeated massive eruptions over the past 270,000 years.

At the center of the caldera stands the active volcano Mount Aso, which still emits smoke, and surrounding it is Japan's largest grassland area.

This unique space has been designated as a national park, a UNESCO Global Geopark, and a World Agricultural Heritage site.

#AsoGrassland #Sustainable #ThousandYearGrassland

title: [Excellent Award] 004 Morioka Castle Let's try 'Tojo'
description:
The Nanbu clan has an 800-year history. Morioka Castle, which served as their residence, is selected as one of Japan's 100 Famous Castles and is counted among the three famous castles of Tohoku. However, perhaps due to the absence of a main keep, its name recognition is weak. Still, Morioka Castle has its own charm! Even without a restored main keep, there is a place here where you can reflect on the Edo period!! With this sentiment in mind, we aimed to create a promotional video for Morioka Castle themed around 'Castle Climbing.' 
Additionally, we have included explanations in subtitles (in Japanese and English) for viewing on company PCs and smartphones.

title: 大佐渡石名天然杉遊歩道【夏編】
description:
大佐渡山脈の北部にある県有林石名団地には、特異な形状の巨杉が生育しています。
新潟県では、この雄大な天然杉を安全にご覧いただけるように遊歩道を整備しました。
起伏の少ないコースなので、子どもの自然学習の場としても安心してお薦めできます。

title: Ogasawara Ishina Natural Cedar Walking Path [Summer Edition]
description:
In the Ishina district of the prefectural forest located in the northern part of the Ogasawara mountain range, unique-shaped giant cedars are growing.
In Niigata Prefecture, a walking path has been developed to allow visitors to safely view these magnificent natural cedars.
The course has little elevation change, making it a safe and recommended place for children's nature learning.

title: 大佐渡石名天然杉遊歩道【霧編】
description:
大佐渡山脈の北部にある県有林石名団地には、特異な形状の巨杉が生育しています。
新潟県では、この雄大な天然杉を安全にご覧いただけるように遊歩道を整備しました。
霧に包まれた幻想的な森で、じっとり露に濡れた樹皮をまとう杉の巨木をご覧いただけます。

title: Ogasawara Shina Natural Cedar Walking Path [Fog Edition]
description:
In the Shina district of the prefectural forest located in the northern part of the Ogasawara mountain range, unique giant cedars are growing.
In Niigata Prefecture, a walking path has been developed to allow visitors to safely view these magnificent natural cedars.
In a fantastical forest shrouded in mist, you can see the giant cedars draped in dewy bark.

title: 【Tokyo Chuo City tourism introduction movie】食（Food）version (English/3min. version）
description:
This is a promotional video to introduce various tourist attractions of Tokyo Chuo City.
The "Food" version of the video is based on the concept of "everything you may want to eat in Japan can be found in Chuo City." Centered on "Japanese food," now registered as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, enjoy dishes that have existed since the Edo period, including sushi, eel, soba and tempura. The theme of food continues with the tastes of the people, such as ramen noodles and local bars, and a selection of Japanese confections.
With beautiful shots of delicious food, chefs showing off their talents and sweets that'll have you salivating at just a glance, you can enjoy everything aside from actually eating the food! In Chuo City, one of the greatest gourmet cities in the world, experience a rich variety of Japanese food.

title: 【Tokyo Chuo City tourism introduction movie】食（Food）version (English/1.5min. version）
description:
This is a promotional video to introduce various tourist attractions of Tokyo Chuo City.
The "Food" version of the video is based on the concept of "everything you may want to eat in Japan can be found in Chuo City." Centered on "Japanese food," now registered as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, enjoy dishes that have existed since the Edo period, including sushi, eel, soba and tempura. The theme of food continues with the tastes of the people, such as ramen noodles and local bars, and a selection of Japanese confections.
With beautiful shots of delicious food, chefs showing off their talents and sweets that'll have you salivating at just a glance, you can enjoy everything aside from actually eating the food! In Chuo City, one of the greatest gourmet cities in the world, experience a rich variety of Japanese food.

title: 【Tokyo Chuo City tourism introduction movie】食（Food）version (English/15sec. version）
description:
This is a promotional video to introduce various tourist attractions of Tokyo Chuo City.
The "Food" version of the video is based on the concept of "everything you may want to eat in Japan can be found in Chuo City." Centered on "Japanese food," now registered as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, enjoy dishes that have existed since the Edo period, including sushi, eel, soba and tempura. The theme of food continues with the tastes of the people, such as ramen noodles and local bars, and a selection of Japanese confections.
With beautiful shots of delicious food, chefs showing off their talents and sweets that'll have you salivating at just a glance, you can enjoy everything aside from actually eating the food! In Chuo City, one of the greatest gourmet cities in the world, experience a rich variety of Japanese food.

title: 宇和島闘牛５月場所(2025.5.3)
description:
年に4回の 晴れ舞台のひとつ。
宇和島闘牛5月場所が2025年5月3日に行われました。
闘牛のルールは制限時間なしで牛同士が戦い、逃げた方が敗けというシンプルなものになっています。
お天気も良くゴールデンウィークということで入場者数は2400人を超える大入満員大盛況のうちに幕を閉じました。
2時間半に渡る長丁場でありましたが主な戦いの箇所をまとめました。
闘牛の魅力が少しでも伝われば良いかなと思っています。

One of the four big stages of the year.
The Uwajima Bullfighting May Tournament took place on May 3, 2025.
The rules of bullfighting are simple: bulls fight each other with no time limit, and the one that runs away loses.
The weather was fine, and it was Golden Week, so the event was a huge success, with over 2,400 attendees.
It was a long event lasting two and a half hours, but we have summarized the main fights.
We hope that we have been able to convey at least a little of the appeal of bullfighting.

title: Residence and Tulip Garden Public Viewing | チューリップガーデンEmbassy of the Netherlands in Japan
description:
#happydutchspring2022 #nlinjapan #tulips #netherlandsandyou #netherlandsinjapan

The Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Japan hosted a Residence and Tulip Garden Public Viewing last April 8 and 10, Friday and Sunday respectively. This is in view of welcoming the Dutch Spring this year, which features 70 kinds of tulips, the largest number ever.

“Tulips, the national flower of the Netherlands, along with other flowers, are a major export industry of the Netherlands. It is said that about 80% of the world's tulip fields are in the Netherlands. This year, the Ambassador's residence is decorated with about 13,000 tulips of 70 varieties, the largest number ever imported from the Netherlands.”- nlinjp.com

It is our pleasure to have joined and witnessed this event and we are pleased to share with you some of the lovely photos and videos we have captured during the said event. 


A special Thank You to the Ambassador of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Japan for sharing and hosting this rare opportunity to the public. It is our pleasure to have seen these Tulip varieties in your Residence giving us the Netherlands’ spring feels while in Japan.

title: 日本の日光を訪れるべき場所 パート1 | 旅行ガイド
description:
#nikko #japan #travel #traveljapan

日光（Nikkō）は、日光国立公園の入り口に位置する町で、最も豪華に装飾された神社である東照宮と、徳川幕府の創始者である徳川家康の霊廟で最も有名です。

日光は1600年代に東照宮が建設される前から、何世紀にもわたり神道と仏教の山岳信仰の中心地でした。日光国立公園は、風光明媚な山の風景、湖、滝、温泉、野生の猿、ハイキングコースを提供し続けています。

title: Places to Visit in Nikko Japan Part1 | Travel Guide
description:
#nikko #japan #travel #traveljapan

Nikko (日光, Nikkō) is a town at the entrance to Nikko National Park, most famous for Toshogu, Japan's most lavishly decorated shrine and the mausoleum of Tokugawa Ieyasu, the founder of the Tokugawa shogunate.

Nikko had been a center of Shinto and Buddhist mountain worship for many centuries before Toshogu was built in the 1600s, and Nikko National Park continues to offer scenic, mountainous landscapes, lakes, waterfalls, hot springs, wild monkeys and hiking trails.

title: Chair Lift Ride at Mount Takao (Ascend) | Japan's Steepest Slope | 高尾山　チェアリフト
description:
#mttakao #chairlift #japan #mttakoadventures #steepestslopeinjapan #mttakaochairlift #japanadventures #mybestjapanmoments #visitjapanjp #viaggiatotravelservices

Mount Takao (高尾山, Takao-san) is a mountain in the city of Hachiōji, Tokyo, Japan. It is protected within Meiji no Mori Takao Quasi-National Park.

Standing 599 metres (1,965 ft) tall and located within an hour of downtown Tokyo, it is a popular hiking spot, with eight hiking courses and more than 2.5 million annual visitors. The Tama Forest Science Garden is also located at the mountain's base.

THE CHAIR LIFT RIDE

In addition to the cable car Mt. Takao also has a chair lift that you can ride to the midway point of the mountain!
The ride time is about 12 minutes so why not enjoy an aerial trip through the mountains?

The distance from “Sanroku Station” at the foot of the mountain to “Sanjo Station” in the middle is about 872m, which is shorter than the distance the cable car travels (The cable car travels a total of 1,020m).

title: Steepest Slope in Japan | Mount Takao Cable Car Ride | Autumn Colors | 高尾山　Takaosan
description:
#mttakao #高尾山 #steepestslopeinjapan #japan #cablecar #autumn #fallfoliage #takaosan #nocopyright #relaxingmusic #slope #fall  #autuminjapan #秋 #秋葉原 #紅葉 #mttakaocablecar

Today we are gonna show you the steepest slope in Japan, the Mt. Takao. Join us as we descend from the mountain top to  its base riding a cable car, showing the autumn view of the beautiful and vibrant trees around. Get relaxed with this 6-min trip and get amazed with this nature's wonders. 

Mount Takao (高尾山, Takao-san) is a mountain in the city of Hachiōji, Tokyo, Japan. It is protected within Meiji no Mori Takao Quasi-National Park.

Standing 599 metres (1,965 ft) tall and located within an hour of downtown Tokyo, it is a popular hiking spot, with eight hiking courses and more than 2.5 million annual visitors. The Tama Forest Science Garden is also located at the mountain's base.

Mount Takao is closely associated with the Shinto-Buddhist tengu, minor kami from Japanese folklore, and the daitengu Naigubu. The mountain is also renowned for Shugendō, the mountain asceticism focusing on strict discipline. A Buddhist temple, Takaosan Yakuōin Yūkiji, is located on the mountain, and attracts many visitors who pray to the tengu for good fortune. The temple belongs to the Shingon Buddhist sect.

source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Takao

title: Autumn at Shinobazu Pond | Boat Ride | Ueno Park | 不忍池　上野公園
description:
#shinobazupond #shinobazunoike #uenopark #autumn #boatride #boatpond #japan #tokyo ＃不忍池　＃上野公園


Come and join us as we show you the relaxing view of autumn at Shinobazu Pond. 

Shinobazu no Ike which is found within the Ueno Park in Taito Ku Tokyo, is historically prominent and usuallly appears in Japanese history and works of art.

If you wanna ride a boat on the boat pond, make sure to wear a mask, sanitize your hands and let the staff check your temperature. Ticket machine is available at the entrance. 

The price of boat ride varies with the type of boat you wanna ride on to. A Cycle boat costs 700 yen, maximum of 2 adults for 30 mins. Swan boat costs 800 yen maximum 3adults for 30 mins. While a row boat costs 500 yen maximum of 3 adults for 30mins.  

Situated in the south of Ueno Park, the pond is divided in three sections. The Lotus Pond (蓮の池, Hasu no Ike), the Boat Pond (ボートの池, Bōto no Ike) and the third called Cormorant Pond (鵜の池, U no Ike).

The pond has a circumference of about 2 km and a surface area of about 1,100,000 sq meters. It hosts several dozens of types of migratory and stationary birds, whose number at times is over ten thousand. Among them particularly numerous are tufted ducks, pochard, and northern pintails.
The pond also contains numerous species of fish, 
and the lotuses of Lotus Pond, which are grown fully in summer, cover the entire surface of the water, hiding it almost completely.

title: Fujikawaguchiko Autumn Leaves Festival 2021 | 富士河口湖紅葉まつり 2021 | Mt Fuji Bound
description:
#fujikawaguchikoautumnleavesfestival2021 #fujikawaguchiko #autumnfestival #japan #富士河口湖紅葉まつり #mtfuji #mybestjapanmoments #visitjapanjp #falfoliage #autumninjapan #viaggiatotravelservices

Fuji Kawaguchiko Autumn Leaves Festival (富士河口湖紅葉まつり) is one of the most popular autumn events in Japan which is annually held at the northern shore of Lake Kawaguchi, one of the Fuji Five Lakes. This year’s festival is held from Oct.30 to Nov.23 2021. 

The event features colourful autumn leaves which stretch around Lake Kawaguchi area, and during daytime, the beautiful scenery can be enjoyed with the amazing view of Mt Fuji on the background.

The festival is centered around the “Momiji Corridor” or Momiji Kairo and is held from 9:00 in the morning. While the light up starts from sunset to 10:00 at night.

The most popular autumn leaves spot is the Momiji Kairo (もみじ回廊) a.k.a. the Maple Corridor.

This is a walkway lined by over 60 maple trees with autumn colour leaves. The trees with red, yellow and orange leaves stretch for about 2km, displaying the stunning scenery.

During the festival, there will be food stalls selling seasonal foods and drinks, as well as small stores selling local products and souvenirs. oh and by the way, most of these souvenirs are hand painted and handmade.

title: Autumn at Ueno Park Tokyo | 上野公園
description:
#travelvlog #uenopark #uenotokyo #tokyojapan #autumnatuenopark

hey guys welcome to Ueno Park in Tokyo!

Ueno Park (上野公園, Ueno Kōen) is a large public park next to Ueno Station in central Tokyo. The park grounds were originally part of Kaneiji Temple, which used to be one of the city's largest and wealthiest temples and a family temple of the ruling Tokugawa clan during the Edo Period. Kaneiji stood in the northeast of the capital to protect the city from evil, much like Enryakuji Temple in Kyoto.

During the Boshin Civil War, which followed the Meiji Restoration in 1868, Kaneiji suffered nearly complete destruction in a battle between the victorious forces of the new Meiji government and loyalists of the overthrown shogunate. After the battle, the temple grounds were converted into one of Japan's first Western style parks and opened to the public in 1873. A statue of Saigo Takamori, one of the generals in the Battle of Ueno, stands near the park's southern entrance.

At the southwestern end of the park lies Shinobazu Pond, one of many reminders of Kaneiji Temple's former grandeur. The pond represents Lake Biwako (in a reference to Kaneiji's model, the Enryakuji Temple of Kyoto, which overlooks Lake Biwako). On an island in the middle of the pond stands Bentendo, a temple hall dedicated to the goddess of Benten.

Today Ueno Park is famous for the many museums found on its grounds, especially the Tokyo National Museum, the National Museum for Western Art, the Tokyo Metropolitan Art Museum and the National Science Museum. It is also home to Ueno Zoo, Japan's first zoological garden.

Additionally, Ueno Park is one of Tokyo's most popular and lively cherry blossom spots with more than 1000 cherry trees lining its central pathway. The cherry blossoms are usually in bloom during late March and early April and attract large numbers of hanami (cherry blossom viewing) parties.

source: Ueno Park - https://www.japan-guide.com/e/e3019.html

title: Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome | Annual Halloween Pumpkin Month | 夢の島熱帯植物館| ハロウィーンのカボチャ
description:
#yumenoshimatropicalgreenhousedome #halloweentheme #pumpkinpatch #夢の島熱帯植物館 #ハロウィーンのカボチャ
Today we’re gonna explore the Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome.

The Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome was created to cover this broad theme of “the relationship between tropical plants and our lives.”
Enjoy the exotic scenery created by the wide variety of tropical plants in the large greenhouse. Learn about the plants and the tropics in the Movie Theater, Information Gallery, and Exhibition Hall. Take a full tour of the museum and learn about the relationship between tropical plants and human life without even realizing it.
Guided tours are offered on Saturdays, Sundays, national holidays, and during long vacations. Enjoy a fun tour while learning in detail about the plants in the greenhouse.

"The Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome (夢の島熱帯植物館, Yumenoshima Nettai Shokubutsukan), also sometimes called the Yumenoshima Tropical Plant Dome, is a botanical garden located at 3-2, Yumenoshima, Kōtō, Tokyo, Japan. It is operated by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association and open daily except Mondays; an admission fee is charged.

The greenhouse was established in 1988 in Yumenoshima ("Dream Island") Park, a reclaimed landfill and dumping ground in Tokyo Bay. Its three domes currently contain about 1,000 species of tropical and semitropical plants. The A Dome features rain forest with ferns and waterfall, B Dome represents a tropical village, and C Dome contains vegetation of the Ogasawara Islands. There is also a small carnivorous plant room.

The domes' plant collections include palms, orchids, aquatic plants, Pandanus, Hevea brasiliensis, Samanea saman, Barringtonia racemosa, Satakentia liukiuensis, Cyathea lepifera, C. mertensiana, C. spinulosa, and Dicksonia antarctica." -Wikipedia

Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome is celebrating their annual Halloween Pumpkin Month from end of September to First of November. You will see their Halloween theme all around the area, inside the museum and on their front lawn or garden are giant pumpkins where you and your kids can play around. Enjoy and shoot lovely Autumn and Halloween photos which will be a great memorabilia for you and your kids! 

10 minute walk from Shin-Kiba Station, which is 10 minutes from Tokyo Station on the Keiyo Line. Also accessible on the Yurakucho Line.

Fees:  Adults 250 yen,
Ages 65 yrs old and older 120 yen, 
Ages 13–15 yrs old 100 yen. 
Under 12 yrs old are FREE!

Address: 2 Chome-1 Yumenoshima, Koto City, Tokyo 136-0081

Phone Number: 03-3522-0281

title: Giant Halloween Pumpkins 2021 at Yumenoshima | Halloween Pumpkins | Halloween Party | ハロウィンパーティー2021
description:
#yumenoshimahalloweenparty2021 #halloweenpumpkins #halloweenintokyo #halloween2021

Welcome back to Yumenoshima tropical greenhouse dome. As you can see on our last posted video, Daddy and i were here and we enjoyed much with the tropical plants in the dome. And since Jt was not with us that day, we went back here today and we will be enjoying with the giant halloween pumpkins. 

An exhibition of these giant ghost pumpkins, which they call Yumenoshima halloween party, is celebrated and very popular every year. And since the halloween is just around the corner, this event is already happening right now. It started on the 22nd of September and will last until the 31st of October. 

They will exhibit more than 100 giant ghost pumpkins weighing 50 to 100 kilograms. Can you imagine how heavy and big is that? These giant pumpkins were made in Hitachiomiya City, in Ibaraki Prefecture, in connection with the Halloween. 

With an admission fee of 250 yen for each adult, you can roam around the greenhouse dome, learn and enjoy the tropical plants which you barely see everyday. Kids under 12 years old can enter free of charge. And for sure your toddlers will have fun with these giant ghost pumpkins all around the open garden. There will also be a photography area just inside the hall with the halloween backdrops. So you better grab your favorite halloween costumes and get ready for memorable photos.

You can also bring your own food and have a small picnic in the garden together with these ghost pumpkins, orrr, you can just go to the cafeteria inside the hall and grab any food of your choice.

Event Date and Hours: 
September 22– Sunday,Tuesday–Sunday  9:30 – 17:00 (Last entry 16:00). Closed on Monday. If Monday is a public holiday they will open and close on Tuesday.

Cost: Fees: Adults 250 yen, Ages 65 and older 120 yen, Ages 13–15 100 yen
Under 12 FREE!

Address: 2-1-2 Yumenoshima, Koto-ku
Phone: 03-3522-0281
Website: http://www.yumenoshima.jp/

Note: this is in Japanese language. You can use google chrome too as it has an automatic translator if you wish to view it in English.

Access: 10 minute walk from Shin-Kiba Station, which is 10 minutes from Tokyo Station on the Keiyo Line. Also accessible on the Yurakucho Line.

You can also access the Metro Tozai line’s Toyocho Station and take the Toei Bus going to Shinkiba, get off at the Yumenoshima Stop and from there you can walk 7mins to Greenhouse Dome.

Notes: Nursing room and Diaper changing table located in the Botanical Garden. Please ask the staff for directions.

title: Fuji Shibazakura Festival 2021 | Mt. Fuji Tour | 富士芝桜
description:
#fujishibazakurafestival2021 #mtfujitour #mossphlox #pinkphlox #springinjapan #富士芝桜 #4K #mybestjapanmoments #visitjapanjp #viaggiatotravelservices #discoverjapan #mtfuji

Have you ever seen an enormous field carpeted with pink or white or purple flowers? If not, then we will show you this fantastic and mesmerizing Fuji Shibazakura Festival 2021 in Yamanashi, Japan, included in our Mt. Fuji Tour this Spring Season. Shibazakura 富士芝桜 is a Japanese term for Pink Phlox or Moss Phlox. 

The festival is open from 8 in the morning until 3 in the afternoon. Entrance fees range from 250yen per each child and 800 yen for adults.

During these days, the pink moss and all the flowers in the festival were not yet in full bloom. So as you can see, the fields are not yet fully covered with pink moss flowers. but during the full bloom days, its really mesmerizing with mt fuji on the background. 

The festival is typically held from mid April through early June. The best time to see the flowers varies from year to year but usually falls into the first three weeks of May. Approximately 800,000 stalks of shibazakura of five varieties are on display, producing delightful fields of pink, white and purple colors in different hues. There are also food trucks which offer a wide variety of menus and food to go as you enjoy the beauty of the scenery around you stalls selling pots of pink moss, shibazakura-themed souvenirs, food and local produce complete the experience.

Thank you for watching and please subscribe to our channel... See you on our next cooking video.

title: Shiraito no Taki | Shiraito Falls | 白糸の滝 | Mt. Fuji Tour
description:
#shiraitonotaki #shiraitofalls #白糸の滝 #mtfujitour #shizuoka #fujinomiya

Shiraito no Taki | Shiraito Falls | 白糸の滝 | Mt. Fuji Tour

Shiraito Falls (白糸の滝, Shiraito no taki) is a waterfall in Fujinomiya, Shizuoka Prefecture, near Mount Fuji, Japan. It is part of Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park and has been protected since 1936 as a Japanese Natural Monument.[1]

The falls were regarded as sacred under the Fuji cult. Another waterfall, the Otodome Falls is approximately a five-minute walk away.

The Shiraito Falls is listed as one of "Japan’s Top 100 Waterfalls", in a listing published by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment in 1990. It was also selected by the Tokyo Nichi Nichi Shimbun and Osaka Mainichi Shimbun.[2] as one of the 100 Landscapes of Japan in 1927. In 2013 the waterfall was added to the World Heritage List as part of the Fujisan Cultural Site.[3]

source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shiraito_Falls

title: Narusawa Ice Cave | Mt. Fuji Tour | 鳴沢氷穴 | Narusawa Hyōketsu
description:
#narusawa #narusawaicecave #mtfuji #yamanashi #japanadventures #touristsppotsinjapan #familyadventureinjapan

The Narusawa "Hyoketsu" Ice Cave is located at the east entrance to the Aokigahara Jukai "sea of trees" forest, and is regarded as one of the tourist spots within the Fuji Five Lakes area that can be visited throughout the year.
Over 1150 years ago, during year 6 of the Jogan era (864 a.d.), Nagaoyama, a flank volcano of Mt. Fuji erupted. The red hot lava flow (Aokigahara Maruo) descended between ancient parasitic volcanoes, creating this two-tunnel type cave. After being designated by the Ministry of Education as a natural monument in 1929, it was introduced to the world as a geological wonder.
By the way, the tree-type lava bed is said to have the most spiracles in the world.

Since the cave is situated in a ring-like manner, visitors can view its various features by making one circular loop.

The average temperature inside the cave is 3degC, that's why it is called an Ice Cave. The total length of the cave is 150m and requires 6-7 mins to have a complete view inside the cave.

title: Cherry Blossoms at Chidorigafuchi Ryokudo | 桜花見　千鳥ヶ淵緑道
description:
Artist#sakura #cherryblossoms #tokyo #chidorigafuchiryokudo #japan

This 700m promenade and park on the west side of the Imperial Palace is particularly impressive during cherry blossom season, when the around 250 sakura trees reach their heavy branches out over the Chidorigafuchi moat. Chidorigafuchi Boathouse, around the middle of the park, is where to rent a boat and paddle out over the water.

It is said that Chidorigafuchi was named because it has the shape of "Chidori". It used to be connected to Hanzo Moat, but it was reclaimed for road construction in 1883, and the moat was divided into two.Somei Yoshino cherry trees and wild cherry trees are planted on the banks of Chidorigafuchi and Hanzo moat, and together with the cherry blossoms of Chidorigafuchi Park managed by the 23 wards of the upper part of the bank, it is one of the most famous cherry blossom viewing spots in Tokyo.

Access:
Toei's Shinjuku Line - Kudanshita Station
Metro's Tozai Line - Kudanshita Station
Metro's Hanzomon Line - Hanzomon Station

title: Fuji Safari Park | 富士サファリパーク
description:
#fujisafaripark #fujizoo 

Fuji Safari Park

At the foot of Mt. Fuji lies this enormous animal park. Divided into 2 major zones, the Safari Zone and Fureai Zone. 

Safari Zone is a 50min drive through where you can find 7 zones of different animals from all over the world. Riding on your own car, you cannot open your windows or doors as it could be too dangerous. But there is an option of riding the Jungle Bus where you can feed the animals yourself. these huge animals come to the jungle bus seeking for food, as close as 20cm apart from you, with just steel mesh in between. You can also opt to try their 4WD vehicle and experience the same as the jungle bus, feed the animals as they come near you and wait to be fed.

The fureai zone on the other hand is extremely different as you can have a friendly contact with the animals. you can feed them upclose, hold them in your arms and caress them as long as you want. Great for kids and animal lovers. 

For more information, visit their website:
https://www.fujisafari.co.jp/en/

title: Mt. Takao Autumn Foliage | 高尾山紅葉
description:
#mttakao #高尾山 #steepestslopeinjapan #japan #cablecar #autumn #fallfoliage #takaosan #nocopyright #relaxingmusic #slope #fall  #autuminjapan #秋 #秋葉原 #紅葉 #mttakaocablecar

Today we are gonna show you the steepest slope in Japan, the Mt. Takao. Join us as we descend from the mountain top to  its base riding a cable car, showing the autumn view of the beautiful and vibrant trees around. Get relaxed with this 6-min trip and get amazed with this nature's wonders. 

Mount Takao (高尾山, Takao-san) is a mountain in the city of Hachiōji, Tokyo, Japan. It is protected within Meiji no Mori Takao Quasi-National Park.

Standing 599 metres (1,965 ft) tall and located within an hour of downtown Tokyo, it is a popular hiking spot, with eight hiking courses and more than 2.5 million annual visitors. The Tama Forest Science Garden is also located at the mountain's base.

Mount Takao is closely associated with the Shinto-Buddhist tengu, minor kami from Japanese folklore, and the daitengu Naigubu. The mountain is also renowned for Shugendō, the mountain asceticism focusing on strict discipline. A Buddhist temple, Takaosan Yakuōin Yūkiji, is located on the mountain, and attracts many visitors who pray to the tengu for good fortune. The temple belongs to the Shingon Buddhist sect.

source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Takao

title: SHOCHU TOURISM ～Discover Miyazaki Culture With Shochu～県西＆県南エリア（Western＆Southern Area）
description:
宮崎県は本格焼酎出荷量9年連続日本一を誇る焼酎の産地です。県では、焼酎づくり体験に加え、夜神楽等の鑑賞や通常は飲食で利用しない文化財を会場にしたメーカーズプレミアムディナーなど、本県の歴史・文化を感じながら、焼酎の魅力に触れるインバウンド向けの酒蔵ツーリズムを推進しています。宮崎の大自然や伝統とともに歩んでいる個性豊かな蔵元の見学と、宮崎グルメと焼酎のペアリングをぜひ体験してみてください。

Miyazaki Prefecture is a shochu-producing region that boasts the largest shipment of authentic shochu in Japan for 9 consecutive years. In promotion of Shochu Tourism, the prefecture not only offers opportunities for shochu-making, but tourists can also explore the charms of shochu and experience Miyazaki’s history and culture through activities such as watching Yokagura performances, enjoying Premium Dinner with shochu-craftsmen at cultural and heritage venues that are usually not used for dining. Come join us in touring our unique distillery that encompasses Miyazaki’s great nature and tradition, as well as try shochu pairing with Miyazaki’s local delicacies.

title: 【高知県】土佐の匠 「フラフ」
description:
空を彩る大きな旗「フラフ」。
主に高知市から東部でよく見られるこの旗は、子どもの健やかな成長を願って鯉のぼり等と一緒にあげられます。

title: [Kochi Prefecture] Tosa's Artisan 'Hrafu'
description:
A large flag 'Hrafu' that colors the sky.
This flag, often seen in the eastern part of Kochi City, is raised alongside carp streamers and others to wish for the healthy growth of children.

title: 小倉城周辺エリア
description: 小倉北区の中心部には、小倉城、北九州市役所、勝山公園などがあります。また街の中心部を流れる「紫川」には紫川自然再生のシンボルとして自然をテーマにしてデザインされた橋が10本かかっており、都心部の風景に溶け込んでいます。

title: Kokura Castle Area
description: In the center of Kokura Kita Ward, there are Kokura Castle, Kitakyushu City Hall, and Katsuyama Park. Additionally, the 'Murasaki River' flowing through the city center features 10 bridges designed with nature as a theme, symbolizing the natural restoration of the Murasaki River, blending seamlessly into the urban landscape.

title: 若戸大橋周辺エリア
description: 洞海湾にかかる赤色の若戸大橋、市民の足「若戸渡船」は懐かしさだ漂うエリア。かつて日本一の石炭の積出港として栄えた若松南海岸通りには、石炭会館、旧古河鉱業ビルなどの近代建築があり、かつての繁栄の面影が今も残っています。

title: Wakato Bridge Area
description: The red Wakato Bridge spanning Dokai Bay and the citizens' ferry 'Wakato Watashisen' create a nostalgic atmosphere in the area. Once thriving as Japan's top coal shipping port, the Wakamatsu Nankai Coast Road features modern architecture such as the Coal Hall and the old Furukawa Mining Building, which still bear the traces of its former prosperity.

title: 皿倉山
description: 標高６２２ｍの皿倉山。山麓駅から山頂駅まででケーブルカー、スロープカー乗継いで約10分で登ることができます。新日本三大夜景の１つで、市街地や工場群を一望できる絶景は「100億ドルの夜景」と言われています。

title: Mount Sarakura
description: Mount Sarakura stands at an elevation of 622 meters. You can reach the summit station from the base station in about 10 minutes by transferring between the cable car and the slope car. It is one of the New Three Great Night Views of Japan, and the breathtaking view overlooking the city and industrial complexes is said to be the '100 Billion Dollar Night View.'

title: 【屋久島】The Legend of Ashitaka | Yakushima (from Princess Mononoke)
description:
A cinematic short film shot on Yakushima,  the breathtaking island that inspired *Princess Mononoke.* Recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, Yakushima is one of Japan’s most beautiful and mystical places, filled with green, moss-covered forests that seem to come alive. This film was inspired by the world and spirit of Princess Mononoke, reimagining what the legend of Ashitaka might look like if it were brought to life in the real world.

Since it is located in the mountains, it is surrounded by mountains and streams, and the only sounds you hear are those of nature.
You can enjoy meals in private rooms and have exclusive access to baths, allowing you to spend your own time leisurely. 😊

title: Nara Secret Food Journey - Spring
description:
Introducing the culinary charm of Nara Prefecture by season.

Ingredients featured in the video...
Yoshino kudzu, Yamato tea, plums, amago, honey, sweets

What is the Nara Secret Food Journey...
Ingredients essential to Japanese life, such as tea, udon, and tofu.
Their roots lie here in Nara.
During the Asuka and Nara periods.
This land, which flourished as the terminus of the Silk Road, saw many cultures and techniques brought by immigrants,
and from here, a food culture that has been passed down to the present day was nurtured.
The "Yamato chicken" created with the dream of recreating Yamato kashiwa.
"Yamato vegetables" that have developed while preserving tradition.
These ingredients are carefully cultivated, and even today, they continue to evolve while looking towards the future.
A journey through the unknown roots of food and the captivating ingredients.

title: THE ROOTS #09 回帰された土壌に根付くアスパラガス
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

北海道南西部、檜山郡厚沢部町。
80％以上を森林が占める農林業の町。
この地でアスパラガス専門農家を営むのは
長谷川博紀（はせがわひろき）さん。

彼がおこなう農業は、とても本質的。
その土地の土壌が形成された歴史・仕組みを
調べることからはじまり、地質が本来の姿を
取り戻すための努力を惜しまない。
大地に負荷を与えず、
昆虫や微生物にも負荷を与えない農業。

アスパラガスは多年草。
ひとつの株が収穫時期を終えても、
幹や枝葉を伸ばし、根に蓄えた養分で越冬する。
ここで育つアスパラガスは20年以上の古株も
珍しくなく、旨味はぐんぐん増していく。

そんな農園のアスパラガスが美味いのは
言うまでもなく、質の高さは都内を中心に
全国のシェフの声で証明されている。
長谷川さんがつくるアスパラ、通称ハセパラは
アスパラガスが持つ本来の甘み・渋み・旨みを
存分に味わえる。

そのまま生でもジューシーな味わいだが



火加減と火入れ時間によっては、
様々な


表情を見せてくれるハセパラ。






まずは一本、めしあがれ。

title: THE ROOTS #09 Asparagus Rooted in Reclaimed Soil
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

In the southwestern part of Hokkaido, in Atsubetsu Town, Hiyama District.
A town where over 80% is covered by forests, known for agriculture and forestry.
The asparagus specialist farmer here is Hiroki Hasegawa.

His approach to agriculture is very fundamental.
It begins with researching the history and structure of the soil formed in that land,
and he spares no effort in restoring the geology to its original state.
Farming that does not burden the earth,
or impose stress on insects and microorganisms.

Asparagus is a perennial plant.
Even when one stalk has finished its harvest season,
it continues to grow its stems and leaves, wintering with the nutrients stored in its roots.
Asparagus grown here often has roots that are over 20 years old,
and its flavor continues to intensify.

It goes without saying that the asparagus from this farm is delicious,
and its high quality is proven by the voices of chefs across the country, especially in Tokyo.
The asparagus made by Hasegawa, commonly known as Hasepara,
allows you to fully enjoy the natural sweetness, bitterness, and umami of asparagus.

It is juicy and flavorful even when eaten raw,
but depending on the heat and cooking time,
it shows various expressions.

First, enjoy one stalk.

title: 【舞鶴観光　東舞鶴編】　～東舞鶴の楽しみ方～
description:
東舞鶴の町は20世紀初めに軍港都市として急速に発展しました。海軍の軍用施設として建てられた赤れんがの倉庫群は、現在舞鶴を代表する観光のスポットとなっています。
また東舞鶴は自然が豊かなところ。桜や紅葉の名所もあり、お天気のいい日は今流行りのe-BIKEを利用して回るのも楽しいです。ぜひお楽しみください！

title: [Maizuru Tourism - Higashi Maizuru Edition] - How to Enjoy Higashi Maizuru
description:
The town of Higashi Maizuru rapidly developed as a military port city in the early 20th century. The red brick warehouses built as naval military facilities have now become representative tourist spots of Maizuru.
Moreover, Higashi Maizuru is rich in nature. It is home to famous cherry blossom and autumn foliage spots, and on sunny days, it is enjoyable to explore using the trendy e-BIKE. Please enjoy your visit!

description:
Healing Time Starting from the Forest / Matsukawa Retreat

Welcome to the town of healing
Are you slowly entering the forest?

In the safe and welcoming "Oyorite no Mori," 
we will awaken the "five senses" that have been closed off by busyness 
with guides connecting people and nature.

The various effects of the forest
Stress relief, relaxation, improved immunity...
Experience healing in the vibrant forest through the seasons,
wrapped in hot springs with views of the Alps.
Enjoy seasonal delicacies and local flavors in your meals,
encounters with warm "Matsukawa people," and 
a variety of healing journeys.

If you get tired, come back again.

A two-day, one-night healing journey utilizing Matsukawa's resources, 
including forest therapy held in "Seiryuu and Oyorite no Mori" 
and accommodation at the healing hot spring inn "Seiryuu-en."
