title: 【京丹波町】#3 和知人形浄瑠璃～地域無形文化遺産 森育ちの文化が待っている～
description:
山の恵みを受け、豊な森とともに発展してきた、「森の京都」。
森の京都エリアの6つのまちで、森と人が育んできた伝統文化の魅力あふれる映像をぜひご覧ください。

■和知人形浄瑠璃（京都府京丹波町）

和知人形浄瑠璃のルーツは、今から150年ほど前のこと。
農家の閑散期に人形回しを嗜んだのが、はじまりといわれています。
通常は3人で扱う人形を、たった1人で操ることが特徴で、太夫・三味線・人形の三業一体となった芸は、地域の誇る伝統の技です。
和知伝統芸能常設館の定期公演で見ることができます。

※この動画は、文化庁地域文化財総合活用推進事業（地域無形文化遺産継承のための新しい生活様式支援事業）おいて制作しました。

title: [Kyotanba Town] #3 Wachi Puppet Joruri - A Cultural Heritage of the Region Awaits in the Forest-Grown Culture -
description:
Blessed by the mountains, and developed alongside rich forests, 'Forest Kyoto'.
Please enjoy the captivating videos showcasing the traditional culture nurtured by the forest and its people in the six towns of the Forest Kyoto area.

■Wachi Puppet Joruri (Kyotanba Town, Kyoto Prefecture)

The roots of Wachi Puppet Joruri date back about 150 years.
It is said to have begun when farmers engaged in puppet manipulation during their off-season.
What sets it apart is the ability to operate the puppet by just one person, instead of the usual three, and the art that combines the roles of tayu (narrator), shamisen player, and puppeteer is a proud traditional skill of the region.
You can see it at the regular performances at the Wachi Traditional Performing Arts Permanent Hall.

*This video was produced as part of the Agency for Cultural Affairs' project to promote the comprehensive utilization of regional cultural assets (Support Project for New Lifestyles to Inherit Intangible Cultural Heritage).

title: 【舞鶴×SUNTORY】スパイス薫る”海軍ホットウヰスキー”もお好きでしょ
description:
寒い夜に「海軍ホットウヰスキー・カクテル」はいかがですか。
スパイス薫る、あったまる。海軍ゆかりのレシピをぜひともお試しください。
-------------------------------------------------------------
【海軍レトロブレンド】
大正7年に発行された海軍の料理教科書「海軍四等主計兵厨業教科書」に記載の「ホットウヰスキー」の復刻です。昭和レトロな味わいをぜひご賞味ください。
「海軍の料理教科書」3冊公開中：http://www.maizuru-kanko.net/120/chinjufu-menu1.html

**************************************
『海軍四等主計兵厨業教科書』第二章　調理法　第三節　西洋料理　一七九～一八〇より

材料　「ナツメク」少量、「アンゴスチュラビター」二滴、角砂糖一個、「チョージ」二個、（グローブス）「レモン」輪切り一片、「ブランデー」酒一杯（リキューグラス）

製法　 水「グラス」ノ中ニ角砂糖、「ナツメク」「ビター」ヲ入レ、其ノ中ニ「ブランデー」酒ヲ注イデ攪拌シ、ソレニ「チョージ」ヲ入レ熱湯ヲ八分目位迄注ギ入レ、「レモン」輪切一片ヲ浮カセテ供スル
此ノ場合「ブランデー」酒ノ代リニ「ウヰスキー」酒ヲ入レルト「ホツトウヰスキー」ト云フ
**************************************
材料：
トリスウイスキー（サントリー）30ml
アンゴスチュラビター　　　　　2ドロップ
角砂糖　　　　　　　　　　　　1個
クローブ　　　　　　　　　　　2個
ナツメグ　　　　　　　　　　　少々
レモン輪切り　　　　　　　　　1片

作り方：
①グラスに角砂糖、ナツメグ、アンゴスチュラビターを入れ、その中にウイスキーを注ぎ混ぜる。
②クローブを入れ、熱湯をグラスに八分目まで注ぐ、輪切りレモンを入れて完成。
-------------------------------------------------------------
【ホットカルダモンビーム】
時間の経過とともにスパイスが染み出し、味の変化が楽しめる、現代風アレンジです。

材料：
ジムビーム（サントリー）15ml
カルダモン（ホール）　　1個
コリアンダーパウダー　　耳かき1程度

作り方：
①事前にティーカップをお湯で温めておく。
②ティーカップにジンビームを注ぎ、真ん中に切り込みを入れたカルダモン（ホール）を入れる。
③コリアンダーパウダーを入れる。
④沸騰寸前のお湯を注ぎ、ステアし完成。
-------------------------------------------------------------
【翠ホット】
翠本来の柚子・生姜・緑茶の香りがお湯により広がり、さらにクローブのバニラ香も薫る現代風アレンジです。

材料：
翠（サントリー）　　　15ml
クローブ　　　　　　　1個
碾茶の葉（てんちゃ）　1枚（※あれば）

作り方：
①事前にティーカップをお湯で温めておく。
②ティーカップに翠を注ぎ、クローブと碾茶の葉（※あれば）を入れる。
③沸騰寸前のお湯を注ぎ、ステアし完成。

title: [Maizuru × SUNTORY] You love the 'Navy Hot Whisky' with a hint of spice, don't you?
description:
How about a 'Navy Hot Whisky Cocktail' on a cold night?
With a hint of spice, it warms you up. Please try this recipe associated with the Navy.
-------------------------------------------------------------

[Navy Retro Blend]
This is a reproduction of the 'Hot Whisky' described in the Navy's cooking textbook 'Navy Fourth Class Cook's Culinary Textbook' published in 1918. Please enjoy the retro flavor of the Showa era.
'Cooking Textbook of the Navy' - 3 volumes available: http://www.maizuru-kanko.net/120/chinjufu-menu1.html

**************************************

'Chapter 2: Cooking Methods, Section 3: Western Cuisine, Pages 179-180' from 'Navy Fourth Class Cook's Culinary Textbook'

Ingredients: A small amount of 'Nutmeg', 2 drops of 'Angostura Bitters', 1 lump of sugar, 2 'Cloves', 1 slice of 'Lemon', 1 cup of 'Brandy' (liqueur glass)

Method: In a glass, place the lump of sugar, 'Nutmeg', and 'Bitters', then pour in the 'Brandy' and stir. Add the 'Cloves' and pour hot water up to about 80% full, floating a slice of 'Lemon' on top to serve.
In this case, if you replace 'Brandy' with 'Whisky', it is called 'Hot Whisky'.
**************************************

Ingredients:
30ml of Torii Whisky (Suntory)
2 drops of Angostura Bitters
1 lump of sugar
2 Cloves
A pinch of Nutmeg
1 slice of Lemon

Instructions:
1. In a glass, place the lump of sugar, Nutmeg, and Angostura Bitters, then pour in the whisky and mix.
2. Add the Cloves, pour hot water into the glass up to 80%, and add the slice of lemon to finish.
-------------------------------------------------------------

[Hot Cardamom Beam]
A modern twist that allows you to enjoy the changing flavors as the spices infuse over time.

Ingredients:
15ml of Jim Beam (Suntory)
1 whole Cardamom
A small amount of Coriander Powder (about the size of a cotton swab)

Instructions:
1. Pre-warm a teacup with hot water.
2. Pour Jim Beam into the teacup and add the whole Cardamom with a slit in the middle.
3. Add the Coriander Powder.
4. Pour near-boiling water, stir, and finish.
-------------------------------------------------------------

[Midori Hot]
A modern twist that spreads the natural aromas of Yuzu, Ginger, and Green Tea in hot water, with the added scent of Clove vanilla.

Ingredients:
15ml of Midori (Suntory)
1 Clove
1 leaf of powdered tea (Tencha) (if available)

Instructions:
1. Pre-warm a teacup with hot water.
2. Pour Midori into the teacup and add the Clove and powdered tea leaf (if available).
3. Pour near-boiling water, stir, and finish.

Whether at home or in a shop, everyone please give it a try.

title: 鹿児島県指宿市/俣川洲（またごし）〈ドローン４K撮影〉
description:
【俣川洲（またごし）】 
山川港の南部に位置する海と火山が生んだ岩。 
俣川洲は観光地化されておらず、地元の方や自然愛好家等によって知られる穴場スポット。 
南西方向には開聞岳、手前には竹山が見える。 角度によっては３つ同時に楽しむことができる。 
陸地からは伏目海岸方面から見えるが、トンネル方向の絶景を狙うなら角度が大切。 海蝕により自然にできたトンネル「海食洞」。穴は小舟が通れるほどの大きさ。 
できるだけ海上からの観察をおすすめします。

title: Ibusuki City, Kagoshima Prefecture / Matagoshima (Drone 4K Shooting)
description:
[Matagoshima] 
A rock formed by the sea and volcano located in the southern part of Yamakawa Port. 
Matagoshima is not a tourist spot and is known as a hidden gem by locals and nature lovers. 
To the southwest, you can see Mount Kaimondake, and in the foreground, you can see Takeyama. 
Depending on the angle, you can enjoy all three at the same time. 
From the land, it can be seen from the direction of Fushime Coast, but if you want to capture the stunning view towards the tunnel, the angle is important. 
The naturally formed tunnel due to marine erosion is called 'Kaishokudo'. The hole is large enough for a small boat to pass through. 
It is recommended to observe as much as possible from the sea.

description:
【知林ヶ島】
鹿児島県指宿市にあり、錦江湾に浮かぶ周囲約3kmの無人島。
島の周辺は透明度の高い海に囲まれ自然豊かな景観が広がってます。
干潮時になると「砂州」が現れ、大潮の時はその時間が長く続き、歩いて島まで渡ることができます。
砂州は3月〜10月の干潮時にだけ現れ、干潮時間は日によって異なるため、訪れる際は潮見表の確認をおすすめします。

title: Ibusuki City, Kagoshima Prefecture / Chiringashima (Drone 4K Shooting)
description:
[Chiringashima]
Located in Ibusuki City, Kagoshima Prefecture, it is an uninhabited island with a circumference of about 3 km floating in Kinko Bay.
The island is surrounded by clear waters, and a rich natural landscape spreads out.
During low tide, a 'sandbar' appears, and during spring tides, this time lasts longer, allowing you to walk to the island.
The sandbar only appears during low tide from March to October, and the low tide times vary by day, so it is recommended to check the tide chart before visiting.
https://www.ibusuki.or.jp/tourism/view/chiringashima/

A sandy path that only appears at low tide

title: 【2025年】雫石よしゃれ祭【新生雫石町70周年記念】
description:
【よしゃれ祭とは？】毎年8月11日に開催される夏の雫石町の一大イベント。よしゃれ通り商店街をメイン会場に、神輿運行、よしゃれ踊りやさんさ踊りなど、各団体によって異なる彩り豊かなパレードが催され、最後はさんさとよしゃれの輪踊りで締め括られます。メイン会場の他、よさこい演舞、雫石郷土芸能競演、南部よしゃれ全国大会最優秀賞者競演なども開催されます。
8月11日は、「よしゃれの里 雫石町」へぜひお越しください！

　天正年間（１５７３〜９２）、南部信直が雫石城攻略の際に西山村（雫石町）の「五輪茶屋」（よしゃれ茶屋）で見せた「雫石女」の貞節と心意気を唄ったものといわれ、「南部牛追唄」と並ぶ岩手の代表的民謡の一つ。踊りが完成したのは藩政末期といわれるが、昭和の始めごろに現在の形に手直しされ、現在でも祝い事の宴席や舞台などでは紋付で踊られる格調高い民謡である。
（いわての文化情報大事典ホームページより引用）

title: [2025] Shizukuishi Yosharai Festival [70th Anniversary of the New Shizukuishi Town]
description:
[What is the Yosharai Festival?] A major summer event in Shizukuishi Town held every year on August 11. The main venue is the Yosharai Street shopping district, where various groups hold colorful parades featuring mikoshi (portable shrines), Yosharai dances, and Sansha dances, culminating in a circle dance of Sansha and Yosharai. In addition to the main venue, there are also performances of Yosakoi dance, Shizukuishi traditional performing arts competition, and a showcase of the winners of the Nanbu Yosharai National Competition.
Please come to 'Yosharai no Sato Shizukuishi Town' on August 11!

It is said that during the Tensho era (1573-1592), when Nanbu Nobunao attacked Shizukuishi Castle, he sang about the chastity and spirit of the 'Shizukuishi Woman' at the 'Gorin Chaya' (Yosharai Chaya) in Nishiyama Village (Shizukuishi Town). This song is one of Iwate's representative folk songs, alongside the 'Nanbu Ushio Uta.' The dance is said to have been completed at the end of the feudal era, but it was revised into its current form around the early Showa period and is still performed in formal attire at celebratory events and on stage as a dignified folk song.
(Quoted from the Iwate Cultural Information Encyclopedia website)

title: 民泊体験
description:
四国、徳島県の西部「そらの郷」は、四国の中央に位置するにし阿波（美馬市、三好市、つるぎ町、東みよし町）エリアです。
そらの郷山里物語では、教育旅行民泊の推奨を行っています。
生徒たちは家族の一員として迎えられ、茶摘みやタマネギ、ジャガイモ、雑穀の収穫など、少量多品目自給的農業を協働します。
収穫した旬の野菜や山菜を使って田舎料理を共同調理、家族団らんの食事での心の交流、自然に触れる体験などを行います。

岩野家
https://nohaku.net/event/%E5%B2%A9%E9%87%8E%E5%AE%B6/

title: Minpaku Experience
description:
Sora no Sato, located in the western part of Tokushima Prefecture in Shikoku, is in the Nishi-Awa area (Mima City, Miyoshi City, Tsurugi Town, Higashi-Miyoshi Town) situated in the center of Shikoku.
At Sora no Sato Yamasato Monogatari, we promote educational travel minpaku.
Students are welcomed as family members and collaborate in small-scale, diverse, self-sufficient agriculture, such as tea picking, onion, potato, and grain harvesting.
Using the seasonal vegetables and wild plants harvested, we engage in communal cooking of countryside dishes, share heartfelt meals with family, and experience nature.

Iwano Family

description:

一方で、この時期、ご自宅でお過ごしの方も多いかと思います。そこで、私たちのさくらんぼをご自宅でお楽しみいただけるよう、「朝摘みさくらんぼを農家よりお届けします」を企画致しました。

title: Minami-Shinshu Matsukawa: 'Freshly Picked Cherries Delivered from Farmers'
description:
This year, the cherries from Minami-Shinshu Matsukawa are growing well. We plan to start cherry picking around mid-June, but we would like to decide on this season's acceptance based on the situation both domestically and internationally.

On the other hand, we understand that many of you may be spending time at home during this period. Therefore, we have planned 'Freshly Picked Cherries Delivered from Farmers' so that you can enjoy our cherries at home.

Project Overview Page
https://dansuki.jp/column/column1569/

Please enjoy the cherries from Minami-Shinshu Matsukawa at home. We hope that your purchases will also bring smiles to the cherry farmers.

description:
石川県への旅行や観光で参考にしてください。一羽のシラサギにより湯脈が見つかったと言い伝えられる、開湯1200年の歴史ある温泉地です。藩政時代には湯治場として人気になったり、時代が変わった現在でも、人気の温泉街・和倉（わくら）温泉。のどかな七尾湾（ななおわん）と能登島（のとじま）、そこにかかる能登島大橋を眺めながら入ることのできる足湯があったり、弁天崎源泉公園では、足湯ならぬ手湯があったり、約90度ある高温の源泉を利用して、自分で温泉卵を作ることができる場所があったりと、フラッと立ち寄るだけでも楽しい施設があります。石川県の東の玄関口ともいえる、和倉温泉でおすすめの宿をご紹介します。

title: [Ishikawa Tourism] 9 Selected Ryokans in Wakura Onsen
description:
Please use this as a reference for your trip or sightseeing in Ishikawa Prefecture. It is said that a single white heron discovered the hot spring source, making it a historic hot spring area with a 1200-year history. During the feudal era, it became popular as a hot spring resort, and even in the present day, Wakura Onsen remains a popular hot spring town. You can enjoy foot baths while gazing at the tranquil Nanao Bay and Noto Island, as well as the Noto Island Bridge. At the Bentenzaki Gensen Park, there is a hand bath instead of a foot bath, and there are places where you can make your own onsen eggs using the high-temperature source water, which is about 90 degrees. There are fun facilities to casually drop by. Here are some recommended accommodations in Wakura Onsen, which can be considered the eastern gateway to Ishikawa Prefecture.

title: 【ドローン映像】大桑城跡 | 「戦国のメインステージ岐阜」
description:
大桑城は、室町時代から戦国時代にかけて権勢を誇った、美濃国の守護土岐氏の山城です。天文4（1535）年に発生した長良川の大洪水により、枝広（現在の岐阜市長良公園）にあった守護所は大きな被害を受けました。これを受けて土岐氏は、大桑に守護所を移し、城と城下町を整備したとされています。天文12（1543）年、勢力を増していた斎藤道三との間に大きな戦いが起こり、大桑城は落城したと考えられています。

title: [Drone Footage] Okuwa Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Sengoku Period in Gifu'
description:
Okuwa Castle is a mountain castle of the Toki clan, who held power in Mino Province from the Muromachi period to the Sengoku period. In 1535, a major flood of the Nagara River caused significant damage to the guardian's base located in Ebihiro (now Nagara Park in Gifu City). In response, the Toki clan moved their base to Okuwa and is said to have developed the castle and the castle town. In 1543, a major battle occurred between the Toki clan and the increasingly powerful Saito Dosan, leading to the fall of Okuwa Castle.

Okuwa Castle Ruins (Kojoyama) | Gifu Prefectural Official Tourism Site 'Gifu Travel Guide'

title: 【ドローン映像】小島城跡 | 「戦国のメインステージ岐阜」
description:
小島城跡は姉小路氏三家の一家・小島氏の居城です。高原郷と小島郷を結ぶ神原峠の峠道が脇を通る交通の要衝に位置し、高原郷からの敵の侵入を睨んでいます。姉小路氏城跡は古川城跡、小島城跡、野口城跡、向小島城跡、小鷹利城跡という5つの城跡の総称で、飛騨市古川町などにあります。令和6年2月21日、その歴史的価値が評価されて国史跡に指定されました。

title: [Drone Footage] Kojima Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Warring States in Gifu'
description:
The Kojima Castle Ruins are the residence of the Kojima clan, one of the three branches of the Anekoji clan. It is located at a strategic point along the mountain pass connecting Takahara and Kojima, overseeing the potential invasion of enemies from Takahara. The Anekoji clan castle ruins refer to a collective of five castle ruins: Furukawa Castle, Kojima Castle, Noguchi Castle, Mukokojima Castle, and Kotakatori Castle, located in places like Furukawa Town in Hida City. On February 21, 2024, its historical value was recognized, and it was designated as a national historic site.

title: 【ドローン映像】大垣城 | 「戦国のメインステージ岐阜」
description:
大垣城は、美濃守護・土岐一族の宮川吉左衛門尉安定により、天文4年（1535年）に創建されたと伝えられています。江戸時代の大垣城は、城郭絵図によると水堀を幾重にもめぐらせた大変規模の大きな城郭でした。関ケ原の戦いでは、西軍・石田三成の本拠地となりました。その後、戸田氏が入城し、大垣藩十万石を明治時代まで治めました。

title: [Drone Footage] Ogaki Castle | 'The Main Stage of the Warring States in Gifu'
description:
Ogaki Castle is said to have been founded in the 4th year of Tenbun (1535) by Miyakawa Yoshizaemon-no-Suke Yasutaka of the Toki clan, the guardians of Mino. According to Edo period castle maps, Ogaki Castle was a large fortress surrounded by multiple moats. During the Battle of Sekigahara, it became the base of the Western Army led by Ishida Mitsunari. Later, the Toda clan took control of the castle and governed the Ogaki Domain of 100,000 koku until the Meiji period.

title: 【ドローン映像】岐阜城 | 「戦国のメインステージ岐阜」
description:
金華山頂にはじめて砦を築いたのは、鎌倉幕府に仕えた二階堂山城守行政と伝えられています。戦国時代には、斎藤道三公の居城でもあったところです。特に岐阜城の名を天下に示したのは、永禄10年（1567年）8月、織田信長公がこの城を攻略し、地名も「井口」を「岐阜」と改称し、天下統一の本拠地としてからでした。

description:
It is said that the first fort was built on the summit of Kinka Mountain by Nikaido Yamashiro no Kami Yoshinari, who served the Kamakura Shogunate. During the Warring States period, it was also the residence of Saito Dosan. Particularly, the name of Gifu Castle was made known throughout the land when, in the 10th year of Eiroku (1567), Oda Nobunaga conquered this castle, renaming the place from 'Iguchi' to 'Gifu' and establishing it as the base for his unification of the country.

description:
岩村城は、奈良県の高取城、岡山県の松山城と並び、日本三大山城の一つに数えられる名城で、日本100名城にも選定されています。城は江戸諸藩の府城の中でも最も高い所（標高717m）に築かれ、高低差180mの険しい地形を巧みに利用した要害堅固な山城です。霧の湧き易い気象も城造りに活かされ、別名「霧ヶ城」とも呼ばれています。

title: [Drone Footage] Iwamura Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Sengoku Period in Gifu'
description:
Iwamura Castle is considered one of Japan's three great mountain castles, alongside Takatori Castle in Nara Prefecture and Matsuyama Castle in Okayama Prefecture, and it has also been selected as one of Japan's 100 Famous Castles. The castle was built at the highest elevation (717m) among the various Edo period feudal lords' castles, utilizing the steep terrain with a height difference of 180m to create a formidable mountain fortress. The fog-prone weather has also been utilized in the castle's construction, earning it the nickname 'Kiri no Shiro' (Castle of Fog).

title: 【ドローン映像】菩提山城跡 | 「戦国のメインステージ岐阜」
description:
永禄元年（1558年）、この地で権力を持っていた岩手氏を竹中重元と息子・重治（半兵衛）が攻め落とし、翌年菩提山に城を築いたとされています。
菩提山城は、竪堀や高低差の大きい堀切が複雑に組み合わさった大規模な山城です。塁はすべて土塁であり、石塁が見られないのが特徴で、最も完成型に近い土塁による城郭といわれています。

title: [Drone Footage] Bodaisan Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Warring States in Gifu'
description:
In the first year of Eiroku (1558), it is said that Takeuchi Shigemoto and his son Shigeharu (Hanbei) attacked the Iwate clan, who held power in this area, and built a castle on Bodaisan the following year.
Bodaisan Castle is a large mountain castle with a complex combination of vertical moats and significant elevation differences. The ramparts are all earthen mounds, and it is characterized by the absence of stone walls, being regarded as the most complete example of an earthen mound castle.

description:
苗木城は、苗木遠山氏により戦国時代（1526年頃）に築城されました。天然の巨石を利用して構築された石垣は、全国でも大変珍しいものです。大矢倉などでは、岩を抱き抱えるように積まれた石垣を見ることができます。
また、年代によって異なる技法で石垣が積まれているのも特徴の一つで、続日本100名城にも選ばれています。

title: [Drone Footage] Naegi Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Sengoku Period in Gifu'
description:
Naegi Castle was built by the Naegi Toyama clan during the Sengoku period (around 1526). The stone walls constructed using natural giant stones are quite rare in the country. At places like Oyakura, you can see stone walls stacked in a way that embraces the rocks.
Additionally, one of the features is that the stone walls are built using different techniques depending on the era, and it has also been selected as one of the 100 Famous Castles of Japan.

title: 【ドローン映像】美濃金山城跡 | 「戦国のメインステージ岐阜」
description:
市内屈指の展望を誇る可児市の古城山山頂に、道三の養子である斎藤正義によって1537年(天文6年)に烏峰城が築城されたと伝えられています。その後、森可成が信長から城を賜り城主となり、「金山城」に改称され、およそ35年にわたり森氏の居城となりました。
美濃金山城跡は、約400年前の石垣が当時の姿のまま残されており、戦国時代の息づかいを肌で感じることができる貴重な城跡で、平成25年に国史跡に指定され、続日本100名城にも選ばれています。

title: [Drone Footage] Mino Kanayama Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Warring States in Gifu'
description:
It is said that Kōfū Castle was built in 1537 (Tembun 6) on the summit of Kōjōyama in Kani City, which boasts one of the best views in the city, by Saitō Masayoshi, the adopted son of Dosan. Later, Mori Kanetaka received the castle from Nobunaga and became the lord, renaming it 'Kanayama Castle,' which served as the residence of the Mori clan for about 35 years.

The Mino Kanayama Castle Ruins preserve stone walls from about 400 years ago in their original form, making it a valuable site where one can feel the breath of the Warring States period. In 2013, it was designated as a national historic site and selected as one of the Continued 100 Famous Castles of Japan.

title: Walking the World Heritage Kumano Kodo and Makino-toge in the Attire of Centuries Past
description: During the Edo period, the pilgrimage to Ise was a dream for many. There were travelers who walked beyond that to reach Kumano. By stepping onto the stone pavement, you will find yourself in the Edo period, immersed in the thoughts of those travelers. It invites you to a nostalgic and authentic historical experience, as if you have stepped out of a ukiyo-e print.

title: 【いちき串木野市】みなと色、ロマン旅。【公式PRムービー】
description:
＼みなと色、ロマン旅。／
.
いちき串木野市総合観光ガイドのWebサイトがリニューアルしました！
.
https://ichiki-kushikino.com
.
合わせて、本市の魅力がギュギュッと凝縮されたプロモーション・ショート・ムービーも完成しました。
.
いちき串木野市は、基幹産業であるマグロの遠洋漁業や、約200年前に宿場町として栄えた市来湊など、港町として栄えた背景があります。また、薩摩スチューデント旅立ちの地、羽島地区の「薩摩藩英国留学生記念館」。徐福伝説の「冠岳」と「冠嶽園」。そして新たに日本遺産に認定された「串木野麓」など、多くの貴重な歴史文化遺産が点在しています。
.
様々な場面で海と歴史・文化の関わりを感じさせるいちき串木野市を「みなと色、ロマン旅。」と表現しました。
.
中央の灯台は、昭和26年から半世紀以上も串木野漁港の安全を見守ってきた「長崎鼻灯台」がモチーフです。
.
皆さん、ぜひご覧ください！そして、いちき串木野市へお越しいただけることを心からお待ちいたしております！！
.
.
.
#みなと色ロマン旅
#いちき串木野市

title: [Ichiki Kushikino City] Minato-iro, Roman Journey. [Official PR Movie]
description:
＼Minato-iro, Roman Journey.／

The comprehensive tourism guide website for Ichiki Kushikino City has been renewed!

https://ichiki-kushikino.com

In addition, a promotional short movie that condenses the charm of our city has been completed.

Ichiki Kushikino City has a background as a port town, thriving with its core industry of tuna long-distance fishing and the city of Ikki Minato, which prospered as a post town about 200 years ago. It is also home to the 'Satsuma Domain British Student Memorial Museum' in the Hashima area, the 'Kankaku' and 'Kankakuen' related to the legend of Jofuku, and the newly recognized Japanese heritage site 'Kushikino Fumoto', among many other valuable historical and cultural heritage sites.

We express Ichiki Kushikino City, where one can feel the connection between the sea and history/culture in various scenes, as 'Minato-iro, Roman Journey.'

The central lighthouse is modeled after the 'Nagasaki Nose Lighthouse', which has been watching over the safety of Kushikino Port for over half a century since 1951.

Everyone, please take a look! We sincerely look forward to welcoming you to Ichiki Kushikino City!!



#MinatoIroRomanJourney
#IchikiKushikinoCity

title: 【かごしま】⑥秘密の展望台で、お醤油愛をさけぶ！【こどもプランナー】
description:
（秘密の展望所"サクラカネヨの杜"編）
すっごく眺めが良い、
秘密の展望所を教えてもらいました！
わたしたちは今回のプチ旅で、
豊かな鹿児島の自然と、優しく流れている時間が
美味しくて、甘いお醤油を作っていることが分かりました！
ロケに協力していただいた皆さん、あいがともさげもしたー！

鹿児島で皆さんのお越しをお待ちしてまーす！！

□動画概要：
「お醤油、借りてもイイですか？」から始まる、
お醤油バラエティー！
「鹿児島のお醤油は何で甘いんだろう？」
という、ふとした疑問を抱いた小学生たちが、
『醤油』を通じて地元の人たちとふれあい、
郷土の食や、文化、自然、歴史を学びながら、
鹿児島の魅力を発信します！！
※昔は、ご近所さんで醤油や、味噌など
調味料の貸し借りが日常的に行われていたという
ことから、こちらのタイトルになりました。

□かごしまこどもプランナー：
新型コロナウィルス感染拡大に伴い、
県内の小学校も長期間休校となりました。
また、県内の観光業・飲食業をはじめ、
経済や社会は大きな打撃を受けています。
そのような中、子どもたち自身が
「今出来ることは何か？」
と自ら考える機会として、鹿児島の自然、歴史、
食、スポーツなどテーマを決めて学び、
そこで気づいた魅力を県内外に発信する、
『かごしまこどもプランナー』
というグループを立ち上げました。
こちらのグループで、休校期間中にネット上の
Zoomアプリを使用して勉強会や、
企画ミーティングなどをオンラインで行い、
今回『醤油』をテーマに動画を作ることになりました。

title: [Kagoshima] ⑥ Shouting Our Love for Soy Sauce at the Secret Observation Deck! [Children's Planner]
description:
(Secret Observation Deck 'Sakurakaneyo no Mori' Edition)
I was told about a super scenic,
secret observation deck!
During this little trip, we discovered that the rich nature of Kagoshima and the gently flowing time
create delicious and sweet soy sauce!
Thank you to everyone who cooperated with the shoot, I had a great time!

We are waiting for everyone to come to Kagoshima!!

□ Video Overview:
Starting with 'Can I borrow some soy sauce?',
a soy sauce variety show!
'Why is Kagoshima's soy sauce so sweet?'
This question arose from elementary school students,
who interact with local people through 'soy sauce',
learning about local food, culture, nature, and history,
and promoting the charm of Kagoshima!!
*The title comes from the fact that in the past,
borrowing and lending seasonings like soy sauce and miso was a common practice among neighbors.

□ Kagoshima Children's Planner:
Due to the spread of the COVID-19 virus,
public elementary schools in the prefecture were closed for a long time.
Moreover, the tourism and food industries in the prefecture,
as well as the economy and society, have been severely impacted.
In such circumstances, the children themselves thought,
'What can we do now?'
They decided on themes such as Kagoshima's nature, history,
food, and sports to learn about,
and to promote the attractions they discovered both within and outside the prefecture,
creating a group called 'Kagoshima Children's Planner'.
During the school closure period, this group held study sessions and
planning meetings online using the Zoom app,
and decided to create a video themed around 'soy sauce'.

□ Playlist:
① Can I buy some soy sauce?
   (AZ Hayato Edition)
② Can I put some soy sauce on it?
   (Seafood Maguroya Edition)
③ Can I borrow some soy sauce?

description:
A land-connected island where you can see the Seto Ohashi Bridge up close. The Seto Ohashi Bridge connects many islands, and Shodoshima is one of them. You can enjoy the Seto Inland Sea and the magnificent architectural beauty of the Seto Ohashi Bridge in various locations, experiencing their harmony.

description:
Awashima, where you can enjoy the art of artists as well as the my art created by the island's residents. Shishijima, where a 1200-year-old camphor tree tells the island's mysteries. Ibukijima, known for its lively fishermen and famous Ibuki iriko. Shonai Peninsula, which juts out into the deep blue Seto Inland Sea, allowing you to enjoy the beauty of multiple islands. Even among the islands of the same Seto Inland Sea, you can enjoy each unique charm.
Check out more videos here! → http://www.my-kagawa.jp/udon-ken/shimatabi.html

title: かがわ極上休日　本島・高見島
description:
昔ながらの趣が漂う町並みが残る本島。江戸時代の隆盛の歴史を残し、ゆっくりと歩いていると、ノスタルジックな風景に時間の流れを忘れてしまいそう。また、島のほとんどが山になっている高見島では、山の急斜面を利用して自然石を積み上げた石垣の集落を見ることができ、懐かしいひとときを感じさせます。

title: Kagawa's Exquisite Holiday: Honjima and Takamijima
description:
Honjima, with its streets that retain the charm of bygone days. 
With a history of prosperity from the Edo period, as you stroll slowly, you might forget the passage of time in the nostalgic scenery. 
On Takamijima, where most of the island is mountainous, you can see villages with stone walls made of natural stones stacked on the steep slopes, evoking a sense of nostalgia.

title: Megijima: A Breeze of Perfection
description:
An island just 20 minutes by ferry from Takamatsu Port. 
At the port, art that captures the wind gently welcomes visitors. 
At the summit of the mountain located almost in the center of the island, there is a large cave, which is the origin of its nickname 'Oni Island.' 
From the observation deck, where you can enjoy a panoramic view of the Seto Inland Sea, the blowing wind lightens your heart.

title: Naoshima: The Ultimate Creative Experience
description: A island where art is scattered everywhere, enveloped in an artistic space both day and night. Step into an alley, and you can catch a glimpse of the culture that has thrived alongside the maritime trade of the Seto Inland Sea since ancient times, intertwined with contemporary art.

description: In Kagawa, a journey around the islands is also a journey through art. The mother port, Takamatsu Port, is the starting point for an artistic island adventure. The bustling scene of departing and arriving ships enhances the excitement of travel. Let's set off to meet the island's art, waved off by colorful artworks.

title: 世界かんがい施設遺産　十石堀
description:
【十石堀の概要と特徴】
　農民自らの意志と計画により350年前の1669年に当時の松井村（現北茨城市中郷町松井）の庄屋沼田主計が中心となって建設した延長約13㎞のかんがい施設であり、集水域の異なる2つの沢を導水路「堀割」で繋いで水源開発を行ったことや、自然地形の沢を利用した用水路などが技術的特徴です。受益面積は78㏊で、その維持管理は建設以来、住民によって行われ、現在は、利水する3地域（北茨城市中郷町松井、日棚、粟野）の住民で構成される「十石堀維持管理協議会」が中心となり行っています。
　令和元年9月「世界かんがい施設遺産」に登録

参考
※世界かんがい施設遺産登録制度
ICID（国際かんがい排水委員会）によって2014年に創設された制度であり、かんがいの歴史・発展を明らかにし、理解醸成を図るとともに、かんがい施設の適切な保全に資するために、歴史的なかんがい施設を認定する制度

title: World Irrigation Heritage: Jikkohori
description:
[Overview and Features of Jikkohori]

It is an irrigation facility approximately 13 km long, constructed in 1669 by Numata Kakei, the village headman of Matsui Village (now Nakagou Town, Kitaibaraki City), based on the will and plans of the farmers themselves. The technical features include the development of water sources by connecting two streams with different catchment areas through a waterway called 'Horikiri' and the use of natural terrain streams for irrigation channels. The area benefiting from this facility is 78 hectares, and its maintenance has been carried out by the residents since its construction. Currently, the 'Jikkohori Maintenance Management Council,' composed of residents from three areas (Matsui, Hinata, and Awano in Nakagou Town, Kitaibaraki City), is primarily responsible for this maintenance.

Registered as a 'World Irrigation Heritage' in September 2019.

Reference
* World Irrigation Heritage Registration System
This system was established in 2014 by ICID (International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage) to clarify the history and development of irrigation, promote understanding, and contribute to the proper conservation of irrigation facilities by certifying historical irrigation facilities.

title: Onsen × Muscle - In Search of Ibaraki's Famous Hot Springs - Vol.1 Yunoami Onsen Shika no Yu Matsuya [With Subtitles]
description:
Ibaraki Prefecture is home to many famous and hidden hot springs, and there are numerous renowned hot springs in Kitai-baraki City as well. This video was created to introduce these many famous hot springs to a wider audience.

【Yunoami Onsen Shika no Yu Matsuya】
Address: 1435 Kamiyoka, Sekinantown, Kitai-baraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture
Phone: 0293-46-1086 (Reservation)
https://www.jsdi.or.jp/~yunoami/
This legendary mineral spring has a history of over 500 years. It is characterized by its reddish-brown water containing iron, and it is said that injured deer soaked in this hot spring to heal their wounds.
The building, which has been around since the early Meiji period, has a charming atmosphere, and just being here soothes both the mind and body. They offer drop-in bathing and day-use bathing (with room access), and for overnight stays with dinner, you can enjoy the specialty grilled Kinki fish.
There is one bath, and it alternates between men and women, so if you are coming for day-use bathing, please call in advance.

title: Trekking to the Famous Waterfall of 60m Drop - Nanatsutaki in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture
description:
※Currently, the approach to Nanatsutaki from the first parking lot of Hanazono Shrine is closed due to a landslide (no entry).

Nanatsutaki is an impressive waterfall boasting a drop of 60m, located in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
It is situated in the Hanazono Valley, created by the erosion of the 'Hanazono River' originating near 'Hanazono Mountain', and is accessible via the approach to the inner shrine of Hanazono Shrine.

Although the width of the waterfall is narrow, it cascades down in seven tiers from the first to the seventh waterfall.
There is a legend that the central pool of the waterfall connects to the sea off the coast of Tenpizuyama in Isohara, where seaweed grows and abalone are believed to inhabit.
In the past, the famous Tokugawa Mitsukuni (Mito Komon) is said to have ordered his retainers to enter the pool to confirm its depth, according to local folklore.

description:
茨城県北茨城市で“海上での安全”と“豊漁”を祈願するために、5年に1度開催される『常陸大津の御船祭』

大津町に鎮座する佐波波地祇（さわわちぎ）神社の大祭で、1726年頃から始まり、2017年には国指定重要無形民俗文化財に登録された歴史あるお祭りです。

御霊遷しの儀により、神様を神輿に宿し、全長約14ｍ幅約3ｍの祭事船に乗せます。

神輿が乗ったことで『神船』となった船を曳き手たちが曳き、陸路を走ります。

船には“車輪が付いておらず”、ソロバンと呼ばれる木桁の上を走ります。
このような形で神が宿った木造の祭事船が陸路渡御を行う祭りは、全国でも北茨城市だけと言われています。

最大の見せ場は、祭り2日目の本祭りで神船が直角に曲がるところ。
曳き手が神船を大きく左右に揺すり、約7トンの神船が向きを変えます。


船底と木桁との摩擦で白い煙が立ち上がり、集まった観衆から歓声と拍手が湧き起ります。

次回開催は、2024年5月2日（宵祭り）・3日（本祭り）

title: [Subtitles ON Recommended] A Festival Where Ships Run on Land!! Hitachi Otsu's Mikoshi Festival - Ibaraki Prefecture, Kitaibaraki City, Otsu Recommended Event Festival Next Time in 2024 -
description:
The 'Hitachi Otsu Mikoshi Festival' is held once every five years in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture, to pray for 'safety at sea' and 'bountiful catches.'

This grand festival is held at the Sawawachigi Shrine in Otsu Town and has a history dating back to around 1726. In 2017, it was registered as an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Asset by the national government.

During the ritual of transferring the spirit, the deity is enshrined in a portable shrine and placed on a ceremonial boat measuring approximately 14 meters in length and 3 meters in width.

With the portable shrine aboard, the boat becomes a 'divine ship' and is pulled by participants as it runs on land.

The boat does not have 'wheels' and runs on wooden beams called 'soroban.'
This type of festival, where a wooden ceremonial boat inhabited by a deity travels on land, is said to be unique to Kitaibaraki City in Japan.

The highlight of the festival is on the second day, during the main festival, when the divine ship makes a right-angle turn.
The participants sway the divine ship vigorously from side to side, changing the direction of the approximately 7-ton vessel.

White smoke rises from the friction between the bottom of the boat and the wooden beams, eliciting cheers and applause from the gathered crowd.

The next event will be held on May 2, 2024 (evening festival) and May 3 (main festival).
Please come and experience the powerful 'Hitachi Otsu Mikoshi Festival'!!

title: Every May, the Rhododendrons are in Full Bloom! Spring Flower Garden Shrine - Hanazono Shrine
description:
This is the Hanazono Valley in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
The spring and fresh green season is perfect for driving and hiking!

In the 'Hanazono Valley', you can listen to the murmuring of the 'Hanazono River' against a backdrop of fresh greenery...
At 'Hanazono Shrine', the contrast of the vermilion gate and main shrine with cherry blossoms and rhododendrons is even more striking.

There are many power spots, including the sacred tree 'Sanbon-sugi', estimated to be 800 years old, and the 'Childbirth and Safe Delivery Cedar', which attracts many tourists from all over the country seeking blessings for children!

Additionally, there are shallow rivers where you can enjoy river play too.*
https://goo.gl/maps/fWiaezWkRVjCqfJ97
(Please note that water levels may rise depending on rainfall. Be sure to check the weather!)

Please come and visit the 'Hanazono Valley', which is different from the autumn foliage season!♪

*Typically, rhododendrons are at their best in early May, but in 2021, the peak is until this weekend (April 25).

title: Let's Go See the Skunk Cabbage in Early April Every Year! Kameyachi Wetland [Recommended Tourist Spot in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture]
description:
Kameyachi Wetland, located in the Ogawa area of Sekimoto Town, Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
About a 30-minute drive from Kitaibaraki IC towards Hanazono Valley. After passing Hanazono Valley, there is a parking area (roadside) along Prefectural Route 27. *See video for reference.
It is located within the Hanazono Hanakan Prefectural Natural Park and is a wetland developed in the mountainous area.
Sagi-suge, Mizuchidori, and Himeichige are growing here. In an effort to preserve this nature, 'Skunk Cabbage' was planted in the 1950s. Later, the city took over management, and in 1987, about 1,000 Skunk Cabbage plants were planted.
Even now, they sprout in late March, and flowers bloom from early to mid-April*1, attracting many tourists.
*1 Reference for best viewing: First week of April 2020, First week of April 2021 (In recent years, the best viewing period has been earlier.)

　シャボン玉 飛んだ　屋根まで飛んだ

野口雨情記念館ではそんな野口雨情の生涯を当時の貴重な資料を展示しながら紹介しています。

title: Ibaraki Prefecture, North Ibaraki, Noguchi Ujo Memorial Hall: Recommended Tourist Spot for 'Shabondama' and 'Nanatsu no Ko'
description:
Have you ever heard the children's songs 'Nanatsu no Ko' and 'Shabondama' that everyone has hummed at least once?
◆Nanatsu no Ko
  Crow, why do you cry? The crow is in the mountains
  Because there are seven lovely children...
◆Shabondama
  Shabondama flew, it flew up to the roof
  It flew up to the roof and broke and disappeared...

All of these were written by the children's song poet 'Noguchi Ujo' from Kitaibaraki City.
Ujo believed that 'It is fine if the author's name is not remembered; if the poems and songs created are loved and sung by people for a long time, that is my true wish,' and he left behind about 3,000 works.

Moreover, surpassing Ujo's belief, the children's songs and school songs he wrote continue to be sung along with Ujo's name even today.
The Noguchi Ujo Memorial Hall introduces the life of Noguchi Ujo while displaying valuable materials from that time.
Why not visit the 'Noguchi Ujo Memorial Hall,' where you can instantly return to your childhood when everyone hummed those songs?

title: World Heritage Site: Jikkohori - Recommended Sightseeing Spot in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture for a Mini Trekking
description:
Enjoy a mini trekking experience at the World Irrigation Heritage site 'Jikkohori'♪
Park your car at the 'Jikkohori Shinsui Park' which has parking and restroom facilities, and take a round trip to the 'Takinokawa Water Gate' on an easy course of about one hour.
Due to the high elevation, there are spots with great views and a nature-made promenade covered by earthen walls on both sides, allowing for an enjoyable walk. In recent years, the number of families enjoying trekking has also increased. This course is suitable for children from around 4 years old, making it a great adventure field for elementary school students!
The area in front of the Hidana Water Control Facility is open, so if you bring a chair and a bento, you can enjoy a light meal in the great outdoors.
It is also gaining attention as a course for the Northern Ibaraki Long Trail.

④ Add miso and bring to a boil

⑥ Arrange the cut ingredients from step ②
⑦ Once all the ingredients are cooked... it's done!!

title: [Stunning thatched roof] Jōren-ji Temple & Jōren-ji Valley / Kita Ibaraki Recommended Tourist Spot
description:
This is 'Jōren-ji Temple' located in Hanakawa Town, Kita Ibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
It is said that the Great Master Jikaku founded this temple after establishing the Oshu Mountain Temple.
After paying respects to the mountain gate and main hall of Jōren-ji, if you proceed along the shaded path, you will arrive at 'Jōren-ji Valley'.
There are 33 Kannon statues carved by ascetic monks scattered throughout the area.
'Jōren-ji Valley' is dotted with large rocks, and during the autumn foliage season, the contrast between the vibrant red leaves and the rocky surfaces creates a stunning landscape that can be enjoyed!♪

■ Kita Ibaraki City Tourism Association HP (Jōren-ji)
　http://www.kitaibarakishi-kankokyokai.gr.jp/page/page000013.html

In Kita Ibaraki City, there are several other valleys such as 'Sarugajō Valley', 'Hanazono Valley', and 'Ōkita Valley', each with different peak foliage times.
Early November: Sarugajō Valley
Mid-November: Hanazono Valley & Ōkita Valley
Early December: Jōren-ji Valley

title: The Best Anko Nabe in Japan / Ibaraki Prefecture, Kitaibaraki City - Delicious Nabe Delivery
description:
**The Birthplace of Anko Nabe: Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture**
For two consecutive years, it has been recognized as the best in Japan at the Nabe 1 GP, a testament to its authenticity.

The rich “miso flavor” is characterized by sautéed anko liver!
It is said that the fishermen of 'Hirakata Port', located in the northern part of Kitaibaraki City, began eating “anko-dobu-jiru” as a dish that could be cooked on board while conserving water and keeping warm. Dobu-jiru is made solely from the moisture released by the anko and vegetables. When dashi broth is added, it becomes anko nabe, which is why it is referred to as the “root of anko nabe.”

Every year, Kitaibaraki City, the birthplace of anko nabe, holds the 'National Anko Summit' (official website: http://www.kitaibarakishi-kankokyokai.gr.jp/page/dir000777.html).
In 2021, the event was canceled due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, leading to disappointment from many, which is why we created this “anko nabe” video.

title: Tokugawa Nariaki, Mito Komon, and the Low Mountain They Climbed: Recommended Ibaraki Sightseeing
description:
Tenpizan and Otatachibana Hime Shrine (天妃山・弟橘媛神社) located in Isohara Town, Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.

A low mountain associated with the famous Tokugawa Mitsukuni (Mito Komon) and Tokugawa Nariaki.
If you climb further from the shrine, there is a stone said to be where Mitsukuni sat.
It is said that Ujo Noguchi, known for children's songs like 'Nanatsu no Ko' and 'Shabondama', often climbed Tenpizan to gaze at the scenery when he struggled with his lyrics.
When asked for his address, Ujo would reply, 'My address is Isohara Coast!' indicating his affection for Isohara Coast and Tenpizan.

When you visit Kitaibaraki City, be sure to enjoy the scenery of Isohara Coast that both of them loved!

title: Ibaraki Prefecture's Famous Upside-Down Autumn Leaves: Mizunuma Dam - Enjoy Dam Fishing, Autumn Foliage, and Trekking - Recommended Ibaraki Tourism
description:
Mizunuma Dam located in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.

The dam, formed by the Hanazono River, boasts beautiful autumn leaves, with Katakuri flowers in spring and clusters of Higanbana in summer. The reflection of the autumn leaves and fresh greenery on the lake surface is stunning, making it a spot that has recently gained attention, especially among Taiwanese tourists.

Additionally, the dam regularly releases young wakasagi and herabuna, allowing for enjoyable fishing experiences! 
* A fishing license is required. For more details, please visit the 'Okita River Fishing Cooperative HP' http://www13.plala.or.jp/ookitagawagyokyo/dam%20fishing%20information.html

Next to the dam management building, there are trailheads for 'Mizunuma Mountain' and 'Takanosuyama', where you can enjoy day hikes. For trekking details, click here ↓ (approximately 2 hours and 40 minutes course) http://www.kitaibarakishi-kankokyokai.gr.jp/page/page000688.html

title: Hanazono Shrine: Great Cedar for Childbirth and Safe Delivery - Recommended Sightseeing Spot in Kitaibaraki, Ibaraki - Goshuin
description:
Hanazono Shrine is located in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
It is a historic shrine said to have been founded by the first shogun of the Heian period, Sakanoue no Tamuramaro.
The 800-year-old great cedar and ancient Koya cedar trees stand in a row, and the vermilion Nio gate, worship hall, and main shrine stand out majestically against the greenery of the trees.

The ancient cedar standing in the precincts is beloved as the 'Cedar for Childbirth and Safe Delivery' because it resembles a mother who is about to give birth, attracting many worshippers from all over the country.

■ For detailed directions from Kitaibaraki IC, please watch this video♪

title: Canyoning & Autumn Foliage Spot - Sarugajo Valley [Kitai-baraki City Tourist Attractions Recommended Spots]
description:
Sarugajo Valley located in Kitai-baraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.

Sarugajo Valley is accessed by proceeding along Prefectural Road 27 from Hanazono Valley towards Hanawa Town, around the Sarugajo Forest Road.
It is a popular tourist spot where you can enjoy walking along the stream and the autumn foliage from your car window.

As you drive from Kitai-baraki IC, you will find the valleys in the order of Jorenji Valley, Hanazono Valley, and Sarugajo Valley.
Sarugajo Valley, located in the mountainous area, is the first to change color in the city, usually starting in late October.
Additionally, you can enter Sarugajo Valley from the sign for 'Hakudaki' at the end of Hanazono Valley, where you can enjoy canyoning over 'Hakudaki', 'Rakuun no Taki', and 'Senjaku no Taki' (for advanced users).

title: First Fishing Boat!! Slow Jigging in Hirakata Offshore, Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki - Recommended Tourism
description:
A group of three beginners experiences boat fishing with slow jigging in Hirakata Offshore, Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki!

Due to time constraints on this day, the location was shallow, but if we go further, we can target species like yellowtail, amberjack, flounder, sea bream, squid, and ribbonfish, among others.*
Red sea bream fishing is also popular. Of course, you can take home the fish you catch!♪♪

There is a toilet on board, making it safe for beginners.
Tackle rental is also available, allowing everyone from beginners to advanced anglers to enjoy boat fishing!♪

title: 茨城県の絶景!!五浦岬公園/北茨城さんぽ【北茨城市 観光 おすすめスポット】茨城 観光 絶景 おすすめ
description:
茨城県北茨城市にある絶景スポット『五浦岬公園』です。
近代日本美術の発展に尽力した岡倉天心が愛した五浦の景色を一望できます。

五浦は『小五浦』、『大五浦』、『椿磯』、『中磯』、『端磯』の大小異なる5つの入り江からなる海岸です。
１年を通して穏やかな波が入り込みに絶壁に生える松の緑と青く澄んだ海が美しい、県内を代表する景勝地です♪

近代日本美術の発展に尽力した『岡倉天心』はこの地を気に入り、移住するとともに、明治39年には東京都谷中にあった日本美術院（第一部 絵画）をこの五浦に移しました。
天心はこの五浦で『没線描法（空気や光を描こうとした）』という描き方を研究、新たな日本画の描き方の確立に取り組みました。
時代が劇的に変わっていく明治時代。天心はこの五浦の景色を見て、日本美術の将来を考えていたのです。

公園内には竹中直人さん主演『映画 天心』で使用されたロケセットや太平洋を一望できる展望台などがあります。

また、周辺には『茨城県立天心記念五浦美術館』や『六角堂』、『岡倉天心の墓』、『黄門の井戸』などの観光スポットが点在しており、近代日本美術の歴史背景に触れながら、海岸沿いの絶景を堪能することができます。

『五浦岬公園』

title: Ibaraki Prefecture's Stunning Views!! Gutsu Cape Park / Kita-Ibaraki Stroll [Kita-Ibaraki City Tourist Recommended Spot] Ibaraki Tourism Stunning Views Recommendations
description:
This is the stunning spot 'Gutsu Cape Park' located in Kita-Ibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
You can enjoy a panoramic view of the scenery of Gutsu, which was loved by Tenshin Okakura, who contributed to the development of modern Japanese art.

Gutsu consists of five bays of varying sizes: 'Kogutsu', 'Ogutsu', 'Tsubaki-iso', 'Naka-iso', and 'Hana-iso'.
Throughout the year, gentle waves come in, and the green pines growing on the cliffs against the backdrop of the clear blue sea create a beautiful representative scenic spot in the prefecture! 🎉

Tenshin Okakura, who dedicated himself to the development of modern Japanese art, loved this place and moved here. In 1906, he relocated the Nihon Bijutsuin (First Division Painting) from Yanaka, Tokyo, to this Gutsu.
At Gutsu, Okakura researched a painting method called 'Bosenbyōhō' (which aimed to depict air and light) and worked on establishing a new way of painting Japanese art.
During the dramatically changing Meiji era, Okakura looked at the scenery of Gutsu and contemplated the future of Japanese art.

Inside the park, there are filming sets used in the movie 'Tenshin' starring Naoto Takenaka and an observation deck that offers a view of the Pacific Ocean.

Additionally, nearby are tourist spots such as the 'Ibaraki Prefectural Tenshin Memorial Gutsu Art Museum', 'Rokkakudo', 'Tenshin Okakura's Grave', and 'Komon no Ido', allowing you to enjoy the stunning coastal views while touching on the historical background of modern Japanese art.

'Gutsu Cape Park'

title: Hachiman Shrine Overlooking Hirakata Port, Poem by Matsuo Basho【Kitaibaraki City Tourism】 Ibaraki Recommended
description:
Kitaibaraki City, located at the northernmost tip of Ibaraki Prefecture.
It is famous as the birthplace of anglerfish hot pot, and has a rich history and culture loved by many artists, including children's song poet Ujo Noguchi and Okakura Tenshin, who contributed to the development of modern Japanese art.
Let's take a leisurely stroll around Kitaibaraki City.

This time, we visit Hachiman Shrine, which sits on a hill overlooking Hirakata Port.
Climbing the stone steps while listening to the sound of the waves. A luxurious moment. From the shrine grounds, you can enjoy a panoramic view of "Hirakata Port."
At Hirakata Port, many anglerfish and spear squid are caught. Fishing boats set sail, allowing you to enjoy various styles of fishing, such as tenya and slow jigging. You can target species like sea bream, flounder, red mullet, ribbonfish, and spear squid.

title: 千年の歴史を持つ神社「備前国総社宮」　～お祭り・神輿担ぎ体験～
description:
平安時代に創建され、岡山備前128の神社のご祭神を合祀した神社。ここにお参りすると一度に全ての神社にお参りしたことになるといわれています。

　日本の伝統芸能、岡山を感じていただけるコンテンツを紹介します。

　鳥居をくぐって見える拝殿は1992年に放火で焼失後、創建当時の平安時代の社殿を復元し再建されたもので、全国でもここにしかない美しい拝殿になります。また、龍ノ口という山の麓に位置し日本でも有数のパワースポットとなっています。

　ここでは、日本に古くから伝わるお祭り、お神輿を担ぐ伝統文化体験、獅子舞奉納、岡山の食を味わえる屋台出店など特別な体験を演出することが出来ます。

title: A Shrine with a Thousand-Year History: Bizen Kuni Sōja Shrine - Festival and Mikoshi Carrying Experience
description:
Founded in the Heian period, this shrine enshrines the deities of 128 shrines in Okayama Bizen. It is said that by visiting here, one has paid homage to all the shrines at once.

We introduce content that allows you to experience traditional Japanese performing arts and the essence of Okayama.

The hall of worship visible through the torii gate was rebuilt in 1992 after being destroyed by arson, restoring the original Heian period structure, making it a beautiful hall of worship unique in the country. Additionally, it is located at the foot of Mount Ryūnoguchi, making it one of Japan's renowned power spots.

Here, you can enjoy special experiences such as traditional cultural activities like carrying the mikoshi, lion dance offerings, and food stalls where you can taste Okayama's cuisine.

For those who refrained from cherry blossom viewing due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, or those who couldn't go, please enjoy the beautiful cherry blossoms blooming in Okayama City and indulge in the hanami atmosphere!

title: Takebe's 8 Circles of Happiness
description:
In the town of Takebe, located in the northern part of Okayama City, there are several famous spots associated with the number '8', which are said to be hidden power spots known to a select few.

From the nostalgic Fukuwatari Station, to shrines with main halls surrounded by trees, visiting several spots this time made me feel as if my spirit was cleansed.

I was particularly impressed by the sound of the river that I wanted to listen to forever when I crossed the bridge over the Asahi River flowing through the center of the town.

It's a great place to visit alone for a change of pace, or to enjoy nature with family and friends!
There are also hot springs, restaurants, and coffee shops, making it a compact town to enjoy.

By the time you leave, I believe many will feel, 'Takebe was a wonderful place!'

title: おかやま うつくしの ひと時へ。　30ver.B
description:
※この動画は2021年に制作したもので、アーカイブとしてYou Tubeに掲載しています。

幻想庭園・烏城灯源郷をはじめとする、四季折々の岡山後楽園・岡山城の見どころが詰まったプロモーション動画が完成しました！ぜひご覧ください！！

【岡山後楽園】
岡山藩2代目藩主・池田綱政（つなまさ）が自ら憩いの場として築いた大庭園。季節の花が彩る広々とした園内は江戸時代さながらの別世界。1952年には歴史的文化遺産として“特別名勝”に指定され、ミシュラン・グリーンガイド・ジャポンでは三つ星の評価を得ています。
https://okayama-korakuen.jp/

【岡山城】
慶長2年（1597）、豊臣家五大老の一人・宇喜多秀家が築城した岡山城天守閣。三層六階の堂々たる天守閣は織田信長の安土城天主閣を模して築かれたと伝えられ、全国的にも珍しい不等辺五角形の天守台をしています。黒い下見板張りの外観から別名「烏城（うじょう）」と呼ばれています。
現在、「令和の大改修」として天守閣の大規模改修工事中です。リニューアルオープンは2022年11月の予定です。
https://kin-ujo.jp/

【幻想庭園・烏城桃源郷】
　毎年、春・夏・秋の期間限定で岡山後楽園と岡山城が美しい光でライトアップされ、「幻想庭園」「烏城灯源郷」として特別に夜間開園・開館します。

title: Okayama: A Beautiful Moment. 30ver.B
description:
※This video was produced in 2021 and is published on YouTube as an archive.

A promotional video filled with highlights of Okayama Korakuen and Okayama Castle throughout the seasons, including the Fantasy Garden and Ujo Togenkyo, has been completed! Please take a look!!

【Okayama Korakuen】
A large garden built by the second lord of the Okayama domain, Ikeda Tsunamasa, as a place of relaxation. The spacious garden, adorned with seasonal flowers, is like a different world reminiscent of the Edo period. In 1952, it was designated as a “Special Scenic Spot” as a historical cultural heritage and has received a three-star rating in the Michelin Green Guide Japan.
https://okayama-korakuen.jp/

【Okayama Castle】
Okayama Castle's main keep was built in 1597 by Ukita Hideie, one of the five elders of the Toyotomi clan. The magnificent three-story, six-story main keep is said to have been modeled after Oda Nobunaga's Azuchi Castle and features a rare irregular pentagonal base. Its black wooden exterior has earned it the nickname “Ujo (Crow Castle).”
Currently, a large-scale renovation of the main keep is underway as part of the “Reiwa Major Renovation.” The renewal opening is scheduled for November 2022.
https://kin-ujo.jp/

【Fantasy Garden & Ujo Togenkyo】
Every year, during the spring, summer, and autumn seasons, Okayama Korakuen and Okayama Castle are beautifully illuminated with lights, and are specially opened at night as the “Fantasy Garden” and “Ujo Togenkyo.”

title: Experience! Momotaro Legend (Promotional Video for the Japanese Heritage 'The Town Where the Momotaro Legend Was Born - Okayama')
description:
★Promotional video for the Japanese Heritage 'The Town Where the Momotaro Legend Was Born - Okayama'
[Experience! Momotaro Legend Edition]

In May 2018, the cities of Okayama, Kurashiki, Soja, and Akaiwa jointly applied for and were recognized as a Japanese Heritage site for 'The Town Where the Momotaro Legend Was Born - Okayama'.
Japanese Heritage is a designation by the Agency for Cultural Affairs that tells the story of Japan's culture and traditions through the historical charm and characteristics of a region. As of the fiscal year 2018, 67 stories have been recognized nationwide.

Okayama still has many locations that are said to be associated with the story of 'Kibitsuhiko and Ura', which served as the model for Momotaro and the demons, and these have been carefully preserved by the local community for a long time.

We have completed a promotional video that clearly conveys the charm of the Japanese Heritage 'The Town Where the Momotaro Legend Was Born - Okayama', so please take a look!

title: [Soudou Sakura] 2021 Cherry Blossoms ~Sky Travel Time~ Skywalk to Experience Okayama City
description:
This is a drone video capturing the cherry blossom spots in Okayama City from the sky.
For those who refrained from hanami due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, and for those who couldn't go out for cherry blossom viewing, please enjoy the beautiful cherry blossoms blooming in Okayama City and indulge in the hanami spirit!

'Soudou no Sakura' located in Seto Town, Higashi Ward, Okayama City. It is a type of double-flowered cherry blossom with about 60 petals, and around 20 of the inner petals are inverted and curled, making it a remarkably luxurious and beautiful flower. There is a legend that after the death of the local priest who loved the cherry blossoms, the petals stopped fully blooming.

description:

造山古墳は、古代吉備王国の首長の墓といわれる県下最大、全国でも応神、仁徳、覆中に次ぐ4番目の規模を持つ全長約350ｍの大前方後円墳です。造営当時は日本一の規模で、その存在は畿内政権と肩を並べる古代吉備の勢力を物語っています。前方には径40ｍの円墳からは鏡、砥石、鈴、多量の鉄器などが出土し、一部が宮内庁に所蔵されています。 

千足古墳は岡山市北区新庄下にある前方後円墳で、造山古墳の前方部前面に位置し、造山古墳の陪塚とされています。千足古墳は国指定史跡で後円部には、九州系の初期横穴式石室内に直弧文を彫刻した石障がおかれていたことで著名。古墳時代中期の吉備と九州の密接な関係を知ることができる重要な古墳です。（千足古墳は令和4年度整備工事完成予定）

title: [Zōzan Kofun & Senjaku Kofun] ~Sky Travel Time~ A Skywalk to Experience Okayama City
description:
Famous landmarks in Okayama City and spots you may not have known about. 
Why not travel from the sky?

Zōzan Kofun is the largest burial mound in the prefecture, said to be the tomb of a chieftain of the ancient Kibi Kingdom, with a total length of about 350 meters, making it the fourth largest in Japan, following the Ōjin, Nintoku, and Fukuchū tombs. At the time of its construction, it was the largest in Japan, and its existence tells the story of the power of ancient Kibi, which stood alongside the Kinai political authority. From the circular mound with a diameter of 40 meters in the front, mirrors, grinding stones, bells, and a large number of iron tools have been excavated, some of which are housed in the Imperial Household Agency.

Senjaku Kofun is a keyhole-shaped burial mound located in Shinjo-shita, Kita Ward, Okayama City, positioned in front of the Zōzan Kofun and considered its accompanying mound. Senjaku Kofun is a nationally designated historic site, famous for having a stone barrier with carved straight-line patterns placed inside an early horizontal stone chamber of Kyushu origin in its round rear section. It is an important burial mound that provides insight into the close relationship between Kibi and Kyushu during the middle of the Kofun period. (The renovation work for Senjaku Kofun is scheduled for completion in the fiscal year 2022)

title: Kibitsu Shrine - Sky Travel Time - A Skywalk to Experience Okayama City
description:
The famous landmarks of Okayama City and those spots you may not have known about. 
Why not travel from the sky? 

Kibitsu Shrine is a grand shrine dedicated to Okibitsuhiko no Okami, and its main hall and worship hall are uniquely constructed in the 'Hiyoku Irimoya-zukuri' style, which is the only one of its kind in the country and designated as a national treasure. Additionally, the approximately 400-meter-long corridor (designated as a cultural property by the prefecture) connecting the main shrine to the southern main shrine, as well as the South and North Suijin Gates, the Okama-den, and the wooden lion and komainu, are designated as important cultural properties of the country.

description:
Famous landmarks in Okayama City and spots you may not have known about. 
Why not travel from the sky?

This shrine is dedicated to Okibitsuhiko no Mikoto. It is said that Okibitsuhiko no Mikoto pacified the land of Kibi by the order of the Yamato court, and the shrine was established on the site of the residence that governed the land of Kibi. It is also known as 'The Shrine of the Morning Sun' because the morning sun rises directly in front of the torii gate on the day of the summer solstice.

description:
「みちのく潮風トレイル　～東北に誕生した森・里・海を感じる道～」

2019年6月。1,000キロを超えるロングトレイル「みちのく潮風トレイル」が東北太平洋沿岸に誕生しました。トレイルとは森林や原野、里山などにある歩く旅の道のこと。自然の中だけでなく、町から町をつなぎ、東北に暮らす人々と交流しながら、旅を楽しめるのがこのトレイルです。

みちのく潮風トレイルでしかできない体験がここにはあります。ぜひ、東北の歩く旅へ。

description:
三重と奈良にすっぽりと囲まれ、和歌山県内の他市町村と接していない日本で唯一の“飛び地”の村、和歌山県北山村。人口約380人、面積の93％が山と森に抱かれた自然の中で、ここにしかない暮らしが静かに息づいています。幻の柑橘「じゃばら」や、全国で唯一の「観光筏下り」など、土地の恵みを活かした文化が根付く、誇り高い秘境を訪ねてみませんか。

description:
Nestled entirely between Mie and Nara, Kitayama Village in Wakayama Prefecture is the only 'exclave' in Japan that does not border any other cities or towns in the prefecture. With a population of about 380 and 93% of its area embraced by mountains and forests, a unique way of life quietly thrives here. Would you like to visit this proud secret place, where a culture rooted in the blessings of the land, such as the elusive citrus 'Jabara' and the only 'tourist rafting' in the country, flourishes?

title: 熊野御幸の足跡をたどる旅 ―祈りの道「熊野古道」をゆく―【熊野御幸ゆかりの御朱印めぐり】
description:
熊野古道とは、京都をはじめ各地から熊野三山（熊野本宮大社、熊野速玉大社、熊野那智大社・那智山青岸渡寺）へと続く参詣道で、そのうち中辺路や大辺路の一部などが「紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道」として世界遺産に登録されています。
熊野古道は、古くから人々の祈りを運び、再生の地へと導いた“よみがえりの道”。都から高貴な方々が熊野を目指して旅をした「熊野御幸（くまのごこう）」こそが、この道のはじまりなんです！
 
上皇や法皇が都・京都から大阪を経て、熊野三山（熊野本宮大社、熊野速玉大社、熊野那智大社・那智山青岸渡寺）を目指した壮大な巡礼の旅。
日本における観光のはじまりと言われる熊野御幸について紹介いたします。
 
＃和歌山＃熊野古道＃熊野御幸＃城南宮＃熊野本宮大社＃熊野速玉大社＃熊野那智大社・那智山青岸渡寺＃熊野三山＃熊野詣

title: A Journey Following the Footsteps of Kumano Gokō - Walking the Sacred Path 'Kumano Kodo' - [Pilgrimage to the Sacred Seals Related to Kumano Gokō]
description:
The Kumano Kodo is a pilgrimage route that connects various places, including Kyoto, to the three Kumano mountains (Kumano Hongu Taisha, Kumano Hayatama Taisha, Kumano Nachi Taisha and Nachi San Seiganto-ji). Parts of the Nakahechi and Ohechi routes are registered as a World Heritage site under 'Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range.'
The Kumano Kodo has long carried the prayers of people and led them to a place of rebirth, known as the 'Path of Resurrection.' The 'Kumano Gokō,' where noble individuals from the capital traveled towards Kumano, is the origin of this path!

A grand pilgrimage journey undertaken by emperors and priests from the capital, Kyoto, through Osaka, aiming for the three Kumano mountains (Kumano Hongu Taisha, Kumano Hayatama Taisha, Kumano Nachi Taisha and Nachi San Seiganto-ji).
We will introduce the Kumano Gokō, said to be the beginning of tourism in Japan.

title: Today is Wakayama Day - A Couple's Trip
description:
A model plan for a 1-night, 2-day trip enjoying Tanabe and Shirahama with your partner.

After experiencing fruit-making using local citrus and enjoying a handmade lunch by local mothers at a renovated experiential facility that was once an elementary school, head to Tenjinzaki for Instagram-worthy photos, also known as Wakayama's Uyuni Salt Lake!?

On the second day, explore Adventure World, home to many animals including giant pandas, stroll along Shirarahama Beach, visit retro cafes, and enjoy the beautiful sunset at Chinjoh Beach, fully savoring Shirahama.

Relax at a hotel stay with an ocean view and an amazing open-air bath, making this a recommended couple's trip plan to explore Tanabe and Shirahama in 1 night and 2 days.

description:

2023年は高野山を開いた弘法大師空海の御誕生1250年にあたり、普段は非公開の御本尊の特別公開や限定御朱印など、パワースポット旅として注目が高まっています。

いざ、遊休の歴史を紡ぐ高野山へ出かけよう！

title: Wakayama Koyasan
description:
Now is the time to visit the powerful World Heritage Site, Koyasan.

The year 2023 marks the 1250th anniversary of the birth of Kobo Daishi Kukai, who opened Koyasan. There is increasing attention on power spot travel, with special openings of the usually closed main deity and limited edition goshuin stamps.

Let’s head to Koyasan, where the history of leisure is woven!

title: 「wakayama shirahama」
description:
和歌山で”海外リゾートステイ”気分が味わえる！？
パノラマに広がる水平線を眺めながら海沿いサイクリング、無人島でラグジュアリーなグランピングやBBQ...
そんな海外リゾートステイが和歌山・白浜でできるんです！

title: Wakayama Shirahama
description:
Experience the feeling of an 'overseas resort stay' in Wakayama!?
Enjoy seaside cycling while gazing at the panoramic horizon, luxurious glamping and BBQ on a deserted island...
You can have such an overseas resort stay in Shirahama, Wakayama!

title: 「wakayama nachikatsuura」
description:
「人生で一度は行きたい」聖地・和歌山県熊野エリア。
今こそ行っておきたい”パワースポット”なんです。
熊野古道の神聖な空気を浴び、幻の”もち鮪”を堪能し、太平洋を望む絶景露天風呂に癒される、極上のネイチャリング体験をチェック！
”紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道”は、世界文化遺産に登録され、2024年で20周年を迎えます。

title: Wakayama Nachikatsuura
description:
A sacred place in the Kumano area of Wakayama Prefecture that you must visit at least once in your life.
Now is the time to experience this 'power spot'.
Bathe in the sacred air of the Kumano Kodo, savor the elusive 'mochi tuna', and enjoy a healing experience in an open-air bath with a breathtaking view of the Pacific Ocean. Check out this ultimate nature experience!
The 'Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range' is registered as a UNESCO World Heritage Site and will celebrate its 20th anniversary in 2024.

title: 紀州浪漫 2023春　日本とトルコ　友好の原点の地へ
description: 日本とトルコ、遠く離れた両国の固い絆。明治期に串本沖で起きたトルコ船籍「エルトゥールル号」の遭難事件を知ると、その理由が見えてくる。歴史に思いを馳せながら、美しい海景を心ゆくまで眺めたい。

title: Kishu Romance Spring 2023: To the Land of Friendship between Japan and Turkey
description: The strong bond between Japan and Turkey, two countries far apart. Understanding the shipwreck incident of the Turkish vessel 'Ertuğrul' that occurred off the coast of Kushimoto during the Meiji period reveals the reason behind it. While reflecting on history, I want to gaze at the beautiful seascape to my heart's content.

title: 紀州浪漫2022秋　秋は和歌山でレトロモダン探しの旅
description:
世界遺産エリア（熊野）にある新宮市は、大正・昭和初期を代表する建築家 西村伊作のふるさと。今もなお西村伊作ゆかりのレトロモダンな建築物が残る芸術と文化が薫るまちです。秋は、世界遺産巡りに加えて、フォトジェニックな建築探訪をしながら文化に触れてみませんか。

観光情報誌「紀州浪漫」では、他にもレトロモダンな建築を訪ねる旅を紹介しています。

description:
Shingu City, located in the World Heritage area (Kumano), is the hometown of the architect Isaku Nishimura, who represents the Taisho and early Showa periods. It is a town rich in art and culture, where retro modern buildings associated with Nishimura still remain. This autumn, why not immerse yourself in culture while exploring photogenic architecture in addition to visiting World Heritage sites?

The tourism information magazine 'Kishu Romance' also introduces journeys to visit retro modern architecture.

title: なまら寒い、冬が来た。
description:
上富良野町に冬が来た

東京では紅葉が見ごろらしいと友人から聞きましたが、かみふらのではもう雪が積もっています。
まだ道路も見えますが、これからは一面の銀世界に！！
今年も寒い、かみふらの冬をぜひお楽しみください

title: It's really cold, winter has come.
description:
Winter has arrived in Kamifurano Town.

I heard from a friend that the autumn leaves are at their peak in Tokyo, but in Kamifurano, snow has already piled up.

The roads are still visible, but soon it will be a world of silver!

Please enjoy the cold Kamifurano winter this year as well.

title: 【冬の秘密の楽しみ方！】グランピング＆サウナで新たな冒険に出よう
description:
🌲 上富良野町で冬のアウトドア体験！🌲

冬の寒さも楽しんでしまおう！この動画では、北海道の美しい自然に囲まれた上富良野町で、東京の女子大生がグランピング、テントサウナ、そしてスノーシューを楽しむ様子をご覧ください。

🏕️ グランピングの贅沢な体験 🏕️

まずは、リッチなアウトドア体験としてグランピングをご紹介！山々の雪景色を望む快適なテントで、暖かいベッドでのんびり過ごしましょう。豪華なバーベキューや焚火も、自然の中での特別な時間を演出します。

🔥 テントサウナでリラックス 🔥

冷えきった身体を温めるために、贅沢なテントサウナ体験もお見逃しなく！自然の中で暖かさを楽しみながら、ストレスを忘れてリフレッシュしましょう。また、サウナの後には十勝岳の温泉で体を癒すこともできます。

この冬、自然とのふれあいと贅沢なアウトドア体験を求めるなら、上富良野町が最高の場所です！ぜひこの動画をチェックして、冬の冒険の準備を始めましょう！

❄️ スノーシューで雪山を探検 ❄️

次に、雪深い森林を探検するためにスノーシューを履いて冒険しましょう！専門ガイドが案内する中、あなたの足跡だけが雪に残る奥深い森の中を散策し、冬ならではの景色を満喫しましょう。

title: [Winter's Secret Enjoyment!] Let's Embark on a New Adventure with Glamping and Sauna
description:
🌲 Winter Outdoor Experience in Kamifurano Town! 🌲

Let's enjoy the winter chill! In this video, watch as a female university student from Tokyo enjoys glamping, tent sauna, and snowshoeing in the beautiful nature of Kamifurano Town, Hokkaido.

🏕️ A Luxurious Glamping Experience 🏕️

First, we introduce glamping as a rich outdoor experience! Relax in a comfortable tent with a view of the snowy mountains, enjoying warm beds. Luxurious barbecues and campfires create a special time in nature.

🔥 Relax in the Tent Sauna 🔥

Don't miss the luxurious tent sauna experience to warm up your chilled body! Enjoy the warmth in nature and refresh yourself while forgetting your stress. After the sauna, you can also soothe your body in the hot springs of Tokachidake.

This winter, if you're looking for a connection with nature and a luxurious outdoor experience, Kamifurano Town is the perfect place! Be sure to check out this video and start preparing for your winter adventure!

❄️ Explore the Snowy Mountains with Snowshoes ❄️

Next, let's wear snowshoes and embark on an adventure to explore the snow-covered forests! Guided by a professional, stroll through the deep forest where only your footprints remain in the snow, and enjoy the winter scenery unique to this season.

description:
In July 2023, we held the "Lavender Festa Kamifurano" at Hinode Park in Kamifurano Town, located on a small hill, where visitors could enjoy the night lavender.
This year marks the 42nd anniversary of lavender becoming the town flower of Kamifurano, and for a limited time, the Hinode Lavender Garden was illuminated! Residents, as well as people from all over Japan and abroad, enjoyed the town flower even at night.

On July 16 (Sunday), there were stage events, and the Lavender Festa reached its peak!
We uploaded a video summarizing special events, including a mini live performance by Kamifurano PR ambassador Yui Makino and a talk show by Kenshi Sugiya.
Please take a look.

パーラーラッキーズ上富良野店付近から、国道237号線しんえい橋の間、富良野川沿いの桜をライトアップ。
コロナ禍で遠出が出来ない中、身近な場所で町民の心を癒してくれる隠れた桜スポットです。「健康づくり推進のまち上富良野町」では、富良野川沿いの町民の散歩コース桜並木の遊歩道に、今年は桜が咲く夜に魔法をかけました。天気が良くない日もありましたが沢山の町民に楽しんでいただきました。

title: LIVE 35th北の大文字カウントダウン2021－2022 北海道上富良野町
description:
「北の大文字」は、年の暮れから年の初めである元旦午前0時、上富良野町内を一望する日の出公園の斜面に、縦70m・横50mの「大」の文字を描いた鉄杭300本に、かみふらの神社から採火した御神火を次々に灯し、雪一面の暗闇斜面に大文字を浮かび上がらせるという、雪国ならではの幻想的かつ雄大なイベントであり、今や上富良野町・富良野沿線の大晦日の風物詩として毎年、地域住民に定着しています。
　今年で35回を迎え、大の文字と花火で幻想的な中にも躍動感を演出し新しい年を祝い、共に誓いを行う機会とします。
　昨年に引き続き新型コロナウイルス感染症の一日も早い終息を合わせて願い、無観客での開催とします。また、その様子をライブ配信することにより、全世界へ上富良野町の魅力を配信いたします。

第35回北の大文字　～イベントスケジュール～
23：35　ライブ中継スタート
23：45　イベント開始／レーザー＆ムービングショー

title: LIVE 35th Northern Daimonji Countdown 2021-2022 Kamifurano Town, Hokkaido
description:
"Northern Daimonji" is a spectacular event unique to snowy regions, where at midnight on New Year's Day, a 70m tall and 50m wide character 'Dai' is illuminated on the slope of Hinode Park, overlooking the town of Kamifurano. This is achieved by lighting 300 iron stakes with the sacred fire taken from Kamifurano Shrine, creating a stunning visual of the character glowing against the dark snowy slope. This event has become a traditional New Year's Eve spectacle for the local residents of Kamifurano and the Furano area. This year marks the 35th edition, where we will celebrate the new year with a dynamic display of the 'Dai' character and fireworks, providing an opportunity for a collective vow. In light of the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, we will hold the event without an audience, while live streaming the event to share the charm of Kamifurano Town with the world.

title: 北広島町にも『むすびのむさし』があるって知ってましたか？ #北広島町 #むすびのむさし
description:
北広島町にも『むすびのむさし』があるって知ってましたか？
むさしどんぐり村豊平店に観光協会職員がレッツら モー‼️

広島県民みんな大好きむすびのむさし。
大人気の「若鶏むすび」のお弁当は、何度食べても「うんうん、これじゃ〜🥰✨」と染みる味。

広島県内には15店舗ありますが、その1つが北広島町にあるんです。
道の駅豊平どんぐり村はスポーツや蕎麦打ち、温泉など一日中楽しめる道の駅！

広島駅から下道で１時間、ゆったりドライブにもぴったりで広くて自然いっぱいです。

むさしのお店で食べるのはもちろん、近くの龍頭山の頂上でお弁当を食べるのもおすすめ。

標高928m⛰️山頂駐車場から徒歩約15分で頂上へ着くので、がっつり登山はキツイかも…と言う方にも🙆あずま屋もあるので、屋根の下でゆったり風を感じながら景色をお楽しみ頂けます。

たくさんの人に愛されるむすびのむさし。
北広島町豊平に遊びに来られた際にはぜひ食べに来てくださいね!!

Did you know that 'Musubi no Musashi' is also in Kitahiroshima Town?
The staff from the tourism association are having a great time at Musashi Donguri Village Toyohira‼️

Everyone in Hiroshima loves Musubi no Musashi.
The popular 'Wakadori Musubi' bento is a flavor that resonates every time you eat it, saying 'Yes, this is it~🥰✨'.

There are 15 locations in Hiroshima Prefecture, and one of them is in Kitahiroshima Town.
The roadside station Toyohira Donguri Village is a place where you can enjoy sports, soba making, hot springs, and more all day long!

It's just an hour's drive from Hiroshima Station via local roads, perfect for a leisurely drive with plenty of nature around.

Of course, you can eat at the Musashi store, but I also recommend having a bento at the top of nearby Ryutozan.

At an elevation of 928m⛰️, it takes about 15 minutes on foot from the summit parking lot to reach the top, so it's suitable even for those who might find a strenuous hike challenging…🙆 There’s also a resting area where you can enjoy the scenery while feeling the breeze under a roof.

Musubi no Musashi is loved by many.
If you visit Toyohira in Kitahiroshima Town, be sure to come and try it out!!

title: 北広島町のスキー場が盛り上がっているらしい⛄⛄ #旅行 #北広島町#広島  #雪  #スキー#グルメ
description:
冬だー！！スキーだ！！北広島町だ！！　
ということで観光協会職員が町内のスキー場へ遊びに行ってきました⛷️　こちらはロングバージョンです!!

広島って雪積もるん？って未だに聞かれる事があります。自信満々に答えます。北広島町、積もります。

オープンしたてのゲレンデはなんだか特別感があります。太陽に反射する雪がキラキラと美しい。
スキーウェアを着るだけでワクワクします☺️

オープンを心待ちにしておられたお客様。皆さん楽しそうに爽快に滑る姿がかっこよかったです。

町内のスキー場は3カ所。
・芸北高原 大佐スキー場
国道186号線沿いに位置し、駐車場の目の前にゲレンデが広がる。ワイドで緩やかなコースは初心者でも十分に楽しめると大人気。山頂からは中国山地を見渡す絶景が広がり、上級者向けコースを一気に滑り降りられる。「雪ん子パーク ぷぷら」は、ソリ専用ゲレンデとなっており、子供向けのイベントや雪遊びを体験できる。島根から来るペンギン達がゲレンデを歩くイベントも！！🐧🐧

・ユートピアサイオト
そりを持ってラクラク運べるスノーエスカレーターや雪遊びアイテムが盛りだくさんのお子様向けキッズキングダム、そして隣接する黄色い建物ソフィーズにはこたつ付休憩スペースがあり、3世代で1日中スキー場を満喫できる。「西日本最大級」のスノーパークも魅力。 いつでも極上スノーが楽しめ、コンパクトにまとめられたバラエティー豊かなコース展開のスキー場。

・やわたハイランド191リゾート
北広島町八幡地域にあるスキー場。町内で一番雪が積もると言われる地域で、人工造雪機も完備しているので、期間内いつ行っても雪がある！味、ボリューム満点な食事や休憩室、更衣室、スキーレンタル、スノボーレンタルなど施設も超充実！コースは初級から上級まで幅広く、キッズスノーランドも完備。オール世代で楽しめるスキー場。

title: It seems that the ski resorts in Kitahiroshima Town are thriving⛄⛄ #Travel #Kitahiroshima #Hiroshima #Snow #Skiing #Gourmet
description:
It's winter!! It's skiing!! It's Kitahiroshima Town!!
So, the tourism association staff went to play at the ski resorts in the town⛷️ This is the long version!!

People still ask me if it snows in Hiroshima. I confidently answer, "Yes, it snows in Kitahiroshima Town."

The freshly opened slopes have a special feel to them. The snow reflecting the sun sparkles beautifully.
Just putting on ski wear makes me excited☺️

Customers who were eagerly waiting for the opening looked cool as they joyfully glided down the slopes.

There are three ski resorts in the town.
・Geihoku Kogen Osa Ski Resort
Located along National Route 186, the slopes spread out right in front of the parking lot. The wide and gentle courses are very popular, as even beginners can enjoy them. From the summit, there is a breathtaking view of the Chugoku Mountains, and advanced courses can be skied down in one go. The "Yukinko Park Pupura" is a dedicated sledding slope where children can experience events and play in the snow. There’s even an event where penguins from Shimane walk on the slopes!!🐧🐧

・Utopia Saioto
With a snow escalator that makes it easy to carry sleds and a kids' kingdom filled with snow play items, the adjacent yellow building, Sophie’s, has a resting area with kotatsu, allowing three generations to enjoy the ski resort all day long. The "largest snow park in western Japan" is also a charm. You can enjoy top-notch snow anytime, and the ski resort features a compact and diverse range of courses.

・Yawata Highland 191 Resort
A ski resort located in the Yahata area of Kitahiroshima Town. It is said to be the area with the most snow in the town, and with artificial snow machines in place, there is always snow whenever you visit! The facilities are super well-equipped with delicious and hearty meals, rest areas, changing rooms, ski rentals, and snowboard rentals! The courses range from beginner to advanced, and there is also a kids' snowland. A ski resort that can be enjoyed by all generations.

🎿 Three ski resorts in Kitahiroshima Town☆Instagram🏂
Follow to check out ski resort information!!

🌟Geihoku Kogen Osa Ski Resort (38-31 Kojinhara, Kitahiroshima Town)

🌟Utopia Saioto (144 Saioto, Kitahiroshima Town)

🌟Yawata Highland 191 Resort (Nishi Yahatahara, Kitahiroshima Town)

For those coming from afar, there are many accommodations and guesthouses nearby, so please take your time to enjoy the winter in Kitahiroshima Town🏠

title: Strawberry Picking in Hiroshima - The Place to Be!! 🍓🍓 #KitahiroshimaTown #Outdoor #Travel #Strawberry
description:
Hey strawberry loversーー!!! 🍓🍓

We visited the Toyohira Donguri Farm in Kitahiroshima Town with the staff of the Kitahiroshima Town Tourism Association and the first Hiroshima Tourism Assistant, Mr. Miyauchi from Hiroshima Kinsaito!!

Mr. Miyauchi from Hiroshima Kinsaito is a tourism assistant who promotes tourism and events in Hiroshima. He visited us last June for the 'Mibu Flower Rice Planting' and has a great love for Kitahiroshima Town!

Mr. Yahagahana from Toyohira Donguri Farm guided us, who are crazy about strawberries. Let's go in a three-person version! So fresh! 😁

It's about a one-hour drive from Hiroshima City. You can enjoy nine carefully cultivated varieties until late May. You can enjoy a 30-minute all-you-can-eat with toppings like condensed milk, chocolate sauce, and whipped cream allowed to be brought in!

The strawberries are so big that when you stuff them in your mouth, you can't talk, so everyone enjoys them in silence. So sweet. And juicy.

Strawberries enjoyed with plenty of whipped cream... the feeling of luxury is irresistible✨️

The spacious pathways in the farm allow for comfortable access with strollers and wheelchairs.

According to Mr. Yahagahana, this time of year when the strawberries are big and sweet is especially recommended! For reservations and inquiries about strawberry picking, please check the Toyohira Donguri Farm's website and social media!

【Toyohira Donguri Farm】
Location: 4827-1 Asaka, Kitahiroshima Town, Yamagata District, Hiroshima Prefecture
Phone: 080-1633-2785
Business Hours: 10 AM - 4 PM (Open every day)

そのゆかり®︎を作っている三島食品のルーツが北広島町にあるって、みなさんご存知ですか〜？
三島食品のルーツが北広島町ならば、ゆかり®︎の所縁(ゆかり)も北広島町
①昭和24年に創業された三島哲男さんは北広島町有田の出身
②創業者 三島哲男さんの生家があった場所は、現在『楠苑』というふりかけの資料館になっています
③楠苑の前に広がる辺り一面シソ色の赤シソ畑！自社農園『紫の里』を北広島町に置いています
などなど…深〜い縁(ゆかり)があるのです。

北広島町では5月中旬からシソ色のじゅうたんが辺り一面に広がり、今だけの景色が広がります。

title: Scenery of Kitahiroshima Town - The Purple Village
description:
[Yukari®︎, a familiar name from Mishima Foods]
Did you know that the roots of the famous furikake 'Yukari®︎', known nationwide, are in Kitahiroshima Town?
If Mishima Foods has its roots in Kitahiroshima Town, then Yukari®︎ also has its connection to Kitahiroshima Town.
1. Mr. Tetsuo Mishima, who founded the company in 1949, is from Arita in Kitahiroshima Town.
2. The birthplace of founder Mr. Tetsuo Mishima is now a furikake museum called 'Kusunoki-en'.
3. In front of Kusunoki-en, there is a vast field of red shiso, colored like shiso! Our own farm 'The Purple Village' is located in Kitahiroshima Town.
And so on... there is a deep connection.

In Kitahiroshima Town, from mid-May, a carpet of shiso spreads across the area, creating a unique scenery just for this time.
*The photo was taken on June 13, 2023.

✨The staff of the tourism association visited Shikinoya Ayakura to try their special autumn menu✨

The evening atmosphere at Ayakura is different from the daytime, with the gentle light of the stone lanterns bringing a sense of calm.

The highlight of this autumn menu is the "Hot Rice Flour Stew."
Inside the rich and sweet pumpkin stew is a hamburger packed with umami!

Each dish has a "beauty" that is enjoyable to the eyes, and seasonal ingredients become even more delicious with the chef's skill, shining on the plate.

title: 県立広島大学の大学祭「紫苑祭」に行ってきました！！ #北広島町#旅行 　#大学　#観光
description:
🐮県立広島大学さんの大学祭「紫苑祭」に参加させていただきました🐮

ブースでは町内のスキー場さんとリフト券やカープグッズが当たるガラポン抽選会を行いました！

たくさんの方が参加してくれて、スキー場のリフト券を当てて大喜びしてくれる生徒さんの姿が印象的でした☺

ステージでの観光PRでは、北広島町の伝統芸能やスキー場情報をお話した後に✨景品付きクイズ大会✨を開催。

町内のクイズ三択問題を真剣に考えてくれる生徒さんたちがとってもかわいかったです💛

「おいでよ！キタひろ」ダンスはたくさんの生徒さんが一緒に踊ってくれて「おい！おい！おい！」と元気のいい（野太い）掛け声もあり、大盛り上がりでした。

いきなり参加することになった「腕相撲大会」では舞太郎くんと優勝者が対決🔥🔥

あっさり負けて悔しそうな舞太郎くんでした。

チュロスや肉巻きおにぎりの出店や、お化け屋敷にカジノなどなどこれぞ大学祭！！という青春の場で観光PRが出来て大変嬉しく思います。

今年の冬も、ぜひ北広島町のスキー場に遊びに来てくださいね⛄

title: I went to the Hiroshima Prefectural University Festival 'Shion Festival'!! #KitahiroshimaTown #Travel #University #Tourism
description:
🐮I participated in the Hiroshima Prefectural University's festival 'Shion Festival'🐮

At the booth, we held a lottery draw with lift tickets from the local ski resort and Carp merchandise!

Many people participated, and it was impressive to see students who won ski resort lift tickets rejoicing☺

During the tourism PR on stage, after talking about the traditional performing arts and ski resort information of Kitahiroshima Town, we held a quiz competition with prizes✨.

The students who seriously thought about the multiple-choice quiz questions from the town were so cute💛.

The 'Come on! Kita Hiro' dance had many students dancing together, and there were energetic (deep-voiced) cheers of 'Oi! Oi! Oi!' which created a lively atmosphere.

In the sudden 'Arm Wrestling Tournament', Maitaro-kun faced off against the champion🔥🔥.

Maitaro-kun lost easily and looked quite disappointed.

With stalls selling churros and meat-wrapped rice balls, as well as a haunted house and casino, it was truly a place of youth that represents a university festival, and I was very happy to promote tourism there.

Please come and visit the ski resort in Kitahiroshima Town this winter too⛄

玄関に入ると、季節の花、ひまわり🌻がお出迎え。

洗練された美しさと、心がほどける「和」の空間がブレンドされた店内は女将のセンスが光ります。

そうです、来て、食べる。それだけでたくさんの方に愛される理由がわかります。

title: ✨We visited 'Shikinoya Ayakura', celebrating its 20th anniversary, for lunch with Maitaro Hanada and the tourism association staff✨
description:
✨We visited 'Shikinoya Ayakura', celebrating its 20th anniversary, for lunch with Maitaro Hanada and the tourism association staff✨

Upon entering the entrance, seasonal flowers, sunflowers 🌻, greet you.

The interior, blending refined beauty with a relaxing 'Japanese' atmosphere, showcases the sense of the owner.

What we had this time was a limited 10 servings soba lunch. (For details on the soba lunch, check Ayakura's SNS ✅)
The seasonal ingredients carefully selected by the chef are beautiful and, needless to say, exquisite.

As I took a bite of the corn rice, the sweet corn wafted through my nose. Eating seasonal foods fills you with the energy to cheerfully overcome that season.

At 'Shikinoya Ayakura', you can leisurely enjoy carefully selected seafood and mountain delicacies in an elegant space, and this August marks its 20th anniversary 🎉

"Fortunately, we have been fully reservation-based for 20 years. The reason is... come to the restaurant and see for yourself♡" says the playful chef 😚

絶叫が苦手な職員はジップラインのスタート地点の高さにビビり、へっぴり腰でなんとかジャンプ。

思い切っていってしまえばもう風を体全体で感じて爽快感を楽しむだけ。

しっかりと操作を教えてもらい、いざ出発。親鳥を追う雛のように、支配人の山元さんに必死についていきます。

一番人気のコース「天空バギーアドベンチャー」走行距離4,000m、標高1,000mを登っていき、頂上へ。
そこには、日本海まで見渡せる絶景が広がっていました。

深呼吸して、大自然のパワーを体いっぱいに吸い込みます。なんだか私自身がレベルアップような達成感と感動がありました。
