title: ✨We experienced the limited-time 'Summer Activities' at Utopia Saioto Ski Resort in Kitahiroshima Town with Maitaro and the tourism association staff!!✨
description:
✨We experienced the limited-time 'Summer Activities' at Utopia Saioto Ski Resort in Kitahiroshima Town with Maitaro and the tourism association staff!!✨

This time, we tried two activities: the 'Zip Line,' where you slide down a rope stretched between trees using a pulley, and the 'Buggy Adventure,' which takes you racing through the slopes and forest roads.

One staff member, who isn't fond of screams, was scared by the height at the starting point of the zip line and managed to jump with a stiff back.

But once you take the plunge, you can just feel the wind all over your body and enjoy the refreshing sensation.

While enjoying the view from the air, I even had the luxury of thinking, 'Is this how birds feel?' ☺ There are a total of six courses, so next time, I’m going to conquer them all!!

And personally, the 'Buggy Adventure' was even more thrilling than the zip line.

After receiving thorough instructions on how to operate, we set off. Like chicks following their parent bird, we desperately kept up with the manager, Mr. Yamamoto.

The most popular course, 'Sky Buggy Adventure,' has a distance of 4,000m and climbs to an elevation of 1,000m, reaching the summit.

There, a breathtaking view that extends all the way to the Sea of Japan unfolded before us.

Taking a deep breath, I absorbed the power of nature with my whole body. I felt a sense of achievement and emotion as if I had leveled up myself.

This summer, let’s break out of our shells at Utopia Saioto.

title: I Went on a Factory Tour of Furikake.
description:
The other day, I had the opportunity to tour the factory!!

【The Connection with Mishima Foods, Famous for Yukari®︎】
Did you know that the roots of Yukari®, the big ace of furikake now known nationwide, are in Kitahiroshima Town?
If Mishima Foods has its roots in Kitahiroshima Town, then Yukari®︎ also has its connection there.
1. Mr. Tetsuo Mishima, who founded the company in 1949, is from Arita in Kitahiroshima Town.
2. The place where the founder, Mr. Tetsuo Mishima, was born is now a furikake museum called 'Kusunoki-en'.
3. The area in front of Kusunoki-en is filled with red shiso fields in a shiso color! They have their own farm, 'Murasaki no Sato', located in Kitahiroshima Town.
And so on... there is a deep connection.

In Kitahiroshima Town, from mid-May, a carpet of shiso color spreads all around, creating a unique scenery that can only be seen now.
*The photo was taken on June 13, 2023.

title: The Land Associated with the Yoshikawa Clan
description:
【Toyohira Area, Kitahiroshima Town】
Numerous historical sites of the Yoshikawa clan, who ruled this area during the Sengoku period, remain, allowing visitors to feel the footsteps of the samurai and the breath of the people.

【Yoshikawa Motoharu Residence Ruins Historical Park】
The ruins of a residence built as a retirement home for Yoshikawa Motoharu. Many building foundations, toilets, wells, and gardens have been discovered. In the restored kitchen building, cooking can be done using a kamado and a hearth.

【Sengoku Garden Historical Museum】
An exhibition facility that guides visitors through the entire site of the Yoshikawa clan's castle ruins. It features displays of artifacts unearthed from the site, exhibitions on medieval life, and armor displays, with the opportunity to try on armor.

title: 加太 淡嶋神社 雛流し
description:
淡嶋神社ホームページより
・雛流しの神事
三月三日は、朝から神社のなかは人々の熱気でむせかえります。それぞれの思いや願いと共に、関西はもとより日本全国から境内に女性たちが集まってきます。
そして、日が高くのぼった正午、ひな流しの神事がおごそかに始まります。
人形に願い事を書き、人形とともに舟に乗せます。
「幼い日、あの人形と遊んだなあ」「嫁に行った娘が幸せでありますように」・・・女性の思いのたけをすべて込めた人形で、雛流しの船はいっぱいになっていきます。
穏やかな春の海に千羽鶴がまかれ、神の国へと続く道ができます。
そこへ、本殿でお祓いを受けた人形を満載した白木の船がしずしずと進んでいきます。
船にぎっしりと積み上げられた無数の人形たちは、先導する船に引かれ、沖へ沖へと
向かっていきます。波のまにまに揺られて、浮かんでは沈み、波間に見え隠れする人形たち。
キラキラと輝く海面を進む、黄金色や朱色のあでやかな着物をまとった人形たちは、まるで生きているようです。
心が澄みわたる瞬間が訪れ、手を合わす人、俳句や短歌を詠む人、シャッターを切る人、たたずむ人、涙ぐむ人・・・ひとりひとりの思いが神の国へと流れていきます。

title: Kada Awashima Shrine Hina Nagashi
description:
From the Awashima Shrine website
・Hina Nagashi Ritual
On March 3rd, the shrine is filled with the excitement of people from the morning. Women gather in the precincts, not only from Kansai but from all over Japan, each bringing their own thoughts and wishes.
At noon, when the sun is high in the sky, the Hina Nagashi ritual begins solemnly.
They write their wishes on dolls and place them on boats along with the dolls.
"I used to play with that doll when I was young," "I hope my daughter who has married is happy"... The boats for Hina Nagashi fill up with dolls that carry the heartfelt wishes of women.
A thousand cranes are released into the calm spring sea, creating a path to the land of the gods.
A white wooden boat loaded with dolls that have been purified at the main shrine glides forward quietly.
Countless dolls piled high on the boat are pulled by the leading boat, heading further out to sea. Rocked by the waves, the dolls float and sink, appearing and disappearing among the waves.
Dressed in splendid golden and vermilion kimonos, the dolls moving across the sparkling sea surface seem almost alive.
A moment of clarity arrives, with people joining their hands in prayer, composing haiku or tanka, taking photos, standing still, or becoming teary-eyed... Each person's thoughts flow toward the land of the gods.

title: 和歌山加太・天然鯛一本釣り漁法ロングバージョン
description:
一本釣りとは針にえさや擬似餌を付けて、一匹の魚を釣る漁法です。
群れごと網で獲ったりせず、食い気のある元気な魚と漁師の一対一の勝負になります。

美味しさの理由のひとつは、魚が元気なことです。自分で餌に食らいついてくる活きの良さは網獲りの魚とは違います。
さらに紀淡海峡の速い潮！
関サバと同じように速い潮はたくましい魚を育てます。
そして活き魚での流通！
活きたままで大阪などの料亭に運ばれグルメの食膳にのぼります。

加太の漁師たちは、効率は悪いけれど江戸時代から続く伝統漁法を守っています。
ぜひ産地で美味しい魚を味わってください。

title: Wakayama Kada - Long Version of Natural Sea Bream Fishing Method
description:
The one-by-one fishing method involves attaching bait or lures to a hook to catch a single fish.
Instead of catching schools of fish with nets, it becomes a one-on-one battle between a lively fish and the fisherman.

One reason for the deliciousness is that the fish are lively. The freshness of a fish that eagerly bites the bait is different from that of net-caught fish.
Moreover, the fast currents of the Kitan Strait!
Just like the famous Saba from Kansei, the swift currents nurture robust fish.
And the distribution of live fish!
They are transported alive to restaurants in Osaka and other places, gracing the tables of gourmets.

The fishermen of Kada uphold traditional fishing methods that have been passed down since the Edo period, even though they are not the most efficient.
Please enjoy delicious fish from the production area.

広大な敷地の中には、グラウンドゴルフ場やテニスコートがあり、さまざまなアクティビティーが楽しめます。

美しい大自然の中で、ゆったりとしたひとときをお過ごしください。

Please spend a relaxing time in the beautiful great outdoors.

At the southern tip of Akita Prefecture, Mount Chokai straddles Yamagata Prefecture.
Yurihonjo City is located at the northern foot of Mount Chokai and is the largest municipality in Akita Prefecture, connecting the inland area to the Sea of Japan.
Tourism in Yurihonjo City takes advantage of its vast outdoor fields for outdoor leisure activities, but it faces challenges such as the aging of players and the deterioration of facilities, prompting efforts to promote generational change and the redevelopment of new outdoor activity bases.

title: nara mahoroba
description:
東京新橋にある奈良県ブランドショップのご紹介。
東京でも奈良を気軽に感じていただける場所。
１F観光案内コーナーでは観光コンシェルジュが旬の情報をお伝えし、よりよい奈良の旅をご提案します。

ホームページ：https://nara-mahoroba.pref.nara.jp/

東京都港区新橋1丁目８－４ SMBC 新橋ビル１F・２F

【１F　Shop】
奈良で生まれた魅力的な商品それぞれがもつストーリーを丁寧にご紹介します。
日々の生活にとりいれることで暮らしが豊かになる、奈良の良いものをとりそろえています。

【１F　Cafe & Bar】
奈良の食材で彩る“かき氷の聖地” 奈良のかき氷。
奈良の歴史と深い関わりを持つ日本酒や、新しい奈良を感じる
こだわりのクラフトビール。
気軽に奈良を味わえるフードメニューもご用意しています。

【２F　TOKi（Restaurant & Bar）】
ＴＯＫｉでは奈良の生産者と連携し、料理を通して季節の素材や奈良の風土と歴史を皆様に感じていただけるようなメニューを構成しています。
季節に合わせ少しずつ移ろう料理をレストランではコースで、バルエリアでは単品で、ワインや奈良の地酒、季節の果物のお飲み物とともにお楽しみ頂けます。

title: nara mahoroba
description:
Introduction to the Nara Prefecture brand shop located in Shimbashi, Tokyo.
A place where you can easily feel the essence of Nara even in Tokyo.
On the 1st floor, the tourist information corner features a concierge who provides seasonal information and suggests a better travel experience in Nara.

Homepage: https://nara-mahoroba.pref.nara.jp/

1-8-4 Shimbashi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, SMBC Shimbashi Building 1F & 2F

【1F Shop】
We carefully introduce the stories behind each attractive product born in Nara.
We offer good items from Nara that enrich your daily life when incorporated into it.

【1F Cafe & Bar】
Nara's shaved ice, a 'holy place' colored with Nara's ingredients.
Japanese sake deeply connected to Nara's history, and craft beer that allows you to feel the new Nara.
We also have a food menu that lets you casually taste Nara.

【2F TOKi (Restaurant & Bar)】
At TOKi, we collaborate with Nara producers to create a menu that allows everyone to experience seasonal ingredients and the culture and history of Nara through cuisine.
The dishes change gradually with the seasons, available as a course in the restaurant and as individual items in the bar area, enjoyed with wine, local sake from Nara, and seasonal fruit beverages.

description:

日本最古の名湯といわれる道後温泉をはじめとする温泉や、近代俳句の礎を築いた正岡子規の存在などもあり、「いで湯と城と文学のまち」と言われているほど文化的魅力が豊富。
市の中心には、全国でも貴重な江戸時代から残る天守を有する松山城があり、その麓に広がる町には、城下町の文化が息づいています。古くから四国遍路のおへんろさんを迎えてきた町らしく、旅人を温かく迎え入れる「おもてなし」も息づいています。

title: Kyun desu. Matsuyama Trip | Shikoku Matsuyama Setouchi Matsuyama [Matsuyama City Official]
description:
Matsuyama City in Ehime Prefecture faces the calm and beautiful Seto Inland Sea, and it is a comfortable area with a mild climate and little rain throughout the year.

With hot springs such as Dogo Onsen, said to be Japan's oldest famous hot spring, and the presence of Masaoka Shiki, who laid the foundation for modern haiku, it is rich in cultural attractions, often referred to as the "town of hot springs, castles, and literature."

At the center of the city stands Matsuyama Castle, which has a valuable keep that has remained since the Edo period, and the town that spreads at its foot is alive with the culture of a castle town. True to its history of welcoming pilgrims on the Shikoku pilgrimage, the town also embodies the spirit of "omotenashi," warmly welcoming travelers.

title: 【松山市公式PR動画】 松山城 「段サンブル」
description:
松山市公式PR動画｜ 松山城 「段サンブル」
公式WEBサイト：https://matsuyama-sightseeing.com/

松山城を舞台に来場者とお城スタッフがコミカルにダンスを交えて演じる「段サンブル（だんさんぶる）」。
松山城は国内に12しかない江戸時代以前に建造された天守を持つ城の一つで、1602年から築城を開始し、四半世紀をかけて完成した。市内中心部に位置し、天守の最上階からは松山平野や瀬戸内海などが見渡せる。二之丸から本丸にかけては 韓国の倭城の防備手法である「登り石垣」があり、堀之内を含む城山公園全体が国の史跡になっているほか、21棟が重要文化財に指定されている。2014年にはトリップアドバイザーの「行って良かった！日本の城ランキング」で第2位に選定された。桜の名所としても有名。

title: [Matsuyama City Official PR Video] Matsuyama Castle 'Dan Sanburu'
description:
Matsuyama City Official PR Video | Matsuyama Castle 'Dan Sanburu'
Official website: https://matsuyama-sightseeing.com/

'Dan Sanburu' is a comedic dance performance featuring visitors and castle staff set against the backdrop of Matsuyama Castle.
Matsuyama Castle is one of the few castles in Japan with a keep built before the Edo period, with construction starting in 1602 and completed over a quarter of a century. Located in the city center, the top floor of the keep offers views of the Matsuyama Plain and the Seto Inland Sea. Between the Ninomaru and Honmaru, there is a 'nobori ishigaki,' a defensive technique used in Korean Wajo castles, and the entire area of Shiroyama Park, including the Horinouchi, is designated as a national historic site, with 21 buildings designated as important cultural properties. In 2014, it was ranked 2nd in TripAdvisor's 'Best Japanese Castles to Visit.' It is also famous as a cherry blossom viewing spot.

description:
"Shikoku Setouchi Matsuyama" Official Tourism Website of Matsuyama City
https://matsuyama-sightseeing.com

Matsuyama City faces the calm and beautiful Seto Inland Sea, and it is a pleasant area with a mild climate and little rain throughout the year. The western side of the city, which is highly convenient, is by the sea, while the eastern side has mountains, combining the comforts of urban life with the tranquility of the countryside.
Additionally, the city is rich in cultural attractions, being known as the "town of hot springs, castles, and literature," with the famous Dogo Onsen, said to be Japan's oldest hot spring, and the presence of Masaoka Shiki, who laid the foundation for modern haiku. At the center of the city stands Matsuyama Castle, which has a valuable Edo-period keep, and the town that spreads at its foot is alive with the culture of a castle town. True to its history of welcoming pilgrims on the Shikoku pilgrimage, the town embodies a warm hospitality that welcomes travelers.

title: 【ヨロン島】沖縄からヨロン島へのフェリーの旅（ショート版）
description:
公式サイト：http://www.yorontou.info/
公式インスタグラム：https://www.instagram.com/yoron_island_official/

沖縄北部エリアは2021年に世界自然遺産に認定されました。
沖縄北部のやんばるの森には、美しく生い茂る緑豊かな森や、清らかな水の流れ、数多くの希少な動植物が生息します。

沖縄北部の本部港からフェリーで約2時間、美しい青い海を誇る「南国の楽園 ヨロン島」があります。

ヨロン島には美しく青く輝くYORON BLUEの海、そしてそれを楽しむ様々なマリンレジャーがあります。
また、海だけでなく、歴史や郷土文化、美味しい食事、そして島の人々との出会いが忘れられない旅の思い出を作ります。
友達と一緒に、カップルでも、ファミリーでも、この島の美しい海と優しい人々は、いつでもあなたを待っています。

沖縄のやんばるの緑と、ヨロン島の美しい海のブルー。
海を挟んで広がる異なる2つの魅力はフェリーで繋がり、1つの特別な観光体験をお届けします。

---

title: [Yoron Island] A Ferry Journey from Okinawa to Yoron Island (Short Version)
description:
Official website: http://www.yorontou.info/
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/yoron_island_official/

The northern area of Okinawa was designated as a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site in 2021.
In the forests of Yanbaru in northern Okinawa, there are lush green forests, clear flowing waters, and numerous rare plants and animals.

About 2 hours by ferry from Motobu Port in northern Okinawa lies Yoron Island, a 'tropical paradise' boasting beautiful blue seas.

Yoron Island features the stunning YORON BLUE sea and various marine leisure activities to enjoy.
In addition to the sea, the island offers a rich history, local culture, delicious food, and unforgettable encounters with the island's people, creating lasting memories of your journey.
Whether with friends, as a couple, or with family, the beautiful sea and kind people of this island are always waiting for you.

The greenery of Yanbaru in Okinawa and the beautiful blue sea of Yoron Island.
These two distinct attractions, separated by the sea, are connected by a ferry, delivering a unique tourism experience.

title: I'm empty, Yoron Island
description:
からっぽな私、与論島　I'm empty, Yoron Island


時代が大きく変わりゆく今、多くの人が「生きていくこと」を見つめ直している。
東京で役者として活動する小野春花（28）
甘くない芸能の世界、立ち止まることもある。
自分で脚本を書いて、自分の映画を作りたいと
いつか映画で観た島、与論島を訪れる。
しかし脚本が全く書くことができない。
書きたいことがない自分の今までの人生は「からっぽ」なんじゃないかと涙を流す。
自分の足で歩き、自分の目で見る、自分の言葉で話す。
からっぽの私が人間らしく居られる場所、与論島
私の目に映るすべてが大切な物語になる。


出演　　小野春花
助監督　濱谷幸江
監督　　福山功起

title: I'm empty, Yoron Island
description:
I'm empty, Yoron Island

In this time of great change, many people are re-evaluating what it means to 'live.'
Haruka Ono (28), an actress active in Tokyo,
faces the harsh realities of the entertainment world and sometimes comes to a standstill.
She dreams of writing her own script and making her own film,
and visits the island she once saw in a movie, Yoron Island.
However, she finds herself unable to write a single line of the script.
Tears flow as she questions whether her life so far has been 'empty' due to her lack of things to express.
Walking on her own feet, seeing with her own eyes, and speaking in her own words.
Yoron Island is a place where the empty me can be human,
and everything I see becomes an important story.

description:
■一心行の大桜

菜の花の絨毯に囲まれた樹齢400年の一本桜。

樹齢約400年、樹高14m、枝張り東西21.3ｍ、南北26ｍ、幹周り7.35m。南阿蘇村のシンボル的な大桜（ヤマザクラ）で、淡い薄紅色の花をつけます。満開時には期間限定でライトアップが行われ、菜の花と桜の幻想的な風景も楽しめます。

開花時期：3月下旬～4月上旬頃

title: [VR] Minami Aso: A 360° View of Isshingyo's Great Cherry Blossom from the Sky
description:
■ Isshingyo's Great Cherry Blossom

A single cherry tree, 400 years old, surrounded by a carpet of rapeseed flowers.

Approximately 400 years old, 14m tall, with a branch spread of 21.3m east-west and 26m north-south, and a trunk circumference of 7.35m. This symbolic great cherry blossom (Yamazakura) of Minami Aso Village blooms with pale pink flowers. During full bloom, there is a limited-time illumination event, allowing visitors to enjoy the fantastical scenery of rapeseed flowers and cherry blossoms.

Blooming period: Late March to early April

description:
熊本県南阿蘇村うまれのハーブティー専門店「南阿蘇TEA HOUSE」。
阿蘇の山々と穏やかな太陽の日差しのもと、豊かな自然の中でハーブの栽培に取り組み、世界各地から厳選したハーブも取り扱い、全てのブレンドを自社で行っています。

良質な水と土、穏やかな日差しと心地よい風。ハーブにとって素晴らしい条件がそろった熊本県南阿蘇村で大切に育てハーブの力を引き出すことで、香り豊かな美味しいハーブができあがります。

description:
Herbal tea specialty store 'Minami-Aso TEA HOUSE' born in Minami-Aso Village, Kumamoto Prefecture.
Under the Aso mountains and gentle sunlight, we engage in herb cultivation in rich nature, handling carefully selected herbs from around the world, and all blends are done in-house.

With high-quality water and soil, gentle sunlight, and pleasant winds, Minami-Aso Village in Kumamoto Prefecture provides excellent conditions for herbs. By carefully nurturing them and bringing out their power, we create fragrant and delicious herbs.
*No pesticides or chemical fertilizers are used. They are cultivated in safe farmland certified by JAS.

title: 熊本県南阿蘇村ふるさと納税・返礼品PRムービー「オーガニック野菜のベビーフード」
description:
南阿蘇村返礼品でも人気の離乳食「くちどけ」シリーズ。
栄養士が監修、産婦人科で扱われている安心安全な離乳食です。
はじまりは、有名産婦人科から「離乳食をつくってほしい」という依頼があったことから。
栄養士が監修し、専門医と相談しながらつくったので、どこよりも安心安全です。
現在も有名産婦人科で扱われ、多くの親子に愛されています。

「くちどけシリーズ」を作られている南阿蘇オーガニックはもともと10年以上化粧品やハーブの栽培をしていた会社。もちろんその時からオーガニックにこだわり、安心安全を大切にしてきました。しかし化粧品やハーブにとどまらず、食品の安心安全も追求していくように。特に赤ちゃんに「一番最初から安心安全なものを与えたい」という想いで作られています。

title: Kumamoto Prefecture Minami-Aso Village Furusato Tax Donation & Return Gift PR Movie 'Organic Vegetable Baby Food'
description:
The 'Kuchidoke' series of baby food is popular among return gifts from Minami-Aso Village.
It is a safe and secure baby food supervised by a nutritionist and used in obstetrics and gynecology.
The beginning was a request from a famous obstetrics and gynecology clinic to 'create baby food.'
Supervised by a nutritionist and developed in consultation with specialists, it is safer and more secure than anywhere else.
It is still used in a well-known obstetrics and gynecology clinic and loved by many parents and children.

Minami-Aso Organic, which produces the 'Kuchidoke series,' originally had over 10 years of experience in cultivating cosmetics and herbs. 
Of course, they have been committed to organic practices and prioritizing safety and security since then. 
However, they have expanded their pursuit of safety and security in food, not just cosmetics and herbs. 
It is created with the desire to provide babies with 'the safest and most secure products from the very beginning.'

2013 国際味覚審査機構にて牛乳では日本で初めての 三ツ星を受賞しました。
そんなＡＳＯＭＩＬＫを使用し自社工場で自家製のクリームチーズを作ることから始め、そのほかの原料にも熊本の地下水で育った小麦を選定しています。独自の製法でしっとりと焼き上げ口の中でとろけるまるで生キャラメルのような不思議な食感を追求しました。また「一五九二（ひごくに）」の由来は熊本県の阿蘇山の標高1592ｍ（高岳）と、肥後の国から名づけられました。冷やしても凍らせても美味しくいただけます。

title: Kumamoto Prefecture Minami Aso Village Furusato Tax Donation & Return Gift PR Movie 'Minami Aso Confectionery Kikon-do' Edition
description:
The fresh cheese bun 'Higokuni' is a heartfelt creation that has been carefully crafted from the selection of ingredients. The main ingredient for the cheese filling is ASOMILK from Abe Farm.
In 2013, it was awarded the Three Stars at the International Taste Institute, becoming the first in Japan for milk.
Using ASOMILK, we started by making homemade cream cheese in our own factory, and we also select wheat grown with Kumamoto's underground water for other ingredients. We pursued a unique method to achieve a moist bake with a mysterious texture that melts in your mouth, reminiscent of fresh caramel. Additionally, the name 'Higokuni' is derived from the elevation of 1592 meters (Takadake) of Mount Aso in Kumamoto Prefecture and is named after the Higo region. It can be enjoyed deliciously whether chilled or frozen.

title: 【デジタルデトックス×民泊】「スマホを"OFF"にしたら、ワタシが"ON"になった。」【長崎県佐世保市宇久町観光協会PR動画】
description:
長崎県佐世保市の宇久島（うくじま）で、
九州初の「デジタルデトックス × 民泊」を軸とした観光プロモーションをスタートしました。

それにあたって、宇久島に訪れるとどんな体験ができるのか、その様子を５分間のムービーにしました。
デジタル社会に疲れたサラリーマンが、宇久島を訪れて、心が充電されていく様子をストーリーにしています。
宇久島にある自然・食・人が与えてくれる「心を充電する」癒やし旅をぜひご覧ください。

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
詳しくは、下記特設サイトから！

■宇久島「デジタルデトックス × 民泊」特設サイト
https://bit.ly/ukujima_digitaldetox
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

■デジタルデトックス(脱デジタル)を軸として発信する理由
急速に発展したデジタル社会において、SNSなどのツールを活用し常に社会と繋がること ができるようになりました。
その一方で、デジタル社会との繋がりにより、膨大な情報に囲 まれたり、他者との比較を余儀なくされたりと、疲弊してしまっている人も少なくありません。
そうした時代背景のなか、短期間だけデジタルから離れて生活を見つめ直す「デジタル デトックス」が注目を集めています。
デジタルから離れて生活する場として、宇久島にある 自然・食・人は、「心を充電する」癒やしの旅を提供できると考えたため、「デジタルデ トックス × 民泊」を軸とした発信をおこないます。

title: [Digital Detox × Minpaku] 'When I turned my smartphone 'OFF', I became 'ON.' [Nagasaki Prefecture Sasebo City Uku Town Tourism Association PR Video]
description:
In Uku Island, Sasebo City, Nagasaki Prefecture, 
the first tourism promotion in Kyushu based on 'Digital Detox × Minpaku' has started.

In this context, we created a 5-minute movie showcasing the experiences one can have when visiting Uku Island.
The story follows a salaryman who, tired of the digital society, visits Uku Island and finds his heart recharged.
Please enjoy this healing journey that 'recharges the heart' through the nature, food, and people of Uku Island.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
For more details, please visit the special site below!

■ Uku Island 'Digital Detox × Minpaku' Special Site
https://bit.ly/ukujima_digitaldetox
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

■ Reasons for promoting based on Digital Detox (detaching from digital)
In the rapidly developed digital society, we have become able to connect with society at all times by utilizing tools like social media.
On the other hand, many people are exhausted due to being surrounded by vast amounts of information and being forced to compare themselves with others because of their connection to the digital society.
In this backdrop, 'Digital Detox,' which allows people to step away from digital life for a short period and reflect on their lives, is gaining attention.
We believe that the nature, food, and people of Uku Island can provide a healing journey that 'recharges the heart,' which is why we will promote 'Digital Detox × Minpaku.'

description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

福山市田尻町。
瀬戸内のほぼ真ん中にあるこのまちで
個性豊かなイタリア野菜を育てるのは
田中陽三郎さん。

色鮮やかで甘いパプリカ「パレルモ」
ちりちりフリルの「カリーノケール」
とげとげ頭の「ロマネスコ」
宇宙人みたいなカブ「コールラビ」...

どれもこれも見た目はすごく個性的。
それでいて嫌なクセが少なく食べやすい。

2年前に田尻に住む仲間がつないだご縁で
この地にたどり着いたイタリア野菜の種。

栽培技術を上げ、品種を増やし
ひとづてに評判が広がり
今では地元飲食店がこぞって使うほど
人気の食材に育っている。

洒落たイタリア料理店だけでなく
ラーメン屋さんやカレー屋さんまで
あらゆる料理人の好奇心を刺激し
お皿を鮮やかに彩るイタリア野菜。

まずは塩とオリーブオイルでめしあがれ。

Tajiri Town, Fukuyama City.
In this town, located almost in the center of the Seto Inland Sea,
Yosaburo Tanaka grows a variety of unique Italian vegetables.

Colorful and sweet bell pepper "Palermo"
Frilly "Carino Kale"
Spiky-headed "Romanesco"
Alien-like turnip "Kohlrabi"...

Each one is visually striking.
Yet, they are easy to eat with minimal unpleasant quirks.

Two years ago, through a connection made by friends living in Tajiri,
the seeds of Italian vegetables arrived in this land.

By improving cultivation techniques and increasing varieties,
word of mouth has spread,
and now they have become popular ingredients
that local restaurants eagerly use.

Not only chic Italian restaurants,
but also ramen shops and curry houses
are stimulated by the curiosity of all kinds of chefs,
coloring their plates vibrantly with Italian vegetables.

Start by enjoying them with salt and olive oil.

新型コロナウイルスの感染拡大による未曾有の事態。

title: What I Can Do Now.
description:

https://etooto.jp/

May 2021
An unprecedented situation due to the spread of the novel coronavirus.

A woman who volunteered to provide meals for mild patients in the kitchen of a COVID-19 accommodation facility.
She says she felt sorry for her family and her subordinates who were involved.

Even so, she has feelings she wants to convey.
A life of isolation, separated from loved ones.
"I want them to at least look forward to mealtime."
It is "emotional care" through food.

Many friends in this town, touched by her passionate feelings,
weave together what they can do now, each with their own thoughts.

To ensure that those who lack taste and smell can enjoy the colors and textures,
fresh ingredients, carefully nurtured, are cooked with heart.
So that they can look forward to tomorrow.
So that they can regain their health and leave this place.
May her feelings and everyone's feelings reach them.

description:

瀬戸内海もほど近い、福山市熊野町。



田畑に囲まれた広い空を望めるこの場所で



狩猟、農業、さらには養蜂まで



地でサスティナブルな暮らしをしている



岡田臣司（おかだしんじ）さん。

「食べることは環境を考えることと同義」



僕らが毎日口に運ぶ、たくさんの食材は



それらを育んだ自然環境と一緒に食べている。



「海を汚さない」「農業は土作りから」



すべての答え合わせのようなお話だった。

そんな岡田さんが辿り着いた狩猟採集。



毎年11月15日からの可猟期間には、



猟銃を持って里山へ足を運ぶ。
すべては身体性を取り戻すため。

天候、気温、猟場によって日々変わる



鳥獣の行動パターンを読んで。



五感を頼りにその痕跡を追いかける。



里山を熟知し、鳥獣を熟知して成せる



流し猟という自然との対話。

グリコーゲンを多く含む鹿肉は



効果的にエネルギーへと変わる。

すなわち、猟師飯にはうってつけ。

しかし、“ジビエ”という響きは



猟師にとっては“命の循環”。

生を終えさせるということ。



今日もまた、静かに
祈りで己を律する。





山の神の恵みに感謝して



まずはひとくち、めしあがれ。

title: THE ROOTS #06 Blessed Game from the Mountain God
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

Near the Seto Inland Sea, in Kumano Town, Fukuyama.

In this place where you can see the wide sky surrounded by fields,

hunting, agriculture, and even beekeeping

are part of a sustainable lifestyle.

Shinji Okada is living this way.

"Eating is synonymous with considering the environment."

The many ingredients we consume daily

are eaten together with the natural environment that nurtured them.

"Do not pollute the sea" and "Agriculture starts with soil preparation"

were all part of a conversation that felt like piecing together answers.

This is the hunting and gathering path that Okada has arrived at.

During the hunting season starting from November 15 each year,

he heads to the satoyama with a hunting rifle.

Everything is to regain a sense of physicality.

Reading the daily changing behavior patterns of birds and beasts

based on weather, temperature, and hunting grounds.

Chasing their traces relying on the five senses.

This is a dialogue with nature through the method of running game hunting,

which can only be achieved by being well-acquainted with the satoyama and the wildlife.

Deer meat, rich in glycogen,

is effectively converted into energy.

In other words, it is perfect for hunter's meals.

However, the sound of "game" for hunters

is about the "cycle of life."

It means bringing life to an end.

Today again, quietly,

he disciplines himself with prayer.

Grateful for the blessings of the mountain god,

first, take a bite and enjoy.

title: 津軽あかつきの会「故郷の味を100年先まで」
description:
青森県弘前市で、津軽地方の郷土料理と食文化を伝える「伝承料理」活動をしている女性だけの料理研究ユニット、「津軽あかつきの会」のオリジナルショートムービーです。（※2021年に撮影）
 
 
「母の味を食べたい」
 
 
そんな想いから、代表の会長の工藤良子さんが始めたこの活動が伝わる映像となっています。
いつか現地で、この味を、味わっていただける日を楽しみにしています！

#母の味 #故郷の味 #青森 #弘前 #aomori #japanesefood #津軽

title: Tsugaru Akatsuki Association: 'The Taste of Home for 100 Years Ahead'
description:
This is an original short movie of the 'Tsugaru Akatsuki Association', a cooking research unit composed solely of women, which conveys the local cuisine and food culture of the Tsugaru region through 'traditional cooking' activities in Hirosaki City, Aomori Prefecture. (Filmed in 2021)

'I want to taste my mother's cooking'

This video conveys the activity that was started by the representative, Chairperson Yoshiko Kudo, from such feelings. We look forward to the day when you can savor this taste on-site!

title: Drone Aerial Photography: Autumn Leaves in Aomori (Jōgakura Ohashi, Nakano Momijiyama, Tsutanuma)
description:
After the resolution of the COVID-19 pandemic, 
we hope to welcome many visitors from both domestic and international locations 
to Aomori Prefecture once again. 
With this wish in mind, we are releasing footage of the autumn leaves in Aomori Prefecture 
(Jōgakura Ohashi, Nakano Momijiyama, Tsutanuma) captured by drone.

Please note that Tsutanuma during the autumn foliage season is extremely crowded, 
and every year we implement measures to address roadside parking and congestion.
There are many other attractive locations in the vicinity of Tsutanuma, 
and you can enjoy beautiful scenery throughout the four seasons, 
so we also recommend visiting during non-peak times.

title: DELISH AOMORI「風間浦村のあんこうのベーコン巻き」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「Delish Aomori」は今回の第１２弾でついに最終回。ラストを飾る食材は風間浦鮟鱇です。風間浦村は鮟鱇の漁場がとても近く、とびきり新鮮な鮟鱇が水揚げされます。鮟鱇といえば、まっ先に思い浮かぶのは鮟鱇鍋でしょうか。今回紹介するレシピは洋風に美味しくいただける「あんこうのベーコン巻き」。淡白な鮟鱇の身とベーコンの旨味と塩気の組み合わせが絶妙です。風間浦村で年に１度開催される風間浦鮟鱇感謝祭の賑わいの様子もお届けします。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Bacon-Wrapped Monkfish from Kazamaura Village'
description: The recipe video series 'Delish Aomori', brought to you by All Aomori, reaches its final episode with this 12th installment. The star ingredient for the grand finale is the monkfish from Kazamaura. Kazamaura Village is very close to the fishing grounds for monkfish, ensuring that the freshest monkfish is landed. When we think of monkfish, the first dish that comes to mind is probably monkfish hot pot. The recipe we are introducing this time is 'Bacon-Wrapped Monkfish', which can be enjoyed in a Western style. The combination of the mild monkfish flesh and the umami and saltiness of the bacon is exquisite. We will also share the lively atmosphere of the Kazamaura Monkfish Appreciation Festival, held once a year in Kazamaura Village.

title: DELISH AOMORI「津軽百年食堂　清おばあちゃん」
description: 黒石市の弘南鉄道黒石駅前に店を構える「すごう食堂」は大正時代から４代に渡って受け継がれ、「津軽百年食堂」の１店に数えられます。現在の店主、須郷清さんは８７歳となった今でも、調理担当として現役で店に立ち続けているおばあちゃんです。店とともに百年受け継がれる変わらない味と、どこか懐かしさを覚える店の雰囲気をお伝えする、DELISH AOMORIがお届けするSpecial Movieです。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo - Grandma Kiyo'
description: The 'Sugou Shokudo', located in front of Kōnan Railway Kuroishi Station in Kuroishi City, has been passed down through four generations since the Taisho era and is counted as one of the 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo'. The current owner, Grandma Kiyo Sugou, who is now 87 years old, still stands at the restaurant as the chef. This is a special movie brought to you by DELISH AOMORI, conveying the unchanged taste that has been inherited for a hundred years along with the nostalgic atmosphere of the restaurant.

title: DELISH AOMORI「ミサオおばあちゃんの笹餅」
description: 五所川原市金木町で、大人気の笹餅を作り続ける９０歳の元気なおばあちゃん、桑田ミサオさん。食べたひとを幸せな気持ちにしてくれる笹餅を作る風景と、その笹餅を作るミサオさんの温かい人柄。その両方に触れられる、DELISH AOMORIがお届けするSpecial Movieです。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Grandma Misao's Sasa Mochi'
description:
In Goshogawara City, Kanagi Town, the lively 90-year-old grandma, Misao Kuwata, continues to make the very popular sasa mochi. 
This is a Special Movie brought to you by DELISH AOMORI, showcasing the scene of making sasa mochi that brings happiness to those who eat it, along with the warm personality of Misao-san who makes it.

title: イサバのカッチャ（魚市場のかあちゃん）
description:
戦後より八戸の台所として人々の暮らしに根付いている「いさば」。いさばとは魚市場のこと。陸奥湊駅前朝市も毎朝多くの人々で賑わいます。イサバのカッチャは働き者。暗いうちから働き始めます。そんな浜
の暮らしぶりを、生まれてからずっと朝市で買い物をしているというカッチャを通して紹介します。

出演：中山　央子
監督：山中　有
製作：青森県観光国際戦略局観光企画課

title: Isaba no Katcha (Mother of the Fish Market)
description:
Since the post-war period, 'Isaba' has been rooted in the lives of people as the kitchen of Hachinohe. Isaba refers to the fish market. The morning market in front of Mutsu-Minato Station is bustling with many people every morning. The Katcha of Isaba is a hard worker. She starts working in the dark. Through Katcha, who has been shopping at the morning market since she was born, we introduce the lifestyle of the seaside.

Cast: Oko Nakayama
Director: Yu Yamanaka
Production: Aomori Prefectural Tourism International Strategy Bureau, Tourism Planning Division

title: べこもち
description:
青森県の下北半島に伝わる伝統郷土菓子「べこもち」。
昔は節句などの行事の際にふるまわれるものでしたが、現在は日常的に愛食されています。
この作品は、べこもちができるまでの工程を映像のみで語ります。
切り口に美しい花模様があらわれる様子を、ぜひご覧ください。

出演：こすもす生活改善グループ
監督：山中　有
製作：青森県観光国際戦略局観光企画課

title: Beko Mochi
description:
Beko Mochi is a traditional local sweet from the Shimokita Peninsula in Aomori Prefecture.
In the past, it was served during events such as festivals, but now it is enjoyed on a daily basis.
This work narrates the process of making Beko Mochi solely through visuals.
Please take a look at the beautiful floral patterns that appear on the cut surface.

Cast: Cosmos Lifestyle Improvement Group
Director: Yu Yamanaka
Production: Aomori Prefectural Tourism International Strategy Bureau, Tourism Planning Division

title: サナブリ
description:
青森県津軽地方では、田植えが終わると農休みに入り、集落の人々は安堵とともに豊作を願う儀礼として「サナブリ」と呼ばれる祭事を行います。
津軽地方の五所川原市相内の人々は、この祭事が昔から地域の人々の憩いのひと時であり、どれだけ心待ちにしていたかを語ります。苗を植えたばかりの田んぼに飛び込む場面も。

出演：三和　敏道
監督：山中　有
製作：青森県観光国際戦略局観光企画課

title: Sanaburi
description:
In the Tsugaru region of Aomori Prefecture, after the rice planting is completed, the farming community enters a break, and the people of the village hold a ceremony called 'Sanaburi' as a ritual to express their relief and wish for a good harvest.
The people of Aikawa in Goshogawara City, Tsugaru region, speak of how this event has been a moment of relaxation for the community for generations and how eagerly they have awaited it. There is also a scene where they jump into the rice fields just after planting the seedlings.

Featuring: Toshimichi Miwa
Director: Yu Yamanaka
Production: Aomori Prefectural Tourism International Strategy Bureau, Tourism Planning Division

title: ホワイトインパルス
description:
青森空港は全国でも有数の豪雪地帯にあり、雪の多い年では類型降雪量が１０ｍを超える空港です。
民間航空機定期便が利8直する空港の中で、累計降雪量が１０ｍを超える空港は、全国でも稀です。
このような豪雪の青森空港を支えているのが、複数社の共同企業体により編成される青森空港除雪帯「ホワイトインパルス」です。

title: White Impulse
description:
Aomori Airport is one of the most heavy snowfall areas in the country, with cumulative snowfall exceeding 10 meters in years with significant snow.
Among airports with regular commercial airline services, it is rare for cumulative snowfall to exceed 10 meters.
Supporting Aomori Airport, which experiences such heavy snowfall, is the Aomori Airport Snow Removal Group "White Impulse," formed by a consortium of multiple companies.

title: はるえさん最高！ by浦風親方
description: 作家・大岡玲さん、浦風親方、カメラマン・松隈直樹さん、紀行作家・山内史子さんの4人で行く「冬の青森旅」vol3.「青森市古川市場はるえ食堂」編です。

title: Haru-e is the best! by Coach Urakaze
description: This is the third volume of the 'Winter Trip to Aomori' featuring four people: writer Rei Ooka, Coach Urakaze, photographer Naoki Matsukuma, and travel writer Fumiko Yamauchi. This edition focuses on 'Haru-e Shokudo' at Aomori City Furukawa Market.

title: 古川市場のっけ丼
description:
のっけ丼は青森魚菜センターで、市場に並んでいるものをちょっとずつ買って食べる丼です。
自分の好きな具材を好きな量だけ買うことができるので、おひとりでも、仲間、カップル、家族でも楽しんでいただけます。

title: Furukawa Market Nokkedon
description:
Nokkedon is a bowl dish at the Aomori Fish and Vegetable Center, where you can buy and enjoy a little bit of what is available in the market.
You can purchase your favorite ingredients in your preferred amounts, making it enjoyable for individuals, friends, couples, and families.

title: 【新島・式根島 】民宿ご飯　式根鯛平君で乾杯
description:
『あなたと いっしょに 育てタイ！』

平成2年（1990年）出荷スタートから30年以上が経過した新島村の養殖事業を、新島在住の人たちに、もっともっと知ってもらいたく、動画の制作を企画しました。

（背景）
島外への販売は、お客さまにとってコストも掛かり、１尾丸ごとの鯛は捌けないし、、など、売るのが難しい現実の中、、島の中で「育て」「調理し」「食べて」もらえる循環を作らないと、どうなるのか？って火を見るより明らか。

また島の課題の一つ、「島の魚が手に入らない」という、かなり残念な声を良く聴きます。。

その声に対する一つの解決策は、安定的に供給できる養殖の鯛「式根鯛平君」です。

30年前の飼育環境からアップデートを積み重ね、現在は独自にブレンドした配合飼料を開発し、ほどよく脂がのった美味しい鯛の味を実現することができました。

真鯛と言えば、粋で真っ赤な「めで鯛」をイメージしますが、式根鯛平君は無骨な色した「彩り鯛」

そんな身近にいる真鯛、あなた色に彩りを加えてみませんか。

『あなたと いっしょに 育てタイ！』


企画：新島村商工会　https://niijima.or.jp/shokokai/

協力：式根島養殖場　https://onl.la/q1DMHAJ

撮影：NUMA FILMS　https://numafilms.tokyo/

事業主体：新島村　https://www.niijima.com/

title: [Niijima & Shikinejima] Cheers with Shikine Taihei-kun at the Guesthouse
description:
'I want to grow with you!' 

More than 30 years have passed since the start of the aquaculture business in Niijima Village in 1990, and we planned to create a video to let the residents of Niijima know more about it. 

(Background) 
Selling outside the island incurs costs for customers, and it's difficult to sell whole fish, among other challenges. It is clear that if we do not create a cycle where we can 'grow,' 'cook,' and 'eat' within the island, the situation will only worsen. 

We often hear a rather disappointing voice regarding one of the island's issues: 'We can't get island fish.' 

One solution to that voice is the stable supply of farmed sea bream, 'Shikine Taihei-kun.' 

By updating the rearing environment over the past 30 years, we have developed a unique blended feed that allows us to achieve the delicious taste of sea bream with just the right amount of fat. 

When we think of sea bream, we often imagine the stylish and bright red 'medetai,' but Shikine Taihei-kun is a robustly colored 'irodori tai.' 

Why not add your own color to the sea bream that is so close to you? 

'I want to grow with you!' 

Planning: Niijima Village Chamber of Commerce https://niijima.or.jp/shokokai/ 

Cooperation: Shikinejima Aquaculture Farm https://onl.la/q1DMHAJ 

Filming: NUMA FILMS https://numafilms.tokyo/ 

Project Entity: Niijima Village https://www.niijima.com/

title: 千秋公園「はちみつソフト」秋田美人が実食♪
description:
秋田駅前すぐそば、四季折々の自然が満喫できる千秋公園。秋田犬やあきた舞妓に会える観光スポットとしても人気の園内に、新名物「はちみつソフト」が登場しました。
早速、あきた観光レディーの３人が実食。
秋田市産のハチミツを使った甘すぎず、スッキリとした味わいで、この夏、話題沸騰間違いなしです！
是非、お試しあれ～♪

title: Senshu Park 'Honey Soft Serve' Akita Beauties Try It Out♪
description:
Right next to Akita Station, Senshu Park offers a chance to enjoy the beauty of nature throughout the seasons. 
As a popular tourist spot where you can meet Akita dogs and Akita maiko, a new specialty 'Honey Soft Serve' has appeared in the park. 
Immediately, three Akita tourism ladies tried it out. 
Using honey produced in Akita City, it has a refreshing taste that is not overly sweet, and it is sure to be a hot topic this summer! 
Be sure to give it a try~♪

description:
Dynamic fireworks floating in the summer night sky of Akita City.
The Omono River Fireworks Festival is held every August.

(Produced by Akita City Tourism Promotion Division)

title: 大正寺おけさ
description:
大正寺おけさは、九州地方で継承されてきた「ハイヤ節」を起源とし、北前船により伝播されたと言われる貴重な民謡文化です。

日本遺産に登録されたストーリー「荒波を越えた男たちの夢が紡いだ異空間～北前船寄港地・船主集落～」の中で、物語を構成する文化財としても位置づけられています。
（秋田市観光振興課制作）

title: Taisho-ji Okesa
description:
Taisho-ji Okesa is a precious folk culture that originated from the 'Haya-bushi' passed down in the Kyushu region, and is said to have been propagated by the Kitamae ships.

It is also positioned as a cultural asset that constitutes the story registered as a Japanese heritage, 'The Dream of Men Who Overcame the Rough Waves Weaving an Otherworldly Space - The Port Towns and Shipowners of Kitamae.'
(Produced by Akita City Tourism Promotion Division)

title: ダリアと菊の魅力をお届け！
description:
秋田中央地域地場産品活用促進協議会（通称「農家のパーティ」ネットワーク」では、JA秋田なまはげと管内の秋田市、男鹿市、潟上市が連携し、地場産品の活用促進と、3市の農林水産業と食品関連産業の振興を図ることを目的に、さまざまな活動を展開しています。

　このPRビデオは、3市で生産されるダリアと菊の生産現場の様子やその魅力を、3市の市長とJA秋田なまはげの組合長自らが皆さんにPRしています！

title: Delivering the Charm of Dahlias and Chrysanthemums!
description:
The Akita Central Region Local Products Utilization Promotion Council (commonly known as the 'Farmers' Party Network') collaborates with JA Akita Namahage and the cities of Akita, Oga, and Katagami to promote the utilization of local products and to enhance the agricultural, forestry, and fisheries industries as well as the food-related industries in the three cities through various activities.

title: EEGANE! あなたの名古屋を見つけに来て！ 〜神社
description:
名古屋観光コンベンションビューローは、日本に住むフィリピン人向けに名古屋を紹介する動画を制作しました。
タイトルは「EEGANE! あなたの名古屋を見つけに来て！」です。
フィリピンのマニラ出身のテレビ愛知アナウンサー、岡田めぐみマリーが、日本に住む2人のフィリピン人、ステファニーとアリサと共に名古屋の魅力を案内します。
（「EEGANE！」は名古屋弁で「素晴らしい！」という意味です。）
動画は「名古屋の食」と「神社」の2パターンを制作しました。
名古屋独特の食文化「モーニング」を味わったり、山田天満宮でお金を洗ったりすることができます。名古屋であなたの幸運を見つけてください！！
「体験」をテーマに名古屋の魅力を伝える動画でした。
ぜひご覧ください！

title: EEGANE! Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!  ~Shrines
description:
NAGOYA convention & visitors bureau has produced a video promoting Nagoya to Filipinos living in Japan.
The title is "EEGANE! Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!"
Megumi Marie Okada, a TV Aichi announcer born in Manila, Philippines, will be appointed to navigate the charm of Nagoya with two Filipinos living in Japan, Stephanie and Alisa.
（"EEGANE!” means ”NICE!” in Nagoya dialect.）
The video produced two patterns, "Nagoya food" and "Shrines ".
Tasting the food culture "Morning" unique to Nagoya, washing money at Yamada Tenmangu, etc. You can find your good luck in Nagoya!!
It was a video that conveys the charm of Nagoya with the theme of "experience".
Please check it out!

title: 安全啓発アニメション第1弾 ～さちとの約束～（無理な踏切横断編）
description:
このアニメは、大阪アニメーションカレッジ専門学校の学生さん達に協力していただき制作しました。 

警報器が鳴りだし、踏切内に入ると大変危険です。踏切では一旦立ち止まり安全を確認してわたりましょう。 
鉄道の安全利用にご協力お願いします。 

また、主人公の中松江　幸の声は中島 由貴さんに担当していただき 
テーマソング「きみとでかけよう」も歌っていただいています。 
ぜひ一緒に口ずさみ南海に親近感を持っていただければ幸いです。

title: Safety Awareness Animation Vol. 1 - The Promise with Sachi - (Dangerous Crossing at the Railway Crossing)
description:
This animation was produced with the cooperation of students from Osaka Animation College.

When the alarm sounds, it is very dangerous to enter the railway crossing. Please stop and check for safety before crossing the railway.
We appreciate your cooperation in using the railway safely.

Additionally, the voice of the main character, Sachi Nakamatsu, is provided by Yuki Nakajima, and she also sings the theme song "Let's Go Out Together."
We hope you can hum along and feel a sense of closeness to Nankai.

title: めっちゃぎなんわかるてれび「岐南イラストアート展」
description:
ぎふチャン（岐阜放送）「めっちゃぎふわかるてれび」
令和7年3月14日（金）放送

現在開催中（令和7年3月1日～3月31日）の「岐南イラストアート展」を紹介します。
イラストレーター集団「岐阜新文化会」のメンバーで結成した「岐南イラストアートまちづくり委員会」から15人が、作品を出展しています。

作品は、岐南町図書館、ホテルルートイン岐南、岐南町役場の3か所で展示しています。
また、3か所の会場をめぐるスタンプラリーも行っています！
すべての会場のスタンプを集めた方には、イラストカード（5枚セット）をプレゼントします。

title: 令和5年度岐南地芝居公演(関市獅子舞保存会)
description:
令和5年9月10日（日）
岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

昨年に引き続き、「伏屋の獅子芝居」と県内の他の獅子芝居や地歌舞伎を同時にみられる「岐南地芝居公演」を開催しました。今年は関市獅子舞保存会と美濃歌舞伎保存会が出演しました。

　　獅子芝居『高野山』
　　
【あらすじ】
　石童丸は父である繁氏（苅萱道心）に遭いたさに、病弱な母を残し、ひとり高野山を歩く。たまたま山道を歩いていた父苅萱道心に、無心に「今道心（いまどうしん）はどこか」と尋ねると、苅萱道心は「出家したばかりの者は、すべて今道心というのだ」と言い、帰るよう諭す。石童丸は母の病いのことなどを告げると、苅萱道心の目に涙が浮かぶ。その様子を見た石童丸は、もしや父ではと問いかけるが、苅萱道心は「繁氏入道という人は今は諸国修行に出ていて行方は知れぬ」と言い、急いで山を下り、母の介抱をするよう勧めるのであった。

title: Ginan Local Lion Dance Performance for the 5th Year of Reiwa (Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society)
description:
September 10, 2023 (Sunday)
Ginan Local Lion Dance Performance @ Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Hall

Following last year, we held the "Fushiya Lion Play" and the "Ginan Local Lion Dance Performance," where you can see other lion dances and local kabuki from within the prefecture at the same time. This year, the Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society performed.

Lion Play 'Koyasan'

【Synopsis】
Ishido Maru, longing to meet his father, Shigeuji (Karakaya Doshin), leaves his ailing mother behind and walks alone to Koyasan. By chance, he encounters his father, Karakaya Doshin, on the mountain path and innocently asks, "Where is Imado Shin?" Karakaya Doshin replies, "Those who have just become monks are all called Imado Shin," and advises him to return. When Ishido Maru mentions his mother's illness, tears well up in Karakaya Doshin's eyes. Seeing this, Ishido Maru questions if he might be his father, but Karakaya Doshin says, "Shigeuji Nindō is currently traveling for training in various regions, and his whereabouts are unknown," urging him to hurry down the mountain and care for his mother.

title: 71st Gifu Prefecture Firefighting Drill Competition: Ginan Town Fire Brigade Wins 5th Place!
description:
August 7, 2022 (Sunday)
"Firefighting Appreciation Festival" 71st Gifu Prefecture Firefighting Drill Competition @ Yamagata City Ijira Comprehensive Ground

The Ginan Town Fire Brigade achieved 5th place among 20 fire brigades from across the prefecture.
This is the first time in 24 years that we have won a prize in the small pump drill!

The drill competition is held to improve the firefighting skills and morale of the fire brigade.
The participating members underwent rigorous training for about four months for this competition, and even those who did not participate supported the competitors by training together.

The beautiful discipline and speed of extinguishing fires were truly impressive.
I was moved to see the competitors embrace each other after completing the entire drill.

Please enjoy the magnificent performance of the Ginan Town Fire Brigade until the end.

[Participants]
Conductor: Kan Iwata
1st Member: Shunya Kato
2nd Member: Hiroki Nagakura
3rd Member: Satoshi Sasaki
Assistant: Daisuke Goto

[Total Score] 81.2 points (5th overall)
[Time] 42.64 seconds (2nd overall)

*The small pump drill involves using a small pump to connect three 20m hoses and perform water discharge with one line of hose.

title: 【観光客のいない嵐山・京都】竹林散策と祇王寺 4K動画 by iphone 11pro(2020年7月10日撮影）
description:
皆さんこんにちは。今日は嵐山の景色を映像と音楽で紹介していきます。
京都・嵐山は京都でも代表的な観光名所、特に竹林が人気のスポットで毎年多く観光客が国内外から訪れています。桜や紅葉のシーズンでは毎年人が溢れかえるほど人気のエリアです。
日本では新型コロナウィルスが発生した直後の4月から5月までは政府より緊急事態宣言が発令され、人々は旅行しなくなり家にこもる日々が続きました。
緊急事態宣言が解除となった6月以降も、感染を恐れて移動を控える人が多く、日本各地の観光地は大きな打撃を受けました。

私達が嵐山を撮影した7月10日は、緊急事態宣言解除直後、また梅雨シーズンにより雨が長く続いた時期でもあり、人がほとんどいませんでした。今この動画を公開した9月現在では、政府がGO TO キャンペーンなど旅行者向けのお得なキャンペーンを促進したり、夏休みを過ごしたこともあり、以前より観光地に旅行客が戻りつつあります。

おそらく、これだけ人のいない嵐山を今後しばらく撮影する事はないかもしれません。
ぜひともこの貴重な、静けさと雨に包まれた嵐山をお楽しみください。
コロナが一日も早く終息することを祈り、また一日も早く観光客がにぎわう日を私たちも楽しみにしています。

title: [Arashiyama, Kyoto Without Tourists] Bamboo Grove Walk and Gio-ji Temple 4K Video by iPhone 11 Pro (Filmed on July 10, 2020)
description:
Hello everyone. Today, I will introduce the scenery of Arashiyama through video and music.

Arashiyama in Kyoto is one of the most famous tourist spots in Kyoto, especially popular for its bamboo grove, attracting many tourists from both domestic and international locations every year. During the cherry blossom and autumn foliage seasons, this area is so popular that it is overflowing with people every year.

In Japan, from April to May, right after the outbreak of the novel coronavirus, the government issued a state of emergency, and people stopped traveling, leading to days of staying at home.

Even after the state of emergency was lifted in June, many people refrained from traveling due to fear of infection, and tourist spots across Japan suffered significant blows.

On July 10, when we filmed Arashiyama, it was just after the state of emergency was lifted, and it was also a time when the rainy season had continued for a long time, resulting in almost no people around. As of September, when this video is being released, the government has been promoting campaigns like the GO TO campaign for travelers, and with the summer vacation having passed, tourists are gradually returning to tourist spots.

It is likely that we will not have the opportunity to film Arashiyama with so few people for a while.
Please enjoy this precious, quiet, and rain-soaked Arashiyama.
We pray for the swift end of the coronavirus and look forward to the day when tourists will once again fill the area.

Filming Locations:
Arashiyama Bamboo Grove https://kyoto.travel/en/blog/33.html
Gio-ji Temple https://www.giouji.or.jp/

and in Fukui City, we will visit places associated with Ieyasu and his family. 
A year later, we will deliver the charm of Fukui, connected by the Hokuriku Shinkansen, 
from history to gourmet experiences.

title: FUKUI Style Soba Feast Edition
description:
Fukui City Image Up PR Video
1st Anniversary of the Release of the 'FUKUI Style' Series!
Starting from Tuesday, October 14, 2025, at LDH kitchen THE TOKYO HANEDA,
what's the exciting content of the 'Fukui Good! Autumn Lunch Fair'?

So──

In this 'FUKUI Style Soba Feast Edition',
Kenchi Tachibana (EXILE/EXILE THE SECOND),
the PR ambassador for Fukui City's food,
will welcome Yuta Nakatsukasa (GENERATIONS),
who has a two-day performance at Sandome Fukui on December 6 (Saturday) and 7 (Sunday),
to enjoy the fair menu items:
'Special Echizen Oroshi Soba',
'Sauce Katsu Don',
'Plum Juice using Fukui Prefecture Plums'.

Actually──

The recipe created and won in the program
'Achikochi Kenchi - The Ultimate Showdown with GENERATIONS and Echizen Oroshi Soba',
recorded in Fukui City in the summer of 2025,
was developed by Kenchi Tachibana,
and the head chef of THE TOKYO HANEDA has brushed it up as 'Special Echizen Oroshi Soba',
making this autumn lunch fair a reality.

During the lunch fair period,
from October 14 (Tuesday) to November 24 (Monday),
please enjoy it when you visit nearby.

Furthermore──

The runner-up,
GENERATIONS' Special Echizen Oroshi Soba,
will also be featured on the menu,
and before the GENERATIONS performance at Sandome Fukui,
it will be offered as a limited-time fair
from November 28 (Friday) to December 8 (Monday)
at Fukui City Tourism and Product Center Fuku Fuku Kan and Echizen Soba Club.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】ダイナミックな自然、豊かなグルメを楽しむ！大隅（おおすみ）ルートver2
description: 垂水港を拠点として8の字に周遊する壮大なルート。大隅半島は、豊かな自然に恵まれ農業をはじめ漁業、畜産など第一次産業が盛んな地域です。地域の資源を活用した体験や学習コンテンツに加えて、近海の鮮魚、黒毛和牛の産地ならではのグルメも揃います。緑深い高隈連山を背景に大平原が広がる、ダイナミックという言葉がよく似合う自然豊かなエリアです。

title: [Kagoshima Cycle Tourism] Enjoy Dynamic Nature and Rich Gourmet! Osumi Route ver2
description:
A grand route that loops in a figure-eight from Tarumizu Port.
The Osumi Peninsula is blessed with rich nature and is an active region for primary industries such as agriculture, fishing, and livestock farming.
In addition to experiences and learning content utilizing local resources, you can also enjoy gourmet food unique to the area, such as fresh seafood from nearby waters and black-haired wagyu beef.
With the lush Takakuma mountain range in the background, it is a nature-rich area that truly embodies the word dynamic.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】宇宙を身近に感じる！種子島ルートをサイクリング！
description:
種子島ルートでは、宇宙をより身近に感じられるエリアがあったり、南の島らしいサトウキビ畑が両側に広がる風景を見ながらサイクルできたりと、美しい海を臨むアイランドロードを存分に楽しめます。種子島の豊かな自然を満喫できるサーフィンやヨガなどのアクティビティも、一緒に体験してみてはいかがでしょうか。

#鹿児島 #サイクリング

title: [Kagoshima Cycle Tourism] Feel Closer to Space! Cycling the Tanegashima Route!
description: The Tanegashima Route offers areas where you can feel closer to space, and you can cycle while enjoying the scenery of sugarcane fields typical of southern islands on both sides, fully experiencing the island road with beautiful views of the sea. How about also trying activities like surfing and yoga to enjoy the rich nature of Tanegashima?

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】日本の原風景を走る！北薩ルートをサイクリング！
description:
熊本県との県境に位置する北薩は、懐かしい里山の風景や風光明媚な温泉が楽しめる場所。白い砂浜が続く美しい海岸線では、東シナ海に沈むオレンジ色の夕日に癒されます。海の幸山の幸が豊かな北薩地域のご当地グルメも楽しみのひとつ！

#鹿児島 　#サイクリング

title: [Kagoshima Cycle Tourism] Ride through Japan's original landscapes! Cycling the North Satsuma Route!
description:
North Satsuma, located on the border with Kumamoto Prefecture, is a place where you can enjoy nostalgic rural landscapes and scenic hot springs. The beautiful coastline with its white sandy beaches offers a soothing view of the orange sunset sinking into the East China Sea. One of the highlights is enjoying the local gourmet food from the North Satsuma region, rich in both seafood and mountain delicacies!

#Kagoshima  #Cycling

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】薩摩藩が誇る武家の歴史と絢爛な文化が薫る街並みを走る！南薩ルート
description:
「サイクリングターミナルりんりん」をスタート・ゴール地点とするルート。南さつま市、日置市、鹿児島市、指宿（いぶすき）市、南九州市、枕崎市、それぞれの特徴的な風景を次々に楽しめます。リアス式の海岸線を背に沈みゆく夕日が美しい東シナ海、さらには桜島、開聞（かいもん）岳が聳え立つ錦江湾の美しさが格別です。武家屋敷群や薩摩焼窯元、焼酎酒蔵、鰹本枯れ節工場など魅力に満ち溢れたエリアです。

#鹿児島 #サイクリング

title: [Kagoshima Cycle Tourism] Ride through the streets filled with the history of the samurai and the splendid culture of the Satsuma Domain! Minamisatsuma Route
description: This route starts and ends at the 'Cycling Terminal Rinrin'. You can enjoy the distinctive landscapes of Minamisatsuma City, Hioki City, Kagoshima City, Ibusuki City, Minamikyushu City, and Makurazaki City one after another. The beautiful sunset over the East China Sea, backed by the rias coastline, and the stunning views of Sakurajima and Kaimondake towering over Kinko Bay are exceptional. This area is filled with attractions such as samurai residences, Satsuma ware pottery studios, shochu distilleries, and katsuobushi (dried bonito) factories.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】霧島連山から豊かに流れ出す川沿いの風景を楽しむ！川内川（せんだいがわ）流域ルート
description:
吉松駅をスタートし、川内川沿いに高速船ターミナル（川内港）へ向かって走るルート。随所に溢れだす湧水池、東洋のナイアガラと呼ばれるダイナミックな曽木の滝、夏の風物詩の「ほたる」、東シナ海につながる河口まで川沿いに楽しみます。霧島山系の豊富な水に支えられる稲穂の田園、銘茶を産出する茶畑の風景がどこまでも広がります。

#鹿児島 #サイクリング

title: [Kagoshima Cycle Tourism] Enjoy the Scenic Views Along the Rivers Flowing Abundantly from the Kirishima Mountain Range! Sendai River Basin Route
description: Starting from Yoshimatsu Station, this route runs along the Sendai River towards the high-speed boat terminal (Sendai Port). Along the way, you can enjoy the bubbling spring water pools, the dynamic Sogi Falls, known as the Niagara of the East, the summer tradition of 'fireflies', and the riverbank all the way to the estuary that connects to the East China Sea. The rich rice fields supported by the abundant water of the Kirishima mountain range and the landscapes of tea fields producing fine tea stretch endlessly.

title: 美食編【どんどん味わいたくなる　かごしまのグルメ】
description: 農業＆畜産王国の鹿児島県は，安心・安全，ヘルシーで美味しいバラエティ豊かな食材の宝庫です。動画では，鹿児島出身のスポーツキャスターで、薩摩大使も務める、宮下純一氏が，鶏の旨味と醤油の甘味を味わうことができる鳥刺しと焼酎の無限ループで，鹿児島を代表するグルメを思う存分味わう模様を描き、鹿児島の食材の魅力を伝えています。温暖な気候で育まれた鹿児島のグルメをたくさん味わって，心も身体も健康になりましょう！

title: Gourmet Edition: Kagoshima's Cuisine That Makes You Want to Taste More
description: Kagoshima Prefecture, an agricultural and livestock kingdom, is a treasure trove of safe, healthy, and deliciously diverse ingredients. In the video, Junichi Miyashita, a sports caster from Kagoshima and also a Satsuma ambassador, showcases the experience of savoring Kagoshima's representative gourmet dishes, including chicken sashimi that allows you to enjoy the umami of chicken and the sweetness of soy sauce, along with an endless loop of shochu. Let's indulge in the deliciousness of Kagoshima's cuisine, nurtured by its warm climate, and become healthy in both mind and body!

title: 温泉編【どんどん癒されたくなる　かごしまの温泉】
description: 鹿児島県は100の温泉地があり，温泉の源泉数は2700カ所以上の全国2位，1日に2億2,500万リットル以上もの温泉が湧出する全国屈指の温泉王国です。世界的にも珍しい砂むし温泉のほか，県内各地に魅力的な温泉がたくさんあり，様々な泉質を楽しむことができるのも鹿児島の温泉の特徴です。動画では，鹿児島出身のスポーツキャスターで、薩摩大使も務める宮下純一氏が霧島温泉郷で癒されている模様を描き，鹿児島の温泉の魅力を伝えています。鹿児島の温泉でゆっくりして、心も身体も健康になりましょう！

title: Onsen Edition: The More You Want to Heal, the More You’ll Love Kagoshima's Hot Springs
description: Kagoshima Prefecture has 100 hot spring areas, ranking second in the nation with over 2,700 hot spring sources. It boasts one of the top hot spring kingdoms in Japan, with more than 225 million liters of hot spring water gushing out daily. In addition to the rare sand bath hot springs, there are many attractive hot springs throughout the prefecture, allowing visitors to enjoy a variety of water qualities, which is a characteristic of Kagoshima's hot springs. The video features Junichi Miyashita, a sports caster from Kagoshima and also an ambassador for Satsuma, as he experiences relaxation in the Kirishima hot spring area, conveying the charm of Kagoshima's hot springs. Let's take a break in Kagoshima's hot springs and become healthy in both mind and body!

title: 東椎屋の滝
description:
日本の滝百選に選ばれた東椎屋の滝は、日光華厳の滝に似ているところから、「九州華厳」と称されています。高さ85mの断崖を落下する様は圧巻でマイナスイオンもいっぱいです。
　また、高貴端麗な名瀑で、滝つぼから流れ出る清流の渓谷、渓流の見事さもこの滝の特色です。清水に新緑の映える春、紅葉の秋ともに素晴らしい景観を誇っています。

title: Higashi Shiuya Falls
description:
Higashi Shiuya Falls, selected as one of Japan's top 100 waterfalls, is referred to as 'Kyushu Kegon' due to its resemblance to Kegon Falls in Nikko. The sight of the water cascading down the 85-meter cliff is breathtaking, and it is filled with negative ions.
Additionally, it is a noble and beautiful waterfall, characterized by the clear stream flowing from the waterfall basin and the stunning beauty of the mountain stream. It boasts wonderful scenery in both spring, when the fresh greenery shines in the clear water, and autumn, when the leaves change color.

title: 長洲神社葵祭り
description:
長洲葵祭りは、毎年5月3日～5日まで行われる、長洲地区加茂神社のお祭りで、山の幸と海の幸の祭りです。
期間中は、コンコンチキリン♪の太鼓や笛の音にあわせて山車が長洲の町を練り歩きます。
宝暦11年(1761)豊前の国に疫病が起こり、それを鎮めるため、踊車として山車を奉納したのが起源とされています。
全盛期には、７基の山車があったそうで、現在は近年復活した「大西車組」と江戸時代からの伝統を受け継ぐ「上町車組」が山車２基を引き回し、無病息災や五穀豊穣を願います。

title: Nagasu Shrine Aoi Festival
description:
The Nagasu Aoi Festival is held every year from May 3rd to 5th at the Kamo Shrine in the Nagasu area, celebrating the blessings of the mountains and the sea.
During the festival, floats parade through the town of Nagasu to the sounds of drums and flutes playing 'Konkontikirin♪'.
The origin of the festival dates back to the 11th year of the Horeki era (1761), when a plague occurred in the Buzen province, and floats were dedicated as a form of dance to appease the spirits.
At its peak, there were said to be seven floats, and currently, two floats are pulled by the 'Onishi Float Group', which was revived in recent years, and the 'Uemachi Float Group', which carries on the traditions from the Edo period, wishing for good health and bountiful harvests.

次は、そばにいる大切な人へ。

勝ちがあるまち宇佐に来て、身近にいる応援したい人の必勝祈願をし「御勝印」を届けよう！

期間：令和3年10月1日（金曜日）～令和4年2月28日（月曜日）

さらに、抽選で69名様に5,000円相当のプレゼントがあたる期間限定キャンペーンを実施！！

〇キャンペーン応募方法

title: Steps to Complete the 'Usa Gokatsu-in' in the Winning Town of Usa
description:
Usa City is known as the 'town of victory,' home to the legendary sumo wrestler Futabayama, who achieved an unbroken 69 consecutive wins, and the Usa Jingu, the head shrine of over 40,000 Hachiman shrines nationwide. Last year, despite the COVID-19 pandemic, we executed the 'Youth Betting on One Victory' project, supporting the passionate efforts of students who worked hard for victory. This summer, we delivered message cards wishing for the success of Olympic and Paralympic athletes from our city.

Next, to your important person nearby.

Come to the winning town of Usa, pray for the success of those you want to support, and deliver the 'Gokatsu-in'!

〇 Completion of Usa Gokatsu-in
We will complete the 'Usa Gokatsu-in' by visiting two locations: Futaba no Sato and the Tourist Association.

Receive a blank base paper at the following locations (you can start from either location):
Futaba no Sato...269 Shimosho, Usa City
Usa City Tourist Association (next to Usa Jingu)...2180-3 Minamiusa, Usa City

Period: October 1, 2021 (Friday) to February 28, 2022 (Monday)

Additionally, we are conducting a limited-time campaign where 69 lucky winners will receive gifts worth 5,000 yen!!

description:
宇佐高等学校では、総合的な探求の時間において、これからの時代に求められる創造力を生かした課題解決の手法「デザインシンキング」について学んでおり、その一環としてショート動画の制作が行われました。
宇佐市や宇佐高等学校の魅力を伝える様々な動画の中には南一郎平に関するものもあり、NHK朝ドラ「南一郎平」誘致推進協議会から資料の提供を受ける等、宇佐の歴史を学びながら制作をされていました。

description:

Among the various videos that convey the charm of Usa City and Usa High School, there are some related to Ichirohei Minami. They received materials from the NHK morning drama 'Ichirohei Minami Promotion Council' and learned about the history of Usa while producing the videos.
It has turned out to be a very enjoyable video, so please take a look!

　今回、ＮＰＯ法人自立支援センターおおいたと連携し、宇佐神宮御鎮座1300年観光振興プロジェクトの一環として、車いす等で参拝する場合のコースや観光ポイントなどをまとめた動画を作成しました。

This time, in collaboration with the NPO Oita Support Center, we created a video summarizing the courses and sightseeing points for worshiping with a wheelchair as part of the Usa Jingu 1300th Anniversary Tourism Promotion Project.

description:

朝一番に源泉からくみ上げた「一番湯」を入れた樽を担いで温泉街を練り歩き、山神社に移動します。神社では、巫女から神職へと順番に手渡して神社に奉納する神事を行います。

令和６年度の第38回献湯祭では
奈良時代の衣装を参加希望者が着て行列が行われます。
衣装を身にまとって白浜温泉街から山神社まで歩きます。
神事の最後には和歌山名物「餅まき」もあります。地元のお祭りに参加することは、その地域の文化をより深く理解し、地元の人々とのつながりを感じる素晴らしい機会となります。

#南紀白浜  #白浜観光  #白浜観光  #献湯祭 #温泉

title: Shirahama Onsen Kentyōsai <A Celebration of Gratitude for the Blessings of Hot Springs>
description:
Eight hot spring companies with their own sources in the town and local tourism officials
will carry a barrel filled with the "first hot spring water" drawn from the source early in the morning
and parade through the hot spring town to Yamajinja Shrine. At the shrine, a ritual will be conducted
where the water is handed over in turn from the shrine maidens to the priests for dedication.

In the 38th Kentyōsai of the 6th year of Reiwa,
participants wishing to join will wear costumes from the Nara period and form a procession.
They will walk from Shirahama Onsen town to Yamajinja Shrine in their costumes.
At the end of the ritual, there will also be a traditional "mochi-maki" (rice cake throwing),
a local specialty of Wakayama. Participating in this local festival is a wonderful opportunity
to gain a deeper understanding of the region's culture and feel a connection with the local people.

#NankiShirahama  #ShirahamaTourism  #ShirahamaTourism  #Kentyōsai #Onsen

title: 静岡県浜松市 プロモーション動画　Hamamatsucity Promotion Video
description:
Thank you for Watching !!
Music: Tobu - Cruel
http://youtube.com/tobuofficial
ーーー
　Follow Me  My account
　Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/shunpei.backpacker/?hl=ja
　twitter : https://twitter.com/shunpeikawai
ーーー
浜松の魅力を1分半で作成しました
同時に1ヶ月間の浜松の素晴らしさを発信するプロジェクトも終了しました
改めて浜松が素晴らしい場所だと実感することができました
自然が多くて人も暖かくてとても住みやすい街です
.
このプロジェクトを通して一番の変化は日本の素晴らしさをもっと知りたい
そして世界の人に伝えたいと思う気持ちが強くなりました
今年の7月に2.3ヶ月かけて自転車で日本縦断をします
その際に日本の素晴らしさを発信するために映像作成しながら縦断することに決めました
.
旅を始めてから色々なことに挑戦してきました
その中で多くの方からありがたいことに「舜平を見ていると勇気を貰える」と言っていただけます
自分が面白いと思って挑戦していることが誰かの挑戦する1歩目を踏み出すきっかけになっていると思うと自分はとても嬉しいです
「後悔なき生き方を」
僕が大切にしている言葉です
しかし僕だけでなく全世界の人が後悔のない生き方を送れるように僕の挑戦を写真や動画を通して発信します
そして僕を見て挑戦しようと思っていただけたら僕はとても幸せです
.
日本縦断前の6月にクラウドファンディングにも挑戦します
少しでも応援していただけたらありがたいです🙏
.
この動画を気軽にシェアしてください！
そしてより一層多くの方に浜松の魅力を知っていただけたら僕はこのプロジェクトを心からやってよかったと思うことができます！
気軽にコメントやアドバイスなども待っています😆
.
最後まで読んでくださりありがとうございます！
来月からまた面白い旅を再開します
5月は自転車で琵琶湖一周と自転車で四国一周します
是非楽しみにしていてください！

title: Hamamatsu City Promotion Video
description:
Thank you for Watching !!
Music: Tobu - Cruel
http://youtube.com/tobuofficial
ーーー
　Follow Me  My account
　Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/shunpei.backpacker/?hl=ja
　twitter : https://twitter.com/shunpeikawai
ーーー
I created the charm of Hamamatsu in one and a half minutes.
At the same time, the project to promote the wonderfulness of Hamamatsu for a month has also ended.
I was able to realize once again that Hamamatsu is a wonderful place.
It is a city with a lot of nature, warm people, and is very easy to live in.
.
The biggest change through this project is that I have a stronger desire to know more about the wonders of Japan
and to convey that to people around the world.
In July of this year, I will cycle across Japan over 2-3 months.
During that time, I decided to create videos to promote the wonders of Japan while traveling.
.
Since I started my journey, I have taken on various challenges.
Many people have kindly told me, "Watching Shunpei gives me courage."
I am very happy to think that what I find interesting and challenging can be a trigger for someone to take their first step in their own challenges.
"Live without regrets"
This is a phrase I hold dear.
However, not just for myself, but for people all over the world to live without regrets, I will share my challenges through photos and videos.
And if my journey inspires someone to take on their own challenges, I will be very happy.
.
In June, before my journey across Japan, I will also challenge crowdfunding.
I would be grateful for any support you can give me.🙏
.
Please feel free to share this video!
And if more people can learn about the charm of Hamamatsu, I can truly say that I am glad to have done this project!
I also welcome any comments or advice! 😆
.
Thank you for reading to the end!
I will resume my interesting journey starting next month.
In May, I will cycle around Lake Biwa and around Shikoku.
Please look forward to it!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
２月25日（土）の『冬の下呂温泉花火物語』打ち上げの様子です。

当日は雨や風もなく絶好の花火日和、『合格祈願花火』がテーマの。
5段打上花火が夜空に広がりました。

毎週の恒例行事に思える花火も、気づけば3月25日（土）の最後の打ち上げまで、
あと4回となってしまいました。
終わってしまうのは寂しい限りですが、1回1回を目に焼き付けていきたいですね。

今後とも、下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします。

#下呂温泉 #日本三名泉 #下呂市 #下呂観光  #花火物語 #下呂大橋 #飛騨川

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
This is a glimpse of the 'Winter Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' held on February 25th (Saturday).

The weather was perfect for fireworks with no rain or wind, themed around 'Fireworks for Success Prayers'.
Five-tiered fireworks spread across the night sky.

What seems like a weekly tradition of fireworks has now dwindled down to just 4 more launches until the final one on March 25th (Saturday).
While it’s sad that it will come to an end, I want to engrave each moment in my memory.

We appreciate your continued support for Gero Onsen.

#GeroOnsen #JapanThreeFamousHotSprings #GeroCity #GeroTourism #FireworksStory #GeroBridge #HidaRiver

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
２月４日（土）の、『冬の星座花火』の様子です。

当日は寒さは厳しいものの雨や雪はなく、絶好の花火日和でした。
澄み切った夜空に、星をイメージした花火が打ち上がりました。
星に負けず劣らずのきれいな花火がお客様を魅了していました。

三寒四温といいますが、少しづつ暖かい日が増えてきたように思えます。

今後とも、下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします。

#下呂温泉 #日本三名泉 #下呂市 #下呂観光  #花火物語 #下呂大橋 #飛騨川 #星座

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
On February 4th (Saturday), we experienced the 'Winter Constellation Fireworks'.

Although it was quite cold on the day, there was no rain or snow, making it a perfect day for fireworks.
Fireworks inspired by stars lit up the clear night sky.
The beautiful fireworks, rivaling the stars, captivated our guests.

As the saying goes, 'three cold days and four warm days', it seems that warmer days are gradually increasing.

We appreciate your continued support for Gero Onsen.

#GeroOnsen #Japan'sThreeFamousHotSprings #GeroCity #GeroTourism #FireworksStory #GeroBridge #HidaRiver #Constellation

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
1月21日（土）の『冬の下呂温泉花火物語』の様子です。

大寒の終わりを、温かみのある色調の花火で表現した「春よ来い来い・寒明け花火」がテーマです。
とても寒い夜でしたが、花火を見に多くのお客様がいらっしゃいました。

新年からあっという間に3週間が経ち、下呂温泉も始動をはじめています。
昨年よりも、もっと素晴らしい下呂温泉を皆様に体験いただけますように、
頑張っていきます。

今週末の1月28日（土）にも花火は打ち上がりますので、ぜひご覧にいらっしゃってください。

今後とも、下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします。


#下呂温泉 #日本三名泉 #下呂市 #下呂観光 #花火物語 #下呂大橋 #飛騨川

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
This is a glimpse of the 'Winter Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' held on January 21st (Saturday).

The theme is 'Spring, Come! Come! - The Fireworks of the End of Cold', expressed through warm-colored fireworks to mark the end of the Great Cold.
It was a very cold night, but many guests came to see the fireworks.

Three weeks have passed since the New Year, and Gero Onsen is starting to get into full swing.
We will do our best to provide everyone with an even more wonderful experience at Gero Onsen than last year.

Fireworks will also be launched this weekend on January 28th (Saturday), so please come and enjoy them.

Thank you for your continued support of Gero Onsen.

#GeroOnsen #Japan'sThreeFamousHotSprings #GeroCity #GeroTourism #FireworksStory #GeroBridge #HidaRiver

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
５月21日（土）、「ラブレター花火」をテーマとする『天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火』が
開催されました。

当日は雨に見舞われたものの、開始時間にはすっかり小ぶりになり、無事に花火が打ち上がりました。
テーマの通り、情熱的に打ち上がる花火にお客様たちは歓声をあげ、終わりごろには盛大な拍手が巻き起こっていました。
来週も、もっともっと多くのお客様に来ていただきたいですね。

もちろん、温泉を堪能するのもお忘れなく。
アルカリ性のお湯ですべすべのお肌を手に入れてください。

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

description:

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
まれにみる大雪の下呂温泉、雪化粧をした合掌村を見に行こうと向かってみました。

いつも見慣れたはずの合掌村は一面の銀世界。
まるで別の場所のようにも見えます。
手湯と足湯で体を暖めながら、雪道を歩いてみました。

雪で覆われた合掌家屋は雰囲気抜群で、いつも以上に堪能できました。
さすがにすべり台は使用できませんでしたが、これから毎日……というには雪かきが大変ですが、
たまにはこうした姿の合掌村に触れるのも楽しいものですね。

こんな雪の日には温泉が一番！
下呂温泉の湯船に浸かって新年への英気を養いましょう！

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

#下呂温泉 #日本三名泉 #下呂市 #下呂観光 #合掌村

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Gero Onsen, covered in rare heavy snow, I headed out to see the gassho village dressed in snow.

The gassho village, which I usually see, is a world of silver.
It looks like a completely different place.
I walked along the snowy path while warming my body in the hand and foot baths.

The gassho houses covered in snow have an exceptional atmosphere, and I was able to enjoy it more than usual.
Although the slide was not usable, it would be quite a task to shovel snow every day...
But it’s fun to experience the gassho village in this form once in a while.

On a snowy day like this, hot springs are the best!
Let’s soak in the Gero Onsen and recharge our spirits for the new year!

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

#GeroOnsen #JapanThreeFamousHotSprings #GeroCity #GeroTourism #GasshoVillage

今年も残すところあと少し、締めくくりと来年へ向けての準備を進めていきたいですね。

『花火物語』が開催されている緑地公園では、ウィンターイルミネーションも点灯していました。
ロマンティックな雰囲気で、こちらにもお客様の姿が見えました。

寒さが一層増す今日この頃、温泉がますます恋しくなってきますね！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Here are the autumn leaves I photographed last week around 'Iwaya Dam', 'Takako Pond Park', and 'Gyokuryuji Temple'.

Under the clear skies, the vibrant autumn leaves were visible, but at the same time, the fallen leaves were starting to stand out.
It is said that the leaves fall rapidly when it gets cold, and with the recent drop in temperature, this year's autumn leaves may have already fallen as well.

Snow was visible on the peaks of the mountains seen from the hot spring town, as if announcing the transition from autumn to winter.

Now is the time to warm up your body in the hot springs and prepare!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
On November 20th (Saturday), the "Tenjo Mukyu - Epidemic Extermination - Gero Onsen Fireworks Story" was held, themed "Labor Thanksgiving Fireworks".

This event was a prelude to Labor Thanksgiving Day on November 23rd (Tuesday), where we express gratitude for the labor and production that support our lives (3 and 9).

A grand display of fireworks was launched in celebration. It is said that this day originally stems from the Niiname-sai, a festival to give thanks for the bountiful harvest of grains.

There are various theories about how the gratitude for the harvest transformed into gratitude for labor, but thinking about how we can enjoy fireworks like this today fills me with appreciation for our predecessors.

Now, what better way to reward ourselves for our labor than with a hot spring!

I hope we can enjoy the next fireworks while soaking in the hot springs!

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

description:
飛騨の山々をいろどる紅葉をイメージした、１１月６日（土）の「天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火物語」の様子です。

ちなみに、最初から全身をつかるよりも、半身浴から始めたほうがより効果的であるそうです。

description:
This is a glimpse of the "Eternal Heaven and Earth, Epidemic Dispersal, Gero Onsen Fireworks Story" held on November 6th (Saturday), inspired by the autumn leaves adorning the Hida mountains.

Even as the cold grows stronger day by day, many customers are enjoying the festivities, cheering for the fireworks.
It is said that the origin of autumn leaves dates back to the Nara and Heian periods, but they continue to delight many people, both now and in the past.

To warm up a body chilled by the night breeze, there’s nothing better than a hot spring!
By the way, it seems that starting with a half-body bath is more effective than immersing your whole body from the beginning.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
飛騨小坂にある『がんだて公園』へ、紅葉が見ごろだと聞き及んで向かってみました。

名前にもある『がんだて』は、県指定天然記念物にもなっている溶岩でできた絶壁で、
その迫力に圧倒される思いです。
山々には赤や黄色の紅葉が広がっており、遊歩道を歩きながらその風景を楽しむことができます。

途中には滝もあり、陽光が差し込む滝を間近で見るのはすごい迫力です。
森林浴も一緒に楽しめ、秋の風情を満喫できました。

今がちょうど見頃ですので、紅葉を堪能したい場合はお早めに。

下呂温泉もよろしくお願いいたします！

#下呂温泉 #日本三名泉 #下呂市 #下呂観光 #がんだて公園 #飛騨小坂

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
I heard that the autumn leaves are at their best at 'Gandate Park' in Hida Kosaka, so I decided to head there.

The 'Gandate' in the name refers to the sheer cliffs made of lava, which have been designated as a natural monument by the prefecture, and I was overwhelmed by their grandeur.
The mountains are adorned with red and yellow foliage, and I enjoyed the scenery while walking along the promenade.

There are also waterfalls along the way, and seeing the sunlight streaming through the waterfall up close is incredibly impressive.
I was able to enjoy forest bathing as well, fully savoring the autumn atmosphere.

Now is the perfect time to enjoy the autumn leaves, so if you want to experience them, please come early.

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

#GeroOnsen #Japan'sThreeFamousHotSprings #GeroCity #GeroTourism #GandatePark #HidaKosaka

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
R3.10.28

下呂温泉の紅葉スポットの一つ、合掌村を撮影してきました。

やはりまだ見ごろには早かったようで、紅葉している木々はあまりありませんでしたが、
その分、既に紅葉が始まっている木々の色合いはとてもきれいでした。
早く、全体が見事に紅葉している光景を見てみたいですね。

合掌村には合掌の足湯があるので、紅葉の中で温泉を満喫するのも良さそうです。
もちろん、下呂温泉各所にある他の足湯と温泉もお忘れなく。

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
R3.10.28

I took some photos at one of the autumn foliage spots in Gero Onsen, the Gassho Village.

It seems that it was still a bit early for the peak foliage, as there weren't many trees that had turned red, but the colors of the trees that had already started to change were very beautiful.
I can't wait to see the entire area in its magnificent autumn colors.

Gassho Village has a foot bath, so it seems nice to enjoy the hot springs amidst the autumn leaves.
Of course, don't forget the other foot baths and hot springs located throughout Gero Onsen.

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
つい先日は秋の到来を感じる涼しさでしたが、
けふは日差しも強く、夏が戻ってきたような陽気の下呂温泉です。
なんだか冷たいものが欲しくなりますね。

縄文公園から歩いて約30分、歴史の森みはらし台へ登りました。
山道ではまだまだ葉が青く、蝉の声も聞こえてきて夏の気候です。
みはらし台から見える絶景の中の街や山々も、まだまだ夏そのものに映ります。

とはいえ、みはらし台への途中の道に栗のイガが落ちているなど、
着実に秋の気配も漂ってきていました。
紅葉の時期が楽しみですね。

絶景を眺めた後は温泉を堪能しましょう！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！


#下呂温泉 #日本三名泉 #下呂市 #下呂観光

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
Just the other day, we felt the coolness of autumn's arrival, but today, Gero Onsen is under strong sunlight, as if summer has returned.
Somehow, I feel like having something cold.

It took about 30 minutes to walk from Jomon Park to the historical Mori Mihara Shidai.
On the mountain path, the leaves are still green, and the sound of cicadas can be heard, giving it a summer climate.
The breathtaking view of the town and mountains from Mihara Shidai still reflects the essence of summer.

That said, on the way to Mihara Shidai, there were chestnut burrs fallen on the path, indicating that the scent of autumn is steadily approaching.
I’m looking forward to the autumn foliage.

After enjoying the stunning views, let’s indulge in the hot springs!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

#GeroOnsen #Japan'sThreeFamousHotSprings #GeroCity #GeroTourism

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
夕暮れの飛騨川に足を踏み入れてみました。

日差しは強いものの、夏真っ盛りのような暑さはなく、秋が近づいているのだなと実感します。
風も涼しく、川の流れに手を入れてみると、これまで感じていたひんやりした気持ちよさよりも、
冷たさが先に感じられました。
川面に映っていた夕陽も、なんだか落ち着いているように見えました。

きれいな紅葉が見れるようになったら、撮影しにいきたいですね。
秋の下呂温泉もご紹介していければと思います。

さて、秋の到来を感じながら入る温泉もまた格別です！

春夏秋冬いつでも極上の湯！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！


#下呂温泉 #日本三名泉 #下呂市 #下呂観光

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
I stepped into the Hida River at dusk.

Although the sunlight is strong, it doesn’t feel like the sweltering heat of summer; I can sense that autumn is approaching.
The breeze is cool, and when I dipped my hand into the river, I felt the coldness before the refreshing chill I had experienced before.
The sunset reflected on the river’s surface also seemed to be calm.

Once the beautiful autumn leaves start to appear, I would like to go and take some photos.
I hope to introduce Gero Onsen in autumn as well.

Now, soaking in the hot springs while feeling the arrival of autumn is truly exceptional!

Anytime throughout the year, enjoy the finest hot springs!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!
