title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
連日の晴れ模様の下呂温泉です。
日差しも気温も夏真っ盛りといった感じで、蝉も元気に鳴いています。

再び合掌村へとお邪魔し、萬古庵（ばんこあん）で「萬古あんみつ」をいただきました。
こんにゃくやトマトを使ったユニークなあんみつで、箸休めの梅干しに黒蜜がついてきます。
最初はそのまま味わい、途中から黒蜜をかけてみるのも、味に変化が出て楽しいですね。
餡子とこんにゃくを一緒に、クリームと白玉を一緒に、トマトと抹茶アイスクリーム等、組み合わせて味わうのも一興です。

あんみつを食べ、合掌村を回ったら温泉へお越しください！
夏の暑さも吹き飛ぶ爽快感が待っています！

どの季節にもピッタリの温泉がよりどりみどり！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
This is Gero Onsen under the continuous sunny weather.
The sunlight and temperature feel like it's the height of summer, and the cicadas are chirping energetically.

I visited the Gassho Village again and enjoyed 'Bankoan Mitsu' at Bankoan.
It's a unique anmitsu made with konjac and tomatoes, served with black syrup and pickled plums as a palate cleanser.
At first, you can savor it as is, and then try drizzling some black syrup on it for a fun change in flavor.
Combining the red bean paste with konjac, the cream with shiratama, or the tomatoes with matcha ice cream is also an interesting experience.

After enjoying the anmitsu and exploring Gassho Village, please come to the hot springs!
A refreshing sensation awaits that will blow away the summer heat!

There are plenty of hot springs that are perfect for any season!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
けふは温泉街から歩いて約10分、雨情公園へゆきました。

連日の暑さの中でも、川の流れと木々の木陰のおかげで、涼しく過ごすことができます。
せせらぎを聞きながら、のんびりと寝転んでみたいですね。
川に足を浸してみると、その冷たさにますます清涼の思いです。

さて、暑さを吹き飛ばすにはやはり温泉が一番！
太陽を浴びながらの入浴も新鮮で楽しいものです！

夏こそ温泉に入って暑気払い！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Today, I went to Ujo Park, about a 10-minute walk from the hot spring town.

Even in the continuous heat, thanks to the flow of the river and the shade of the trees, I can spend my time comfortably cool.
I would love to lie down and relax while listening to the babbling of the stream.
Dipping my feet in the river, the coldness brings even more refreshing feelings.

Now, to blow away the heat, nothing beats a hot spring!
Bathing under the sun is also a fresh and enjoyable experience!

Summer is the perfect time to enjoy hot springs and cool off!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
『とちの実煎餅　千寿堂』さんへ、素肌美人スイーツを目指していきましょう。

まさに栃の実づくしといった店内。
注文してからすぐに『栃の実シフォンのチョコパフェ』が運ばれてきました。
これまた栃の実づくしのチョコレートパフェ、チョコと栃の実、シフォンケーキのハーモニーが
ぜいたくで奥の深い甘さを奏でているようです。
添えられてる煎餅もぱりぱりとした歯ごたえです。

栃の実にはポリフェノールが含まれていて、抗酸化作用で張りのある肌を保ってくれます。
食べ終わった後、早速肌に張りが出てきたような気がしました。

さらなる素肌美人を目指して温泉へ入りましょう！
栃の実と温泉の相乗効果で肌はますます美しく！

素肌美人と温泉の聖地！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Let's head to 'Tochinomi Senbei Senjudou' for some skin-beautifying sweets.

The store is truly filled with tochinomi (Japanese horse chestnut).
As soon as I placed my order, the 'Tochinomi Chiffon Chocolate Parfait' was brought to me.
This chocolate parfait, also packed with tochinomi, seems to create a luxurious and profound sweetness with the harmony of chocolate, tochinomi, and chiffon cake.
The accompanying senbei (rice cracker) also has a crispy texture.

Tochinomi contains polyphenols, which help maintain firm skin through their antioxidant effects.
After finishing my meal, I felt like my skin had already started to become firmer.

Let's aim for even more beautiful skin by taking a dip in the hot springs!
With the synergistic effect of tochinomi and the hot springs, my skin will become even more beautiful!

A sacred place for beautiful skin and hot springs!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
素肌美人スイーツを求めて、『自家焙煎珈琲工房ペリゴール』さんへ行きましょう。

注文したのは『とちの実クラッシュアイス』。
バニラアイスとフレンチトーストと一緒に、抗酸化作用のある栃の実をふんだんに使用した、下呂銘菓『栃の実せんべい』が添えられています。

バニラアイスのひんやりした上品な甘み、フレンチトーストの優しい食感、『栃の実せんべい』の歯ごたえが混ざり合った絶品で、あっという間に食べ終えてしまいました。
暑さも吹き飛び、心身ともにリフレッシュ。
ついつい2杯目が欲しくなるおいしさです。

余韻を忘れないうちに温泉へGO！
さらなるリフレッシュが期待できます！

お肌に優しい温泉とスイーツの街！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Let's head to 'Périgord Coffee Roastery' in search of beautiful skin sweets.

What I ordered was 'Tochi Nut Crush Ice'.
It comes with vanilla ice cream and French toast, accompanied by Gero's famous sweet 'Tochi Nut Senbei', which is generously made with antioxidant-rich tochi nuts.

The elegant sweetness of the chilled vanilla ice cream, the gentle texture of the French toast, and the crunchiness of the 'Tochi Nut Senbei' blend together to create an exquisite treat that I finished in no time.
The heat was blown away, and I felt refreshed both physically and mentally.
It's so delicious that I couldn't help but want a second serving.

Before the aftertaste fades, it's time to go to the hot springs!
Further refreshment can be expected!

A town of hot springs and sweets that is gentle on the skin!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
けふも暑い下呂温泉です。

涼しさを求めて足が自然に飛騨川へと向かっていました。
清流を見ていると、思わず泳ぎたくなってしまいます。
深くなっているところはきれいな青色で、まるで海のようでした。

以前に発見できなかった、もうひとつの塚田の渡しの碑へたどり着くことができました。
確かに飛騨川の大きさを考えると、橋がなければ舟が重要な交通手段になるのも
納得です。
もし舟が今もあったら、飛騨川を進んでみたいですね。

暑気払いには温泉が一番！
汗を流して過ごしやすい夜を迎えましょう。

飛騨川と温泉の街！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
It is another hot day at Gero Onsen.

Seeking coolness, my feet naturally headed towards the Hida River.
As I looked at the clear stream, I couldn't help but want to swim.
The deeper parts were a beautiful blue, just like the sea.

I was able to reach another monument of Tsukada's ferry that I couldn't find before.
Considering the size of the Hida River, it makes sense that without a bridge, boats would be an important means of transportation.
If there were still boats, I would love to navigate the Hida River.

For cooling off, nothing beats a hot spring!
Let’s wash off the sweat and welcome a comfortable night.

The town of Hida River and hot springs!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
小川地区にある竹原川に降りてみました。

緑の木々が映えていてせせらぎが耳に心地よいです。
水がとてもきれいで、手を入れてみるとひんやりとし、暑い日差しの中の清涼の気分でした。

この竹原川は飛騨川にも合流していて、あの大きな流れの一部になっているかと思うと
なんだか不思議な気分になりました。

暑い日が続く今こそ温泉で暑気払い！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
I went down to the Takehara River in the Ogawa area.

The green trees are vibrant, and the sound of the flowing water is pleasant to the ears.
The water is very clear, and when I put my hand in, it felt cool, providing a refreshing sensation on a hot sunny day.

This Takehara River merges with the Hida River, and thinking that it is part of that large flow made me feel somewhat mysterious.

Now, during these hot days, it's the perfect time to cool off in the hot springs!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
けふは縄文公園を散策しました。

縄文時代に集落があった峰一合遺跡と、室町時代に築かれたといわれる山城・森城跡、10万年前に噴火して、下呂温泉や下呂石などに深いかかわりをもつ湯ヶ峰が一体となっている公園です。

一面に緑が映え、縄文時代と弥生時代の竪穴住居跡が復元されていて、中に入ることもできました。のんびりと散策するには最高の公園ですね。

小さな池もあり、近づくとエサをもらえると思ったのかコイが集まってきました。

太古の人々も温泉に入っていたのでしょうか？
そう考えると、今日入ろうと思っている温泉にも歴史が感じられそうです！

今も昔も温泉の街！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Today, I took a stroll through Jomon Park.

This park encompasses the Mineichigo ruins, where a settlement existed during the Jomon period, the ruins of Mori Castle, said to have been built during the Muromachi period, and Yuga Peak, which erupted 100,000 years ago and is deeply connected to Gero Onsen and Gero stone.

The park is lush with greenery, and the restored pit dwellings from the Jomon and Yayoi periods were accessible for entry. It’s the perfect park for a leisurely stroll.

There’s also a small pond, and when I approached, koi fish gathered, perhaps thinking they would be fed.

Did ancient people also bathe in hot springs?
Thinking about that, I feel a sense of history in the hot spring I plan to visit today!

A hot spring town, both now and in the past!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
つかの間の雨上がりの下呂温泉です。

散策路を歩いてみましたが、すぐまた雨が降り出してきました。
飛騨川のかさは増し、いつもは全身が見えているブロックもすっかり水の中です。

梅雨の時期のため仕方がないことですが、太陽が恋しくなってきましたね。

そんな湿っぽい気分を吹き飛ばすには温泉がぴったり！
体を温めれば心も温かくなります。

梅雨の時期こそ下呂温泉！
よろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
This is Gero Onsen after a brief rain.

I took a walk along the promenade, but it started to rain again soon after.
The Hida River has risen, and the blocks that are usually fully visible are now completely submerged.

It's to be expected during the rainy season, but I'm starting to miss the sun.

To blow away such damp feelings, hot springs are just perfect!
Warming the body also warms the heart.

Gero Onsen is best during the rainy season!
Thank you!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
いでゆ朝市へやってきました。

地元のたくさんの特産品がお手頃価格で手に入ります。
欲しくなるものばかりで、どれを買おうか目移りしてしまいますね。
お店の方もとっても親切で、のんびりショッピングするにはうってつけです。

午前8時から正午まで開いていて、開催期間が終わる12月5日（日）までは無休で開催しています。

ショッピングの後は温泉につかり、手に入れたお土産をどうしようかワクワクしながら考えるのが最高です！

温泉とショッピングといえば下呂温泉！　よろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
I have come to the morning market at the hot spring.

You can find many local specialties at reasonable prices.
There are so many tempting items that it's hard to decide which ones to buy.
The shopkeepers are very friendly, making it a perfect place for leisurely shopping.

It is open from 8 AM to noon, and it will be held without a break until the end of the event on December 5th (Sunday).

After shopping, soaking in the hot spring while thinking about what to do with the souvenirs you’ve acquired is the best!

When it comes to hot springs and shopping, it’s Gero Onsen! Thank you very much!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
けふ訪れた合掌村では、手湯と足湯が同時に楽しめます。

中へ入ると、かえるが番をしている手湯が目に入りました。
温かいお湯で手をリラックスさせ、次に向かうのは鷺が番をする合掌の足湯。

広々としていて屋根もあり、腰を落ち着かせて足湯につかりながら、日本の原風景の織り成す世界に浸りました。

手、足とお湯につかると、当然温泉に全身をつからせたくなりました！
せっかくなので、1か所と言わずに、2か所3か所と入りたいですね！

温泉めぐりといえばここ！　下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
At the Gassho Village I visited today, you can enjoy both hand baths and foot baths at the same time.

Upon entering, I noticed a hand bath being watched over by a frog.
Relaxing my hands in the warm water, the next stop was the foot bath watched over by a heron.

It was spacious and had a roof, allowing me to settle down and soak my feet while immersing myself in the world woven by Japan's original landscapes.

Once my hands and feet were in the water, naturally, I wanted to soak my whole body in the hot spring!
Since I'm here, I would love to visit not just one place, but two or three!

When it comes to hot spring hopping, this is the place! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
晴れとくもりが交互にやってきている下呂温泉です。
晴れのときの日差しはなかなか強く、帽子が欲しくなりますね。

散策の途中、ビーナスの足湯で一休み。
洋風の装いと円形の腰かけ、ビーナス像が相まって、異国にいっているような気分になりますね。

熱めの足湯で足を温めれば、汗を流してサッパリできます。
さあ、散策の続きへ行きましょう。

終わったらもう一度足湯へつかり、今度は温泉へ！

ビーナスも常駐の下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Gero Onsen is experiencing alternating sunny and cloudy weather.
When it's sunny, the sunlight can be quite strong, making you wish for a hat.

During a stroll, take a break at the Venus foot bath.
With its Western-style decor, circular seating, and the Venus statue, it feels like you're in a foreign land.

Warming your feet in the hot foot bath will help you refresh by sweating it out.
Now, let's continue our walk.

After finishing, let's soak in the foot bath once more, and this time, head to the hot spring!

Please take care of Gero Onsen, where Venus is always present!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
けふの下呂温泉はくもり時々晴れ、それほど暑くなくて過ごしやすい一日です。

こんな日は、自然に足湯へ足が向いていきますね。
田の神の足湯は市役所のそばにあって、お湯も熱すぎずのんびりゆったりとつかっていられるスポットです。
足湯には美肌効果もあって、むくみの予防やデトックスにも効果があるそうです。

足湯でリラックスしたら、そのまま今度は温泉につかりましょう！
全身美肌でツヤツヤ、ピカピカ！

美肌と言ったら下呂温泉！　よろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Today's Gero Onsen is cloudy with occasional sunshine, making for a comfortable day that isn't too hot.

On days like this, it's natural to head towards the foot bath.
The foot bath at the rice deity shrine is located near the city hall, and the water is not too hot, allowing for a leisurely and relaxing soak.
The foot bath is said to have beauty benefits, helping to prevent swelling and aiding in detoxification.

After relaxing in the foot bath, let's move on to soaking in the hot spring!
With beautiful skin all over, you'll be glowing and shining!

When it comes to beautiful skin, Gero Onsen is the place to be! Thank you very much!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
カラッとした快晴が広がる下呂温泉です。

強い日差しも、森の中に入ると木陰が和らげてくれて、川の流れの近くでは涼しささえ感じさせてくれます。澄んだ空気もあいまって、リフレッシュ気分です。

まだまだ感染防止対策をしていかないといけませんが、岐阜県の「まん延防止等重点措置」が解除されて、少しづつ光が見えてくるようですね。

と、言うわけで、さっそく温泉に入りにいきましょう！
太陽を浴びながらの露天風呂は最高です！

日本三名泉地の一つ、下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
Gero Onsen is basking in a clear, sunny day.

Even the strong sunlight is softened by the shade of the trees when you enter the forest, and near the flowing river, you can even feel a cool breeze. Combined with the clear air, it’s refreshing.

We still need to continue with infection prevention measures, but it seems that the 'Priority Measures to Prevent the Spread of COVID-19' in Gifu Prefecture have been lifted, and a glimmer of hope is starting to appear.

So, let’s head to the hot springs right away!
An outdoor bath under the sun is the best!

Please enjoy Gero Onsen, one of Japan's three famous hot spring areas!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
前回の続きとして、デジタルフォトラリーのスポットのひとつ、合掌村へと足を運びました。

白川郷などから移築した、合掌造りの民家で集落を形成し、日本の原風景を再現しています。
資料館、食事処、体験施設等や自然の美しさが広がり、タイムスリップしたような感覚になりました。

散策した後は、足湯に入ってほっと一息。
そのまま、今度は温泉へ全身をひたしにいきましょう！

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
As a continuation from the last time, I visited one of the spots for the digital photo rally, the Gassho Village.

The village is formed by traditional Gassho-style houses that were relocated from places like Shirakawa-go, recreating the original scenery of Japan.
The area is filled with museums, dining places, experiential facilities, and the beauty of nature, giving me a feeling of having time-traveled.

After strolling around, I took a moment to relax in a foot bath.
Next, let's immerse ourselves fully in the hot springs!

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
快晴の下呂温泉です！　日差しも強く、いよいよ夏到来という気持ちが高まってきますね。

暑さに負けず、各所で花たちはきれいに咲いていました。せみの声はまだ聞こえてきませんが、間もなくうるさいほどの合唱が始まりそうです。

暑いときは、熱い温泉で汗を流してサッパリするのがおすすめです！

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
It’s a clear day at Gero Onsen! The sunlight is strong, and the feeling of summer is definitely on the rise.

Despite the heat, flowers are blooming beautifully everywhere. Although I can’t hear the cicadas yet, it seems like the noisy chorus will start soon.

When it’s hot, I recommend refreshing yourself by sweating it out in the hot springs!

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: 自然溢れる下呂温泉
description:
飛騨川の流域に湧く下呂温泉は室町時代京都五山の僧万里集九や、
徳川家康から四代の将軍に仕えた儒学者林羅山により、
兵庫県の有馬温泉、群馬県の草津温泉と並ぶ「日本三名泉のひとつ」と称された天下の名泉です。
温泉街は飛騨川を中心に歓楽的な賑わいと山里の風情が調和して、下呂温泉の魅力を醸し出しています。

下呂温泉観光協会：https://www.gero-spa.com/

title: Gero Onsen Surrounded by Nature
description:
Gero Onsen, which springs from the basin of the Hida River, is a famous hot spring recognized as one of Japan's three great hot springs, alongside Arima Onsen in Hyogo Prefecture and Kusatsu Onsen in Gunma Prefecture, as praised by the monk Manri Shukyu from the Muromachi period and the Confucian scholar Hayashi Razan, who served four generations of the Tokugawa shogunate. The hot spring town harmonizes the lively atmosphere centered around the Hida River with the rustic charm of the mountain village, creating the allure of Gero Onsen.

Gero Onsen Tourism Association: https://www.gero-spa.com/

title: 美人林の松之山ダイニング 2019
description:
雪国 - 雪によって形作られた生活。
https://yukigunijapan.com/

雪を中心にした生活様式。
東京から電車で近いが、ライフスタイルは遠く離れている。

雪国は8000年以上の歴史を持っています。遠い縄文時代から、私たちの先祖はこの純白の世界に住むようになりました。今でも、その時代に育まれた知恵は今日まで生き続けています。
北緯37度に位置する雪国は、サンフランシスコ、アテネ、リスボンと同じ緯度にあります。これらの比較的温暖な都市と同じ緯度にありながら、ここ湯沢では12月から4月にかけて比類のない量の雪が積もります。
その秘密は日本海の暖流にあります。湿った暖かい空気が、苗場山や谷川岳などの最初の高い山々にぶつかり、空気が急速に冷やされて雪が降ります。このため、ここでの雪は高い湿度と粘着性を持っています。これが特徴的な密に詰まった雪景色を生み出します。

東京からわずか70分
深い山の中で、別の日本の側面をリラックスして体験してください。

[雪国は時を超えた体験を提供します]
https://www.timelessyukiguni.com/
時を超えた雪国を代表する旅館は、日本のホスピタリティの伝統と最高の快適さを体現しています。しかし、それぞれの旅館はこれを超え、地域の歴史、文化、ライフスタイルからの影響を取り入れています。このインスピレーションが、各旅館をユニークなものにしています。
時を超えた雪国のすべての旅館は、その地域自体の表現です。気候、土壌、ブドウ畑の地形に影響を受ける上質なワインのように、これらの旅館は雪国地域の環境とそのすべての影響の産物です。
旅館の物語やその背後にいる人々を学ぶことで、彼らが今日の場所に至るまでのインスピレーションをより深く理解することができます。

雛乃宿 千歳
https://www.timelessyukiguni.com/chitose

玉木屋
https://www.timelessyukiguni.com/tamakiya

title: MATSUNOYAMA DINING in Bijin-bayashi 2019
description:
YUKIGUNI - Lives shaped by snow.
https://yukigunijapan.com/

A Way of Life with Snow at its Heart.
Close to Tokyo by train, far removed by lifestyle.

YUKIGUNI has over 8000 years of history. Since the distant Jomon period, a long time ago, our ancestors came to live in this pure white world. Even now the wisdom raised back then lives on to this day.
Located 37° north. YUKIGUNI is on the same latitude as San Francisco, Athens and Lisbon. Despite being on the same latitude as these relatively warm cities, here in Yuzawa, there is an unparalleled amount of snow piled up from December to April.
The secret lies in warm currents in the Sea of Japan. The moist warm air hits the first high mountains, such as Naeba Mountain and Tanigawa Dake, the air quickly cools and causes snow to fall. Because of this the snow here has high moisture and stickiness. This is what creates the characteristic densely packed snowscape.

Only 70 min from Tokyo​
Experience another aspect of Japan in deep mountain at ease.

[ YUKIGUNI offers a TIMELESS experience ]
https://www.timelessyukiguni.com/
The ryokans selected to represent Timeless Yukiguni embody the very best of the Japanese hospitality tradition and the highest levels of comfort. Yet each one of them goes further than this, and all have incorporated influences from the history, culture, and way of life of the area. This inspiration is what makes each ryokan unique.
Every ryokan in Timeless Yukiguni is an expression of the region itself. Much like a fine wine that is affected by the climate, soil, and topography of the location of its vineyard, so these ryokans are a product of the environment of the Yukiguni area and all of its influences. 
Learn the stories of the ryokan and the people behind them to gain a deeper appreciation of the inspiration that has brought them to where they are today. 

Hinanoyado Chitose
https://www.timelessyukiguni.com/chitose

Tamakiya
https://www.timelessyukiguni.com/tamakiya

　　＼　　　　 Presented by Chris Peppler 　　　　／

This is a promotional video for Fukuchiyama City, featuring TV and radio personality Chris Peppler, who serves as the special ambassador for "The Castle Town Built by Akechi Mitsuhide, Fukuchiyama."

Chris Peppler, believed to be a descendant of Akechi Mitsuhide, was appointed as an ambassador at Fukuchiyama Castle in February 2019. In March, the promotional video "Chris Peppler's Press Conference for the New Lord of Fukuchiyama Castle" was released, and this is its sequel.

【Comment from Chris Peppler】
In the previous video, I expressed my ambition to "contribute to the further development of Fukuchiyama City" upon my appointment as lord, but in this video, I narrate the story of Fukuchiyama Castle as its new lord. I am delighted that Fukuchiyama is gaining momentum starting from the castle, and I hope this video will spark even more interest in Fukuchiyama Castle and Fukuchiyama next year.

＊　＊　＊

This work is the 5th installment of the "Unknown Akechi Mitsuhide Project," which aims to promote the unknown charm of Akechi Mitsuhide, who built Fukuchiyama Castle, and its connection to Fukuchiyama City nationwide!

title: 本編5分ver.【京都府福知山市】「明智光秀マインド～ 語り:クリス・ペプラーさん」
description:
【地域プロモーションアワード2021 動画部門 「箭内道彦賞」を受賞しました！！】

「光秀マインド」（3分ver.）が、地域のパンフレットやプロモーション動画を表彰する「地域プロモーションアワード2021」の「動画部門」にて、審査委員賞のひとつにあたる「箭内道彦（やない みちひこ）賞」を受賞しました。

●審査員コメント
その挑戦に可能性を感じた福知山市のアクションを個人賞に選んだ。市民性に「光秀マインド」と名づけ、あるべき姿をひとりひとりに再自覚させながら、最新の成果を示すことで、まちづくりに力を与える。地域動画の新しい在り方のひとつだ。―箭内道彦（審査委員長／クリエイティブディレクター）

受賞作品3分ver.はこちら　https://youtu.be/-4BRB37bor8
字幕付き3分ver.はこちら　https://youtu.be/O1mA05-JL1c
字幕付き5分ver.はこちら　https://youtu.be/HgH-t5WxexA
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

「明智光秀が築いた城下町 福知山」特別大使を務めるTV・ラジオ パーソナリティーのクリス・ペプラーさんがナレーションを務める福知山市のコンセプトムービーです。

明治時代の廃城令によって石垣と一部の遺構だけになった福知山城が、なぜ再建を果たすことができたのか。そこには、「昭和の瓦一枚運動」と呼ばれた市民の盛り上がりがありました。当時の新聞記事などにより、その歴史を振り返ります。

いつの時代も常に逆境に立ち向かいまちづくりを進めてきた福知山。そこには、『光秀マインド』ともいうべきものが脈々と受け継がれていました。

字幕付きはこちら　https://youtu.be/HgH-t5WxexA

明智光秀の知られざる魅力と福知山城の盛り上がりをクリス・ペプラーさんが発信！　　　 
明智光秀の子孫とされるクリス・ペプラーさんは、2019年2月に福知山城で大使に就任。
本作は、福知山城を築いた明智光秀の知られざる魅力と福知山市とのつながりを全国に発信する「知られざる明智光秀プロジェクト」第6弾です。

【クリス・ペプラーさんコメント】
福知山市の特別大使と福知山城主に就任し、明智光秀の末裔としての自負、そして誇りのようなものが強く芽生えたと思います。福知山市とお城を訪れる度に、光秀公が優れた武将のみならず、優れた都市デザイナーでもあり、領民に強く支持され愛された領主であったことを痛感しました。明智光秀が築いたまち、そして、光秀マインドが今も息づく福知山を今後も宜しくお願いします。

☆お知らせ☆
明智光秀が築いた福知山城の公式サイトオープン！
https://www.fukuchiyamacastle.jp/

福知山城の400年以上の歴史で初の公式サイトです。
天正7（1579）年に丹波を平定した明智光秀は、この地に福知山城を築きました。築城当時から残る個性豊かな石垣の上に、昭和の時代、市民らによる寄附運動「瓦一枚運動」で再建された天守閣がある福知山城は、福知山の400年の歩みがつまったまちのシンボルです。
『麒麟がくる』本編終了後の「紀行」コーナーで紹介されるなど、福知山城にかつてない注目が集まる今だからこそ伝えたい、歴史や秘話などの「知られざるストーリー」を公式サイトでは紹介します。
ストーリーテラーは、専門家から福知山市民まで様々。各ストーリーをじっくり読んでほしいという意図から、順次公開とします。第一弾公開ページに登場するのは、明智光秀や福知山城に精通する千田嘉博さん、梅林秀行さん、島充さん、そして小和田哲男さん（登場順・詳細下記）。今後は、福知山在住の漫画家・こうの史代さんの描き下ろしイラストや、昨年から募集していた「瓦一枚運動」寄附者からのエピソードなどの公開を予定しています。
この取組みは、明智光秀の知られざる魅力と福知山とのつながりを全国に発信する「知られざる明智光秀プロジェクト」第7弾です。なお、この公式サイトには、クラウドファンディング型ふるさと納税「明智光秀×福知山サポーター」の寄附金が活用されています。

title: Main Story 5-Minute Version. [Fukuchiyama City, Kyoto Prefecture] "The Mind of Akechi Mitsuhide - Narration: Chris Peppler"
description:
[Won the "Yanai Michihiko Award" in the Video Category of the Regional Promotion Award 2021!!]

The "Mind of Mitsuhide" (3-minute version) received the "Yanai Michihiko Award," one of the jury awards in the "Video Category" of the "Regional Promotion Award 2021," which honors local brochures and promotional videos.

● Jury Comments
I chose Fukuchiyama City's action, which I felt had potential in its challenge, for the individual award. By naming the civic spirit "Mind of Mitsuhide" and helping each individual to reawaken to what should be, while demonstrating the latest achievements, it empowers community development. This is one of the new forms of regional video. - Yanai Michihiko (Jury Chair / Creative Director)

You can watch the award-winning 3-minute version here: https://youtu.be/-4BRB37bor8
You can watch the subtitled 3-minute version here: https://youtu.be/O1mA05-JL1c
You can watch the subtitled 5-minute version here: https://youtu.be/HgH-t5WxexA
------------------------------

This is a concept movie of Fukuchiyama City narrated by Chris Peppler, a TV and radio personality serving as a special ambassador for "The Castle Town of Fukuchiyama Built by Akechi Mitsuhide."

Why was Fukuchiyama Castle, which was left with only stone walls and some ruins due to the castle abolition order in the Meiji era, able to be rebuilt? There was a civic movement called the "Showa Tile Movement." We will look back at that history through newspaper articles from that time.

Fukuchiyama has always faced adversity and progressed in community development throughout the ages. There, the essence of what can be called the 'Mind of Mitsuhide' has been passed down through generations.

You can watch the subtitled version here: https://youtu.be/HgH-t5WxexA

Chris Peppler shares the unknown charm of Akechi Mitsuhide and the excitement of Fukuchiyama Castle! 
As a descendant of Akechi Mitsuhide, Chris Peppler was appointed as an ambassador at Fukuchiyama Castle in February 2019. 
This work is the 6th installment of the "Unknown Akechi Mitsuhide Project," which aims to share the unknown charm of Akechi Mitsuhide, who built Fukuchiyama Castle, and the connection with Fukuchiyama City nationwide.

[Comment from Chris Peppler]
As I took on the role of special ambassador for Fukuchiyama City and lord of Fukuchiyama Castle, I felt a strong sense of pride and self-identity as a descendant of Akechi Mitsuhide. Every time I visit Fukuchiyama City and the castle, I am deeply aware that Mitsuhide was not only an excellent military commander but also a great urban designer, a lord who was strongly supported and loved by his people. I look forward to continuing to support Fukuchiyama, the town built by Akechi Mitsuhide, where the 'Mind of Mitsuhide' still thrives.

☆ Announcement ☆
The official website of Fukuchiyama Castle, built by Akechi Mitsuhide, is now open! 
https://www.fukuchiyamacastle.jp/

This is the first official website in the 400-year history of Fukuchiyama Castle. In 1579, Akechi Mitsuhide, who pacified Tanba, built Fukuchiyama Castle in this area. On the unique stone walls that have remained since the time of its construction, there stands the main keep, rebuilt during the Showa era through the civic donation movement known as the "Tile Movement." Fukuchiyama Castle is a symbol of the town, encapsulating 400 years of Fukuchiyama's history. 
Now, as unprecedented attention is being drawn to Fukuchiyama Castle, such as being featured in the "Travel" corner after the main story of "Kirin ga Kuru," we want to share the "unknown stories" of history and secrets on the official website. 
The storytellers will range from experts to Fukuchiyama citizens. With the intention of encouraging readers to take their time with each story, they will be released sequentially. The first page to be published will feature Yoshihiro Chida, Hideyuki Umebayashi, Mitsuru Shima, and Tetsuo Kowada (in order of appearance; details below). In the future, we plan to publish illustrations drawn by Fumiyo Kono, a manga artist residing in Fukuchiyama, and episodes from donors of the "Tile Movement" that have been collected since last year. 
This initiative is the 7th installment of the "Unknown Akechi Mitsuhide Project," which aims to share the unknown charm of Akechi Mitsuhide and the connection with Fukuchiyama nationwide. Please note that the donations from the crowdfunding-style hometown tax "Akechi Mitsuhide x Fukuchiyama Supporters" are being utilized for this official website.

On March 18, 2006 (Saturday) at 7:25 AM, it passed through the Ayabe Bridge slightly late, as if to bid farewell. It departed while being seen off by many fans.

title: ５月の香美町
description:
５月も今日で終わりですね。
５月は新型コロナウイルス感染症の影響により外出自粛期間が多かったため、香美町へ来ることができなかった皆さんに５月の香美町の風景を少しではありますが、ご紹介させていただきます。
香美町観光ポスターの撮影地から「香住海岸」「和池の大カツラ」「うへ山の棚田」「かえる島」をご覧ください。
鳥のさえずり、水の音、カエルの鳴き声、波の音、香美町のありのままの風景をお楽しみください。

title: Kōbichō in May
description:
Today marks the end of May.
Due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, there were many periods of self-restraint in going out, so for those who could not visit Kōbichō, I would like to introduce a glimpse of the scenery of Kōbichō in May.
Please take a look at 'Kasumi Coast', 'O-Katsura of Waki', 'Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields', and 'Kaeru Island' from the locations of the Kōbichō tourism posters.
Enjoy the natural scenery of Kōbichō with the sounds of birds chirping, water flowing, frogs croaking, and waves crashing.

title: ６月の香美町
description:
６月も今日で終わりですね。
６月１０日に梅雨入りし、雨の降る日が多くなりました。
町内の田植えも終わり、田んぼにとっては恵みの雨といったところでしょうか。
また、香住海岸に夕日が沈む風景を見ることができる季節となりました。
６月の香美町の風景を少しではありますが、ご紹介させていただきます。
香美町観光ポスターの撮影地から「香住海岸」「和池の大カツラ」「うへ山の棚田」「かえる島」をご覧ください。
夕日の景色、雨の音、鳥のさえずりなど、香美町のありのままの風景をお楽しみください。

title: Kōmi Town in June
description:
Today marks the end of June.
The rainy season began on June 10, and we have seen many rainy days since then.
The rice planting in the town has also been completed, and for the rice fields, it can be considered a blessing of rain.
Additionally, it is now the season when we can witness the sunset over Kasumi Coast.
I would like to introduce a glimpse of the scenery of Kōmi Town in June.
Please take a look at "Kasumi Coast," "Wai Pond's Great Katsura," "Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields," and "Kaeru Island" from the locations where the Kōmi Town tourism posters were shot.
Enjoy the natural scenery of Kōmi Town, including the sunset views, the sound of rain, and the chirping of birds.

title: ７月の香美町
description:
７月も終わりましたね。
７月３１日にようやく梅雨も明け、暑い夏がやってきそうです。
熱中症には十分気をつけてお過ごしください。
７月の香美町の風景を少しではありますが、ご紹介させていただきます。
香美町観光ポスターの撮影地から「香住海岸」「和池の大カツラ」「うへ山の棚田」「かえる島」をご覧ください。
夕日の景色、漁火の明かり、ヒグラシの鳴き声、鳥のさえずりなど、香美町のありのままの風景をお楽しみください。

title: Kōbichō in July
description:
July has come to an end.
Finally, the rainy season has cleared on July 31, and the hot summer seems to be approaching.
Please take care to avoid heatstroke.
I would like to introduce a little bit of the scenery of Kōbichō in July.
Please take a look at "Kasumi Coast," "Waiike's Great Katsura," "Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields," and "Kaeru Island" from the locations of the Kōbichō tourism posters.
Enjoy the natural scenery of Kōbichō, including the sunset views, the lights of fishing fires, the calls of evening cicadas, and the chirping of birds.

title: ８月の香美町
description:
８月も終わり、いよいよ９月になりました。
香美町では底曳き網漁と香住ガニ漁が解禁となり、漁港が賑わう季節となりました。
８月の香美町の風景を少しではありますが、ご紹介させていただきます。
香美町観光ポスターの撮影地から「香住海岸」「和池の大カツラ」「うへ山の棚田」「かえる島」をご覧ください。
夏らしい青い空、青い海、青々育つ稲穂、セミの鳴き声など、香美町のありのままの風景をお楽しみください。

title: Kōbichō in August
description:
August has come to an end, and September has finally arrived.
In Kōbichō, the bottom trawling and Kasumi crab fishing have been lifted, marking the season when the fishing port becomes lively.
I would like to introduce a glimpse of the scenery in Kōbichō during August.
Please take a look at 'Kasumi Coast', 'Waiike's Great Katsura', 'Uheyama's Terraced Rice Fields', and 'Kaeru Island' from the locations of the Kōbichō tourism posters.
Enjoy the true scenery of Kōbichō with its summer-like blue sky, blue sea, lush green rice ears, and the sound of cicadas.

title: ９月の香美町
description:
９月も終わり、いよいよ１０月になりました。
朝晩涼しくなり、過ごしやすい日が続いています。
町内の稲刈りも始まり、実りの秋、食欲の秋を感じられる季節です。
香美町の美味しい食材をぜひ味わってください。
９月の香美町の風景を少しではありますが、ご紹介させていただきます。
香美町観光ポスターの撮影地から「香住海岸」「和池の大カツラ」「うへ山の棚田」「かえる島」をご覧ください。
秋らしい青い空、青い海、稲刈りの終わった田、鳥のさえずりなど、香美町のありのままの風景をお楽しみください。

title: Kōbichō in September
description:
September is coming to an end, and October is finally here.
The mornings and evenings have become cooler, and comfortable days continue.
The rice harvesting in the town has also begun, marking the season of fruitful autumn and appetizing autumn.
Please enjoy the delicious ingredients of Kōbichō.
We would like to introduce a glimpse of the landscapes of Kōbichō in September.
From the locations of the Kōbichō tourism posters, please take a look at "Kasumi Coast," "Waiike's Great Katsura," "Uheyama's Terraced Rice Fields," and "Kaeru Island."
Enjoy the true landscapes of Kōbichō, featuring autumn-like blue skies, blue seas, rice fields after harvesting, and the chirping of birds.

title: 板仕野で棚田ボランティアをやってみよう！
description:
香美町村岡区の板仕野地域には、緩やかな地形を利用して作られた棚田が広がっています。
　ミネラルに富んだ水や土壌、昼夜の寒暖差などを利用して育てたお米は“美味しい”と評判で、一部ではブランド米「とろかわの恋」が栽培されています。
　人口が減っていく中で、これからも魅力ある棚田を守っていきたく、農作業を手伝っていただく「棚田ボランティア」を募集します。活動の内容は動画をご覧ください。
　棚田で農業、一緒にやってみませんか？お申し込みをお待ちしています。

【お問い合わせ先】
　香美町農林水産課：0796-36-0846
　※申込の受付開始は、令和４年３月を予定しています。
　※申込の詳細は、香美町ホームページに掲載します（準備が整い次第、この概要欄にアドレスを追記します）。

【活動期間・日時】
　４月中旬から10月中旬頃まで。詳細の日時は農家さんと調整して決定します。

【募集対象や参加費】
　棚田での農業や農家との交流に興味がある方などをはじめ、どなたでも無料で参加可能です。

【交通手段】
　各自でお願いします。

＃棚田ボランティア
＃板仕野
＃但馬県民局
＃棚田

title: Let's Try Volunteer Work in the Terraced Rice Fields of Itashino!
description:
In the Itashino area of the Murooka district in Kami Town, terraced rice fields have been created using the gentle topography.
The rice grown using mineral-rich water and soil, along with the temperature differences between day and night, is renowned for being 'delicious,' and some of it is cultivated as the brand rice 'Torokawa no Koi.'
As the population decreases, we want to continue preserving these attractive terraced fields, and we are recruiting 'Terraced Rice Field Volunteers' to help with farming activities. Please watch the video for details on the activities.
Would you like to try farming in the terraced fields together? We look forward to your application.

【Contact Information】
Kami Town Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Division: 0796-36-0846
*Applications are expected to start in March 2022.
*Details of the application will be posted on the Kami Town website (the address will be added to this overview as soon as it is ready).

【Activity Period and Dates】
From mid-April to around mid-October. The specific dates will be determined in coordination with the farmers.

【Target Participants and Participation Fee】
Anyone interested in farming in the terraced fields or interacting with farmers is welcome to participate for free.

【Transportation】
Please arrange your own transportation.

title: #飛騨高山　雲上の世界へ！ #乗鞍岳 で出会う感動のパノラマとお花畑
description:
🏔️ 日本百名山・乗鞍岳へようこそ！
岐阜県と長野県の県境に広がる中部山岳国立公園に属し、最高峰は標高3,026mの「剣ヶ峰」。
畳平（標高2,702m）までバスでアクセスでき、日本で最も手軽に挑戦できる3,000m級の山として人気です。

🌸 夏は高山植物が咲き誇るお花畑を散策、
🌋 火口湖や溶岩地形など火山ならではの景色、
🌅 頂上からは北アルプス・白山・八ヶ岳などを望む壮大なパノラマ！

🚶‍♂️登山初心者でも挑戦しやすいコースが充実！
・剣ヶ峰までは片道約1時間30分
・魔王岳なら片道15分で山頂へ

✨「大自然と親しみやすい山」＝それが乗鞍岳。
子どもから大人まで楽しめる、岳人入門にぴったりの名山です。

📹 この動画では、登山ルートの様子、花々に彩られたお花畑、山頂からの絶景をたっぷりご紹介します。
ぜひ最後までご覧いただき、次の旅の参考にしてください！
※手頃とはいえ、体調や服装・装備などは、出来るだけ登山仕様（山歩きしやすい服装・装備）を心がけ、決して注意を怠らないようにして下さい。また、寝不足や体調不良の状態では登山は控えてください。高山病にも注意が必要です。

title: #Hida Takayama: A World Above the Clouds! Encounter the Stunning Panorama and Flower Fields at #Norikura Mountain
description:
🏔️ Welcome to Norikura Mountain, one of Japan's 100 Famous Mountains!
It belongs to Chubu Sangaku National Park, which stretches along the border of Gifu and Nagano Prefectures, with its highest peak, "Kengamine," reaching an elevation of 3,026m.
You can access Tatamidaira (elevation 2,702m) by bus, making it a popular choice for those looking to easily challenge a 3,000m-class mountain in Japan.

🌸 In summer, stroll through flower fields adorned with alpine plants,
🌋 Experience volcanic landscapes such as crater lakes and lava formations,
🌅 Enjoy a magnificent panorama from the summit, overlooking the Northern Alps, Hakusan, and Yatsugatake!

🚶‍♂️ There are plenty of courses that are beginner-friendly for mountain climbing!
・It takes about 1 hour and 30 minutes one way to Kengamine.
・You can reach the summit of Maou-dake in just 15 minutes one way.

✨ "A mountain that is friendly to nature" = that is Norikura Mountain.
It is a perfect mountain for beginners, enjoyable for both children and adults alike.

📹 In this video, we will thoroughly introduce the climbing routes, flower-filled meadows, and breathtaking views from the summit.
Please watch until the end and use it as a reference for your next trip!
*Although it is accessible, please ensure your physical condition, clothing, and equipment are suitable for mountain climbing (wearing comfortable hiking attire and gear) and never let your guard down. Also, refrain from climbing if you are sleep-deprived or unwell. Be cautious of altitude sickness as well.

title: 美人林の松之山ダイニング 2018
description:
雪国 - 雪によって形作られた生活。 
https://yukigunijapan.com/

雪を中心にした生活様式。 
東京から電車で近いが、ライフスタイルは遠く離れている。 

雪国は8000年以上の歴史を持っています。遠い縄文時代から、私たちの祖先はこの純白の世界に住むようになりました。今でも、その時代に育まれた知恵は今日まで生き続けています。 
北緯37度に位置する雪国は、サンフランシスコ、アテネ、リスボンと同じ緯度にあります。これらの比較的温暖な都市と同じ緯度にありながら、ここ湯沢では12月から4月にかけて比類のない量の雪が積もります。 
その秘密は日本海の暖流にあります。湿った暖かい空気が、苗場山や谷川岳などの最初の高い山々にぶつかり、空気が急速に冷やされて雪が降ります。このため、ここでの雪は高い湿度と粘着性を持っています。これが特徴的な密に詰まった雪景色を生み出します。 

東京からわずか70分 
深い山の中で、別の日本の側面をリラックスして体験してください。 

[雪国は時を超えた体験を提供します] 
https://www.timelessyukiguni.com/ 
時を超えた雪国を代表する旅館は、日本のホスピタリティの伝統と最高の快適さを体現しています。しかし、それぞれの旅館はこれを超え、地域の歴史、文化、生活様式からの影響を取り入れています。このインスピレーションが、各旅館をユニークなものにしています。 
時を超えた雪国のすべての旅館は、その地域自体の表現です。気候、土壌、ブドウ園の地形に影響を受ける上質なワインのように、これらの旅館は雪国地域の環境とそのすべての影響の産物です。 
旅館の物語やその背後にいる人々を学ぶことで、彼らが今日の場所に至るまでのインスピレーションをより深く理解することができます。

title: MATSUNOYAMA DINING in Bijin-bayashi 2018
description:
YUKIGUNI - Lives shaped by snow.
https://yukigunijapan.com/

A Way of Life with Snow at its Heart.
Close to Tokyo by train, far removed by lifestyle.

YUKIGUNI has over 8000 years of history. Since the distant Jomon period, a long time ago, our ancestors came to live in this pure white world. Even now the wisdom raised back then lives on to this day.
Located 37° north. YUKIGUNI is on the same latitude as San Francisco, Athens and Lisbon. Despite being on the same latitude as these relatively warm cities, here in Yuzawa, there is an unparalleled amount of snow piled up from December to April.
The secret lies in warm currents in the Sea of Japan. The moist warm air hits the first high mountains, such as Naeba Mountain and Tanigawa Dake, the air quickly cools and causes snow to fall. Because of this the snow here has high moisture and stickiness. This is what creates the characteristic densely packed snowscape.

Only 70 min from Tokyo​
Experience another aspect of Japan in deep mountain at ease.

[ YUKIGUNI offers a TIMELESS experience ]
https://www.timelessyukiguni.com/​
The ryokans selected to represent Timeless Yukiguni embody the very best of the Japanese hospitality tradition and the highest levels of comfort. Yet each one of them goes further than this, and all have incorporated influences from the history, culture, and way of life of the area. This inspiration is what makes each ryokan unique.
Every ryokan in Timeless Yukiguni is an expression of the region itself. Much like a fine wine that is affected by the climate, soil, and topography of the location of its vineyard, so these ryokans are a product of the environment of the Yukiguni area and all of its influences. 
Learn the stories of the ryokan and the people behind them to gain a deeper appreciation of the inspiration that has brought them to where they are today. 

Hinanoyado Chitose
https://www.timelessyukiguni.com/chitose​

title: #飛騨高山 ふるさとの風景
description:
岐阜県高山市は、標高3,000メートル級の山々に抱かれた自然豊かなエリア。春は芽吹く新緑、夏は涼やかな高原の風、秋は色鮮やかな紅葉、そして冬は一面を白銀に染める雪景色——四季の移ろいを全身で感じられる場所です。

北アルプスの麓に広がる風景は、訪れるたびに表情を変え、心に深く残る感動を与えてくれます。澄み渡る空気、野鳥のさえずり、木々を渡る風の音…。自然のリズムに包まれる時間は、日々の喧騒を忘れさせてくれます。

春には枝垂れ桜が咲き誇り、夏には清流と緑の中で涼を楽しむ。秋には山々が黄金色や朱に染まり、冬には幻想的な雪景色が広がります。どの季節に訪れても、それぞれの美しさが旅人を魅了します。

また、自然だけでなく、古い町並や匠の技といった人の営みも、この地の魅力のひとつ。自然と文化が寄り添いながら息づく高山は、訪れる人の心をそっと癒してくれる特別な場所です。

心を整える旅に、飛騨高山へ。
四季とともにある静かな時間が、あなたを待っています。

title: #Hida Takayama - Hometown Scenery
description:
Takayama City in Gifu Prefecture is a nature-rich area surrounded by mountains over 3,000 meters high. In spring, fresh green buds emerge; in summer, a cool breeze flows through the highlands; in autumn, vibrant foliage colors the landscape; and in winter, the scenery is transformed into a silver-white wonderland of snow—it's a place where you can fully experience the changing of the seasons.

The scenery that spreads at the foot of the Northern Alps changes its expression with each visit, leaving a deep emotional impact. The clear air, the chirping of wild birds, and the sound of the wind passing through the trees... Time enveloped in the rhythm of nature allows you to forget the hustle and bustle of daily life.

In spring, weeping cherry blossoms bloom in splendor, and in summer, you can enjoy the coolness among clear streams and greenery. In autumn, the mountains are dyed in golden and crimson hues, and in winter, a fantastical snow landscape unfolds. No matter which season you visit, each has its own beauty that captivates travelers.

Moreover, not only nature but also the old townscape and the craftsmanship of people are part of the charm of this area. Takayama, where nature and culture coexist, is a special place that gently heals the hearts of those who visit.

Embark on a journey to Hida Takayama to restore your spirit. A quiet time in harmony with the seasons awaits you.

Dp. Ed. Cam.: Motohiko Hino

description:
岐阜県高山市。北アルプスの山々に抱かれたこのまちは、歴史ある町並みと自然の恵みに満ちた観光地として知られています。しかし、実はもうひとつの魅力があるのをご存じでしょうか？それは――「酒」。高山市では、日本酒はもちろん、クラフトビール、ウイスキー、ワイン、そして珍しいレモンリキュールまで、五つの種類のお酒が地元で造られています。これほど多彩な「地酒」を、ひとつの市で飲み比べできる場所は全国でも極めて珍しいのです。江戸時代から続く酒蔵で仕込まれる伝統の日本酒。地元の湧き水と地元産麦芽でつくられるクラフトビール。標高の高い気候を活かしたフルーティなワイン。高原育ちの果実で造る香り高いリキュール。そして、こだわりの蒸留で仕上げる個性豊かなウイスキー。高山市には、お酒そのものはもちろん、その背景にある風土・技術・人の想いまでも味わえる豊かな酒文化があります。Dp. title: Five Sakes, Five Senses: Experience the Ultimate Drink in #HidaTakayama
description:
Takayama City, Gifu Prefecture. Surrounded by the Northern Alps, this town is known as a tourist destination rich in historical streets and natural blessings. However, did you know there is another charm? That is—"sake." In Takayama City, not only sake but also craft beer, whiskey, wine, and even rare lemon liqueur are locally produced in five different types. It is extremely rare in Japan to find a place where you can compare such a diverse range of "local sake" all in one city. Traditional sake brewed in a sake brewery that has been in operation since the Edo period. Craft beer made from local spring water and locally sourced malt. Fruity wine that takes advantage of the high-altitude climate. Fragrant liqueur made from fruits grown in the highlands. And unique whiskey finished with meticulous distillation. Takayama City offers a rich sake culture where you can savor not only the drinks themselves but also the local climate, techniques, and the heartfelt dedication of the people behind them. Dp. Ed. Cam.: Motohiko Hino

title: ReVIEW!#飛騨高山 国府町
description:
こくふ観光協会会長　北村家光さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
国府町は高山市の北部に位置する歴史と自然が息づく地域です。千数百年前、斐陀国の政治の中心地「国府」があった地と推測されるような数多くの文化財をみることができ、古くから栄えた地でした。この町では多くの古墳や石器時代の出土品をはじめ、安国寺経蔵（国宝）や清峯寺に伝わる円空仏など数々の文化財や歴史的建造物をみることができ、「日本遺産」を構成する文化財も含まれています。これらのものを通じて、懐かしさや、ぬくもりを感じることができるでしょう。また、周囲を美しい山々に囲まれており、四季折々の風景を楽しむことができます。特に春には、桜野公園の桜が見事に咲き、山里沿いの道が桃の花でピンクに染まり、美しい風景が広がります。この風景は「ピーチロード」として知られ、地元の人々にも親しまれています。さらに、標高1,200mの水源を持つ宇津江四十八滝に、数々の滝が点在し、清流や森林の中でトレッキングやピクニックを楽しむことができます。ここでの時間は心を癒してくれることでしょう。
国府町に是非お越しください。
（高山市街地から車で約20分）

Mr. Iemitsu Kitamura, chairman of the Kokufu Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town.
Kokufu Town is located in the northern part of Takayama City and is an area rich in history and nature. It has been a prosperous area since ancient times, with many cultural assets that can be seen, suggesting that it was the site of the Kokufu, the political center of Hidanokuni, over a thousand years ago. In this town, you can see many cultural assets and historical buildings, including many ancient tombs and excavated items from the Stone Age, as well as the Ankoku-ji Kyozo (national treasure) and the Enku Buddha handed down at Seiho-ji Temple, and is designated as a ``Japanese Heritage Site.'' It also includes the cultural assets that make up the area. Through these things, you will feel a sense of nostalgia and warmth. It is also surrounded by beautiful mountains, allowing you to enjoy the scenery of each season. Especially in spring, the cherry blossoms in Sakurano Park are in full bloom, and the roads along the mountain village are dyed pink with peach blossoms, creating a beautiful scenery. This scenery is known as "Peach Road" and is loved by locals. Furthermore, there are many waterfalls dotted around the Utsue Shijuhachi Falls, which have a water source at an altitude of 1,200m, and you can enjoy trekking and picnicking among the clear streams and forests. Your time here will soothe your soul.
Please come to Kokufu Town.
(About 20 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: Mt. Ontake and Mt. Norikura View #Hida Takayama 'Takane Town'
description:
In the Meiji to Taisho era, 'Hida Takane' was a place where poor girls from Hida traveled far to Shinshu to earn a living along the Nomugi Highway. It is a nature-rich area that offers views of Mt. Ontake's northern edge, Mt. Kegusuko, and Mt. Norikura. There are many campsites that take advantage of the great outdoors, and in autumn, you can enjoy beautiful autumn leaves.
Taking advantage of the cool highland environment even in summer, it has gained attention as a place where athletes come to train. Additionally, the indigenous variety 'Hibata Soba' cultivated in this climate is also popular! Why not visit Hida Takane?

北アルプスの南端・乗鞍岳に抱かれる丹生川町。ライチョウが棲む乗鞍岳は、山岳の世界を気軽に体感させてくれます。その麓、五色が原には原生林が広がり、秘境の森が守られています。丹生川町は、トマトやホウレンソウの生産が盛んで、北アルプスから生まれる水で育った野菜はどれも滋味に溢れています。また、サイクリストが訪れる地でもあり、農山村の風景と乗鞍岳の絶景が魅了し、ペダルをこぐ脚には活力を与えます。四季の移ろいを魅せる農山村の風景はどこか懐かしく未来へと残したい宝物です。

title: A Town Where Hidden Realms and Myths Sleep #Niu River
description:
Niu River Town, nestled at the southern end of the Northern Alps, Mount Norikura. 
Mount Norikura, home to the Japanese rock ptarmigan, allows you to easily experience the world of mountains. 
At its foot, the Goshikigahara area is covered with primeval forests, protecting a hidden realm of woods. 
Niu River Town is known for its active production of tomatoes and spinach, and the vegetables grown with water from the Northern Alps are all rich in flavor. 
It is also a destination for cyclists, where the picturesque rural landscape and the breathtaking views of Mount Norikura captivate, energizing the legs that pedal. 
The changing scenery of the rural landscape through the seasons is a nostalgic treasure that we want to preserve for the future.

description: The city of Takayama retains a strong resemblance to its past as a castle town. The old streets exude the atmosphere of the Edo period, and numerous historical buildings remain in the city, including the Takayama Jinya, the only existing structure from the Tokugawa shogunate in Japan, and the Kusakabe Folk Museum. title: #飛騨高山 #新伝統工芸 #iPhone ケース制作
description:
飛騨高山に今も息づく匠の技。木を知り、漆を操り、土石を生活に活かす「技」として受け継がれ、やがて「匠」として呼ばれるようになったその技は今日も継承され磨かれつづけています。 さらに、現代のライフスタイルに合わせ、飛騨の匠の技を継承した新しいカタチで創り出される「新伝統工芸」。流行や目新しさに留まらない、伝統工芸の新しい可能性を秘めています。

「飛騨の匠」の技と魂を現代のライフスタイルに合わせて提案する飛騨新伝統工芸「ノクターレ」。
ノクターレは、飛騨春慶や一位一刀彫、山中和紙などの伝統工芸を今の時代に、現代のライフスタイルに合わせた商品を従来の概念にとらわれず作り出し、新しいユーザー層を獲得しています。中でも一押しは、鷲塚彫刻とコラボレーションした一位一刀彫のデザインが手に馴染むスマートフォンケース(iPhone14)。天然木を使用し、木目を活用したデザインが特徴です。スマートフォン本体の形状に究極まで沿わせたケース設計にこだわり、薄く忠実に削りだすノクターレの木工技術と一位一刀彫の匠の技が歪みなくスマートフォンをケースに装着することができます。永く使い込むほどに美しさや味わいが増すスマートフォンケースで、新伝統工芸を生活に取り入れてみてはいかがでしょうか。

title: #Hida Takayama #New Traditional Crafts #iPhone Case Production
description:
The craftsmanship that still thrives in Hida Takayama. 
The knowledge of wood, the manipulation of lacquer, and the utilization of clay and stone have been passed down as 'techniques' and eventually came to be known as 'craftsmanship.' This skill continues to be inherited and refined today. 
Furthermore, in line with modern lifestyles, 'New Traditional Crafts' are created in a new form that inherits the techniques of Hida's artisans. It holds new possibilities for traditional crafts that go beyond trends and novelty.

Introducing Hida's craftsmanship and spirit in a way that aligns with modern lifestyles, Hida's New Traditional Craft 'Nocturne.' 
Nocturne creates products that align with contemporary lifestyles, breaking away from conventional concepts, using traditional crafts such as Hida Shunkei, Ichii Ittobori, and Yamanaka Washi, and has gained a new user base. 
Among them, the highlight is the smartphone case (iPhone 14) designed in collaboration with Washizuka Sculpture, featuring the Ichii Ittobori design that fits comfortably in hand. 
Using natural wood, it features a design that utilizes the wood grain. 
The case design is committed to closely following the shape of the smartphone body, and Nocturne's woodworking techniques and the craftsmanship of Ichii Ittobori allow for a distortion-free attachment of the smartphone to the case. 
As you use it over time, the beauty and character of the smartphone case will increase. Why not incorporate New Traditional Crafts into your life?

title: #飛騨高山 秋の#高山祭 (#八幡祭）
description:
秋の高山祭（八幡祭）は櫻山八幡宮の例祭で毎年10月9日・10日に開催されます。また、春の高山祭（山王祭）は日枝神社の例祭で毎年4月14日・15日に開催されます。高山祭とはこのふたつをさす総称で、日本三大美祭のひとつに挙げられ、高山の人々によって大切に守り継がれてきました。

秋の高山祭では動く陽明門とも称される「祭屋台」が11台曳き揃えられ、その豪華絢爛な姿を披露してくれます。また、闘鶏楽（とうけいらく）や裃姿（かみしもすがた）の警固など伝統の衣装を身にまとった総勢数百名におよぶ祭行列が、お囃子や雅楽、獅子舞に先導され祭地域をまわります。夜になると各屋台はそれぞれ約100個にもおよぶ提灯を灯し、艶やかに夜の闇を飾ります。飛騨人の意気が高まる高山祭。高山の揺るぎない誇りです。

title: #Hida Takayama Autumn #Takayama Festival (#Hachiman Festival)
description:
The Autumn Takayama Festival (Hachiman Festival) is the annual festival of Sakurayama Hachiman Shrine, held on October 9th and 10th each year. Additionally, the Spring Takayama Festival (Sanno Festival) is the annual festival of Hie Shrine, held on April 14th and 15th each year. The Takayama Festival refers to these two festivals collectively and is recognized as one of Japan's three great beautiful festivals, cherished and preserved by the people of Takayama.

During the Autumn Takayama Festival, 11 'Yatai' (festival floats), also known as the moving Yomeimon, are paraded, showcasing their splendid and extravagant appearance. Furthermore, a festival procession consisting of hundreds of participants dressed in traditional costumes, including Tokeiraku (a traditional performance) and Kamishimo (formal attire), moves through the festival area, led by music, gagaku (Japanese classical music), and lion dances. At night, each float lights up with approximately 100 lanterns, beautifully illuminating the darkness. The Takayama Festival, where the spirit of the Hida people rises, is an unwavering pride of Takayama.

title: 2022年春の#高山祭　山王祭
description:
春の高山祭(山王祭)は旧高山城下町南半分の氏神様である日枝神社の例祭で毎年4月14日、15日に開催されます。祭りの起源は飛騨の領国大名金森氏の時代、屋台の起こりは1718年頃といわれ、巧みな人形の動きを披露するからくり奉納や、仕掛けが施された戻し車など、匠の技が生きています。
2022年の春の高山祭はあいにくの雨模様でしたが、雨が止んだ合間に屋台が蔵から出て古い町並を通る様子が見られました。

title: 2022 Spring Takayama Festival - Sanno Festival
description:
The Spring Takayama Festival (Sanno Festival) is the annual festival of Hie Shrine, the guardian deity of the southern half of the old Takayama castle town, held on April 14 and 15 each year. The origins of the festival date back to the time of the Hida feudal lord Kanamori, and the beginnings of the floats are said to be around 1718. The festival showcases the skillful movements of karakuri puppets and features mechanisms such as the returning wheel, highlighting the craftsmanship of artisans.
The 2022 Spring Takayama Festival unfortunately experienced rainy weather, but during breaks in the rain, the floats could be seen coming out of the storehouses and passing through the old town streets.

title: #Hida Takayama Handheld Fireworks Display (#HandheldFireworks)
description: A summer tradition in Hida Takayama! The 'Hida Takayama Handheld Fireworks Display' is held every year on August 9th. A temporary platform is set up on the banks of the Miyagawa River, where members of the Hida Takayama Handheld Fireworks Group hold bamboo tubes filled with fireworks, creating a magnificent display while being showered with sparks. The thunderous sound at the end of the display and the towering flames are truly impressive! It is held every year on August 9th to wish for the purification of both the participants and the spectators.

description:
長岡は、最高のいっぱいに出会えるまちです。長岡ならではの生姜醤油ラーメン、山盛りの枝豆、寺泊の海でとれる大漁のサザエ、ものづくりの技術を活かしたアルミ鋳物のぐい呑み、花火を見ながらの一杯など...。作られるまでの物語や情熱とともに魅力を味わってください。

title: Nagaoka City Hometown CM 'A Town Where You Can Meet the Best of Everything' (30-second version) (Produced in 2022 / Entry for the 3rd Niigata Hometown CM Awards)
description:
Nagaoka is a town where you can meet the best of everything. Enjoy the unique ginger soy sauce ramen, heaping servings of edamame, the abundant sea urchins caught in Teradomari, aluminum cast sake cups made with craftsmanship, and a drink while watching fireworks... Experience the charm along with the stories and passion behind their creation.

Awarded 4th place in the '3rd Niigata Hometown CM Awards'! 
27 cities and towns in the prefecture produced and submitted their hometown pride CM. We received 4th place at the judging session on November 10, 2022 (Thursday).

title: 湯あかり10周年記念動画
description: 黒川温泉の竹害対策として始まった湯あかりは今年（2022年）で10周年。今では南小国町全体に湯あかりが広がり、里山の風景を優しく灯しています。仄かな灯りと自然の風景、そして温泉を楽しみに南小国町に遊びに来ていただけますと幸いです。

title: Yuuakari 10th Anniversary Video
description: Yuuakari, which started as a bamboo damage countermeasure in Kurokawa Onsen, celebrates its 10th anniversary this year (2022). We hope you will come to Minamioguni Town to enjoy the soft lights, natural scenery, and hot springs.

title: A Clear Village of People and Time: Minamioguni (long ver.)
description:
Minamioguni Town, located in Aso District, Kumamoto Prefecture. It is a rural area dotted with many hot springs, including Kurokawa Onsen.
In this rural area, we are introducing the thoughts and efforts of those involved in the tourism industry through video.
We hope you can learn about the charm of Minamioguni Town from the perspective of those who live and work here.

title: KIYORA STYLE2
description:

生きていることを実感できる自然が溢れる南小国町に遊びにいらしてください。

title: KIYORA STYLE2
description:

title: The 22nd Midorikawa Lake Dondo Festival (Drone)
description:
The '22nd Midorikawa Lake Dondo Festival,' which was scheduled to be held on January 10, 2021, was canceled due to the prevention of the spread of the COVID-19 virus. However, the lighting of the yagura, which had been prepared since December, took place on January 14 (Thursday), and we captured the event with a drone. 
We hope that next year, the COVID-19 pandemic will subside, and events can be held as usual...

title: 道の駅 美里「佐俣の湯」　美里町観光PR動画
description:
令和５年度に作成した美里町観光PR動画です。

源泉掛け流し温泉が心と体を癒す道の駅 美里「佐俣の湯」。
道の駅美里「佐俣の湯」は、熊本県の中央部に位置し、九州自動車道松橋ＩＣから延岡方面に向かう国道218号沿いにあります。施設内には、源泉掛け流しの天然温泉施設、地元農家が生産した農産加工品を販売する物産館、地元食材を使ったレストラン、ログハウス風の宿泊施設などを備えています。また、来駅された方に道路情報や観光情報などを提供するために、屋外でも利用可能な公衆無線ＬＡＮ設備と専用のホームページを準備しており、道の駅を起点に町内の観光、グルメなどを楽しんでいただけるようにしています。

title: Michi-no-Eki Misato 'Samata no Yu' Misato Town Tourism PR Video
description:
This is a tourism PR video for Misato Town created in the 5th year of Reiwa.

The natural hot spring with flowing spring water heals both the mind and body at Michi-no-Eki Misato 'Samata no Yu'.
Michi-no-Eki Misato 'Samata no Yu' is located in the central part of Kumamoto Prefecture, along National Route 218 heading towards Nobeoka from the Matsubase IC of the Kyushu Expressway. The facility includes a natural hot spring with flowing spring water, a product hall selling agricultural processed products produced by local farmers, a restaurant using local ingredients, and log cabin-style accommodations. Additionally, to provide visitors with road and tourism information, we have prepared public wireless LAN facilities that can be used outdoors and a dedicated website, allowing visitors to enjoy local tourism and gourmet experiences starting from the Michi-no-Eki.

title: 日本一の石段　3333段　釈迦院御坂遊歩道　美里町観光PR動画
description:
令和５年度に作成した美里町観光PR動画です。

　この石段は、１２００年の歴史を秘めた由緒ある釈迦院（八代市泉町）の表参道である御坂に日本一の石段(美里町）を建設し、世紀の文化遺産として後世に残すとともに町の活性化を図るための観光の目玉づくり、町おこしのシンボルづくりを狙って建設されたものです。
　石段建設は、昭和５５年１月から着手し、昭和６０年１１月には山形県羽黒山の２４４６段を抜いて名実とも日本一の座につき、昭和６３年３月末に完成しました。
　この石段には、全国各地の名石のほか、中国、韓国、インド、旧ソ連、ブラジル、アメリカ、南アフリカなど世界各国の御影石を使用し、国際親善並びに友好の絆を結ぶとともに歴史の探究及び健全な観光レクレーション施設として利用されています。
　また、毎年１１月には、石段を利用して、アタック・ザ・日本一が開催されています。
　早い方は登り終えるまで１時間を切られる方もおられますが、一般の方の場合、上りに２時間、下りに１時間、合計３時間程度とお見込みください。


◇HP　http://misato.town/spot.html?id=68

title: Japan's Best Stone Steps: 3333 Steps at Shaka-in Misaka Walking Path - Misato Town Tourism PR Video
description:
This is a tourism PR video for Misato Town created in the 5th year of the Reiwa era.

These stone steps were constructed on the approach to the historic Shaka-in (Izumi Town, Yatsushiro City), which has a history of 1200 years, aiming to create a tourist attraction and a symbol for revitalizing the town by leaving behind Japan's best stone steps (Misato Town) as a cultural heritage of the century.
The construction of the stone steps began in January 1980, and by November 1985, it surpassed the 2446 steps of Haguro Mountain in Yamagata Prefecture, officially becoming the best in Japan. It was completed by the end of March 1988.
These stone steps utilize granite from famous stones across the country, as well as from countries around the world including China, South Korea, India, the former Soviet Union, Brazil, the United States, and South Africa, fostering international friendship and goodwill, while also serving as a facility for historical exploration and healthy tourism recreation.
Additionally, every November, an event called 'Attack the Best in Japan' is held using the stone steps.
While some individuals can complete the climb in under an hour, for the general public, it is estimated to take about 2 hours to ascend and 1 hour to descend, totaling approximately 3 hours.

◇HP http://misato.town/spot.html?id=68

title: 熊延鉄道遺構　八角トンネル　美里町観光PR動画
description:
令和５年度に作成した美里町観光PR動画です。

大正４年４月に南熊本駅（熊本市）開業、その後、下益城郡砥用（美里町）まで延線して総延長２８．６キロ間を走っていた熊延鉄道の遺構のひとつです。
　昭和３９年に廃線となりましたが、約６０年たった今でも、線路の両側の岩が崩れるのを防ぐために作られた洞門であるこの八角トンネルは、産業遺構として今も多くの観光客を迎えています。
　７基が連なり、間が空いている、落石よけとしては不完全な形になった理由として、建設費削減のためとする説が有力ですが、なぜ八角形なのかなど、形も構造も謎が多い遺構です。
　また、近くには、同じく熊延鉄道の遺構である津留川橋梁の橋脚も残っており、かつての産業発展を支えた「熊延鉄道」の貴重な遺構です。

◇HP　http://misato.town/spot.html?id=73

title: Kumonobu Railway Ruins: Hakkaku Tunnel - Misato Town Tourism PR Video
description:
This is a tourism PR video for Misato Town created in the 5th year of Reiwa.

Opened in April 1915 at Minami Kumamoto Station (Kumamoto City), the Kumonobu Railway extended to Toyo in Shimomashiki District (Misato Town), running a total length of 28.6 kilometers. This is one of the ruins of the Kumonobu Railway.

Although it was abandoned in 1964, even after about 60 years, this Hakkaku Tunnel, which was built to prevent the rocks on both sides of the railway from collapsing, still welcomes many tourists as an industrial heritage site.

There are seven tunnels in a row with gaps in between, and a prevailing theory suggests that the incomplete shape as a rockfall prevention measure was due to cost-cutting during construction. However, the reasons for its octagonal shape and other structural mysteries remain.

Additionally, nearby, the piers of the Tsuru River Bridge, another ruin of the Kumonobu Railway, still remain, representing the valuable heritage of the "Kumonobu Railway" that once supported industrial development.

◇HP http://misato.town/spot.html?id=73

title: 国指定重要文化財　霊台橋　美里町観光PR動画
description:
令和５年度に作成した美里町観光PR動画です。

緑川本流の最大の難所、船津峡に架けられた全長90ｍの巨大な石橋です。江戸時代の石造単一アーチとしては日本最大級の規模を誇っています。種山石工の卯助・宇一・丈八3兄弟が中心となって1847年（弘化4年）に架橋した、国指定重要文化財です。

◇HP　http://misato.town/spot.html?id=80

title: Nationally Designated Important Cultural Property: Reidaibashi Bridge - Misato Town Tourism PR Video
description:
This is a tourism PR video for Misato Town created in the 5th year of Reiwa.

It is a massive stone bridge, 90 meters long, spanning the most difficult section of the Midorikawa River, Funatsu Gorge. It boasts one of the largest scales in Japan as a stone single arch from the Edo period. The bridge was constructed in 1847 (the 4th year of Koka) by the three brothers, Usuke, Uichi, and Joha, from the Taneyama stone masonry family, and is designated as a nationally important cultural property.

title: カンパチロウ物語
description:
カンパチロウ物語とは・・・

　鹿児島県鹿屋（かのや）市（人口10万人）では、特産である「カンパチ」による「まちおこし」がおきている。
　この現象を元に、主人公である半魚人「かのやカンパチロウ」の過去・現在・未来を描いたミュージカルショートフィルムを制作。

＜制作背景＞
　鹿屋市の名産である”かのやカンパチ”は、５年ほど前まで市民を含めて認知度が低く、カンパチの値段も低迷していたことで、かつては栄えた”鹿屋市漁業協同組合”も経営難に苦しんでいた。

　そんな中、危機感を募らせた若手漁師達は、”かのやカンパチ”の知名度向上・販路拡大等を目指し、自らの手で半魚人である”かのやカンパチロウ”を誕生させ、PRを行うことにした。

　ところが、カンパチロウ誕生後もその見た目からか簡単には受け入れてもらえず、もがき苦しむ時期があった。

　しかし、漁師を始め、仲間たちと共に、カンパチソング・カンパチダンスを開発し、鹿児島県内外によるカンパチのPRと併せてひたむきに踊り続けた。

　その結果、理解してくれる仲間が少しづつ増え、認めて応援してくれるマチの人が増え、カンパチロウ・カンパチダンスは鹿屋全体に認知されるほどになった。

　このような鹿屋市漁協青年部を中心としたPR活動が功を奏し”かのやカンパチ”の知名度の上昇・国内における販路拡大に繋がったことで、漁協も経営難から抜け出し現在は軌道にのりつつある。

　また、鹿屋市漁協の市民を巻き込んだ一連のPR活動は内閣総理大臣表彰を受賞。

　現在、鹿屋市では「カンパチソング」「カンパチダンス」はほとんどの保育園や小学校の運動会や文化祭等をはじめ、忘年会での余興や式典、かのや夏祭りでも正式な踊りとして踊られる等、一つの文化になっている。

　さらに、漁協も国内のみならず国外に向け”かのやカンパチ”を積極的にPRしていこうとしている・・・。

＜参考記事：キレキレに踊る、ゆるキャラでPR。地元の危機に立ち上がった若き漁師たち＞

title: The Story of Kanpachirou
description:
The Story of Kanpachirou is about...

In Kanoya City, Kagoshima Prefecture (population 100,000), a revitalization effort is underway centered around the local specialty, "Kanpachi."
Based on this phenomenon, a musical short film depicting the past, present, and future of the protagonist, a half-fish man named "Kanoya Kanpachirou," has been produced.

<Production Background>
The local specialty, "Kanoya Kanpachi," had low recognition among citizens until about five years ago, and the price of Kanpachi was also stagnant, causing the once-thriving "Kanoya City Fisheries Cooperative" to struggle financially.

Amidst this, young fishermen, feeling a sense of crisis, aimed to raise awareness and expand sales channels for "Kanoya Kanpachi" by creating their own half-fish man, "Kanoya Kanpachirou," and conducting PR activities.

However, even after the birth of Kanpachirou, he was not easily accepted due to his appearance, leading to a period of struggle.

Nevertheless, together with fellow fishermen, they developed the Kanpachi song and Kanpachi dance, and diligently continued to dance while promoting Kanpachi both within and outside Kagoshima Prefecture.

As a result, the number of friends who understood them gradually increased, and more people in the community began to recognize and support Kanpachirou and the Kanpachi dance, leading to widespread recognition throughout Kanoya.

The PR activities led by the Kanoya City Fisheries Cooperative Youth Division proved successful, resulting in increased awareness of "Kanoya Kanpachi" and expanded sales channels domestically, allowing the cooperative to recover from its financial difficulties and get back on track.

Additionally, the series of PR activities involving the citizens of Kanoya City received an award from the Prime Minister of Japan.

Currently, in Kanoya City, the "Kanpachi Song" and "Kanpachi Dance" are performed at most kindergartens and elementary schools during sports festivals and cultural events, as well as at year-end parties and ceremonies, becoming a part of the local culture.

Furthermore, the fisheries cooperative is actively promoting "Kanoya Kanpachi" not only domestically but also internationally...

title: Sky Music Knock on Wood Fingers
description:
The live event "Sky Music" has been held at the top of Mount Yashima in Takamatsu City, Kagawa Prefecture since 2012. This year marks its 10th anniversary, and we have produced a video featuring the beautiful guitar of Hirokazu Ogura. This video completely captures the finger techniques of "Knock on Wood." A must-see for guitar lovers.
Directed by Hiroyuki Nakano, this video is a version that captures the music of Hirokazu Ogura and the atmosphere of the mountaintop. We hope you can immerse yourself in this special time that can only be experienced here!
Organizer: Yashima Mount Top Live Event Executive Committee
Planning and Production: Music on the Street @ Kagawa (MUSIC BLUE)
Cooperation: Yashimaji Temple, Yashima Mount Top Tourism Association
Director: Hiroyuki Nakano
Music: Hirokazu Ogura

Hiroyuki Nakano
Filmmaker, Film Director, Director
Born in 1958 in Fukuyama City, Hiroshima Prefecture. Graduated from Fukuyama Seiko High School and Waseda University, Faculty of Commerce. After working at Yomiuri Television, he established Tyrell Corporation, producing visual art and music videos, directing numerous MVs for music artists in Japan and around the world. In 1993, he established Peace Delic, directing many contents that make viewers happy. His activities span a wide range, including film, advertising, web videos, signage, and event direction.
In 1998, he won the Grand Prix at the Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival in South Korea for the film "SF SAMURAI FICTION." In 2006, he won the Young Critics Award at the Cannes International Film Festival's Critics' Week for the short film "Iron." In 2015, he won the Grand Prix at the Okinawa Children's Film Festival for "Flying Bodies." In 2018, he released the film "Peace Nippon," depicting the beautiful landscapes and spiritual history of Japan captured over eight years. He is currently continuing the Peace Nippon Project to convey Japan's future.

Commercials: Suntory, Sumitomo Life, Pioneer, TOYOTA, Takeda Pharmaceutical, Mitsubishi Motors, POLA, Meiji Seika, KOSE, Yakult, Seven & I, Hitachi, etc.

Films: Directed "SF SAMURAI FICTION," Scripted and Directed "SF Stereo Future," Produced, Scripted, and Directed "SF Short Films," Directed "Red Shadow Akakage," Produced, Scripted, and Directed the short film collection "Men's Poetry," Directed "TAJOMARU," Directed "FLYING BODIES" (a documentary film about Aomori University Men's Rhythmic Gymnastics planned by Issey Miyake), Directed "FOOL COOL ROCK / ONE OK ROCK DOCUMENTARY FILM" (a documentary film about the rock band ONE OK ROCK).

description:
The live event 'Tenku Music' has been held at the top of Yashima Mountain in Takamatsu City, Kagawa Prefecture since 2012. This year marks the 10th anniversary, and we have produced a video featuring the beautiful guitar of Hirokazu Ogura. The director is Hiroyuki Nakano. Enjoy this year's sound that intertwines the past and the future. 
Organizer: Yashima Mountain Live Event Executive Committee 
Planning and Production: Music in the Streets @ Kagawa (MUSIC BLUE) 
Cooperation: Yashimaji Temple, Yashima Mountain Tourism Association 
Director: Hiroyuki Nakano 
Music: Hirokazu Ogura 
Drone: Shigeru Ohno 

Hiroyuki Nakano 
Video creator, film director, and producer 
Born in 1958 in Fukuyama City, Hiroshima Prefecture. Graduated from Fukuyama Seiryu High School and Waseda University, Faculty of Commerce. After working at Yomiuri Television, he established Tyrell Corporation, producing visual art and music videos, directing numerous MVs for music artists in Japan and around the world. In 1993, he established Peace Delic, directing many contents that make viewers happy. His activities span a wide range, including film, advertising, web videos, signage, and event direction. 
In 1998, he won the Grand Prix at the Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival in South Korea for the film 'SF SAMURAI FICTION.' In 2006, he won the Young Critics Award at the Cannes International Film Festival's Critics' Week for the short film 'Iron.' In 2015, he won the Grand Prix at the Okinawa Children's Film Festival for 'Flying Bodies.' In 2018, he released the film 'Peace Nippon,' depicting the beautiful landscapes and spiritual history of Japan captured over eight years. He is currently continuing the Peace Nippon Project to convey Japan to the future. 
MVs: Tomoyasu Hotei, Miki Imai, Mr.Children, GLAY, AKB48, SKE48, STU48, etc. 
CMs: Suntory, Sumitomo Life, Pioneer, TOYOTA, Takeda Pharmaceutical, Mitsubishi Motors, POLA, Meiji Seika, KOSE, Yakult, Seven & I, Hitachi, etc. 
Signage: Currently screening at Kyoto Station Kyoto Premium Vision and Nagano Toyota Panorama Vision. 
Web: Hamamatsu City PR, Fukuyama City PR, WABARA, etc. 
Events: Kyoto Fashion Cantata 2007-2014 planning and direction, Tokyo Motor Show AUDI booth direction, ISSEY MIYAKE 3D collection direction. 
Films: Directed 'SF SAMURAI FICTION,' script and direction for 'SF Stereo Future,' production, script, and direction for 'SF Short Films,' directed 'Red Shadow Akakage,' produced, scripted, and directed the short film collection 'Poems of Men,' directed 'TAJOMARU,' directed 'FLYING BODIES,' a documentary film on Aomori University Men's Rhythmic Gymnastics planned by Issey Miyake, and 'FOOL COOL ROCK / ONE OK ROCK DOCUMENTARY FILM,' a documentary film on the rock band One OK Rock. 
-- 
Hirokazu Ogura 
(Guitarist, songwriter, arranger) 
Involved in numerous Japanese music works, including Keisuke Kuwata, Southern All Stars, Masaharu Fukuyama, Ryoko Moriyama, Taeko Onuki, Noriyuki Makihara, JUJU, Bank Band, and kokua. Formed the guitar instrumental duo Yamagen, releasing five albums. In 2014, released the solo album 'GOLDEN TIME,' in 2016 'Summer Guitars,' and in 2019 'Sketch Song' and 'Sketch Song 2.' His high technique, wide musicality, and heartfelt music & guitar play are supported across genres. He serves as a radio DJ for FM COCOLO's MARTIN CLUB JAPAN Presents 'Hirokazu Ogura's FRIDAY, Sound of Strings.' He is from Takamatsu City (Tourism Ambassador of Takamatsu City).

When I lived in the city, I lived by 'cutting corners.'

Since coming to Kumano, our values have changed.

description:
The daily life of a couple who moved from the city to the countryside.

A town where the majestic Pacific Ocean meets the mysterious Kii Mountains.
A town in Mie Prefecture, Mihama, where mandarins are harvested year-round.
The southern part of Mie Prefecture, where Mihama is located, is called the Eastern Kishu region,
and is known for its production of Satsuma mandarins.
When the mandarin flowers bloom, the Satsuma mandarin trees here, prepared for summer,
produce delicious fruit after overcoming the rainy season and surviving the summer heat in autumn.
I believe the love these people have for mandarins makes the mandarins of Eastern Kishu so delicious. I can’t wait for the early September Satsuma mandarins.

description:
※冒頭字幕は熊野川ではなく、北山川の間違いでした。

田舎の日常を旅する。
今日は休み。
いつもお世話になっている友人からキャンプへのお誘いがあり、
夕食にちゃっかりお邪魔。
自宅から車で30分の場所にこんな自然があるのことにいつも幸せを感じる。夕食だけだったが、非常に楽しく、ゆっくり出来たので、

三重県御浜町について、詳しくは下記Webサイトをご覧下さい↓
https://mihama-mie-townpromotion.jp/

熊野にある町、三重県御浜町

よみがえりの地、熊野

熊野は「よみがえりの地」と言われてきました。古来より日本では、人々が生活を営む里に対し、山は神や祖先の霊が宿る神聖な場所である、という考え方があります。中でも熊野は神々が籠る深山の霊場であり、訪れた方は心魂が甦り、新たな気持ちになります。
「人生、出発たびだちの地」
と言われる所以です。また、有史以前から続く自然信仰、熊野修験に代表される山岳宗教、そして神＝仏であるとする神仏習合の信仰形態が相まり、日本固有の宗教観を育む土壌ともなりました。

熊野本宮大社ホームページより引用

About Kumano

“Kumano is a feeling - not a form - a manifestation of the Divine Intangibles, a celebration of life's powerful vitality.
It is a peaceful place in nature to take a moment to reflect on, and reaffirm one's future direction and meaning of life - a sacred space to open one's mind, heart soul ; all of one's senses; and let the artificial boundaries and borders of the modern world  disappear - allowing us to contemplate life as one unified humanity on planet earth.
The importance of a pilgrimage to Kumano is not in its completion, but rather what you take home after internalizing your experience” (Kumano Kodo, 2019).

今年1月から移住場所探しを始め、コロナで外出制限がかかるギリギリの3月に三重県御浜町を含め、和歌山、東紀州エリアを運良く訪問することができました。ただし、その後は現地訪問が出来ない状態が続き、他の場所のリサーチに行くことが出来なくなったこともあり、
運命的な出会いであった御浜町に移住を決断しました。約半年で決めた移住。

title: [Camping] Solo Camping at Kumano River | Recommended Campsite | Kumano | Rural Relocation | Sustainable
description:
※The opening subtitle mistakenly referred to Kumano River instead of Kitayama River.

Traveling through rural daily life.
Today is a day off.
I received an invitation to camp from a friend who has always been supportive, and I casually joined them for dinner.
I always feel happy knowing that such nature is just a 30-minute drive from my home. Although it was just dinner, it was very enjoyable and relaxing, so we decided to have our own camping experience, making it a relaxing night.

For more information about Mihama Town in Mie Prefecture, please visit the website below:
https://mihama-mie-townpromotion.jp/

The town of Kumano, Mihama Town in Mie Prefecture

The Land of Resurrection, Kumano

Kumano has been referred to as the "Land of Resurrection." Since ancient times in Japan, there has been a belief that mountains are sacred places where the spirits of gods and ancestors reside, in contrast to the villages where people live. Among them, Kumano is a spiritual site in the deep mountains where deities dwell, and those who visit find their spirits revived and their hearts renewed. This is why it is said to be the "land of life's new beginnings." Additionally, the natural faith that has continued since before recorded history, the mountain religion represented by Kumano Shugendo, and the syncretic belief that gods and Buddhas are one have all contributed to the nurturing of a unique Japanese religious perspective.

Quoted from the Kumano Hongu Taisha website

About Kumano

"Kumano is a feeling - not a form - a manifestation of the Divine Intangibles, a celebration of life's powerful vitality.
It is a peaceful place in nature to take a moment to reflect on, and reaffirm one's future direction and meaning of life - a sacred space to open one's mind, heart, soul; all of one's senses; and let the artificial boundaries and borders of the modern world disappear - allowing us to contemplate life as one unified humanity on planet earth.
The importance of a pilgrimage to Kumano is not in its completion, but rather what you take home after internalizing your experience" (Kumano Kodo, 2019).

Since January of this year, I began searching for a place to relocate, and I was fortunate to visit Mie Prefecture's Mihama Town, as well as the Wakayama and Higashi-Kishu areas, just before the COVID-19 restrictions on outings in March. However, after that, I was unable to visit the area, and I couldn't research other places, which led me to make the fateful decision to relocate to Mihama Town. I decided to relocate within about six months.
It took courage to decide to move to Mihama Town, a place with no connections or ties, especially since I had only visited for a few hours in March. However, I thought that if I continued searching, it would take years to relocate, so I believe I was able to make a bold decision.

三重県御浜町

紀伊半島、本州ほぼ最南端の太平洋沿いの町。
太平洋の海岸沿いには、約22kmに渡る七里御浜。
それは、古くから庶民に愛された祈りの路、世界遺産「熊野古道伊勢路」。
黒潮と温暖な気候のおかげで一年中、様々なみかんがとれる。

Mihama Town, Mie Prefecture

A town along the Pacific coast at the southernmost tip of Honshu, on the Kii Peninsula.
Along the Pacific coastline stretches the 22 km long Shichiri Mihama.
It is a path of prayer loved by the common people since ancient times, the World Heritage Site 'Kumano Kodo Iseji'.
Thanks to the Kuroshio Current and a warm climate, various mandarins can be harvested throughout the year.
With the mystical Kii Mountains and the majestic Pacific Ocean,
the town where the blue mountains meet the blue sea.

Cooking rice in a kamado and preparing a pot and sweetfish over an irori.

This is why it is said, "Life is the land of departure."

The land of resurrection, Kumano
A town where mandarins are harvested year-round, Mihama Town, Mie Prefecture.

A town along the Pacific Ocean at the southernmost tip of the Kii Peninsula, Honshu.
Along the Pacific coastline lies the 22 km stretch of Shichiri Mihama.
This has long been a beloved path of prayer for the common people, the World Heritage Site "Kumano Kodo Iseji."
Thanks to the Kuroshio Current and a mild climate, various mandarins can be harvested year-round.
With the mystical Kii Mountains and the majestic Pacific Ocean,
it is a town where mountains and sea intersect.

Kumano has been called the "land of resurrection." Since ancient times in Japan, there has been a belief that mountains are sacred places where the spirits of gods and ancestors reside, in contrast to the villages where people live. Among them, Kumano is a sacred site of deep mountains where deities dwell, and those who visit find their spirits revived and their hearts renewed.

This is why it is said, "Life, the land of new beginnings."
Additionally, the natural faith that has continued since prehistoric times, the mountain religion represented by Kumano Shugendo, and the belief system that sees gods as Buddhas have combined to create a fertile ground for Japan's unique religious perspective.

description:
田舎の日常を旅する。

自分の日常をひと休みして、他人の日常にお邪魔する。
それが旅だと思う。
そんな誰かの日常をのぞくことが、自分の日常を一番変えるのかもしれない。

♯13 七十三歳のシンデレラ
https://youtu.be/sbZj1yTbW18

地方移住、田舎暮らしを通じて、また、このコロナ禍で、今までになかった旅の形や暮らしの形を考えるようになった。
コロナになり、旅自体が難しくなった中で、自分のそばにある、自分の日常とは違う、他人の日常を体験することが楽しい。
最近はふと考える。

これもひとつの旅の形なのだと。

今日は、以前にも登場した、三重県御浜町尾呂志地区に佇む、尾呂志庵の七十三歳のシンデレラのサステナブルな暮らしにお邪魔する。
竃でご飯を炊き、囲炉裏で鍋と鮎を料理する。
夕食の後は五右衛門風呂で疲れをとり、畳の上で寝る。
理想の田舎暮らしを存分に体験した日本昔話のような一日。

よみがえりの地、熊野
年中みかんのとれる町、三重県御浜町

太平洋の海岸沿いには、約22kmに渡る七里御浜。
それは、古くから庶民に愛された祈りの路、世界遺産「熊野古道伊勢路」。
黒潮と温暖な気候のおかげで一年中、様々なみかんがとれる。
神秘的な紀伊山地と雄大な太平洋を有し、
山と海が交差する町。

熊野は「よみがえりの地」と言われてきました。古来より日本では、人々が生活を営む里に対し、山は神や祖先の霊が宿る神聖な場所である、という考え方があります。中でも熊野は神々が籠る深山の霊場であり、訪れた方は心魂が甦り、新たな気持ちになります。

description:

The Land of Resurrection, Kumano
A town in Kumano, Mihama Town, Mie Prefecture

Kumano has been referred to as the "Land of Resurrection." Since ancient times in Japan, there has been a belief that while the villages where people live are ordinary, the mountains are sacred places where gods and ancestral spirits reside. Among them, Kumano is a spiritual site where deities dwell, and those who visit find their spirits revived and their hearts renewed.
This is why it is said to be "the land of life's new beginnings."
Additionally, the long-standing nature worship, mountain religions represented by Kumano Shugendo, and the syncretic belief that gods and Buddhas are one have fostered a unique religious perspective in Japan.

Quoted from the Kumano Hongu Taisha website
About Kumano

"Kumano is a feeling - not a form - a manifestation of the Divine Intangibles, a celebration of life's powerful vitality.
It is a peaceful place in nature to take a moment to reflect on, and reaffirm one's future direction and meaning of life - a sacred space to open one's mind, heart, soul; all of one's senses; and let the artificial boundaries and borders of the modern world disappear - allowing us to contemplate life as one unified humanity on planet earth.
The importance of a pilgrimage to Kumano is not in its completion, but rather what you take home after internalizing your experience" (Kumano Kodo, 2019).

I started searching for a relocation place in January this year, and fortunately visited Mie Prefecture, including Mihama Town, and the Wakayama and Higashi-Kishu areas just before the COVID-19 restrictions in March. I made the decision to relocate within about six months. It took courage to decide to move to a town with no connections or ties, especially since I had only visited for a few hours in March, but I felt that if I continued searching, it would take years to relocate, so I was able to take the plunge.
