title: 伊勢と奈良、神話からの古代の道
description:
伊勢と奈良、神話からの古代の道

日本の起源の地、神話の時代から。日本の神道の頂点である伊勢神宮、相撲、酒、修験道、巨大な古代の墳墓など。これは、今日の政治と文化の起源を感じることができる道です。「古代日本」を体験してください。

伊勢と奈良の地域は、精神性の道を導き、日本の神秘主義の起源へと至ります。

関西の中心に位置する奈良は、日本で最も古い仏教寺院や神社で世界的に有名です。それらは、シカが生息する森林公園の中心にある緑豊かな草原に位置しています。8世紀の古代首都は、日本の政治と宗教の中心でした。奈良の計り知れない芸術的な富は、今なお彼女を精神性の大きな中心にしています。近くには、法隆寺の五重塔があり、世界最古の木造建築とされています。

聖なる土地は、神聖な山々であふれる紀伊半島まで広がっています。そこでは、百年の杉の深い森の中で、神々がほぼ二千年にわたり崇拝されてきました。伊勢神宮は、日本で最も神聖で崇敬される場所の一つです。日本人はそれを「日本の魂の揺りかご」と考えています。

寺院周辺の精神性と修験道の修行に加えて、伊勢と奈良の地域は、相撲や酒の蒸留などの古代の伝統を育んでいます。海側では、紀伊半島の沿岸で、真珠、貝、魚、甲殻類を求めてシュノーケリングをする女性たち、あま文化が生まれました。半島とその沿岸は、日本の最も古い伝統に抱かれ、集団的な想像力にとって最も印象的なものです。

title: ISE and NARA,Ancient paths from mythology
description:
ISE and NARA,Ancient paths from mythology

The place of origin of Japan since mythical times. Ise Jingu, the pinnacle of Japanese Shintoism, Sumo, Sake, Shugendo, giant ancient tombs, etc. This is the path where you can feel the origin of today's politics and culture.Experience the "ancient Japan"

The region of Ise and Nara leads on the paths of spirituality, to the origins of Japanese mysticism.

In the heart of Kansai, Nara is world famous for its Buddhist temples and Shinto shrines, some of the oldest in Japan. They are set on lush meadows, in the heart of a wooded park populated by Sika deer. The ancient capital of the 8th century was the political and religious center of Japan. Nara's inestimable artistic wealth still makes her a great center of spirituality. Nearby, the 5-story pagoda of Hōryū-ji Buddhist temple is considered the oldest wooden building in the world.

The sacred lands extend to the Kii Peninsula, which is teeming with sacred mountains. There, in deep forests of hundred-year-old cedars, the kami have been revered for nearly two millennia. Ise-jingu (Ise Shrine) is one of the holiest and most revered sites in Japan. The Japanese consider it to be a “cradle of the Japanese soul.

In addition to the spirituality and ascetic practice of shugendō around the temples, the region of Ise and Nara cultivates ancient traditions, foremost among them sumo and the distillation of sake. On the sea side, the coasts of the Kii peninsula have seen the emergence of the culture of the ama, these women who snorkel in search of pearls, shellfish, fish and crustaceans. The peninsula and its coasts are cradled by the oldest traditions of Japan, and the most striking for the collective imagination.

title: ショート【日本語】Royal Food of Japan 御食国　～歴史に愛された美味がある。～

title: 伊勢と奈良、神話からの古代の道
description:
伊勢と奈良、神話からの古代の道

日本の起源の地、神話の時代から。日本の神道の頂点である伊勢神宮、相撲、日本酒、修験道、巨大な古代の墳墓など。これは、今日の政治と文化の起源を感じることができる道です。「古代日本」を体験してください。

伊勢と奈良の地域は、精神性の道を導き、日本の神秘主義の起源へと至ります。

関西の中心に位置する奈良は、日本で最も古い仏教寺院や神社で世界的に有名です。これらは、シカが生息する森林公園の中心にある緑豊かな草原に位置しています。8世紀の古代首都は、日本の政治と宗教の中心でした。奈良の計り知れない芸術的な富は、今なお彼女を精神性の大きな中心にしています。近くには、法隆寺の五重塔があり、世界で最も古い木造建築とされています。

聖なる土地は、神聖な山々であふれる紀伊半島まで広がっています。そこでは、百年の杉の深い森の中で、神々がほぼ二千年にわたり崇拝されてきました。伊勢神宮は、日本で最も神聖で崇敬される場所の一つです。日本人はこれを「日本の魂の揺りかご」と考えています。

寺院周辺の修験道の精神性と禁欲的な実践に加えて、伊勢と奈良の地域は、相撲や日本酒の蒸留など、古代の伝統を育んでいます。海側では、紀伊半島の海岸で、真珠や貝、魚、甲殻類を求めてシュノーケリングをする女性たち、あま文化が生まれました。半島とその海岸は、日本の最も古い伝統に抱かれ、集団的な想像力にとって最も印象的なものとなっています。

title: ISE and NARA,Ancient paths from mythology
description:
ISE and NARA,Ancient paths from mythology

The place of origin of Japan since mythical times. Ise Jingu, the pinnacle of Japanese Shintoism, Sumo, Sake, Shugendo, giant ancient tombs, etc. This is the path where you can feel the origin of today's politics and culture.Experience the "ancient Japan"

The region of Ise and Nara leads on the paths of spirituality, to the origins of Japanese mysticism.

In the heart of Kansai, Nara is world famous for its Buddhist temples and Shinto shrines, some of the oldest in Japan. They are set on lush meadows, in the heart of a wooded park populated by Sika deer. The ancient capital of the 8th century was the political and religious center of Japan. Nara's inestimable artistic wealth still makes her a great center of spirituality. Nearby, the 5-story pagoda of Hōryū-ji Buddhist temple is considered the oldest wooden building in the world.

The sacred lands extend to the Kii Peninsula, which is teeming with sacred mountains. There, in deep forests of hundred-year-old cedars, the kami have been revered for nearly two millennia. Ise-jingu (Ise Shrine) is one of the holiest and most revered sites in Japan. The Japanese consider it to be a “cradle of the Japanese soul.

In addition to the spirituality and ascetic practice of shugendō around the temples, the region of Ise and Nara cultivates ancient traditions, foremost among them sumo and the distillation of sake. On the sea side, the coasts of the Kii peninsula have seen the emergence of the culture of the ama, these women who snorkel in search of pearls, shellfish, fish and crustaceans. The peninsula and its coasts are cradled by the oldest traditions of Japan, and the most striking for the collective imagination.

title: 雪国のECO LODGES JAPAN - 100年後も雪国があることを確保する
description:
雪国のECO LODGES JAPAN
https://ecolodge.yukigunijapan.com/

雪国 - 雪によって形作られた生活
https://yukigunijapan.com/

エコロッジとして知られる宿泊施設は、世界中に存在する小規模で高品質な施設であり、通常は「環境保護」、「地域社会への貢献」、および「本物の自然と文化との交流」を重視しています。おそらく、各地域の特性を取り入れたさまざまなスタイルのエコロッジが世界中に存在すると言えるでしょう。

私たちの雪国地域には、他の地域では見られない環境があり、地元の自然と密接に結びついたエコロッジがあります。これらのエコロッジは、地域社会に利益をもたらすだけでなく、地元の自然と文化を次の世代に引き継ぐことを望んでいます。

100年後にも雪国が存在することを確保することを目指し、「雪と水の保護」や「雪国特有の料理や地域産業の継続」といった約40の要件を定め、エコロッジを評価します。各宿泊施設がこれらの要件にどのように適合しているかを見ることで、社会的影響を把握し、将来の改善点を明らかにすることができます。

title: ECO LODGES JAPAN in YUKIGUNI - Ensuring there is a Snow Country 100 years from now
description:
ECO LODGES JAPAN in YUKIGUNI
https://ecolodge.yukigunijapan.com/

YUKIGUNI - Lives shaped by snow
https://yukigunijapan.com/

Accommodations known as eco-lodges tend to be small, high quality facilities that exist all over the world that usually have a high regard for “environmental conservation”, “contribution to the local community”, and “interaction with genuine nature and culture”. It is probably fair to say that there are various styles of eco-lodges across the globe that each incorporate the special characteristics of their own region.

In our Yukiguni region, with its environment that can’t be found in other parts of the world, there are eco-lodges that are closely entwined with the local nature. Each of these eco-lodges shares the desire to not only be a benefit to the community, but also to pass on the local nature and culture to the next generation.

With the aim of ensuring that there is still a Snow Country in 100 years we have stated around forty requirements on which the eco-lodges are to be graded that encompass “the protection of snow and water”, and “the continuation of cuisine and local industries that are typical to Snow Country.” By seeing how each accommodation measures up to these requirements we will be able to see their social impact as well as highlight areas for future improvements.

title: A Treasure Trove of Cultural Heritage! 4 Recommended Filming Locations in Shiga!
description:
Shiga Prefecture ranks 4th in the nation for the number of important cultural properties, making it one of Japan's leading prefectures in terms of cultural heritage. Various historical and cultural assets rooted in the region are scattered throughout the area. title: 【東北・青森】秋旅「山彩る　弘前」
description:
秋の弘前市は、紅葉が広がる岩木山や一面が赤く染まるりんご畑、桜の紅葉が楽しめる弘前城菊と紅葉まつりなど、市内各所で秋を感じることができます。
中でもりんごは、生産量日本一を誇り、全国の約20％が弘前市産りんごです。
ぜひ、秋の弘前市をご堪能ください。

title: [Tohoku/Aomori] Autumn Trip 'Colorful Mountains in Hirosaki'
description:
In autumn, Hirosaki City offers the beauty of the colorful leaves on Mount Iwaki, apple orchards painted in red, and the Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival, where you can enjoy the autumn scenery throughout the city.
Among them, apples are a point of pride, with Hirosaki City producing about 20% of Japan's total apple production.
Please enjoy the autumn in Hirosaki City.

title: 【東北・青森】春旅「風光る　弘前」（春編）
description:
弘前市の春は、弘前公園のさくらはもちろん、真っ白なりんごの花が畑一面に咲き誇る、とても華やかな季節となります。
食事をしながら津軽三味線の音色を楽しんだり、明治・大正の洋風建築を巡ったり、弘前れんが倉庫美術館で現代アートが楽しめたり…
ぜひ、弘前の春を動画でお楽しみください。

title: [Tohoku/Aomori] Spring Trip 'Kaze Hikaru Hirosaki' (Spring Edition)
description:
Spring in Hirosaki City is a very vibrant season, with not only the cherry blossoms in Hirosaki Park but also the pure white apple blossoms blooming across the fields.
You can enjoy the sounds of Tsugaru shamisen while dining, explore Western-style architecture from the Meiji and Taisho eras, and appreciate contemporary art at the Hirosaki Brick Warehouse Museum...
Please enjoy the spring of Hirosaki through our video.

description:
The Niyodo River, known as the "Miraculous Clear Stream," is a first-class river flowing from the highest peak in western Japan, Mount Ishizuchi, to the Pacific Ocean.
It is said to have the best water quality in Japan, and its beautiful water color is referred to as Niyodo Blue.
This area features breathtaking gorges, mystical forests, and the lives of people living in the mountain villages, showcasing Japan's original landscapes.

title: 【夏篇】下北ゆかい村 PR動画（青森県風間浦村）
description:
下北ゆかい村公式HP
http://www.yukaimura.com/

幾百年ものあいだ湯治場として親しまれてきた下風呂温泉。津軽海峡を望む本州の北端をめぐる旅情。硫黄のにおいに包まれながら湯の街を歩き、海の幸に舌鼓を打つ。「湯」と「海」で、身も心も解きほぐす「ゆかい村」。また食べたくなる新鮮な海の幸、また会いたくなる温かな人、また行きたくなる心のふるさと。

そんな「ゆかい」の村、風間浦村があなたを待っています。

title: [Summer Edition] Shimokita Yukai Village PR Video (Kazamaura, Aomori Prefecture)
description:
Official website of Shimokita Yukai Village
http://www.yukaimura.com/

For hundreds of years, Shimoburo Onsen has been cherished as a hot spring resort. A journey around the northern tip of Honshu, overlooking the Tsugaru Strait. Walking through the hot spring town enveloped in the scent of sulfur, indulging in the flavors of the sea. A 'yukai village' that relaxes both body and mind with 'hot springs' and 'the sea.' Fresh seafood that makes you want to eat again, warm people you want to meet again, a heartfelt hometown you want to visit again.

Such a 'yukai' village, Kazamaura Village, is waiting for you.

title: 【鳥羽水族館🐠飼育係「森滝さん」イチ推しの「へんな生きもの」に会いに行こう🪼！】
description:
今年、開館70週年を迎えた鳥羽水族館。

日本で唯一飼育されているラッコやジュゴン、アシカやセイウチのショーが大人気✨️！でも、鳥羽水族館の魅力はそれだけではありません🙅

実は…
飼育種類数「日本一」を誇る水族館なんです🦭🐧🌊

飼育係の森滝さんに、数あるエリアの中から、最もディープな「へんな生きもの研究所」を案内いただき、鳥羽水族館の奥深い世界をのぞいてみましょう！

#鳥羽水族館 #へんな生きもの研究所 #観光三重 #kankomie

title: Let's Go Meet the 'Weird Creatures' Recommended by Toba Aquarium's Caretaker, Mr. Moritaki! 🪼
description:
This year marks the 70th anniversary of Toba Aquarium.

The shows featuring the only sea otters, dugongs, sea lions, and walruses in Japan are extremely popular! ✨️ But the charm of Toba Aquarium doesn't stop there. 🙅

In fact...
It's an aquarium that boasts the highest number of species in Japan! 🦭🐧🌊

Let's have Mr. Moritaki, the caretaker, guide us through the most profound area, the 'Weird Creatures Research Institute,' and take a peek into the deep world of Toba Aquarium!

#TobaAquarium #WeirdCreaturesResearchInstitute #TourismMie #kankomie

title: 【魅惑のお花リレー🌼この春行きたいNo.1スポットをご紹介✨】
description:
行ってみたいと思ったら「🌷」、
今年はもう見たという人は「👍」と
コメント欄で教えてください！

今回は魅惑のお花リレー、
春行きたいNo.1を紹介しました🦋

2月ごろの梅に始まり、桜、
チューリップ、ネモフィラ…と
春のお花リレーが続くなばなの里。

4月5日現在、チューリップが
見ごろの最盛期を迎えていました！

今なら満開のソメイヨシノとの
競演も楽しめますよ！

チューリップの見頃は4月中旬ごろまで✨
今だけの絶景をぜひお見逃しなく‼︎

また、次のお花リレー走者、
ネモフィラの開花も
チューリップの隙間から
少しずつ始まってきています！

色とりどりのチューリップ畑が

title: 【Charming Flower Relay 🌼 Introducing the No.1 Spot to Visit This Spring✨】
description:
If you want to go, please comment "🌷", 
If you've already seen it this year, let us know with "👍" in the comments!

This time, we introduced the charming flower relay, 
No.1 spot to visit this spring 🦋

Starting with plum blossoms around February, followed by cherry blossoms, 
tulips, and nemophila... the spring flower relay continues at Nabana no Sato.

As of April 5th, the tulips were 
at their peak bloom!

You can also enjoy the beautiful sight of the fully bloomed Somei Yoshino in competition with the tulips right now!

The best time to see tulips is until mid-April✨
Don't miss out on this breathtaking view‼︎

Additionally, the next flower relay runner, 
the blooming of nemophila, has started 
slowly peeking through the tulips!

The colorful tulip fields will soon transform into a sea of nemophila blue... 
Please look forward to this magical change✨

・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・

Nabana no Sato "Tulip Festival"

▶ Event Period
　From mid-March to mid-April

▶ Blooming Information as of April 5th (Saturday)
　In full bloom

title: 【みえのイマココ旅】伝統工芸“組子”の行灯づくりと匠と行く！伊賀まち歩き
description:
#みえのイマココ旅

伊賀の匠「馬場建具店」
伝統工芸“組子”の行灯づくりと
匠と行く！伊賀まち歩き

〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜

【内容】
1級木製建具製作技能士などの資格を持つ三重県を代表する匠「馬場建具店」店主の馬場幸次さんによるワークショップ！
💡釘やビスなどの金属を使わずに組み立てていく日本の木工技術「組子」に触れる体験です。
💡網目のような模様の「ねじり組子」作品「みえの木製品コンテスト2023」の家具・インテリア部門で優秀賞を獲得した行灯「木漏れ灯（こもれび）」を作ります。
💡国の登録有形文化財（建造物）に指定されている伊賀市上野忍町の武家屋敷「赤井家住宅」が会場です。
💡匠の技に触れる体験と軽快なトークが魅力！
💡作品完成までの1時間、伊賀を知り尽くした匠の案内でまち歩きに出掛けます。
💡忍者体験や伊賀グルメ、お土産など、伊賀をまるごと楽しむことができます。

【料金】
おひとり¥19,800～

【集合場所】
武家屋敷 赤井家住宅
〒518-0854　三重県伊賀市上野忍町2491-1

title: [Mie no Imakoko Tabi] Traditional Craft 'Kumiko' Lantern Making and Walking in Iga with a Craftsman!
description:
#Mie no Imakoko Tabi

Iga's Craftsman 'Baba Joinery'
Traditional Craft 'Kumiko' Lantern Making and
Walking in Iga with a Craftsman!

〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜

[Content]
A workshop by Koji Baba, the owner of 'Baba Joinery', a representative craftsman of Mie Prefecture with qualifications such as a first-class wooden joinery craftsman!
💡 An experience to touch on Japan's woodworking technique 'Kumiko', which is assembled without using metal such as nails or screws.
💡 You will create a lantern called 'Komorebi', which won the Excellence Award in the furniture and interior category of the 'Mie Wooden Products Contest 2023', featuring a pattern like a mesh called 'Twisted Kumiko'.
💡 The venue is the Akai Family Residence, a samurai house in Ueno Shinobucho, Iga City, designated as a national registered tangible cultural property (building).
💡 An experience to touch the craftsman's skills and enjoy lively talks!
💡 For one hour until the completion of the work, you will go for a walk in the town guided by a craftsman who knows Iga inside and out.
💡 You can fully enjoy Iga with ninja experiences, Iga gourmet food, souvenirs, and more.

[Price]
¥19,800 per person～

[Meeting Place]
Samurai House Akai Family Residence
2491-1 Ueno Shinobucho, Iga City, Mie Prefecture, 518-0854

[Access]

title: The Nemophila at Shima City Tourist Farm is in full bloom 💙
description:
The delicate silver-blue nemophila flowers are
spreading across the fields, creating a 'spring flower spectacular.'

Planted on gentle hills, the nemophila looks picturesque from any angle 💙

With red telephone boxes and benches,
the photo spots are also adorable 📞

Some areas are planted with moss phlox,
showcasing blue, light purple, and pink colors
that beautifully contrast against the blue sky ✨

You can enjoy the Shima City Tourist Farm until Golden Week!

📅 Opening dates: Scheduled from 4/6 (Sat) to 5/6 (Mon, holiday)
*Dates may change depending on blooming conditions.
👛 Admission fee: Adults: 300 yen *Free for middle school students and younger

日本列島のほぼ中央に位置し、南北に長い三重県。
伊勢湾や熊野灘の海に面し、鈴鹿山脈、紀伊山地などの
山々が連なる、海、山、川の自然に恵まれた環境です。

さらには、二千年の歴史を有する日本人の心のふるさと
「伊勢神宮」や、鳥羽志摩の「海女」など、
太占より受け継がれてきた伝統・文化も三重の誇るべきもの。

「持続可能」という言葉を近年耳にするようになりましたが、
三重のそうした自然、歴史・文化は、
“当たり前”に今日まで守られてきた大切な宝物です。

“三重の美しい自然や由緒ある伝統を守り未来へと繋ぎたい”
先人たちの想いが込められた、
「持続可能な観光地」三重に訪れてみませんか？
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

title: With Eternal Prayers - 'Sustainable Tourism Destination' Mie
description:
[With Eternal Prayers, it is a journey that is kind to the future.] https://www.kankomie.or.jp/special/sustainable/

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
Mie Prefecture, located almost in the center of the Japanese archipelago, stretches long from north to south.
Facing the Ise Bay and Kumano-nada Sea, it is blessed with nature of sea, mountains, and rivers, with the Suzuka Mountains and Kii Mountains.

Furthermore, it is home to the 'Ise Jingu,' the spiritual home of the Japanese people with a history of over two thousand years, and the 'Ama' of Toba and Shima, which are traditions and cultures inherited from ancient times that Mie takes pride in.

The term 'sustainable' has become more common in recent years, but the nature, history, and culture of Mie have been precious treasures that have been 'naturally' preserved until today.

'We want to protect Mie's beautiful nature and esteemed traditions and connect them to the future.'
Why not visit Mie, a 'Sustainable Tourism Destination,' filled with the hopes of our ancestors?
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

title: 六華苑（旧二代諸戸清六邸）【ドローン撮影】(桑名市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: 桑名の大実業家だった二代諸戸清六の新居として、大正２年（1913年）に完成した六華苑。4層の塔屋を持つ特徴的な洋館は、あの有名な鹿鳴館を手掛けたイギリス人の建築家ジョサイア・コンドルの設計によるもの。洋館に連結して建つ和館、蔵、池泉回遊式庭園など、創建時の姿がほぼそのまま残されており、洋館と和館は国の重要文化財に指定されています。

title: Rikkaen (Former Residence of the Second Generation Moroto Seiroku) [Drone Photography] (Kuwana City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description: Rikkaen was completed in 1913 as the new residence of the prominent businessman Moroto Seiroku, the second generation. The distinctive Western-style building with a four-story tower was designed by the British architect Josiah Conder, who also worked on the famous Rokumeikan. The Japanese-style building, storehouse, and pond-style garden connected to the Western-style building have largely retained their original appearance, and both the Western and Japanese buildings are designated as Important Cultural Properties of the country.

title: 七里御浜【ドローン撮影】(熊野市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報里御浜
description: 世界遺産熊野古道「浜街道」としても知られる七里御浜をドローンで空撮しました！熊野市から紀宝町に至る約22Ｋｍ続く日本で一番長い砂礫海岸。これまでに「日本の渚百選」や「21世紀に残したい自然百選」など全国の景勝地と並んで選ばれています。荒々しい黒潮をおおらかに受けとめるこの浜には、熊野灘の荒波に磨かれた丸い小石が敷き詰められた美しい海浜です。

title: Shichiri Mihama [Drone Photography] (Kumano City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description: We captured Shichiri Mihama, also known as the World Heritage Kumano Kodo 'Hama Kaido', with a drone! This is the longest gravel beach in Japan, stretching approximately 22 km from Kumano City to Kiho Town. It has been selected alongside other scenic spots nationwide, such as 'Japan's Top 100 Beaches' and 'Top 100 Natural Sites to Preserve for the 21st Century'. This beautiful beach, which gracefully embraces the rough Kuroshio Current, is adorned with round pebbles polished by the rough waves of Kumano-nada.

title: Ume - Mie Ume Tour - Suzuka no Mori Garden
description:
Mie Prefecture is actually a famous place for ume (plum blossoms). The 'Suzuka no Mori Garden', which has about 200 magnificent weeping ume trees, including the 'Amanoryu', believed to be the oldest in Japan, conducts research cultivation aimed at the preservation and dissemination of 'shitate technology', one of Japan's traditional horticultural cultures. It is open to the public only during the peak viewing season of the ume blossoms, and there is also a night illumination event.

title: 「楯ヶ崎」　海に突き立てられた巨大な楯のような大岩壁は圧倒的な迫力です！
description:
三重県の名勝天然記念物に指定されている「楯ヶ崎（たてがさき）」は、　海に突き立てられた巨大な楯のような大岩壁！（高さ約80m、周囲約550）

無数の柱が連なったように見える「柱状節理（ちゅうじょうせつり）」は、約1400万年前の大規模な火山活動で発生した大量のマグマが冷却固結されてできたもの。柱状節理自体は熊野の海岸の至る所に見られますが、この「楯ヶ崎」は独立してそびえ立って存在し圧巻の風景です！

ハイキングコースしても最適で、楯ヶ崎園地には遊歩道が整備されており、遊歩道入り口の国道311号から楯ヶ崎までは片道40分の道のりで、途中には海からつながる参道が珍しい阿古師（あこし）神社もあります。熊野ならではの植物が遊歩道沿いにあり、特別な植物には解説付の樹木ラベルが設置されていて、森林浴も兼ねて植物の学習をしながら適度なハイキングが楽しめます。

なお、よりダイナミックな景色を楽しみたい人のためには、観光遊覧船もあります。

title: Tategasaki: A massive cliff resembling a giant shield thrusting into the sea is truly overwhelming!
description:
Tategasaki, designated as a scenic natural monument in Mie Prefecture, is a massive cliff that looks like a giant shield thrusting into the sea! (Approximately 80m high, about 550m in circumference)

The 'columnar jointing' that appears to be a series of countless pillars was formed by the cooling and solidification of a large amount of magma from a massive volcanic activity about 14 million years ago. While columnar jointing can be seen all along the coast of Kumano, Tategasaki stands independently and presents a breathtaking landscape!

It is also ideal as a hiking course, with a well-maintained promenade in the Tategasaki Park. The one-way journey from the entrance of the promenade on National Route 311 to Tategasaki takes about 40 minutes, and along the way, there is the rare Akoshi Shrine, which connects to the sea. Unique plants native to Kumano line the promenade, and special plants have explanatory tree labels installed, allowing for a moderate hike while enjoying forest bathing and learning about the plants.

For those who want to enjoy a more dynamic view, there are also sightseeing boats available.
*For inquiries and reservations for the sightseeing service from the sea, please contact the Kumano City Tourism Association (TEL0597-89-2229)

title: 透明度抜群！御座白浜海水浴場でシーカヤック【伊勢志摩グランピング】LUXUNA伊勢志摩　マリンアクティビティ
description:
カヤックはカヤックでも、「クリアカヤック」はご存知でしょうか？ボディーもオールもすべて透明なカヤックなんです

これが、三重県No.1の透明度を誇るとも言われる御座白浜海水浴場の透き通る海と相性バツグン！透き通ったカヤック越しに、水中の様子をじっくり楽しむことができます。魚が真下を泳いでいくことも！

title: 高田本山 専修寺 (三重県津市)
description:
専修寺は、全国に600余ヶ寺ある真宗高田派の本山寺院です。開山親鸞聖人のみ教えをまっすぐに受け継ぐ寺院で、境内の御廟にはご遺骨をお守りしています。三重県津市一身田町に位置し、親しみを込め高田本山と呼ばれています。
2017年11月三重県初の国宝建造物に指定された、如来堂・御影堂（みえいどう）に加え、国宝の法宝物や国指定の重要文化財を数多く抱えています。境内ではお浄土に咲くとされる蓮の花を、35種類100鉢以上楽しむことができます。また毎年１月９日から１６日まで、真宗最大の法会“報恩講”を行っています。

※令和2年度文化財多言語解説整備事業の補助を受けて作成した動画です。

title: Takada Honsan Senshuji (Tsu City, Mie Prefecture)
description:
Senshuji is the head temple of the Shinshu Takada sect, with over 600 temples nationwide. It is a temple that directly inherits the teachings of the founder, Shinran Shonin, and the remains are enshrined in the mausoleum on the temple grounds. Located in Ichinada Town, Tsu City, Mie Prefecture, it is affectionately called Takada Honsan.
In November 2017, it was designated as the first national treasure building in Mie Prefecture, along with the Nyorai-do and Mieido, and it houses numerous national treasures and important cultural properties designated by the country. This time, I challenged myself to my first-ever rock climbing experience!

title: “みえ旅”で感動を！みえ旅プレミアムCP実施中♪
description:
三重県内の対象施設に泊まって、スマホで簡単なアンケートに答えるだけで、ペア宿泊券や松阪牛・伊勢えびなど豪華賞品が当たる！「みえ旅プレミアムキャンペーン」実施中♪

この秋冬の宿泊先は三重で決まり！！（期間：令和３年１月11日まで）


【動画について】
三重県が「Discover Japan」とタイアップし、「FEEL VIBRATIONS（フィール バイブレーションズ）」をコンセプトに、伊勢神宮や熊野古道の「神秘の波動」、高田本山や伊賀に根付く歴史の「息づかい」、英虞湾で感じる海の「鼓動」など、三重県が発するさまざまな「VIBRATION」を、旅人が実際に体験している視点で紹介します。動画で三重の「VIBRATIONS」を感じたあとは、豪華賞品が当たる「みえ旅プレミアムキャンペーン」に“三重に泊まって”“答えて”参加しよう！
詳細はコチラ
https://www.kankomie.or.jp/sp/special/mietabipremium/index.html?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=premium

title: Kumano Kodo Center (Owase City, Mie Prefecture) - A facility that conveys the charm of the World Heritage Kumano Kodo - | [Official] Tourism Mie
description:
The Kumano Kodo Center, located in Owase City, Mie Prefecture, exhibits the charm of the World Heritage "Kumano Kodo" in an easy-to-understand manner.
The permanent exhibition room is filled with actual materials and replicas related to the history, nature, and culture of the Kumano Kodo and its surroundings.
There is also a "Video Hall" that screens the history and seasonal landscapes of the Kumano Kodo, as well as a "Special Exhibition Room" that hosts themed exhibitions, art exhibitions, and work exhibitions, allowing visitors to learn about the Kumano Kodo from various angles.

〇 With the theme "People and Roads Here, Here, and From Here," we provide information related to nature, history, and culture. The facility "Kumano Kodo Center" conveys the charm of the World Heritage Kumano Kodo.

title: Gozaisho Mountain (Autumn Leaves) 【Drone Photography】(Komono Town) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description:
Gozaisho Mountain, the main peak of the Suzuka Mountains, stands at an elevation of 1,212 meters. At the foot of the mountain is Yunoyama Onsen, and a world-class ropeway connects to the summit, offering a wonderful aerial walk. The autumn leaves begin to change around mid-October from the summit, gradually descending to the mid-slope and finally to the foot of the mountain at Yunoyama Onsen over the course of about a month.

title: Oysters of Urakamura (Toba City, Mie Prefecture) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description:
In Toba City, Mie Prefecture, the recommended specialty during the winter season is oysters! This video showcases the oysters from the Urakamura area of Toba City, which have become famous through television and other media. The picturesque Urakamura area, which has been celebrated in many songs since ancient times, is home to numerous oyster farms. In this area, there are many restaurants where you can enjoy plenty of nutritious oysters, often referred to as the milk of the sea! Additionally, many establishments offer service menus such as fried oysters, oyster rice, and tsukudani during meals, so be sure to check them out. Thank you to Yamayasu Fisheries for their cooperation in the filming!

title: I took a little walk at Magotaro Auto Campground (Kihoku Town) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description:
Just a 10-minute drive from the Kii Nagashima Interchange on the Kisei Expressway.
Magotaro Auto Camp, located in Kihoku Town, Kitamuro District, Mie Prefecture, is a nature-rich auto campground surrounded by the sea and mountains.
The tent sites are broadly divided into two types: 'Tent Sites' and 'Seaside Cottages', with the tent sites further divided into A sites, B sites, C sites, D sites, and free sites.
You can fish right in front of the campground by the sea. You can also sign up for tours such as kayaking and SUP, allowing you to experience various activities.

title: Tokaido Sekijuku - Inheriting Tradition - (Kameyama City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description:
Sekijuku, the 47th post town of the Tokaido Fifty-Three Stations, flourished and still retains the atmosphere of that time.
Here, more than 200 townhouses built from the late Edo period to the Meiji period still exist, and it has been designated as a National Important Traditional Building Preservation District and selected as one of Japan's Top 100 Roads.
Through the people who have inherited the old traditions, we introduce the charm of 'Sekijuku'.

title: 円座・佐八かんこ踊り
description:
かんこ踊りは白馬の尾で作ったじゃぐまをかぶり、太鼓を叩いて篝火の周りを輪になって踊るお盆の行事(県指定無形民俗文化財)です。胸に抱えた太鼓をたたきながら松明の周りを舞う姿に魅せられます。

詳細については、HP観光三重をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Enza - Sahachi Kanko Dance
description:
The Kanko Dance is a Bon Festival event where participants wear a jaguma made from the tail of a white horse, beat drums, and dance in a circle around a bonfire (designated as an intangible folk cultural asset by the prefecture). The sight of dancers performing around the torches while beating the drums they hold in their arms is captivating.

For more details, please visit the HP Tourism Mie.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: 植木神社祇園祭
description:
宵宮祭と遷幸祭からなる祭りで、勇壮に練る神輿と江戸時代から大切に使われている豪華な楼車が町内を巡行する。神輿を傾けながら回る「クネリ」や祇園花の行列が中心となる華やかな祭りは、多くの見物客が訪れます。

詳細については、ＨP「観光三重」をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Ueki Shrine Gion Festival
description:
A festival consisting of the Yoimiya Festival and the Senkou Festival, featuring a magnificent procession of portable shrines and luxurious floats that have been cherished since the Edo period. The vibrant festival, centered around the 'Kuneri' where the portable shrines are tilted and the Gion flower parade, attracts many spectators.

For more details, please visit the HP 'Tourism Mie'.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: ざるやぶり神事
description:
約450年の伝統を受け継ぐ祭り。ふんどし姿の青年たちが神前に供えたお饌米の入っていた直径約90㎝のざるを奪い合います。からだをぶつけ合いもみ合いながら、ざるをやぶる姿は迫力満点です。

詳細については、HＰ「観光三重」をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Zaru Yaburi Festival
description:
A festival that has inherited a tradition of about 450 years. Young men in fundoshi compete to snatch a zaru, a basket with a diameter of about 90 cm that contains rice offerings presented before the deity. The sight of them colliding and grappling to tear the zaru apart is truly spectacular.

For more details, please visit the HP 'Kankou Mie'.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: ミキモト真珠島
description:
明治26年、御木本幸吉が世界で初めて真珠の養殖に成功した島。夏休みは、真珠のティアラをつけて、お手持ちのｶﾒﾗで記念撮影ができる「真珠のティアラで華麗に変身」や淡水真珠を使った「ストラップ工房」や「万華鏡工房」など開催します。

詳細については、ＨＰ「観光三重」をご覧ください。

title: Mikimoto Pearl Island
description:
In 1893, Kokichi Mikimoto succeeded in the world's first pearl cultivation on this island. During the summer vacation, you can participate in events such as 'Transform into Elegance with a Pearl Tiara' where you can wear a pearl tiara and take commemorative photos with your own camera, as well as workshops like 'Strap Workshop' and 'Kaleidoscope Workshop' using freshwater pearls.

For more details, please visit the HP 'Tourism Mie'.

title: 伊勢・安土桃山文化村
description:

title: Ise Azuchi Momoyama Cultural Village
description:
The haunted house that fully utilizes Azuchi Castle is unique to this place! It is a hellish scene of agony and despair, where people are tormented by raging flames and flee in panic. Visitors will receive a command, and will you be able to escape safely from the haunted Azuchi Castle where vengeful spirits lurk?

For more details, please visit the website 'Kankou Mie'.

description:

description:

description:

description:
The Saiku where the priestess lived, supported by the goddess Amaterasu of Ise Jingu on behalf of the Emperor. Around this historical site, there are spots scattered throughout the world of Saiku, which was considered a phantom palace, including 'Saiku Heian no Mori,' which has restored three buildings of the Saiku Ryocho from the Heian period.

For more details, please visit the HP of Kankou Mie.

title: 世界遺産 巡礼路「熊野古道伊勢路」 ～映像シリーズ１
description:
古より日本人は万物に神が宿ると信じ、自然を神と崇めてきた…。

太陽の神、天照大御神がお祀りされている伊勢神宮。
ここで旅の無事を祈り、熊野への旅を始めます。
伊勢路は、伊勢から熊野までおよそ170キロ。
様々な顔、様々な表情をした峠をいくつも越えて行きます。
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
熊野古道とは、日本の各地から和歌山県にある熊野三山（熊野速玉大社、熊野那智大社、熊野本宮大社）を目指した巡礼者が歩いた古道のこと。
伊勢神宮と熊野三山という日本の二大聖地をむすぶ世界遺産である巡礼の道「熊野古道伊勢路」の歴史と魅力を紹介します。

title: World Heritage Pilgrimage Route 'Kumano Kodo Iseji' - Video Series 1
description:
Since ancient times, the Japanese have believed that gods reside in all things and have revered nature as divine...

Ise Jingu, where the sun goddess Amaterasu Omikami is enshrined.
Here, we pray for a safe journey and begin our pilgrimage to Kumano.
The Iseji route stretches approximately 170 kilometers from Ise to Kumano.
We will cross many mountain passes, each with its own unique face and expression.
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
The Kumano Kodo refers to the ancient paths walked by pilgrims aiming for the three Kumano shrines (Kumano Hayatama Taisha, Kumano Nachi Taisha, and Kumano Hongu Taisha) located in Wakayama Prefecture from various parts of Japan.
We will introduce the history and charm of the World Heritage pilgrimage route 'Kumano Kodo Iseji,' which connects the two major sacred sites of Japan, Ise Jingu and the Kumano Sanzan.

手をあわせて旅の無事を願ってくれる、年を召した里の人。
木の精霊と話して、舟を作る人。
「耕して天に至る」と称される棚田を耕す人。
自然と、神々と、共存する人々が暮らします。

description:
On the pilgrimage path, there are lives of people who respect their ancestors and cherish nature...

An elderly villager who prays for the safety of travelers with hands together.
A person who talks to the spirits of trees and builds boats.
A person who cultivates terraced rice fields, known as 'plowing to the heavens.'
People live in harmony with nature and the gods.

title: 四日市コンビナート夜景クルーズ
description: 日本を代表する工場夜景の聖地・四日市。ベテランのガイドさんが同乗し、宝石のような工場夜景はもちろん、遠くは中部国際空港セントレアの夜景まで、特に、第一コンビナートの幻想的な夜景は息を飲む美しさです。

title: Yokkaichi Industrial Complex Night View Cruise
description: Yokkaichi, a sacred place for Japan's representative factory night views. A veteran guide will accompany you, showcasing not only the jewel-like factory night views but also the distant night view of Chubu Centrair International Airport. In particular, the fantastical night view of the First Complex is breathtakingly beautiful.

title: 伊賀流忍者博物館
description:
伊賀上野城や俳聖殿など名所が多い上野公園内にある忍者博物館です。忍者やくノ一がどんでん返しなどの忍者屋敷の仕掛けからくりを案内します。忍術体験広場では、迫力の忍術実演ショーも楽しめます。

詳細については、HP観光三重をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Iga-ryu Ninja Museum
description:
This is a ninja museum located in Ueno Park, which is home to many famous sites such as Iga Ueno Castle and the Haisei Hall. Ninja and kunoichi guide visitors through the tricks and mechanisms of the ninja house, including surprise elements. In the Ninja Experience Plaza, you can also enjoy thrilling ninja performance shows.

For more details, please visit the HP Kankou Mie.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Arisue
description:
You can enjoy the Ise tuna brand from Minami-Ise in various textures and flavors, such as sashimi of Ise tuna, fried bloodline, red meat yukhoe, and heart tsukudani. It's also delightful to encounter local flavors like the heart, which are hard to find elsewhere.

title: Red Dragonfly Hometown Search Operation!
description:
I went to Mount Gozaisho and participated in the Red Dragonfly Hometown Search Operation. Although there was sunshine, the breeze made the shade of the trees very refreshing. It was said that the number of dragonflies was low that day, possibly due to the wind from the previous day, but the children ran around and managed to catch 9 dragonflies and mark them with a 'G'. It became a fun summer memory.

It's fun to participate in the parade with characters and dancers.
I thoroughly enjoyed Parque Espana for two full days.

title: 福王神社～福王山～東海自然歩道コース 山歩き
description:
菰野町にある福王山（標高597ｍ)に登った時の動画です。
２回目の福王山でしたが、下りは福王神社と反対側の東海自然歩道へ下りてぐるっと１周回れるコースがある事を最近知り、気分新たに楽しみにして登ってきました。
とても暑かったですが蝉や虫の声、山と森の空気に癒された時間を過ごすことができました。

Copyright 三重県観光連盟「観光三重」

title: Fukuou Shrine - Fukuou Mountain - Tokai Nature Trail Course Hiking
description:
This is a video of my hike up Fukuou Mountain (elevation 597m) located in Komono Town.
It was my second time at Fukuou Mountain, but I recently learned about a course that allows you to descend to the Tokai Nature Trail on the opposite side of Fukuou Shrine and make a complete loop, so I was excited to hike it with a fresh mindset.
It was very hot, but I was able to spend a healing time listening to the sounds of cicadas and insects, and enjoying the air of the mountains and forests.

Copyright Mie Prefecture Tourism Federation "Kankou Mie"

description:

標高1212mの山頂は24度と涼しく赤トンボがたくさん飛んでいました。

title: Gozaisho
description:
I took the ropeway (2161m in length) to the top of Gozaisho Mountain.
The highest support pillar of the ropeway is the tallest in Japan at 61m. The temperature in the city was 35 degrees,
the summit at an elevation of 1212m was a cool 24 degrees, and many red dragonflies were flying around.

Copyright Mie Prefectural Tourism Federation "Kankou Mie"

title: なばなの里～シロモチくんといっしょ～
description:

きれいでしたよ！夢の世界でした。

description: We went to a Kintetsu railway event in Shiohama with our family. It was fun to look under the train and even operate it. During the tug-of-war, the train moved!

title: 搾乳体験ワクワクだー
description:
四日市市市ふれあい牧場の「春のワクワクふれあいまつり」に行ってきました。初めての乳しぼりは、ワクワクしつつも、ちょっとドキドキしていました。おじさんに丁寧に教えてもらって、上手にできました！きなこちゃん（牛の名前）ありがとう！！楽しい1日でした。

title: Exciting Milking Experience!
description: I went to the 'Spring Exciting Interaction Festival' at Yokkaichi City Interaction Farm. My first time milking was exciting, but also a bit nerve-wracking. With the kind guidance of the uncle, I was able to do it well! Thank you, Kinako-chan (the cow's name)!! It was a fun day.

title: 伊賀上野NINJAフェスタで忍者に変身
description:
伊賀上野ＮＩＮＪＡフェスタ2012へ行きました。
忍者衣装を借りて忍者に変身し、伊賀上野城・忍者屋敷・忍者ショーを楽しみました。

description:
I went to the Iga Ueno NINJA Festival 2012.
I borrowed a ninja costume and transformed into a ninja, enjoying Iga Ueno Castle, the ninja house, and the ninja show.
I was surprised to see so many ninjas in the city even on a weekday.

description:
伊勢から熊野三山へとつながる世界遺産「熊野古道・伊勢路」は、歴史にも登場する参詣道。昔の旅人に思いをはせて歩けば、奥深さの虜になるはず。夢古道おわせではお母ちゃんのランチバイキングがオススメ！

description: The World Heritage Site "Kumano Kodo - Iseji," which connects Ise to the Kumano Sanzan, is a pilgrimage route that appears in history. If you walk while imagining the travelers of old, you are sure to be captivated by its depth. At Yumekodo Owase, the mother's lunch buffet is highly recommended!

description:
ノスタルジーに誘われてイザ寺内町へ！日本で唯一という環濠や伝統的な町屋、土蔵など、情緒溢れる町を散策。専修寺内の御影堂や如来堂、宝物館など国や県指定の文化財も多いので歴史好きには必見スポット！

title: Self-Polishing Spot Mie - Tsu Edition -
description: Invited by nostalgia, let's head to the temple town! Stroll through a town rich in atmosphere, featuring Japan's only moat, traditional townhouses, and storehouses. With many cultural properties designated by the national and prefectural governments, such as the Mikagedo and Nyorai-do in Senshuji Temple and the Treasure Museum, it's a must-visit spot for history lovers!

title: 夜桜を見てきたでござるの巻

title: 石神さんに行ったついでにお宝発見
description:
鳥羽の石神さんへ行ってきました。その帰り、港の方を歩いていたら、漁師さんが伊勢海老を網からとって、大事にしまってました。大きい！食べてみた～い

description: I went to Ishigami-san in Toba. On the way back, while walking towards the port, I saw a fisherman taking a spiny lobster out of the net and carefully storing it. It's huge! I want to try it!

title: 輪中の郷のジャガイモ掘り
description:
桑名市長島町の輪中の里でジャガイモ掘り体験をしてきました。お天気にも恵まれ、楽しんでジャガイモを収穫することができて、満足でした。無農薬で有機栽培とのことで、家に帰ってから、おいしくいただきました。

波は高い中頑張って、綺麗な鯛、ハマチ、カンパチが大漁でした。

I went fishing on a charter boat in Toba.

My two sons, who love meat, said the fish was tastier than meat and enjoyed eating it.

It is a treasure trove of attractions that goes beyond just sightseeing and shopping.

description:
先日、鳥羽の相差で、海女小屋体験をしてきました！

description:
The other day, I had an ama hut experience in Osozu, Toba!

A real ama diver grilled fresh seafood for us, including freshly caught abalone and turban shell.

The weather was nice, so the sea was beautiful, and the ama hut had a great atmosphere. Listening to the ama diver's stories made me realize how tough their work is, which made the food taste even better.

title: 四日市コンビナート夜景クルーズ

title: 北越後の酒観光 - 日本の隠れた宝石
description:
北越後の酒観光 - 日本の隠れた宝石
日本世界観光映画祭2023｜受賞者
ART & TUR - 国際観光映画祭2023｜最優秀映画

1. この地域は日本の「魂」を本当に捉えており、代表的な風景を示し、地元の人々がどのように調和して生活し、米の栽培から塩の収穫まで、地域の自然を活用しているかを強調しています。

2. この映画は、派手な大都市に目を奪われがちな日本の別の側面を示し、真の日本の目的地を探している人々の好奇心を刺激します。

3. 酒は単なる飲み物ではなく、地域の文化、技術、風味の器です。菊水を飲むと、醸造家の努力と誇りを一滴一滴で味わうことができます。新発田とその周辺の北新潟を訪れることで、酒の歴史に浸り、醸造への深い感謝の気持ちを得ることができます。

title: KITA ECHIGO Sake Tourism – Japan’s Hidden Gem
description:
KITA ECHIGO Sake Tourism – Japan’s Hidden Gem
　Japan World's Tourism Film Festival2023｜Winners 
　ART & TUR - International Tourism Film Festival2023｜Best Film

1. The area really captured the “soul” of Japan, showing the representative landscape and highlighting how the locals live in harmony and make use of the nature in the area, from the growing of rice to the harvesting of salt. 

2. This film shows another side of Japan that gets overlooked in favor of flashy big cities, and piques the curiosity of those looking for an authentic Japanese destination. 

3. Sake is more than just a beverage, it is a vessel for the region’s culture, craftsmanship and flavor. When you drink Kikusui, you’re tasting the hard work and pride of the brewers in every drop. A visit to Shibata and the surrounding North Niigata will immerse you in sake’s history and bring you a deep appreciation for brewing.

description:
The 'Kaga Hyakumangoku Sightseeing Route' was born with the opening of the Nezumi Gate.
Among them, we will explore the 'Instagram-worthy course' where you can fully enjoy the beautiful scenery of Kanazawa that you will want to capture in photos.

title: ≪KYOKA音・語り≫　泉鏡花「照葉狂言」より
description: 慶長7年（1602年）、12世教如上人が東本願寺を興した後、加越能三ヵ国の門徒衆が建立した「東末寺」として出発。寛永11年（1634年）に現在地に寺基を定め、「金沢東別院」を舞台に、泉鏡花の美しく幻想的な物語が語られ、能と音楽、舞踊が絡んでいく夢の一夜をご覧ください。

title: ≪KYOKA Sound & Story≫ From Izumi Kyōka's 'Teruha Kyōgen'
description: In the 7th year of the Keichō era (1602), after the 12th generation of the Kyōnyo Shōnin established the Higashi Hongan-ji, it began as 'Higashimatsu-ji,' built by the followers from the three provinces of Kaga, Etchū, and Noto. In the 11th year of the Kan'ei era (1634), the temple's foundation was set in its current location. Please enjoy a dreamlike night where Izumi Kyōka's beautiful and fantastical stories are told on the stage of 'Kanazawa Higashi Betsuin,' intertwined with Noh, music, and dance.

title: 【らんらん走井】走井は今日も笑う！
description:

title: 【滋賀県公式観光PR動画】シガリズム 暮らし旅篇（30秒版）
description:
【シガリズムについて】
シガリズムでは、時代に即した滋賀らしいニューツーリズムを全国へ向けて発信します。
--------------------------------------------------------------
滋賀のリズムにふれて、
心のリズムをととのえる旅へ。

滋賀のリズム。
それは、人だけが焦ることなく、自然と歩みをそろえながら、
ゆっくり、ていねいに暮らしてきた、自然と人とのちょうどいいリズム。
滋賀の暮らしや歴史との出会い。滋賀の自然空間でのアクティビティ。
滋賀の人々とのなにげない会話。
いろんなことがある日々の中で、滋賀での体験はきっと、
心のリズムをととのえる旅になる。
ようこそ。シガリズム　滋賀・びわ湖へ。
----------------------------------------------------------------

title: [Shiga Prefecture Official Tourism PR Video] Shigarhythm: Living Travel Edition (30-second version)
description:
[About Shigarhythm]
Shigarhythm promotes a new tourism experience that reflects the essence of Shiga to the nation.
--------------------------------------------------------------
Experience the rhythm of Shiga,
Embark on a journey that harmonizes your heart's rhythm.

The rhythm of Shiga.
It is a perfect balance between nature and people, where one can live slowly and carefully, without haste.
Encounters with Shiga's lifestyle and history. Activities in Shiga's natural spaces.
Casual conversations with the people of Shiga.
Amidst the various experiences of daily life, a journey in Shiga will surely become a journey that harmonizes your heart's rhythm.
Welcome. Shigarhythm, Shiga and Lake Biwa.

title: 【兵庫県赤穂市PR動画】Ako Onsen,Japan「Feel Ako Time」
description:
赤穂温泉から望む瀬戸内の美しい水平線。
赤穂の自然や歴史、文化、グルメなどを体感。
“どこにでもあるかもしれない”“ここにしかないかもしれない”日常と非日常とが混ざり合う、ゆったりとした旅時間を連想させる映像です。ぜひご覧ください。

Learn more about Ako：http://ako-kankou.jp/

title: [PR Video of Ako City, Hyogo] Ako Onsen, Japan 'Feel Ako Time'
description:
A beautiful horizon of the Seto Inland Sea viewed from Ako Onsen.
Experience the nature, history, culture, and gourmet of Ako.
This video evokes a leisurely travel time that blends the everyday and the extraordinary, something that might be found anywhere or might only exist here. Please take a look.

Learn more about Ako: http://ako-kankou.jp/

title: 【兵庫県赤穂市PR動画】「AKO SALT OF THE SEA」
description: 日本の食文化をはじめ、様々な分野で使用される『塩』。赤穂塩にまつわる歴史や製法、伝統的な製法によってできた塩に着目した新たな試みなど、塩の未来・可能性を表現しています。

title: [Hyogo Prefecture Ako City PR Video] 'AKO SALT OF THE SEA'
description:
Salt, used in various fields including Japanese food culture.
This expresses the future and possibilities of salt, focusing on the history and production methods related to Ako salt, as well as new initiatives based on traditional production methods.

title: Cycle Adventure Akan
description:
Experience the rich nature of Akan, a town where you can fully enjoy the abundant nature of Akan Mashu National Park.

The rich nature woven by volcanoes, forests, and lakes, the Ainu culture that still thrives in the Akan Lake hot springs,
and various activities such as cycling and canoeing to thoroughly enjoy the great outdoors.

We will introduce ways to enjoy the famous hot spring area of Hokkaido, Akan Lake Onsen!

We have a few things we would like to apologize for to everyone around the world.
That is...

We have made it into a video.
In a daily life where what seems obvious is not always so,

and perhaps smile and forgive us.

We sincerely hope for your continued support of Kusatsu Onsen.

title: BIRD'S EYE3「５　藤原ダムを望む風景」｜建設企画課｜群馬県
description:
※群馬テレビで令和元年５月４日・５日に放映したものです。

私達の生活に欠かせない土木施設。県内には重要文化財に指定されたもの、最新の技術を駆使したものなど、将来に語り継ぐ価値のある土木施設が数多く存在します。
これら土木施設の役割や魅力を広く伝え、また将来を担う子どもたちに興味を持ってもらうため、県内の土木施設を紹介する番組を制作し放送することとなりました。
ドローンで撮影した映像などを駆使し、土木施設ならではのスケール感・ダイナミック感をお伝えします。

群馬県みなかみ町に位置する藤原ダムでは、年に一度、洪水期を迎える前にダムの放流設備が安全に作動するか確認するため点検放流を行います。
迫力あふれる放流映像をお楽しみください。

問い合わせ先：建設企画課（027-226-3531）

title: BIRD'S EYE3 '5 View of Fujiwara Dam' | Construction Planning Division | Gunma Prefecture
description:
This was broadcasted on Gunma TV on May 4th and 5th, 2019.

Civil engineering facilities are essential to our lives. Within the prefecture, there are numerous civil engineering structures that are designated as important cultural properties, as well as those that utilize the latest technologies, all of which have value worth passing down to future generations.
To widely convey the roles and attractions of these civil engineering facilities and to spark interest in the children who will carry the future, we have produced a program introducing civil engineering facilities in the prefecture.
Using footage captured by drones, we will convey the unique scale and dynamism of civil engineering facilities.

At Fujiwara Dam, located in Minakami Town, Gunma Prefecture, an inspection release is conducted once a year before the flood season to ensure that the dam's release equipment operates safely.
Enjoy the impressive release footage.

Contact: Construction Planning Division (027-226-3531)

title: BIRD'S EYE3「１０　上野スカイブリッジから望む風景」｜建設企画課｜群馬県

The Doai Sabo Dam, located in Minakami Town, Gunma Prefecture, is an arch dam installed on exposed bedrock. Its semi-circular shape allows water to collect in the center, making it a rare structure within the prefecture.
Although it is a relatively small dam, measuring 112m in length and 11m in height, the sight of the flowing water, combined with its unusual shape, is truly impressive.
With the refreshing sound of water and lush greenery, why not visit during the summer to seek some coolness?

いまは穏やかな風景が広がりますが、利根川は急流と曲がりくねった形状から古来より暴れ川としての悪名もありました。そのたびに人々は知恵を絞り、利根川の護岸工事を進めたのです。高さ1メートルから4メートルの石積み群は、過去から受け継ぐ治水術であり、その技術は現在も人々を守り続けています。

The Tone River is a representative river of Japan that flows through Maebashi City. From there, one can enjoy a scenic view of Mount Akagi.
Currently, a tranquil landscape spreads out, but the Tone River has historically been notorious as a turbulent river due to its swift currents and winding shape. Each time, people have devised ways to advance the riverbank construction of the Tone River. The stone walls, ranging from 1 to 4 meters in height, are a legacy of flood control techniques passed down from the past, and that technology continues to protect people today.

title: 【石狩市公式動画】観光プロモーション映像（第６回 日本国際観光映像祭(JWTFF) 北海道部門 創造賞(Creative Award)受賞作品）
description:
北海道石狩市の観光プロモーション映像です。
本映像では、①Adventure　②Time Travel　③Gourmet Huntの３テーマで構成しています。
シネマ風の美しい映像で本市の魅力をお楽しみください。
ご来訪を心よりお待ちしております。



石狩市は、道都・札幌市に隣接し、札幌中心部から車で40分の距離に位置します。
札幌からのアクセス性が高い中、海・山・川など雄大な自然を有しており、海水浴やキャンプなどのアウトドアを筆頭に、乗馬やスノーシュー、果物狩りなどの自然を満喫することができます。

また、日本遺産に認定されている北前船構成文化財など、歴史的・文化的観光地も多数あります。

そのほか、港朝市や地物市場とれのさとで購入できる朝採れの農水産物や、この新鮮な食材を用いた美味しい食事も自慢の一つです。

*****************************************************************************************************************************************************
本映像は、日本国際観光映像祭実行委員会が主催する「第６回日本国際観光映像祭（JWTFF）」北海道部門で創造賞（Creative Award)を受賞しました。
　https://jwtff.world/archives/4781​

■日本国際観光映像祭（JWTFF）とは
UNWTO（国連世界観光機構）が認定する国際観光映像祭ネットワークに加盟し、アジア唯一の構成映像祭として、日本を始めとしたアジアの観光映像を世界に紹介している映像祭です。令和元年から始まり、今回で６回目の開催となり、第６回映像祭の応募総数は1,278本で、うち日本映像部門への応募数は242本でした。
****************************************************************************************************************************************************

title: [Ishikari City Official Video] Tourism Promotion Video (Awarded Creative Award at the 6th Japan International Tourism Film Festival (JWTFF) Hokkaido Division)
description:
This is a tourism promotion video for Ishikari City, Hokkaido.
The video is composed of three themes: ① Adventure ② Time Travel ③ Gourmet Hunt.
Enjoy the charm of our city through beautiful cinematic visuals.
We sincerely look forward to your visit.

Ishikari City is located adjacent to Sapporo City, the capital of Hokkaido, and is a 40-minute drive from downtown Sapporo.
With high accessibility from Sapporo, it boasts magnificent nature including the sea, mountains, and rivers, allowing for outdoor activities such as swimming, camping, horseback riding, snowshoeing, and fruit picking.

Additionally, there are many historical and cultural tourist sites, including the Kitamaebune Cultural Heritage, which has been designated as a Japan Heritage.

Furthermore, we take pride in the fresh agricultural and marine products available at the Port Morning Market and the local market, Torenosato, as well as delicious meals made from these fresh ingredients.

*****************************************************************************************************************************************************
This video received the Creative Award at the 6th Japan International Tourism Film Festival (JWTFF) Hokkaido Division, organized by the Japan International Tourism Film Festival Executive Committee.
https://jwtff.world/archives/4781​

■ What is the Japan International Tourism Film Festival (JWTFF)?
It is a film festival that is part of the international tourism film festival network recognized by UNWTO (United Nations World Tourism Organization) and is the only film festival of its kind in Asia, introducing tourism films from Japan and other Asian countries to the world. It started in the first year of the Reiwa era and is now in its sixth edition, with a total of 1,278 entries for the sixth festival, of which 242 were submitted in the Japan film category.
****************************************************************************************************************************************************

title: Akan Soul
description:
秋・冬・夏と3シーズン、計1ヶ月撮影した「Akan Soul」。北海道阿寒湖温泉地域とアイヌ文化の日常を追ったノンバーバルドキュメンタリーです☺️非言語で、説明なしで人々の日常が紡ぐ物語が伝えられるか、とても挑戦的な試みでした。この作品を通して多くの人と関われ、文化の深いところまで勉強させて頂きました。

あらためて、自分の心が動く作品を時間と情熱をかけて作っていきたいと思いました！
北海道の阿寒湖温泉地域を３シーズンに渡り撮影したノンバーバル・ドキュメンタリー。美しい自然、阿寒湖温泉地域の木彫りの職人、生活を営む人々、アイヌの文化や伝統、そこに住む人々の熱量に魅了され、僕はカメラを回した。

阿寒湖温泉：http://ja.kushiro-lakeakan.com
阿寒湖アイヌコタン：https://www.akanainu.jp
阿寒湖アイヌシアターイコロ：https://www.akanainu.jp/about/ikoro
豆腐工房まるふく：https://ja.kushiro-lakeakan.com/eat_souvenir/16078/

この動画の制作にご協力下さった皆様に改めて感謝を申し上げます。自分自身とても学びがありたくさん勉強になりました、ありがとうございます！！！

title: Akan Soul
description:
Akan Soul, filmed over three seasons in autumn, winter, and summer for a total of one month. This is a non-verbal documentary that follows the daily life of the Ainu culture in the Lake Akan Onsen area of Hokkaido. ☺️ It was a very challenging attempt to convey the stories woven by people's daily lives without words or explanations. Through this work, I was able to connect with many people and learn deeply about the culture.

Once again, I felt the desire to create works that move my heart with time and passion!
A non-verbal documentary filmed over three seasons in the Lake Akan Onsen area of Hokkaido. Captivated by the beautiful nature, the woodcarvers of the Lake Akan Onsen area, the people living their lives, the Ainu culture and traditions, and the passion of the people who live there, I turned the camera.

description:

title: 森の中へ
description:
北海道・阿寒摩周国立公園の中にある「アカエゾマツの森」。
2022年8月に、地元の弟子屈中学校一学年生29名が散策をしました。

きっかけとなった総合学習のテーマは、「弟子屈再発見、エコツーリズムの視点に立って」。

その後、体験や調査を経て行われた発表会では、
地元の自然に触れて改めて感じた
フレッシュな感想やストレートな意見が次々と飛び出し、
本来のエコツーリズムとは何かを考える、貴重な機会になりました。

同時に、豊かな自然の中で育まれる感性のすばらしさを、
実感させてもらったような気がします。

出演：樋口愛海、横山結那
協力：北海道 弟子屈町立弟子屈中学校
撮影：広瀬結花
提供：一般社団法人摩周湖観光協会
＊（公社）北海道観光振興機構の「令和4年度地域の魅力を活かした観光地づくり推進事業」の
支援を受けています。

【北海道弟子屈町・アカエゾマツの森】
弟子屈町・川湯ビジターセンターの裏に広がる、アカエゾマツの純林。
徒歩約30分のゴゼンタチバナコースと約60分のアカゲラコース、ふたつの散策路があり、一年を
通して、希少な植生や森の心地よさを楽しむことができる。

川湯ビジターセンター
住所：北海道川上郡弟子屈町川湯温泉2-2-6
電話：015-483-4100
https://www.kawayu-eco-museum.com

title: Into the Forest
description:
The "Akaezomatsu Forest" located in Akan Mashu National Park, Hokkaido.
In August 2022, 29 first-year students from the local Teshikaga Junior High School took a walk.

The theme of the comprehensive learning that sparked this was, "Rediscovering Teshikaga from the perspective of ecotourism."

At the presentation held after experiences and research, fresh impressions and straightforward opinions emerged one after another, reflecting on the local nature.
It became a valuable opportunity to think about what true ecotourism is.

At the same time, I feel like I was able to truly appreciate the wonderfulness of the sensitivity nurtured in rich nature.

Featuring: Aimi Higuchi, Yuna Yokoyama
Cooperation: Teshikaga Junior High School, Teshikaga Town, Hokkaido
Filming: Yuka Hirose
Provided by: Mashu Lake Tourism Association, General Incorporated Association
*Supported by the Hokkaido Tourism Promotion Organization's "2022 Project for Promoting Tourism Development Utilizing Local Attractions."

【Akaezomatsu Forest, Teshikaga Town, Hokkaido】
A pure forest of Akaezomatsu spreading behind the Kawayu Visitor Center in Teshikaga Town.
There are two walking trails: the Gozentachibana Course, about 30 minutes on foot, and the Akagera Course, about 60 minutes, where you can enjoy rare vegetation and the comfort of the forest throughout the year.

Kawayu Visitor Center
Address: 2-2-6 Kawayu Onsen, Teshikaga Town, Kawakami District, Hokkaido
Phone: 015-483-4100
https://www.kawayu-eco-museum.com

title: I Can't Just Hide
description:
Koka Film Festival 2023 [Creator Category] Semi-Grand Prix
This time, I filmed in a drama style while exploring the city, focusing on the beloved rural landscapes of Koka. I hope you enjoy the various faces of Koka's townscape, featuring famous spots such as Abihiyama Shrine, Shingu Shrine's front gate, Rokakudo, the ruins of Minakuchi Okayama Castle, Tonomi Da Tea Garden, Shigaraki Kogen Railway, and Cafe Ogama.

title: JOINKOKA
description:
甲賀映像祭2023【クリエーター部門】水口青年会議所理事長賞
矢川神社、水口岡山城、庚申山など。見るもの自体はもちろん、伝えてくれる忍者たちが大きな魅力です。そして、見るだけじゃなく参加して、忍者になれる。
やってるほうが本当に楽しいと思う事を繰り出して「集え」と仲間にさそってくれているような、聞いてるだけ見てるだけじゃなく、仲間に入って体感できる魅力を、タイトルの「JOINKOKA」に込めました。

title: JOINKOKA
description:
Koka Film Festival 2023 [Creator Category] President's Award of the Minakuchi Junior Chamber
Yagawa Shrine, Minakuchi Okayama Castle, Koshin Mountain, etc. The attractions are not only the sights themselves but also the ninjas who convey them. Moreover, you can not only watch but also participate and become a ninja.
The title 'JOINKOKA' embodies the charm of being able to experience it firsthand, inviting friends to join in on the fun of what truly feels enjoyable, rather than just listening or watching.

description: 別府・由布に隣接し、県内への周遊が便利な大分市には、1,000頭を越えるおサルが暮らす「高崎山自然動物園」や水族館など子どもから大人まで楽しめるスポットがあります。さらに関あじ・関さばやとり天といったグルメに、県下有数の源泉数を誇る温泉も楽しめ、工業都市でありながら様々な魅力をそなえています。

title: Presentation Video of the 2021 Tourism Business Meeting ① (Oita City)
description: Oita City, adjacent to Beppu and Yufu, offers convenient access for touring within the prefecture. It features attractions enjoyable for all ages, such as the "Takasakiyama Natural Zoo," home to over 1,000 monkeys, and an aquarium. Additionally, visitors can savor local delicacies like Seki mackerel and Seki horse mackerel, as well as enjoy hot springs boasting one of the highest numbers of sources in the prefecture, making it a city rich in various attractions despite being an industrial hub.

■ミッドナイトおおいた とは
温泉といえば大分県。
だけど、温泉だけじゃない“おおいた県”
ここには、夕暮れから深夜にかけて
ゆったり・じっくり過ごせる最高のスポットが勢ぞろいしています。
来たらきっと分かる、「ミッドナイトまで楽しめる街」 。
初めての人も、来たことのある人も、
『ちょっと気になる』大分県の夜の魅力を、掘り下げてご紹介します。

https://midnight.visit-oita.jp/

■ミッドナイトおおいた×ミュージック
おんせん県おおいたの旅のダイジェストをダイノジさんとマーク・パンサーさんがご案内。
温泉や雄大な自然と楽しんだ後は、大分グルメを堪能して、ネオンきらめく夜の街へ繰り出すも良し！温泉宿でゆっくり過ごすも良し！
2組のアーティストをフィーチャーし、一度聞いたら耳から離れないアッパーチューンに乗せて大分県の魅力をご紹介します。

おんせん県おおいたのまだ見ぬ夜の魅力を、人・場所・食に焦点を当ててドキュメンタリータッチでご紹介します。
日が暮れていく街並み・人々が行き交う雑踏・あかりが灯る飲み屋街…すると、大分県の夜を楽しむ人々の生き生きとした声が入ってくる。
「大分県の夜」が、彼らにとってどんな存在なのか、なぜ唯一無二なのか、なぜ観光客の人々がそれらを体験するべきなのか。
まだ見ぬ大分県の魅力は、人から溢れ出てくるものだった…！
大分県に来たことのある方もまだない方も、まだ見ぬ大分県の魅力にはまるはず。

■ What is Midnight Oita?
When it comes to hot springs, it's Oita Prefecture.
But Oita Prefecture is not just about hot springs.
Here, from dusk to midnight,
you can find the best spots to relax and enjoy.
You'll surely understand when you come, "a city you can enjoy until midnight."
For first-timers and those who have been here before,
we will delve into the nighttime charm of Oita Prefecture that you might be 'a little curious' about.

https://midnight.visit-oita.jp/

■ Midnight Oita x Music
Dinoji and Mark Panther guide you through a digest of the journey in Onsen Prefecture Oita.
After enjoying the hot springs and magnificent nature, you can indulge in Oita gourmet and head out into the neon-lit night city! Or you can relax at a hot spring inn!
Featuring two groups of artists, we introduce the charm of Oita Prefecture with an upper tune that you won't forget once you hear it.
[Midnight Oita] Onsen Prefecture Oita MV feat. Mark Panther full [Official/Oita Prefecture]
https://youtu.be/X2J676UAh6Y

[Midnight Oita] Onsen Prefecture Oita MV feat. Dinoji full [Official/Oita Prefecture]
https://youtu.be/SGiJvyDBRZo

■ Midnight Oita x Culture
We will introduce the unseen nighttime charm of Onsen Prefecture Oita, focusing on people, places, and food in a documentary style.
The streets as the sun sets, the bustling crowds of people, the illuminated drinking streets... then, the lively voices of people enjoying the night in Oita Prefecture come in.
What does 'the night of Oita Prefecture' mean to them, why is it unique, and why should tourists experience it?
The charm of Oita Prefecture that has yet to be seen is something that overflows from the people...!
Whether you have been to Oita Prefecture or not, you will surely fall in love with the unseen charm of Oita Prefecture.

title: 令和３年度ツーリズム商談会プレゼンテーション動画 ③(中津市）
description: 中津市は、山国川の源流から河口まで続く渓谷美と城下町の歴史が織り成す魅力あふれるところです。軍師黒田官兵衛・福澤諭吉ゆかりの中津城下町や、奇岩の渓谷が美しい絵巻物のような風景をつくる日本遺産、名勝耶馬渓などがあります。メイプル耶馬サイクリングロードは耶馬渓の景色と歴史を体感できる人気スポットです。

title: Presentation Video of the 2021 Tourism Business Meeting ③ (Nakatsu City)
description: Nakatsu City is a place full of charm, woven together by the beautiful gorge that stretches from the source to the mouth of the Yamakuni River and the history of its castle town. There are attractions such as Nakatsu Castle Town, associated with strategist Kuroda Kanbei and Yukichi Fukuzawa, and the Japan Heritage site, Yabakei, known for its stunning landscapes created by bizarre rock formations. The Maple Yaba Cycling Road is a popular spot where you can experience the scenery and history of Yabakei.

title: 【京都府八幡市】男山散策動画　|　石清水八幡宮と豊かな自然
description:
このたび、石清水八幡宮境内にある男山散策路や史跡、石垣を紹介する動画を制作しました。
・
ブラタモリでも紹介された石清水八幡宮を有する男山には、竹林が広がり自然を感じられる散策路や、「男山四十八坊」と呼ばれたかつて48近くあった「坊」というお寺の跡地が数多くあります。坊跡の多くには石垣が残り、歴史を感じることができます。

title: [Yawata City, Kyoto] Otokoyama Walking Video | Iwashimizu Hachimangu Shrine and Rich Nature
description:
We have produced a video introducing the Otokoyama walking trail, historical sites, and stone walls located within the grounds of Iwashimizu Hachimangu Shrine.
・
Otokoyama, which is home to Iwashimizu Hachimangu Shrine featured in Buratamori, has walking trails where you can feel nature amidst bamboo groves, as well as numerous ruins of temples known as 'Otokoyama Shijuhachibo,' which once numbered nearly 48. Many of the temple ruins still have stone walls, allowing you to feel the history.

Would you like to take a stroll through Otokoyama, where you can experience nature and history?

Information about the Otokoyama walking trail can be found here
https://www.city.yawata.kyoto.jp/0000000511.html

Iwashimizu Hachimangu Shrine's official website can be found here
https://iwashimizu.or.jp/

The Otokoyama Shijuhachibo pamphlet can be found here
https://www.city.yawata.kyoto.jp/cmsfiles/contents/0000007/7241/2023_R5_03_otokoyama38_web.pdf

title: 浜田の石見神楽 伝統文化体験プレミアムツアー
description:
～浜田の人々の熱に触れ、時を超えた物語に心奪われる、唯一無二の旅路～

島根県の西部に位置し、日本海に面する豊かな自然と伝統産業が息づく街・浜田。この地には、古くから大切に守り伝えられ、発展を遂げてきた伝統芸能があります。迫力あふれる奏楽と舞、思わず見とれてしまうほどの豪華な衣装うや面。地域の住民たち、そして、訪れた人々の心を一度つかむと離さない。それが浜田の石見神楽です。

石見地方の多くの社中や職人たちの手によって受け継がれてきた石見神楽の中でも、とりわけその継承と発展に尽力してきたのが浜田の人々だと言われており、この「石見神楽を創り出したまち」に暮らす若者やお年寄り、そして小さな子どもたちが、学業や仕事など日々の生活を送りながら、自らの強い意志で技の鍛錬に励んでいるのです。

彼らを突き動かすものとは。その情熱の源となっているものとは。このツアーでのみ楽しめる特別公演や社中との交流、衣装や面なふどの工房めぐりを経て明らかになる、時を超えて”浜田人”の心に宿る石見神楽にかける想い。長年の物語に心を奪われる唯一無二の旅路の果てには、知られざる新しい世界が広がっています。


https://hamada-iwamikagura.jp/

title: Hamada's Iwami Kagura Traditional Culture Experience Premium Tour
description:
A unique journey that allows you to touch the passion of the people of Hamada and be captivated by timeless stories.

Hamada, located in the western part of Shimane Prefecture and facing the Sea of Japan, is a city rich in nature and traditional industries. This area is home to traditional performing arts that have been cherished and developed over the years. The powerful music and dance, along with the stunning costumes and masks, captivate the hearts of local residents and visitors alike. This is the Iwami Kagura of Hamada.

Among the many groups and artisans who have inherited Iwami Kagura in the Iwami region, it is said that the people of Hamada have particularly dedicated themselves to its preservation and development. Young people, the elderly, and small children living in this "town that created Iwami Kagura" are diligently honing their skills with strong determination while balancing their studies and daily work.

What drives them? What is the source of their passion? Through special performances exclusive to this tour, interactions with local groups, and visits to workshops for costumes and masks, the feelings that reside in the hearts of the "people of Hamada" for Iwami Kagura will be revealed. At the end of this unique journey, captivated by years of stories, a new and unknown world awaits.

title: Nanase Nishino | Stay in the Town [Tabiiro Movie]
description:
Featuring "distributed hotels" that allow you to enjoy not only the accommodation but also the surrounding town. This is a travel movie where Nanase Nishino explores Kumamoto Prefecture's "Kurokawa Onsen," imagining the entire hot spring town as a single ryokan.

❀Nanase Nishino Profile❀
Born in 1994, from Osaka Prefecture. She passed the first audition for Nogizaka46 in 2011. Since 2015, she has also been active as an exclusive model for the fashion magazine 'non-no' (Shueisha) (graduated in the March 2022 issue). After graduating from Nogizaka46 in December 2018, she has continued to appear in notable works such as the Amazon Original drama "Hot Mama," the movie "The Blood of Wolves LEVEL2," and the drama "Kotodama-so" (TV Asahi). In 2022, she won the Best Supporting Actress Award and the New Actor Award at the 45th Japan Academy Awards for "The Blood of Wolves LEVEL2." From April 2022, she appeared in the drama "What Should I Do About Love?" (Kansai TV / Fuji TV), and from May, she will appear in the stage play "All My Sons," with the movie "Love is Light" set to be released nationwide on June 17.

title: 上白石萌歌｜奥薩摩・伊佐のふわり旅日和 鹿児島県伊佐市 60秒Ver【旅色Movie】
description:
鹿児島県本土の最北地に位置します。川内川（せんだいがわ）をはじめとする清流に囲まれ、美しい自然景観が魅力です。寒暖差の激しい盆地後系で、2020年の最低気温がマイナス6.4℃（12月26日）、最高平均気温は37.6℃（8月18日）と気温差がはっきり。その環境が豊かな食文化を育み、「薩摩の米蔵」としても有名です。また、“東洋のナイアガラ”とも呼ばれる「曽木の滝」、５月～９月の間にしか姿を現さない幻の建物「曽木発電所遺構」など歴史ロマンの詰まったまちでもあります。自然、食、カルチャーと、多彩な魅力にあふれる伊佐市の旅へ出かけてみませんか。

title: Moka Kamishiraishi | A Fluffy Travel Day in Okusatsuma, Isa City, Kagoshima Prefecture 60-Second Version [Tabiiro Movie]
description: Located in the northernmost part of Kagoshima Prefecture. Surrounded by clear streams such as the Sendai River, it boasts beautiful natural scenery. With significant temperature differences in this basin area, the lowest temperature in 2020 was -6.4°C (December 26), while the highest average temperature was 37.6°C (August 18), clearly showing the temperature variation. This environment nurtures a rich food culture, and it is also famous as the 'Satsuma Rice Storehouse.' Additionally, it is a town filled with historical romance, featuring the 'Sogi Falls,' known as the 'Niagara of the East,' and the elusive 'Sogi Power Plant Ruins,' which only appear between May and September. Why not embark on a journey to Isa City, overflowing with diverse attractions such as nature, food, and culture?

description:
Rena Matsui visited Kanzaki City, where ancient history comes alive. Surrounded by rich nature, there are plenty of historical and fortune spots, such as the Yoshinogari Ruins, which vividly convey life in the Yayoi period, a bridge for matchmaking, and a shrine with sacred water for wishes. ┈┈Rena Matsui Profile┈┈
Born on July 27, 1991, in Aichi Prefecture. Active as a member of SKE48 since 2008, she graduated in 2015. After that, she has been active as an actress, appearing in the NHK morning drama "Manpuku" in 2018, and taking her first lead role in a film with "Let's Meet When the Curtain Falls," released in November 2021. She starred in the film "The Whisper of Green" released in September 2023 and is currently appearing in "Even If I Forget You," which started in October of the same year. From December 2023, she will appear in the NHK BS Premium drama "Virtual Ritual." She is also a writer, making her literary debut in 2018 with a novel in the literary magazine "Shousetsu Subaru," and published her first book, "Camouflage," in 2019. A new series titled "Cut In / Cut Out" will start in "Shousetsu Subaru" from December 15.

Born on July 18, 1991, in Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture. Debuted as an exclusive model for the fashion magazine 'CanCam' in 2009. Started her acting career in 2011. title: Yoko Maki | A Journey of Academic Exploration to Unwind in Eternal Time (Hirogawa Town, Wakayama Prefecture) [Tabiiro Movie]
description:
Hirogawa Town, the first in Japan to have its disaster prevention heritage recognized as a Japanese heritage site. We explore the land associated with Mr. Goryo Hamaguchi, a key figure in this achievement, tracing his wonderful personality and the history of Hirogawa Town. We also visit beloved dining spots and cafes in the town, and in the evening, we relax in a hot spring. Together with actress Yoko Maki, we embark on an adult journey that deepens our learning while being healed by nature.

description:
Yuasa Town in Wakayama Prefecture is known as the birthplace of soy sauce brewing. It boasts a variety of local specialties brought forth by its rich nature, and there are many delicious gourmet foods to try. ┈┈Rei Okamoto Profile┈┈
Born on June 18, 1991, in Wakayama Prefecture. She made her modeling debut in 2003 in the teen fashion magazine 'nicola.' As an actress, she has appeared in Fuji TV dramas such as 'Freeter, Buy a House,' and NHK's morning dramas 'Jun to Ai' and 'Warotenka.' Since starring in the 2008 film 'Ren,' she has appeared in numerous works. She is also active in theater and commercials. From August 2023, she stars in the TOKYO MX drama 'Is That Marriage for Real?' marking her first lead role in a series. She is currently playing a slovenly woman in her thirties in a romantic comedy depicting a marriage of disparity.

title: Hinako Sakurai | A Travel Destination in the East of Chiba That You Want to Share. Togane, the Best Place【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
This year marks the 10th anniversary of Hinako Sakurai's debut, and she embarked on a two-day, one-night trip to explore Togane City, located in the eastern part of Chiba Prefecture. Togane City is just about an hour's drive or train ride from the city center. Many may be surprised to find such rich nature that makes you want to take a deep breath, intriguing history that piques intellectual curiosity, and exquisite gourmet options all in such a close location. 2024 is a commemorative year marking the 70th anniversary of the city's establishment, so be sure to pay attention to the various events and commemorative goods planned throughout the year.

┈┈Hinako Sakurai Profile┈┈
Born in Okayama Prefecture. In 2014, she won the Grand Prix in the Okayama Beautiful Girl and Beauty Contest, gaining attention as the 'Miracle of Okayama.' This year marks her 10th anniversary, and she is breaking new ground with the release of her first photo book 'Tokiiro,' which features her first swimsuit shoot. She also appeared in the TV drama 'Mahi no Mitsuko-san' (Nippon Television) aired in the summer of 2024. It has been decided that she will star as the heroine in the stage play '138 Billion Years or Less,' which will be held in Tokyo and Osaka starting November 22. She will also appear in the popular film series 'Kingdom: The Return of the General' and the upcoming release 'Saint☆Oniisan: Holy Men vs. Demon Army' scheduled for December.

栃木県の北東部に位置し、天然鮎遡上日本一を誇る清流・那珂川や、八溝山系に抱かれた豊かな自然が魅力の那珂川町。多くが西向きに構える馬頭温泉郷は、沈みゆく夕日を眺められる「夕焼け温泉郷」とも言われ、知られざる魅力が満載のまさに栃木の秘境です。江戸時代から今も受け継がれる小砂焼のろくろ体験をしたり、浮世絵を展示する馬頭広重美術館で芸術に触れたりと、那珂川町の魅力が詰まった旅に桜庭ななみさんが出かけます。

title: Nanami Sakuraba | A Gentle and Interesting Satoyama Town! The Charms of Nakagawa Town, Tochigi, Will Melt Your Heart [Tabiiro Movie]
description:
Located in the northeastern part of Tochigi Prefecture, Nakagawa Town boasts the clear stream Nakagawa, known for having the highest number of wild sweetfish in Japan, and rich nature embraced by the Yatsugatake mountain range. The Bato Onsen area, mostly facing west, is also known as the 'Sunset Onsen Town' where you can enjoy the setting sun, making it a true hidden gem of Tochigi filled with unknown attractions. Nanami Sakuraba embarks on a journey packed with the charms of Nakagawa Town, experiencing the traditional Kozu pottery wheel since the Edo period and engaging with art at the Bato Hiroshige Museum, which displays ukiyo-e prints.

title: Miyamoto Mayu | Shining Bright, Kofu City is a Treasure Box of Travel【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
Actor and model Mayu Miyamoto traveled to Kofu City, located almost in the center of Yamanashi Prefecture. Kofu City, situated in the middle of the Kofu Basin and surrounded by mountains on all sides, is home to many historically rich and mystical sites, such as the Shosenkyo Gorge, known for its 'most beautiful valley in Japan,' and shrines associated with Takeda Shingen. The more you explore, the more you can recharge and heal in Kofu City, collecting sparkling travel memories.

┈┈Miyamoto Mayu Profile┈┈
Born in 1995, from Akita Prefecture. In 2016, she received the Special Jury Award at the '1st Miss Beautiful 20s Contest.' Since 2017, she has been a model for the magazine 'CanCam,' gracing the cover of the January 2023 issue before graduating. She continues to work as a model in magazines such as 'VoCE,' 'Bijin Hyakka,' and 'andGIRL.' In 2018, she made her acting debut in 'Legal V: Former Lawyer Takanashi Shoko' (TV Asahi). She has appeared regularly in popular series such as 'Inspector Asagao' (Fuji TV), 'Great Hospital Occupation,' and 'New Airport Occupation' (both on Nippon TV), and in the April 2024 drama '6 Seconds of Trajectory: The Second Melancholy of Fireworks Artist Seitaro Mochizuki' (TV Asahi), she will play her first heroine. In 2022, she starred in the film 'Like a Dove, Like a Snake: 75th Anniversary of Osamu Dazai's 'The Setting Sun,' set in Yamanashi Prefecture. Her hobbies include classical ballet, watching movies, and photography.

title: 常盤貴子｜期待を超える、すごい町　美しき釧路町【旅色Movie】
description:
常盤貴子さんが訪れたのは、1980 年の町制施行により生まれた北海道釧路町。北海道の南東部に位置する町で南側は太平洋、原始時代から悠久の時を刻み続ける釧路湿原国立公園が広がり、観光、グルメ、アクティビティ……、何をチョイスしても期待以上の感動をもたらします。訪れる者を温かく迎え、鮮烈な印象を残す、美しき釧路町へ出かけましょう。

┈┈常盤貴子Profile┈┈
1972年生まれ、神奈川県出身。1993年に俳優としてデビューして以後、多くのドラマで主演を務め、エランドール賞新人賞第 1 回大賞を受賞。代表作はドラマ『愛していると言ってくれ』(TBS) 、『Beautiful Life～ふたりでいた日々』(TBS)、『グッドワイフ』(TBS)など。現在は俳優業だけでなく『京都画報』（TOKYO MX）にナビゲーター役で出演するほか、『釣瓶の家族に乾杯』（NHK）でナレーションを務めるなど、さまざまなジャンルで活躍。2024年7月24日公開予定、映画『乱歩の幻想』に芙蓉役で出演。

title: Takako Tokiwa | A Town Beyond Expectations, Beautiful Kushiro Town [Tabiiro Movie]
description:
Takako Tokiwa visited Kushiro Town, Hokkaido, which was established in 1980 when the town system was implemented. Located in the southeastern part of Hokkaido, the town faces the Pacific Ocean to the south, and the Kushiro Wetland National Park, which has been marking the passage of time since prehistoric times, spreads out. Whether you choose sightseeing, gourmet food, or activities, you will experience emotions that exceed your expectations. Let's head to beautiful Kushiro Town, which warmly welcomes visitors and leaves a vivid impression.

┈┈Takako Tokiwa Profile┈┈
Born in 1972 in Kanagawa Prefecture. She debuted as an actress in 1993 and has since starred in many dramas, winning the first Elandor Award for Best Newcomer. Her representative works include the dramas 'Ai shiteru to itte kure' (TBS), 'Beautiful Life - The Days We Were Together' (TBS), and 'Good Wife' (TBS). Currently, she is active not only as an actress but also as a navigator on 'Kyoto Gaho' (TOKYO MX) and as a narrator on 'Tsurube's Family Cheers' (NHK), among various genres. She will appear as Fuyou in the movie 'Ranpo no Gensou', scheduled for release on July 24, 2024.

title: Nao | Delicious Tokachi Address【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
The Tokachi area in Hokkaido is known as one of Japan's leading agricultural and dairy farming regions. This area, consisting of 19 cities and towns, boasts a food self-sufficiency rate of approximately 1,100%. As a treasure trove of ingredients, the journey is filled with encounters of exquisite gourmet food. Nao, who has a keen eye for delicious food, toured the towns of Tokachi and enjoyed the blessings of the land.

description:

┈┈藤原紀香Profile┈┈
兵庫県出身。神戸親和女子大学英米文学科在学中に「ミス日本グランプリ大会」でグランプリを受賞。卒業後、モデルを経て女優へ転身し、数多くのドラマで主演を務めるほか、CM、司会、声優など幅広い分野で活躍。映画『翔んで埼玉 ～琵琶湖より愛をこめて～』では夫婦共演でも話題に。近年は舞台出演が続き、『キャッツ・アイ』の舞台化、『サザエさん』、朗読活劇『細雪』、『怪談・牡丹灯籠』などに出演。2025年12月からは、堤幸彦演出による舞台『忠臣蔵』全国公演で、上川隆也演じる大石内蔵助の妻・大石りく役を務めることが決定している。芸能活動のみならず、社会貢献活動にも積極的に取り組む。NPO法人「Smile please藤原紀香 世界子ども基金」の発起人として、世界の子どもたちの教育や環境改善を目的とした支援事業を20年以上継続中。現在開催中の大阪・関西万博では日本館名誉館長を務め、国内外の賓客を迎える役割を果たしている。

description:
Yuasa Town in Wakayama Prefecture, known as the birthplace of soy sauce brewing, is compact at just 20 square kilometers. The town retains its historic streets, and the sea is just nearby. Norika Fujiwara explores the small yet full of attractions Yuasa Town by rental bicycle.

┈┈Norika Fujiwara Profile┈┈
Born in Hyogo Prefecture. While attending Kobe Shinwa Women's University majoring in English and American Literature, she won the Grand Prix at the 'Miss Japan Grand Prix Contest.' After graduating, she transitioned from modeling to acting, starring in numerous dramas, and has been active in a wide range of fields including commercials, hosting, and voice acting. She gained attention for her on-screen couple performance in the movie 'Ton de Saitama - With Love from Lake Biwa.' In recent years, she has continued to appear in stage productions, including the stage adaptation of 'Cat's Eye,' 'Sazae-san,' the reading play 'Sosui,' and 'Kaidan: Botan Doro.' Starting in December 2025, she has been confirmed to play the role of Oishi Riku, the wife of Oishi Kuranosuke played by Takaya Kamikawa, in the national tour of the stage 'Chushingura' directed by Yukihiko Tsutsumi. In addition to her entertainment activities, she is also actively involved in social contribution activities. As the founder of the NPO 'Smile Please Norika Fujiwara World Children's Fund,' she has been continuing support projects aimed at improving education and the environment for children around the world for over 20 years. Currently, she serves as the honorary director of the Japan Pavilion at the ongoing Osaka-Kansai Expo, welcoming domestic and international guests.

description:
Ryoko Yonekura visited Takeo Onsen in Saga Prefecture, which has become much more accessible with the opening of the Nishi-Kyushu Shinkansen. ❀Ryoko Yonekura Profile❀
Born in 1975, from Kanagawa Prefecture. After working as a model, she transitioned to acting. She has starred in numerous dramas, including 'Seicho Matsumoto: Kurokawa no Techou' and 'Legal V: Former Lawyer Shoko Kotoriyasu' (both aired on TV Asahi). In 2012, she made her Broadway debut in the musical 'CHICAGO,' becoming the first Japanese actress to star in it, gaining significant attention. The 'Doctor X: Surgeon Michiko Daimon' series (TV Asahi) that started in 2012 became a huge hit. She has continued to shine in works such as the Netflix drama 'Shinbun Kisha.' Her latest leading role, the Amazon Original drama 'Angel Flight: International Funeral Director,' is currently streaming exclusively worldwide (Prime Video).

title: 【JWTFF2024 Official Selection】Niigata Culture Tourism  - Niigata-Sado area -
description:
本作品が、日本国際観光映像祭（JWTFF2024）日本部門のオフィシャルセレクションに選出されました。
This film was selected as an official selection in the Japan section of Japan World’s Tourism Film Festival (JWTFF2024).
https://jwtff.world/archives/4408

-------------------
Niigata Culture Tourism

In Niigata Prefecture, tourism that allows visitors to immerse themselves in the culture rooted in the region (cultural tourism), such as traditional performing arts, cuisine, and cultural properties, is called "Niigata Culture Tourism" . This initiative introduces a novel way of experiencing abundance through cultural tourism.

ーーーEmbark on a Journey of Abundanceーーー
This phrase holds dual meanings. Firstly, it means "a journey to explore the wealth of cultural resources in Niigata". Secondly, it means "a journey to feel your heart becoming enriched (contentment and joy)".
It symbolizes the cultural resources blessed with nature, such as the Japan Sea, breathtaking mountains, and rivers of Niigata, stretching from north to south, as well as the distinctive feature of each season.

In fiscal 2022, we implemented initiatives to let people know the charm of Niigata’s culture, targeting the “Niigata-Sado area (*)”. 
* Niigata-Sado area: Niigata City, Gosen City, Aga Town, Sanjo City, Tsubame City, Kamo City, Tagami Town, Yahiko Village, Sado City

title: Fantastique Toba
description:
「Fantastique Toba」
 
 
Venez découvrir la ville de Toba. 
Ici les femmes et les hommes ont construit un lien unique avec la mer, à l’image des plongeuses ama et leur tradition ancestrale de pêche durable. 
Plus qu’une simple escale, c'est une invitation à repenser notre relation à la nature.
 
 
Come and discover the city of Toba.
Having traditions such as the Ama divers and their unique way of sustainable fishing, the women and men of Toba have built a special bond with the sea.
More than a simple step along the way, it's a good chance to let us rethink the relationship between nature and men.
