title: パノラマ大湊 宮川流域案内人 奥野拓也
description:
伊勢志摩ビデオサークルの奥野拓也氏が手掛ける映像は、彼の自然に対する深い愛情とそこに住む人々の暮らしに対するやさしい眼差しが読み取れる。
本作は伊勢市大湊町から見える風景の単なる紹介ビデオではなく、伊勢志摩に住まい、この地で自然とともに生きる人々の底辺に流れる繊細な心の在りようを語った民俗学的プロモーションの動画である。ぜひ、彼の語る一語一語に耳を傾けていただきたい。

title: Panorama Ominato Takeya Okuno, Guide of the Miyagawa Basin
description:
The videos created by Takeya Okuno of the Ise-Shima Video Circle reflect his deep love for nature and his gentle gaze towards the lives of the people who inhabit it.
This work is not merely an introduction video of the scenery visible from Ominato Town in Ise City, but rather a folkloric promotional video that narrates the delicate essence of the hearts of the people who live in Ise-Shima and coexist with nature. I hope you will listen closely to each word he speaks.

title: 白瀧大明神
description:
行者山全体をご神体とする白瀧大明神は、かつて修験者たちが修行した聖地です。空海が座禅を組んだといわれる弘法岩や、役行者の地蔵など、修験僧ゆかりのスポットが多数残っています。
白瀧大明神奉賛会は、現代の複雑化した社会のなかで疲れた心を癒し、再起したいと訪れる方に、滝行や行者山の山歩きを通じて自然に触れる体験を提案しています。皆様の心の平安が保たれ、再生の心が育まれますことをお祈り致します。
ＨＰ：https://shiratakisan.jp/
MB01XAXASMZ1DSV

title: Shirataki Daimyojin
description:
Shirataki Daimyojin, which regards the entire Mount Gyōja as its sacred body, is a holy place where ascetics once practiced. There are many spots associated with ascetic monks, such as Kōbō Rock, where Kūkai is said to have meditated, and the Jizō of Yakushimaru.
The Shirataki Daimyojin Support Association proposes experiences that connect visitors with nature through waterfall training and mountain walking on Mount Gyōja, aiming to heal tired hearts and help them rejuvenate in today's complex society. We pray that your peace of mind is maintained and that the spirit of rebirth is nurtured.
HP: https://shiratakisan.jp/

【大垣市のご紹介】
岐阜県の西部、西美濃の中心に位置する人口16万人のまちで、古くから「水の都大垣」と称されるほど、豊富な地下水に恵まれています。
俳人松尾芭蕉の紀行文「奥の細道」のむすびの地として知られ、関ケ原合戦の際に西軍石田三成の本拠地となった大垣城や、豊臣秀吉が一夜で築いたとされる墨俣一夜城などもあり、自然と歴史が共存したまちです。

~This is the official channel of the Ogaki Tourism Association~
We introduce various attractions of Ogaki, including nature, history, and culture, through videos.

【Introduction to Ogaki City】
Located in the western part of Gifu Prefecture, in the center of Nishi-Mino, Ogaki is a city with a population of 160,000, blessed with abundant underground water, and has long been known as 'the City of Water, Ogaki.'
It is known as the ending point of Matsuo Basho's travelogue 'The Narrow Road to the Deep North' and features Ogaki Castle, which served as the base for Ishida Mitsunari of the Western Army during the Battle of Sekigahara, as well as the Sumiyoshi Castle, said to have been built in a single night by Toyotomi Hideyoshi. It is a city where nature and history coexist.
From late March to May, boat rides, tarai boats, and the Ogaki Festival, which was registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2016, are held, attracting many tourists.

description:
令和５年７月３０日（日）開催の「火まつり行事」の動画です。

この祭りは、若松区出身の芥川賞作家　火野葦平が、戦後のすさんだ世の中を明るく照らし、世の中の平和と安全を願って、昭和２９年に始めた祭りです。
久岐の浜広場（JR若松駅横）でかっぱの徳を讃える祭典を行ったあと、参加者がたいまつを掲げ、高塔山の「かっぱ封じ地蔵」まで行進します。

title: Chikuzen Wakamatsu Fire Festival Event - Summer Record
description:
This is a video of the 'Fire Festival Event' held on July 30, 2023 (Sunday).

This festival was started in 1954 by Akutagawa Prize-winning author Hino Ashihei, who was born in Wakamatsu Ward, to brightly illuminate the desolate post-war world and to wish for peace and safety in society.
After a ceremony praising the virtues of the kappa at Kuki no Hama Square (next to JR Wakamatsu Station), participants march with torches to the 'Kappa Sealing Jizo' on Mount Takato.

================================
大垣市 岐阜県No.1の住み良さ
知っといた方がいい
大人からガキまで幅広く包み込む歴史の深い街

～大垣観光協会の公式チャンネルです～
自然や歴史、文化など大垣の様々な魅力を動画でご紹介します。

【大垣市のご紹介】
岐阜県の西部、西美濃の中心に位置する人口16万人のまちで、古くから「水の都大垣」と称されるほど、豊富な地下水に恵まれています。
俳人松尾芭蕉の紀行文「奥の細道」のむすびの地として知られ、関ケ原合戦の際に西軍石田三成の本拠地となった大垣城や、豊臣秀吉が一夜で築いたとされる墨俣一夜城などもあり、自然と歴史が共存したまちです。
3月下旬から5月には、舟下りやたらい舟、平成28年にユネスコ無形文化遺産にも登録された大垣まつりが開催され、多くの観光客で賑わいます。

description:

Ogaki City, Gifu Prefecture No.1 for livability
You should know this
A city with deep history that embraces everyone from adults to kids
Matsuo Basho also traveled the Narrow Road to the Deep North
The place where his journey concluded
Say cheese, picturesque everywhere
At Sekigahara, the stronghold of the Western Army
Ishida Mitsunari's last castle
Don't compare it to your four-and-a-half tatami mat room
Ogaki Castle, also known as Bijo, also known as Kyoka Castle
You should visit at least once
================================
This project is supported by the Gifu Prefecture Clear Stream Country Promotion Subsidy

~This is the official channel of the Ogaki Tourism Association~
We introduce various attractions of Ogaki, such as nature, history, and culture, through videos.

[Introduction to Ogaki City]
Located in the western part of Gifu Prefecture, in the center of Nishi Mino, this city has a population of 160,000 and has long been known as 'the water city of Ogaki' due to its abundant underground water.
It is known as the concluding place of Matsuo Basho's travelogue 'The Narrow Road to the Deep North' and is home to Ogaki Castle, which served as the stronghold of Ishida Mitsunari during the Battle of Sekigahara, as well as the Suimon Castle, said to have been built by Toyotomi Hideyoshi in a single night. It is a city where nature and history coexist.
From late March to May, boat rides and tarai boats are available, and the Ogaki Festival, registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2016, is held, attracting many tourists.

Located in the center of Nishi-Mino in the western part of Gifu Prefecture, Ogaki is a city with a population of 160,000, blessed with abundant underground water, and has long been known as the "Water City Ogaki."

description:
大垣祭の軕行事は、大垣の城下町祭礼として伝承されてきた美濃地方を代表する祭礼行事であり、大垣藩主下賜(かし)の軕と町衆の軕が併存する形態は全国的にも希少です。

title: [Live] Ogaki Festival (R4.5.15)
description:
The Ogaki Festival's float events have been passed down as a representative festival of the Mino region, celebrated in the castle town of Ogaki. The coexistence of the floats bestowed by the Ogaki feudal lord and those of the townspeople is rare nationwide.

Additionally, the karakuri puppets show a strong influence from the float events of the Chukyo region, while the performing arts on the floats reflect the traditions of the Kinki region, indicating a cultural exchange between the East and West. This festival is considered important for understanding the transmission and evolution of float, hoko, and yatai events in Japan.

It is a city where nature and history coexist.

title: Ogaki City Migration and Settlement Promotion Video
description:
Let's start from Ogaki.

A man captivated by city life learns about the charming current state of Ogaki City through conversations with his girlfriend who lives there. As he reminisces about his hometown, he realizes what is truly important and decides to return to Ogaki.

The background music is a modern arrangement of "Cotton Handkerchief." Originally, this song's lyrics express the feelings of a woman living in her hometown who thinks of her boyfriend who has left for the city. title: [Ogaki City, Gifu Prefecture] UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage - The Ogaki Festival's Yamaboko Float Events
description:
The Ogaki Festival is the annual grand festival of Ogaki Hachiman Shrine, which has been held for over 370 years.
It takes place on the weekend closest to May 15 each year.
The sight of thirteen floats (yama) parading for approximately 8.8 km is breathtaking. In 2015, it was designated as an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Asset of Japan, and in 2016, the 'Ogaki Festival's Yamaboko Float Events' were registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

The city is a place where nature and history coexist.

title: Untouched Hokkaido : Japan’s Natural Wonderland(Summer)
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

歴史的・地理的に、ユニークな場所である東北海道は、⽇本でありながら北⽶プレートに位置するため、その植⽣はとてもに珍しい種類で溢れている。この⼟地だからこそ出逢える希少な野⽣⽣物、そして多くの⽣き物が暮らす⽇本の国⽴公園はその⾃然と共⽣する地元の⼈々がずっと昔から守りぬいてきた『⾃然が⼿付かずで残る場所（Untouched
Hokkaido）』。 東北海道、この地域は豊かな清流でつながっており、日本の特別天然記念物でもある、優雅で美しいタンチョウが住んでいる。北海道の先住民族であるアイヌの言葉で、タンチョウはサロルンカムイ（湿原に住む神）と呼ばれていた。
水は生命を育みながら、魔法をかけられたようにさまざまなカタチに変化する。

title: Untouched Hokkaido : Japan’s Natural Wonderland(Summer)
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

Historically and geographically, Eastern Hokkaido is a unique place that, while being in Japan, is located on the North American Plate, resulting in a rich variety of rare plant species. It is here that you can encounter rare wildlife, and the many creatures that inhabit Japan's national parks have been preserved by the local people who have coexisted with nature for generations, creating a place where 'nature remains untouched (Untouched Hokkaido)'. Eastern Hokkaido is connected by rich, clear streams, and is home to the elegant and beautiful red-crowned crane, which is also a special natural monument of Japan. In the language of the Ainu, the indigenous people of Hokkaido, the red-crowned crane is called Sarorunkamuy (the god that lives in the marshlands). Water nurtures life while magically transforming into various forms.

title: 南紀熊野ジオパーク
description:
紀伊半島南部に位置する、南紀熊野ジオパーク。世界最北の大規模サンゴ群生地を擁するこの海の底の大地は、長い時間の中で地上へ押し上げられてきた。海の底の記憶と、そして大規模な火山活動の痕跡とを刻んだ大地。こうした「過去」が南紀熊野の「現在」の生命や人々の暮らしをつくり出しており、ジオパークという取り組みを通じて「未来」へ伝えられている。

title: Nanki Kumano Geopark
description:
Located in the southern part of the Kii Peninsula, the Nanki Kumano Geopark. This land at the bottom of the sea, which boasts the world's northernmost large-scale coral reef, has been pushed up to the surface over a long period of time. A land etched with the memories of the ocean's depths and traces of large-scale volcanic activity. Such 'past' creates the 'present' life and the livelihoods of the people in Nanki Kumano, and is being conveyed to the 'future' through the initiative of the geopark.

title: 大阪の24時間
description:
大阪は素晴らしい観光名所、文化、食べ物でいっぱいです。

この街の刺激的で活気に満ちたシーンは、世界中で知られています。しかし、大阪が知られる無限のアクションと興奮に加えて、訪問者が自然と一体になり、この壮大な都市の歴史を真に感じることができる場所もたくさんあります。

梅田、難波、道頓堀などの人気の観光地から、たこ焼きや寿司などの魅力的な食べ物まで、歴史と文化に富んだ多様な都市を見て、発見してください。象徴的な大阪城から、街の通りにある無限のナイトクラブの電気的な活気まで - これが大阪です。

今すぐ私たちのチャンネルを登録して、大阪とその多くの魅力についてもっと知りましょう！

title: 24 hours in Osaka
description:
Osaka is jam-packed full of stellar tourist attractions, culture, and food. 

The city's exhilarating and lively scene, full of unbounded energy, is well known across the world. However, in addition to the endless action and excitement that Osaka has become known for, there are many places where visitors can be at one with nature and truly sense the history of this magnificent city.  

From some of the most popular destinations including Umeda, Namba, and Dotonbori, to irresistible food such as takoyaki (Octopus Dumplings) and sushi, watch and uncover a diverse city rich in history and culture. From the iconic Osaka Castle to the electric vivacity found in the boundless nightclubs in the city streets - this is Osaka.

Subscribe to our channel now and discover more about Osaka and its many wonders!

title: The Four Seasons in Osaka＜Short ver.＞
description:
Check out some of Osaka’s top sightseeing spots, food, and culture.
The long version is here. →https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LvwrqwlK0FE&t=5s

Whether Spring, Summer, Autumn, or Winter, Osaka can be enjoyed at any time of the year!
Watch on as we introduce just some of Osaka's many seasonal hot spots.

Spring: Discover the lovely pinks of Cherry Blossom at Osaka Castle.
Summer: Take part in one of Japan's most famous festivals, the "Tenjin Festival", and check out the breath-taking Minoo Falls.
Autumn: Fall in love with the Autumn leaves of trees lining the Midosuji Boulevard and painting Katsuo-ji temple into a fiery red and yellow masterpiece.
Winter: Take in the city's enchanting winter illumination. 

With so many more fantastic sights, including the Expo ’70 Commemorative Park, Umeda Sky building, and Universal Studios Japan, Osaka is full of incredible activities and hotspots that will keep you longing for more.

Subscribe to our channel now and discover Osaka and its many wonders!

title: 鳥取山中に眠る天空の要塞「若松鉱山」紹介Ｍｏｖｉｅ
description:
若松鉱山は、わずか30年前まで採掘が行われていた日本有数のクロム鉱山。産出されたクロムは耐火煉瓦の原料となり、この地域一帯で日本のクロム需要のほとんどを賄っていた時代もありました。
1995年の閉山となりましたが、今も採掘、選鉱、破砕が行われていた当時の様子がそのまま残る日本では数少ない鉱山跡で平成21年（2009年）に、経済産業省「近代化遺産群 続33」に選定されています。

title: The Sky Fortress 'Wakamatsu Mine' Sleeping in the Tottori Mountains Introduction Movie
description:
Wakamatsu Mine is one of Japan's leading chrome mines, where mining was conducted until just 30 years ago. The extracted chrome was used as a raw material for fireproof bricks, and there was a time when it supplied most of Japan's chrome demand in this region.
Although it closed in 1995, it remains one of the few mine sites in Japan where the conditions of mining, sorting, and crushing from that time are still preserved. In 2009, it was selected as part of the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry's 'Modernization Heritage Group Continued 33'.

title: 蓬平・会沢集落 canvas ３ | 蓮池もも【越後妻有 この大地の里山は キャンバスになり 祭りがはじまる。】
description:
蓬平・会沢集落 canvas ３ | 蓮池もも【越後妻有 この大地の里山は キャンバスになり 祭りがはじまる。】

越後妻有 蓬平・会沢集落 canvas ３
越後妻有 この大地の里山は キャンバスになり 祭りがはじまる。

大地の芸術祭 作家　蓮池もも
新潟県十日町市 蓬平・会沢集落　会田法行
語り　山口ひかり（十日町市在住／十日町市立吉田中学校）

新潟県十日町市・津南町からなる越後妻有地域。2000年からこの地で始まった「大地の芸術祭」。
その祭りの舞台となるのは、その地域で生活を営む人々の暮らしと、四季を通じて豊かな大自然が織りなす様々な表情の大地。

この映像作品は、地域をキャンバスと捉え、そこで暮らす人々や自然・文化の魅力を再認識し、大地の芸術祭で訪れたアーティストが作品のインスピレーションとなる地域の魅力へ迫る、地域の暮らしが主役のドキュメンタリーです。

監督：分部康仁
クリエーティブディレクター：引地央行
企画・プロデュース：酒井隆光

【大地の芸術祭の里】
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/

【新潟県十日町市】
https://www.tokamachishikankou.jp/

▼大地の芸術祭
新潟県越後妻有地域を舞台に、地域に内在するさまざな価値を、アートを媒介として掘り起こし、その魅力を高めて世界に発信し、地域再生の道筋を築くことを目指す世界最大級の国際芸術祭。越後妻有は、縄文期からの豪雪という厳しい条件のなかで、米づくりをしてきた土地です。人々は、切り離すことができない人間と自然の関わり方を探りながら、濃密な集落を営んできました。そこから「人間は自然に内包される」という基本理念が生まれ、すべてのプログラムに貫かれています。人間と自然がどう関わっていくか――。その可能性を示すモデルになろうと、越後妻有の地域づくりは進められています。

▼蓮池もも「山の奥 海の底」※公開終了
作家は、大地の芸術祭での作品制作サポート活動の縁もあり、2016年に家族で越後妻有に移住してきた。今回の作品は、当地での日々の様子を、子どもの成長や地域の歳時を軸に、10mの絵巻に物語るように描いたもの。展示会場の「やぶこざきキャンプ場」の建屋は、山々の眺望がすばらしい場所で、絵巻が風景へと連なっていくような印象が楽しめる。
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/art/artwork/depth_of_mountain_bottom_of_ocean/

【My trip TOKAMACHI 新潟県十日町市】
https://www.tokamachishikankou.jp/
十日町市にはアート、自然、グルメなどの見どころが満載です。
アート作品と出会ってじっくり思考を巡らせたり、大自然が織りなす造形美に心を癒されたり…ここでしか味わえないグルメや温泉もあります。
たくさんのスポットの中から、おすすめのコースを巡ったり、行きたい場所だけをぎゅっと集めて自分だけの旅をつくることもできます。
十日町市で「私だけの旅」を楽しもう。

【Snow Rich.Tokamachi! 日本遺産「究極の雪国 とおかまち　-真説！豪雪地ものがたり」】
https://www.city.tokamachi.lg.jp/yukiguni/nihonisan/index.html
地域の歴史的魅力や特色を通じて日本の文化・伝統を語るストーリーを「日本遺産（Japan Heritage）」として文化庁が認定しています。ストーリーを語る上で欠かせない魅力溢れる有形・無形の様々な文化財群を総合的に整備・活用し、国内外へも戦略的に発信していくことにより、地域の活性化を図ることを目的としています。令和2年(2020)に十日町市のストーリー「究極の雪国とおかまち ―真説！豪雪地ものがたり―」が「日本遺産」に認定されました。

【I’m home! Tokamachi　移住・定住サイト】
https://www.city.tokamachi.lg.jp/iju/index.html
十日町市移住コンシェルジュでは、移住検討中または移住して約1年の方を対象にオンライン相談を実施しています。支援制度の紹介、しごとや住まい、子育て環境や不安事の相談など一貫してサポートします。

title: [Kyoto Kamigamo Shrine] Kasakake Shinto Ritual - Third Sunday of October
description:
One of the oldest shrines in Kyoto, Kamigamo Shrine
The entire precinct is registered as a World Heritage site, preserving its appearance unchanged since the Heian period.

Kasakake Shinto Ritual - Third Sunday of October
Kasakake is one of the mounted archery events mentioned in the Nihon Shoki.
It requires a higher level of skill than yabusame, as archers must shoot at not only horizontal targets but also targets set low to the ground on the right and left sides, making it a more practical form of equestrian archery.
At this shrine, records show that Emperor Go-Toba performed Kasakake during the Kamakura period, and since 2005, it has been held annually with the service of the Dai Nippon Kyuba Kai Takeda School.

Kyoto Kamigamo Shrine

title: 【京都 上賀茂神社】神楽・舞楽
description:
京都で最も古い社のひとつ　上賀茂神社

【神楽・舞楽】
日本では古よりご神前にて楽を奏し、歌を唱え、舞を舞い、神様の御心を和めて頂く神事が執り行われてきました。

「神楽」とは、日本古来の神前奉納の歌舞で、天岩戸開きの神話にて天鈿女命（アメノウズメノミコト）が天照大御神の御出現の祈願の為に行った舞が起源とされる神事芸能です。
映像内の巫女神楽は「浦安の舞」です。

「舞楽」は、中国大陸や朝鮮半島から伝来した舞踊音楽が起源とされ、日本独自の発展を遂げ平安時代頃に大成した雅楽のひとつです。
映像内の舞楽は「還城楽（げんじょうらく）」です。

上賀茂神社では、1月5日の新年竟宴祭をはじめ祭典やご祈祷等においてご神前に神楽や舞楽を奉奏しております。

title: [Kyoto Kamigamo Shrine] Kagura and Bugaku
description:
One of the oldest shrines in Kyoto, Kamigamo Shrine
The entire precinct is registered as a World Heritage site, preserving the appearance unchanged since the Heian period.

[Kagura and Bugaku]
In Japan, since ancient times, rituals have been performed in front of the deities, playing music, singing songs, and dancing to soothe the hearts of the gods.

"Kagura" refers to the traditional Japanese performing arts dedicated to the deities, originating from the dance performed by Ame-no-Uzume-no-Mikoto in the myth of the opening of the Heavenly Rock Cave, praying for the appearance of Amaterasu Omikami. The miko kagura in the video is "Urayasu no Mai."

"Bugaku" is believed to have originated from dance music brought from the Asian continent and the Korean Peninsula, developing uniquely in Japan and becoming one of the gagaku forms that flourished around the Heian period. The bugaku in the video is "Genjōraku."

At Kamigamo Shrine, kagura and bugaku are performed in front of the deities during various ceremonies and prayers, starting with the New Year’s celebration on January 5.

Kyoto Kamigamo Shrine

title: [Kyoto Kamigamo Shrine] Kamo Kyokusui En - Second Sunday of April
description:
One of the oldest shrines in Kyoto, Kamigamo Shrine
The entire precinct is registered as a World Heritage site, preserving the appearance unchanged since the Heian period.
Known for its divine virtues such as protection from calamities, directional protection, lightning protection, victory, and matchmaking, over 70 festivals are held annually.

Kamo Kyokusui En - Second Sunday of April
In the garden Shokeien within the shrine grounds, cups are floated down a small stream, and participants recite a waka poem that corresponds to a given theme before the cup arrives. This elegant banquet of the Heian period nobility is recreated by top contemporary poets.

Admission fee: 1,000 yen (limited to 300 seats)
Reception from 11:00 AM - at Kamigamo Shrine precincts

title: [Winter] Maniwa PR Video 'Winter of Maniwa Okayama Japan' Tourism PV
description:
This is a winter video of Maniwa City and Shinjo Village in Okayama Prefecture. It showcases the joys of snow and the traditional crafts unique to the cold season.

Maniwa (Maniwa City and Shinjo Village) is located in the northern part of Okayama Prefecture, bordering Tottori Prefecture, and has lived in harmony with the satoyama (mountain village) since ancient times. It is a region blessed with various climates and nature, featuring tourist spots such as Hiruzensan Plateau and Yubara Onsen.

In the northern area, snow accumulates, allowing for activities like skiing and snowshoeing, and the Yukikoi Festival captivates visitors with its enchanting candlelit scenery. Traditional winter activities such as sake brewing and bamboo crafts are also carried out, offering a glimpse into the lifestyles that have continued for generations.

title: Hida Hirayu waterfall in winter
description: Hirayu Otaki, located in Okuhida Onsengo, Takayama City, Gifu Prefecture, has a height of 64 meters and a width of 6 meters. It is one of the three great waterfalls of Hida and has been selected as one of Japan's top 100 waterfalls. During the winter season, the massive flow of the waterfall freezes, transforming into pillars of ice as if blocking the way. Please enjoy the ice sculpture created by the power of nature.

it is said that during the eastern expedition of Emperor Jimmu,

title: Mononobe Shrine, Ichinomiya, Iwami Province, Shimane Prefecture
description:
The enshrined deity is the founder of the ancient powerful family, the Mononobe clan, Umashimaji no Mikoto.
Umashimaji no Mikoto is a child of Nigihayahi no Mikoto,
it is said that during the eastern expedition of Emperor Jimmu,
he defeated Nagasunehiko and later led the Mononobe clan to protect the imperial castle.
It has a history of more than 1500 years since its foundation,
the main shrine is the second largest shrine after Izumo Taisha,
and is a giant shrine built in the Kasuga style.
The shrine crest 'Hioi Crane' is a sacred crest based on the story that Umashimaji no Mikoto descended on a crane,
and is said to be the only shrine crest in Japan.

偉大な神様として、武運長久、勝利を引き寄せる

description:
The enshrined deity is Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto.
A long time ago, Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto thought,
'Izumo Province is like a long strip of cloth; at first,
I made the country too small. So let's make it and make it
bigger.'
After completing the land dragging four times at Kiduki's cape,
Sada's country, Kurami's country, and Miho's cape,
Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto was enshrined in Nagahama
as the god of land dragging, the general guardian of Izumo Province,
who had completed the creation of the land.
Due to the story of the Kunibiki myth, Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto
is widely worshiped as a great god who attracted the country,

title: 【Yamagata - Tohoku / Japan travel】The Kaneyama path, one hundred years of light
description:
The Kaneyama path, one hundred years of light
Kaneyama Town 100th Anniversary Commemorative Video


－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－


Kaneyama Town, Yamagata Prefecture, marked the 100th anniversary of its town administration on January 1, 2025.

Over these hundred years, some things were born and some were lost; some remain unchanged, while others continue to shift with each passing moment.

What kind of hundred years have the mountains, the forests, and the clear, flowing rivers witnessed?
Have the mythical creatures of this land watched over this century?
Standing where people reflect on Kaneyama’s hundred years, what winds do they feel, and what skies do they see?

In the autumn of 2024, we held the “Centennial Festival” to celebrate Kaneyama’s hundred years.

Leading up to that day, we traced Kaneyama’s four seasons and its changing townscape, explored the work and history of forestry and other local industries, and encountered the lives and words of the people connected to this town.

Join us as we look back with gratitude and forward with hope—carrying the light of a hundred years into the years to come.


－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

description:
We are releasing a compilation of the 'K-hour movie'.

In 'K-hour', we have created videos that capture the 'lifestyle' and 'everyday life' in Kaneyama, so that visitors can experience the same daily life when they come to Kaneyama.

In Kaneyama Town, a unique flow of time exists that can only be found here. It is a gentle and slow passage of time that warmly envelops those who visit. You can feel the fresh air, the scent of the mountains, and the overflowing smiles that come naturally. As the day fades, it embraces the activities of the town, and as if to illuminate the day, the sun rises again. Time spent with an open heart.

We have compiled the time of Kaneyama, which has been woven from the four seasons, into a single work.

[Birds fly higher, and K-hour is going on]

We hope that as many people as possible will see and feel the ongoing 'time of Kaneyama'.

title: [Yamagata - Tohoku / Japan travel] K-hour -winter-
description:
We are releasing the winter edition of the 'K-hour movie'.

In 'K-hour', we have created a video to capture the 'lifestyle' and 'everyday life' in Kaneyama, so that visitors can experience the same daily life when they come to Kaneyama.

In Kaneyama Town, there is a flow of time that can only be found here. It is a gentle and slow passage of time that warmly envelops those who visit. You can feel the fresh air, the scent of the mountains, and the overflowing smiles that come naturally. As the sun sets, it embraces the daily activities, and as the day breaks, it illuminates the day once again. It is a time to spend with your heart as it is.

From a winter moment in Kaneyama Town, please feel 'traveling as if you live'.

title: おかやまうつくしのひと時へ。岡山後楽園＆岡山城
description:
※この動画は2021年に制作したもので、アーカイブとしてYou Tubeに掲載しています。

【岡山後楽園】
岡山藩2代目藩主・池田綱政（つなまさ）が自ら憩いの場として築いた大庭園。季節の花が彩る広々とした園内は江戸時代さながらの別世界。1952年には歴史的文化遺産として“特別名勝”に指定され、ミシュラン・グリーンガイド・ジャポンでは三つ星の評価を得ています。
https://okayama-korakuen.jp/

【岡山城】
慶長2年（1597）、豊臣家五大老の一人・宇喜多秀家が築城した岡山城天守閣。三層六階の堂々たる天守閣は織田信長の安土城天主閣を模して築かれたと伝えられ、全国的にも珍しい不等辺五角形の天守台をしています。黒い下見板張りの外観から別名「烏城（うじょう）」と呼ばれています。
https://kin-ujo.jp/

【幻想庭園・烏城桃源郷】
　毎年、春・夏・秋の期間限定で岡山後楽園と岡山城が美しい光でライトアップされ、「幻想庭園」「烏城灯源郷」として特別に夜間開園・開館します。

title: A Beautiful Moment in Okayama: Okayama Korakuen & Okayama Castle
description:
※This video was produced in 2021 and is published on YouTube as an archive.

【Okayama Korakuen】
Okayama Korakuen is a large garden built by the second lord of the Okayama domain, Ikeda Tsunamasa, as a place for his own relaxation. The spacious garden, adorned with seasonal flowers, is like a different world reminiscent of the Edo period. In 1952, it was designated as a 'Special Scenic Spot' as a historical cultural heritage, and it has received a three-star rating in the Michelin Green Guide Japan.
https://okayama-korakuen.jp/

【Okayama Castle】
Okayama Castle's main keep was built in 1597 by Ukita Hideie, one of the five elders of the Toyotomi clan. The magnificent three-story, six-floor main keep is said to have been modeled after Oda Nobunaga's Azuchi Castle, and it features a rare irregular pentagonal base. Its black wooden exterior has earned it the nickname 'Ujo' (Crow Castle).
https://kin-ujo.jp/

【Fantasy Garden & Ujo Peach Blossom Land】
Every year, during the limited periods of spring, summer, and autumn, Okayama Korakuen and Okayama Castle are beautifully illuminated with lights, and they open specially at night as 'Fantasy Garden' and 'Ujo Lantern Land'.

title: 岡山で日本刀の聖地を訪ね、匠の技に触れる旅【short ver.】
description:
鎌倉時代より日本刀の産地として栄えた、岡山県瀬戸内市長船町。この町にある、全国でも珍しい刀剣の博物館を訪ねます。勇壮かつ繊細な職方の技、刀剣ゆかりの寺院や地元の味。知れば知るほど奥深い、備前長船をめぐる一日。さぁ、次の旅は岡山へ。


【山鳥毛ラッピングタクシー】 
上杉謙信が所持した来歴等から、備前刀の最高峰のひとつにも数えられる国宝「山鳥毛」の特徴的な刃紋と和柄をあしらったデザインで、ドライバーは刀鍛冶をイメージした作務衣姿で乗務します。JR長船駅から「備前おさふね刀剣の里」までの往復料金と博物館の入館料がセット。1週間前までに予約が必要です。
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/news/591

【備前おさふね刀剣の里　備前長船刀剣博物館】 
鎌倉時代より日本刀の産地として栄えた瀬戸内市長船町にある、全国でも珍しい備前刀を中心に展示している博物館です。敷地内には鍛刀場があり、日本刀の古式鍛錬、刀装製作、刀身への彫刻、研ぎなどの、さまざまな日本刀に関する製作工程を実際に見学する事ができます。 
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11175

【ふれあい物産館】
「備前おさふね刀剣の里　備前長船刀剣博物館」に併設。刀剣類や備前小刀、刃物類を中心に、備前焼、工芸品など刀剣の里ゆかりの伝統美術作品を展示販売しています。お茶処では、地元の食材を使ったうどんやそばをはじめ、お守り刀の塩ソフトパフェやキンツバなどのスイーツも味わえます。
http://www.ikoi-okayama.com/token.html
 
【慈眼院】
備前長船刀匠の霊を供養する備前・刀工菩提寺です。江戸時代以降、水害の難を逃れて長船鍛冶の伝統を守り続けた刀匠・横山祐定の墓や、その後の刀工・横山元之進祐定が寄進した梵鐘（市指定文化財）が置かれています。
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11147

【備前福岡 一文字うどん】
備前福岡の刀工「福岡一文字」が名前の由来となっているセルフうどん屋。地元岡山産の小麦を丁寧に石臼で自家製粉した、風味豊かなうどんが味わえます。また、鎌倉時代からこの地に伝わり、備前ばら寿司の元祖と言われている地元の郷土料理、「どどめせ」も食べることができます。
http://ichimonji.ne.jp/

【岡山観光WEB】 https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/

title: A Journey to the Sacred Place of Japanese Swords in Okayama, Experiencing the Artisan's Craft【short ver.】
description:
Nagaoka Town in Setouchi City, Okayama Prefecture, has flourished as a production area for Japanese swords since the Kamakura period. We will visit a rare sword museum located in this town. Experience the majestic yet delicate skills of the craftsmen, temples related to swords, and local flavors. The deeper you know, the more profound the day exploring Bizen Nagafune becomes. Now, let’s head to Okayama for the next trip.

【Yamatorige Wrapping Taxi】
Designed with the distinctive blade pattern and traditional Japanese patterns of the national treasure "Yamatorige," which is considered one of the highest peaks of Bizen swords due to its history of ownership by Uesugi Kenshin. The driver will be dressed in a samue, reminiscent of a swordsmith. The round-trip fare from JR Nagafune Station to "Bizen Osafune Sword Village" includes the museum entrance fee. Reservations are required one week in advance.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/news/591

【Bizen Osafune Sword Village - Bizen Nagafune Sword Museum】
This museum, located in Nagaoka Town, Setouchi City, which has flourished as a production area for Japanese swords since the Kamakura period, focuses on the rare Bizen swords. The premises include a swordsmithing workshop where you can actually observe various production processes related to Japanese swords, such as traditional forging, sword fittings production, engraving on blades, and polishing.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11175

【Fureai Bussan-kan】
Adjacent to the "Bizen Osafune Sword Village - Bizen Nagafune Sword Museum." It exhibits and sells traditional art pieces related to the sword village, focusing on swords, Bizen knives, and cutting tools, as well as Bizen pottery and crafts. In the tea room, you can enjoy local dishes such as udon and soba made with local ingredients, as well as sweets like salt soft serve parfaits and Kintsuba, which are amulets in the shape of swords.
http://www.ikoi-okayama.com/token.html

【Jigen-in】
A temple dedicated to the spirits of Bizen Nagafune swordsmiths. Since the Edo period, it has preserved the tradition of Nagafune smiths, avoiding the difficulties of flooding. It houses the grave of the swordsmith Yokoyama Yasutaka, who continued the tradition, and a bronze bell donated by the later swordsmith Yokoyama Motonoshin Yasutaka, which is designated as a cultural property by the city.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11147

【Bizen Fukuoka Ichimonji Udon】
A self-service udon shop named after the Bizen Fukuoka swordsmith "Fukuoka Ichimonji." You can enjoy flavorful udon made from locally sourced Okayama wheat, carefully ground in a stone mill. Additionally, you can taste "Dodome-se," a local dish said to be the origin of Bizen bara-zushi, which has been passed down since the Kamakura period.
http://ichimonji.ne.jp/

title: 【津山まなびの鉄道館】こどもたちも大喜び！まなびと発見がいっぱいの鉄道館（岡山県津山市）
description:
【こどもたちも大喜び！鉄道ファンも必見！懐かしい車両を多数展示】
津山まなびの鉄道館は、旧津山扇形機関車庫として車両、転車台、蒸気機関車の動輪など展示するスペースと、岡山の鉄道の歴史や、鉄道のしくみを体験しながら学べるスペース、さらに、津山の街並みをジオラマ展示したスペースで構成されています。
1936年に建設された旧津山扇形機関車庫は現存するものでは国内2番目の規模を誇る貴重な施設です。国内で1台のみ製造された大馬力のエンジンを積んだディーゼル機関車「DE50-1」が保存されています。
家族で訪れれば、こどもたちも大喜び！開館日の12時と15時に汽笛の吹鳴は迫力満点！
鉄道や機関車に興味がある人も必見のスポットです！

title: Tsuyama Manabi Railway Museum: A Delight for Children! A Museum Full of Learning and Discovery (Tsuyama City, Okayama Prefecture)
description:
A delight for children! A must-see for railway fans! A large number of nostalgic vehicles on display.
The Tsuyama Manabi Railway Museum consists of a space displaying vehicles, a turntable, and the driving wheels of steam locomotives, as well as a space where visitors can learn about the history of Okayama's railways and experience the workings of trains. Additionally, there is a diorama display of the streets of Tsuyama.
The former Tsuyama roundhouse, built in 1936, is a valuable facility boasting the second largest scale in Japan among existing structures. It houses the diesel locomotive "DE50-1," which is equipped with a high-power engine, of which only one was manufactured in Japan.
If you visit with your family, the children will be thrilled! The sound of the whistle at 12:00 and 15:00 on open days is truly impressive!
This is a must-visit spot for anyone interested in railways and locomotives!

title: 【大原美術館モーニングツアー】 開館前に美術館を貸し切り、特別解説員さんのご案内で巡るツアー企画（倉敷）
description:
大原美術館の開館前に、このツアーに参加されるお客様のためだけに美術館を貸し切り、かつ特別解説員に名画を案内いただける、個人の方向けの特別企画です。

ツアー参加後に近隣の協力飲食店さんでお食事をされた方には大原美術館のノベルティがプレゼントされます！

◆大原美術館
https://www.ohara.or.jp/

【大原美術館】
日本初の私立西洋美術館で世界の名画を鑑賞できます。

1930（昭和5）年に設立された日本初の私立西洋美術館です。倉敷の文化発展に貢献した事業家・大原孫三郎によって創立されました。本館にはエル・グレコ作『受胎告知』、クロード・モネ作『睡蓮』、ルノワール、ゴーギャンなど、有名な西洋の名画が数多く展示されています。ほかにも、エジプト古代美術、西洋現代美術、日本近代・現代美術など約3,000点の美術品を収蔵。倉敷美観地区を訪れた際には、必ず立ち寄りたい観光スポットのひとつです。

【大原美術館の建物について】
設計者の薬師寺主計は、設立者である大原孫三郎が社長を務める倉敷絹織株式会社に入り、大原の片腕として同社や大原家が関係する数多くの建築物を手がけました。
玄関の巨大な柱は、一見大理石に見えますが実は鉄筋コンクリート造で、石の粉をモルタルに混ぜており、左官技術によって施されています。
建築家／完成年：薬師寺主計／1930年・分館 浦辺鎮太郎／1961年
見学・撮影について：館内撮影不可

title: [Ohara Museum Morning Tour] A special tour plan where the museum is reserved before opening, guided by a special lecturer (Kurashiki)
description:
Before the opening of the Ohara Museum, this tour offers a unique opportunity for participants to have the museum exclusively reserved for them, with a special lecturer guiding them through the masterpieces.

Guests who dine at nearby partner restaurants after the tour will receive a novelty gift from the Ohara Museum!

◆ Ohara Museum
https://www.ohara.or.jp/

[Ohara Museum]
Japan's first private Western art museum where you can appreciate world-renowned masterpieces.

Established in 1930, it is Japan's first private Western art museum, founded by businessman Ohara Sozaburo, who contributed to the cultural development of Kurashiki. The main building displays numerous famous Western masterpieces, including El Greco's 'Annunciation', Claude Monet's 'Water Lilies', and works by Renoir and Gauguin. Additionally, it houses around 3,000 artworks, including ancient Egyptian art, modern Western art, and modern and contemporary Japanese art. It is one of the must-visit tourist spots when visiting the Kurashiki Bikan Historical Area.

[About the Ohara Museum Building]
The designer, Yakuji Shukei, joined Kurashiki Silk Weaving Co., Ltd., where the founder, Ohara Sozaburo, served as president, and worked on numerous buildings related to the Ohara family. The massive columns at the entrance may appear to be marble, but they are actually made of reinforced concrete, mixed with stone powder in the mortar and finished using plastering techniques.
Architect / Completion Year: Yakuji Shukei / 1930, Branch: Urabe Chintaro / 1961
Photography and Viewing: Photography inside the museum is not allowed.

title: [Ushimado Training Center Carillon House] A Rich Natural Experience on an Island! Let's See the Spectacular View and Facilities from the Sky!
description:
[Official] Ushimado Training Center Carillon House
https://carillon-house.com/

A training facility equipped with an environment conducive to nature experiences and training.

On Maejima Island, floating in Ushimado (Setouchi City, Okayama Prefecture), known as the Aegean Sea of Japan, is the training accommodation facility Carillon House. The tranquil Seto landscape woven with olive trees and the blue sea is breathtakingly beautiful. With Carillon House as the core facility, which consists of a lodging building that accommodates 250 people, a training building, and a large hall, the vast grounds are equipped with an observatory, multipurpose workshop, and Bizen pottery climbing kiln, providing an optimal environment for a variety of activities and programs such as learning, outdoor activities, marine sports, and cultural experiences. It also serves as a lodging seminar house for corporate training and plays a role as a support facility for local events.

See the great nature of the remote island from the sky, the beauty of the many islands in the Seto Inland Sea, and the full view of the facilities along the coast!

description:
日本のエーゲ海とも言われている瀬戸内市牛窓。牛窓港からフェリーで約5分の場所にある「前島」は、別名「緑島」と呼ばれ、美しい松林などの自然林が繁り、キャベツ畑が広がる、緑豊かな島で、島全体が国立公園に指定されています。

「まえじま夕日公園」や大坂城再建の際に石垣を切り出した丁場の跡である「大坂城築城残石群」からの景色は絶景！レンタサイクルで島を散策してみよう♪

また、前島を含む牛窓周辺は「日本の夕陽百選」に選ばれており、オレンジ色に染まる瀬戸内の夕景は旅の思い出になること間違いなし！

title: Cycling Experience on Maejima Island in Ushimado, Setouchi City
description:
Ushimado, Setouchi City, is often referred to as the Aegean Sea of Japan. Located about 5 minutes by ferry from Ushimado Port, Maejima, also known as 'Green Island,' is a lush island with beautiful pine forests and expansive cabbage fields, and the entire island is designated as a national park.

The views from 'Maejima Sunset Park' and the 'Osaka Castle Construction Remains,' where stones were quarried during the reconstruction of Osaka Castle, are breathtaking! Let's explore the island by renting a bicycle! 

Additionally, the area around Ushimado, including Maejima, has been selected as one of the 'One Hundred Best Sunsets in Japan,' and the orange-hued sunset over Setouchi is sure to become a cherished memory of your trip!

【Experience Only on the Island! Setouchi Island Time】

title: 白石島 盆踊り（白石踊）【岡山県笠岡市】
description:

2022年11月30日、お囃子にあわせて踊る全国各地の民俗芸能「風流踊」のひとつとして、真庭市蒜山の「大宮踊」とともにユネスコの無形文化遺産に登録（岡山県の「大宮踊」「白石踊」をはじめ、日本国内の24都府県41件で構成）されました。

※地域の盆踊りのため、8月13日～16日の当日は衣装を着けての踊りは行われません。

title: Shiraishijima Bon Odori (Shiraishi Dance) [Kasaoka City, Okayama Prefecture]
description:
It is said that this dance, which has been passed down on the island, was started to mourn those who died in the Genpei Battle of Mizushima. This traditional Bon Odori is held from the night of August 13 to 16. Characterized by dancing in a circle to a single chant (ondo), it features a variety of dances, including male and female dances, making it a unique form of dance that has been designated as an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Asset by the national government.

On November 30, 2022, it was registered as one of the folk performing arts called 'Furyu Odori' that dance to the accompaniment of traditional music, along with 'Omiya Odori' from Hiruzan, Maniwa City, as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage (composed of 41 items from 24 prefectures in Japan, including Okayama's 'Omiya Odori' and 'Shiraishi Dance').

*Please note that traditional costumes will not be worn during the local Bon Odori on August 13 to 16.

Okayama Prefectural Official Tourism Site [Okayama Tourism WEB]

title: Hokkaido fisherman in spring
description:
北海道の内浦湾にある洞爺湖町では、ホタテの養殖が盛んだ。
ユネスコの世界遺産にも登録されているこの地域は、100年の間に４度も噴火を繰り返す「有珠山」や、噴火によって形成されたカルデラ湖「洞爺湖」があり、その噴火によって降り注ぐ火山灰はやがて豊富な土壌となり、川からはミネラル豊富な水が海に注がれる。
そんな美しい海で育ったホタテの味は絶品である。

特に春は、「耳づり」と言われる独特な養殖方法に多くの人手が必要なため、小さな漁業町は活気づく季節である。

title: Hokkaido fisherman in spring
description:
In Toyako Town, located in Uchiura Bay, Hokkaido, scallop farming is thriving.
This region, which is registered as a UNESCO World Heritage site, features Mount Usu, which has erupted four times over the past 100 years, and Lake Toya, a caldera lake formed by volcanic eruptions. The volcanic ash that falls from these eruptions eventually becomes rich soil, and mineral-rich water flows from the rivers into the sea.
The taste of scallops raised in such beautiful waters is exquisite.

Especially in spring, the unique farming method known as "mimizuri" requires a lot of manpower, making this small fishing town a lively place during the season.

description:
This is the Kumagaya City, Saitama Prefecture Gourmet CM Series 'Gokabou Edition'.

'Gokabou' is a simple confection made only from soybean flour, puffed rice flour, and syrup.
Although 'Gokabou' is counted among the three major confections of Saitama Prefecture, it is not suitable for mass production by machines, and its tradition is still carefully passed down by artisans, one by one.

https://www.oideyo-kumagaya.com/cate-gourmet/16470/

title: [NIIGATA-SORADORI] Fukushima Lagoon Traditional Fishing in the Morning Mist, Niigata City
description:
Niigata Tourism Navigation [NIIGATA-SORADORI]
Fukushima Lagoon, Niigata City, Traditional Fishing in the Morning Mist
Fukushima Lagoon, located in the northern part of Niigata City, is a migratory bird habitat for over 200 species, cherished not only by the local citizens but also by many bird enthusiasts. It is also known as the northern limit habitat for rare plants, including the giant water lily. In this lagoon, traditional fishing has been practiced for a long time, with the lagoon boats gliding across the lake surface in the early morning. The silhouettes of fishermen blending into the morning mist represent the rich natural environment of the lagoon and should be preserved as a symbol of Niigata.

description:
Niigata Tourism Navigation [NIIGATA-SORADORI]
Great Snake Festival: The Villagers' Feelings Embedded in the Great Snake - Sekikawa Village

The "world's longest giant snake made of bamboo and straw," certified by Guinness, is a symbol of the festival that began in 1967 to convey the tragedy of the Uetsu flood and is themed around the giant snake legend of "Oritoge" that remains in the village. The length of the giant snake is 82.8 meters, inspired by the date of the Uetsu flood, which occurred on August 28. The sight of the enormous snake writhing and coiling in front of the town hall is truly impressive.

description: The "Hoshitoge Rice Terraces" located in the Matsunoyama-Matsushiro area, which has been selected as one of the "100 Best Rural Scenes in Japan." We captured aerial footage of the rice terraces in winter. Enjoy the scenery that you usually cannot see.

description:

description:
This is the Takikumo seen from Edori Pass in Uonuma City. It can be seen in July if the conditions are right.

title: 【NIIGATA-SORADORI】日本の原風景　秘境秋山郷の紅葉　津南町
description:
鈴木牧之が桃源郷と呼んだ秋山郷は、信濃川の支流、中津川の上流域に点在する集落の総称で、長野県と新潟県にまたがる狭谷地帯。

title: [NIIGATA-SORADORI] The Original Scenery of Japan: The Autumn Foliage of Akiyamago in Tsunan Town
description:
Akiyamago, which Suzuki Bakin referred to as a paradise, is a collective term for the villages scattered in the upper reaches of the Nakatsugawa, a tributary of the Shinano River, located in a narrow valley that spans Nagano and Niigata Prefectures.
The autumn foliage season offers a wonderful landscape to enjoy.

title: 【NIIGATA-SORADORI】日本の風情を感じて　弥彦公園・もみじ谷の紅葉　弥彦村
description: 弥彦公園は、日本の風情を感じられる公園。園内にあるもみじ谷では、朱色に塗られた観月橋と赤や黄色に染まるもみじが織りなす景色を楽しめる。

title: [NIIGATA-SORADORI] Experience the Essence of Japan: Autumn Foliage at Yahiko Park and Momiji Valley, Yahiko Village
description: Yahiko Park is a place where you can feel the essence of Japan. In the Momiji Valley within the park, you can enjoy the scenery created by the vermilion-painted Kanzukibashi Bridge and the maple leaves dyed in red and yellow.

title: 【NIIGATA-SORADORI】新潟県景勝100選　そそり立つ岩壁と紅葉　八木ヶ鼻　三条市
description: そそり立つ岩壁は約200m。ハヤブサが生息し、内陸での繁殖は非常にめずらしく「八木ヶ鼻のハヤブサ繁殖地」として県天然記念物に指定されているだけでなく、そのすばらしい景観から新潟県景勝100選に選ばれている。

title: [NIIGATA-SORADORI] Niigata Prefecture's 100 Scenic Spots: Towering Cliffs and Autumn Foliage at Yagigahana, Sanjo City
description: The towering cliffs rise about 200 meters. Peregrine falcons inhabit the area, and their breeding inland is extremely rare. Not only is it designated as a natural monument of the prefecture as the 'Breeding Ground of Peregrine Falcons at Yagigahana,' but it has also been selected as one of Niigata Prefecture's 100 Scenic Spots due to its magnificent landscape.

description:

徳川直轄の金山であった「佐渡金山」（新潟県）と「土肥金山」（静岡県）は、家康公が開発に注力した金山であり、発掘された金は、江戸や大御所となった家康公が過ごした駿府に運ばれておりました。
長野県、山梨県にも金山があったことから、佐渡～土肥を結ぶ金を運んだ道を「黄金KAIDO」と命名いたしました。

title: Celebrate the Registration of Sado Mine as a World Heritage Site! Enjoy a Great Trip on the 'Golden KAIDO' / Sado, Niigata
description:
[What is Golden KAIDO...]
The 'Sado Mine' (Niigata Prefecture) and 'Doi Mine' (Shizuoka Prefecture) were gold mines directly controlled by Tokugawa, and they were the mines that Tokugawa Ieyasu focused on developing. The gold that was excavated was transported to Edo and to Sunpu, where Ieyasu spent his time as a shogun.
Since there were also gold mines in Nagano and Yamanashi Prefectures, we named the road that transported gold connecting Sado and Doi as 'Golden KAIDO'.

[Great Driving Plan]
We are currently offering a driving plan that makes the highways in the Golden KAIDO area more affordable.

[For more details, check the official website]

description:
Niigata Tourism Navigation [NIIGATA-SORADORI]
Tokamachi City, Kiyotsu Gorge - A Hidden Paradise Drenched in Seven Colors

One of Japan's three great gorges located in Tokamachi City, Niigata Prefecture. During the autumn foliage season, many tourists visit to witness the majestic beauty of the green schist and columnar jointing, which is further enhanced by the vibrant colors of the leaves. After being closed due to a rockfall accident in 1988, it is now safely accessible thanks to the opening of the 'Kiyotsu Gorge Tunnel.' It is a tourist spot where you can enjoy breathtaking views as well as hot springs.

title: 映画『urar suye』本編
description:
北海道・阿寒湖アイヌコタンを舞台に、現代に息づくアイヌの世界観を体感する短編映画『urar suye（ウララ スエ）』を公開

【ストーリー】
東京で音楽活動をしているユカリ（xiangyu）は、自分のアーティストとしての将来性を信じきれず、思い悩んでいた。そんな中、ユカリは大学の同級生であるダンサーのサヤに誘われ、釧路にある阿寒湖アイヌコタン（「コタン」は、アイヌ語で「集落」）を訪れることに。

アイヌコタンは〈創り作り手の街〉とも呼ばれており、人々の暮らしの中に伝統的に受け継がれた木彫りや刺繍、歌や踊りが息づいている。さらに、アイヌの世界観では、山や川、動物、樹木といった自然物や、火や雷などの自然現象、道具などに「カムイ」が宿ると信じられていた。
ユカリはアイヌコタンを巡りながら、人々が日々の営みの中でカムイの存在を全身で感じることで、自分自身と世界とのつながりを捉えなおしていく。

title: Movie 'urar suye' Full Version
description:
A short film 'urar suye' (ウララ スエ) that allows you to experience the Ainu worldview alive in modern times, set in the Ainu Kotan of Lake Akan in Hokkaido, is now available.

【Story】
Yukari (xiangyu), who is active in music in Tokyo, was troubled and unable to fully believe in her potential as an artist. In the midst of this, Yukari is invited by her university classmate, dancer Saya, to visit the Ainu Kotan at Lake Akan in Kushiro (where 'Kotan' means 'village' in the Ainu language).

The Ainu Kotan is also known as the 'City of Creators,' where traditional wood carving, embroidery, songs, and dances are alive in people's daily lives. Furthermore, in the Ainu worldview, it is believed that 'Kamuy' resides in natural objects such as mountains, rivers, animals, and trees, as well as in natural phenomena like fire and thunder, and in tools. As Yukari explores the Ainu Kotan, she re-evaluates her connection to herself and the world by fully experiencing the presence of Kamuy in the daily lives of the people.

title: ウタリタリ2025　ティザー
description:
アイヌ文化の周知、伝承、体験を通し、多くの方に親しんでいただき、伝えていくことを目的とし、アイヌ文化フェスティバル「ウタリタリ」を開催。

「ウ」はアイヌ語で「互いに」、「ウタリ」は「仲間」、「タリタリ」は「何かを上下に揺らす」を意味します。言葉を掛け合わせてフェスティバルの名前を「ウタリタリ」としました。

「ウタリタリ」では、自然と共生してきた阿寒湖のアイヌ文化の魅力を国内外に発信するために阿寒湖アイヌコタン等の会場において、アイヌ民族の音楽や古式舞踊、食や文化体験などを盛り込むほか、ゲストのアーティストを招き、アイヌ文化発信の新たな見せ方に挑戦します。

■開催概要
名称　ウタリタリ
日程　2025年1月18日（土）・19日（日）
会場　阿寒湖アイヌシアター ＜イコロ＞ 
　　　伝統・創造「オンネチセ」　ほか

■実施内容
●阿寒アイヌ民族文化保存会の公演
●全道各地のアイヌ民族チームによる演舞
●ゲストアーティストによる公演
　NEO Ryukyu（沖縄）・・・沖縄伝統芸能の公演
　Zoord（ハンガリー）・・・口琴・ヴァイオリン・太鼓ユニットの公演
●アイヌ文化担い手×ゲストアーティストのコラボ公演
●藍染・刺繍ワークショップ
●口琴ワークショップ
●森のガイド
●松明行進
●オハウ提供
●民芸品店スタンプラリー　など

title: Utaritari 2025 Teaser
description:
The purpose of the Ainu Culture Festival 'Utaritari' is to promote, pass down, and experience Ainu culture, allowing many people to become familiar with it and share it.

'U' means 'together' in the Ainu language, 'Utar' means 'friends', and 'Taritari' means 'to shake something up and down'. By combining these words, we named the festival 'Utaritari'.

At 'Utaritari', we will showcase the charm of Ainu culture from Lake Akan, which has coexisted with nature, at venues such as the Akan Lake Ainu Kotan. The festival will include Ainu music, traditional dances, food, cultural experiences, and invite guest artists to challenge new ways of presenting Ainu culture.

■ Event Overview
Name: Utaritari
Date: January 18 (Saturday) and 19 (Sunday), 2025
Venue: Akan Lake Ainu Theater <Ikoro>
		Traditional and Creative 'Onnechise' and more

■ Implementation Details
● Performances by the Akan Ainu Cultural Preservation Association
● Dance performances by Ainu teams from various regions
● Performances by guest artists
	NEO Ryukyu (Okinawa) ... Performance of traditional Okinawan arts
	Zoord (Hungary) ... Performance by a jaw harp, violin, and drum unit
● Collaborative performances between Ainu cultural bearers and guest artists
● Indigo dyeing and embroidery workshops
● Jaw harp workshop
● Forest guide
● Torch procession
● Offering of Ohau
● Folk craft shop stamp rally, etc.

▼ Official Instagram
https://www.instagram.com/utaritari_2025/

title: 【Adventure Base SIRI -Autumn-】
description:
【Adventure Base SIRI -Autumn-】
ここでしか味わえない冒険が、あなたを待っている。

阿寒摩周国立公園・阿寒湖を舞台にした「アドベンチャーベースSiri」のガイドツアー。雄大な自然と神秘の湖が織りなす、特別なひとときを体感しませんか？

プロフェッショナルなガイドが導くこのツアーでは、阿寒湖の深い魅力を余すことなく堪能できます。静寂の中で聴く自然の音、息をのむ景色、心を揺さぶる体験――ここは日常から解き放たれる場所。

ただ訪れるだけでは見つけられない、阿寒湖の真の姿へ。

企画・鶴雅リゾート株式会社ADV事業部
撮影・制作：海住健次・松岡隼平

title: Adventure Base SIRI -Autumn-
description:
Adventure Base SIRI -Autumn-
An adventure that can only be experienced here is waiting for you.

A guided tour of "Adventure Base Siri" set in Akan Mashu National Park and Lake Akan. Would you like to experience a special moment woven by majestic nature and a mysterious lake?

In this tour led by professional guides, you can fully enjoy the deep charm of Lake Akan. The sounds of nature heard in silence, breathtaking scenery, and heart-stirring experiences—this is a place to be liberated from the everyday.

Discover the true face of Lake Akan that cannot be found just by visiting.

Planning: Tsuruga Resort Co., Ltd. ADV Division
Photography and Production: Kenji Umizumi, Junpei Matsuoka

title: 【Eastern Hokkaido -Autumn-】
description:
【Eastern Hokkaido -Autumn-】
秋色に染まる道東  - 広がる絶景と特別な時間 -

北海道・道東エリアには、全６つの国立公園のうち３つが広がり、その壮大な自然が魅力を放ちます。

紅葉に包まれる原生林や澄んだ湖、雄大な自然,、秋ならでは鮭の遡上にも出会えます。

阿寒湖温泉を起点に、秋の道東が織りなす特別な瞬間をお楽しみください。

企画・鶴雅リゾート株式会社　ADV事業部
撮影・制作 : 海住健次・松岡隼平

title: Eastern Hokkaido -Autumn-
description:
Eastern Hokkaido -Autumn-
The eastern part of Hokkaido dyed in autumn colors - Expansive scenic views and special moments -

In the eastern Hokkaido area, three of the six national parks are spread out, showcasing its magnificent nature.

You can encounter virgin forests wrapped in autumn leaves, clear lakes, and the majestic nature, as well as the unique sight of salmon swimming upstream in the fall.

Starting from Lake Akan Onsen, enjoy the special moments woven by autumn in eastern Hokkaido.

Planning: Tsuruya Resort Co., Ltd. ADV Division
Photography/Production: Kenji Umizumi, Junpei Matsuoka

title: SIRI WINTER
description:
阿寒湖の冬を楽しむ、アドベンチャー

ようこそ、ビギナーからエキスパートまで、誰もが楽しめる懐の深いフィールドへ。
この地を形づくった火山活動から奥深い森の豊かさまで、大地の鼓動を感じられる場所へと
アクセス良く出かけられるのが阿寒カルデラ アドベンチャーの最大の魅力。
世界レベル、第一級のフィールドがすぐそこに。
原始の面影を残す表情豊かな地形、多様性に富んだ動植物との出会いを求めて
感動と発見にあふれる冒険へ出かけよう。

title: SIRI WINTER
description:
An adventure to enjoy the winter of Lake Akan

Welcome to a deep field where everyone from beginners to experts can enjoy.
The greatest charm of Akan Caldera Adventure is the easy access to a place where you can feel the heartbeat of the earth, from the volcanic activity that shaped this land to the richness of the deep forests.
World-class, first-rate fields are right there.
Let’s embark on an adventure filled with excitement and discovery, seeking encounters with diverse flora and fauna in a landscape that retains the traces of the primordial.

title: （公式）トーベ・ヤンソンあけぼの子どもの森公園
description:
平成9年の開園から20年を過ぎてもなお、たくさんの人に世代を超えて愛される、トーベ・ヤンソンあけぼの子どもの森公園。この公園は、北欧の童話作家として有名なトーベ・ヤンソンとの手紙のやり取りから生まれました。
　トーベ・ヤンソンの想いは、公園内のいろいろな処にちりばめられています。子どもも、大人も、生き物も、草花も。それぞれがお互いを受け入れ、自由に時間を過ごす。そんな空間が、トーベ・ヤンソンあけぼの子どもの森公園です。

title: (Official) Tove Jansson Akebono Children's Forest Park
description:
Since its opening in 1997, Tove Jansson Akebono Children's Forest Park has been loved by many people across generations, even after more than 20 years. This park was born from the correspondence with Tove Jansson, who is famous as a Nordic fairy tale writer.
Tove Jansson's thoughts are scattered throughout various places in the park. Children, adults, living creatures, and plants all coexist. Each accepts one another and spends time freely. This is the space of Tove Jansson Akebono Children's Forest Park.

title: 寄居北條まつり 2018 【4K ドローン空撮】
description:
寄居北條まつり (2018)

戦国時代に行われた、北条軍と豊臣軍による合戦を再現する祭り。日本 100 名城の一つ「鉢形城」を背に、大砲のごう音が鳴り響く中行われる。刀や槍での戦いは、まるで戦国時代へとタイムスリップしたかのような迫力です。

title: Yorii Hojo Festival 2018 【4K Drone Footage】
description:
Yorii Hojo Festival (2018)

A festival that reenacts the battle between the Hojo army and the Toyotomi army during the Sengoku period. Held against the backdrop of one of Japan's 100 famous castles, 'Hachigata Castle', the sound of cannons echoes through the air. The battles with swords and spears are so intense that it feels like a time slip back to the Sengoku period.

title: 菓子木型で和菓子づくり体験　～越中の小京都・城端で職人体験～　田村萬盛堂／南砺市観光協会
description:
#菓子木型　#職人体験　#和菓子づくり

★菓子木型で和菓子づくり体験

★菓子木型で和菓子づくり体験（田村萬盛堂／南砺市観光協会）
富山県南砺市城端にある、老舗菓子処田村萬盛堂が保有する貴重な菓子木型を用いた和菓子作り体験や、盆点前の一部作法による、茶道の雰囲気を体験します。
寛政年間より代々続く田村萬盛堂には、菓子木型を約３００点展示する木型館もあり、まるで美術作品といえる精緻な菓子木型を、店主による城端菓子小話とともにお愉しみ頂けます。
信仰心に篤く土徳文化の薫る越中の小京都・城端で、加賀前田藩主らが奨励した茶の湯文化の香りにふれてみませんか。

title: Experience Making Japanese Sweets with Wooden Molds - Craft Experience in Jōhana, a Small Kyoto of Etchū - Tamura Manseido / Nanto City Tourism Association
description:
#WoodenMolds #CraftExperience #JapaneseSweetsMaking

★Experience Making Japanese Sweets with Wooden Molds

★Experience Making Japanese Sweets with Wooden Molds (Tamura Manseido / Nanto City Tourism Association)
In Jōhana, Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture, the long-established confectionery shop Tamura Manseido offers a valuable experience of making Japanese sweets using rare wooden molds. You will also experience the atmosphere of the tea ceremony through part of the bon temae practice.
Tamura Manseido, which has been passed down since the Kansei era, features a wooden mold museum displaying about 300 wooden molds, allowing you to enjoy exquisite wooden molds that could be considered works of art, along with charming stories about Jōhana sweets from the shop owner.
In Jōhana, a small Kyoto of Etchū, rich in cultural heritage and faith, why not immerse yourself in the aroma of the tea culture encouraged by the Kaga Maeda clan?

★Main Experience Menu
☆Experience Making Japanese Sweets with Wooden Molds
☆Experience Making Japanese Sweets with Shike Silk
☆Experience Filling Tai-shaped Monaka with Anko
☆Experience Whisking Matcha through Bon Temae
☆Experience Folding Fukusa through Bon Temae
☆Visit the Wooden Mold Museum displaying about 300 wooden molds and confectionery tools

*The content may vary slightly depending on the experience course.

title: Zuisenji temple Night Museum ＜Toyama, Nanto＞
description:
南砺市井波は全国随一の木彫りのまちで「日本遺産」にも認定されています。今も約200名の職人が江戸中期からの彫刻技術を受け継いでいます。そんな井波の中心にある井波別院瑞泉寺は、まるで『木彫刻の美術館』とも称され、精緻な彫刻が随所に施されています。本プランでは、寺内の木彫刻をライトアップすることで陰影が生まれ、昼間より彫刻の緻密さを感じることができます。また、井波彫刻師が解説してくれるので、井波彫刻の技術への理解を深めることができます。

詳しくはこちら
https://www.tabi-nanto.jp/archives/16393

title: Zuisenji temple Night Museum ＜Toyama, Nanto＞
description:
Nanto City, Inami is renowned as one of the best wood carving towns in Japan and has been recognized as a 'Japanese Heritage'.
Approximately 200 artisans continue to inherit the carving techniques from the mid-Edo period.
Zuisenji Temple, located in the heart of Inami, is often referred to as a 'museum of wood carvings', adorned with intricate sculptures throughout.
In this plan, the wooden carvings within the temple are illuminated, creating shadows that allow you to appreciate the meticulousness of the sculptures more than during the day.
Additionally, an Inami woodcarver will provide explanations, deepening your understanding of the techniques of Inami wood carving.

For more details, visit
https://www.tabi-nanto.jp/archives/16393

title: Wakasa Wada Beach in Takahama, Fukui Prefecture
description:
Wakasa Wada Beach in Takahama, Fukui Prefecture, is a popular beach that has received the first international environmental certification "BLUE FLAG" in Asia. It is characterized by its excellent transparency, shallow waters, and wide white sandy beach. It has also been selected as one of Japan's top 88 swimming beaches. During the swimming season, lifeguards and rescue personnel are stationed on the beach, ensuring a safe and secure environment. Additionally, the scenery is beautiful, and it has been chosen as one of Japan's top 100 sunsets.

title: 「神奈川ルルルン♪」 - 湘南エリアで恋に落ちる
description:

・江ノ電
・由比ヶ浜
・湘南平塚七夕祭り
・寺ヶ崎 / 二宮海岸
・小町通り
・鶴岡八幡宮
・江の島水族館
・江の島

description:
Inlay refers to a craft technique that means to shape (kata-dori) and to fit (hame-ru). Wood inlay is a wooden painting created by utilizing and combining the colors and grains of various types of natural trees.
The only region in Japan that forms a production area for wood inlay is the Odawara and Hakone area.

This video introduces the inlay technique using a unique scroll saw sewing machine specific to the Odawara and Hakone region.

title: 小田原漆器の椀 - 日常使いできる「本物」 2017/07/07 Fri.
description:
小田原漆器は木地に丈夫で歪みの少ないケヤキを用います。丈夫なケヤキの木地に、天然のプロテククターでもある漆を何度も刷り込むことで、さらに強く、木目も美しくなるのです。
漆器は取り扱いが面倒と思われるかもしれませんが、小田原漆器の椀は丈夫で実用的、毎日使える「本物」なのです。
小田原・箱根地域は、ろくろ挽き（木地挽き）を中心に千年以上前から発展してきた木工産地。
室町時代、挽物の椀に漆を塗られたのが小田原漆器の始まり。以来、実用的な漆器として発展してきました。
動画本編では、小田原の職人さんたちによる木地挽きとすり漆塗りを紹介しています。

title: Odawara Lacquerware Bowl - A 'Real' Everyday Use 2017/07/07 Fri.
description:
Odawara lacquerware uses sturdy and less warped Zelkova wood for its base. By repeatedly applying natural lacquer, which also acts as a protective layer, to the durable Zelkova base, it becomes even stronger and the wood grain becomes more beautiful.
Lacquerware may seem troublesome to handle, but the Odawara lacquerware bowl is sturdy, practical, and a 'real' item that can be used every day.
The Odawara-Hakone region has been a woodworking area that has developed for over a thousand years, primarily centered around lathe turning (wood base turning).
During the Muromachi period, the application of lacquer to turned bowls marked the beginning of Odawara lacquerware. Since then, it has developed as practical lacquerware.
In the main video, we introduce the wood turning and lacquer application by craftsmen from Odawara.

Featuring and filming cooperation:
Tomoko Suzuki (Mokunosuke / Odawara lacquerware craftsman and wood turner)

title: GREENable HIRUZEN
description:
As people have distanced their lives from the rhythms of nature, the balance between humans and nature is gradually breaking down. However, in Hiruzan, an ecosystem where humans and nature nurture each other still remains. It is a space where humans and nature are inseparably intertwined, flowing in harmony with nature's rhythm, often referred to as 'Hiruzan time.' To live in a way that benefits both humans and nature, we protect and enrich the natural environment. GREENable is an initiative and brand that aims to restore the relationship where humans and nature can coexist. 

Why not experience the true richness we once had here in Hiruzan?

title: 瀬見温泉
description: 最上小国川の清流に臨む静かな温泉場。山水の景勝に恵まれ、特に紅葉の季節がすばらしい温泉地です。源義経の妻、北の方が亀若丸を生んだ際、産湯を探しに出た弁慶が近くの岩陰から立ち昇る湯煙を見つけたのがこの温泉の始まりと伝えられています。近くには亀若丸の誕生に加護のあった亀割子安観音や瀬見温泉の守り神が祀られている湯前神社など、義経・弁慶に関する伝説や旧跡が数多く残っています。夏は、近くを流れる最上小国川でアユ釣りを楽しむ方を多く見かけます

title: Semmi Onsen
description: A quiet hot spring resort overlooking the clear stream of the Mogami Oguni River. Blessed with scenic mountain waters, this hot spring area is particularly wonderful during the autumn foliage season. It is said that the origin of this hot spring began when Benkei, searching for a birthing bath for his wife, the noblewoman Kito, who gave birth to Kamewakamaru, discovered the rising steam from a nearby rock. Nearby, there are many legends and historical sites related to Yoshitsune and Benkei, such as the Kamewakamaru's protective Kamewariko An Kannon and the Yumemae Shrine, which enshrines the guardian deity of Semmi Onsen. In summer, many people can be seen enjoying sweetfish fishing in the nearby Mogami Oguni River.

title: 山刀伐峠
description: 山刀伐峠は、最上町と尾花沢市を結ぶ峠のひとつで、標高は470メートルにすぎませんが、北の最上町側は急峻で、南の尾花沢市側は比較的なだらかな地形をしています。元禄2年(1689)5月17日、陽暦にすると7月3日。松尾芭蕉と河合曾良は最上町の封人の家に逗留した後、「おくのほそ道」でも“最大の難所”と言われている山刀伐峠を越えて、尾花沢市へ向かいました。現在は散策道として整備され、300年の時を越えても尚、松尾芭蕉の旅を偲ぶ貴重な史跡となっています。

title: Yamato-bari Pass
description: Yamato-bari Pass is one of the mountain passes connecting Mogami Town and Obanazawa City. Although its elevation is only 470 meters, the northern side towards Mogami Town is steep, while the southern side towards Obanazawa City has a relatively gentle terrain. On May 17, 1689, in the Gregorian calendar, July 3, Matsuo Basho and Kawai Sora stayed at the house of a feudal lord in Mogami Town before crossing the Yamato-bari Pass, which is said to be the 'most difficult point' in 'The Narrow Road to the Deep North,' and headed towards Obanazawa City. Today, it has been developed as a walking path and remains a valuable historical site that evokes the journey of Matsuo Basho even after 300 years.

title: 堺田分水嶺
description: 陸羽東線の堺田駅前には、太平洋と日本海へと水が分かれる分水嶺があります。一般的な分水嶺は、山脈や丘陵地などの高い地形に形成されますが、平坦な場所にあるのは珍しく、その流れを見ることができます。

title: Sakaida Watershed
description:
In front of Sakaida Station on the Rikuuhigashi Line, there is a watershed where water divides into the Pacific Ocean and the Japan Sea. 
Typically, watersheds are formed in high terrains such as mountain ranges or hills, but it is rare to find one in a flat area where you can see the flow.

title: 【東北・山形】「EMMA」山形県最上町プロモーション動画  Promotion Video for Mogami Town, Yamagata (Tohoku, Japan)
description:
[山形県最上町の歴史や風景を背景にした心が動かされる短編物語]

　最上町は、古来より馬の産地であり、小国駒と呼ばれる名馬の産地として、馬を慈しみ深い関わりを持って暮らしてきた町であった。
　今回のプロモーション動画は、東北三大馬頭観音の一つであり、馬の守り神として崇拝されてきた富山馬頭観音の東善院と、近代では観光地として「馬」に関わりの深い前森高原をメインロケ地にし、その2箇所が『桜』の名所でもあり、『馬』と『桜』、その桜のイメージから『女性』をテーマに、主人公の過去から未来に繋がるストーリーを町の魅力的なロケ地を活かして制作。


[A moving short story set against the backdrop of the history and scenery of Mogami Town, Yamagata Prefecture]

Mogami Town has been a horse-breeding town since ancient times, and as the birthplace of the famous horse called Oguni Koma, it has been a town where people have lived in a beautiful and deep connection with horses.
The main locations for this promotional video are Tozen-in Temple of Tomiyama Bato Kannon, one of the three major horse-headed Kannon temples in the Tohoku region and worshipped as the guardian deity of horses, and Maemori Plateau, which has a deep connection with horses as a tourist destination in modern times. These two places are also famous for cherry blossoms. The story is based on the theme of horses, cherry blossoms, and the protagonist, taking advantage of the town's attractive locations to create a story that connects the protagonist's pas, present, and future.

title: The SUKIYAKI Gastronomy Cyclingｰtour
description:
■Activity details■
With its waterways, traditional old houses, and beautiful rural villages, Niu is the perfect place to enjoy a cycling adventure through unique Japanese scenery. The locals are proud of their pioneering spirit and still talk about the days long ago when people dug waterways through the barren land, making it into a lush agricultural community. This program offers participants the chance to cycle amongst the seasonal scenery of the village while experiencing its history. After the bike ride, they'll enjoy sukiyaki made with Special Matsusaka Beef. Matsusaka Beef is already world famous, but this variety accounts for a mere 4% of all Matsusaka cows, making it a particularly special treat. This is a luxurious cycling tour through gorgeous villages followed by the ultimate Wagyu beef.
An optional organic farm vegetable picking activity is also available.

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■
日本の原風景をサイクリングで走り抜ける。そんな場所にぴったりなのが、水路や古民家等、美しい里山の風景が広がる丹生。ここはかつて、痩せた土地を人々の手で水路を引き、豊かな農村したというストーリーがあり、今もこの土地の人々の誇りとして語り継がれています。本プログラムでは、このエリアの歴史に触れながら、四季折々の里山のサイクリングを楽しめます。サイクリングの後は、世界的に有名な松阪牛のなかでも、たった4%しか存在しない幻の「特産松阪牛」のすきやきに舌鼓。里山の美しい風景と最高級和牛をまるごと味わえる、贅沢なサイクリングツアーです
※オプションでオーガニック農園での収穫体験もございます。

title: Premium dinner with Ama butler at private beach
description:
■Activity details■
Ama are female freedivers who catch seafood such as abalone and sea urchin. Ama fishing, which has been a tradition in Shima, Mie for over 2,000 years, is designated as an important intangible folk cultural property. With over 200 active ama, it is one of the few places in the country where this type of fishing is still practiced. The average ama age is 65!

This program offers participants the chance to get their fill of Shima accompanied by energetic ama. First, participants will head out on a boat with the ama to experience their traditional basket fishing technique used to collect a variety of fresh seafood. Next they'll enjoy a special dinner made with the freshly caught seafood on a private beach. The ama serve as their own private butlers for an unforgettable experience.

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■
「海女（あま）」ー素潜りで海に入り、あわびやウニなどの海鮮類を獲る漁をする女性です。
三重県志摩市は2000年以上続く海女漁が重要無形民俗文化財に指定されており、今もなお200名以上の海女さんが現役で活躍している国内でも希少な地域です。海女さんの平均年齢はなんと65歳！
本プログラムはそんなエネルギッシュな現役海女さんと一緒に志摩を満喫するプランです。まずは伝統的な漁法である「かご漁体験」をするため、海女さんと一緒に船で海に出かけましょう。そして、漁で捕れた新鮮な食材を使った特別ディナーをプライベートビーチで堪能してください。海女さんが、あなただけのbutlerとなって忘れられない1日をご案内します。

title: Premium dinner with Ama butler at private beach
description:
■Activity details■
Ama are female freedivers who catch seafood such as abalone and sea urchin. Ama fishing, which has been a tradition in Shima, Mie for over 2,000 years, is designated as an important intangible folk cultural property. With over 200 active ama, it is one of the few places in the country where this type of fishing is still practiced. The average ama age is 65!

This program offers participants the chance to get their fill of Shima accompanied by energetic ama. First, participants will head out on a boat with the ama to experience their traditional basket fishing technique used to collect a variety of fresh seafood. Next they'll enjoy a special dinner made with the freshly caught seafood on a private beach. The ama serve as their own private butlers for an unforgettable experience.

■Overview & Story of the Content■
"Ama" - women who dive into the sea and catch seafood such as abalone and sea urchin. Shima City in Mie Prefecture has a tradition of ama fishing that has continued for over 2,000 years and is designated as an important intangible folk cultural property. Even now, there are more than 200 active ama, making it a rare region in Japan. The average age of ama is an astonishing 65!
This program is a plan to fully enjoy Shima with energetic active ama. First, let's head out to sea on a boat with the ama to experience the traditional fishing method known as "basket fishing." Then, enjoy a special dinner made with the fresh ingredients caught during the fishing on a private beach. The ama will be your own butlers, guiding you through an unforgettable day.

title: Nagatanien, the Iga ware kiln with 200 years of Japanese culinary history
description:
■Activity details■
Located in northern Mie prefecture in a quiet area where you can see chimneys poking up around town is Marubashira, the Iga ware village. The pottery crafted here is highly flame resistant, and since long ago, clay pots used for cooking on open flames and teapots have been made in this village.

Nagatanien, one of the potteries of Iga ware, has continued to carry on the techniques of this craft since the workshop's founding in 1832, making pieces that are highly valued both in Japan and abroad. This program offers participants the chance to go on a special tour of the climbing kilns with the eighth generation head of Nagatanien while listening to secret stories about Iga ware, and to try cooking in a famous Nagatanien clay pot. Don't miss the chance to try some delicious rice prepared in this unique piece of pottery!

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■

伊賀焼窯元「長谷園」は1832年築窯して以来、伊賀焼の伝統と技術を継承し、国内外から高く評価される製品を生み出しています。本プログラムでは、8代目当主による特別な案内で登り窯見学と伊賀焼に関する秘話を聞くことができるだけでなく、長谷園の代表的作品である土鍋を使った炊飯実演もご用意。炊き立ての土鍋ご飯の美味しさをぜひ味わってみてください。

title: Walk the Magose pass on the Kumano Kodo trail, UNESCO World heritage site
description:
■Activity details■
Long ago, it was popular for people from all across Japan to walk hundreds of kilometers to tour sacred sites such as Ise Grand Shrine and Kumano Sanzan (the Three Grand Shrines of Kumano). Many travelers walked the perilous Magose Pass, which is part of the Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range that leads to Kumano Sanzan. The beautiful stone paved path leading deep into the forest has been lovingly maintained by locals for centuries, and still looks as it did long ago. This program offers participants the chance to dress in travel garb recreated from ukiyo-e prints and historic documents and walk the Magose Past just as ancient travelers did. Partial proceeds from the program are used to preserve the stone paving and keep the scenery in pristine condition for future generations.

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■
かつて日本では、日本全国から何百キロもの道のりを歩いて伊勢神宮や熊野三山を参拝する聖地巡礼の大ブームが起きました。世界遺産「紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道」の一部である「馬越峠」もまた、数多くの旅人がいくつもの険しい峠を越え、熊野三山を詣でるために通った“祈りの道”の一つ。森の奥へと伸びる美しい石畳は、何百年もの間、地元の人々の手によって大事に保全され、今もなお、当時の姿を留めています。本プログラムでは、浮世絵や文献等を参考に再現された旅装束に身を包み、かつての旅人たちのように馬越峠を歩きます。体験代の一部は、この先もこの美しい景色を残すため、石畳の保全活動費用に使われます。

description:
■アクティビティの詳細■
三重県志摩市は真珠養殖の発祥の地です。豊かな海の資源と受け継がれた技術のおかげで、志摩の真珠は世界でも最高品質のものとして知られています。このプログラムでは、参加者が真珠養殖場を訪れ、職人と話しながら養殖技術を直接学ぶ機会を提供します。また、参加者は牡蠣から真珠を取り出す体験や、非常に珍しい「母貝への核入れ作業」を行い、真珠養殖のプロセスがいかに難しいかを学ぶことができます。最後に、参加者は集めた真珠を使って、世界に一つだけのオリジナルジュエリーを製作します。

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■
真珠養殖の発祥の地である三重県志摩市。豊かな海と技術が受け継がれる志摩で作られる真珠の品質の高さは世界有数です。本プログラムでは、今もなお稼働している真珠養殖の現場に訪問し、伝統的な養殖手法を間近で見学、職人と直接お話することができます。また、「真珠の取り出し体験」や通常は体験することができない「母貝への核入れ作業」を通して、「真珠づくり」の真の難しさを体感してみてください。そして最後に、取り出した真珠で世界に一つだけのオリジナル真珠ジュエリーを製作しましょう。

description:

Shima, Mie is the birthplace of pearl cultivation. Thanks to abundant ocean resources and time-honored techniques, Shima pearls are known as being some of the highest quality around the world. title: An authentic Ninja experience on the site of a mountain castle
description:
■Activity details■
Long ago, many mountain castles were built in Iga, where the ninja were valued for their ability to move swiftly when fighting in mountainous terrain. This program offers participants an authentic ninja experience to learn ninjutsu at the site of a mountain castle, just like the ninja of old. The introductory course teaches breathing techniques, mystic hand signs, and fundamental walking techniques based on Iga ninjutsu at an indoor dojo. After lunch, participants will try swinging a sword in the forest, using a grappling hook, concealment techniques, and more while walking through the site of a mountain castle which records say was used for actual ninja training. This program is designed by the Japan Ninja Council, and is part of a rare domestic workshop that offers continuous advancement based on a systematic curriculum.

■コンテンツの概要＆ストーリー■
かつて伊賀には山城が多く築かれ、山岳地帯での戦において山を素早く移動できる忍者は重宝されました。本プログラムは、かつての忍者のように山城を使って忍術を学ぶ、本格的な忍者体験です。初回は「入門編」として、道場（屋内）で伊賀発祥の忍術をベースとした呼吸法や印、歩き方の基礎を学びます。昼食後、実際に忍者が活動した記録の残る山城を散策しながら、山城ならではの森での刀の振り方、鍵縄の使い方、隠れ方等々に挑戦。本プログラムは、日本忍者協議会の忍道プログラムを用いており、体系的なカリキュラムに基づいた継続的なステップアップもできる国内でも珍しいワークショップです。

title: Visit Mie  "Tokowaka"
description:
私たちは木と生きる道を選んだ。
We have chosen to live with trees.
SDG’sと言う言葉が生まれる前から、持続可能な生活を今でも続けている。
Even before the word SDG's was born, he continues to live a sustainable life.
その中心にあるのが「常若」というコンセプトだ。
At the center of the idea is "TOKOWAKA-the concept of constant renewal".
このコンセプトは一見すると理解するのが難しいかもしれない。
This concept may be difficult to understand at first glance.
それはバレエやクラシックのように、見るものを選ぶ一流のアートに似ている。
It resembles top-notch art that chooses what to see, like ballet and classical music.
変わることを繰り返しながら、永遠を生み出す技術と言ってもいい。
It can be said that it is a technology that creates eternity while repeating changes.
これは石と生きる文明の人からすると不思議に見えるかもしれない。
This may seem strange to a civilized person who lives with stones.
ここに住む人は人間は自然の一部と信じているから、ただ自然のサイクル従っている。
People who live here believe that humans are part of nature. So it follows the natural cycle.
この場に宿る、空気と木々と木漏れ日が、何が大切か教えてくれる。
The air, trees and sunbeams in this place tell us what is important.
その信仰の源流がここにある。
The source of that faith is here.

description:

It is located just across the national road from JR Nachi Station on the Kisei Main Line, where the ocean-crossing ascetics are enshrined.
The Hamano-Miya Coast, which stretches in front of Nachi Station, is where the ocean-crossing ascetics set out for Fudarakudokai, sitting in their anchored boats, aiming for the Pure Land of Kannon believed to be at the end of the southern sea for nearly a thousand years since the Heian period.
Please come and visit!

title: 京都市観光PR映像本編_KYOTO PROMOTIONAL MOVIE -Where Every Corner Sparks Discovery-
description:
映像の詳細は、京都市観光協会のホームページをご覧ください。
https://www.kyokanko.or.jp/news/20240430/

～ストーリー～
この旅で初めて会う２人の旅人、マックとカレン、
日本に住むマックは、親友の娘であるカレンを京都案内することになった。

旅は駅でマックが荷物を預けるところからスタートする。
マックが荷物を預ける一方、待ち合わせ場所の観光案内所になかなか到着しないカレン。
マックは伏見へと向かう。

スケジュールを管理しながら京都を巡るマックと、
出会いと直感に導かれて街を駆け抜けるカレン。
時折、２人の旅は交錯しながらも、それぞれのスタイルで京都を旅していく。

滞在最後の日、着物を纏い京懐石を楽しむ２人。
お互いの旅の出来事について会話が弾む。
お店を出て京都の街を歩くと、幻想的な東山の夜があった。

2人は東山を歩きながら地元の人たちが集うバーに辿り着く。
旅の出来事について会話が弾む中、京都の旅の終わりを迎える。

四季が巡り、1年後、カレンは再び京都を訪れる。
京都の静かな朝、木漏れ日に包まれながらお寺を歩く。
これから待つ新たな出会いと発見に静かに心を躍らせながら。

For more details about this video, please visit our website.
https://kyoto.travel/en/see-and-do/we_released_kyoto_city_promotional_videos.html

~Story~
In the historical city of Kyoto, two travelers, Mac and Karen, embark on a unique journey of discovery. Mac, a resident of Japan, offers to guide Karen, his best friend's daughter, to showcase the beauty of Kyoto. Their journey begins at Kyoto Station with Mac checking his luggage, but their paths quickly diverge as Karen loses her way to their meeting point at the Kyoto Tourist Information Center. Mac continues the planned itinerary and visits Fushimi Inari Shrine alone. Karen, guided by instinct and spontaneous encounters, sets off on her own. 
Both travelers weave through the city’s sights as their paths intertwine sporadically, discovering Kyoto’s charms from different perspectives. That evening, adorned in traditional kimonos, they enjoy an exquisite Kyoto kaiseki meal followed by a stroll through the enchanting atmosphere of Higashiyama at night.  On their final night in Kyoto, the two visit a local bar and amid new friends share stories of their discoveries around the ancient capital.
A year later Karen returns to the city. She meanders through a temple in the peaceful morning light, her heart brimming with excitement for the new memories Kyoto promises to unveil.

title: 京都一周トレイル　ダイジェスト
description:
京都の東南、伏見桃山から、比叡山、大原、鞍馬を経て、高雄、嵐山、苔寺に至る全長約83.3キロの４コース（東山、北山東、北山西、西山）と、豊かな森林や清流、田園風景に恵まれた京北地域をめぐる全長約48.7キロの１コースからなる「京都一周トレイル」の紹介動画ダイジェスト版です。
　京都の自然、世界遺産をはじめとする歴史・文化、グルメ情報などを紹介しています。

title: Kyoto Circular Trail Digest
description:
This is a digest video introducing the "Kyoto Circular Trail," which consists of four courses (Higashiyama, Kitayama East, Kitayama West, and Nishiyama) totaling approximately 83.3 kilometers, starting from Fushimi Momoyama in the southeast of Kyoto, passing through Mount Hiei, Ohara, and Kurama, and reaching Takao, Arashiyama, and the Moss Temple, as well as one course of approximately 48.7 kilometers that explores the rich forests, clear streams, and rural landscapes of the Kyoko region.
It introduces Kyoto's nature, historical and cultural heritage including World Heritage sites, and gourmet information.

title: [Kyoto Loop Trail® Official] Keihoku Course
description:
The Kyoto Loop Trail🄬 'Keihoku Course' is an approximately 48.7 km route that circles the nature-rich Keihoku area, which is about an hour by bus from Kyoto Station.
The entire area is included in the Tanba Highlands, with over 90% being forested land. It remains cool even in summer and is blessed with greenery. You can enjoy a stroll filled with attractions such as the Takimata Falls, the famous Jojohōji Temple known for its cherry blossoms, and the suspension bridge at Uogabuchi, as well as breathtaking viewpoints overlooking the satoyama landscape. (This course is slightly more advanced than others.)

title: [Kyoto Circular Trail® Official] Higashiyama Course
description:
The Kyoto Circular Trail🄬 'Higashiyama Course' consists of a route of approximately 9.5 km that circles the Fushimi Momoyama and Fukakusa areas, and a hiking course of about 24.6 km that goes from Fushimi Inari Taisha to Kiyomizu Mountain, Incline, Daimonji Mountain Yotsujima, and then to Mount Hiei.
You can enjoy views of Kyoto's urban area while experiencing rich nature, history, and culture. The course is easily accessible and suitable for beginners.

description:

title: KYOTO SERENDIPITY - シャルロット・ペリアン
description:
「空間にリズムを与える、自由な形」。モダニズムのデザイナー、シャルロット・ペリアンが京都を訪れた際、彼女は変革的なインスピレーションを見出しました。桂離宮の棚は、彼女の有名な『Nuage a Plots』書棚に直接影響を与えました。

桂離宮から河井寛次郎との民藝哲学まで、京都は彼女にとってアイデアの交差点でした。20世紀を形作ったデザインのルーツを探求しましょう。人生のあらゆる瞬間における時を超えた美しさ。

title: KYOTO SERENDIPITY - Charlotte Perriand
description:
"A free form that gives rhythm to space." When modernist designer Charlotte Perriand visited Kyoto, she found a transformative inspiration. The shelving at Katsura Imperial Villa directly inspired her famous "Nuage a Plots“ bookshelf
From the imperial villa to the philosophy of Mingei with Kanjiro Kawai, Kyoto was a meeting ground of ideas for her. Explore the roots of the design that shaped the 20th century. Timeless beauty in every moment of life.

「空間にリズムを与える、自由な形」。 モダニズムの巨匠シャルロット・ペリアン。彼女の代表作である『Nuage a Plots bookshelf』は、実は京都の桂離宮にある「違い棚」から着想を得て生まれたと言われています。
桂離宮の機能美、そして河井寛次郎らとの出会いによる民藝哲学への共感。 20世紀のデザイン史に影響を与えた、「出会い」の物語に触れよう。

title: 京都のセレンディピティ - ジョン・ケージ
description:
「静寂とは、音がないことではなく、心の扉を開くこと」。
伝説的な作曲家ジョン・ケージは、龍安寺の石庭で深い「音の風景」を発見しました。
彼は石をただ観察するだけでなく、その輪郭をなぞって音楽を作り出し、偶然性と虚無の中に美を見出しました。
彼にとって、京都の美意識は音楽そのものでした。
喧騒から離れ、自分自身の静寂を見つけてください。
人生のすべての瞬間に時を超えた美があります。

title: KYOTO SERENDIPITY - John Cage
description:
"Silence is not the absence of sound, but the opening of the mind." Legendary composer John Cage discovered a profound "Soundscape" in the rock garden of Ryoan-ji Temple. He didn't just observe the stones; he traced their outlines to compose music, finding beauty in chance and emptiness.
For him, the aesthetics of Kyoto were like music itself. Step away from the noise and find your own silence. Timeless beauty in every moment of life.

「静寂とは、音がないことではなく、心の扉を開くこと」。 音楽家・ジョン・ケージは、龍安寺の石庭に深いインスピレーションを受けました。彼は石庭を眺めるだけではなく、石の輪郭をなぞることで音を紡ぎ、偶然性と虚無の中に音楽を見出したのです。
彼にとって、京都の美意識は音楽そのものでした。 日常の喧騒を離れ、心研ぎ澄ます静寂の旅へ。

title: 京都のセレンディピティ - イザベラ・バード
description:
「ガイドブックのその先にある、真の京都」。1878年、英国人探検家イザベラ・バードは京都で単なる風景以上のものを見つけました。彼女は人々の日常生活に織り込まれた「清潔さ」、「自尊心」、そして「相互扶助」を目にしました。
彼女の著書『日本の未踏の道』に記したように、「日本の人々はまじめで勤勉で礼儀正しい」。彼女が感動した普遍的な美徳を発見し、人生のあらゆる瞬間に見られる時を超えた美に触れる旅へ。

title: KYOTO SERENDIPITY - Isabella Bird
description:
"Beyond the guidebooks, the true Kyoto awaits." In 1878, British explorer Isabella Bird found more than just scenery in Kyoto. She saw "immaculate cleanliness," "self-respect," and "shared responsibilities" woven into the everyday lives of the people.
As she noted in her book Unbeaten Tracks in Japan: "The Japanese are wonderfully gentle, courteous, and good-tempered." Discover the universal virtues she admired?a timeless beauty found in every moment of life.

「ガイドブックのその先にある、真の京都」。 明治期、1878年に京都を訪れた英国人探検家イザベラ・バード。彼女がこの地で見つけたのは、単なる風景ではなく、人々の暮らしに根付く「清潔さ」「自尊心」、そして「相互扶助」の精神でした。
「日本の人々はまじめで勤勉で礼儀正しい」。 彼女が感動した普遍的な美徳と、受け継がれる暮らしの美に触れる旅へ。

願い事に合った寺社に赴き、「龍の願い玉」を奉納するまでの姿をご覧ください。

「股のぞき☆一龍万倍」
宮津市の天橋立には龍にまつわる伝説が多く残っています。龍の姿そのものにも例えられる神秘的な天橋立ですが、股の間からさかさまな景色をのぞくと、まるで龍が空を舞っているかのように見えることから、縁起の良い景色として知られています。
そんな「龍伝説」と「股のぞき」を掛け合わせ、天橋立に伝わる龍のストーリーを実感し一層パワーを感じて頂ける体験が「股のぞき☆一龍万倍」です。
古くから象徴される、天に昇った龍が如意宝珠（意のままに願いを叶える玉）を授かり降臨する姿にちなんだ“最強の開運体験”で龍とともに運をつかみましょう！
