Please witness the journey to the temple or shrine that matches your wish, where the "Dragon's Wish Ball" will be offered.

"Matanozoki☆Ichiryuu Manbai"
Amanohashidate in Miyazu City is rich with legends related to dragons. The mystical Amanohashidate is often likened to the form of a dragon, and when you look at the inverted scenery through your legs, it appears as if a dragon is soaring through the sky, making it known as a propitious view.
Combining the "Dragon Legend" and "Matanozoki," this experience allows you to feel the story of the dragon passed down in Amanohashidate and enhances your sense of power. This is the "Matanozoki☆Ichiryuu Manbai" experience.
Inspired by the ancient symbolism of a dragon ascending to heaven and bestowing the wish-fulfilling jewel (a ball that grants wishes), let’s seize fortune together with the dragon in this "ultimate fortune experience"!

title: 【夏の富山の絶景】富山市の天空の楽園『白木峰』に行ってきました！車両通行止による迂回路を登る、過酷な登山を是非ご参考にしてください。＜高画質4K＞
description:
#富山市　#白木峰　＃登山

【最新の通行状況のお知らせ】
令和6年5月31日更新
八尾方面から白木峰につながる林道(林道大谷線：白木峰の8合目駐車場まで繋がる林道)が、通行できるようになりました。

令和4年5月26日
白木峰につながる林道は、土砂崩れの影響で、当面の間、車両・徒歩ともに通行できません。
早く林道の開通が再開されることを願います。

令和3年10月1日
白木峰につながる林道について、徒歩による通行が全線で可能となりました。(※動画撮影時は、5合目から7合目まで林道は通行不可でしたので、過酷な登山道を利用した編集内容になっております。)
なお、21世紀の森杉ケ平キャンプ場から先は、10月1日以降も「車両通行止め」措置が継続となりますのでご注意ください。

白木峰一帯は、昭和４９年に白木・水無県立自然公園として選定されています。その中で、白木峰は標高1,596mと特別高い山ではありませんが、太古から気象条件等が複雑に作用し穏やかな美しさをもつ山容が形成され、特徴ある植物を育んできたと考えられています。
　
白木峰では、ブナの芽吹きから始まりシャクナゲやワタスゲ、夏には環日本海を代表するニッコウキスゲが咲き乱れます。秋に入ると、真っ赤に色づいたナナカマドや、山腹は紅葉で燃え上がります。山頂周辺からは、立山連峰、御岳、槍、穂高山、白山の峰々や富山湾が望めるなど景観が見事です。

高山でもないのに「どうして」！
こんなに素晴らしいところがこんな身近にあったなんて！
草原の花と池塘と湿原植物、山から望むはるかなる絶景！
四季の折々の山から醸し出す情景が！
一度訪れたらこの山の虜になってしまいます。


最新の状況や詳細についてはこちらをご覧ください。
【白木峰登山ガイド】

title: [Summer's Spectacular View] I visited Toyama City's Sky Paradise 'Shirakimine'! Please refer to the challenging mountain climbing route that ascends the detour due to vehicle traffic restrictions. <High-Quality 4K>
description:
#ToyamaCity #Shirakimine #MountainClimbing

【Latest Traffic Status Update】
Updated May 31, 2024
The forest road connecting to Shirakimine from the Yao area (Forest Road Otani Line: the forest road leading to the 8th station parking lot of Shirakimine) is now open for traffic.

May 26, 2022
The forest road leading to Shirakimine is currently closed to both vehicles and pedestrians due to landslide damage. We hope for the early reopening of the forest road.

October 1, 2021
The forest road leading to Shirakimine is now fully accessible on foot. (Note: At the time of video recording, the road was closed from the 5th to the 7th station, so the editing content utilized the challenging mountain climbing path.) Please be aware that the 'vehicle traffic restriction' measures will continue beyond the 21st Century Forest Sugihira Campground after October 1.

The Shirakimine area was designated as Shirakimine and Minami Prefectural Natural Park in 1974. Although Shirakimine is not an exceptionally high mountain at 1,596m, it is believed that the complex interplay of weather conditions since ancient times has shaped its gentle beauty and nurtured unique plant life.

At Shirakimine, the season begins with the budding of beech trees, followed by blooming rhododendrons and cotton grass, and in summer, the stunning daylilies representing the entire Japan Sea region. As autumn arrives, the bright red of the rowan trees and the mountainside ablaze with autumn leaves create a breathtaking scene. From the summit area, one can enjoy magnificent views of the Tateyama mountain range, Ontake, Yari, Hotaka, the peaks of Hakusan, and Toyama Bay.

'Why is it so wonderful even though it's not a high mountain?' I never knew such a fantastic place was so close! The flowers of the grasslands, the ponds, and wetland plants, and the distant spectacular views from the mountains! The scenery that changes with the seasons! Once you visit, you will be captivated by this mountain.

For the latest information and details, please check here.

title: 【夏の富山の絶景】開通した称名滝に行ったら、幻の滝とのV字光景が見れた！
description:

当面の間、通行時間は、8時から17時までとなっております。★

称名滝は、富山県屈指の秘境スポットで、落差350ｍの日本一の滝です。
また、国指定の名勝および天然記念物、日本の滝百選にも選ばれています。

４月～５月は残雪残る渓谷に立山連峰の雪解け水が多く流れ込み、称名滝の右側に「ハンノキ滝」が現れ、2つの滝が流れ落ち、豪快なV字形の光景が見れます。

富山市内からは、称名滝の駐車場までは車で約１時間。そして、称名滝の駐車場から滝までは徒歩30分。合計１時間30分程の距離にあります。

※駐車場から滝のスポットまで約30分歩くため、歩きやすい靴がおすすめです。
また、滝の下は水しぶきがあるので、レインコートも持参されることをおススメします。

title: [Summer's Spectacular Toyama] When I visited the newly opened Shomyo Falls, I saw the V-shaped view of the phantom waterfall!
description:
[Latest Information] Updated on June 6, 2022
★As of May 21, 2022 (Saturday), the walking path (approximately 1.3 km) from the parking lot to the waterfall has reopened.
For the time being, the operating hours are from 8 AM to 5 PM.★

Shomyo Falls is one of Toyama Prefecture's top hidden spots, boasting a drop of 350 meters, making it the tallest waterfall in Japan.
It is also designated as a national scenic spot and natural monument, and has been selected as one of Japan's top 100 waterfalls.

From April to May, the melting snow from the Tateyama mountain range flows into the valley with remaining snow, revealing the 'Hannoki Falls' on the right side of Shomyo Falls. The two waterfalls cascade down, creating a magnificent V-shaped view.

From Toyama city, it takes about one hour by car to reach the parking lot of Shomyo Falls. Then, it takes about 30 minutes on foot from the parking lot to the waterfall. The total distance is approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes.

*Since it takes about 30 minutes to walk from the parking lot to the waterfall, comfortable walking shoes are recommended.
Also, as there is water spray at the base of the waterfall, it is advisable to bring a raincoat.

[Shomyo Falls Accessible Period]
Typically from early May to late November *Depending on snow conditions
[Fee]
Free

- About 60 minutes by car from Toyama city center + 30 minutes on foot
- About 50 minutes by car from Tateyama IC on the Hokuriku Expressway + 30 minutes on foot

title: 【夏の富山の絶景】癒しのブナ林と絶景を求め、いざ『牛岳』へ！
description:
＃富山　＃牛岳　＃登山

「牛岳温泉スキー場赤とんぼ広場」から「牛岳頂上」までの約3kmコースは、「牛岳遊歩道」と呼ばれ、人気の登山道として整備されています。

春から夏にかけては、ハイキングや昆虫・植物採取ができ、秋は紅葉した木立の中を歩きながら、図鑑片手にバードウォッチングが楽しめます。

8合目付近の「鍋谷ブナ林」では、背の高いブナが生い茂り、美しい癒しの空間が広がっています。

987mの山頂には、「牛岳大明神」の祠があり、牛に乗った大国主の尊の像がまつられています。また、山頂では、立山連峰から、富山平野、富山湾、砺波平野、白山連峰にわたる360度の大パノラマを堪能できます。

今回の動画は、5合目の「二本杉登山口」から「山頂」までの、登山の様子を紹介しています。※(5合目まで車でアクセス可：駐車場有)

5合目から頂上までは、約1.2kmの距離があり、徒歩で上り約40分、下り約30分の所要時間になります。

また、頂上よりさらに南に進むと「深道ブナ林」があります。約27haに及ぶブナ林で、樹齢300年を超える大木を含む約1,200本のブナの木の群生しており、さらにその林床には、チシマザサやユキツバキが群生しているのが特徴です。これほどの範囲で県内に群生している所は殆どありません。（平成6年富山市指定文化財に登録）
※但し、「深道ブナ林」エリアは、道幅が狭く遊歩道が未整備の箇所もあるため、行かれる際には十分ご注意ください。また、熊等の野生動物が出没する可能性がありますので、熊よけ鈴を携帯するなど十分にご注意ください。

牛岳遊歩道についての詳細ページ

title: [Summer's Spectacular Toyama] Seeking Healing Beech Forests and Scenic Views, Off to 'Ugidake'!
description:
#Toyama #Ugidake #Hiking

The approximately 3km course from 'Ugidake Onsen Ski Resort Akatonbo Plaza' to 'Ugidake Summit' is called the 'Ugidake Walking Path' and is maintained as a popular hiking trail.

From spring to summer, you can enjoy hiking and collecting insects and plants, while in autumn, you can walk among the colorful foliage and enjoy birdwatching with a field guide in hand.

In the vicinity of the 8th station, the 'Nabeya Beech Forest' is filled with tall beech trees, creating a beautiful and healing space.

At the summit, which stands at 987m, there is a shrine dedicated to 'Ugidake Daimyojin', housing a statue of the deity Okuninushi riding a cow. Additionally, from the summit, you can enjoy a 360-degree panoramic view stretching from the Tateyama Mountain Range to Toyama Plain, Toyama Bay, Tonami Plain, and the Hakusan Mountain Range.

This video introduces the hiking experience from the 5th station 'Nibonsugi Trailhead' to the 'Summit'. *(Accessible by car to the 5th station: parking available)*

The distance from the 5th station to the summit is about 1.2km, taking approximately 40 minutes to ascend and 30 minutes to descend on foot.

Furthermore, if you proceed further south from the summit, you will find the 'Fukamichi Beech Forest'. This beech forest spans approximately 27ha and is home to about 1,200 beech trees, including large trees over 300 years old. The forest floor is characterized by clusters of Chishimazasa and Yukitsubaki. There are very few places in the prefecture with such a vast area of beech trees. (Designated as a cultural property by Toyama City in 1994)
*However, please be cautious when visiting the 'Fukamichi Beech Forest' area, as the paths are narrow and some walking paths are not well-maintained. Additionally, there is a possibility of encountering wild animals such as bears, so please take precautions such as carrying bear bells.*

Details about the Ugidake Walking Path

description:
#富山　＃紅葉　＃富山観光

富山市の大沢野にある「寺家公園」は、紅葉の名所で知られています。

当地出身の医師加藤幸次郎氏が私財を投じ、京都の嵐山を模して故郷の里山に木石を配し、昭和５年から１０年の歳月をかけて完成された公園です。

つつじや桜・楓の名所で、富山県指定天然記念物に指定されている「アカガシの群生林」は有名です。また、総延長2.1kmの西国三十三観音巡拝路もあり、春の新緑、秋の紅葉の時期には、多くの家族連れが行楽に訪れています。

title: [Autumn Foliage Spot in Toyama] We went leaf peeping at the beloved autumn destination 'Jike Park'♪
description:
#Toyama #AutumnFoliage #ToyamaTourism

'Jike Park', located in Osawano, Toyama City, is known as a famous spot for autumn foliage.

The park was completed over a period of five to ten years, funded by local physician Kojiro Kato, who modeled it after Arashiyama in Kyoto, arranging trees and stones in his hometown's satoyama.

It is famous for its azaleas, cherry blossoms, and maple trees, and the 'Akagashi Grove', designated as a natural monument by Toyama Prefecture, is particularly well-known. Additionally, there is a 2.1 km pilgrimage route for the 33 Kannon of the Western Country, which attracts many families during the spring greenery and autumn foliage seasons.

*This video was filmed on November 17, 2021.

[Autumn Foliage Period] Mid to late November

title: 【飛騨高山】名料亭で眼福のひとときを。素踊り簡単解説付でご紹介します。
description:
一日限りの特別イベントに潜入レポート！

飛騨高山の名料亭「洲さき」にて谷口裕和氏の素踊りを拝見しました。
谷口氏はこの料亭で育ち、長年の鍛錬を経て、素踊りの名手として、
流派に属さない舞踊家として独立。現在は、東京と飛騨高山に稽古場を持ち、歌舞伎俳優市川中車さんをはじめ、未来の歌舞伎の担い手でもある尾上右近さん片岡千之助さん、市川團子さん、市川勸玄さん、市川ぼたんさんなどの指導を勤められています。

2023年12月4日（月）に日本橋三越本店の三越劇場にて18時半開演で
「別会 谷口裕和の會」が催されます。ご自分の目でご覧いただくと迫力が全く違いますので、これを機会にぜひ足を運んでご覧ください！

I had the pleasure of witnessing Hirokazu Taniguchi's traditional dance at the renowned restaurant 'Susaki' in Hida Takayama.
Taniguchi grew up in this restaurant and, after years of training, became a master of traditional dance, establishing himself as an independent dancer not affiliated with any particular school. He currently has training studios in Tokyo and Hida Takayama, where he teaches future Kabuki performers such as Ichikawa Chusha, Onoue Ukon, Kataoka Chinosuke, Ichikawa Danco, Ichikawa Kangen, and Ichikawa Botan.

On December 4, 2023 (Monday), at 6:30 PM, 'Betsukai Hirokazu Taniguchi's Association' will be held at the Mitsukoshi Theater in Nihonbashi Mitsukoshi Main Store. The impact is completely different when you see it with your own eyes, so please take this opportunity to attend!

#HidaTakayama
#TraditionalPerformingArts
#TraditionalDance
#HirokazuTaniguchi

title: 絶景を望む極上リゾートホテル『山人-oga-』誕生！
description:
皆さまこんにちは。
2025年5月に完成した秋田男鹿半島の『山人 -oga-』のご紹介です。

秋田と岩手の県境にある『山人』さんへ何度か宿泊していて
お料理が美味しかったのが記憶に残っています。

今年、男鹿半島に新しいお宿が完成し、
温泉が2025年10月から開始になったので行ってきました。

男鹿の大地を一望する絶好のロケーション。
全てのお部屋(全16室)がオーシャンビューです。
ここのお部屋に住みたいほどの居心地の良さったら！

食事は素敵なレストランで、
男鹿の食材を活かしたお料理が頂けます。

ラウンジではコーヒーなどの飲み物やアイスクリームなども
無料で頂けて、最高です。

とてつもなく贅沢な時間を過ごせますので
皆様もぜひ一度行ってみてください！

#男鹿半島

title: A Luxurious Resort Hotel 'Yamato -oga-' with a Stunning View is Born!
description:
Hello everyone.

I would like to introduce 'Yamato -oga-', which was completed in May 2025 on the Oga Peninsula in Akita.

I have stayed at 'Yamato' several times, located on the border of Akita and Iwate, and I remember the delicious food.

This year, a new accommodation has been completed on the Oga Peninsula, and the hot springs will start in October 2025, so I went to check it out.

It has a perfect location with a panoramic view of the Oga land.
All rooms (16 in total) have an ocean view.
The comfort of these rooms makes you want to live here!

The meals are served in a wonderful restaurant, featuring dishes that utilize local ingredients from Oga.

In the lounge, you can enjoy drinks like coffee and ice cream for free, which is fantastic.

You can spend an incredibly luxurious time, so I highly recommend everyone to visit at least once!


#AkitaTravel
#OgaPeninsula
#Yamato

description:

title: 季節の風景⑦（城山公園・ヤマボウシ）
description:
もてぎあいあいチャンネルで放送している季節の風景です。
今回は、茂木町市街地にある城山公園のヤマボウシをお届けします。

城山公園は、桜、彼岸花など茂木町の花の名所の一つです。
自然いっぱいの公園には四季を通じて様々な花が来る人の目を楽しませてくれます。
頂上には駐車場、トイレもありますので、天気のいい日には、のんびりお散歩が最高です！
頂上までの道は狭いので、運転には十分注意してお越しください。

花がない時期でも、茂木町の市街地を一望できます。

title: Seasonal Scenery ⑦ (Shiroyama Park - Yamaboushi)
description:
This is the seasonal scenery broadcasted on the Motegi Ai Ai Channel.
This time, we present the Yamaboushi at Shiroyama Park located in the city of Motegi.

Shiroyama Park is one of the famous flower spots in Motegi Town, featuring cherry blossoms, higanbana, and more.
The park, full of nature, delights visitors with various flowers throughout the seasons.
At the top, there is a parking lot and restrooms, making it perfect for a leisurely stroll on a nice day!
Please be cautious while driving as the road to the top is narrow.

Even during times when flowers are not in bloom, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the city of Motegi.

description:

title: 今治市+CYCLEプロモーション動画『Sea Area Activities』ver
description:
今治市には、緑豊かな山間・里山エリアから世界有数の多島美を誇る瀬戸内しまなみ海道・とびしま海道エリアまで変化に富んだ地勢であり、近年では、瀬戸内しまなみ海道が｢サイクリストの聖地｣として国のナショナルサイクルルートの指定を受けるなど、世界ブランド化に向けた取組みが進められています。

　一方で、しまなみ海道エリア等を含む本市には、豊かな自然を活用した様々なアウトドア＆アクティビティフィールドや観光資源が点在しており、これらの資源に本市観光の主軸であるサイクリングを組み合わせた｢＋CYCLE（プラスサイクル）事業｣により、自転車愛好家のみならず他アクティビティ愛好家にもサイクリングに興味を持ってもらうなど双方向の取組みを推進することで、本市全体の新たな魅力の創出を図るとともに滞在型観光及び誘客促進に繋げることを事業目的としています。

　この動画は、Sea Area（海エリア）の観光イメージ映像です。是非ご覧ください。

title: Imabari City + CYCLE Promotional Video 'Sea Area Activities' ver
description:
Imabari City features a diverse topography, ranging from lush mountainous and satoyama areas to the world-renowned scenic beauty of the Setouchi Shimanami Kaido and Tobishima Kaido areas. In recent years, the Setouchi Shimanami Kaido has been designated as a 'sacred place for cyclists' as part of the national cycle route initiative, promoting efforts towards becoming a global brand.

On the other hand, our city, which includes the Shimanami Kaido area, is dotted with various outdoor and activity fields and tourism resources that utilize its rich natural environment. Through the '+CYCLE' project, which combines cycling—our city's main tourism focus—with these resources, we aim to promote mutual engagement not only among cycling enthusiasts but also among other activity lovers, thereby creating new attractions for the entire city and contributing to stay-type tourism and visitor promotion.

This video is a promotional image of the Sea Area. Please take a look.

　元和元年（1615）信雄（織田信長の二男）は、大和松山（奈良県宇陀市）と上野（群馬県）小幡合わせて五万石の領主となり、子の信良が入封して小幡織田氏の藩政が始まった。
　３代信昌は、祖父信雄の遺命（死に際してのこした命令）により、松山三万石を後見役であった叔父の織田高長に譲り、小幡二万石のみとなった。
　その後、明和４年（1767）の事件で、出羽高畠（山形県高畠町）に移封されるまで、８代１５２年にわたり小幡藩を統治した。
　織田氏の墓石はいずれも五輪塔で、初代信雄から、信良－信昌－信久－信就－信右－信富の歴代順に並んでいて、大名家の墓所らしい風格を見せている。　
　織田氏は初め、轟の宝積寺を菩提寺（先祖の墓や位牌をまつる寺）としていたが、４代信久の時、崇福寺に移している。崇福寺は宝暦８年（1758）と明治４年（1871）の火災により、５代以下の墓石は火炎を受け破損している。

title: Oda Koen Park (Kanra Town, Gunma Prefecture)
description:
Location: 1416 Obata, Kanra Town
Designated Historical Site of Kanra Town: June 20, 1963

Visit the Kanra Town website here → https://www.town.kanra.lg.jp/index.html

At Suifukuji Temple, there are the graves of seven generations from Oda Nobuhiro, the lord of the Obata domain, to Nobutomi.
In the first year of Genna (1615), Nobuhiro (the second son of Oda Nobunaga) became the lord of a combined 50,000 koku in Yamato Matsuyama (Uda City, Nara Prefecture) and Obata (Gunma Prefecture), and his son Nobuyoshi entered the domain, marking the beginning of the Obata Oda clan's rule.
The third generation, Nobumasa, following the last wishes (orders left at the time of death) of his grandfather Nobuhiro, ceded 30,000 koku of Matsuyama to his uncle Oda Takanaga, becoming the lord of only 20,000 koku in Obata.
After that, until the incident in the fourth year of Meiwa (1767), they governed the Obata domain for 152 years across eight generations.
The gravestones of the Oda clan are all five-ring pagodas, arranged in order from the first generation Nobuhiro to Nobuyoshi, Nobumasa, Nobuhisa, Nobushige, Nobuemon, and Nobutomi, showcasing the dignified appearance typical of a feudal lord's burial site.
Initially, the Oda clan used the Hojuji Temple in Todoroki as their family temple (a temple for ancestral graves and memorial tablets), but during the time of the fourth generation Nobuhisa, they moved to Suifukuji Temple. Due to fires in the 8th year of Hōreki (1758) and the 4th year of Meiji (1871), the gravestones of the fifth generation and beyond were damaged by flames.

title: 串柿
description:
http://www.katsuragi-kanko.jp/kusigakinosato.html

串柿の里として400年の昔から歴史と伝統を育んできた四郷(しごう)。 のどかな山里からは紀ノ川の清流を眼下に国道24号沿いの町並みを見渡して、はるか雨引山、龍門山、高野山、大峰山を遠望できます。

東谷、平、滝、広口の四つの村を総称して四郷(しごう)といいます。
400年の昔から串柿の特産地として、現在に引き継がれています。

11月も秋が深まり、串柿作りが始まると農家の軒先や周囲の干場に柿の玉のれんが一斉に吊るされ山里は柿一色に染まります。
その見事な風景は晩秋の風物詩として全国に知られ、訪れる人々を楽しませています。また山沿いに点在する村からの展望は息をのむほど美しく、春から夏にかけての新緑の季節は心までも緑に染まります…

title: Kushigaki
description:
http://www.katsuragi-kanko.jp/kusigakinosato.html

Shigō has nurtured its history and tradition as a place of kushigaki (dried persimmons) for 400 years. From this tranquil mountain village, one can overlook the clear stream of the Kinokawa River below and gaze at the town along National Route 24, with distant views of Mount Amabiki, Mount Ryūmon, Mount Kōya, and Mount Ōmine.

The four villages of Higashitani, Hira, Taki, and Hirokuchi are collectively referred to as Shigō. For 400 years, it has been passed down as a specialty area for kushigaki.

As November deepens into autumn and the production of kushigaki begins, the eaves of farmers' houses and the surrounding drying areas are adorned with hanging strings of persimmons, dyeing the mountain village in shades of orange. This magnificent scenery is known nationwide as an autumnal spectacle, delighting visitors. Additionally, the views from the scattered villages along the mountains are breathtakingly beautiful, and the fresh green season from spring to summer colors the heart in green...

title: 天野の風景
description:
http://www.katsuragi-kanko.jp/amanonosato.html

■登場する風景
　・田園
　・丹生都比売神社
　・二つ鳥居
　・二つ鳥居から見た天野

標高450mの天野盆地は、四季折々の田園風景がひろがります。
また「歴史の里　天野」は1700年前の丹生明神や1200年前の
空海にまつわる史跡が数多く点在します。「にほんの里100選」にも
選ばれた天野は、まさに「癒しの里」です。

天野の里は、和歌山県北東部のかつらぎ町南部にあり、国道２４号線より南へ車で１５分、高野山のふもと標高約４５０ｍに
位置しています。四季折々のどかな田園風景が広がる天野盆地は、『にほんの里100選』にも選ばれています。
１９９８（平成元年）年には、環境庁（現環境省）から『ふるさと生きものの里』に認定され、初夏、
今なお清い流れを守る真国川では源氏ボタルの乱舞が見られ、豊かな自然に恵まれた地域です。
「日本の原風景」と謳われる地は多いですが、特に天野は四季折々の変化に富み、ことに
春の新緑、秋のまばゆいばかりの稲穂の波は美しく、まさに桃源郷を想わせます。

白洲正子さんは、著書「かくれ里」の一節で…
「まだかまだかと思ううち、峠を二つばかり越えたところで下り坂となり、
いきなり目の前が明るくなった。見渡す限り、まばゆいばかりの稲の波だ。
こんな山の天辺に、田圃があろうとは想像もしなかったが、それはまことに
「天野」の名にふさわしい天の一角に開けた広大な野原であった。もしかすると
高天原も、こういう地形のところを　いったのかも知れない」「ずいぶん方々旅を
したが、こんなに閑でうっとりするような山村を私は知らない」「できることなら
ここに隠居したい。桃源郷とは正にこういう所をいうのだろう」と記されました。

かつて空海を高野山にみちびいたとされる真言密教の守り神、
丹生都比売神社が鎮座する天野は、開山後、高野のかくれ里と呼ばれました。
高野山が女人禁制であったことから出家していつの日か逢えることを楽しみに、
高野の麓、天野に移り住む人も多く、それにまつわる多くの史跡が点在します。
また、源平時代の史跡もあり、まさに歴史ロマンの里・信仰の里
でもあります。

title: Amano Landscape
description:
http://www.katsuragi-kanko.jp/amanonosato.html

■Scenery Appearing
　・Rural Landscape
　・Niu Tohime Shrine
　・Two Torii Gates
　・Amano as Seen from the Two Torii Gates

At an elevation of 450m, the Amano Basin offers a rural landscape that changes with the seasons. 
Moreover, "Historical Village Amano" is dotted with numerous historical sites related to Niu Myojin from 1700 years ago and Kukai from 1200 years ago. Selected as one of the "100 Best Villages in Japan," Amano is truly a "Healing Village."

Amano is located in the southern part of Katsuragi Town in the northeastern part of Wakayama Prefecture, about 15 minutes by car south of National Route 24, at the foot of Mount Koya at an elevation of approximately 450m. The Amano Basin, with its tranquil rural scenery throughout the seasons, has also been selected as one of the "100 Best Villages in Japan." In 1998, it was certified as a "Hometown of Living Creatures" by the Environment Agency (now the Ministry of the Environment), and in early summer, the Genji Fireflies can be seen dancing in the still pure waters of the Makuni River, making it a region blessed with rich nature. 
While many places are praised as "Japan's Original Scenery," Amano, in particular, is rich in seasonal changes, especially the fresh greenery of spring and the dazzling waves of rice ears in autumn, evoking the image of a paradise.

Masako Shirase wrote in her book "Hidden Village":
"As I wondered when it would come, after crossing a couple of mountain passes, the descent began, and suddenly the view brightened. As far as the eye could see, there were dazzling waves of rice. I never imagined there would be rice fields at the top of such a mountain, but it was indeed a vast field that opened up in a corner of heaven worthy of the name 'Amano.' Perhaps Takamagahara was also a place with such terrain."
"I have traveled quite a bit, but I have never known such a quiet and enchanting mountain village. If possible, I would like to retire here. This is precisely what is meant by a paradise."

Amano, where the guardian deity of Shingon Esoteric Buddhism, Niu Tohime Shrine, is enshrined, is said to have guided Kukai to Mount Koya. After its establishment, it was called the hidden village of Koya. Since Mount Koya was off-limits to women, many people moved to Amano at the foot of Koya, looking forward to the day they could meet again, and many historical sites related to this can be found scattered throughout the area. Additionally, there are historical sites from the Genpei era, making it a place rich in historical romance and faith.

title: [360度動画]小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館 記念館探検[VR体験] Kodaira Tokyo Japan360° VIDEO
description:
小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館の記念館をVR体験できる360度動画です。
ぜひ、スマートフォンのyoutubeアプリからご視聴ください

[平櫛田中彫刻美術館の概要]
東京都小平市学園西町1-7-5
Tel&Fax:042-341-0098

西武多摩湖線「一橋学園駅」から徒歩10分


小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館は、日本近代彫刻の巨匠・平櫛田中の作品を保存・展示し、ながくその功績を顕彰するとともに、市民文化の向上を図ることを目的として、昭和59年に平櫛田中の旧宅を公開し、「小平市平櫛田中館」として開館しました。その後、平成6年に展示館を新築し、平成17年に遺族から作品の寄贈を受けたことを機に、平成18年4月に館名を「小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館」へ変更し、現在に至っています。

主な美術館活動として、田中が遺した彫刻、書、資料を中心とする通常展示のほか、平櫛田中と関係の深い作家の作品紹介を中心とする特別展（2年に1回の隔年開催）を開催し、田中芸術への理解が深められるような企画・展示を行っています。

また、春と秋の2回開催するお茶会や、夏休みに小学生とその保護者を対象としたワークショップ「親子で美術館」もご好評いただいております。

近年では美術館ボランティアを組織し、市民との協働により美術館活動のさらなる活性化と充実を目指しております。

title: 【絶景茨城】牛久大仏 ［4K］茨城県牛久市｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description:
牛久大仏は、浄土真宗東本願寺派本山東本願寺が事業主体。この浄土真宗の開祖が、親鸞聖人（1173年～1262年）です。親鸞は後鳥羽上皇の怒りを買い、1207年に越後国に流罪に処せられます。その4年後に赦免された後、常陸国（現在の茨城県）に入り、関東における布教の拠点としました。県内には親鸞ゆかりの寺や事跡が多く残っており、この牛久の地もそのひとつです。
事業構想は1983年に着手、1986年に工事が着工し、1992年12月に完成した。事業主体は浄土真宗東本願寺派本山東本願寺。
その姿は同派の本尊である阿弥陀如来像の形状を拡大したものである。
全高120m（像高100m、台座20m）を誇り、奈良の大仏（像高14.98m）が掌に乗り、アメリカ合衆国ニューヨーク州にある自由の女神像（全高93m、手を掲げた姿勢の像高さ46.05m）の実質的な像高（足元から頭頂までの高さ33.86m）の3倍近くの大きさである。

title: [Spectacular Ibaraki] Ushiku Daibutsu [4K] Ushiku City, Ibaraki Prefecture | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
The Ushiku Daibutsu is a project initiated by the Higashi Honganji sect of Jodo Shinshu. The founder of this Jodo Shinshu sect is Shinran Shonin (1173-1262). Shinran incurred the wrath of Emperor Go-Toba and was exiled to Echigo Province in 1207. Four years later, after being pardoned, he entered Hitachi Province (now Ibaraki Prefecture) and established a base for propagation in the Kanto region. Many temples and historical sites related to Shinran remain in the prefecture, and this area of Ushiku is one of them.
The project began in 1983, construction started in 1986, and it was completed in December 1992. The project was led by the Higashi Honganji sect of Jodo Shinshu.
Its form is an enlarged version of the Amida Nyorai statue, which is the principal object of worship of this sect.
Standing at a total height of 120 meters (100 meters for the statue and 20 meters for the pedestal), it is nearly three times the height of the Great Buddha of Nara (which is 14.98 meters tall) and the effective height of the Statue of Liberty in New York, USA (which has a total height of 93 meters and an effective statue height of 33.86 meters from feet to top of the head).

title: [Spectacular Ibaraki] Lotus Fields | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
In Ibaraki Prefecture, which boasts the highest production of lotus root in Japan, lotus flowers can be seen blooming around Lake Kasumigaura from July to August. The lotus flowers blooming beside the vast lake captivate people with the sunlight shimmering on the water's surface.

In autumn, the leaves turn brown and begin to wither.
During the harvesting of lotus root, a method called "water digging" is employed to bring the lotus roots to the surface. Care is taken to wash off the mud gently after digging them up to avoid damaging the skin of the lotus root. Their plump, round shape and soft texture, along with a hint of sweetness, are truly appealing.

Thanks to the abundant water resources and fertile soil of Lake Kasumigaura, delicious lotus roots loved throughout Japan are cultivated.

#Kasumigaura #LotusRoot #Lotus #Ibaraki

title: [Spectacular Ibaraki / Japan Heritage] Kodokan [4K] Mito City, Ibaraki Prefecture | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
[Date of filming: 2015.5.27] Kodokan, a nationally designated special historic site and important cultural property located in Mito City, Ibaraki Prefecture. Established in 1842 by Tokugawa Nariaki, the 9th lord of the Mito domain, it is the largest domain school in Japan. The last shogun, Tokugawa Yoshinobu, also studied at this location during his childhood and lived in seclusion here after the restoration of imperial rule. This time, we were able to capture footage of parts that are usually not visible, such as the actual 'bird's-eye view' (chōkanzu), the interior of the Confucius Temple, and the monument of Kodokan housed in the Hakkadō.

description:
[Date of filming: 2015.5.11] 
Lake Kasumigaura, a rare brackish lake in Japan where seawater and freshwater mix. It is located almost in the center of Ibaraki Prefecture, spanning Ibaraki Town, Hokota City, and Oarai Town. title: [Spectacular Ibaraki] Cherry Blossoms [4K] Tsukuba Mirai City, Ibaraki Prefecture | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
[Date of filming: 2015.4.2]

In Tsukuba Mirai City, there is one of the three major dams in Kanto, the 'Fukuoka Dam.' The Fukuoka Dam is also famous as a cherry blossom viewing spot, and every year the 'Fukuoka Dam Cherry Blossom Festival' is held.
It has been selected as one of Ibaraki's top 100 tourist attractions, and you can see a tunnel of cherry blossoms with about 600 trees blooming along a 1.8 km promenade.

Additionally, Kirakuyama Fureai Hill, which is a place for citizens to relax, showcases a stunning corridor of cherry trees in spring at the entrance of the facility.

description:
「常陸秋そば」は、茨城が全国に誇るブランド品種。香り、味わいに優れ、通をも唸らせるほどの逸品です。1978年に旧・金砂郷町（常陸太田市）の在来種から高品質種が選抜され、育成されました。その後は県内各地で栽培されるようになり、常陸太田市、常陸大宮市、稲敷市、土浦市、筑西市、結城市、下妻市などが主な産地になっています。合わせて「そばまつり」も各地で開催されています。常陸秋そばは、秋の茨城の風物詩となっています。

title: [Breathtaking Ibaraki] Hitachi Aki Soba [4K] Hitachi Ota City, Ibaraki Prefecture | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: "Hitachi Aki Soba" is a brand variety that Ibaraki proudly boasts nationwide. It excels in aroma and flavor, making it a masterpiece that even connoisseurs rave about. In 1978, high-quality strains were selected and cultivated from the local variety in the former Kinasagō Town (Hitachi Ota City). Since then, it has been cultivated in various regions of the prefecture, with Hitachi Ota City, Hitachi Ōmiya City, Inashiki City, Tsuchiura City, Chikusei City, Yūki City, and Shimotsuma City being the main production areas. Additionally, "soba festivals" are held in various locations. Hitachi Aki Soba has become a seasonal symbol of autumn in Ibaraki.

title: 【絶景茨城】茨城の紅葉｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description:
茨城県の紅葉の名所を、空撮を交えてご紹介します。

筑波山は、1000種以上の珍しい植物が群生する植物の宝庫で、登山やハイキングなど年間を通して自然に親しめるのが魅力です。

花貫渓谷は、渓谷にかかる汐見滝吊り橋からの眺めが素晴らしく、清流や汐見滝を楽しめるほか、秋には川沿いを華やかな紅葉が彩ります。

花園渓谷は、花園花貫県立自然公園に指定されている花園川上流一帯の渓谷で、麓には花園神社が立ちます。秋には色づいた紅葉が花園川に舞い落ち、ひときわ美しい風景を見せてくれます。

竜神大吊橋は、竜神ダムの湖面から高さ100mの位置に架かる橋です。橋の長さは歩行者専用として国内最大級の375mを誇り、橋の上からは四季折々のパノラマが広がります。

袋田の滝は日本三名瀑の一つです。滝が四段に落下することや、四季に一度ずつ訪れなければ本当の良さがわからないとも言われ、別名「四度の滝」とも呼ばれています。

title: [Spectacular Ibaraki] Autumn Leaves in Ibaraki | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
We introduce the famous autumn foliage spots in Ibaraki Prefecture, featuring aerial shots.

Mount Tsukuba is a treasure trove of over 1,000 rare plant species, making it attractive for nature lovers throughout the year with activities like climbing and hiking.

The Hananuki Valley offers stunning views from the Shioimi Falls suspension bridge, where visitors can enjoy the clear stream and Shioimi Falls, while in autumn, the riverside is adorned with vibrant autumn leaves.

Hananora Valley is a gorge located in the upper reaches of the Hananora River, designated as Hananora Hananuki Prefectural Natural Park, with Hananora Shrine at its base. In autumn, the colorful leaves fall onto the Hananora River, creating an exceptionally beautiful landscape.

The Ryujin Big Suspension Bridge is a bridge that spans 100 meters above the surface of the Ryujin Dam lake. With a length of 375 meters, it boasts one of the largest pedestrian-only bridges in Japan, offering panoramic views of the changing seasons from the bridge.

Fukuroda Falls is one of Japan's three famous waterfalls. It is said that the waterfall's four-tiered drop and the need to visit each season to truly appreciate its beauty have earned it the nickname 'Four Times Falls.'

description: ここは、愛媛県松山市にある松山城です。松山城には、加藤嘉明の鎧や当時使われていた武器が展示されています。その他にも、武装服を試着できたり、松山城小天守復興の様子のビデオを視聴することもできます。そして、天守閣では360°のパノラマを見ることができます！RyoFさんが松山城入口までの景色を撮影しております！→https://youtu.be/T1l3eHh-TaQ

title: I visited Matsuyama Castle's Main Keep!
description: This is Matsuyama Castle located in Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture. Matsuyama Castle displays armor worn by Kato Yoshiaki and weapons used at that time. Additionally, you can try on armored clothing and watch a video of the restoration of the Matsuyama Castle's small keep. Furthermore, you can enjoy a 360° panorama from the main keep! RyoF has captured the scenery leading to the entrance of Matsuyama Castle! → https://youtu.be/T1l3eHh-TaQ

title: 大洲城に行ってきました！
description: ここは、愛媛県大洲市大洲９０３にある大洲城です。大洲城には、2004年に復元された天守をはじめ、国指定重要文化財に選定された4棟の櫓があります。そしてこの動画の最後には、愛媛県松山市を流れる宮前川にいたコガモを撮影しております。

title: I visited Ozu Castle!
description: This is Ozu Castle, located at 903 Ozu, Ozu City, Ehime Prefecture. Ozu Castle features a main keep that was restored in 2004, along with four turrets designated as Important Cultural Properties by the national government. At the end of this video, we also captured footage of a female teal that was in the Miyamae River flowing through Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture.

title: 大洲城 歓迎はたふり
description: このイベントは、愛媛県大洲市大洲９０３にある大洲城で行われている「大洲城 歓迎はたふり」です！大洲城では、JR四国の観光列車「伊予灘ものがたり」が鉄橋をゆっくり渡るとき、大洲城本丸からのぼり旗を振って、歓迎しています。開催日は毎週土・日・祝日、時間は15:16頃と16:25頃の２回です。参加無料です。 そしてこの動画の最後には、愛媛県松山市を流れる宮前川にいたコガモを撮影しております。

title: Ozu Castle Welcome Hataburi
description: This event is called 'Ozu Castle Welcome Hataburi' and takes place at Ozu Castle located at 903 Ozu, Ozu City, Ehime Prefecture! At Ozu Castle, we wave welcome flags from the main keep when the JR Shikoku sightseeing train 'Iyodan Monogatari' slowly crosses the bridge. The event is held every Saturday, Sunday, and public holiday, with two sessions at around 15:16 and 16:25. Participation is free. At the end of this video, we also captured a female duck (Kogamo) in the Miyamae River flowing through Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture.

title: 名古屋おもてなし武将隊の演武を見てきました！
description: この演武は、平成30年(2018年)1月28日に堀之内と松山城で行われた「第５回 全国城サミットin松山」です。この演武では、織田信長と豊臣秀吉と徳川家康の楽しい話を聞いて楽しめます！そして、演武終了後は、織田信長と豊臣秀吉と徳川家康と一緒に写真撮影ができます！ 丸亀城鉄砲隊の演武はこちら！→https://youtu.be/lgCToSMmet4

title: I went to see the performance of the Nagoya Omotenashi Busho-tai!
description: This performance took place on January 28, 2018, at Horinouchi and Matsuyama Castle during the "5th National Castle Summit in Matsuyama." In this performance, you can enjoy fun stories about Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Tokugawa Ieyasu! After the performance, you can take photos with Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Tokugawa Ieyasu! You can see the performance of the Marugame Castle Gun Corps here! → https://youtu.be/lgCToSMmet4

title: 丸亀城鉄砲隊の演武を見てきました！
description: このイベントは、愛媛県松山市の堀之内で行われた「第５回 全国城サミットin松山」の丸亀城鉄砲隊の演武です。この演武では、安土桃山時代に使われていた火縄銃の迫力を感じることができます。実際の安土桃山時代の迫力を感じてみて下さい！ 名古屋おもてなし武将隊の演武はこちら！→https://youtu.be/nSs7-jqvqVQ

title: I Went to See the Demonstration of the Marugame Castle Gun Corps!
description: This event is the demonstration of the Marugame Castle Gun Corps at the '5th National Castle Summit in Matsuyama' held in Horinouchi, Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture. In this demonstration, you can experience the power of the matchlock guns used during the Azuchi-Momoyama period. Feel the actual intensity of the Azuchi-Momoyama period! You can watch the performance of the Nagoya Hospitality Samurai Corps here! → https://youtu.be/nSs7-jqvqVQ

description:
ここは、愛媛県宇和島市にある宇和島城です。宇和島城は、標高80mの丘上に築かれた平山城です。伊達氏2代宗利が大改修し現在の形になってます。天守閣は国指定重要文化財です。 天守編→https://youtu.be/niqMlrwPq6M

#宇和島城 #愛媛県宇和島市 #伊達藩

title: I visited Uwajima Castle! (Castle Climbing Edition)
description:
This is Uwajima Castle located in Uwajima City, Ehime Prefecture. Uwajima Castle is a flatland castle built on a hill with an elevation of 80m. It was significantly renovated by the second generation of the Date clan, Muneyoshi, to take its current form. The main keep is designated as an important cultural property by the country. Main keep edition → https://youtu.be/niqMlrwPq6M

#UwajimaCastle #UwajimaCity #DateDomain

title: 愛媛県四国中央市「川之江城」に行ってみた！
description:
ここは、愛媛県四国中央市にある川之江城です。川之江は、昭和61年(1986年)に天守閣、涼櫓、櫓門、空塀などが整備された城で、瀬戸内の島々の眺望が素晴らしく、桜の名所として多くの観光客が訪れている場所です。皆さんも是非行ってみて下さい。

#川之江城 #城 #愛媛県四国中央市

title: I Went to Kawanoe Castle in Shikokuchuo City, Ehime Prefecture!
description: This is Kawanoe Castle located in Shikokuchuo City, Ehime Prefecture. Kawanoe is a castle that was developed in 1986 (Showa 61) with its main keep, cool turret, turret gate, and sky walls, offering a wonderful view of the islands of the Seto Inland Sea. It is a famous cherry blossom spot that attracts many tourists. Please make sure to visit!

description:
[Overview]
In Amano Village, a sacred place for Shugendo, we created a video that invites viewers to experience a quiet mountain climb, as if taking a deep and slow 'breath of the heart.'
With each step up the mountain, we aimed to express the sensation of having one's heart cleansed, and the moment of liberation as one gazes at the breathtaking view from the summit.
Why not find a special time in Amano Village to step away from the hustle and bustle of daily life, face yourself, and refresh your heart from deep within?

title: 【高画質】阿蘇山観音まつり
description:
令和5年4月13日、阿蘇市黒川の西巌殿寺で「阿蘇山観音まつり」が行われ、山伏姿の行者らが行う荒行「火渡り」「湯立て」に参加しようと、多くの参拝者が集まりました。

ヒノキの葉っぱなどでこしらえた護摩壇に火が入ると、山伏姿の行者らが厳かにお経を唱えながら、願いごとが書かれた護摩木を火に投げ入れて無病息災を祈願。そして燃え続ける火の上を裸足で渡る「火渡り」が行われました。

一般の参拝者は、火の勢いが衰えたあと、行者らに続いて灰の上を裸足で歩き、最後にはぐらぐらと煮えたぎった湯しぶきを浴びる荒行「湯立て」に参加して一年間の無病息災を祈りました。

この阿蘇山観音まつりは西南戦争で殉職した西巌殿寺の住職、厨亮俊僧の招魂祭として、命日である4月13日に例年行われています。

#阿蘇 
#火渡り
#湯立て

title: [High Quality] Aso Mountain Kannon Festival
description:
On April 13, 2023, the 'Aso Mountain Kannon Festival' was held at the Saigandaji Temple in Kurokawa, Aso City, where many worshippers gathered to participate in the ascetic practices of 'fire walking' and 'water purification' performed by practitioners dressed as yamabushi.

As the fire was lit on the goma altar made of hinoki leaves and other materials, the yamabushi solemnly chanted sutras while throwing goma sticks inscribed with their wishes into the flames, praying for good health and safety. Then, the 'fire walking' ritual was conducted, where participants walked barefoot over the burning fire.

After the intensity of the fire diminished, general worshippers followed the practitioners and walked barefoot over the ashes, ultimately participating in the intense 'water purification' ritual, where they were splashed with boiling water, praying for a year of good health and safety.

This Aso Mountain Kannon Festival is held annually on April 13, the anniversary of the death of the temple's priest, Ryojun Churi, who died in the Seinan War, as a memorial service for his spirit.

#Aso
#FireWalking
#WaterPurification

title: 千年の草原
description:
九州熊本県阿蘇地方。
27万年前からの度重なる大噴火で出来たカルデラと呼ばれるくぼ地に、約5万人が暮らす、世界でも珍しい場所です。
カルデラの中央には、今も噴煙を上げる活火山阿蘇山がそびえ、その周辺には日本最大の草原地帯が広がります。
この唯一無二の空間は、国立公園、ユネスコ世界ジオパーク、世界農業遺産にも認定されています。

#阿蘇の草原 #サステナブル #千年の草原

title: Thousand-Year Grassland
description:
Aso region in Kumamoto Prefecture, Kyushu.

This is a rare place in the world where about 50,000 people live in a caldera, a depression formed by repeated massive eruptions over the past 270,000 years.

At the center of the caldera stands the active volcano Mount Aso, which still emits smoke, and surrounding it is Japan's largest grassland area.

This unique space has been designated as a national park, a UNESCO Global Geopark, and a World Agricultural Heritage site.

#AsoGrassland #Sustainable #ThousandYearGrassland

title: [Nature 4K] 'Aso Wildfire' High-Quality Healing Video
description:
A series capturing the rich landscapes of Aso with a 4K camera, 'SCENE of the ASO'.

Vol.6 features the springtime tradition of Aso, the 'wildfire'.

The grasslands that spread across Aso not only serve as pastures for cattle and horses and provide winter feed, but they also absorb large amounts of rain, becoming the source of six first-class rivers and acting as the water reservoir for Kyushu.
Additionally, rare flora and fauna unique to the grasslands thrive and inhabit the area, and the wildfires have been maintaining these grasslands for over a thousand years.

This time, we will focus on the 'wildfire experience event' organized by 'Asotan Guide Tours', where participants can experience lighting the fire during the wildfire held in the Kokamaki area of Aso City.

The footage captured with a long take can be enjoyed even more by watching it at double speed, allowing you to appreciate the wildfire experience.

title: [Nature 4K] 'Aso Shime Nawa Making' High-Quality Healing Video
description:
A series capturing the rich landscapes of Aso with a 4K camera, 'SCENE of the ASO'.

Vol. 4 features the year-end tradition of Aso, the making of shime nawa at Aso Shrine.

The large shime nawa displayed at Aso Shrine's worship hall has been offered every year by the 'Ichinomiya Town Great Shime Nawa Inheritance Association', made up of local devotees, for over 30 years.

This year, preparations began in earnest in October, and a 7.5-meter long, 150-kilogram large shime nawa was completed by 17 members, woven from rice straw.

On December 8, 2021, it was offered to Aso Shrine, and the beautiful, lush large shime nawa was displayed in the newly rebuilt worship hall, which had just completed restoration work from the Kumamoto earthquake in June this year.

As we welcome the first New Year with the rebuilt worship hall, we invite you to visit Aso Shrine for your first shrine visit of the year.

自然豊かな阿蘇の風景を4Kカメラで撮影するシリーズ『SCENE of the ASO』。

vol.7は、阿蘇の春の味覚「阿蘇高菜」です。

阿蘇高菜はアブラナ科のカラシナという品種で、寒暖の差が激しい阿蘇特有の自然と、火山灰を含んだ土壌で育ちます。
10月に種をまき、雪の下で冬を越して、3～4月に収穫される阿蘇高菜。その収穫方法は、一本一本手で茎を折っていくことから「高菜折り」と呼ばれています。春の麗らかな日、阿蘇地方では高菜畑で高菜折りをする風景がよく見られます。
収穫後はすぐに漬物にします。塩と鷹の爪などを揉みこんで漬け込み、1週間もすればピリッとした辛さとシャキシャキとした歯ごたえがたまらない新漬けが味わえます。

収穫のポキポキという高菜折りの音や、漬け込み作業で塩を揉みこむ時の音もお楽しみください。

title: [Nature 4K] 'Aso Aso Takana' High-Quality Healing Video
description:
A series capturing the rich landscapes of Aso with a 4K camera, 'SCENE of the ASO'.

Vol.7 features the spring delicacy of Aso, 'Aso Takana'.

Aso Takana is a variety of mustard plant from the Brassicaceae family, grown in the unique natural environment of Aso, characterized by significant temperature differences and volcanic ash-rich soil.
Seeds are sown in October, overwintering under the snow, and harvested from March to April. The harvesting method, where each stem is snapped by hand, is called 'Takana-ori'. On beautiful spring days, the sight of Takana-ori in the fields of Aso is commonly seen.
After harvesting, it is immediately pickled. By rubbing in salt and chili peppers, within a week, you can enjoy the crisp texture and delightful spiciness of the freshly pickled Takana.

Enjoy the sound of the snapping Takana during the harvest and the noise of rubbing in salt during the pickling process.

description:
Iwate Short-Horned Cattle is...
Among the beef cattle distributed in Japan, it is the elusive wagyu 'Japanese Short-Horned Breed' that accounts for only about 0.4%. Iwate Prefecture is said to be the birthplace of the Japanese Short-Horned Breed and is also the largest production area in the country.

The 'Summer Mountain and Winter Village Method' allows both mother and calf to live in the pasture from spring to autumn.
Calves spend about six months in the pasture with their mothers, after which they are raised in barns as beef cattle and provided to everyone as delicious meat.

Please enjoy the scenery of the summer mountains nurtured by the majestic nature.

description:
いわて短角牛とは……
国内で牛肉として流通する牛のうち、わずか0.4％足らずという幻の和牛『日本短角種』。岩手県は日本短角種発祥の地といわれ、国内最大の産地でもあります。

岩手県久慈市では、東北地方唯一の闘牛大会が開催されています。
この地方では、古くは藩政時代（江戸時代）、沿岸部で生産された塩を、在来の「南部牛」に乗せて内陸の盛岡方面へ運んでいました（塩の道）。その隊列の先頭牛（ワガサ）を決めるため、牛に角突きをさせたのが闘牛の始まりとされています。
現在のように観光行事化されたのは昭和58年からです。（久慈市HPより）

※南部牛は、明治の開国により海外品種との交配が行われ、昭和32年に４番目の和牛「日本短角種」として品種登録。

title: Iwate Short-Horned Cattle - Hiraniwa Bullfighting -
description:
Iwate Short-Horned Cattle is...
Among the beef cattle distributed in Japan, the elusive wagyu 'Japanese Short-Horned Breed' accounts for only about 0.4%. Iwate Prefecture is said to be the birthplace of the Japanese Short-Horned Breed and is also the largest production area in the country.

In Kuji City, Iwate Prefecture, the only bullfighting tournament in the Tohoku region is held.
In this region, dating back to the feudal era (Edo period), salt produced along the coast was transported inland to Morioka on the backs of the native 'Nanbu Cattle' (Salt Road). It is said that bullfighting began when bulls were made to butt heads to determine the lead bull (Wagasa) of the procession.
The event became a tourist attraction starting in 1983. (From Kuji City HP)

*Nanbu Cattle were crossbred with foreign breeds due to the opening of Japan in the Meiji era, and were registered as the fourth wagyu breed 'Japanese Short-Horned Breed' in 1957.

Good evening. It's time for Kame TV. This time, we have a shorter, PV-style video. To be honest, the next Night Edition EP2 is better, but in order of title, I'm uploading from EP1. So, the next one is even better, so please look forward to it.
But EP1 is also quite good, so please do watch it ☀️

Now that I think about it, my knowledge of video and filming techniques has been self-taught by watching various creative works on YouTube, learning about filming and editing methods, but it's quite difficult... 

However, I realize that it's important to imagine how to edit while filming. This time, while editing the Nagasaki Lantern, I really feel that way. 
While filming... I thought about editing, and I want to keep that in mind for the next shoot. Yes, yes.

In that sense, the next Night Edition EP2 will be the last for the 2020 Nagasaki Lantern Festival. Yes.

Well then, see you again ☀️

Thank you for your hard work today 🌴

Peace ✌️

[Goto Guest House KAME]

title: 【長崎ランタンフェスティバル】2020 想像以上の異国をご覧あれ❗️
description:
#長崎ランタンフェスティバル　#長崎ランタン　#長崎中華街
はい、こんにちは。
ちょっとペースが早目ですが、旬のうちにと思いアップします。
20年ぶりにランタンに行きましたが、その当時は学生だったので
原付かなんかで仲間と国家試験前に行ったことを思い出しました笑

想像以上のライトアップと規模で、びっくりしました。
コロナウィルスやインフルが心配なので動画ではマスク着用していますが、
ご容赦ください☀️

しばらくは、ランタンの様子をアップしていますので良かったら次回や前作の動画も見ていただけるとうれしいです。

　それでは、最高のランタンをご覧ください

　ピース✌️

【五島ゲストハウスKAME】

title: [Nagasaki Lantern Festival] 2020, Experience an Unexpected Foreign Land❗️
description:
#NagasakiLanternFestival #NagasakiLantern #NagasakiChinatown
Hello, everyone.
I'm posting this a bit quickly, but I wanted to share it while it's still relevant.
I went to the lantern festival for the first time in 20 years, and back then I was a student, so I remember going with friends on a scooter before our national exams, haha.

I was surprised by the lighting and scale, which exceeded my expectations.
I'm wearing a mask in the video due to concerns about the coronavirus and influenza, so I hope you understand ☀️

For a while, I'll be uploading videos of the lantern festival, so I would be happy if you could also check out my next video or previous works.

Now, enjoy the amazing lanterns!

Peace✌️

title: 佐渡の極み Vol. 3: 究極の街歩き - 港町小木の町並みと歴史 -
description:
「佐渡の極み」、または究極の佐渡は、佐渡に住み、佐渡を愛し、佐渡を極めた人々を通じて、佐渡の冒険観光を紹介します。
第3巻では、街歩きガイドの笠井に導かれ、佐渡でしか味わえない究極の体験である港町小木の魅力と歴史的な町並みを見ていきます！

* 冒険観光は、「自然、アクティビティ、文化」の3つの要素のうち少なくとも2つを含む体験を通じて、場所の魅力をより深く楽しむことができる観光の一形態です！

#新潟 #佐渡 #冒険観光 #小木 #ウォーキング

title: SADO NO KIWAMI Vol. 3: Ultimate City Walking -The Townscape and History of the Port Town Ogimachi-
description:
“SADO NO KIWAMI”, or Ultimate Sado, showcases adventure tourism on Sado through those who live in Sado, love Sado, and have mastered Sado.
In volume 3, we will be led by the city walking guide Kasai to see the charms and historic townscape of the port town Ogi, another ultimate experience found only on Sado!

* Adventure tourism is a form of tourism that lets you enjoy the charms of a place more deeply by having an experience consisting of at least two of the three elements: “nature, activity, and culture”!

#niigata #sado #adventure tourism #Ogi #walking

title: 愛媛県 宇和島市 和霊神社(2019.9.19)
description:
漁業を中心に広く産業の神として、中四国で崇められている和霊信仰。その総本山といえるのが和霊神社です。愛媛県宇和島市にあります。雰囲気のある神社でパワーを貰えそうですが観光のお客様は少なめです。是非、いらしてくださいね。

title: Uwajima City, Ehime Prefecture, Warei Shrine (2019.9.19)
description:
Warei faith, revered as the god of industry centered around fishing, is widely worshipped in the Chugoku and Shikoku regions. The Warei Shrine can be said to be its main temple. It is located in Uwajima City, Ehime Prefecture. The shrine has a charming atmosphere that seems to offer power, but there are relatively few tourists. Please do come and visit.

Uwajima City Tourism and Products Association Warei Shrine
http://www.uwajima.org/spot/index3.html
Uwajima City Official Website
https://www.city.uwajima.ehime.jp/
For accommodation, Uwajima Oriental Hotel
https://www.oriental-web.co.jp/uwajima/

title: 大佐渡石名天然杉遊歩道【夏編】
description:
大佐渡山脈の北部にある県有林石名団地には、特異な形状の巨杉が生育しています。
新潟県では、この雄大な天然杉を安全にご覧いただけるように遊歩道を整備しました。
起伏の少ないコースなので、子どもの自然学習の場としても安心してお薦めできます。

title: Ogasawara Ishina Natural Cedar Walking Path [Summer Edition]
description:
In the Ishina district of the prefectural forest located in the northern part of the Ogasawara mountain range, unique-shaped giant cedars are growing.
In Niigata Prefecture, a walking path has been developed to allow visitors to safely view these magnificent natural cedars.
The course has little elevation change, making it a safe and recommended place for children's nature learning.

title: 大佐渡石名天然杉遊歩道【霧編】
description:
大佐渡山脈の北部にある県有林石名団地には、特異な形状の巨杉が生育しています。
新潟県では、この雄大な天然杉を安全にご覧いただけるように遊歩道を整備しました。
霧に包まれた幻想的な森で、じっとり露に濡れた樹皮をまとう杉の巨木をご覧いただけます。

title: Ogasawara Ishina Natural Cedar Walking Path [Fog Edition]
description:
In the Ishina district of the prefectural forest located in the northern part of the Ogasawara mountain range, unique-shaped giant cedars are growing.
In Niigata Prefecture, a walking path has been developed to allow visitors to safely view these magnificent natural cedars.
In a fantastical forest shrouded in mist, you can see the giant cedars draped in dewy bark.

title: 大佐渡石名天然杉遊歩道【秋編】
description:
大佐渡山脈の北部にある県有林石名団地には、特異な形状の巨杉が生育しています。
新潟県では、この雄大な天然杉を安全にご覧いただけるように遊歩道を整備しました。
澄み切った秋空と色づく木々の中、天然杉の雄大さがひときわ存在感を増して見られます。

title: Ogasawara Ishina Natural Cedar Walking Path [Autumn Edition]
description:
In the Ishina district of the prefectural forest located in the northern part of the Ogasawara Mountains, unique-shaped giant cedars are growing.
In Niigata Prefecture, a walking path has been developed to allow visitors to safely view these magnificent natural cedars.
Amidst the clear autumn sky and the colorful trees, the grandeur of the natural cedars stands out even more.

description:
This is a promotional video to introduce various tourist attractions of Tokyo Chuo City.
The "Walk" version of the video shows a day in Chuo City from the perspective of a visitor, walking around and seeing the sights. It captures areas representative of Chuo City, including Nihonbashi, Ningyocho, Ginza, Tsukiji, Tsukuda and Tsukishima, from the perspective of a pedestrian on the street. Take a stroll through the varied scenes of Chuo City, feel the traditions of history and touch upon the latest trends.

The "Colors" version of the video takes famous spots within the city and, based on the concept of imparting the interweaving of Japan with the seasons, maximizes their appeal, from spectacular buildings to spectacular scenery. A variety of techniques are used to really bring out the unique beauty and characteristics of each subject, including time-lapse and drone photography, creating truly bold footage. Get a feel for the beautiful colors of the seasons in the heart of Tokyo, with stunning imagery that requires no further words depicted on an awe-inspiring scale.

title: Uwajima Ushi-Oni Festival Fireworks Display (2023.7.23)
description:
I went to see the fireworks display at the Uwajima Ushi-Oni Festival.
It was about a 40-minute fireworks show from 8:30 to 9:10, but during that time, the main camera had some troubles and stopped recording due to overheating, making for a challenging 40 minutes. However, I managed to stitch together the footage that was captured into a video just under 9 minutes long.

As for my impressions of the fireworks, I thought they were generally positioned low, but then some went up to heights that far exceeded the frame, which seemed to be a bit of a challenge for the person filming. Although I was using a 360° camera, so I didn't miss the frame, there were many parts in the editing that had to be cropped out. The overall composition could have been better, I think.
It might be understandable since it was the first event in several years. I look forward to next year.

Filming equipment: Insta360 One X2

title: Ozu City Shōhikona Shrine (2023.12.19)
description:
I visited the Shōhikona Shrine in Ozu City.
Unfortunately, it was raining, but I really wanted to see the shrine's worship hall, so I made the trip.
The scaffolding for the construction was impressive and caught my attention.

Due to the impact of the Hijikawa river improvement work, it seemed that not many people visit, and the main hall was somewhat neglected, which was disappointing.

眼下に広がる雲海、なんかいつまでも見てられる。

description:
I visited the Tomisuyama Park Observatory in Ozu City.
The sea of clouds spread out below is something you can watch forever.
I’m really surprised that such a breathtaking view can be seen just 5 minutes from outside Ozu City.

Before 10:00, the clouds began to clear, and the city of Ozu started to come into view.

description:

I traveled from Uwajima City to Kōchi Prefecture via Kihoku and Tōyama. It took about 3 hours.

The exhibition had many vehicles that are irresistible for supercar enthusiasts.

Personally, I thought the Dino and Crown were the best.

title: 宇和島闘牛 和霊大祭場所 厳選見どころ(2024.7.23)
description:

猛暑の中、吹き抜け闘牛場の中での開催です・・・暑っ！
12番の取り組みの予定が猛暑で体調を崩した牛さんがいたため11番となりました。
ハプニングがあったり戦う意思が低い闘牛がいたりと色々ありましたがその中での見所を厳選して編集しております。

この動画を見て次回の闘牛に行きたいなぁと思っていただければ幸いです。

title: Uwajima Bullfighting Wale Festival Venue Highlights (2024.7.23)
description:
I attended the Uwajima Bullfighting Tournament, which is being held for the first time in five years in conjunction with the Wale Festival.
In the scorching heat, it took place in the open-air bullfighting arena... so hot!
The 12th match was scheduled, but due to a bull that fell ill from the heat, it became the 11th match instead.
There were various incidents and some bulls that seemed less willing to fight, but I have carefully edited the highlights from those moments.

I hope this video makes you want to attend the next bullfighting event.

title: Uwajima City, Yuko Mizunoura Terraced Rice Fields (2025.4.30)
description:
On the last day of April, I went to the terraced rice fields of Yuko Mizunoura.
If you drive for about 20 minutes from the city towards the Miura Peninsula, you will see the magnificent terraced fields.
I think Uwajima City is quite promoting it, but it seems that it hasn't led to an increase in tourists. On weekends and holidays, the 'Dandan Chaya' located in the parking lot at the foot of the terraced fields is open, allowing you to enjoy meals such as Uwajima Tai-meshi (sea bream rice) (please check separately for business hours).

Why not feel the eternal time in the magnificent terraced fields carved into the mountainside?

At 'Dandan Chaya', they have been playing music created by the Meekan Channel as in-store music since before the CD 'KISAIYA Uwajima' was made, so I support them.

title: 宇和島闘牛５月場所(2025.5.3)
description:
年に4回の 晴れ舞台のひとつ。
宇和島闘牛5月場所が2025年5月3日に行われました。
闘牛のルールは制限時間なしで牛同士が戦い、逃げた方が敗けというシンプルなものになっています。
お天気も良くゴールデンウィークということで入場者数は2400人を超える大入満員大盛況のうちに幕を閉じました。
2時間半に渡る長丁場でありましたが主な戦いの箇所をまとめました。
闘牛の魅力が少しでも伝われば良いかなと思っています。

title: Castle in the Sky - Uwajima Castle - (2025.8.6)
description:
I climbed Uwajima Castle.
In this heat, I shouldn't have, but I somehow wanted to see the castle.
I regretted it greatly while climbing (^^;
It was hot, I lost weight, I was tired... haha.
I was thinking of cuts to match the song while climbing, but after the museum, I couldn't focus on that anymore.
It was too hot.
Since I was there, I arranged the BGM for "Castle in the Sky - Uwajima Castle -" in an Infinite Castle Mix.
The first half is inspired by the tension leading up to the departure.
The song starts a cappella and the orchestra gradually joins in.
In the midsummer, Uwajima Castle was... a private experience without encountering other tourists (^^)

title: 県南浜街道地域（名取市，岩沼市，亘理町，山元町）観光案内動画（台湾語版）
description:
宮城県仙台地方振興事務所では，東日本大震災で甚大な被害を受けた県南浜街道地域（名取市，岩沼市，亘理町，山元町）に１人でも多くの観光客に足を運んでもらいたいという願いを込め，それぞれの市町が持っている魅力的な自然や観光施設，復興の様子などについて紹介した動画を制作しました。
　ドローンで撮影した迫力ある映像で，県南浜街道地域の魅力を発信していますので，ぜひご覧ください。

title: Kennan Hamakaido Region (Natori City, Iwanuma City, Watari Town, Yamamoto Town) Tourism Promotion Video (Taiwanese Version)
description:

The video features powerful footage shot with a drone, showcasing the charm of the Kennan Hamakaido region, so please take a look.

title: 日本の日光で訪れるべき場所 | 湯滝 | 旅行ガイド
description:
#nikko #yudakifalls #japantravel #japanvlog #visitjapanjp #mybestjapanmoments #japantour

湯滝は、栃木県日光市の奥日光エリアにある滝です。高さ50メートル（164フィート）、幅25メートル（82フィート）で、華厳の滝や竜頭の滝と並ぶ奥日光の三大滝の一つです。日本の100名山の一つである日光白根山の麓に位置する湯ノ湖の南岸から流れ落ちています。湯ノ湖の岸には日光湯元温泉があり、湯ノ湖エリア全体には温泉が点在していますが、湯滝はその名に反して温泉水ではなく冷水が流れています（湯=温水、滝=滝）。滝の水は湯川となり、日本の高地湿原の一つである仙女ヶ原湿原を流れ、竜頭の滝を経て中禅寺湖に流れ込みます。湯滝の側には遊歩道が整備されており、滝の口、盆地、側面など、滝の三つのポイントを観賞することができます。展望デッキから滝の盆地を間近で見ることは特に意義深い体験です。

title: Places to Visit in Nikko Japan | Yudaki Falls | Travel Guide
description:
#nikko #yudakifalls #japantravel #japanvlog #visitjapanjp #mybestjapanmoments #japantour

Yudaki Falls is a waterfall in the Oku-Nikko area of Nikko City, Tochigi Prefecture. Measuring 50 meters (164 feet) high and 25 meters (82 feet) wide, it is one of the three major waterfalls in Oku-Nikko along with Kegon Falls and Ryuzu Falls. It flows down from the south shore of Lake Yuno-ko, which is located at the foot of Mt. Nikko-Shirane, one of Japan's 100 Major Mountains. There is Nikko Yumoto Onsen on the banks of Lake Yuno-ko, and the entire Yuno-ko area has hot springs all over the place, but it is not hot water but cold water that flows down the Yudaki despite of its name Yudaki aka Yutaki (Yu=hot water, daki/taki=waterfall). The water from the waterfall becomes the River Yukawa, which flows through one of Japan's most prominent wetland of high elevation, Senjo-gahara Marshland, then flows down the Ryuzu Falls to Lake Chuzenji-ko. A promenade is provided on the side of the Yudaki Falls, from where you can watch three points of the waterfall such as its mouth, basin and side. Watching the waterfall basin up close from the observation deck is expecially significant.

title: Chair Lift Ride at Mount Takao (Ascend) | Japan's Steepest Slope | 高尾山　チェアリフト
description:
#mttakao #chairlift #japan #mttakoadventures #steepestslopeinjapan #mttakaochairlift #japanadventures #mybestjapanmoments #visitjapanjp #viaggiatotravelservices

Mount Takao (高尾山, Takao-san) is a mountain in the city of Hachiōji, Tokyo, Japan. It is protected within Meiji no Mori Takao Quasi-National Park.

Standing 599 metres (1,965 ft) tall and located within an hour of downtown Tokyo, it is a popular hiking spot, with eight hiking courses and more than 2.5 million annual visitors. The Tama Forest Science Garden is also located at the mountain's base.

THE CHAIR LIFT RIDE

In addition to the cable car Mt. Takao also has a chair lift that you can ride to the midway point of the mountain!
The ride time is about 12 minutes so why not enjoy an aerial trip through the mountains?

The distance from “Sanroku Station” at the foot of the mountain to “Sanjo Station” in the middle is about 872m, which is shorter than the distance the cable car travels (The cable car travels a total of 1,020m).

title: Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome | Annual Halloween Pumpkin Month | 夢の島熱帯植物館| ハロウィーンのカボチャ
description:
#yumenoshimatropicalgreenhousedome #halloweentheme #pumpkinpatch #夢の島熱帯植物館 #ハロウィーンのカボチャ
Today we’re gonna explore the Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome.

The Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome was created to cover this broad theme of “the relationship between tropical plants and our lives.”
Enjoy the exotic scenery created by the wide variety of tropical plants in the large greenhouse. Learn about the plants and the tropics in the Movie Theater, Information Gallery, and Exhibition Hall. Take a full tour of the museum and learn about the relationship between tropical plants and human life without even realizing it.
Guided tours are offered on Saturdays, Sundays, national holidays, and during long vacations. Enjoy a fun tour while learning in detail about the plants in the greenhouse.

"The Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome (夢の島熱帯植物館, Yumenoshima Nettai Shokubutsukan), also sometimes called the Yumenoshima Tropical Plant Dome, is a botanical garden located at 3-2, Yumenoshima, Kōtō, Tokyo, Japan. It is operated by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association and open daily except Mondays; an admission fee is charged.

The greenhouse was established in 1988 in Yumenoshima ("Dream Island") Park, a reclaimed landfill and dumping ground in Tokyo Bay. Its three domes currently contain about 1,000 species of tropical and semitropical plants. The A Dome features rain forest with ferns and waterfall, B Dome represents a tropical village, and C Dome contains vegetation of the Ogasawara Islands. There is also a small carnivorous plant room.

The domes' plant collections include palms, orchids, aquatic plants, Pandanus, Hevea brasiliensis, Samanea saman, Barringtonia racemosa, Satakentia liukiuensis, Cyathea lepifera, C. mertensiana, C. spinulosa, and Dicksonia antarctica." -Wikipedia

Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome is celebrating their annual Halloween Pumpkin Month from end of September to First of November. You will see their Halloween theme all around the area, inside the museum and on their front lawn or garden are giant pumpkins where you and your kids can play around. Enjoy and shoot lovely Autumn and Halloween photos which will be a great memorabilia for you and your kids! 

10 minute walk from Shin-Kiba Station, which is 10 minutes from Tokyo Station on the Keiyo Line. Also accessible on the Yurakucho Line.

Fees:  Adults 250 yen,
Ages 65 yrs old and older 120 yen, 
Ages 13–15 yrs old 100 yen. 
Under 12 yrs old are FREE!

Address: 2 Chome-1 Yumenoshima, Koto City, Tokyo 136-0081

Phone Number: 03-3522-0281

title: Giant Halloween Pumpkins 2021 at Yumenoshima | Halloween Pumpkins | Halloween Party | ハロウィンパーティー2021
description:
#yumenoshimahalloweenparty2021 #halloweenpumpkins #halloweenintokyo #halloween2021

Welcome back to Yumenoshima tropical greenhouse dome. As you can see on our last posted video, Daddy and i were here and we enjoyed much with the tropical plants in the dome. And since Jt was not with us that day, we went back here today and we will be enjoying with the giant halloween pumpkins. 

An exhibition of these giant ghost pumpkins, which they call Yumenoshima halloween party, is celebrated and very popular every year. And since the halloween is just around the corner, this event is already happening right now. It started on the 22nd of September and will last until the 31st of October. 

They will exhibit more than 100 giant ghost pumpkins weighing 50 to 100 kilograms. Can you imagine how heavy and big is that? These giant pumpkins were made in Hitachiomiya City, in Ibaraki Prefecture, in connection with the Halloween. 

With an admission fee of 250 yen for each adult, you can roam around the greenhouse dome, learn and enjoy the tropical plants which you barely see everyday. Kids under 12 years old can enter free of charge. And for sure your toddlers will have fun with these giant ghost pumpkins all around the open garden. There will also be a photography area just inside the hall with the halloween backdrops. So you better grab your favorite halloween costumes and get ready for memorable photos.

You can also bring your own food and have a small picnic in the garden together with these ghost pumpkins, orrr, you can just go to the cafeteria inside the hall and grab any food of your choice.

Event Date and Hours: 
September 22– Sunday,Tuesday–Sunday  9:30 – 17:00 (Last entry 16:00). Closed on Monday. If Monday is a public holiday they will open and close on Tuesday.

Cost: Fees: Adults 250 yen, Ages 65 and older 120 yen, Ages 13–15 100 yen
Under 12 FREE!

Address: 2-1-2 Yumenoshima, Koto-ku
Phone: 03-3522-0281
Website: http://www.yumenoshima.jp/

Note: this is in Japanese language. You can use google chrome too as it has an automatic translator if you wish to view it in English.

Access: 10 minute walk from Shin-Kiba Station, which is 10 minutes from Tokyo Station on the Keiyo Line. Also accessible on the Yurakucho Line.

You can also access the Metro Tozai line’s Toyocho Station and take the Toei Bus going to Shinkiba, get off at the Yumenoshima Stop and from there you can walk 7mins to Greenhouse Dome.

Notes: Nursing room and Diaper changing table located in the Botanical Garden. Please ask the staff for directions.

title: 青森市通年観光PR動画（3分編）
description:
青森市の、八甲田連峰や陸奥湾などの美しい自然と、
その豊かな自然の中で育まれてきた豊富で多彩な食に加
えて、世界に誇る青森ねぶた祭や三内丸山遺跡をはじめ
とした縄文遺跡、温泉などといった多種多様な魅力ある
観光資源がたっぷりあります。
四季を通じて楽しめる青森の魅力を、ぜひ動画でご覧ください。

title: Aomori City Year-Round Tourism PR Video (3-Minute Version)
description:
Aomori City boasts beautiful nature such as the Hakkoda Mountains and Mutsu Bay, 

along with a rich and diverse food culture nurtured by this abundant nature. 

In addition, there are various attractive tourism resources, including the world-renowned Aomori Nebuta Festival, 
the Sannai-Maruyama archaeological site, and hot springs. 

Please enjoy the charm of Aomori throughout the four seasons in the video.

title: 東広島の自然～豊栄・福富・河内～
description:
広島県の中央に位置する豊栄・福富・河内。
それぞれの町独特の自然風景をお楽しみください。
５月中旬～６月上旬はクロボヤ峡のホンシャクナゲ、
１０月下旬～１１月下旬は深山峡の紅葉が見頃を迎えます。

title: Nature of Higashihiroshima - Toyosaka, Fukutomi, Kawachi
description:
Toyosaka, Fukutomi, and Kawachi are located in the central part of Hiroshima Prefecture.
Enjoy the unique natural landscapes of each town.
From mid-May to early June, the Rhododendron in Kuroboya Gorge is in full bloom,
and from late October to late November, the autumn leaves in Miyama Gorge reach their peak.

title: 桜の名所　鏡山公園（東広島市）
description:
鏡山公園は、国史跡・鏡山城跡の麓に整備された公園で、30種余り約500本の桜が咲きほこる、東広島を代表する桜の名所の一つです。園内には、幾つかの池があり、美しい景観を見せてくれるほか、ウォーキングコースも設定され、晴れた日には健康づくりを兼ねた散策にもお勧めです。

■場所：東広島市鏡山2丁目
■アクセス
・JR山陽本線西条駅から広島大学方面行きのバスで約10分、「鏡山公園入口」バス停下車
・山陽自動車道西条ICから車で約20分
■駐車場：あり（220台、大型バスも可）

title: Famous Cherry Blossom Spot: Kagamiyama Park (Higashihiroshima City)
description:
Kagamiyama Park is a park developed at the foot of the national historic site, Kagamiyama Castle ruins, and is one of the representative cherry blossom spots in Higashihiroshima, featuring over 30 varieties and about 500 cherry trees in full bloom. The park has several ponds that offer beautiful scenery, and there are walking courses set up, making it a recommended spot for leisurely walks that also promote health on sunny days.

■Location: 2 Chome Kagamiyama, Higashihiroshima City
■Access
・About 10 minutes by bus from JR Sanyo Main Line Saijo Station heading towards Hiroshima University, get off at 'Kagamiyama Park Entrance' bus stop
・About 20 minutes by car from Sanyo Expressway Saijo IC
■Parking: Available (220 cars, large buses also allowed)

title: 元気になりに、いらっしゃい。【宮崎市】宮崎食堂ムービー｜一人旅編
description:
●宮崎食堂ホームページ
https://www.city.miyazaki.miyazaki.jp/miyazaki-shokudo/

宮崎市の魅力を発信するプロジェクト「宮崎食堂」のムービーができました。訪れた人が、青い空のもとで海・山の豊かな自然にふれ、地元で愛されるローカル食や人との交流を通じて元気になれる、宮崎市の魅力が詰まっています。

＜一人旅編＞
日々仕事に追われるビジネスパーソンが、仕事をしていたカフェで突然「宮崎食堂」ののれんに遭遇。のれんに自然と身体が引き込まれていくと、そこは！？

浜辺のバーガーハウスでテレワーク、ニシタチの温かい人達に宮崎のローカル食と”だれやみ”文化を教えてもらい、スナックで出会ったサーファーに誘われるまま青い海でいきなり波に乗る。明るい日差しの中でサクサク仕事を済ませた後には、浜辺でのんびりくつろぎタイム…。宮崎の開放感につつまれながら、人の温かさや食と自然の豊かさに触れ、充実した時間が過ごせる、宮崎食堂へ。

●音楽
　宮崎市出身の藤森元生さんがVo＆Gt.を務めるスリーピースロックバンドSAKANAMONが「宮崎食堂」のために書き下ろした楽曲“つつうららか”。“ローカルポップ”をテーマに制作され、軽快なリズムにのって次々と場面が転換していくムービーに仕上がっています。

「つつうららか　宮崎食堂Ver.」
　作詞：藤森元生
　作曲：藤森元生
　アーティスト：SAKANAMON


●宮崎食堂とは　
宮崎市は、食や自然、人の温かさなどの宮崎市の魅力が“ごちそう”であり
宮崎市全体を“ごちそうが集まっている場所＝食堂”に見立てた
「宮崎食堂」プロジェクトを推進しています。
「元気になりに、いらっしゃい。」を合言葉に、
地元のみなさまのご協力をいただきながら、
プロジェクトを盛り上げていきます。


●宮崎食堂ブランドステートメント
　宮崎市は大きな食堂だ。
　きばらす、ふらっと。
　旬や地元のとびきり
　おいしいものが
　気がるに手ごろに食べられる。
　海も山も空も風も
　ごちそうで
　だれでものんびり
　元気をとりもどせる。
　いつでも遊びに、いらっしゃい。
　いつもでも帰って、いらっしゃい。

title: Come to Get Energized. [Miyazaki City] Miyazaki Shokudo Movie | Solo Travel Edition
description:
●Miyazaki Shokudo Homepage
https://www.city.miyazaki.miyazaki.jp/miyazaki-shokudo/

A movie for the project "Miyazaki Shokudo," which promotes the charm of Miyazaki City, has been created. It is filled with the appeal of Miyazaki City, where visitors can get energized through rich nature of the sea and mountains under the blue sky, local foods loved by the community, and interactions with people.

<Solo Travel Edition>
A business person, overwhelmed by daily work, suddenly encounters the noren (curtain) of "Miyazaki Shokudo" at a café where they were working. As their body is naturally drawn to the noren, what awaits them there?!

Teleworking at a beach burger house, learning about Miyazaki's local food and "dareyami" culture from the warm-hearted people of Nishitachi, and being invited by a surfer met at a snack bar to suddenly ride the waves in the blue sea. After finishing work efficiently under the bright sunlight, it’s time to relax on the beach... Surrounded by the openness of Miyazaki, experiencing the warmth of people and the richness of food and nature, you can spend fulfilling time at Miyazaki Shokudo.

●Music
The three-piece rock band SAKANAMON, with Motoki Fujimori from Miyazaki City as the vocalist and guitarist, has written the song "Tsutsu Uraraka" for "Miyazaki Shokudo." Produced with the theme of "local pop," the movie transitions through various scenes with a lively rhythm.

"Tsutsu Uraraka Miyazaki Shokudo Ver."
Lyrics: Motoki Fujimori
Composition: Motoki Fujimori
Artist: SAKANAMON

●What is Miyazaki Shokudo
Miyazaki City promotes the project "Miyazaki Shokudo," which envisions the charm of Miyazaki City, such as food, nature, and the warmth of people, as a "feast" and likens the entire city to a "place where feasts gather = a dining hall." With the slogan "Come to Get Energized," we will enhance the project with the cooperation of local residents.

●Miyazaki Shokudo Brand Statement
Miyazaki City is a large dining hall.
Casually, spontaneously.
Seasonal and local delicacies

title: Miyazaki STYLE SHORT ver
description: This is a video showcasing the beautiful scenery of Aoshima in Miyazaki City.

title: 【高知県】土佐の匠 「尾戸焼」
description:
江戸時代から続く「尾戸焼」の継承者、谷信一郎さん。
あしもとの自然を活かしたものづくりへの思いを伺いました。

title: [Kochi Prefecture] Tosa's Artisan 'Odo-yaki'
description:
The successor of 'Odo-yaki' that has continued since the Edo period, Nobuichiro Tani.
We asked him about his thoughts on creating things that utilize the nature at his feet.

title: 高知家ええもん動画　土佐おもてなし勤王党リポート　高知城ガイド・前編
description:
今回、土佐おもてなし勤王党が案内するのは高知観光の王道スポット、「高知城」。
意外と知らない高知城の見どころを紹介しちゃいます！

title: Kochi Family Good Things Video: Tosa Hospitality Kinno Party Report - Kochi Castle Guide Part 1
description:
This time, the Tosa Hospitality Kinno Party will guide you to the classic sightseeing spot in Kochi, 'Kochi Castle'.
We will introduce some highlights of Kochi Castle that are surprisingly not well known!

title: 【高知県】土佐の匠 「土佐古代塗」
description:
気品と重厚感のある土佐独特の漆器「土佐古代塗」。
ただ一人受け継ぐ、池田泰一さんの職人の技をご覧あれ！

title: Kochi Prefecture: Tosa's Artisan 'Tosa Ancient Lacquer'
description:
The elegant and substantial Tosa's unique lacquerware 'Tosa Ancient Lacquer'.
Behold the craftsmanship of Mr. Taiichi Ikeda, the sole inheritor of this tradition!

title: 【高知県】土佐の匠 「フラフ」
description:
空を彩る大きな旗「フラフ」。
主に高知市から東部でよく見られるこの旗は、子どもの健やかな成長を願って鯉のぼり等と一緒にあげられます。

title: Kochi Prefecture: Tosa's Artisan 'Hrafu'
description:
A large flag 'Hrafu' that colors the sky.
This flag, often seen in the eastern part of Kochi City, is raised alongside carp streamers and others to wish for the healthy growth of children.

title: 小倉城周辺エリア
description: 小倉北区の中心部には、小倉城、北九州市役所、勝山公園などがあります。また街の中心部を流れる「紫川」には紫川自然再生のシンボルとして自然をテーマにしてデザインされた橋が10本かかっており、都心部の風景に溶け込んでいます。

title: Kokura Castle Area
description: In the center of Kokura Kita Ward, there are Kokura Castle, Kitakyushu City Hall, and Katsuyama Park. Additionally, the 'Murasaki River' flowing through the city center features 10 bridges designed with a nature theme as symbols of the Murasaki River's natural restoration, blending seamlessly into the urban landscape.

title: 平尾台
description: 小倉南区の平尾台は国の点々記念物に指定された日本三大カルストの１つで多くの石灰岩が散在する風景は草原に遊ぶ羊の群れを思わせる。ほかにも平尾台の雄大な風景を一望できる大型公園「平尾台自然の郷」、鍾乳洞など自然を満喫することができます。

title: Hiraodai
description: Hiraodai in Kokura Minami Ward is one of Japan's three major karsts designated as a national monument, and the landscape scattered with limestone evokes images of flocks of sheep grazing on the grasslands. Additionally, you can enjoy nature at the large park 'Hiraodai Nature Village,' which offers a panoramic view of the magnificent scenery of Hiraodai, as well as limestone caves and other natural attractions.

title: 関門地域（下関・門司港レトロ）　ドローン撮影映像（３分Ｖｅｒ）
description: 関門海峡で繋がる下関と門司港（関門地域）の観光スポットを３分にギュッと詰め込みました。連絡船を利用すれば５分で渡れる距離ですが、街の雰囲気は似ているようで違います。それぞれの街の歴史を感じられる映像になっていますので、ぜひ比べて違いを楽しんでみてください。

title: Kanmon Area (Shimonoseki & Mojiko Retro) Drone Footage (3-Minute Version)
description: This video condenses the tourist spots of Shimonoseki and Mojiko (Kanmon Area), connected by the Kanmon Strait, into three minutes. Although it's only a five-minute ferry ride between the two, the atmosphere of each town is similar yet distinct. The footage captures the history of each town, so please enjoy comparing and discovering their differences.

title: 若戸大橋周辺エリア
description: 洞海湾にかかる赤色の若戸大橋、市民の足「若戸渡船」は懐かしさだ漂うエリア。かつて日本一の石炭の積出港として栄えた若松南海岸通りには、石炭会館、旧古河鉱業ビルなどの近代建築があり、かつての繁栄の面影が今も残っています。

title: Wakato Bridge Area
description: The red Wakato Bridge spanning the Dokai Bay and the 'Wakato Ferry', a means of transport for the citizens, create a nostalgic atmosphere in the area. Once flourishing as Japan's top coal shipping port, the Wakamatsu Nankai Coast Road features modern architecture such as the Coal Hall and the old Furukawa Mining Building, which still bear the traces of its former prosperity.

title: 皿倉山
description: 標高６２２ｍの皿倉山。山麓駅から山頂駅まででケーブルカー、スロープカー乗継いで約10分で登ることができます。新日本三大夜景の１つで、市街地や工場群を一望できる絶景は「100億ドルの夜景」と言われています。

title: Mount Sarakura
description: Mount Sarakura, with an elevation of 622 meters. You can reach the summit station from the base station in about 10 minutes by transferring between the cable car and the slope car. It is one of the New Three Great Night Views of Japan, and the spectacular view overlooking the city and industrial complexes is said to be the '100 Billion Dollar Night View.'

title: 門司港レトロ
description: 明治後半から国際貿易港として栄えた門司港。今も当時の面影を残すレトロな建物が数多く立ち並び、北九州市内屈指の観光スポットとして多くの観光客が訪れます。春～秋にかけて門司港レトロ～和布刈間を走る観光列車「北九州銀行レトロライン潮風号」は日本一短い区間（２．１ｋｍ）を日本一遅い速度（１５ｋｍ/ｈ）で走ります。

title: Moji Port Retro
description:
Moji Port, which flourished as an international trade port from the late Meiji period. 
Even now, many retro buildings that retain the atmosphere of that time stand side by side, attracting many tourists as one of the top sightseeing spots in Kitakyushu City. 
From spring to autumn, the sightseeing train 'Kitakyushu Bank Retro Line Shio Kaze-go' runs between Moji Port Retro and Wabukari, covering the shortest distance in Japan (2.1 km) at the slowest speed in Japan (15 km/h).

title: 長崎街道
description: 豊前小倉と長崎を結ぶ長崎街道。その起点となる、「城下町小倉」には「常盤橋」、長崎街道の面影が残る「曲里の松並木」、黒崎宿と木屋瀬宿間の休憩場所として参勤交代の諸大名・長崎奉行などが使った「立場茶屋銀杏屋」、宿場町として栄えた木屋瀬の資料等が残る「木屋瀬宿記念館」などがあります。

title: Nagasaki Highway
description: The Nagasaki Highway connects Buzen Kokura and Nagasaki. At its starting point, 'Castle Town Kokura,' there is 'Tokiwa Bridge,' the 'Pine Tree Avenue of Kyukuri' that retains the traces of the Nagasaki Highway, 'Tachiba Chaya Ginkgo,' a resting place used by various feudal lords and the Nagasaki magistrate during the Sankin-kotai system between Kurozaki-juku and Kiyase-juku, and the 'Kiyase-juku Memorial Museum,' which preserves materials related to the prosperous post town of Kiyase.

title: 河内・合馬周辺エリア
description: 八幡東区にある河内貯水池は製鐵様子の確保のため大正８年から８年の歳月をかけ建設された貯水池。奥にある赤い「南河内大橋」は国の重要文化財に指定されています。小倉南区の合馬地区は合馬竹林公園や、菅生の滝、三岳梅林公園などの自然を満喫できるスポットがたくさんあります。

title: Kawachi and Aiba Area
description: Kawachi Reservoir, located in Yahatanihonmachi, is a reservoir constructed over eight years starting in 1919 to secure the supply of iron manufacturing. The red 'Minamikawachi Bridge' in the background is designated as an Important Cultural Property of the country. The Aiba area in Kokura Minami Ward has many spots where you can enjoy nature, such as Aiba Bamboo Grove Park, Suga Falls, and Mitake Plum Grove Park.

title: 若松北海岸・グリーンパークほか
description: 若松区北海岸には海水浴場としてにぎわう脇田（わいた）海岸や、マリーンパーク、頓田貯水池などがあります。動物や季節の花を楽しめる響灘緑地｜グリーンパーク、約３００頭を飼育している日本一のカンガルー王国のひびき動物ワールドは多くの家族連れでにぎわいます。

title: Wakamatsu North Coast and Green Park, etc.
description: The Wakamatsu North Coast features popular spots such as Waita Beach, a bustling swimming area, Marine Park, and Tonda Reservoir. Hibikinada Green Space | Green Park, where you can enjoy animals and seasonal flowers, and Hibiki Animal World, home to Japan's largest kangaroo kingdom with about 300 kangaroos, attracts many families.

スターフライヤーのCAや北九州看板娘がナビゲーターとして、

title: 【天城峠】『伊豆の踊子』の物語をたどる旅《東京駅→修善寺駅→伊豆急下田駅》 12/12-101
description:
今度の３月から、伊豆方面へのJR特急が大きく変容することの記念として、12月に伊豆へ行ってきました。特急踊り子号についてよく知りたいと思っていたので、予めモデルになった、川端康成の小説『伊豆の踊子』を熟読し、川端康成とほぼ同じ行程の旅をしました。途中宿泊した湯ケ野温泉「福田家」さんは、川端康成の泊まった部屋がそのまま残っており、宿自体は明治初頭のものであるなど、立派な文化財でした。

なお、ルートは
東京駅（特急踊り子）→修善寺駅（東海バス）→浄蓮の滝→伊豆近代文学館→旧天城トンネル→天城峠→湯ケ野温泉・福田屋→河津駅（特急踊り子）→伊豆急下田駅（特急スーパービュー踊り子）→東京駅

で、南伊豆フリー乗車券みたいな名前の割引乗車券を利用しました。

宿泊した福田家さん→https://bit.ly/34WtBSe


2020年12月12日

title: [Amagi Pass] A Journey Following the Story of 'The Dancing Girl of Izu' {Tokyo Station → Shuzenji Station → Izukyu Shimoda Station} 12/12-101
description:
In December, I traveled to Izu to commemorate the significant changes to the JR Limited Express services to the Izu area starting this March. I had always wanted to learn more about the Limited Express Odoriko, so I thoroughly read the novel 'The Dancing Girl of Izu' by Yasunari Kawabata, which served as the model for the journey, and followed a route nearly identical to Kawabata's. The accommodation I stayed at, Yukeno Onsen 'Fukudaya', still has the room where Kawabata stayed, and the inn itself is a splendid cultural asset dating back to the early Meiji period.

The route was:
Tokyo Station (Limited Express Odoriko) → Shuzenji Station (Tokaibus) → Joren Falls → Izu Modern Literature Museum → Old Amagi Tunnel → Amagi Pass → Yukeno Onsen, Fukudaya → Kawazu Station (Limited Express Odoriko) → Izukyu Shimoda Station (Limited Express Super View Odoriko) → Tokyo Station

I used a discount ticket that had a name similar to 'Minami Izu Free Ride Ticket'.

Accommodation at Fukudaya → https://bit.ly/34WtBSe

December 12, 2020

I travel about 200 days a year and post travelogues as well as reviews of tourist spots, hotels, and inns. I hope this can serve as a reference for your enjoyable travels.

title: [Accelerating Decline] A Retro Hot Spring Town Where Time Stands Still, Quietly Nestled in the Mountains! A Nostalgic Journey Enjoying Hidden Hot Springs and Townscapes. A Hidden Tourist Spot in Kagoshima Prefecture: 'Kawauchitakajo Onsen'
description:
By turning on the subtitles, descriptions and other information will be displayed.

This time, we visit Kawauchitakajo Onsen, located in the hidden mountains of Kagoshima Prefecture.
It is a hot spring town that is declining not due to the collapse of the bubble economy, but simply due to depopulation and a lack of successors.
The nostalgic retro townscape exudes an atmosphere that can only be produced by history, and it is a precious landscape that remains to this day.
While I don't wish for it to be bustling, it is certainly a wonderful townscape and high-quality hot spring that I would like to see preserved for future generations.
